school: not Chan — a 4th-century scholar-monk; the roster's 'Early Chan' tag is an anachronism
bio: Pre-Chan scholar-monk of the Eastern Jin, lay surname Wei (衛). He entered the order at twelve and became a disciple of the Kuchean thaumaturge Fotucheng (佛圖澄); the Gaoseng zhuan says flatly 「事澄為師」. When the north collapsed he fled with his teacher, then taught for fifteen years at Xiangyang. Fu Jian of the Former Qin took Xiangyang expressly to get him, installed him at Wuchong monastery in Chang'an and treated him as a teacher. He worked chiefly on the Prajna literature, the Agamas and Abhidharma, compiled the first catalogue of Chinese Buddhist scriptures, and established the convention that monks take Shi (釋) as their surname.

teacher.kind: 本傳 (梁高僧傳卷5, 慧皎 c.530)
teacher.quote: 至鄴入中寺，遇佛圖澄，澄見而嗟歎，與語終日。眾見形貌不稱，咸共輕怪，澄曰：「此人遠識，非爾儔也。」因事澄為師。
teacher.note: 『因事澄為師』 — explicit master-service verb. This is a 傳 (biography), NOT a lamp record: 高僧傳 predates all lamp compilations by ~500 years.

teacher.kind: 道安法師傳 (出三藏記集卷15, 僧祐 c.515) — the EARLIEST surviving life
teacher.quote: 後為受具戒恣其遊方。至鄴入中寺遇佛圖澄。澄見而嗟歎。與語終日。…澄曰。此人遠識非爾儔也。
teacher.note: IMPORTANT: the earlier witness (515) says only 遇 (met) — it does NOT contain 事澄為師. That phrase is 慧皎's addition 15 years later. The teacher edge is real but the transmission verb is a 6th-c. editorial strengthening. Flagging honestly.

teacher.quote: 《高僧傳》卷5：「事澄為師」
teacher.note: DILA's citation is Gaoseng zhuan j.5 (T50n2059_p0351c17). ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 《高僧傳》卷5：「太陽竺法濟、并州支曇講《陰持入經》，安後從之受業。」
teacher.note: Two further teachers, 竺法濟 and 支曇講, under whom he studied the Yinchiru jing. Not transmission in the Chan sense.

dates.quote: birth +0314 依記錄推算; death 卒於符秦建元二十一年，東晉太元十年，年七十二。（佛光：5625）
dates.note: Roster gave floruit 312; DILA computes birth 314 from the recorded age of 72 at death.

school.note: DILA assigns him NO sect (no 禪宗 tag). He predates Chan. The roster's 'Early Chan' is unsupported.

bio.quote: 竺佛圖澄弟子。姓衛，為東晉佛教之中心人物。十二歲出家…嗣入佛圖澄之門，後北方大亂，與其師避於諸方，於湖北襄陽講說教化十五年。前秦苻堅聞其名，率兵攻襄陽，迎至長安，居五重寺，事以師禮。

notes: Systematized monastic rules, established Shi surname convention, created first catalogue of Chinese Buddhist scriptures.

bio: Fifth Patriarch of Chan. From Xunyang, or by other accounts Huangmei in Qizhou; lay surname Zhou. At seven he left home under the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin at Dongshan on Shuangfeng, and in 651 succeeded to his seat, whence the name 'East Mountain Dharma Gate' (東山法門). Under him the school's scriptural centre of gravity shifted from the Lankavatara to the Diamond Sutra. His two chief disciples, Shenxiu and Huineng, became the fountainheads of the Northern and Southern lines.

teacher.kind: 傳法寶紀 (唐 杜朏撰), the earliest Chan lineage document
teacher.quote: 惠可傳僧璨。僧璨傳道信。道信傳弘忍。弘忍傳法如。
teacher.note: Composed c.713 — within ~38 years of 弘忍's death (675), inside living memory. The verb is 傳 (transmitted), not 參/謁. The same text's roster (lb 1291c03) lists 「唐雙峯山東山寺釋道信 / 唐雙峯山東山寺釋弘忍」 back-to-back — teacher and heir at the SAME temple, which corroborates the edge independently of the lineage formula.

teacher.kind: 楞伽師資記 (唐 淨覺集)
teacher.quote: 第六。唐朝蘄州雙峯山幽居寺大師。諱弘忍。承信禪師後。忍傳法。妙法人尊。時號為東山淨門。
teacher.note: Also c.713-716, and INDEPENDENT of 傳法寶紀. 承信禪師後 = 'succeeded after Chan master 信 (道信)'. 淨覺 stood two generations down the same line, so this is a near-contemporary insider witness.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道信 (A003654), cite (T49n2035_p0291a03)
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0602 依記錄推算; death +0675-11-18 以高宗上元二年十月二十三日告滅，報齡七十有四。(T50n2061_p0754b09)
dates.note: Song gaoseng zhuan: died Shangyuan 2 (675), 10th month 23rd day, aged 74.

DISAGREEMENT. The roster's 601–674 is the common Western convention; the Song gaoseng zhuan date computes to 602–675. I take DILA/SGSZ (602–675) because it rests on a dated primary notice; the one-year offset is the usual Chinese/Western age-reckoning gap.

bio.quote: 禪宗第五祖。潯陽人，或謂蘄州黃梅人，俗姓周。七歲，從蘄州黃梅雙峰山東山寺四祖道信出家…永徽二年（651）繼承師席，世稱「五祖黃梅」…成「東山法門」，禪宗傳教自《楞伽經》增修《金剛般若經》即由此始。門下有神秀及慧能二師。

notes: Fifth Patriarch. Presided over the famous poetry contest between Shenxiu and Huineng at East Mountain (Dongshan).

bio: Founder of the radical Baotang school in Sichuan; lay surname Li. He began as a soldier — serving as a forward scouting officer under the Prince of Xin'an, and remembered as a man of exceptional strength and martial skill — before a lay teacher, the layman Chen Chuzhang, expounded the sudden teaching to him. In the Tianbao era he called successively on Zizai of Taiyuan, Master Ming of Wutai, and Shenhui, before finally going to Sichuan to Master Jin — Wuxiang — from whom he received the robe and bowl. His teaching, which rejected all external ritual form, survives in the Lidai fabao ji.

teacher.kind: teacher's own words at the handover, in the Baotang community's own house-record 歷代法寶記 (compiled c. 774-780, within years of Wuzhu's death)
teacher.quote: 和上遂將袈裟一領…此是則天皇后與詵和上。詵和上與唐和上。唐和上與吾。吾傳與無住禪師。此衣久遠已來保愛，莫遣人知。
teacher.note: Musang speaks in the first person, naming Wuzhu as the man he passes the robe to. He empties the room of his own attendants first (發遣左右親事弟子…汝等總出堂外去) and hands the robe to the messenger 董璿 — i.e. a PROXY handover, not a face-to-face 付法.

teacher.quote: 後至寶應元年五月十五日，忽憶白崖山無住禪師…使工人薰(董璿)將吾信衣及餘衣一十七事，密送與無住禪師…遙付囑訖。
teacher.note: The text itself calls it 遙付囑 — a REMOTE charge. Wuzhu was not present; he never met his master at the transmission.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 無相 (A010305)
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 天寶年間先後禮太原自在、五臺山明和尚、神會，最後投釰南禮金和尚，繼承衣缽。
teacher.note: 金和尚 = 無相. He inherited the robe and bowl from him — transmission, as against the several teachers he merely called on.

teacher.quote: 《圓覺經大疏釋義鈔》卷3：「時號陳七哥。有一僧名無住，遇陳開示領悟。」
teacher.note: 陳楚章 the layman first awakened him. NOT the transmission — a case of the association/transmission distinction.

dates.quote: birth 春秋六十有一。（T51n2075_p0196b05）; death 大曆九年六月三日……坐化。（T51n2075_p0196a27）
dates.note: Lidai fabao ji: died Dali 9 (774), aged 61 → born 714. ROSTER CONFIRMED.

bio.quote: 俗姓李，天寶八年登戒。開元年，代父朔方展効，時年二十。膂力過人，武藝絕倫。信安王留充衛前遊弈先鋒官。忽遇白衣居士陳楚璋…說頓教法。

notes: Founded the radical Baotang school in Sichuan, rejecting all external forms. Teachings recorded in the Lidai fabao ji.

bio: Heir of Mazu Daoyi and one of the two disciples through whom the Hongzhou line reached the capital; lay surname Xie. Early in the Zhenyuan era he called on Mazu at Hongzhou and received his mind-seal. He was later burdened by the sheer volume of students seeking him out, and moved repeatedly — to Baijiayan, to the Zhongtiao mountains, into retreat on Mount Culai, and to the Lingyan and Baiyan monasteries — before ending as abbot of Zhangjing monastery in the capital, from which he takes his name. Posthumously titled Chan Master Daxuanjiao.

steles.title: 唐故章敬寺百岩大師碑銘（並序）
steles.author: 權德輿 (Quan Deyu, 759–818), chief minister and Mazu's own lay hearer
steles.quote: 師諱懷暉，姓謝氏，東晉流寓，今為泉州人
steles.note: ⚠ NAME/AUTHOR CORRECTION — see FINDINGS. The brief attributed this stele to 賈島 and placed it in 全唐文 715. It is by 權德輿 and it is in 全唐文 卷0501. No 賈島 stele for Huaihui was found.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0501, 唐故章敬寺百岩大師碑銘（並序）, by 權德輿 (Quan Deyu)
teacher.quote: 禪宗長老百岩大師之師，曰大寂禪師，傳佛語心法，始自達摩，至於惠能之化…授受吻合，大師得之，一言宗通，深入無礙
teacher.note: The stele's FIRST CLAUSE names the teacher: 大寂禪師 = Mazu Daoyi's posthumous title. 授受吻合…大師得之 — 'giving and receiving met exactly; the Master obtained it.' 得 is a transmission verb.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0501, same stele
teacher.quote: 德輿三十年前，嚐聞道於大寂。聿來京下，時款師言
teacher.note: The stele's AUTHOR states he personally heard the dharma from Mazu thirty years earlier and knew Huaihui personally in the capital. That makes this a first-hand witness to the relation, not a later reconstruction.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道一 (A003623), cite 其後一公振法鼓于洪州，其門弟子曰惟寬、懷暉。（T50n2061_p0761a29）
teacher.note: Song gaoseng zhuan names Weikuan and Huaihui as Mazu's disciples. ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: death +0816-01-18 元和十年乙未冬示疾。十二月十一日滅度。春秋六十二。（T50n2061_p0768a09）
dates.note: Died Yuanhe 10, 12th month 11th day (= Jan 816), aged 62 → born 755. Roster gave floruit 756.

bio.quote: 姓謝氏，雍京章敬寺僧人。貞元（785-805）初年，禮謁洪州馬祖道一，得其心要…苦於禪子請問繁雜，上中條山行禪法…後隱於徂徠山，寓居濟州靈巖寺、定州百巖寺等。

notes: Prominent student of Mazu who served as abbot of Zhangjing monastery in Chang'an.

school: Korean Seon (Silsangsan 實相山派); Hongzhou line via Xitang
bio: Silla monk who went to Tang China, verified his mind under Xitang Zhizang, and returned to found the Silsangsan school at Namak — the first of the Nine Mountain Schools of Korean Seon. Choe Chiwon's stele for Master Jijeung places his activity under King Heungdeok (r. 826–836) and describes him in one line: 'he went to Xitang and verified his mind; he came to Namak and rested his feet.' He is named in the corpus's Silla lineage charts as a second-generation heir of Xitang Zhizang, alongside Doui.

steles.title: 洪陟大師寂照塔銘
steles.author_note: his own stupa inscription — QUOTED, not extant in full, in a later Korean compilation
steles.quote: 洪陟大師寂照塔銘云：興德王之時，洪陟大師亦西堂澄心，南岳休足。源流云：道義彌陟皆西堂智藏大師法嗣。
steles.note: HIS STELE EXISTS as a quoted source. It gives the teacher (西堂澄心 = clarified his mind under Xitang) and the reign (興德王 826-836). The compiler adds that both Doui and Hongcheok are Xitang Zhizang's dharma heirs.

steles.kind: 碑銘 (a contemporary's stele, naming him)
steles.title: 智證大師碑 (by 崔致遠 Choe Chiwon, 893)
steles.author: 崔致遠
steles.quote: 及興德大王纂戎。宣康太子監撫…有洪陟大師。去西堂證心。來南岳休足。
steles.note: Choe Chiwon's Jijeung stele — the same formula. A named man writing in 893. Independent of the stupa inscription above.

teacher.quote: 洪陟大師亦西堂澄心，南岳休足…道義彌陟皆西堂智藏大師法嗣。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED from his own stupa inscription.

teacher.quote: 有洪陟大師。去西堂證心。來南岳休足。
馬祖道一下一世西堂智藏。二世新羅道義禪師…新羅洪陟禪師。

school.quote: 其他新羅道允。道均真鑑。梵日。大茅。迦智。忠彥。道義。無染。惠哲。洪陟。玄昱。覺體等師。皆傳馬祖宗派之心印者也。
school.note: lb=0790a05. Places him in the Mazu (Hongzhou) transmission.

notes: Early Silla monk who studied under Xitang Zhizang in Tang China and returned to establish the Silsangsan school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools of Korean Seon. His transmission is attested in Korean stele inscriptions and the Zutangji.
date_note: roster 826/830 are his return-from-Tang year and temple founding, not life dates

school: Korean Seon (Huiyangsan 曦陽山派 line)
bio: Silla monk known essentially from a single line of Choe Chiwon's stele for Master Jijeung at Bongamsa (893), which sets out a spiritual genealogy by kinship metaphor: 'the grandson was Sinhaeng, the great-grandson Junbeom, the great-great-grandson Hyeeun.' He transmitted the Beomnang–Daoxin line to Doheon, founder of the Huiyangsan school. Nothing else about him — no dates, no monastery, no recorded sayings — survives.

steles.kind: 碑銘 (a disciple-line stele naming him)
steles.title: 大唐新羅國故鳳巖山寺教謚智證大師寂照之塔碑銘
steles.author: 崔致遠 (Choe Chiwon)
steles.author_note: 893; the Jijeungdaesa stele at Bongamsa
steles.path: 全唐文．拾遺．卷四十四 (cited by DILA; not located as a separate text in the Zen corpus)
steles.quote: 孫慎行，曾孫遵範，玄孫慧隱。
steles.note: The stele states the lineage by kinship metaphor. This is the ONLY source for the man.

teacher.kind: authority record, teacher relation citing the Jijeung stele
teacher.quote: TEACHER 遵範 (A024868), cite 孫慎行，曾孫遵範，玄孫慧隱。（全唐文．拾遺．卷四十四．大唐新羅國故鳳巖山寺教謚智證大師寂照之塔碑銘）
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED (Junbeom = 遵範). The evidence is a stele of 893.

bio.quote: 新羅遵範弟子。

notes: Doheon's direct Seon teacher. Known only from the Jijeungdaesa stele at Bongamsa (893 CE, by Choe Chiwon). Transmitted the Beomnang-Daoxin lineage to Doheon, founder of the Huiyangsan school.

bio: Founder of the Linji school, from Lihu. He first went to Huangbo Xiyun in Jiangxi, then called on Gao'an Dayu and Guishan Lingyou. In 854 he settled at the Linji cloister in Zhenzhou, Hebei, from which the school takes its name. He taught by way of the Three Mysteries and Three Essentials and the Four Discernments, and was famous for the severity of his method — the shout (喝) used to display the great function. Posthumously titled Chan Master Huizhao. The lamps count twenty-two dharma heirs, among them Guanxi Zhixian and Sansheng Huiran.

steles.title: 臨濟慧照禪師塔記
steles.author: 延沼 (住鎮州保壽嗣法小師)
steles.quote: 時唐咸通八年丁亥孟陬月十日也。門人以師全身建塔于大名府西北隅，勅諡慧照禪師，塔號澄靈。合掌稽首，記師大略。住鎮州保壽嗣法小師延沼謹書。
steles.note: Named author, named grave, named year (867). Death year given as 咸通八年 (867), not 866.

teacher.kind: 塔記 (勅諡臨濟慧照禪師塔記), signed 住鎮州保壽嗣法小師延沼謹書
teacher.quote: 師諱義玄，曹州南華人也…即更衣游方，首參黃蘗，次謁大愚，其機緣語句載于行錄。既受黃蘗印可，尋抵河北鎮州城東南隅…
teacher.note: The stupa-record appended to the 臨濟錄 itself, written by his own dharma-heir Baoshou Yanzhao 寶壽延沼 at the grave (塔 at 大名府西北隅, 塔號澄靈). It states 既受黃蘗印可 — the 印可 is Huangbo's. 大愚 is where he woke, but the sanction (印可) is explicitly Huangbo's; 大愚 is a 謁 (a visit), not a transmission. DILA's second teacher-edge to 大愚 is the association-is-not-transmission error.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 希運 (A000490)
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 斷際希運（751-850）禪師法嗣，臨濟宗之祖。初至江西參黃蘗希運，復謁高安大愚、溈山靈祐等師。
TEACHER 大愚 (A003660), cite 次謁大愚，其機緣語句載于行錄。（T47n1985_p0506c12）
teacher.note: Dayu is where the famous awakening happens, but the transmission is Huangbo's. The distinction is exactly the association/transmission one.

dates.quote: death +0866-05-31 以咸通七年丙戌歲四月十日示滅。（T50n2061_p0779b02）
dates.note: Xiantong 7 (866), 4th month 10th day. NO BIRTH DATE in DILA. The roster's floruit 810 is not a sourced birth year.

bio.quote: 宣宗大中八年（854），住河北鎮州臨濟院，設三玄三要、四料簡等機法接引徒眾，以機鋒峭峻著名…每以叱喝顯大機用。諡慧照禪師。法嗣有灌谿志閑、譚空和尚、三聖慧然等二十二人。

notes: Founder of the Linji school. Asked Huangbo three times about the essence of Buddhism and was beaten each time; enlightened after visiting Gaoan Dayu. Known for radical pedagogy: shouts (喝), blows, and paradoxical statements. Developed 'four shouts' and 'four positions of host and guest' frameworks. His recorded sayings (臨濟錄) compiled by Sansheng Huiran are foundational to the koan tradition.

bio: Lay surname Chen. Tonsured at thirteen under Shaoluan at Xishan in Hongzhou, fully ordained at twenty-three on Mount Song, and trained in the Vinaya at Luoyang; he then went to Guishan Lingyou and served as rice-steward. After his awakening he opened the hall on Mount Shishuang, where the assembly grew past five hundred. His monks sat in unbroken meditation, unmoving as tree-stumps, and the age called them 'the dead-tree assembly' (枯木眾). His transmission is from Daowu Yuanzhi.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 卷12〈唐長沙石霜山慶諸傳〉(贊寧, 988)
teacher.quote: 釋慶諸，俗姓陳，廬陵新淦玉笥鄉人也…諸始十三，禮紹鑾禪翁為師，於洪井西山剃䰂。二十三，往嵩山受具戒…迴抵南嶽，入大溈山。次屆雲巖，遇道吾，垂問知意，方為二夏之僧。得石霜山，便議終焉之志。道吾躬至石霜山，日勤執侍，往還問答，語在別錄。
teacher.note: A 傳 (not a lamp), one century after his death, drawing on a 別錄 now lost. It separates the four men cleanly: 紹鑾 TONSURED him (剃䰂) at 13; ordination at Songshan at 23; 溈山 and 雲巖 were visits; 道吾 is where 垂問知意 — the meeting of minds — happens, and Daowu then comes to Shishuang and is served daily. The dharma relation is Daowu's.

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 — the earliest Chan compilation, 64 years after his death
teacher.quote: 石霜和尚嗣道吾
teacher.note: Earliest surviving succession statement. Corroborates, does not originate, the Song Gaoseng Zhuan account.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 圓智 (A004596); concise: 道吾智嗣
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 紹鑾 (A010582), cite 始十三禮紹鑾禪翁為師。（T50n2061_p0780c16）
teacher.note: Tonsure master at 13 — NOT the dharma transmission.

dates.quote: death +0888-03-30 光啟四年戊申歲二月十日遷化，享齡八十二。僧臘五十九。（祖堂集：131；T50n2061_p0781a01）
dates.note: Died Guangqi 4 (888), 2nd month 10th day.

dates.quote: birth field: 「…報齡八十，僧夏五十九。（祖堂集：131）」 vs death field: 「…享齡八十二。僧臘五十九。」
dates.note: SOURCES DISAGREE on his age at death: 80 (報齡八十) or 82 (享齡八十二). 888 − 82 = 807 (DILA's birth range starts 807); 888 − 80 = 809. DILA hedges with a range 807–809. I take 807 to match DILA's own preferred death notice (82), but the ambiguity is real.

school.note: Roster said only 'Chan'. DILA is more precise: the Shitou (not Hongzhou) line — correct, since Daowu Yuanzhi descends from Yaoshan.

bio.quote: 俗姓陳，長沙石霜山僧人，道吾智嗣。十三歲時依洪州西山紹鑾禪師落髮，二十三歲赴嵩岳受具足戒，後詣洛下學習毗尼。後投溈山靈祐禪師座下，充當米頭。悟後住石霜山…其徒眾有長坐不臥、屹若株杌者，天下謂之「枯木眾」。

notes: His assembly called 'the dead tree hall' — monks sat in continuous meditation.

school: Korean Seon; Hongzhou line (洪州宗) via Hyecheol
bio: Silla Seon monk and the master geomancer of Korean tradition, disciple of Hyecheol of Dongni. He is credited with the doctrine of bibo (裨補), 'supplementation': as a physician needles or cauterises a sick man's veins, so a sick landscape is treated by siting temples, Buddha-images, stupas and pagodas at the diseased points. He returned east in 875 at the age of forty-nine, and the tradition has him identifying the sites of hundreds of temples. His stele stands at Dogapsa on Mount Wolchul.

steles.title: 月出山道岬寺道詵國師碑銘
steles.author_note: his stele at Dogapsa, Mount Wolchul
steles.quote: 月出山道岬寺道詵國師碑銘…夫以金山建剎。永垂…
steles.note: Also carried at B/B31/B31n0169.xml lb=0095b18 as 月出山道岬寺道詵國師守眉大師碑銘 (a joint stele with Sumi).

steles.title: 道詵國師本碑
steles.author: 崔惟清 (Choe Yucheong, Goryeo)
steles.quote: 師俗姓金氏。新羅靈巖人也…年二十三。受具戒於穿道寺…享年七十二。
steles.note: A second, earlier stele was ordered from 朴仁範 by Doseon's disciples but 竟未鐫于石 — 'in the end it was never cut into stone.' The surviving 本碑 is Choe Yucheong's.

teacher.kind: 塔銘/本碑 — 道詵國師本碑, 高麗崔惟清撰
teacher.quote: 【備考】道詵國師本碑〈高麗崔惟清撰〉…于時惠徹大師。傳密印於西堂智莊禪師。開堂於桐裏山。師摳衣請學。凡所謂無說之說。無法之法。虛中授受。廓爾超悟。
teacher.note: His own stele, quoted in full in 朝鮮佛教通史. Names Hyecheol (who had himself received the 密印 from Xitang Zhizang) as the man Doseon studied under and from whom he 'received in the void' and broke through. Also gives the death date (光化元年/898.3.10), age 72, stupa 證聖慧燈, posthumous name 了空禪師 — all matching the roster.

teacher.kind: second recension of the same stele-derived life
teacher.quote: 道詵禪師。〈桐裏哲嗣〉…于時。惠徹大師。傳密印於西堂智藏禪師。開堂於桐裏山。師摳衣請學。
teacher.note: Second copy in the same work, headed 桐裏哲嗣 ('heir of Dongni [Hye]cheol'). Note this copy spells the Chinese master correctly as 西堂智藏 where the first copy has the corrupt 智莊.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 慧徹 (A022969); concise: 桐裏慧徹弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：5；B31n0169_p0061b03）
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED — the roster's romanisation 'Hyejeol' is 慧徹 Hyecheol.

dates.quote: birth +0827; death +0898
dates.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 道詵東還。乃唐僖宗乾符二年。新羅憲康王元年乙未也。詵於是年。四十九歲。
dates.note: lb=0744b22. Returned east in 875 aged 49 → born 827. Independently corroborates DILA. The compiler adds a caution that the 竹迷記's account is itself conjectural (「竹迷記此說本亦猜度」).

bio.quote: 人若有病。即尋血脉。或針或灸。則病即愈。山川之病。亦然。今我落點處。建寺立佛立塔立浮圖。則如人之針灸。名曰裨補也。道詵受教。退還。一一如教。
bio.note: lb=0620a18 — the bibo doctrine in the master's own transmission.

notes: Korean Seon monk and master geomancer (pungsu) who profoundly shaped the political geography of Korea. Trained in both Seon meditation and Chinese geomantic arts (fengshui), he applied topographical analysis to temple and capital siting. His prophecies regarding the decline of Silla and the rise of a new dynasty at Songak (modern Kaesong) were later credited with guiding Wang Geon's founding of the Goryeo dynasty (918). He founded or restored numerous temples based on geomantic principles. Though his geomantic legacy sometimes overshadows his Buddhist teaching, he was recognized as a legitimate Seon master. Attested in Goryeo-era hagiographies: credited with prophecies that legitimized the Goryeo founding, with his geomantic writings preserved in the Doseon bigi.

school: Korean Seon; Caodong (曹洞宗) line via Yunju Daoying
bio: Silla-Goryeo monk, lay surname Jang, born on the eleventh day of the fourth month of 871. He was fully ordained in 888 under the Vinaya master Yeongjong at Tongdosa, then crossed to Tang China and sought out Yunju Daoying, who — in the words of his own stele — 'quietly conferred the lamp of wisdom and secretly transmitted the essentials of the Dharma,' saying 'my Way has gone east.' He returned to Korea in the seventh month of 908, landing at Hoejin in Muju, and died in 921 in the dharma hall of Irwolsa. With Hyeongmi, Yeoeom and Ieom he is counted one of the Four Fearless Great Beings of Haedong. Posthumously titled Great Master Beopgyeong.

steles.title: 普照慧光之塔碑
steles.author_note: his own stupa stele; posthumous title 法鏡大師. Text partly effaced (□ in the corpus).
steles.quote: 諡法鏡大師。普照慧光之塔碑云：大師諱慶猷。俗姓張氏。咸通十二年四月十一日誕生。光啟四年。受具於通度寺靈宗律師。□□□□。遄達西津。聞雲居道膺和尚。道冠楞伽…慶猷逈㣲。麗嚴。利嚴。共海東謂之四無畏大士也。和尚曰。聞言識士。見面知心。萬里同居。千年一遇於是。潛付慧燈。密傳法要。遂曰吾道東矣…迺於天祐五年七月。達于武州之會津。貞明七年二十三日。示滅于日月寺法堂。
steles.note: HIS STELE — and it carries everything: birth date, ordination, teacher, the transmission formula, the return voyage, the death. It also confirms the roster's 'Four Fearless Masters' note verbatim.

teacher.quote: 聞雲居道膺和尚…潛付慧燈。密傳法要。遂曰吾道東矣。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED from his own stupa stele — the strongest possible evidence.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道膺 (A010588), cite 《五燈全書目錄》卷5：「雲居膺禪師法嗣……新羅慶猷禪師」

teacher.kind: lamp / 傳法正宗記 heir lists
teacher.quote: 新羅慶猷禪師
teacher.note: Listed among Yunju Daoying's heirs in the Jingde chuandeng lu and the Chuanfa zhengzong ji.

dates.quote: 咸通十二年四月十一日誕生…貞明七年二十三日。示滅于日月寺法堂。
dates.note: Born Xiantong 12 (871), 4th month 11th day; died Zhenming 7 (921). ROSTER'S DEATH CONFIRMED; the roster's floruit 880 is superseded by a real birth date of 871.

dates.quote: birth +0871; death +0921 (疑年錄:179)

school.note: Yunju Daoying is Dongshan Liangjie's heir, so the Caodong tag is right.

notes: Dharma heir of Yunju Daoying alongside Ieom. One of the Four Fearless Masters of Haedong. Stele preserved in CBETA B31n0170.

school: Shitou line (石頭宗) — the Xuefeng branch
bio: Lay surname Li. As a child he would not touch meat and loved the sound of temple bells; gravely ill at twelve, he dreamt a spirit gave him medicine and recovered, and the next year took the robe under Daogui of Bailu Mountain in Weizhou. He called on many teachers before meeting Xuefeng Yicun, with whom his conditions matched and from whom he received the mind-seal. After Xuefeng's death the Min ruler built the Yongquan Chan cloister for him on Gushan (Drum Mountain) at Fuzhou, where he taught for more than thirty years. Titled National Teacher Xingsheng.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988), 贊寧 — 義存 biography, heir-list
teacher.quote: 其庶幾者，一曰師備…次曰惠稜，擁徒于泉州招慶；其五曰神晏，住福州之鼓山。分燈化物，皆膺聖獎，賜紫袈裟。
teacher.note: 贊寧 (919–1001) overlapped 神晏's own lifetime (d. 944). The 義存 biography in 宋高僧傳 derives from 黃滔's 真覺大師碑銘; the heir-list names 神晏 fifth. Contemporary, not lamp.

teacher.quote: 鼓山和尚嗣雪峰，在福州。師諱神晏…後遇雪峰，雪峰攔胸把住云：「是什摩！」師乃豁然而已…峰乃呵曰：「大有人未到此境界，切須保任護持！」
teacher.note: 祖堂集 was compiled 952 — eight years after 神晏's death — at 泉州招慶寺, the seat of 長慶慧稜, 神晏's own dharma-brother under 雪峰. Not a Qing lamp: this is a within-living-memory Fujian source, and it records the encounter (攔胸把住 → 豁然) plus 保任護持 (the charge to guard and sustain). It also lists his prior, FAILED visits — 白馬趙州, 徑山荷玉 — 「雖諧請問，未契機緣」 (不契 = it failed): the source itself distinguishes association from transmission.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 義存 (A003677); concise: 及參雪峰義存，機緣相契，釋然了悟，得其心印。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0860 依記錄推算; death 天福年間（936～944）示寂，世壽七十七。（佛光：4250）
dates.note: CONFLICT. The roster gives death 944. DILA gives only 'the Tianfu era (936–944), aged 77.' But 860 + 77 = 937 — so if the age is right, the death falls at the START of that range (c. 936–937), not 944. I record the roster's 944 and DILA's 936–944 range; the internal arithmetic favours c. 937. Neither is a fixed, dated notice.

bio.quote: 福州鼓山興聖國師，俗姓李。幼惡葷羶，樂聞梵鐘之音。十二歲染疾甚篤，夢神人賜藥而頓癒。次年遂從衛州白鹿山道規禪師出家，歷參諸禪德。及參雪峰義存…得其心印。雪峰歸寂後，閩帥王延彬常往詢法要，造鼓山湧泉禪院，請師入住，舉揚宗旨，歷三十餘年。

notes: Heir of Xuefeng Yicun. In 908, Min kingdom ruler Wang Shenzhi appointed him to supervise the reconstruction of Yongquan Temple on Gushan (Drum Mountain) in Fuzhou, where he served as abbot and established a lasting Chan lineage in Fujian.

bio: Lay surname Fu. At sixteen he was tonsured by the monk Zhishen of Kongtong in Weizhou, and took the full precepts from the Vinaya master Jingyuan at Jingzhou; he began in the Vinaya halls, spent a summer retreat at Changsha, and at its close went to Yunmen Wenyan, whose heir he became. He dwelt on his mountain for forty years and his teaching went everywhere. In the seventh month of 990 he sat cross-legged and died without illness, aged eighty-one, having kept sixty-five summers. His is the koan of the three pounds of hemp.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 (1004), 襄州洞山守初崇慧大師
teacher.quote: 襄州洞山守初崇慧大師。初參雲門。…門曰。放汝三頓棒。師至明日却上問訊。曰昨日蒙和尚放三頓棒。不知過在什麼處。門曰。飯袋子。江西湖南便與麼。師於言下大悟。
teacher.note: 師於言下大悟 under 雲門文偃 — the transmission encounter itself. Association-trap-free: this IS the awakening.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 文偃 (A003703); 夏休詣雲門偃禪師。
teacher.note: Confirms 雲門文偃.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 文偃 (A003703); concise: 夏休詣雲門偃禪師。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: authority record citing 禪林僧寶傳
dates.quote: death +0990 「淳化元年秋七月，無疾跏趺而化。閱世八十有一。（《禪林僧寶傳》卷 8〈洞山守初禪師〉）」
dates.note: Chunhua 1 (990), aged 81 → born 910. ROSTER CONFIRMED.

bio.source: DILA A010448 citing X79n1560 禪林僧寶傳
bio.quote: 傅氏。年十六依渭州崆峒沙門志諗剃髮。詣涇州舍利。律師淨圓受具足戒。始游律肆。至長沙坐夏。夏休詣雲門偃禪師。住山四十年。道徧天下。淳化元年秋七月。無疾跏趺而化。閱世八十有一。坐六十有五夏。

notes: Known for the 'three pounds of hemp' koan.

school: Linji, Huanglong branch (臨濟宗黃龍派)
bio: Founder of the Huanglong branch of Linji, lay surname Zhang. He left home young under Zhiluan of the Dingshui cloister, called on Chengshi of Qixian and Cheng of Letan, and finally awakened under Shishuang Chuyuan. He is remembered for the Three Barriers, the set of three questions with which he tested comers. Posthumously titled Pujue in the Daguan era. His heirs include Huitang Zuxin, Baofeng Kewen and Letan Hongying.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (開堂 at 同安崇勝禪院)
teacher.quote: 師初住同安崇勝禪院。開堂日。宣疏罷。師拈香云。此一炷香。為今上皇帝聖壽無窮。又拈香云。此為知軍郎中文武寀僚…又拈香去。大眾且道。此一炷香。當為何人。多少人卜度。未知落處。今日為湖南慈明禪師。一炷爇却。
teacher.note: THREE sticks, correctly separated: (1) emperor, (2) officials/state, (3) 湖南慈明禪師 = 石霜楚圓, who held 石霜 in Hunan. The third is the dharma stick. First-person, at his own enthronement.

teacher.kind: own 開堂 Q&A immediately following the incense
teacher.quote: 時有僧問。寶座已登於鳳嶺。宗風演唱嗣何人。師畫一圓相。進云。石霜一派迸入江西也。
teacher.note: The 開堂 formula question 「嗣何人」 (whom do you succeed?) answered in the same assembly: 石霜一派 — the Shishuang line. Corroborates the third stick.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 楚圓 (A001439); concise: 石霜楚圓（986-1039）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十二世，臨濟宗黃龍派之祖。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: authority record citing 嘉泰普燈錄
dates.quote: birth +1002; death +1069-04-17 熙寧二年三月十七日示寂，閱世六十八（《嘉泰普燈錄》卷 3）
dates.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

bio.quote: 隆興府黃龍慧南禪師，章氏子…少從定水院智鑾出家，復謁棲賢澄湜、泐潭澄，後參石霜楚圓得悟。大觀間，諡曰「普覺」…嗣法弟子有晦堂祖心、寶峰克文、泐潭洪英等。

notes: Founded the Huanglong branch. Famous for his 'Three Barriers' test.

bio: Caodong master, lay surname Wang. In the Shaosheng era (1094–98) he left home under Furong Daokai and received his seal. In 1104 he took up Puyan monastery on Dashengshan at Nanyang, in 1107 was appointed to Jingyin, and in 1111 moved to Mount Lumen, where he died in 1117; his stupa was raised there and he was titled Chan Master Dinghui. His line carried the Caodong transmission north into Jin territory, and the stele charts run it 芙蓉楷 → 鹿門覺 → 青州辯 → 磁州寶 → 王山體 → 雪巖滿 → 萬松秀.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道楷 (A001539); concise: 紹聖年間（1094-1098），從芙蓉道楷出家，得蒙印可。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.kind: 正名錄 (1694), arguing from stele and stupa records
teacher.quote: 至政和七年示寂。凡三主大剎．歷年僅十四載．淨因自覺．鹿門自覺．先後住持．原是一人明矣。歷考住持鹿門者．並無二自覺。會元載淨因自覺者．以次主淨因．紀住處故也。二書以自覺嗣如淨．出住鹿門。豈不是以一鹿門覺為二鹿門覺。
teacher.note: lb=0459a16. Zhikai REFUTES the rival claim that Zijue was Tiantong Rujing's heir: the books that say so have split one man into two, and 「况自覺行道．與芙蓉同時」 — he was active in Furong's own lifetime, and Rujing (1163–1228) was born 46 years after Zijue died. The chronology is decisive.

teacher.kind: 佛祖傳法偈碑 (stele chart), quoted
teacher.quote: 曹洞正傳青原思．石頭遷．藥山儼．雲巖晟．洞山价．雲居膺．同安丕．同安志．梁山觀．大陽玄．投子青．芙蓉楷．鹿門覺．青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕…
teacher.note: lb=0459b07. FOUR separate stele charts in this text give the same sequence. 芙蓉楷 → 鹿門覺 directly.

dates.quote: death +1117-03-27 政和七年丁酉二月十六日示寂。（疑年錄：236）
dates.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED (1117). No birth date is recorded anywhere; the roster's floruit 1060 is unsupported.

bio.quote: 宋代曹洞宗僧。俗姓王…崇寧三年（1104），住南陽府大乘山普嚴寺，大觀元年（1107）補住淨因。政和元年（1111），遷於鹿門山。七年（1117）示寂，建塔於鹿門山，諡號「定慧禪師」。

notes: Direct disciple of Furong Daokai. His line carried Caodong transmission northward into Jin territory, eventually reaching Wansong Xingxiu via four generations — a separate branch from the southern Danxia Zichun line.

bio: The leading Caodong master of the Southern Song and the advocate of silent illumination (默照). Surname Li, from Xizhou; his grandfather Ji and father Zongdao had studied the Prajna for generations. He entered the order at Jingming monastery under Benzong and was ordained by Zhiqiong at Ciyun in Jinzhou; at eighteen he set out on pilgrimage, called on Kumu Facheng and then on Danxia Zichun, under whom he awakened. He held Puzhao at Sizhou, then Taiping, Yuantong and Nengren, and Changlu, before settling at Tiantong, where he died in 1157. In the second month of 1158 an edict conferred on him the title Chan Master Hongzhi and named his stupa Miaoguang.

steles.title: 妙光塔銘
steles.author: 周葵
steles.author_note: Zhou Kui, a Longtu-ge official; the stele was calligraphed by 張孝祥, the zhuangyuan (first-place examination graduate)
steles.quote: 勅賜妙光塔…賜號「宏智」，塔曰「妙光」，建于東谷。狀元張孝祥書碑。周葵：妙光塔銘…序曰：紹興戊寅春二月，詔諡故明州天童山景德寺僧正覺「宏智禪師」，塔曰「妙光」…乃摭其示世之實，序而銘之。師，李姓，正覺，名也。隰州人。祖寂，父宗道，世學般若。母趙氏嘗夢五臺山一僧…
steles.note: HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION, by a named contemporary official, written within a year or two of his death. DILA independently cites 〈塔銘〉 in his 語錄 for the death date.

steles.title: 勅諡宏智禪師行業記
steles.author: 王伯庠 (左朝奉大夫侍御史), dated 乾道二年 (1166)
steles.quote: 伯庠聞師名舊矣。歲在戊午。教授州學。始識其面。
steles.note: Author states he met Hongzhi in person (戊午 = 1138) — a genuine contemporary. Appended to 宏智禪師廣錄 卷9. It also records the separate 塔銘 by 參知政事周公葵 (lb 0121a05: 「詔諡宏智禪師。塔曰妙光。參知政事周公葵。為之銘」) — that 塔銘 is NOT in the corpus, but the 行業記 stands on its own.

teacher.kind: 行業記 (行狀-class) by 王伯庠, who knew him personally
teacher.quote: 又二年住泗洲普照。實始出世嗣法淳和尚。
teacher.note: Explicit 嗣法. 「實始出世」 = at his first abbacy he declared his succession — i.e. this records the enthronement act itself.

teacher.quote: 丹霞淳禪師。道價方盛。師乃造焉。霞問。如何是空劫已前自己…霞打一拂子云。又道不借。師忽悟作禮…時二十三歲矣。
teacher.note: Awakening under 丹霞子淳 at age 23; he then followed 子淳 to 唐州大乘 and to 大洪 as 記室 and 首座.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 子淳 (A000084); concise: 隰州李氏，丹霞子淳（1066-1119）禪師法嗣…參枯木法成、丹霞子淳，遂有所悟。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: authority record citing his 塔銘
dates.quote: birth +1091; death +1157-11-18 《明州天童景德禪寺宏智覺禪師語錄》卷 4〈塔銘〉
dates.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED. The death date rests on the stupa inscription itself.

bio.quote: 師，李姓，正覺，名也。隰州人。祖寂，父宗道，世學般若。
初投淨明寺本宗出家，受具於晉州慈雲寺智瓊。十八遊方…出世泗州普照寺，歷遷舒州太平、江州圓通、能仁，真州長蘆…復歸天童而寂，諡宏智禪師。提倡「坐禪」、「默照」之禪風。

notes: Leading Caodong master. Advocate of silent illumination (mozhao) Chan. Compiled the Book of Equanimity.

bio: Caodong master of the Jin, the link between Cizhou Bao and Xueyan Man in the northern Caodong line. His stupa inscription — quoted at length in the Zhengming lu — records that he first studied under Master Bao at Lingyan in Qi, and attended him for more than ten years as Bao moved to Yangshan in Yan and to Daming in Cizhou. On the ninth day of the ninth month of 1160 he took his leave of Daming, and Master Bao conferred the transmission on him with a verse. In 1161 he opened the dharma at Wangshan in Taiyuan; in 1165 he moved to Tianning at Fenyang; in 1171 he returned to Wangshan, and he died there on the second day of the ninth month of 1173. His successor at Wangshan was Shengmo Guang; his dharma heir was Xueyan Man, teacher of Wansong Xingxiu.

steles.title: 王山體塔銘
steles.author_note: his own stupa inscription. NOT extant as a separate text — quoted in 智楷's 正名錄 (1694), which uses it as documentary evidence against the lamp records.
steles.quote: 王山體塔銘。其略曰．正隆五年重九日．辭大明。寶和尚以偈付之。正隆六年．開法大原王山。大定五年．遷住汾陽天寧。即南宋孝宗乾道元年乙酉。大定十一年．還居王山。即乾道七年辛卯。十三年九月二日示寂。即乾道九年癸巳也。
steles.note: HIS STELE, quoted. It gives the transmission (寶和尚以偈付之, 1160), three abbacies with dates, and the death: 大定十三年九月二日 = 1173. This is the ONLY source for his dates.

steles.title: 王山體塔銘
steles.quote: 磁州寶．雖碑銘不存。據王山體塔銘．謂先參寶和尚於齊之靈巖。及寶遷燕之仰山．磁之大明．師皆侍從十餘年。至正隆五年九月．始辭大明。
steles.note: Cited to reconstruct his TEACHER, whose own stele is lost (磁州寶．雖碑銘不存). This passage is why the roster calls the teacher 'Lingyan' — Ti first met Bao at Lingyan.

steles.title: 佛祖傳法偈碑
steles.author_note: a stele at 勝果寺, erected by 大覺彝; one of four stone charts the 正名錄 collates
steles.quote: 曹洞正傳青原思．石頭遷．藥山儼．雲巖晟．洞山价．雲居膺．同安丕．同安志．梁山觀．大陽玄．投子青．芙蓉楷．鹿門覺．青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕．少林泰…
steles.note: The name is 王山體 — 王, not 玉 — on the stone, and in all four charts.

steles.title: 王山寺記
steles.quote: 勝默光事跡．載王山寺記。內曰．大定十三年．體和尚示寂。監院圓祥與眾．請住王山。
steles.note: INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION of the 1173 death, from the monastery's own record.

teacher.quote: 正隆五年重九日．辭大明。寶和尚以偈付之。
teacher.note: Master Bao conferred the transmission with a verse in 1160. TEACHER = 寶和尚 = 磁州寶 / 大明寶.

teacher.quote: 先參寶和尚於齊之靈巖。及寶遷燕之仰山．磁之大明．師皆侍從十餘年。
teacher.note: Attended Bao for 10+ years across three monasteries. The 'Lingyan' of the roster's 'Lingyan Sengbao' is where they MET, not Bao's standard designation.

teacher.kind: 佛祖傳法偈碑 and three other stele charts
teacher.quote: …青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀…

dates.quote: 十三年九月二日示寂。即乾道九年癸巳也。
dates.note: DIED 1173 (Dading 13 = Qiandao 9, guisi), 9th month 2nd day. The roster's 'floruit 1150, death 1200' is WRONG.

dates.quote: 大定十三年．體和尚示寂。
dates.note: Second, independent attestation of 1173.

school.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED: Caodong.

notes: Caodong master; teacher of Xueyan Huiman. Appears in standard Caodong lineage charts between Lingyan Sengbao and Xueyan Huiman. Specific dates not preserved.

bio: Korean Seon monk, dharma heir of Hyesim and third patriarch of Suseonsa (Songgwangsa). He is named in his master's stele as the heir who arranged its erection: he had the layman Jeong Bun of Iram draft the record of conduct, petitioned Duke Jinyang, and the matter was reported to the throne, whereupon the court commanded that the inscription be composed.

steles.kind: 碑銘 (his master's stele, which names him)
steles.title: stele of his master (Hyesim)
steles.author_note: composed at royal command; 夢如 is the heir who commissioned it
steles.quote: 噫。真可謂禪門正眼。肉身菩薩者歟。嗣法禪老夢如。亦法王也。請逸庵居士鄭君奮。草具行錄。以立碑。請於晉陽公。公曰和尚住世利人多矣。樂石不可不立。遂聞于上。命小臣為之銘。
steles.note: He is 嗣法 — the dharma-heir — in his master's own stupa stele. That is the transmission claim, made at the master's grave. 晉陽公 = Choe U, the Goryeo military dictator.

teacher.quote: 嗣法禪老夢如。亦法王也。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED — he is named as the dharma-heir in his master's stele, and as the man who caused it to be erected. This is as close to the transmission as evidence gets.

notes: 3rd patriarch of Suseonsa/Songgwangsa. Led the community for ~18 years after Hyesim's death.

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: The most celebrated master of the Yuan, lay surname Sun, of Qiantang. In 1286 he went to Gaofeng Yuanmiao on Tianmu; he was tonsured and ordained the following year, and after Gaofeng gave him a huatou he laboured at it for ten years. He then lived in retreat in the Huanzhu ('illusory abiding') hermitage on Mount Bian at Huzhou, and returned to Tianmu in 1318. He refused the appointments the Renzong emperor pressed on him, taking only a robe and a title, and was widely sought out by Korean and Japanese monks. Titled National Teacher Puying; the age called him the Old Buddha of Jiangnan.

steles.title: 普應國師中峰舍利法雲塔記
steles.author: 惟則
steles.author_note: Tianru Weize — his own dharma heir
steles.quote: 普應國師中峰舍利法雲塔記…惟則…
steles.note: The record of his relic-stupa, written by his disciple Tianru Weize.

steles.title: 普應國師中峰舍利法雲塔記
steles.author: 惟則 (天如惟則)
steles.quote: 普應國師中峰舍利法雲塔記…惟則…先師中峰和尚寂于西天目山之獅子巖
steles.note: In 雲居聖水寺志, a temple gazetteer — the classic 'the stele sits in somebody else's book' case.

steles.kind: 塔銘 (attested, text NOT in corpus)
steles.title: 法雲塔銘
steles.author: 虞集 (Yu Ji), 奉勅撰, 天曆元年 1328
steles.quote: 天厤元年奎章閣學士虞集奉勅…塔銘，其塔曰法雲
steles.note: Existence attested by Weize's 塔記; the stele text itself is not in CBETA. Not counted as read evidence.

teacher.kind: his own 法語 (幻公法語), quoted in 雲居聖水寺志 卷六補遺
teacher.quote: 濟十七傳而至仰山雪巖，巖授先師高峰和尚
teacher.note: The section is headed 「厯代祖師 幻公法語數則」 — 幻公 = 幻住 = Mingben himself. In his own mouth he calls 高峰 先師 (my late master) and places him as Xueyan Zuqin's heir. First-person.

teacher.kind: 塔記 (舍利塔記) by his disciple 惟則 (Tianru Weize)
teacher.quote: 至治癸亥秋，先師中峰和尚寂于西天目山之獅子巖…天厤元年奎章閣學士虞集奉勅…塔銘，其塔曰法雲
teacher.note: Weize, his own heir, writing 「先師中峰和尚」. Records that 虞集 wrote the imperially-commissioned 塔銘 (1328) and 揭徯斯 the 語錄序 — neither text is in the CBETA corpus, but the 塔記 attests they existed.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 原妙 (A004700); concise: 高峰妙（1238-1296）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十三世。至元二十三年（1286），參謁高峰妙，次年剃度、受具。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

bio.quote: 杭州天目中峰明本禪師，俗姓孫…後隱於湖州辨山之幻住庵。授以話頭，苦參十年，鋒銳機敏，時稱大辯。延祐五年（1318），應眾請還居天目山。仁宗召聘不出，賜衣號。

notes: Most celebrated Yuan-dynasty master. Declined imperial appointments. Strong ties with Korean monks and extensive international connections.

school: Korean Seon; Linji Yangqi line via Naong
bio: Dharma heir of Naong Hyegeun and royal preceptor to Yi Seonggye, founder of the Joseon dynasty. The records have him installed by royal command at Hoeamsa, Naong's great practice-ground; in the autumn of 1397 he was ordered to build the stupa on the northern cliff of that monastery, at the site of Jigong's own pagoda. In 1398 he pleaded age and withdrew to Yongmun; recalled to Hoeam in 1402, he took leave again the next spring and entered the Diamond Mountains, where he died on the eleventh day of the ninth month of 1405. Korean tradition credits him with selecting the site of the new capital at Hanyang.

steles.title: account of his last years and death, in the 朝鮮佛教通史
steles.quote: 懶翁所居大道塲。命師入焉。丁丑秋。命造塔于寺之北崖。師師指空浮屠所在也。戊寅秋。師以老。辭。歸居于龍門。壬午五月。今我主上殿下。又命入檜巖。明年正月。又辭。入金剛山。以乙酉九月十一日示寂。
steles.note: Gives the death precisely: 乙酉 (1405), 9th month, 11th day. CONFIRMS the roster's 1405.

steles.title: 無學王師妙嚴尊者塔銘 (in 朝鮮佛教通史)
steles.author: 卞季良 (Byeon Gye-ryang), by royal command
steles.quote: 上命臣季良。名其塔。且為銘。臣季良。謹按其弟子祖琳所撰行狀。師諱自超。號無學。所居曰溪月軒。壽七十九。法臘六十一。俗姓朴氏。三岐郡人也。
steles.note: Underlying 行狀 by disciple 祖琳 is now lost except as quoted here. Died 乙酉 (1405) 9/11; interred 丁亥 (1407) at 檜巖.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 (stele) by 卞季良, commissioned by the king, 庚寅 1410; the epitaph states it is drawn from the 行狀 by his disciple 祖琳
teacher.quote: 辛亥冬。前朝恭愍王。封懶翁為王師。翁住松廣。以衣鉢付師。師以偈謝。
teacher.note: 『以衣鉢付師』 — 付 is the transmission verb. The stele also records 懶翁's own words to him: 「爾與我一家矣」 and 「今日乃知吾不汝欺也」 (0380a02), and 懶翁's written certificate of his 日用全機 on parting (0380a05-08). First-hand, at a named grave, by a named official, in a named year.

teacher.kind: same 塔銘 — the OTHER masters, kept separate
teacher.quote: 年十八。依慧鑑國師上足弟子小止禪師。薙髮具戒。…咨法于慧明國師。…癸巳秋。挺身走燕都。參西天指空。…次年甲午正月。到法泉寺。參懶翁
teacher.note: TRAP AVOIDED: the stele names FOUR men and keeps them apart — 小止 TONSURED him (薙髮具戒), 慧明國師 was consulted (咨法), 指空 (Indian, Śūnyādiśya) 許之 (approved him), and only 懶翁 handed over the 衣鉢. Do not let 指空 be promoted: the stele gives him approval, not the charge.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 惠勤 (A015606); concise: 懶翁慧勤弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：23）
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 懶翁所居大道塲。命師入焉。
teacher.note: He is installed at Naong's own practice-ground — consistent with the succession.

dates.quote: 以乙酉九月十一日示寂。
dates.note: Death 1405. ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +1327; death +1405
dates.note: DILA's source is a museum website (sarimuseum.com), i.e. weak; but the corpus independently gives the 1405 death.

bio.quote: 三方伯躍進而執其手曰此必無學也。與同歸而狀聞。太祖大喜。事以師禮。尚玄曰。謹按釋王寺諸錄。太祖夢身負三椽。無學以…
bio.note: lb=0687a22 — Taejo dreamt he carried three rafters; Muhak read it, and the king thereafter served him as a teacher.

notes: Royal preceptor and chief advisor to Yi Seonggye (King Taejo), the founder of the Joseon dynasty (1392). Muhak's most famous contribution was selecting the site of the new capital at Hanyang (modern Seoul) using geomantic principles, a decision that shaped the political geography of Korea. As Naong's dharma heir, he carried the unified Seon lineage into the new dynasty and served as a bridge between the Goryeo Buddhist establishment and the Joseon court, even as Neo-Confucian officials increasingly marginalized Buddhism. He designed the layout of key Seoul temples including Hoeryongsa. Attested in Joseon-era court records: his role in the capital selection and his advisory relationship with King Taejo are documented in the Joseon wangjo sillok (Annals of the Joseon Dynasty).

bio: Ming Chan master, lay surname Huai, of Xushan in Jiashan. He entered the order at the Dayun monastery in his home district and first practised Tiantai calming-and-insight. Fazhou Daoji, who was then keeping a sealed retreat at Tianning, told him his practice 'runs off into the lesser vehicle — the study of the Way must take awakening the mind as its master,' and gave him the huatou 'who is it that recites the Buddha's name.' He worked at it day and night, forgetting food and sleep; one day, having eaten without knowing it, his bowl fell to the ground and he woke as from a dream. Daoji sealed him. He then hid himself in the monasteries doing menial work, later dwelt at Qixia, and taught at Tianjie and Pude. Hanshan Deqing and Zibo Zhenke both sought him out; Hanshan was his disciple and wrote his biography.

steles.title: 雲谷先大師傳
steles.author: 憨山德清 (Hanshan Deqing)
steles.author_note: HIS OWN DISCIPLE
steles.quote: 師諱法會，別號雲谷，嘉善胥山懷氏子。生於弘治庚申。幼志出世，投邑大雲寺某公為師。初習瑜伽…年十九，即決志操方。尋登壇受具，聞天台小止觀法門，專精修習。法舟濟禪師續徑山之道，掩關於郡之天寧。師往參扣，呈其所修。舟曰：止觀之要，不依身心氣息，內外脫然。子之所修，流於下乘，豈西來的意耶？學道必以悟心為主。師悲仰請益，舟授以念佛審實話頭，直令重下疑情。師依教，日夜參究，寢食俱廢。一日受食，食盡亦不自知，碗忽墮地，猛然有省，恍如夢覺。復請益，舟乃蒙印可。
steles.note: *** THE DECISIVE TEXT. Written by his own disciple. It names 法舟道濟 as the man who gave him the huatou and the seal (印可). It also dates his birth: 弘治庚申 = 1500.

steles.kind: 塔銘 (recorded as existing; not located by me)
steles.title: 塔銘 for Yungu Fahui
steles.author: 袁黃 (Yuan Huang)
steles.author_note: the lay author of the Liaofan sixun
steles.quote: 寂後袁黃（1533-1606）撰塔銘，憨山為其傳。
steles.note: DILA A009611 records that Yuan Huang wrote his stupa inscription. I did NOT locate the text itself and do not assert its contents — only that DILA says it exists.

teacher.kind: 傳 by his own disciple 憨山德清
teacher.quote: 法舟濟禪師…舟授以念佛審實話頭…復請益，舟乃蒙印可。
teacher.note: *** CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER. Teacher = 法舟道濟.

teacher.kind: 憨山德清's own statement of his lineage
teacher.quote: 至弘正末，有濟關主，其門人為先師雲谷和尚，典則尚存。
teacher.note: lb=0595b10. Hanshan, in his own voice, says '濟關主' — Master Ji of the sealed room, i.e. 法舟道濟, who 掩關 at Tianning — 'was the teacher of my late master Yungu.' Second, independent statement by the same disciple.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道濟 (A001560); concise: 後聞法舟濟（1487-1560）續徑山之道，掩關於天寧，師往參扣，得印可。
teacher.note: DILA agrees: 法舟道濟.

teacher.kind: polemical text on the Hanshan–Yungu succession
teacher.quote: 清公立師神主，不曰明圓寂本師雲谷會禪師之神主乎？傍勒得法弟子德清立乎？
teacher.note: lb=0961b25. Hanshan set up a spirit-tablet reading 'my root teacher Chan Master Yungu Hui', signed 'erected by the dharma-heir Deqing'. Corroborates the Yungu→Hanshan link from a hostile/critical source.

dates.quote: 生於弘治庚申。
dates.note: BORN 1500. The roster's 1500 is RIGHT.
DILA's 1501 is an inference (依記錄推算) and is superseded by the disciple's explicit 弘治庚申 = 1500. DEATH 1575 — the roster's 1579 is WRONG.

school.note: DILA does NOT assign him to Linji. Given his teacher Fazhou Daoji descends via 吉菴祚, the roster's flat 'Linji' should be treated with caution.

links.label: DILA Authority A001560 (法舟道濟, the true teacher)

notes: Ming dynasty Chan master who pioneered 7-day meditation retreats. Teacher of Hanshan Deqing, one of the Four Great Monks of the Ming.

bio: Disciple of Hanshan Deqing, named among his chief disciples in the Eighty-Eight Patriarchs' Portrait Eulogies. He was the tonsure master of Ouyi Zhixu, one of the four eminent monks of the late Ming. Almost nothing else about him is recorded.

teacher.quote: 其上首弟子知微、善若…雪嶺峻等數十人，不具載。師甞示雪嶺峻曰：學道人第一要骨氣剛，次要識量大，次要生死心切。
teacher.note: 八十八祖道影傳贊 j.4 — places 雪嶺峻 as chief heir of 憨山德清 and shows Hanshan teaching him directly.

teacher.quote: 從其徒雪嶺剃度，明天啟二年也。
teacher.note: Confirms 雪嶺 as Hanshan's disciple and Zhixu's tonsure master (via DILA A007925 citation).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 德清 (A001681), cite 《八十八祖道影傳贊》卷4：「其上首弟子……雪嶺峻等數十人。」(X86n1608_p0649c19)
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED. He is listed among Hanshan's chief disciples.

school.note: DILA assigns NO sect. The roster's 'Linji' is unsupported.

links.label: DILA Authority A007925
links.confirms: teacher, role as Ouyi's tonsure master

notes: Disciple of Hanshan Deqing. Tonsure master of Ouyi Zhixu at Yunqi Temple.

bio: Major Korean Seon master of the mid-Joseon and dharma heir of Buhyu Seonsu. He led the reconstruction of Hwaeomsa and extended the Buhyu line into the middle Joseon period. He held the office of Supreme Superintendent of the Sixteen Schools of Seon and Gyo, and died in 1660. His stele carries the honorific: Great Seon Master, State Preceptor, Requiting Grace and Propagating the Teaching.

steles.title: 賜報恩闡教圓照國一都大禪師碧巖碑銘
steles.author: 李景奭 (Yi Gyeongseok)
steles.author_note: 原任大匡輔國崇祿大夫議政府領議政 — the retired Chief State Councillor of Joseon, the highest civil office in the realm
steles.quote: 賜報恩闡教圓照國一都大禪師碧巖碑銘。原任大匡輔國崇祿大夫議政府領議政兼領經筵弘文館藝文館春秋館觀象監事世子師李景奭撰
steles.note: HIS STELE, by the Chief State Councillor. Also carried at B/B31/B31n0170.xml lb=0410b20.

steles.title: 故俗離山賜報恩闡教圓照國一都大禪師兼禪教十六宗都摠攝…
steles.author: 李景奭
steles.quote: 鶴失近錫。鷗驚斷盃。山川變色。龍象興哀。頻伽遺韻。尚繞雲隈。眼有餘照。神不俱寺。維巖屹立終古獨碧。
steles.note: The verse of the inscription — it closes on his name: 'the cliff stands sheer, alone and blue-green (碧) through all time.'

steles.title: 賜報恩闡教國一都大禪師碧巖碑銘并序
steles.author: 李景奭 (領議政)
steles.quote: 大師法諱覺性，碧巖其號，湖西報恩人，俗姓金海之金。
steles.note: Also carried in B/B31/B31n0169.xml lb 0073a10 as 賜國一都大禪師碧巖碑. Erected despite his own instruction 戒勿封碑.

steles.title: 俗離山法住寺碧嵓大師碑銘并序
steles.author: 鄭斗卿
steles.quote: 故俗離山賜報恩闡教圓照國一都大禪師…特賜衣鉢碧嵓大師碑銘并序…鄭斗卿撰
steles.note: A SECOND, independent stele at 法住寺 (also in B31n0170 lb 0411b16). Two named men, two named graves.

teacher.kind: his own 碑銘 (stele), by 李景奭 (1595-1671), from the 行狀 (手狀) submitted by his disciple 律戒
teacher.quote: 浮休到華山，大異之，勉以真筌。乃從休師，入俗離山…自是相隨不暫離…蓋業于休門二十餘年，入室傳法。
teacher.note: 入室傳法 — entered the room and received the dharma. Twenty-odd years under Buhyu. The stele carefully keeps the other men apart: 雪默 was his tonsure-master (禮雪默而師之), 寶晶 gave him the precepts (受具于寶晶老師). Only Buhyu 傳法.

teacher.quote: 大師之承竺教，厥有所自。芙蓉靈觀接臨濟之遺緒。浮休與清虛休靜，俱事觀。靜傳之松雲，休傳之碧巖云。
teacher.note: 休傳之碧巖 — Buhyu transmitted to Byeogam. Explicit, on stone.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 善修 (부휴선수, A032251); concise: 浮休善修弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：23）
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: chronicle entry adjacent to the stele
dates.quote: 庚子元年…○沙門覺性入寂。【備考】賜報恩闡教國一都大禪師碧巖碑銘
dates.note: lb=0410b20. 庚子 = 1660. ROSTER'S DEATH CONFIRMED. No birth date found; the roster's 1575 is unsourced.

school.note: DILA classes the Korean Buhyu line as Linji-Yangqi by descent.

notes: Major post-Hyujeong figure. Led reconstruction of Hwaeomsa (1630-1636). Extended the Buhyu lineage into mid-Joseon.

bio: Caodong master of the late Song and early Yuan, lay surname Wei. Sharp as a boy and drawn to the school's teaching, he was tonsured by a Master Zhi in his home district, then left to travel — crossing the Taihang range into eastern Lu, studying the doctrinal vehicles under the Tripitaka master Yan and the Vinaya master De. He then went to Wanshou monastery in Yanjing and to Xueting Fuyu, under whom he grasped the profound purport and inherited the dharma. He attended Fuyu for ten years, and when Fuyu was near death he charged Wentai expressly with opening the hall at Shaolin, the ancestral monastery — and so he succeeded to the seat at Shaoshi.

teacher.kind: 五燈全書 lamp biography, under the heading 少室裕禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 少室裕禪師法嗣　西京少室靈隱文泰禪師，太原汾州陽城魏氏子。穎悟過人，篤好宗乘，遂從少室遊。未幾，即悟心要。故當時稱二泰一肅，為雪庭之高弟者，師其一也。
teacher.note: 'Heir of Chan master Yu of Shaoshi' is the section header; 少室 here = 雪庭福裕, abbot of Shaolin. 悟心要 + 高弟.

teacher.kind: lineage chain in 百丈清規證義記
teacher.quote: 琇傳少林萬壽雪庭福裕。裕傳嵩山靈隱文泰。泰傳寶應還源福遇。遇傳香嚴淳拙文才。才傳南陽萬安松庭子嚴。嚴傳嵩山凝然了改。改傳嵩山俱空契斌。
teacher.note: The whole Shaolin Caodong chain in one line; it fixes four of the men in this batch at once.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 福裕 (A015346); concise: 後詣燕京萬壽寺，參雪庭福裕，得契玄旨並嗣其法。侍錫十年，迨福公將入寂，特囑師開堂於少林祖剎，遂繼席少室。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +1236 依記錄推算; death +1289~1290
dates.note: ROSTER'S DEATH (1289) CONFIRMED; DILA supplies the birth, 1236, which the roster lacked.

bio.quote: 俗姓魏，南宋末元初曹洞宗僧。少即穎悟過人，篤好宗乘，禮本鄉智禪師剃髮受業…經太行入東魯，初習教乘於演三藏、德律師之法席；後詣燕京萬壽寺，參雪庭福裕，得契玄旨並嗣其法。

notes: Shaolin Monastery Caodong transmission. Link figure between Xueting Fuyu and the late Ming Caodong revival.

teacher.source: Korean Taego lineage lists (東師列傳)
teacher.quote: 龍巖慧彦 → 永月奉律 (연이은 법맥).
teacher.note: The teacher-edge (龍巖慧彦 → 永月奉律) is asserted by the Korean patriarch-lists; not verifiable in CBETA.

links.label: 불교닷컴: 근·현대불교 법맥의 근원 경허, 그의 법맥은
links.confirms: that the lineage containing Yeongwol Bongyul is one of three competing theories, and is disputed
links.verified: fetched; states 「이 설은 '용암 혜언-영월 봉율-만화 보선-경허 성우로 이어진다」 as the third of three rival accounts

notes: Late 18th-early 19th century Seon master. The 73rd Korean patriarch. One of the few masters in the intermediate chain with attested dates (1738-1823). Teacher of Manhwa Boseon, who in turn taught Gyeongheo.

bio: One of Xuedou Chongxian's principal heirs, lay surname Chen, of Yueqing. He first called on Shan of Jinluan and Sheng of Yexian, then went to Chongxian and received the dharma. He came out at the Iron Buddha monastery in Wuwei and later held Tianyi in Yuezhou, presiding at nine practice-grounds in all; in old age, ill, he retired to a hermitage on Shanshan at Chiyang. He taught the joint cultivation of Chan and Pure Land, and left the Tongming ji. The Yongzheng emperor conferred on him the posthumous title Chan Master Yuanzhan Zhenzong. His heirs include Yuanzhao Zongben and Yuantong Faxiu — through whom the Yunmen house reached the Northern Song capital.

teacher.source: X/X79/X79n1560.xml (禪林僧寶傳, 惠洪, c.1120)
teacher.quote: 懷初謁荊州金鑾善禪師。不契。後謁葉縣省禪師。又不契。東游至翠峯。眾盛。懷當營炊。自汲㵎。折擔悟旨。顯公印可。以為奇。
teacher.note: 顯公 = 雪竇重顯 (of 翠峯/Cuifeng). Verb 印可 (sealed). ⚠ Note the two NON-transmission encounters correctly distinguished: 謁金鑾善 (不契 — it FAILED) and 謁葉縣省 (又不契 — also failed). Only 雪竇 sealed him. The 折擔悟旨 (awakening when his carrying-pole broke) is the classic account.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 重顯 (A000885); concise: 雪竇重顯（980-1052）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十一世…後參重顯得法。
teacher.note: ROSTER CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: authority record citing 祖庭事苑
dates.quote: death +1064-11-12 治平元年甲辰九月二十五日示寂，俗壽七十二（《祖庭事苑》卷 5）
dates.note: Zhiping 1 (1064), aged 72 → born 993.

dates.quote: 嘉祐五年入寂，世壽七十二（佛光：5575）
dates.note: SOURCES DISAGREE: 佛光 gives Jiayou 5 (1060), also aged 72. Both are in DILA's own death field. I take 1064 (祖庭事苑), because it is the more precise notice (full date, cyclical year 甲辰 which checks out for 1064) and because 993+72 = 1064 in Chinese reckoning. But the disagreement is recorded, not silently resolved.

bio.quote: 越州天衣義懷禪師，樂清陳氏…初謁金鑾善、葉縣省，後參重顯得法。出世無為鐵佛，尋住越州天衣，凡九坐道場。晚年以疾居池陽杉山庵。提倡禪淨雙修，撰論明理，有《通明集》行於世。清雍正敕諡圓湛振宗禪師。法嗣有圓照宗本、圓通法秀等多人。

notes: One of Xuedou Chongxian's most important dharma heirs. He taught at Tianyi Monastery in Zhejiang and continued Xuedou's literary-poetic Chan. Through his student Huilin Zongben, who became abbot of the imperially sponsored Xiangguo Monastery in Kaifeng, his branch maintained a significant Yunmen institutional presence into the late 11th century.

bio: Tang–Five Dynasties master, of the Wang family of Yanting county in Zizhou, Jiannan. His account of conduct describes him as ancient of face and formidable, his brows hanging over his lashes, so that the old monks called him the Buddha Dipankara come again. He resolved on a teacher at Huiyi monastery, and after full ordination travelled south, seeing Yaoshan, Daowu, Yunyan and Xiandong, and then coming to the assembly of the Great Guishan, where for several years he ate less than his fill and slept without seeking warmth. Guishan asked why he never brought a question; told to ask 'what is Buddha', he simply put out his hand and covered Guishan's mouth — and Guishan sighed, 'you have truly got the marrow.' He returned to western Shu, boiled tea by the roadside for three years, and then found an ancient tree on Mount Dasui, four spans round, hollow and open to the south, needing no axe to make a hut. He lived in it more than ten years, and the age called it the wooden Chan hermitage. The king of Shu summoned him three times and he would not go; only when the envoy pleaded that refusal would cost him his own head did he accept the purple robe. His is the koan of the kalpa fire.

steles.title: 大隨開山神照禪師行狀
steles.author_note: an account of conduct — the primary life
steles.quote: 師諱法真，貌古有威，眉垂覆睫。嘗聞老宿輩皆稱為定光佛。示蹟於劒南梓州鹽亭縣王氏家生。族本簪纓，妙齡夙悟。決志尋師於慧義寺…師圓具後，遂遊南方。初見藥山．道吾．雲巖．先洞，次至嶺外大溈和尚會下。數載食不至充，臥不求暖。清苦鍊行，履操不群。大溈一見，乃深器之。一日大溈問曰：闍黎在老僧此中，不曾問一轉話。師云：教某甲向什麼處下口？溈云：何不道如何是佛？師便作手勢掩溈口。溈嘆曰：子真得其髓。…爾後聿旋西蜀，寄錫於天彭珊口山龍懷寺。路傍煎茶，普施三年。忽一日往後山，見一古院，號大隨山…中有一樹，圍四丈餘…南開一門，裏面虗通。不假斤斧，自然一庵。師乃居之…時人皆目之為木禪庵。師居十有餘年，影不出山，迹不出俗…蜀王崇重師名，凡三詔不從…遂於光天元年十月十五日，遣內侍賷紫衣．師號．寺額等賜師，師不受。
steles.note: *** HIS 行狀 IS IN THE CORPUS — an account of conduct for a 9th-century master. It is the source of his birthplace, his awakening, the hollow-tree hermitage, and the Shu king's summonses. DILA cites it for the death date.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 大安 (A003636); concise: 長慶大安禪師（793-883）法嗣。
teacher.note: The roster's reading. This is the standard lamp attribution.

teacher.kind: teacher relation citing 傳法正宗記
teacher.quote: TEACHER 靈祐 (A001984), cite 《傳法正宗記》卷7：「潭州溈山靈祐禪師。其所出法嗣……一曰溈山法真者。」(T51n2078)
teacher.note: *** A DIFFERENT ANSWER. The Chuanfa zhengzong ji lists him among GUISHAN LINGYOU's heirs, and even calls him 溈山法真.

teacher.quote: 次至嶺外大溈和尚會下…大溈一見，乃深器之…溈嘆曰：子真得其髓。
teacher.note: *** THE PRIMARY SOURCE IS AMBIGUOUS. The 行狀 says his awakening and recognition came under 大溈和尚 — 'the Great Guishan'. But BOTH candidates were abbots of Mount Gui: 溈山靈祐 founded it, and 長慶大安 succeeded him there and is himself often called 溈山大安. The 行狀 does not disambiguate. DILA's concise separately notes 「參道吾圓智、雲巖曇晟、溈山靈祐諸師，復於溈山門下刻苦修行，終於悟道」 — he awakened at Mount Gui.

dates.source: DILA A004046 citing his 行狀
dates.quote: birth +0834; death +0919-08-18 「乾德元年己卯七月十五日齋前，辭眾端坐而化，俗壽八十六」（〈大隨開山神照禪師行狀〉）
dates.note: Died Qiande 1 of Former Shu (己卯 = 919), aged 86 → born 834. ROSTER CONFIRMED.

school.quote: 唐末五代僧。鹽亭王氏（一說陳）
school.note: DILA assigns NO sect. The roster's 'Hongzhou' is defensible via either candidate teacher, both of whom descend from Baizhang/Mazu.

notes: Best known for the Kalpa Fire koan (BCR 29, BOS 30): 'When the great fire at the end of the kalpa destroys the universe, is this destroyed or not?' — 'Destroyed.' Touzi Datong called him 'the Ancient Buddha of West River.' Lived for over ten years in a hollow tree on Mt. Dasui in Sichuan, then ran a tea stall by the road. Also studied with Dongshan Liangjie and Yunyan Tansheng.

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Poshan Haiming, abbot of Huayan and Bao'en. His incense-offering recalls that he 'got it in the ranks of war' (兵戈隊裏得來) — he came to the dharma through the Ming–Qing collapse. He died in 1701 aged seventy-three, leaving an unusually large number of heirs, more than thirty of whom the lamps name.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 海明 (A009652), cite （明清序：047；X82n1571_p0337b05）
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. The live DILA page renders 德玉, 聖可 AND 破山/海明 together.

teacher.quote: 兵戈隊裏得來
teacher.note: From the harvest's reading of his own record of sayings.

dates.kind: authority record citing 華嚴寺續志 and 疑年錄
dates.quote: birth 「明崇禎元年七月十三日，世壽七十三。」（《華嚴寺續志》卷 2）; death 「康熙四十年。」（疑年錄：461）
dates.note: Chongzhen 1 (1628) to Kangxi 40 (1701); 1628 + 73 = 1701, internally consistent.

bio.quote: 法嗣有還初佛、南芝靜、子鐘洪、法空證、浮石演…（X85n1589_p0114a24）

links.label: DILA Authority A001669
links.verified: curl: 人名：1 筆; page renders 德玉/聖可/破山/海明

bio: Caodong master, of the Li family of Macheng in Hubei. As a child he would leap for joy at the sight of a monk; he left home at seven and took the full precepts at nineteen under Fumu of Shifeng, then studied the sutras and treatises. He went down to Jinling and called on Lang Zhangren, and then to Yuanjie Jingying at Yunyan, where he had an insight into the 'three not-thats' huatou and received the entrustment. He was abbot of Longhua on Bingshan at Huzhou and of Yunfeng at Hengzhou. He wrote the Fahua jing shoushou, notes on the Chanlin baoxun, and a record of sayings. After his death his body is said not to have decayed, the hair and beard continuing to grow.

steles.title: 元潔瑩禪師語錄 卷10 〈塔銘〉 — the TEACHER's stele, in the record 智祥 himself edited
steles.author: not read in full
steles.note: Catalogued at B/B35/B35n0194.xml lb 0345a16: 「元潔瑩禪師語錄十卷 … 智祥編，有行實、塔銘」. The heir edited his master's record and appended his master's 行實 and 塔銘 — the classic pattern. The 語錄 text itself does not appear to be in the corpus on disk; the catalogue entry is the witness that it exists.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense, at his own enthronement (頻吉祥禪師語錄 卷1)
teacher.quote: 復懷中出香曰：「此香種植得地，灌溉有源，正芬芳於獅子峰頭，被一陣風吹落兩浙三吳，星霜歷盡，末後移到弁嶽山中，頓使氣消葉盡，今朝忽遭人於千里外撥動寒灰，放出遼天惡氣，就此熏他現住江西雲巖堂上傳洞山正宗第二十九世睦堂瑩老和尚，不是報德酬恩，且要明冤理屈。」
teacher.note: THE dharma stick — the one he draws 懷中 (from his own bosom), after the emperor's stick. He names the living man in full: 雲巖堂上, Caodong 29th generation, 睦堂瑩 = 元潔淨瑩. The closing 「不是報德酬恩，且要明冤理屈」 is a deliberate Chan inversion of the 用酬法乳之恩 formula — 'not to repay a debt, but to right an injustice' — which is a joke only because everyone present knows the formula it is displacing.

teacher.kind: own 上堂 (New Year, 癸亥/1683)
teacher.quote: 山僧自受先雲巖密印已來，迄今二十一年，竟未曾向人舉著。
teacher.note: 'Since I received the secret seal of my late master Yunyan, twenty-one years have passed.' 受…密印 = he received the seal. Dates the transmission to c. 1662.

teacher.quote: 睦堂老人忌辰。…翻思二十三年事，破泣為歌恨轉多。
teacher.note: He keeps 睦堂's death-anniversary as an heir keeps a father's. 睦堂 is 元潔淨瑩's own alternative name (per DILA A010055).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 淨瑩 (A010055); concise: 元潔淨瑩（1612-1672）法嗣…參元潔瑩於雲巖，看三不是話有省。承付囑。
teacher.note: *** THIS RESOLVES THE HARVEST'S CAUTION. The harvest wrote: 'CAUTION: I read 雲巖老和尚 and 睦堂瑩 as one man — the record never says so in one breath.' DILA A010055 carries BOTH names as alternatives for one person: 淨瑩 | 睦堂 | 元潔 | 元潔瑩 | 元潔淨瑩 | 睦堂淨瑩 | 雲巖瑩. The harvest's reading was CORRECT: 雲巖老和尚 = 睦堂瑩 = 元潔淨瑩, one man.

teacher.quote: 淨瑩 | alternative: 睦堂 | 元潔 | 元潔瑩 | 元潔淨瑩 | 睦堂淨瑩 | 雲巖瑩. 瑞白明雪禪師之嫡嗣。birth 「生明神宗萬曆壬子三月十七」（《元潔瑩禪師語錄》卷10〈塔銘〉）; death 「寂康熙壬子又七月廿四」
teacher.note: The teacher's own dates (1612–1672) and his own 塔銘. His teacher in turn is 瑞白明雪 — the edge climbs.

dates.quote: birth 「生於明崇禎丙子（1636）臘月十日。」; death 1709
dates.note: Born on the 10th day of the 12th lunar month of 1636 = January 1637.

bio.quote: 清僧。元潔淨瑩（1612-1672）法嗣。麻城（今屬湖北）李氏…七歲出家。十九從獅峰浮木受具戒，研究經論。後下金陵，參浪杖人。參元潔瑩於雲巖，看三不是話有省。承付囑。住湖州并山龍華及衡州雲峰。寂後，肉身不壞，鬚髮生長不已。著有《法華經授手》、《禪林寶訓筆記》、《語錄》若干卷。
bio.note: The two abbacies (Longhua on Bingshan at Huzhou; Yunfeng at Hengzhou) MATCH the harvest's independent reading of J39nB454 exactly — same man confirmed.

links.label: DILA Authority A010055 (his teacher 元潔淨瑩)
links.confirms: that 睦堂 and 雲巖瑩 are the same man

school: Caodong (曹洞宗) — the Shouchang 壽昌 line
bio: Caodong master, of the Feng family of Jianyang in Fujian, born in 1577. He was tonsured in 1604 under Likong at Huxiaoyan, and became a dharma heir of Wuming Huijing of Shouchang. He was abbot of Dongyuan at Jianning in the Wuyi mountains, and is styled in his own stupa inscription 'first-generation Chan patriarch of Wuyi'. He died in 1630 aged fifty-four. His stele places him second, after Boshan Yuanlai, among the men who carried Shouchang's revived Caodong line forward.

steles.title: 武夷第一代禪祖東苑鏡公大師墖銘并序
steles.author_note: appended to his own 語錄 (附墖銘)
steles.quote: 附墖銘。武夷第一代禪祖東苑鏡公大師墖銘并序。宗門獨貴具擇法眼，而能得人傳，雖久不絕也…近世濟洞雖微，尚有人至於能使洞水逆流如壽昌，而又得人傳其真，真而必可久者，誠千古中興之祖也。自壽昌掃絕流獘，獨唱祖機，而諸方尊宿聳耳而驚、乘風而起者，駸駸然首得博山、繼得東苑，如圓悟之有杲有隆、一顯一晦，其東苑亦…
steles.note: *** HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION, appended to his own record of sayings. It names him as Shouchang's (Wuming Huijing's) heir — 'from Shouchang… first came Boshan, then came Dongyuan' — i.e. he is the dharma-brother of Boshan Yuanlai. DILA cites this same 墖銘 for BOTH his birth and his death.

teacher.quote: 自壽昌掃絕流獘，獨唱祖機…駸駸然首得博山、繼得東苑
teacher.note: The stele derives him from 壽昌 = 無明慧經, alongside 博山 = 無異元來. TEACHER CONFIRMED at his own grave.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 慧經 (A003828), cite （明清序：030；X81n1570_p0383c24）

dates.source: DILA A015910 citing his 墖銘
dates.quote: birth 生于萬曆丁丑六月廿五日（《晦臺元鏡禪師語錄》卷1〈武夷第一代禪祖東苑鏡公大師墖銘并序〉）; death 崇禎庚午七月十三日子夜，世壽五十四（同上）
dates.note: Born 1577-07-20, died 1630-08-20 aged 54. The harvest had only the birth year; the stele supplies the death.

bio.quote: 閩建陽人，姓馮，武夷山東苑僧人。

links.label: DILA Authority A015910
links.confirms: dates, teacher, school, and the existence of the 墖銘

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, from Anlu in Chu, dharma heir of Muchen Daomin. He was abbot of Longya at Tanzhou, and died in 1676 aged fifty-seven.

teacher.kind: own 語錄 — sermon on receiving the dharma-robe from his master
teacher.quote: 弘覺本師老和尚寄法衣至，示眾。「香嚴接得溈山拄杖便哭蒼天，合哭不合笑？龍牙寄來天童法衣搭在肩頭，合笑不合哭？…」乃提起袈裟，云：「還見麼？…今日山僧復挂之。」
teacher.note: First-person, at the transmission. 弘覺 is Muchen Daomin's imperially bestowed title; 本師 = 'my own root master'. Benzhu holds up the robe sent to him at Longya from Tiantong and preaches on it. This is the robe of transmission, not a gift.

teacher.quote: 天童師翁密老和尚讚
teacher.note: He calls Miyun Yuanwu 密雲圓悟 of Tiantong his 師翁 — grandfather-master. That fixes the line Miyun → Muchen → Benzhu exactly, from his own hand.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 道忞 (A001513), cite （明清序：054；X85n1586_p0002a05）
teacher.note: CONFIRMED — the teacher is on the existing 301-roster, so this edge lands.

dates.kind: authority record citing the preface to his own 語錄
dates.quote: death 「丙辰八月十四日，而尚唱滅時，春秋五十有七。」（《雲叟住禪師語錄》卷 1〈龍牙雲叟禪師語錄序〉）
dates.note: Died 1676 aged 57 → born 1620. The harvest had NO dates.

bio.quote: 楚安陸人，潭州龍牙僧人。（疑年錄：451）
bio.note: Anlu in Chu and Longya at Tanzhou — MATCHES the harvest's independent reading of J34nB310.

links.label: CBETA 語錄 J34nB310
links.verified: carried from the harvest, which read the text

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Lingji Xingguan. A preface to his own record of sayings calls him 'my dharma-brother Zuliang, who awakened and verified in his prime, entering in person the room of the old man Lingji at Yangfen.' He left a record of sayings in two fascicles.

teacher.quote: 復拈香云：「此一瓣香，超啟自十七歲時向秦郵天王禪床角頭覷著，末後撞著個不近人情老漢，一槌擊碎…于無把握處拈出，供養中興、翔鳳、資福，次住即此堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二世上靈下機觀老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。」
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick, and it is the THIRD stick — the first went to 今上皇帝 (0465c12), the second to 滿朝文武 (0465c16). Only this one carries 用酬法乳之恩. He names himself (超啟) in the first person and names 上靈下機觀老和尚 = 靈機行觀, 32nd generation of the Linji orthodox line. Cannot be stronger.

teacher.kind: preface to his own 語錄, by a dharma-brother
teacher.quote: 我祖亮法兄，英年悟證，親入揚墳靈機老人之室。
teacher.note: 親入…之室 = personally entered his room (i.e. received transmission). Written by a 法兄 (dharma-brother), i.e. a fellow heir of 靈機 — independent corroboration of the incense.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 行觀 (A004078), cite 《祖亮啟禪師語錄》卷1：「我祖亮法兄英年悟證，親入揚墳靈機老人之室」(CBETA, J39, no. B449, p. 459, a4-5)
teacher.note: *** THE HARVEST'S DANGLING EDGE NOW CLIMBS. The harvest wrote: 'Teacher Lingji Guan is attested but has no located lamp entry of his own, so his own teacher is unestablished; the edge will dangle.' DILA has him: 靈機行觀, A004078, with dates AND a teacher.

teacher.quote: 行觀 | 資福靈機 | 靈機 | 靈機觀 | 靈機行觀. birth 「生於萬曆丙辰正月廿三日寅刻。」（《靈機禪師語錄》卷 6〈行狀〉）; death 「示寂於康熙辛酉九月廿九日子時，世壽六十有六。」; concise: 費隱通容禪師（1593-1661）法嗣…首參天童圓悟于天童，次謁金粟通容，蒙印可。
teacher.note: *** 靈機行觀 (1616–1681) is the heir of 費隱通容, who is the heir of 密雲圓悟. The chain now runs 祖亮超啟 → 靈機行觀 → 費隱通容 → 密雲圓悟, and lands on the roster.

bio.quote: 為靈機行觀禪師（1616-1681）法嗣。有《祖亮啟禪師語錄》二卷。

links.label: DILA Authority A004078 (his teacher 靈機行觀)
links.confirms: the teacher's full name, dates, and his own teacher 費隱通容

links.label: CBETA 語錄 J39nB449
links.verified: carried from the harvest, which read the text

school: Caodong (曹洞宗) — the Shouchang 壽昌 line
bio: Caodong master of the Shouchang line, of the Hu family of Nancheng in Jianchang. In his own account of conduct, dictated at Longhu monastery in Xincheng, he says: 'this mountain monk is named Yuanmi, styled Jianru, and also Quran; a son of the Hu family of Nancheng in Jianchang. My father was named Fu, my mother of the Ning clan.' He was born on the third day of the twelfth month of 1579. Taken as a boy by his father to Baofang, he met the monk Wuming Huijing and was won over by him; he returned alone the next morning to ask for instruction, and Huijing gave him a verse and told him to work at it day and night. At twenty-one he gave up meat and wine and asked to be tonsured, but Huijing refused while his parents lived, so he went to Fuzhou and took the robe from the dharma master Kai of Jinshan. He returned to Baofang as fire-keeper. Huijing, looking into the stove, said: 'if you want the rice cooked, you must turn your body in the flames and see the wall.' He took up the phrase, and after seven or eight days, standing behind the hall at the third watch, body and mind fell still. He died in 1649, aged seventy-one.

steles.title: 行實
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON — dictated by the master at the request of the layman Hai'an and his disciples
steles.quote: 己卯，師在新城龍湖寺，海岸居士偕諸弟子請說行實，師𠃔其請。述曰：山僧名元謐，字見如，一字閴然，建昌南城胡氏子也。父名富，母寗氏…乃萬曆己卯年十二月初三日也…一日，偶隨父至寶方，謁無明經和尚，傾服道風。明旦，獨往寶方，求開示。和尚異之，遂示偈曰：本地風光騰法界…其年二十一歲，遂斷葷酒…遂抵撫州，禮金山鎧法師祝髮…和尚一日至竈前，看竈內曰：欲得飯熟，須是火焰裏轉身見壁始得。予即提此語，晝夜參究。越七、八日，夜立殿後，至三更，身心俱寂…
steles.note: *** HIS OWN ACCOUNT OF CONDUCT, IN HIS OWN VOICE. It gives his name, style, second style, birthplace, parents, birth date, the meeting with Wuming Huijing, the tonsure master, and the awakening. There is no closer evidence.

teacher.quote: 偶隨父至寶方，謁無明經和尚，傾服道風…和尚一日至竈前…予即提此語，晝夜參究。
teacher.note: *** FIRST-PERSON. 無明經和尚 = 無明慧經. Teacher CONFIRMED in the master's own words. Note the tonsure master is a DIFFERENT man — 金山鎧法師 — which the account carefully distinguishes.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 慧經 (A003828), cite (X80n1566_p0446a02)

dates.source: DILA A015916 citing his 行實
dates.quote: birth 「乃萬曆己卯年十二月初三日也。」（《見如元謐禪師語錄》卷 1〈行實〉）; death 「師寂于己丑，世壽七十有一。」（同上）
dates.note: Born 1579-12-30; died 己丑 = 1649, aged 71. The harvest had only the birth year.

links.label: CBETA 語錄 X72n1434
links.confirms: his record of sayings, containing the 行實
links.verified: carried from the harvest; I read the 行實 in the local corpus copy

bio: Caodong master of Baoxianglin at Nanhai in Guangdong, lay name Zhang Mingda, of Longjiang in Shunde; his father was Yinliang and his mother of the Deng clan. His mother, having repeatedly borne children who did not live, prayed to Guanyin and conceived him. At seventeen he took the robe at Dinghu and was given the name Kaixiong. He became the dharma heir of Zaishan Hongzan. The Dinghushan gazetteer's life of him — under his sobriquet Shijian, 'Stone Arrow' — records that when the venerable Zaiweng came to his village he went to call on him, their question and answer matched, and he went straight home, took leave of his parents, and left to study with him. His record of sayings assembles the comments-on-the-ancients of two hundred Caodong monks. He died in 1676 aged forty-three.

teacher.kind: own 語錄, the transmission event itself (秉拂, 壬子/1672 新年)
teacher.quote: 秉拂壬子元正，老和尚示眾。首座出問，機緣相契，即以衣拂付之。座禮謝老和尚竟…詗上座今日承老和尚傳來，雙手接到，不難不易；一肩披上，無欠無餘。
teacher.note: First-person, AT the transmission: the robe and whisk are 付 (conferred) on him. The giver is named only by title (老和尚) in this passage — the two entries below name him.

teacher.lb: 卷四 (侍者傳調錄, 偈頌)
teacher.kind: the TEACHER's own collected writings (木人剩稿 = 鼎湖山木人居在犙禪師剩稿)
teacher.quote: 庚戌元旦別慧弓首座號石箭：「一弓纔秉，須彌殞質。毒箭仰施，虛空失色。」
teacher.note: Hongzan's OWN book, addressing 慧弓 as his 首座 (head seat) at New Year 庚戌/1670 — two years before the 壬子/1672 robe-and-whisk conferral above. This is the giver, in his own hand, naming the receiver.

teacher.kind: contemporary printed byline in the teacher's own book
teacher.quote: 粤東鼎湖山沙門釋　弘贊在犙　註　門人比丘　開詗　記 … 師之上足石箭詗公，記師日前闡演之言，註于章末
teacher.note: 開詗 is 弘贊's 門人 (disciple) and, in the preface, 師之上足 — 'the master's foremost disciple'. Printed in their lifetimes (順治庚子/1660 preface).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 弘贊 (A000244), cite 《鼎湖山慶雲寺志．卷5．石箭大師傳》：「適在翁和尚至里，師往謁見。問答相契，遽歸拜辭父母，往從師學。」; concise: 為弘贊在犙禪師法嗣，南海寶象林住持。
teacher.note: *** CORRECTS THE HARVEST. The harvest recorded the teacher as 瀛山智誾 with an explicit caveat: 'no explicit 「本師 X…用酬法乳」 formula survives; the teacher is read from the lineage-incense plus the FELLOW-STUDENT relation to 在犙弘贊.' DILA says 在犙弘贊 is not his fellow-student but his TEACHER. This is exactly the brief's systematic error — a transmission mistaken for an association — occurring in the inverse direction.

dates.quote: birth +1634; death 「清康熙十五年卒，年四十三。」（疑年錄：468）
dates.note: Died 1676 aged 43 → born 1634. The harvest had NO dates.

school.quote: 所作《南海寶象林慧弓詗禪師語錄》…內容主要輯錄曹洞宗僧二百人之拈古，今收錄於《嘉興藏》第35冊。

bio.kind: concise biography citing 鼎湖山慶雲寺志
bio.quote: 順邑龍江人，俗姓張。父寅亮，母鄧氏…母親因屢產不育，禱觀音大士而娠。十七歲時投鼎湖和尚削髮，名開詗。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Poshan Haiming, and a great teacher in his own right — the lamps count many heirs, of whom Chisong Daoling carried the line into Guizhou. In his own account of conduct he says he was a son of the Wang family of Tongchuan prefecture in Sichuan; he brooded daily on impermanence, suffering and emptiness, felt at twenty-five that he had wasted his life, and could not get his family's leave to go, until he took up a pair of shears and made to cut off his hair, and so broke out of the cage. He was tonsured by Master Jiankong. Reading the Heart Sutra at 'the five aggregates are empty', doubt broke open in him. He read Hanshan's expedient words on Zhaozhou's dog, and knew that what he had was only 'use on the road' and not the house itself. Hearing that a great teacher had appeared at Liangshan — 'the venerable Poshan is truly an eye for men and gods' — he went to him, was given the dog-and-Buddha-nature huatou, took the full precepts, and was sent off with three fascicles of the record of sayings. He was abbot of Baizhang in Sichuan and of Sanmei at Shiqian in Guizhou, and died in 1672 aged seventy.

steles.title: 行實
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON — spoken by the master when his disciple Weixue and the assembly asked for the causes of his pilgrimage
steles.quote: 山僧亦非別布政人，乃是本省潼川州王氏子，每日思念無常、苦、空，自覺虛度光陰二十有五…忽一日，省一個方法，執一把剪刀，將欲去髮，而親族難勉，所以得脫樊籠，遂依本境禮鑑空師薙染…偶一朝看《心經》，至五蘊皆空，度一切苦厄，忽然疑情觸發…忽一日，披憨山大師方便語，至狗子無佛性話，更加深疑…忽有一僧來云：『梁山出一大善知識，上破下山和尚真是人天眼目。』…次期與張善人同往親師，師示以狗子無佛性話，頗有入處。受具畢，辭師起身，師仍賜語錄三卷，送出山門。
steles.note: *** FIRST-PERSON. 上破下山和尚 is the honorific way of naming 破山 (Poshan) — the teacher, in the master's own mouth, with the huatou and the ordination.

teacher.quote: 梁山出一大善知識，上破下山和尚真是人天眼目…師示以狗子無佛性話，頗有入處。受具畢…
teacher.note: *** FIRST-PERSON. Teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 海明 (A009652), cite （明清序：045；X85n1591_p0228b21）
teacher.note: X85n1591 = 黔南會燈錄, the Guizhou lamp — the local source, closest to his circle.

dates.source: DILA A010077 citing 黔南會燈錄
dates.quote: birth +1603; death 「康熈壬子仲冬朔三日亥時示寂，春秋七十」（《黔南會燈錄》卷1）
dates.note: Died 1672 aged 70 → born 1603. The harvest had NO dates.

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Yuan and early-Ming master, fifty-third patriarch of Jingshan. Song Lian's stupa inscription opens: 'the master's name was Zhiji, styled Yizhong, a son of the Gu family of Wu county in Suzhou; his father was Maoqing, his mother of the Zhou clan.' He entered the Haiyun cloister as a boy, advancing in the Buddhist books and the Confucian classics together. He went to Jianye and saw Guangzhi Xin at the great Longxiang monastery, who — with the leading literary men of the age — was so struck by his gifts that they vied to praise him. But a fellow-monk rebuked him: 'with talent as sharp as this, do you not think to shoulder the great Dharma, and are content to be a slave to poetry?' He could not answer. He went back to Haiyun with a boulder in his chest, and for more than a month did not close his eyes — until he saw an autumn leaf blow down into the courtyard and suddenly awoke. Unwilling to trust himself without testing, he took his staff to Shuangjing and called on Jizhao Duan — Yuansou Xingduan — who had long marked him as a vessel of the dharma, questioned him, and found him answering as a falcon drops through the autumn sky. He was made attendant, then keeper of the library. He came out at Longjiao in 1342, moved to Puci, was installed at Jingci by the Left Chancellor in 1358, and rose to Jingshan. He died in 1378, aged sixty-eight.

steles.title: 塔銘 (No.1421-B)
steles.author: 宋濂 (Song Lian)
steles.author_note: 前翰林學士承旨嘉議大夫知制誥兼脩國史兼太子贊善大夫金華宋濂 — Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts, the foremost prose stylist of the early Ming
steles.quote: 師諱智及，字以中，蘇之吳縣顧氏子。父茂卿，母周氏…遂走建業，見廣智訢公於大龍翔集慶寺。廣智以文章道德傾動一世…師之同袍嶼上人呵曰：子才俊爽若此，不思負荷大法，甘作詩騷奴僕乎？…師舌噤不能答，即歸海雲，胸中如礙巨石，目不交睫者踰月。忽見秋葉吹墜于庭，豁然有省…於是杖䇿遊虎林，升雙徑山，謁寂照端公，自列其所證甚悉。初寂照嘗以法器期師，聞其言喜甚，因勘辨之，師隨機而答，隼落秋空而兔走荒原也…未幾，命執侍左右，以便咨叩。俄遷主藏室…
steles.note: *** HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION BY SONG LIAN. And it is itself a lesson in the association/transmission distinction: 廣智大訢 was his patron and admired his LITERARY gifts; the transmission is from 寂照端公 = 元叟行端 at Jingshan, who tested him (勘辨) and took him as attendant.

teacher.quote: 升雙徑山，謁寂照端公，自列其所證甚悉。初寂照嘗以法器期師…因勘辨之…未幾，命執侍左右…俄遷主藏室。
teacher.note: *** TEACHER CONFIRMED by the stele. 寂照端公 = 元叟行端, abbot of Jingshan. The harvest's edge holds.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 行端 (A001032)

dates.source: DILA A015578 citing his 塔銘
dates.quote: birth +1311; death 「戊午八月忽示微疾，至九月四日，索筆書偈而逝，……，世壽六十八。」（《愚菴智及禪師語錄》卷 10〈塔銘〉）
dates.note: Died Hongwu 11 (1378), 9th month 4th day, aged 68 → born 1311. The harvest had NO dates.

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: A NUN, and one of the very few women of the Ming–Qing with a record of sayings in the Jiaxing canon. Lay surname Jin, lay name Jin Shuxiu; her dharma name was Xuanzong and her style Baochi. Widowed, she took the robe, and became the dharma heir of Tuiweng Hongchu, thirty-third generation of Linji. She was first abbess of Miaozhan at Jiahe, then of Nanxun at Yanguan, and afterwards at Lingyan. Her record of sayings runs to two fascicles.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (開堂 at 禾城妙湛禪院)
teacher.quote: 開堂日陞座，拈香云：「大眾見麼？…要聽山僧表彰，分明記取，舉似諸方，爇向爐中，供養靈嵒堂上本師退翁和尚。」便燒
teacher.note: A SINGLE stick, and it goes to 靈巖堂上本師退翁和尚 = 退翁弘儲, abbot of 靈巖. No emperor stick, no ordination stick to compete with it — the dharma attribution is unambiguous. First-person, at her enthronement. (寶持玄總 is a woman, 俗姓金; her 語錄 was recorded by 參學門人明英.)

teacher.quote: TEACHER 弘儲 (A000241), cite （明清序：079；J35nB337_p0705b02）; concise: 為退翁弘儲禪師（1605-1672）法嗣，為臨濟三十三世。俗姓金，師諱玄總字寶持；初住嘉禾妙湛，次住鹽官南詢，繼住靈巖…有《寶持總禪師語錄》二卷。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. Her teacher 繼起弘儲 is also in this batch — the two entries are internally consistent.

school.quote: [sect] 臨濟宗 楊岐派; 臨濟三十三世

bio.kind: concise biography citing 五燈全書 and her own 語錄
bio.quote: 俗姓金，師諱玄總字寶持；初住嘉禾妙湛，次住鹽官南詢，繼住靈巖嗣祖沙門碓菴曉青書於大鑒堂中。

links.label: DILA Authority A019288
links.confirms: teacher, school, the three abbacies, lay name

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Founder-abbot of Qianling at Guiyang and the man who planted the Linji line in Guizhou. In the account of his course, dictated in 1682, he says: 'I am a son of the Han family, born on the twenty-fourth day of the fourth month of 1634; our ancestral home is Changsha, but we lived at Tongchuan in Shu. My father was named Liang, my mother of the Xie clan.' His father died when he was six; his mother and elder brother raised him, and war drove the family into Guizhou. At fifteen he fled into the Nanwang mountains with a companion, living on grass and wood and reciting the Buddha's name until he was thin as a stick. He studied under Jiufeng Lingyao, took Baiyun Xishi as his tonsure master, and afterwards, at Zunyi, called on the master who would become his own. The master asked where he was from. 'Tongchuan.' 'Then you are from my own district' — and the two shouted at each other, and the master beat him out of the room. The next day the master read his verse and asked, 'is this awakening, or is it learning?' 'Do not rub your eyes and make flowers in the air.' He bowed; the master gave him a nudge and said, 'take good care of yourself,' and later handed over the whisk with a verse: 'go deep into hiding, and the dragons and gods will push you out.' In 1667 he was asked to head the Shoushi Chan cloister in the provincial capital, sealed himself in a cell there for a thousand days, and on coming out was asked to found Qianling. He taught for more than thirty years.

steles.title: 行由
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON — dictated in the summer of 1682 at the request of his disciple Dazhuo and the assembly
steles.quote: 康熙壬戌夏，門人大拙率眾於方丈請示入道因繇…乃曰：「予韓氏子，生於甲戌四月廿四，祖籍長沙，寓蜀潼川，父諱亮公，母謝氏。六歲慈父見背，母兄撫而教之，未幾遇亂，隨戎入黔。至十五歲…逃入南望山中，艸衣木食…參九峰靈藥和尚…復指依白雲西識和尚為業師…後於遵城參本師和尚，師問：『何處人？』予曰：『潼川。』師曰：『既是潼川，與老僧同鄉，同在甚處？』…後書偈拂囑曰：『此去深隱，自有龍天推出。』…康熙丁未春，都閫張公請住省中壽世禪院…又請開建黔靈。」
steles.note: *** FIRST-PERSON, and it corroborates his teacher by an independent route: his 本師 says 'you are from Tongchuan — then you are my fellow-countryman.' Minshu Ruxiang's OWN 行實 (J39nB450) says he is 本省潼川州王氏子. The two first-person texts, in different books, lock together.

teacher.quote: 後於遵城參本師和尚，師問：『何處人？』予曰：『潼川。』師曰：『既是潼川，與老僧同鄉』…後書偈拂囑曰…
teacher.note: *** FIRST-PERSON. His 本師 (root teacher) is a fellow Tongchuan man who hands him the whisk — and Minshu Ruxiang is precisely a Tongchuan man. Note the account carefully DISTINGUISHES this from his 業師 (tonsure master) 白雲西識 and his earlier teacher 九峰靈藥.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 如相 (A010077), cite （明清序：082；X85n1589_p0113b08）

dates.source: DILA A016604 citing his 行由
dates.quote: birth 「生於甲戌四月廿四」（《赤松領禪師語錄》卷 5〈行由〉）
dates.note: Born 1634-05-20. NO DEATH DATE in DILA or the corpus.

bio.quote: 潼川人，姓韓，黔靈僧人…參敏樹和尚發明，親承印證，閉關三載，出闢黔靈開法，行化三十餘年，道振黔地…得法者數十餘人。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master of the Song who carried the school to Japan. From western Shu, he left home at Jiangshan, then went to Wuzhun Shifan at Jingshan and laboured under him for several years; in 1235 Shifan sent him on to Chijue Daochong. He first held the Lingyan Guangfu cloister at Xiangshan in Qingyuan. In 1260 he was invited to Japan and became the second abbot of Kenchō-ji at Kamakura, where he taught the regent Hōjō Tokiyori. He returned to China in 1265 and spent his last years at Longxiang on Jiangxinshan in Wenzhou, dying on the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month of 1276 at seventy-eight. Posthumously titled Chan Master Zongjue. The Japanese know him as Gottan Funei.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense, at his first enthronement (靈巖)
teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，生無陰陽之地，出絕思慮之鄉…今日人天眾前當陽爇却，奉為見住徑山佛鑑圓照禪師大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: First-person, at the transmission. 「見住徑山佛鑑圓照禪師」 = the THEN-LIVING abbot of 徑山, 佛鑑 — i.e. 無準師範 (imperial title 佛鑑禪師, abbot of 徑山 1232-1249).
