Identity nailed down by his own memorial-day incense: X71n1404 lb 0023a05 「徑山佛鑑忌，拈香云：每年三月十八，憶著痛恨入骨」 — 3/18 is 無準師範's death date (淳祐九年三月十八日) — and lb 0028b12 「無凖忌，拈香云：這箇老漢…」 uses the name outright. Same man, same anniversary.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 師範 (A004697); concise: 號兀菴，徑山無準師範法嗣。西蜀人，出家於蔣山。後謁無準師範，苦參數年。端平二年（1235）師範囑參癡絕道冲。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +1200 依記錄推算; death 「景炎元年11月24日（1276年12月30日）」…「年七十八」（宋僧著：563）
dates.note: SOURCES DISAGREE ON THE BIRTH. DILA's structured birth field says 1200, but its own death note gives 1276 at age 78 — which computes to a birth of 1199, and the harvest/ja-wiki give 1197–1276. The DEATH (1276) is firm and agreed. I record birth as 1199 as the value implied by the age-at-death, and flag that the harvest's 1197 and DILA's 1200 both circulate.

bio.quote: 初住慶元府象山靈巖廣福禪院，開慶元年（1260）受請至日本，住持巨福山建長興國禪寺。景定五年（1265）回國。晚年住溫州江心山龍翔寺。景炎元年十一月二十四日卒，年七十八，諡「宗覺禪師」。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派) — the Qingshan 磬山 line
bio: Linji master of the Qingshan (磬山) line, of the Wang family of Wuyuan in Xin'an. He was the dharma heir of Tongshou, and so a grand-heir of Tianyin Yuanxiu. He was abbot of Shending at Changsha, and died in 1654 aged forty-eight.

steles.title: 神鼎雲外澤禪師傳
steles.author_note: in his own record of sayings, fascicle 15
steles.quote: 「萬曆丁未秋八月初度，壽四十有八」（《神鼎雲外澤禪師語錄》卷 15〈神鼎雲外澤禪師傳〉）
steles.note: Cited by DILA for his birth. I did not locate the 傳 by <head> search in the local copy — the citation is DILA's, and I record it as such rather than asserting a path/lb I have not confirmed.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his 開堂 (enthronement)
teacher.quote: 拈香祝聖訖，復拈香，云：生平扶弱不扶強，不涉恩讎獨主張，雪窖冰枯紅燄發，一爐香散海雲忙，奉為磬山第二代松際先師授和尚，爇向爐中，從教匝地熏天去也。
teacher.note: The SECOND stick — the first went to the emperor (祝聖). The dharma stick names 磬山第二代 松際先師 授和尚. First-person, at the transmission.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 at a second 陞座
teacher.quote: 拈香祝聖訖，次拈香云：三十年來弄馬騎，誰知卻被瞎驢記？…今日對人天眾前敬為磬山第二代先師授和尚當空爇卻，普請同觀。
teacher.note: Repeats the dedication independently. Again the emperor's stick first, the master's stick second.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 通授 (A010045); concise: 印中通授禪師法嗣。新安嫠源人，俗姓汪。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 通授 | alternative: 印中 | 松際 | 印中通授 | 印中授. birth +1593; death 「崇禎壬午八月二十二日也，世壽五十，僧臘三十有四。」; concise: 俗姓嚴，年十七投道場山脫白，後依磬山修。嗣法門人神鼎雲外澤禪師。
teacher.note: *** THIS RESOLVES THE HARVEST'S NAME WARNING. The harvest wrote 松際通授 and warned that 'the corpus consistently abbreviates the teacher to a single [character]'. DILA carries BOTH 松際 and 印中 as sobriquets of ONE man (A010045). The harvest's name is right; DILA's headword is 印中通授. And DILA names 雲外行澤 as his heir, closing the loop. His own teacher is 磬山修 = 天隱圓修 — CONFIRMING the harvest's 'grand-heir of Tianyin Yuanxiu'.

dates.quote: birth 「萬曆丁未秋八月初度，壽四十有八」; death 「順治甲午，師示寂」（《五燈全書》卷 81）
dates.note: Born 1607, died 1654 aged 48 — the age MATCHES the harvest's independent 'died aged 48'.

links.label: DILA Authority A010045 (his teacher)
links.confirms: that 松際 and 印中 are the same man, and that Yunwai Xingze is his heir

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Poshan Haiming. In his own account of conduct he says: 'I am a man of Yiliang county in Yunnan; my father's surname was Gu, my mother of the Shi clan. The family was poor and I did not read as a boy. At fourteen I left home, tonsured by the old master Shunyu at the Zhulin monastery on Zhuzishan.' At seventeen he was at Yuntai in southern Yunnan; at nineteen the thought of death and impermanence stirred in him. A travelling monk from Jizu gave him Zhaozhou's dog, and he worked at it for five years without an opening, then set it down and went off to recite the Buddha's name. Later Chan master Jifan drew him out — 'you say there is nothing to be done, but there is plainly one thing unfinished in your breast' — and struck him across the face, saying that to press a question to the point where nothing can be done is the point where strength comes, as a soldier who has lost his sword rides bare-handed at the enemy and takes his weapon from him and kills with it. At that he saw where old Zhaozhou had put his hand, and without so much as a bow he slapped his teacher across the mouth and pushed him out of the door, and Jifan shook himself and went off laughing. He became abbot of Kaifeng (Nanyun cloister) at Hengzhou. His heirs carried the line into Yunnan.

steles.title: 行實
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON — spoken at the request of the monk Zhanzhuo and the assembly
steles.quote: 余乃雲南宜良縣人，父姓谷、母時氏，家計貧寒，幼未讀書。一十四歲出家，禮竹子山竹林寺順語老師剃落。十七歲住滇南雲臺山，拜《楞嚴》經題。十九忽動無常生死之想…蒙禪德示我：僧問趙州：『狗子還有佛性也無？』州曰：『無。』底公案，勉囑參究…如是五載，了無下…一日，遇濟凡禪師問曰：『密行師每日所行何事？』…濟劈面掌曰：『鈍置殺人。』…『參禪參到無可奈何處是得力處，猶如戰士失卻寶刀，雖則赤手，以勇健故不顧利害，拍馬直前奪取敵人手中器械便殺人去。』予于言下忽然見得趙州老子下手處…
steles.note: *** HIS OWN FIRST-PERSON ACCOUNT. Birthplace, parents, tonsure master, the huatou, the awakening.

steles.kind: 行實 (his HEIR's, in the same book — naming him as 本師)
steles.title: 行實 of 嗣燈圓胤
steles.author_note: the account of conduct of his dharma heir, dictated the day before that heir's death
steles.quote: 我是本省富順縣劉氏子…聞破山老人從天童歸住梁山萬峰，便買舟東下，至堂中，禮燕居和尚，賜法名圓胤，字嗣燈…師翁豎拳曰：『會麼？』…丁酉秋，將落成，而本師開峰老和尚至…
steles.note: *** THE HEIR'S ACCOUNT CONFIRMS THE GRANDFATHER-LINE FROM BELOW: he calls Mixing Jiren 本師開峰老和尚 (my root teacher, the venerable Kaifeng — 開峰 being Mixing's other name), and calls 破山 (Poshan) 師翁, grand-master. So Mixing's teacher is Poshan, attested by his own disciple. DILA independently lists 嗣燈胤 as Mixing's first heir.

teacher.kind: his OWN 拈香 transmission-incense, at his 陞座 (衡州開峰密行忍禪師語錄卷之一, 上堂一)
teacher.quote: 再拈云：「此香逢火不燒、遇水不溺，刀斫不入、斧劈不開，初年懷抱行腳至梁山界內，遇個毒手老賊，不分皂白當頭擊碎…今日向人天眾前一回拈出，爇向爐中，供養現住梁山縣雙桂堂上傳曹溪正脈第三十五世本師破山老和尚，用酬法乳。」
teacher.note: THE DHARMA-MILK STICK. He offers three: (1) 祝延今上皇帝 — the emperor; (2) 三世諸佛、歷代祖師 — the buddhas and patriarchs; (3) THIS one, 用酬法乳, to 本師破山老和尚 at 雙桂堂. First-person, at the transmission. 『遇個毒手老賊…當頭擊碎』 is his own account of the breakthrough under 破山.

teacher.kind: second 拈香 in the same 語錄 (a later 陞座)
teacher.quote: 老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: The 用酬法乳之恩 formula recurs at his second enthronement — the edge is stated twice in his own voice.

teacher.kind: 行實 of his heir 嗣燈圓胤
teacher.quote: 師翁豎拳曰…本師開峰老和尚至
teacher.note: *** The disciple names Mixing (開峰) as his own root teacher and Poshan as the grand-master. Transmission confirmed from below.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 海明 (A009652), cite （明清序：046；X85n1586_p0001c14）; concise: 為破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣。雲南宜良人，俗姓谷。
TEACHER 順語 (A042553), cite 《密行忍禪師語錄》卷3：「一十四歲出家，禮竹子山竹林寺順語老師剃落。」
teacher.note: Tonsure master — NOT the transmission. The 行實 distinguishes them.

dates.quote: 師生於明崇禎甲戌，年方登四十云
dates.note: 崇禎甲戌=1634 birth; the phrase means about 40 at compile time, not a death age. Own 行實 (J38nB428) states no death year.

dates.quote: 為破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣。雲南宜良人，俗姓谷
dates.note: no structured dates in DILA

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派) — the Wuzhun Shifan line via Jue'an Kexiang
bio: Linji master, of the Nie family of Huai'an, abbot of Xuefeng at Fuzhou. He was the dharma heir of Jue'an Kexiang, on whose death he wrote: 'In the autumn of the gengyin year my late master, the venerable Jue'an, passed away at Censhan in Hangzhou; on hearing the news of his death I made this.' He also mourned Xueyan Zuqin of Yangshan. He died about 1334.

teacher.kind: his own poem-title, on hearing of his master's death
teacher.quote: 庚寅秋先師絕岸和尚示寂於杭之岑山聞訃有作
teacher.note: *** FIRST-PERSON, and it dates itself. He calls Jue'an 先師 — my late master — and puts his death in the autumn of 庚寅 = 1290.

teacher.kind: authority record for 絕岸可湘
teacher.quote: 可湘 | 絕岸可湘 | 雪峰湘. birth +1206; death 至元二十七年（1290）示寂，壽八十五。concise: 俗姓葛。臨濟宗楊岐派破菴派僧，無準師範之法嗣…咸淳八年（1272）主雪峰，凡十年謝事。
teacher.note: *** THE IDENTIFICATION IS EXACT. 絕岸可湘 died in 1290 — precisely the 庚寅 of Wuyi's poem. And he was abbot of XUEFENG for ten years from 1272; Wuyi is himself recorded as a Xuefeng monk. The harvest's caution ('only the teacher's sobriquet 絕岸 survives') is RESOLVED: 絕岸 = 絕岸可湘, and his teacher in turn is 無準師範.

dates.quote: death +1334~1335 （疑年錄：319）; concise: 懷安人，姓聶，雪峰僧人。
dates.note: No birth date. The harvest's placement 'around 1290–1320' is consistent.

bio.quote: 懷安人，姓聶，雪峰僧人。

links.label: DILA Authority A003948 (his teacher 絕岸可湘)
links.confirms: the teacher's identity, dates 1206-1290, Xuefeng abbacy, and his own teacher 無準師範

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master of Tui'an at Jiaxing, of the Jin family of Xiushui; his father was styled Chengdan and his mother of the Tang clan. In his own account of conduct, given at the Layman Pang's tea-offering on the eighth day of the twelfth month of 1669, he says he was born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of 1622; both parents died early and his grandfather raised him. As a boy he dreamt Guanyin laid a hand on his head, and thereafter held to her name. At sixteen, his grandfather ill and wanting the marriage completed, he refused; his grandfather died sitting, his grandmother followed, and after the burials he left. He was tonsured at twenty at the Dongta Chan monastery by the old master Juera. In 1643 the great master Xuejiao held the retreat, and asked him sweeping the floor, 'why did you leave home?' 'My parents died early; I fear birth and death.' 'Then why not investigate the one that has no birth and death?' — and struck him. Cutting firewood one day, a hare broke cover, he dropped the knife, and awoke. He later called on Gunan Muyun, on Fu, and on Yu, and at last on the old man Yongzheng in his retreat cell — Yichu Wuyuan — who became his master and gave him the name Tui'an. He died in 1677.

steles.title: 行實
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON — given at a tea-offering on the eighth of the twelfth month, 1669
steles.quote: 己酉臘八日，震澤龐全力設普茶，同大眾請說行腳…師云：「…予乃秀水金氏子，父號成丹，母唐氏，生於天啟壬戌四月二十七日也。不幸二親早喪，老祖拊養長成…遂辭親族，蒙送東塔禪寺，禮覺如老師披剃，是辛巳二十歲也。至癸未，請雪嶠大師結制，予充行者於方丈。一日，灑掃次，嶠問：『你為什麼出家？』予云：『父母早亡，為懼生死。』嶠云：『何不參個無生死底？』予便禮拜…一日，斫柴次，正迷悶間，有兔躍出，不覺失刀株立，擬取刀，忽然有省…復至興善參永正老人於靜室…」
steles.note: *** FIRST-PERSON. And it names the teacher precisely: 永正老人, whom he sought at 興善.

teacher.quote: 復至興善參永正老人於靜室…予自愧見地未得超卓。
teacher.note: *** FIRST-PERSON: 永正老人 at 興善.

teacher.quote: A016482 TEACHER 悟元 (A010711). A010711: 悟元 | alternative: 一初曹元 | 一初悟元 | 永正元 | 一初元. concise: 姓曹，嘉興當湖人。清初臨濟宗僧，從興善弘遠落髮。birth +1615; death 「康熙戊午五月十九日，壽六十四」
teacher.note: *** THE LOCK. DILA's 悟元 carries BOTH 一初元 (the harvest's reading) AND 永正元 (the 行實's name) as alternatives — AND is recorded as having taken the robe at 興善, the very monastery where the 行實 says he found 永正老人. Three names, one man. The harvest's dangling '一初元' is now identified and dated (1615–1678).

dates.source: DILA A016482 citing his 行實 and 徑石滴乳集
dates.quote: birth 「天啟壬戌四月二十七日」（《嘉興退菴斷愚智禪師語錄》卷 1〈行實〉）; death 「康熈丁巳季秋二十日」（《徑石滴乳集》卷 5）
dates.note: Born 1622-06-05 (from his own mouth), died 1677-10-16. The harvest had only the 1675/1677 window; the birth is new.

links.label: DILA Authority A010711 (his teacher 一初悟元)
links.confirms: that 一初元 = 永正元 = 悟元, one man, 1615-1678

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, styled Banshui, of the Yu family of Ba county (Chongqing), abbot of Sanfeng there. He was the dharma heir of Dahou Yinchuan, himself a disciple of Poshan Haiming. He died on the second day of the seventh month of 1691.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，爇向爐中，耑為現住榮縣鼎新堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二世上大下吼本師大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His own 三峰半水元禪師語錄, at the 開爐 upper-hall. 上大下吼 = 大吼 (印傳); 本師 + 用酬法乳之恩 = the dharma-milk stick. Generation 32 of Linji matches 大吼印傳 as heir of 破山海明 (gen 31).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 印傳 (A026228), cite 《五燈全書》卷88：「巴縣三峰半水元禪師……(大吼傳嗣)。」(X82n1571); concise: 字半水，巴縣余氏，為大吼印傳禪師法嗣。有《三峰半水元禪師語錄》一卷。（《錦江禪燈》卷 13）
teacher.note: *** THE HARVEST'S UNKNOWN NAME IS RECOVERED. The harvest wrote: '大吼 … has no entry of his own in the lamps I searched, so his full dharma name is unknown.' It is 印傳.

teacher.quote: 印傳 | 大吼印傳 | 狼盤印傳. concise: 破山海明弟子。cite 《五燈全書》卷70：「雲南狼盤大吼印傳禪師……(破山明嗣)。」
teacher.note: *** AND THE EDGE CLIMBS: 大吼印傳 is 破山海明's disciple. So 半水發元 → 大吼印傳 → 破山海明, and it lands on the roster. The harvest's 'teacher is not in the roster' is superseded.

dates.kind: authority record citing his own 語錄
dates.quote: death 「康熙三十年歲在辛未前七月初二日未時。」（《三峰半水元禪師語錄》卷 1）
dates.note: Died 1691-07-26. The harvest had NO dates.

bio.kind: concise biography citing 錦江禪燈
bio.quote: 字半水，巴縣余氏…有《三峰半水元禪師語錄》一卷。

links.label: DILA Authority A026228 (his teacher 大吼印傳)
links.confirms: the teacher's full name and that he is Poshan Haiming's disciple

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master of the early Yuan, of the Wang family of Changxi in Fuzhou; his grandfather Yikui was county sheriff of Gutian and his father Liangfu magistrate of Huangyan. At seven he loved to read Buddhist books, and his father, seeing he was no ordinary child, had him leave home at Xuefeng in the prefecture. Six months later he went out over the Feiyuan ridge to Fazang at Yixing, and was ordained by Chan master Yifeng Qi; at fifteen he took the head-shaving and the full precepts, and travelled to all quarters. Passing Ayuwang he called on Chan master Jichuang Zhao, entered his room and matched him, and was made incense-attendant and then keeper of the library. He came out at Shouguo in Siming, moved to Kaishou, and afterwards was installed at Daochang in Huzhou, where he built the great Buddha hall and the Guanyin repository and had the canon copied. His fame reached the imperial court, which granted him a gold-brocade robe and the title Chan Master Fohai Xingkong. He died on the third day of the sixth month of 1301, aged sixty-three, having kept forty-eight summers and ordained more than two hundred and fifty disciples.

steles.title: 龍源和尚塔銘 (No.1374-A)
steles.author: 牟巘
steles.author_note: composed by 牟巘 (前朝奉大夫主管千秋鴻禧觀); CALLIGRAPHED AND SEAL-SCRIPTED BY 趙孟頫 (Zhao Mengfu), the greatest calligrapher-painter of the Yuan, then Confucian Education Intendant for the Jiangzhe region
steles.quote: 前朝奉大夫主管千秋鴻禧觀牟巘譔。集賢直學士朝列大夫行江淛等處儒學提舉趙孟頫書并篆額。道場山龍源禪師既寂之五年，為乙巳七月，其記室懷珠裒次遺事，偕其徒希渭來求銘心源之塔。予尚記歲甲午，訪師雲峯，留三日，窮極幽討，意甚樂…不料遂為死別也…師諱介清，龍源號也，世居福州長溪。祖諱一夔，古田縣尉。父良輔，知黃岩縣。母蔡氏，素好善，嘗夢神人介而送一子，曰：是善知識，當生爾家。果娠而生…
steles.note: *** HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION — and the author knew him personally: 'I still remember the jiawu year, when I visited the master at Yunfeng and stayed three days… I did not know it would be our parting in death.' A named man, at a named grave, writing of a friend. Zhao Mengfu wrote out the stone.

teacher.source: DILA A009259 (found by FULL-TEXT sweep, not persName)
teacher.kind: authority note citing his 塔銘
teacher.quote: 號龍源，寂窻照禪師法嗣。福州長溪人，俗姓王。年七歲…出家郡之雪峯…得度於一峰齊禪師。年十五薙髮受具戒，遂徧參諸方。過育王謁寂牕照禪師，入室有契，以為侍香，次掌藏鑰…（《龍源介清禪師語錄》卷1〈龍源和尚塔銘〉）
teacher.note: *** THE HARVEST'S DANGLING EDGE RESOLVES. Teacher = 寂窗有照, per his own 塔銘. NOTE the careful distinction the source makes: 一峰齊 was his TONSURE master (得度); 寂窗有照 is the man whose room he entered and matched (入室有契) — the transmission.

teacher.quote: 有照 | 育王照 | 育王有照 | 寂窓有照 | 寂窓照. concise: 寧波府育王寂窓有照禪師，閩縣鄧氏。枯禪鏡禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十世…曾任阿育王寺第四十九代住持…法嗣為龍源介清。
teacher.note: *** CONFIRMED FROM BOTH ENDS. DILA's record for 寂窗有照 names 龍源介清 as HIS heir. And 有照's own teacher is 枯禪自鏡, so the edge climbs. The harvest wrote '寂窗有照 is not in the 301-roster — this edge dangles'; he IS in DILA, as A009669.

dates.source: DILA A009259 citing his 塔銘
dates.quote: 大德五年六月三日示寂，壽六十三，臘四十八，度弟子二百五十餘人。
dates.note: Died 1301-07-16 aged 63 → born 1239. The harvest had NO dates.

links.label: DILA Authority A009259
links.confirms: dates, teacher, school, bio, and the 塔銘

links.label: DILA Authority A009669 (his teacher 寂窗有照)
links.confirms: the teacher exists in DILA and names Longyuan Jieqing as his heir

steles.kind: 塔院 (stupa court, not a stele text)
steles.quote: 越壬子春，方拽杖興善，與先師建塔院，立普同。
steles.note: Built by 林我鑑 at 大興善寺, Xi'an, spring 1672. No 塔銘/墖銘/行狀 text for 印師 survives in the canon.

teacher.quote: 付易菴印師禪人｜截流香象斂全威，任世任時堪所依，四隅八荒藏不住，始伸牙爪活頑機。
teacher.note: Poshan Haiming himself names him 易菴印師. Neighbouring verses 付寂光印豁禪人 / 付古城印堅禪人 show 印 as the generation character — so 印師 is the whole dharma name, and both lamp abbreviations (易菴印 / 易菴師) are clippings of it.

teacher.quote: 易菴師禪師。資陽廖氏子。因讀圓覺，念世無常，年三十三方始披剃。聞明和尚宗風大振，躬詣參究，更名印師，遂蒙記莂。後住西安大興善寺。
teacher.note: States the expansion explicitly: 更名印師. 明和尚 = 破山海明.

teacher.source: J/J38/J38nB422.xml (林我禪師語錄, J38_p0584c09 and p0585a14)
teacher.quote: 終聞法於易菴老人。老人為破山法子，傳臨濟正宗。… 祝髮大慈，受戒寶池。破山之徒，易菴為師。
teacher.note: Independent statement that 易菴 was Poshan's dharma son.

teacher.quote: 關中興善易菴印師禪師｜西蜀成都人。
teacher.note: Head-line carries the full two-character name 印師. Birthplace conflicts with 錦江禪燈 (資陽 vs 成都).

teacher.quote: 易庵印師 / 興善印師; 清; 臨濟宗 楊岐派; 破山海明弟子。（X85n1588_p0104c05）; student 林我鑑 (A016352)
teacher.note: DILA already holds him under the FULL name 易庵印師 — the roster's 易菴師 simply failed to match it. Cites 《正源略集補遺》卷1：「破山明禪師法嗣，關中興善易庵印師禪師」.

bio: Dharma heir of Hanyue Fazang (1574–1635) of Sanfeng, thirty-fifth generation below Nanyue; abbot of Lingyan at Suzhou, and known as Jiqi ('the one who takes up the succession') and Tuiweng. He edited and prefaced his teacher's sixteen-juan record, having been charged with the task by Hanyue himself six months before his death — 'he put it into my unworthy hands to compile', he writes, adding that twenty-seven years later he still shrank from committing it to print. He was the chief figure of the Sanfeng branch after Hanyue, defending it through the Wudeng yantong controversy, and a great teacher of nuns: the Jiaxing catalogue records at least three abbesses as his heirs (寶持玄總, 靈瑞祖揆玄符, and others). He was born on the eighth of the second month of 1605 and died on the twenty-seventh of the ninth month of 1672, aged 67.

steles.title: 退翁塔銘
steles.note: ⚠ A TEXTBOOK CASE OF THE BRIEF'S WARNING, AND A LOOSE END. The Jiaxing catalogue (B/B35/B35n0194.xml lb 0331a04) records: 「三峯藏和尚語錄十六卷 明法藏說，弘儲記并序…有年譜。附南嶽勒古、退翁塔銘」 — i.e. HIS OWN stupa inscription is appended to his TEACHER'S recorded sayings, not to his. But I searched J34nB299 (the CBETA text of 三峯藏和尚語錄) and the 退翁塔銘 IS NOT IN IT — CBETA's edition carries the 年譜 and 南嶽勒古 but appears to omit the 塔銘. So: the stele is attested to exist and its location is known, but the text is not in the corpus as digitised. Nothing quoted. Worth a manual look at the print edition.

steles.title: 退翁塔銘 (appended to 三峯藏和尚語錄)
steles.author: not named in the catalogue entry
steles.quote: 三峯藏和尚語錄十六卷　明法藏說，弘儲記并序…附南嶽勒古、退翁塔銘
steles.note: The 嘉興藏 catalogue records that a 退翁塔銘 (Hongchu's own stupa-inscription; 退翁 is his hao) was appended to his TEACHER's record — the classic 'the stele sits in somebody else's book' pattern. The text of the stele itself is NOT in the CBETA file J34nB299; only the catalogue's witness to its existence. Not counted as evidence for the teacher, but a live lead for anyone with the printed 嘉興藏.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 transmission-incense, at his enthronement at 虎丘雲巖寺
teacher.quote: 末上拈香曰：「此一瓣香…第十回爇向爐中，單為供養先淨慈堂上三峰老和尚，以酬法乳。」
teacher.note: THE DHARMA-MILK STICK. He offers several: Sakyamuni, the 68 generations of ancestors, and 當山隆和尚暨歷代開法祖師 (the temple's founding line — the SECONDARY stick). Only the last, 末上, names 三峰老和尚 and only that one carries 以酬法乳. 三峰 = Hanyue Fazang, unambiguous.

teacher.quote: 嗣法門人濟璣等編
teacher.note: His record is compiled by his own 嗣法門人 — corroborating, not the primary evidence.

teacher.quote: 南嶽繼起和尚語錄十卷 清弘儲說、節錄并序跋，濟機等編，南嶽下第三十五世，嗣三峯藏。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.kind: his own preface to his teacher's record
teacher.quote: 弘儲序三峰和尚語錄序…示疾前半年，手命不肖弘儲結集。
teacher.note: SUPPORTING ONLY, NOT DECISIVE. Hanyue, half a year before his death, personally charged Hongchu with compiling his record. ⚠ Deliberately NOT treated as proof of transmission: being commissioned to compile a master's sayings is compatible with being merely a trusted editor (the 'editor trap' — 芝巖秀 was miscredited to 二隱謐 on exactly this signal). The edge itself rests on the catalogue's 嗣三峯藏 and DILA, which are independent of the editing.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 法藏 (A003668), cite （明清序：044；X85n1586_p0001c07）; concise: 三峰法藏禪師（1574-1635）法嗣，南嶽第六十九祖…年二十五，依三峰藏公出家。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 生于明萬曆乙巳二月八日日出時，歷六十七年 … 康熙壬子九月二十七日。
dates.note: 1605-03-26 to 1672-11-16, aged 67. The roster gives no dates.

dates.source: DILA A000241 citing 五燈全書
dates.quote: birth 「生于明萬曆乙巳二月八日日出時，歷六十七年。」（《五燈全書》卷 69）; death 「康熙壬子九月二十七日。」（同上）
dates.note: Born 1605-03-26, died 1672-11-16. The harvest had NO dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 退翁弘儲禪師，通州李氏…歷參法空、澗川、普門、若昧諸尊宿…出世常州祥符，遷蘇州靈巖，更移堯峰。有《語錄》百卷。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Songyuan Chongyue (who as abbot of Lingyin is also styled Lingyin Chongyue). In 1201 he answered the call to Yunju on Mount Lu, and shortly afterwards was appointed by edict to Jinshan. He compiled his master's record of sayings in two fascicles.

teacher.kind: the teacher's own deathbed charge, in his 語錄 (松源崇嶽禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 又貽書嗣法香山光睦、雲居善開，囑以大法。因書偈曰：來無所來，去無所去。瞥轉玄關，佛祖罔措。跏趺而寂
teacher.note: DECISIVE, and it defuses the editor trap. Songyuan Chongyue, dying, writes to his 嗣法 (dharma-heirs) 光睦 and 善開 and 囑以大法 — ENTRUSTS THEM WITH THE GREAT DHARMA — then sits down and dies. 囑 is the transmission verb. This is the teacher's own final act, in the teacher's own record.

teacher.quote: 宋掩室善開禪師，乃靈隱嶽禪師法嗣，南嶽下十九世，傳臨濟宗
teacher.note: Corroborating index. 靈隱嶽 = 松源崇岳.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 崇岳 (A001037); concise: 靈隱崇岳禪師法嗣，嘉泰元年（1201），赴廬山雲居請，未幾敕補金山。
teacher.note: The transmission is stated as a 法嗣 relation, citing 望月佛教大辭典 and 宋僧錄 — i.e. INDEPENDENTLY of the fact that he edited the master's record. See the flag.

bio.quote: 靈隱崇岳禪師法嗣，嘉泰元年（1201），赴廬山雲居請，未幾敕補金山。編有《松源崇嶽禪師語錄》二卷，存。（宋僧錄：687；T51n2077_p0710c18）

links.label: DILA Authority A001343
links.confirms: teacher, school, the 1201 Yunju call and Jinshan appointment

bio: From Tongchuan in western Shu (surname Zhang, mother Liu), born at noon on the 22nd of the 6th month of 1610. Tonsured at five at Qinglian monastery after an illness, he saw lights on Emei at seven and carried the doubt from then on; at twenty-one, in 1630 at Bao'en in Jinling, the blaze of the pagoda's light broke it open. He met Linye Tongqi in 1643 and received his charge in 1644. He held Xianglin at Taicang, Caoxi at Pinghu, and Qianfo and Yuanning in the capital. He died in the small hours of the 23rd of the 11th month of 1666, aged 57, and was interred west of the Xianglin hall; sixteen heirs, of whom Shipu Chaozhi succeeded him.

steles.title: 臨濟三十二世香林寺佛古聞禪師塔銘
steles.quote: 師諱行聞，號佛古，西潼川張氏子。家世好善，母劉孺人，尤有令德。明萬曆庚戌年六月二十二日午時，師示生…五歲，忽腋下生毒…乃送入青蓮寺，依印宗錫禪師出家…至崇禎庚午，年二十有一，抵金陵，隨喜報恩，復睹塔光交燦，五色盈空，驀觸前疑，徹明大事…癸未夏，通玄林野奇和尚出天台，寓盛澤，師往參見。
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷4. It opens with a striking attack on false succession: 「自古禪林僧寶，印法必擇明師…自求法不擇真師，而主院欲承父業，則師家以名位籠人，而學者以小才錄用，弘道二字，僅屬虛名，法運於是乎寖衰矣。」 The author's name is not given in the text I read.

steles.title: 臨濟三十二世香林寺佛古聞禪師塔銘
steles.quote: 塔銘。臨濟三十二世香林寺佛古聞禪師塔銘。自古禪林僧寶，印法必擇明師，而行道不承師蔭，蓋非遇明眼作家，豈得傳持不謬？所以稱鵝王擇乳，素非鴨類也…自求法不擇真師，而主院欲承父業，則師家以名位籠人，而學者以小才錄用，弘道二字，僅屬虛名，法運於是乎寖衰矣。求其慧命，果得真傳，而道緣不求自至，如我香林佛古禪師者，今時豈易得哉？師諱行聞，號佛古，西潼川張氏子。家世好善…
steles.note: *** HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION — and its preamble is a polemic on exactly the problem this whole project exists to solve: 'if a man seeking the dharma does not choose a true master, and heads a monastery meaning to inherit it as a family business, then the master's house snares men with rank and title, and the student is enrolled for his small talents; the two words *propagating the Way* become an empty name, and the fortunes of the Dharma decay from there.' DILA cites this same 塔銘 for BOTH his dates.

teacher.quote: 復拈云：者瓣香描不成、畫不就，昔從通玄峰頂拾來，今向香林堂前拈出，爇向爐中，耑伸供養現住浙江嘉興府棲真堂上林野奇老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0803b26 (天童堂上林野先師) and 0806b17, which adds the generation: 傳臨濟正宗第三十一世上林下野先師.

teacher.quote: 為林野通奇禪師（1596-1652）法嗣…甲申（1644）季春遂承付囑。
TEACHER 通奇 (A012053), cite （明清序：065；X85n1586_p0002b01）
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. The harvest independently notes that 林野通奇 is placed under 天童(密雲)悟禪師法嗣 by X82n1571, X84n1583, X81n1568 and 錦江禪燈 — so the edge lands on the roster in one hop.

dates.quote: 明萬曆庚戌年六月二十二日午時，師示生。
birth +1610-08-10；death +1666-12-18「丙午年十一月二十三日子時，世壽五十有七。」（〈塔銘〉）；法臘三十五。
dates.note: Note DILA is internally inconsistent: in the record of his heir Shipu (A004351) it gives his dates as (1616-1666). The 塔銘 says 萬曆庚戌 = 1610. I take 1610.

dates.source: DILA A016279 citing his 塔銘
dates.quote: birth 「萬曆庚戌年六月二十二日午時」（《佛古聞禪師語錄》卷 4〈臨濟三十二世香林寺佛古聞禪師塔銘〉）; death 「丙午年十一月二十三日子時，世壽五十有七。」（同上）
dates.note: Born 1610-08-10, died 1666-12-18 aged 57. Both from the stupa inscription. The harvest had NO dates.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；臨濟三十二世

bio.quote: 師諱行聞，號佛古，西潼川張氏子。

links.label: DILA Authority A016279
links.confirms: dates, teacher, school, and the 塔銘

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派) — the Sanfeng 三峰 line
bio: Linji master and the Qing restorer of Lingyin monastery at Hangzhou. His disciple Jiexian's account of conduct opens: 'the master's name was Hongli, his style Jude; he was born of the Zhang family of Kuaiji — a great clan of Yuezhou, descended from Shu, truly the posterity of Master Ziyan.' He was tonsured at the Baohua hermitage on Putuo by Zhongya, and became the dharma heir of Hanyue Fazang. He rebuilt Lingyin — the greatest of the five mountains of Zhejiang — and Wu Weiye's stupa inscription for him is titled 'for the great venerable Jude who rebuilt Lingyin'. He died on the nineteenth day of the tenth month of 1667, aged sixty-eight.

steles.title: 重建靈隱具德大和尚塔銘
steles.author: 吳偉業 (Wu Weiye)
steles.author_note: one of the greatest poets and historians of the early Qing
steles.quote: 塔銘。重建靈隱具德大和尚塔銘。吳偉業。自佛法入中國，漸被江南；宋元以來，浙河東西分立五山十剎，靈隱實居其最。歷代禪祖如無著喜、永明壽、明教嵩、密菴傑諸老，百四十代，雲興川湧，甲冠諸…
steles.note: *** HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION, BY WU WEIYE, in the Lingyin monastery gazetteer.

steles.title: 本師具德老和尚行狀
steles.author: 戒顯 (Jiexian)
steles.author_note: HIS OWN DISCIPLE — 本師 means 'my root teacher'
steles.quote: 行狀。本師具德老和尚行狀。戒顯。師諱弘禮，字具德，生緣會稽張氏。張為越州巨族，系出西蜀，實紫巖先生後也。居地名移貴，明中葉殿元…
steles.note: *** AND AN ACCOUNT OF CONDUCT BY HIS OWN DISCIPLE, in the same gazetteer. Two independent stele-grade sources for one man.

steles.title: 重建靈隱具德大和尚塔銘
steles.author: 吳偉業 (梅村), 祭酒
steles.quote: 塔銘　重建靈隱具德大和尚塔銘　吳偉業祭酒梅村　自佛法入中國，漸被江南；宋元以來，浙河東西分立五山十剎，靈隱實居其最。
steles.note: By WU WEIYE (1609-1671), one of the foremost poets and historians of the age — a first-rank literatus stele, in 武林靈隱寺志 j.7.

steles.title: 本師具德老和尚行狀
steles.author: 戒顯 (his dharma heir)
steles.quote: 本師具德老和尚行狀　戒顯　師諱弘禮，字具德，生緣會稽張氏。
steles.note: Written by a named dharma-heir; the source of nearly every fact above.

teacher.kind: 行狀 (本師具德老和尚行狀), by his own heir 戒顯, in 武林靈隱寺志 j.7
teacher.quote: 師雖去，念老人法乳，時時反顧。後老人入死關，復奔回玄墓，老人遂以衣拂并源流法偈付之，勉師收鐵骨徒、破斷法魔，為吾宗作大竫子。偈曰：住山養得機緣熟　多覓真真鐵骨禪　莫負老僧珍重付　痛除魔外作真傳。付畢，老人旋示寂。
teacher.note: 付 + 衣拂 + 源流法偈 = transmission, and 法乳 named explicitly. 老人 / 漢老人 / 三峰老人 throughout this 行狀 = 漢月法藏 (三峰), identified at lb0487a09 as 「座元漢老和尚新受囑於金粟」.

teacher.quote: 遂力辭蘇師，登普陀，依寶華菴仲雅師薙削
teacher.note: COUNTER-EVIDENCE PROPERLY PLACED: 仲雅 is the TONSURE master (薙削), not the dharma-father. DILA A016082 lists 仲雅 as a second 'teacher' relation citing 新續高僧傳 j.57 「投普陀寶華庵仲雅祝髮」 — 祝髮 is a tonsure verb, not a transmission verb. Association is not transmission.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 法藏 (A003668), cite （明清序：044；X85n1586_p0001c07）
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. Same teacher as 繼起弘儲 in this batch — they are dharma-brothers.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 仲雅 (A042487), cite 《新續高僧傳》卷57：「投普陀寶華庵仲雅祝髮」
teacher.note: Tonsure master — NOT the transmission.

dates.source: DILA A016082 citing 正源略集
dates.quote: birth +1600; death 「時康熙丁未十月十九日也，壽六十八。」（《正源略集》卷 5）
dates.note: Died 1667-12-04 aged 68 → born 1600. The harvest had NO dates.

bio.kind: 行狀 by his disciple 戒顯
bio.quote: 師諱弘禮，字具德，生緣會稽張氏。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Linji master of the Song, lay surname Yao. He left home at nineteen and worked hard at the Tiantai teaching, but felt he could not efface his own traces, and so went round the noted teachers seeking the Chan dharma; coming at last to Longmen he awakened outright, presented a verse to Foyan Qingyuan, and received his seal. He went to Lushan and sat without food inside a withered tree at Tong'an, to the wonder of all; before long he moved to Nanyue, where he would ride out on a tiger, so that Confucians and Buddhists alike bowed in his dust and the fourfold assembly called him the tiger-tamer. He ended as abbot on Mount Huanglong in Longxing, Jiangxi. He died in 1149, aged sixty-six.

teacher.quote: 隆興府黃龍牧菴法忠禪師。四明姚氏子…遍參名宿至龍門。觀水磨旋轉發明心要…呈佛眼…眼曰。我有末後一句待分付汝。師即掩耳而去。
teacher.note: 續傳燈錄 j.? — full bio; transmission verb 分付 (to hand over). Teacher 佛眼清遠 confirmed.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 清遠 (A008397); concise: 後至龍門，頓然開悟，以偈呈佛眼清遠禪師，蒙其印可。
teacher.note: *** THE HARVEST'S CORRECTION IS VALIDATED. The harvest wrote: 'CORRECTS A LIKELY ASSUMPTION. It is tempting to make 牧菴法忠 an heir of 圓悟克勤, since his heir 普菴印肅's biography calls him 紹臨濟十二世孫牧菴忠禪師 without naming his master.' DILA is unambiguous: the awakening is at 龍門 (Foyan Qingyuan's seat) and the seal is Foyan's. Teacher = 佛眼清遠, NOT 圓悟克勤.

dates.source: DILA A008460 citing 佛祖歷代通載
dates.quote: birth +1084; death 「紹興十九年示寂，壽六十六」（《佛祖歷代通載》卷20）
dates.note: Died 1149 aged 66 → born 1084. The harvest had NO dates.

bio.quote: 宋代臨濟宗僧，俗姓姚。十九歲出家，精勤參修天台教旨，唯自覺未能泯跡，乃徧參名德，叩求禪法；後至龍門，頓然開悟…後至廬山，於同安枯樹中絕食靜坐，人皆奇之。未久遷居南嶽，每跨虎出遊，儒釋皆望塵而拜，四眾亦以伏虎稱之。後住江西隆興之黃龍山。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Ming Linji master, dharma heir of Wanfeng Shiwei (1303–1381) and second abbot of Sheng'en monastery on Mount Dengwei at Suzhou, where he cast the great bell and built its tower in 1388. Dragons and elephants came out of his gate, and the age called him the Sheng'en Patriarch. After his death his stupa was raised beside Wanfeng's. His surname is not recorded, and his record of sayings and his stupa inscription are both lost.

teacher.quote: 塔上之銘．屬弟子普壽普福普堅普隱仝西序．普持普華普榮普慈等立石
teacher.note: signs as 萬峯's disciple

teacher.quote: 萬峯蔚．出寶藏普持．海舟普慈二人
萬峯蔚禪師．寶藏持禪師．東明旵禪師
teacher.note: the rival branch's own chart, same edge

teacher.kind: his teacher's 塔銘 — the signatory list
teacher.quote: 大明洪武十六年三月　日，弟子普壽、普福、善堅、普隱、西序、普持、普華、普榮、普慈等立石
teacher.note: Puchi is named, as 弟子, among the men who SET THE STONE on Wanfeng's stupa-inscription (慈光寂炤圓明利濟萬峰大禪師塔銘, by 沈貫, 1383). He is at his master's grave, on the stone, two years after the death. Same list is independently transmitted in 正名錄 B24n0137 lb 0470b23.

teacher.kind: transmission verse 付法偈 from Wanfeng, in his own temple's gazetteer
teacher.quote: 萬峰禪師付法與師偈云：大愚肋下痛還拳　三要三玄絕正偏　臨濟窟中獅子子　燈燈續燄古今傳
teacher.note: 鄧尉山聖恩寺志 — the gazetteer of the temple Puchi himself headed as 2nd abbot. The verse is the transmission act (付法). Independently reproduced verbatim in 吳都法乘 B34n0193 lb 0153a10 (釋弘忍).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 時蔚 (A000933), cite (X80n1567_p0579a23); concise: 萬峰時蔚禪師（1303-1381）法嗣，住蘇州鄧蔚山聖恩寺，門下龍象輩出，人稱「聖持祖」。寂後，塔於萬峰之側。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 臨濟正傳．二十一世萬峯蔚．出寶藏普持．海舟…
teacher.note: lb=0486a21. The Zhengming lu places him as Wanfeng Shiwei's heir in the Linji orthodox transmission. Second, independent attestation.

bio.quote: 明代臨濟宗禪僧。萬峰時蔚禪師（1303-1381）法嗣，住蘇州鄧蔚山聖恩寺…寂後，塔於萬峰之側。

bio.source: 聖恩寺志 (quoted in the harvest; not independently located by me)
bio.quote: 姓氏未詳。語錄塔銘並無存
bio.note: 'His surname is unknown; neither his record of sayings nor his stupa inscription survives.' I carry this from the harvest and mark it as unverified by me.

bio: Caodong master and abbot of Shaolin, of the Huang family (one account says Wang), from Jinxian in Jiangxi. As a boy he was moved by watching a play, and went off to Funiushan to be tonsured by Tanran Ping; he later went south to Wansong at Jingshan, knocked at the door of Dafang Lian, and studied under Xiaoshan Zongshu, whose heir he became. In the autumn of 1574 he took charge of the Shaolin cloister. He died on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of 1585. He is the dharma-brother of Yunkong (Linshan) Changzhong, through whom the roster's own Wuming Huijing branch descends — the two trunks confirm each other.

steles.title: 幻休潤行實碑記
steles.author: 袁了凡 (袁黃)
steles.quote: 幻休潤行實碑記。東吳袁了凡居士譔。碑陰有洞宗正統圖
steles.note: lineage chart on the reverse

steles.title: 幻休潤塔銘
steles.author: 陸樹聲
steles.quote: 敕賜嵩山大少林禪寺．傳曹洞正宗第二十五代

steles.title: 幻休潤塔記
steles.author: 汪道昆
steles.quote: 是為曹洞之正宗．歷世二十有五．載大涵集
steles.note: collected in 大涵集

teacher.kind: 行實碑 (deeds-stele), 東吳袁了凡居士 (Yuan Huang 袁黃 1533–1606) — a contemporary, cited in 《正名錄》
teacher.quote: 幻休潤行實碑記。東吳袁了凡居士譔。碑陰有洞宗正統圖…芙蓉楷．鹿門覺．青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕．靈隱泰．寶應遇．淳拙才．松庭嚴．凝然改．俱空斌．無方從。
teacher.note: A stele erected for 幻休潤 with the Caodong succession chart CARVED ON ITS REVERSE (碑陰). 袁了凡 was his contemporary. This is stone, not lamp.

teacher.quote: 華亭陸樹聲居士譔幻休潤塔銘曰．敕賜嵩山大少林禪寺．傳曹洞正宗第二十五代。｜ 新安汪道昆居士譔幻休潤塔記曰．是為曹洞之正宗．歷世二十有五．載大涵集。
teacher.note: TWO independent stupa-inscriptions, by two named contemporaries (陸樹聲 1509–1605; 汪道昆 1525–1593), both fixing him at Caodong generation 25. Pair with 0460a06–07: 宗鏡書 SELF-SIGNED his own stele-composition 「嗣曹洞正宗第二十四世宗書譔」 and his own 行實/塔銘 by 鄭藩德慶王 likewise say 第二十四世. Gen 24 → gen 25 in the same Shaolin seat = 宗書 → 常潤, on stone, from both ends.

teacher.kind: 憨山老人夢遊集 — 憨山德清 (1546–1623), contemporary
teacher.quote: 無言道公承二十五世幻休潤大…
teacher.note: 憨山, a contemporary, independently places 幻休潤 at gen 25 (and his heir 無言正道 at 26).

teacher.quote: TEACHER 宗書 (A008304), cite （明清序：023；X66n1297_p0274b09）; concise: 宗鏡書禪師法嗣，嵩山少室僧人…嘗叩大方蓮，參小山。萬曆二年甲戌秋，領少室院事。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. Note DILA writes the teacher as 宗鏡書 — 小山宗書 is also styled 宗鏡; the same man (A008304).

dates.quote: death 萬曆十三年四月二十七日逝（X84n1585_p0784a12）
dates.note: Died 1585-05-26. NO BIRTH DATE anywhere; the harvest's floruit 1575 is not a birth year.

bio.quote: 黃氏子（一說姓王），幼時觀演雜劇有感，遂往伏牛山從坦然平祝髮，後南謁萬松於徑山。嘗叩大方蓮，參小山。萬曆二年甲戌秋，領少室院事。

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (臨濟宗楊岐派)
bio: Song Linji master of Gushan at Fuzhou, a son of the Wu family of Min county. He took the robe in his twentieth year, and hearing that there was a transmission outside the teachings went to Lan'an Dingxu at Yunmen, whose heir he became — eighteenth generation below Dajian. He lived first at Qianyuan, moved to Huangbo, and afterwards held Gushan at Fuzhou. He left a fascicle of essential sayings. His dharma heirs were Jingci Wuming and Yi'an Fajian. He died in 1173.

teacher.kind: 五燈嚴統 lamp biography, under the heading 西禪需禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 福州皷山木庵安永禪師，閩縣吳氏子。弱冠為僧。未幾謁懶庵於雲門。一日入室。庵曰：不問有言，不問無言，世尊良久，不得向世尊良久處會。隨後便喝。倐然契悟。作禮曰：不因今日問，爭喪目前機。庵許之。
teacher.note: 契悟 + 許 (approve). 西禪需 = 懶庵鼎需, abbot of 西禪. Same entry, same wording, in 五燈嚴統 X80n1565 and the 續傳燈錄 index X79n1558.

teacher.quote: 西禪懶庵鼎需禪師法嗣二人：福州鼓山木庵安永禪師　南劒州劒門安分庵主
TEACHER 鼎需 (A008561); concise: 福州鼓山木庵安永禪師，閩縣吳氏子。懶菴鼎需（1092-1153）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十八世。弱冠薙染，聞有別傳之道，乃謁懶菴於雲門。
teacher.note: CONFIRMED. The 閩縣吳氏子 origin matches the harvest's independent reading exactly — same man.

dates.source: DILA A008738 citing 續燈正統
dates.quote: death +1173 （《續燈正統》卷10）
dates.note: The harvest had NO dates. NO BIRTH DATE anywhere.

bio.quote: 初居乾元，次遷黃蘗，後住福州鼓山。有《語要》一卷。法嗣有淨慈悟明、一庵法堅。

bio: Fourth patriarch of Chan. Of the Sima clan of Hanei, later of Qizhou. In 592 he entered Mt. Wangong in Shuzhou, attended Sengcan for nine years and received his robe and bowl. From 624 he settled on Mt. Potou (Shuangfeng) in Qizhou for over thirty years, where he gathered a fixed, self-supporting community instead of wandering — the first settled Chan monastic body. Taizong summoned him to the capital three times from 643; he declined each time. He died sitting upright in the intercalary ninth month of Yonghui 2 (651), aged 72.

teacher.kind: 續高僧傳 — 道宣, writing within a generation of the man
teacher.quote: 釋道信。姓司馬。未詳何人。初七歲時經事一師。戒行不純。信每陳諫…又有二僧莫知何來。入舒州𡷗公山靜修禪業。聞而往赴便蒙授法。隨逐依學遂經十年。師往羅浮不許相逐。
teacher.note: ⚠ THE MOST IMPORTANT NEGATIVE FINDING IN THIS BATCH. 道宣 (596–667) is a near-contemporary — he died only 16 years after 道信 — and he DOES attest a transmission (便蒙授法) at 皖公山 followed by ten years of study. But he does NOT NAME THE MASTER. He writes 「二僧莫知何來」 — 'two monks, and no one knew where they came from.' The closest witness to Daoxin leaves his teacher ANONYMOUS.

teacher.kind: 楞伽師資記 (淨覺, c.712–716) — the earliest source that NAMES the teacher
teacher.quote: 第四。隋朝舒州思空山粲禪師。承可禪師後…按續高僧傳曰。可後粲禪師。隱思空山。蕭然淨坐。不出文記。祕不傳法。唯僧道信。奉事粲十二年。寫器傳燈。燈成就。粲印道信了了見佛性處。
teacher.note: This DOES give an explicit transmission verb — 粲印道信 (Can SEALED Daoxin) — and 12 years of service. But note two things. (1) It is c.712, some 60 years after Daoxin's death; it is a lineage treatise, not a stele. (2) It claims to be quoting 續高僧傳 (按續高僧傳曰) — and 道宣's actual text, quoted above, says nothing of the kind: no name, and ten years, not twelve. 淨覺 is HARMONIZING, retrofitting a name onto Daoxin's anonymous 皖公山 master. The identification is plausible (Sengcan is independently placed at 皖公山/思空山) but it is a construction, not a witness.

teacher.quote: 隋開皇十二年（592），入舒州皖公山參謁僧璨，奉侍九年，得其衣缽。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Sengcan CONFIRMED. DILA cites 佛光:5635.

dates.quote: 永徽二年閏九月安坐而寂，世壽七十二。（佛光：5635）
dates.note: Birth 580 is DILA's back-calculation (依記錄推算). A variant tradition gives 永徽元年 (650) for the death.

notes: Fourth Patriarch. First to establish a settled monastic community for Chan practice at Mount Shuangfeng.

bio: Of the Gao clan of Xiangyang. He studied the Five Classics, Laozi and Zhuangzi before ordaining under Haoyuan at Guochang monastery, then went to Huineng and received his teaching. At an open assembly at Dayun monastery in Huatai in 732 he attacked the Northern school of Shenxiu as 'collateral in its succession, gradual in its gate'; the polemic established Huineng as the Sixth Patriarch and the Southern school as orthodox. His line was called the Heze school. He died at Kaiyuan monastery in Jingzhou in 758, aged 75, and was given a stupa at Longmen in Luoyang.

steles.title: 六祖能禪師碑銘（并序）
steles.author: 王維 (d. 761), commissioned by 神會
steles.quote: 弟子曰神會，遇師於晚景，問道於中年…
steles.note: The classic case of the brief's rule: the stele sits in SOMEBODY ELSE'S BOOK — here, a temple gazetteer (重修曹溪通志, B30n0163), and it is HUINENG's stele, not Shenhui's, yet it is the best attestation of Shenhui's own discipleship.

teacher.kind: 碑銘 — 王維《六祖能禪師碑銘》, in the temple gazetteer 重修曹溪通志
teacher.quote: 弟子曰神會，遇師於晚景，問道於中年，廣量出於凡心，利智踰於宿學…先師所明，有類獻珠之顧…謂余知道，以頌見託。
teacher.note: 王維 (d. 761) was Shenhui's CONTEMPORARY and wrote Huineng's stele AT SHENHUI'S OWN REQUEST (「謂余知道，以頌見託」). Wang Wei names Shenhui 弟子 of Huineng and calls Huineng 先師 — reporting Shenhui's own words back at him. The 'he met the master late, asked the way in middle years' line is Shenhui's own account of his discipleship, on stone.

teacher.kind: his own words — 菩提達摩南宗定是非論 (Dunhuang MS, Hu Shih's critical edition)
teacher.quote: 我六代大師一一皆言，單刀直入，直了見性，不言階漸。
teacher.note: Shenhui speaking at the 滑臺大雲寺 assembly (開元 20 = 732), claiming the six-patriarch line (…→慧能) as HIS OWN (「我六代大師」). At lb 0065a04 he asserts 「能禪師是的的相傳付囑人」.

teacher.quote: 參謁六祖慧能（638-713），得其旨。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Huineng CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 享年七十有五，僧臘五十四夏，乾元元年五月十三日荊府開元寺，奄然坐化。

notes: Championed Huineng as true Sixth Patriarch against the Northern school. His polemical efforts established Southern school dominance.

bio: Of the Wang clan of Changle. Ordained under Huizhao at Xishan and fully ordained under Fachao at Hengshan. Hearing that Mazu Daoyi was teaching at Nankang he went to him and attended six years. He then opened Mt. Baizhang in Hongzhou, founded an independent Chan monastery and wrote the rule that is the ancestor of all later monastic codes, insisting the community feed itself — 'a day without work is a day without food.' Whatever his seniority he took his turn at the labour. His heirs included Huangbo Xiyun and Guishan Lingyou. He died on the 17th of the first month of Yuanhe 9 (814); his stupa inscription was cut four years later.

steles.title: 唐洪州百丈山故懷海禪師塔銘并序
steles.author: 陳詡
steles.author_note: 將仕郎守殿中侍御史. Calligraphy by 武翊黃 (守信州司戶參軍員外置同正員). Erected 元和十三年十月三日 = 818, four years after the death.
steles.quote: 曹溪傳衡嶽觀音臺懷讓和上，觀音傳江西道一和上，詔諡為大寂禪師。大寂傳大師。中土相承凡九代矣。大師太原王氏，福州長樂縣人。
steles.note: Preserved at the end of the 敕修百丈清規. Hands over the transmission Huineng > Nanyue Huairang > Mazu > Baizhang in a single sentence. THE STELE ALSO SAYS HE DIED AT 66 (「證滅於禪床，報齡六十六」), against the 95 of every lamp. The stele carries an appendix of five rules the community fixed after his death — one monk and one novice always at the stupa; no nuns' graves in the precinct; no privately held grain or cash.

teacher.quote: 大寂傳大師。中土相承凡九代矣。
teacher.note: 陳詡's stupa inscription, 818. 大寂 is Mazu Daoyi's imperial posthumous title. Roster teacher CONFIRMED at the highest rung available.

teacher.quote: 聞馬祖道一（709-788）在南康弘法，往依隨侍6載，得其秘傳。

dates.quote: 師於唐元和九年正月十七日示寂，春秋九十五。
dates.note: THE LAMPS SAY 95, which back-calculates to a birth of 720 — this is the source of the roster's 720. The same figure appears in 五燈會元 (X78n1553, lb 0658a07) and X76n1516.

dates.quote: 證滅於禪床，報齡六十六。
dates.note: THE STELE SAYS 66 — which would put his birth around 749, not 720. DILA flags the identical conflict: 「惟陳詡塔銘記其年壽為六十六，此與宋高僧傳卷十、景德傳燈錄卷六、天聖廣燈錄卷八所記之『春秋九十五』不一致」. I have LEFT 720-814 in the fields because that is the lamp consensus the chart already carries and the DEATH date is not in dispute — but the primary source disagrees with it, and by the brief's own rule the 塔銘 outranks the lamps. This must be shown on his page, not silently resolved.

links.label: DILA Authority A001897
links.confirms: dates (and the 66-vs-95 conflict), teacher, Hongzhou school

notes: Established the first independent Chan monastic code (百丈清規), revolutionizing Chan communal life. Famous for 'a day without work is a day without food' (一日不作一日不食). Subject of the wild fox koan. His monastic regulations became the model for all later Chan/Zen monasteries.

bio: Dharma name Baoche. His native place, lay surname and dates are all unknown. He went to Mazu Daoyi and inherited his dharma, then taught at Mt. Magu in Puzhou (Shanxi). He survives almost entirely through encounter dialogues — shaking the staff-rings, the handkerchief, and the exchange on the wind-nature that is everywhere.

teacher.quote: 麻谷和尚嗣馬大師，在蒲州。師諱寶徹，未詳姓氏。師與丹霞遊山，見水中魚…
teacher.note: 嗣馬大師 — explicit, in the earliest full lamp. Upgrades the roster from a bare DILA line.

teacher.quote: 出家後參謁馬祖道一，並嗣其法。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Mazu CONFIRMED. DILA cites 祖堂集:283 and 佛光:4852.

bio.quote: 唐代僧。籍貫、俗姓、生卒年均不詳。

notes: Appears in several encounter dialogues including a well-known exchange with Nanquan.

bio: The great mid-Tang poet; jinshi of 800, and successively collator, reminder, adviser to the heir apparent, marshal of Jiangzhou and prefect of Hangzhou and Suzhou. With Yuan Zhen he led the new yuefu movement, writing verse plain enough (the saying went) for an old woman to follow. In later life he took the lay name Xiangshan Jushi and gave himself to Buddhism. His link to Chan is certain but its channel is disputed: he composed the hall-of-transmission stele for Xingshan Weikuan, the Hongzhou-line master in the capital, while the authority record instead makes him a disciple of the monk Ruman.

steles.title: 西京興善寺傳法堂碑
steles.author: 白居易 (the subject's own disciple — i.e. our man)
steles.quote: 王城離域有佛寺，號興善寺；之坎地有僧舍，名傳法堂。先是大徹禪師晏居於是寺，說法于是堂，因名焉。
steles.note: Written after 817 while Bai was governor of 南賓郡 (Zhongzhou), on commission from Weikuan's disciples. Also in 全唐文卷678.

teacher.kind: his OWN stele — 〈西京興善寺傳法堂碑〉, written BY 白居易 for 惟寬's transmission-hall
teacher.quote: 師之徒殆千餘，達者三十九人，其入室受遺者有義崇、有圓鏡。以先師嘗欲與予言，知予嘗醍醐齅薝蔔者有日矣。師既沒後，予出守南賓郡，遠託撰述，迨今而成。嗚呼，斯文豈直起師教、慰門弟子心哉，抑且志吾受信默證，傳記於靈山會於將來世，故其文不避繁。
teacher.note: DECISIVE AND FIRST-PERSON. Bai Juyi calls 惟寬 『先師』 — my late master — in his own hand, and states his purpose is 『志吾受信默證』: to place on record that HE HIMSELF received the trust and the silent verification. He is the author of the stone. There is no closer witness possible than a man carving his own teacher's epitaph and naming himself in it.

teacher.kind: same stele — the lineage and the four questions
teacher.quote: 能傳南嶽讓，讓傳洪州道一，一諡曰大寂，寂即師之師… 然居易為贊善大夫時，嘗四詣師，四問道
teacher.note: Bai places 惟寬 as 馬祖道一's heir (making Bai a Hongzhou-line layman, which the roster's school tag already assumes) and records his own four visits and four questions verbatim. Bai's 銘 closes: 『佛以一印付迦葉，至師五十有九葉』.

teacher.quote: 晚年好佛，號香山居士，為如滿法師之弟子。
teacher.note: CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER. The roster gives Xingshan Weikuan 興善惟寬; DILA names 如滿 (Ruman). Both are defensible — Bai Juyi WROTE 〈西京興善寺傳法堂碑銘〉 for Weikuan and describes attending on him, while DILA records the Ruman discipleship. I have set teacher: null rather than silently pick one. DILA's sect 洪州宗 is consistent with EITHER, since both men are of Mazu's line. Note too that he is a LAYMAN: 'teacher' here means discipleship, not dharma transmission, and a transmission edge on the chart would misrepresent him.

dates.quote: 生於唐代宗大曆七年鞏縣（今河南鞏義）… 會昌六年逝世，享年七十五。（佛光：2086）

school.note: DILA marks him explicitly as NOT a monk.

links.label: DILA Authority A004029
links.confirms: dates, lay status, the Ruman discipleship

notes: One of the greatest Tang poets and devoted lay Buddhist. Famous exchange with Bird's Nest Daolin.

bio: Silla monk who crossed to Tang China and inherited the dharma of Xitang Zhizang, Mazu's heir. Returning to Korea he founded the Dongnisan school, one of the Nine Mountain schools of Seon. The Zutang ji — compiled in 952, within living memory of his line — enters him as 'the Korean master of Dongni, heir of Xitang', gives his dharma name as Hyejeol, his posthumous title as Chan Master Jeogin, and names his stupa the Pure Stupa of the Illuminating Wheel.

teacher.quote: 東國桐裏和尚，嗣西堂，師諱慧徹。諡號寂忍禪師，照輪清淨之塔。
teacher.note: 祖堂集 (952) — the earliest surviving Chan collection, centuries closer to him than any Qing lamp. Roster teacher Xitang Zhizang CONFIRMED, together with his posthumous title and the name of his stupa.

teacher.quote: 西堂下出處微和尚、海東陳田、海東桐裏、海東實相。
teacher.note: A second, independent listing in the same text: under Xitang come the Korean masters of Jinjeon, Dongni (= Hyejeol) and Silsang.

notes: Silla monk who traveled to Tang China and received dharma transmission from Xitang Zhizang (Mazu lineage). Returned to found the Dongni-san school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools. Teacher of Doseon.

bio: Of the Ye clan of Zhenchang. He entered Nanhua monastery at nine, and at seventeen cut off two fingers before his parents to force their consent to his ordination. After Danyuan Yingzhen he entered the room of Guishan Lingyou, was sealed by him, and then served him fifteen years, the two of them striking sparks off each other. Under Xizong he moved to Great Yangshan and so extended Guishan's teaching that the house took both their names — the Guiyang school. He taught by drawing circular figures. Born on the 21st of the 6th month of 807; died on the 13th of the 2nd month of 883.

steles.title: 仰山通智大師塔銘
steles.author: 陸希聲 (Lu Xisheng, d. 895/896, Tang chancellor and Huiji's own student)
steles.path: 全唐文 卷813 (not in the CBETA corpus; text from zh.wikisource, fetched and verified)
steles.quote: 乾寧二年三月一日，力病撰銘曰：六用如如，合於太虛。四大無主，當歸享土。以家為塔，終古永樂。千載之後，靈光照灼。
steles.note: Dated Qianning 2 (895), commissioned by the disciple Guangmei 光昧. Lu Xisheng notes he had earlier written a stele for Xiangyan 香嚴 at the request of Xiangyan's disciples, and refuses to repeat its argument here.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷813 陸希聲「仰山通智大師塔銘」 (zh.wikisource, fetched)
teacher.kind: 塔銘 (stele, 895 CE, by his own student)
teacher.quote: 自文宗朝，有大溈山大圓禪師居士養道，以曹溪心地，直指示學人，使入玄理。天下雲從霧集，常數千人。然承其宗旨者，三人而已。一曰仰山，二曰大安，三曰香嚴。
teacher.note: 大溈山大圓禪師 = Guishan Lingyou (posthumous title 大圓禪師). The stele states that only THREE men carried his 宗旨, and Yangshan is the first named. 承其宗旨 is transmission language.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷813 陸希聲「仰山通智大師塔銘」
teacher.quote: 然師得曹溪元旨，傳付學人，雖與經教符同，了然自顯一道。
teacher.note: 傳付 — the author was himself Huiji's student, so this is a first-person witness embedded in stone.

teacher.quote: 未久，入溈山靈祐之室，受其印可… 復還溈山，執侍靈祐凡十五年，互相激揚宗門。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Guishan Lingyou CONFIRMED. He ALSO studied under 耽源應真 and later visited 巖頭全奯 — association, not transmission. The seal (印可) is Guishan's.

dates.quote: 大師元和二年六月二十一日生… 中和三年二月十三日入滅。
dates.note: DILA takes BOTH dates from 全唐文 卷813 〈仰山通智大師塔銘〉 — i.e. ultimately from his stupa inscription. That text is not in this corpus, so I could not quote it at first hand.

notes: Co-founder of the Guiyang school. Known for circular figures in teaching.

bio: Of Qingzhou. Learned and retentive, at home in sutra and treatise — which was exactly his obstacle. Guishan Lingyou asked him for a word from before his parents were born and he could not find one in all his reading; he burned his notes and withdrew to Nanyang. Clearing weeds one day, a flung pebble rang against bamboo and he awoke; Guishan sealed him. He then taught at Mt. Xiangyan in Dengzhou. Posthumously titled Great Master Xideng. Died 898.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988), 梁鄧州香嚴山智閑傳
teacher.quote: 既而慕法心堅，至南方禮溈山大圓禪師盛會，咸推閑為俊敏。溈山一日召對，茫然。…便望南陽忠國師遺跡而居。偶芟除草木，擊瓦礫，失笑，冥有所證，抒頌唱之，由茲盛化。
teacher.note: 溈山大圓禪師 = 溈山靈祐. The 擊竹 awakening was triggered BY 溈山's teaching (the unanswerable question) even though the moment came in solitude — the lamps are unanimous he is 溈山's heir.

teacher.quote: 溈山靈祐禪師（771-853）法嗣… 一日芟草次，擊瓦礫，廓然省悟，得靈祐印可。
teacher.note: 得靈祐印可 = received 靈祐's seal.

teacher.quote: 溈山靈祐禪師（771-853）法嗣… 參溈山靈祐，示以父母未生時話… 一日芟草次，擊瓦礫，廓然省悟，得靈祐印可。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Guishan Lingyou CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 戊午光化元年。……。禪師溈山支下鄧州香嚴智閑寂。（X86n1600_p0186a21）
dates.note: Death 898 (光化元年). Birth UNKNOWN — the roster's floruit 820 is unsourced.

notes: Awakened by sound of a pebble striking bamboo after burning his notes.

bio: Of the Xu clan of Minyue. Ordained young and strict in the precepts. He first paid his respects to Yantou Quanhuo and inherited from him, then settled at Ruiyan cloister in Taizhou, where he would sit all day on a boulder like a simpleton, calling out to himself — 'Master!' — answering himself 'Yes', and adding: 'Stay awake! Never let anyone fool you.' King Qian of Wuyue took refuge with him. His stupa was raised on his own mountain and he was posthumously titled Chan Master Kongzhao.

teacher.quote: 師彥，姓許氏，閩越人也。早悟羈縻，忽求拔俗，循乎戒檢。俄欲觀方，見巖頭禪師領會無疑。初樂杜默似不能言者，後為所知敦喻，允請住台州瑞巖山院
teacher.note: HONESTY FLAG for the grader: this is Zanning's Song Gaoseng Zhuan, compiled 988 — c. 68 years after Shiyan's death (920), so NOT a strict contemporary, but it is an independent narrative biography, it PREDATES the Jingde lamp (1004), and it draws on Taizhou local records. The verb is soft (領會無疑, 'understood without doubt'), not 嗣法. I grade B; a strict grader could reasonably call this C.

teacher.quote: 台州瑞巖師彥禪師，青六，巖頭奯嗣
teacher.note: Corroborating index line.

teacher.quote: 初禮巖頭全禪師，未久居於台州（浙江）瑞巖院… 為青原行思法系（南宗禪）下之第六世。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Yantou Quanhuo CONFIRMED.

school.note: DILA places him in the Qingyuan/Shitou line (Yantou < Deshan < Longtan < Tianhuang < Shitou), which is more precise than the roster's bare 'Chan'.

notes: Called out to himself daily 'Master! Be alert! Don't be deceived!'

bio: Of the Chen clan of Yongjia. He went to Xuefeng Yicun and inherited his dharma. In Yue he was the constant sparring partner of Pi Guangye. He held Jingqing monastery and then Tianlong; Qian Liu of Wuyue styled him Great Master Shunde, and Qian Yuanguan built Longce monastery in Hangzhou for him — with which, the sources say, the flourishing of Chan learning in Wuyue began. He died in the 8th month of 937, aged 70; his relics were gathered into a stupa before Mt. Longmu.

steles.title: (道怤) 塔銘
steles.author: 僧主彙征
steles.quote: 起塔於龍姥山前。故僧主彙征撰塔銘。
steles.note: Named author, named grave. Text not extant in the corpus; cited by SGSZ.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 後唐杭州龍冊寺道怤傳 — written FROM his stele, which it names
teacher.quote: 釋道怤，俗姓陳，永嘉人也…具戒已，遊閩入楚，言參問善知識，要決了生死根源。見臨川曹山寂公，大有徵詰，若曇詢之問僧稠也。終頓息疑於雪峯，閩中謂之小怤布納。
teacher.note: 曹山本寂 is a 見 with 徵詰 — a sparring visit, NOT a transmission (association trap). The resolution — 終頓息疑於雪峯, 'he finally, utterly put his doubt to rest at Xuefeng' — is Xuefeng's. Confirms the current teacher.

teacher.quote: 以天福丁酉歲八月示滅，春秋七十。茶毘于大慈山塢，收拾舍利，起塔於龍姥山前。故僧主彙征撰塔銘。今舍利院，弟子主之，香火相綴焉。
teacher.note: His 塔銘 was written by 僧主彙征 (Huizheng, the Wuyue monk-rector) — a NAMED author at a NAMED grave (龍姥山前), and a contemporary. Zanning names the stele as his source. The stele text itself is not in the CBETA corpus, but its existence, author, and grave are attested.

teacher.quote: 參謁雪峰義存，嗣其法。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Xuefeng Yicun CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 天福丁酉歲八月示滅。春秋七十。（T50n2061_p0787b01）
dates.note: From the 宋高僧傳 — a Song source, not a Qing lamp.

notes: Heir of Xuefeng Yicun with five dharma successors. Best known for the 'voice of the raindrops' exchange, preserved as Book of Serenity case 46. Also appears in Blue Cliff Record cases 16, 23, and 46.

bio: Of the Wang clan of Yuhang. He served as a garrison officer at Huating — buying a boatload of fish to release them — before ordaining under Cuiyan Lingcan at Longce monastery; he then went to Mt. Tiantai and got the point from Tiantai Deshao. In 961 Qian Chu of Wuyue moved him to Yongming monastery, where his assembly reached two thousand. He taught the joint cultivation of Chan and Pure Land, and compiled the Zongjing lu in 100 fascicles together with the Wanshan tonggui ji. The king of Goryeo, reading his Record, sent him a gold-threaded robe. He died on the 26th of the 12th month of Kaibao 8 (early 976), aged 72, and was interred on Mt. Daci.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 卷28〈宋錢塘永明寺延壽傳〉(贊寧, 988 — 13 years after Yanshou died)
teacher.quote: 釋延壽，姓王，本錢塘人也。兩浙有國時為吏，督納軍須…屬翠巖參公盛化，壽捨妻孥，削染登戒。甞於台嶺天柱峯九旬習定，有鳥類尺鷃，巢棲于衣襵中。乃得韶禪師決擇所見，遷遁于雪竇山…以開寶八年乙亥終于住寺，春秋七十二，法臘三十七。葬于大慈山，樹亭誌焉。
teacher.note: 贊寧 (919–1001) was himself a Wuyue monk under the same Qian court, in the same city, in Yanshou's own lifetime — this is as close to a contemporary witness as the man has. And it keeps the two teachers APART: 翠巖令參 is where he 削染登戒 (tonsure + full precepts); 德韶 is 「乃得韶禪師決擇所見」 — Shao ADJUDICATED his insight. 決擇 is the dharma act.

teacher.quote: 天台德韶（891-972）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十一世… 後往天台山謁德韶得旨。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Tiantai Deshao CONFIRMED. His TONSURE teacher was 翠巖令參 — association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 「開寶八年乙亥十二月示疾，二十六日辰時，焚香告眾，跏趺而化。閱世七十有二」（《禪林僧寶傳》卷 9）
dates.note: DILA renders the death 976-02-03 Gregorian: the 12th month of Kaibao 8 falls in early 976. The roster's 975 is the Chinese-year rendering of the same event — not a conflict.

links.label: DILA Authority A000282
links.confirms: dates, teacher, Fayan school, the Zongjing lu

notes: Third patriarch of the Fayan school and author of the Zongjing Lu (宗鏡錄, Record of the Mirror of the School) in 100 fascicles, one of the most comprehensive Chan works ever composed. Student of Tiantai Deshao. Served as abbot of Yongming Monastery in Hangzhou.

bio: Of Linjiang. Austere in conduct and quick of understanding. He went to Deshan Huiyuan and attended him; one day Huiyuan came into the hall, looked over the assembly and said, 'The lion roars; the elephant king turns his head' — and Shanxian saw into it, and brought his understanding into the master's room. He then held Kaixian monastery on Mt. Lu for eighteen years. Thirteen dharma heirs are recorded, among them Yunju Liaoyuan (Foyin), the friend of Su Shi.

teacher.quote: 德山遠禪師法嗣：開先善暹禪師…遠禪師在德山，師往依之。一日遠陞堂顧視大眾云：「師子頻呻，象王回顧。」師忽有省。
teacher.note: 續傳燈錄 — teacher 德山慧遠 confirmed

teacher.quote: 師嗣開先善暹。暹嗣德山遠。遠嗣雙泉郁。郁嗣雲門偃禪師。
teacher.note: 佛祖歷代通載 — full Yunmen chain

teacher.quote: 德山遠禪師法嗣：開先善暹禪師。廬山開先善暹禪師，臨江軍人。操行清苦，智識明達。遠禪師在德山，師往依之。一日遠陞堂顧視大眾云：「師子頻呻，象王回顧。」師忽有省。入室陳解。
teacher.note: THE ROSTER IS WRONG. It gives Xuedou Chongxian 雪竇重顯. He is filed under 德山遠禪師法嗣 with a full account of the awakening under Deshan Huiyuan — and he is ABSENT from the 84-name list of Xuedou Chongxian's heirs at lb 0499a12 of this very same text.

teacher.kind: 佛祖歷代通載 — explicit chain
teacher.quote: 師嗣開先善暹。暹嗣德山遠。遠嗣雙泉郁。郁嗣雲門偃禪師。
teacher.note: Spells the whole line out: Shanxian < Deshan Yuan < Shuangquan Yu < YUNMEN WENYAN. So the SCHOOL the roster gives (Yunmen) is right; only the teacher is wrong.

teacher.quote: 德山慧遠禪師法嗣，師住開先寺，凡十八年。
teacher.note: Third independent agreement.

teacher.quote: 德山遠禪師法嗣：開先善暹禪師、欽勤禪師…
teacher.note: Fourth. B24n0140 (lb 0604b57) likewise sets 德山慧遠 directly above 開先善暹 in a lineage column.

school.quote: 遠嗣雙泉郁。郁嗣雲門偃禪師。

links.label: DILA Authority A020662
links.confirms: teacher = Deshan Huiyuan; eighteen years at Kaixian

notes: Yunmen school master at Kaixian Temple on Mount Lushan. Teacher of Foyin Liaoyuan.

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Wang clan of Shezhou. He came into the monasteries as an ascetic, so that people called him 'Ning the ascetic' all his life. Working the bath-house at Chongguo monastery he was reciting the Diamond Sutra — at 'if anyone can give rise to faith in these phrases and take them as real' — and forgot what he knew, letting his foot down into the boiling water without noticing. He shaved his head at Jiangshan and studied under a long line of masters (Xuedou Liang, Yongquan Cheng, Zihu Jue, Kaixian Xian, Sanzu Zong, Taiping Qing, Yuantong Fajing) before hearing Wuzu Fayan raise the National Teacher's old jug and Zhaozhou's dog, and penetrating to the source. In the Daguan era the governor of Tan installed him at Kaifu, where the assembly made his seat the first in Hu-Xiang. He died seated on the 7th of the 11th month of Zhenghe 3 (1113), aged 61.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense, at his 開堂 (enthronement)
teacher.quote: 師開堂日，拈香云：此一瓣香，虔祝今上皇帝聖壽無窮。此一瓣香，奉為知府待制…此一瓣香，佛祖不知名…今對人天眾前，更不囊藏被葢。奉為蘄州五祖山第十二代演禪師，爇向爐中，以醻法乳。
teacher.note: Textbook. Three sticks — emperor, prefect, and then the dharma-milk stick, explicitly 以醻法乳, to Yan chanshi, 12th generation of Wuzu Mountain in Qizhou = 五祖法演. First-person, at the transmission. 開福道寧禪師語錄, collected by his 嗣法小師 善果.

teacher.quote: 五祖法演禪師法嗣… 晚至白蓮，聞五祖小參舉忠國師古佛淨瓶、趙州狗子無佛性話，頓徹法源。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Wuzu Fayan CONFIRMED. DILA cites 僧寶正續傳 卷2, 嘉泰普燈錄 卷11, 續傳燈錄 卷28. NOTE the trap: 開先暹 (Kaixian Shanxian, also in this batch) is among the masters he merely CONSULTED — association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 「政和三年十一月七日，跏趺湛然而逝，閱歲六十一，坐二十一夏。」（《僧寶正續傳》卷2）

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A010679
links.confirms: dates, teacher, the Diamond Sutra awakening

notes: Fellow student of Yuanwu Keqin under Wuzu Fayan. His sub-lineage led to Wumen Huikai.

bio: Of the Yong clan of Anchang (Zuomian, Sichuan). He ordained at eleven under Qingjun at Shengguo monastery and was licensed on the Lotus Sutra at eighteen. Leaving Shu, he went to Danxia Zichun at Mt. Danxia in Deng; Danxia asked him what his own self was before the aeon of emptiness, and as he moved to answer, struck him — and he opened. At Changlu he met Zuzhao, who made him his attendant and within a year gave him a seat; in 1122 he took the abbacy, and the hall held 1,700 monks. He went on to Putuo, Tianfeng, Xuefeng, Ayuwang (by imperial order), Longxiang and Jingshan. In 1151 he was commanded to open Chongxian Xianxiao cloister for the Empress Dowager Cining. He died there cross-legged on the first of the tenth month, aged 64, and was given the posthumous title Chan Master Wukong. With Hongzhi Zhengjue, his dharma brother, he is the pivot of the Southern Song Caodong revival.

steles.title: 崇先真歇了禪師塔銘
steles.author_note: Author not recoverable from the corpus text I could read; the Japanese re-cutter 面山瑞方 notes in his 1767 preface that the stupa inscription was printed WITHOUT its preface in the received edition and that he restored it from an old manuscript found in a worm-eaten pile.
steles.quote: 末載塔銘，亦脫其序，余悶之尚矣。今秋有緣寓惠日之艮嶽院，偶得古寫本於蠧冊堆，讀之巨備焉，是故重刊流布。
steles.note: DILA cites 《真歇清了禪師語錄》卷1〈崇先真歇了禪師塔銘〉 for his dates, so the inscription is the ultimate source for them. The same volume carries 吳敏's 1158 preface, which states the transmission independently.

teacher.kind: 序 by 吳敏, 紹興二十八年 (1158)
teacher.quote: 長蘆了禪師，芙蓉之孫，丹霞之子。得法於鉢盂峯上，以無所得而得。
teacher.note: Written seven years after his death by a man who says he visited his room (予甞造其室). 'Grandson of Furong, SON OF DANXIA' — roster teacher Danxia Zichun CONFIRMED, and the grandfather Furong Daokai named too.

teacher.quote: 丹霞子淳（1066-1119）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十四世… 投鄧之丹霞山淳禪師之席，一日入室，霞問：「如何是空劫以前自己。」師擬進語，霞與一掌，師豁然開悟。

dates.quote: 「紹興二十一年十月旦，壽六十四」（《嘉泰普燈錄》卷 9）
dates.note: DILA also cites the 塔銘 in X71n1426 卷1 for the life. Death 1151-11-17 Gregorian.

links.label: DILA Authority A006941
links.confirms: dates, teacher, the seats he held

notes: Born in Anchang, Sichuan. Dharma brother of Hongzhi Zhengjue under Danxia Zichun. Key figure in the Caodong revival during the Southern Song. Abbot of Changlu and Tiantong monasteries. His emphasis on silent illumination (mozhao) drew Dahui Zonggao's famous critiques. 10th patriarch of the Caodong lineage; his line leads through Tiantong Zongjue to Tiantong Rujing and eventually to Dogen, founder of Japanese Soto Zen.

bio: Known as Zu'an. He was already in the assembly at Changlu when Dahui Zonggao's contemporary Zonggue held the first seat there and marked him out. He inherited from Tiantong Dahui Zongjue — Zongjue's ONLY dharma heir — and settled at Mt. Xuedou. His own sole recorded heir is Tiantong Rujing, the teacher of Dogen, so the whole Japanese Soto line runs through him.

teacher.kind: 天童寺志 — explicit adjudication of the dispute
teacher.quote: 大休宗玨禪師：師嗣真歇了，了嗣丹霞淳。其法嗣雪竇鑑。〔附紀〕雪竇智鑑，號足菴，玨嗣止一人。《續燈錄》又以鑑作「真歇了法嗣」，未免有誤。
teacher.note: TAKEN. The 天童寺志 knows of the rival claim and rejects it by name: 續燈錄 makes Zhijian an heir of 真歇清了 (i.e. of his teacher's teacher), 'which cannot avoid being an error'. It also notes Zongjue had exactly ONE heir.

teacher.source: 續燈錄 (as reported at GA013n0012, not read directly)
teacher.quote: 《續燈錄》又以鑑作「真歇了法嗣」
teacher.note: THE DISSENT, recorded per the brief. 續燈錄 makes him an heir of 真歇清了. I do not take it: it skips a generation, and the 天童寺志 — the house record of the monastery where his own heir Rujing taught his Way — corrects it explicitly. Marked `disputed` so the reroute stays visible.

teacher.quote: 足庵智鑑時在座下，珏居第一座，即器之。
大休宗玨禪師：師嗣真歇了，了嗣丹霞淳。其法嗣雪竇鑑。〔附紀〕雪竇智鑑，號足菴，玨嗣止一人。《續燈錄》又以鑑作「真歇了法嗣」，未免有誤。
teacher.note: Roster teacher CONFIRMED — and the source itself flags the rival tradition and rejects it: the 續燈錄 makes him Zhenxie Qingliao's heir, which the Tiantong temple history calls an ERROR. He is Zongjue's only heir. Worth displaying: this is a case where the roster is RIGHT and a lamp is wrong.

teacher.quote: 天童玨禪師法嗣：雪竇智鑑一則… 明州雪竇智鑑禪師（青十五，天童玨嗣）
teacher.note: Independent agreement; the same text at lb 0681a27 gives 「雪竇鑑禪師法嗣：天童如淨」 — his heir is Rujing.

teacher.quote: 足庵智鑑時在座下，珏居第一座，即器之。
teacher.note: Zongjue, holding the first seat, recognised him while he was still in the assembly.

school.note: Caodong via Danxia Zichun — confirms the school.

notes: Caodong master at Mount Xuedou. Teacher of Tiantong Rujing.

bio: Of the Cai clan of Hanei. Sent at fifteen to Jingtu monastery in Xingzhou, he placed seventh in the state examination for monks; the examiner Sun Chunnian was so taken with his prose that he offered to have him laicised and married to his daughter, and Xingxiu refused. He studied under Shengmo Guang at Wanshou, then went to Xueyan Man at Daming in Cizhou, where after twenty-seven days of hard effort he broke through; Man gave him robe and bowl. He built the Wansong hermitage at Jingtu to live in. Summoned to preach in the palace in 1193, he was received by the emperor in person. He read the whole canon three times and took the Huayan as his constant work. He compiled the Congrong lu (1224) — his prose commentary on Hongzhi Zhengjue's hundred verse-comments, the Book of Serenity — and the Qingyi lu. His heirs included Linquan Conglun and the Mongol chancellor Yelu Chucai. Died 1246.

teacher.kind: his own preface to 《請益錄》, signed by him (庚寅 = 1230)
teacher.quote: 萬松曰：雪巖先師亦曾於王山頂上、滏水岸邊，舉洞山示眾云…萬松忝授緒餘，義無牢讓，自庚寅九月旦請益，纔廿七日…二十八日序。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. In his own signed preface 萬松 calls 雪巖 「先師」 — my late master — and 「忝授緒餘」, 'I unworthily received the remaining threads [of his line]'. He even places 雪巖 geographically: 王山頂上、滏水岸邊 — 滏水 runs through 磁州, exactly where 雪巖滿 held 大明寺. Self-reference in the third person ('萬松曰') is standard Chan convention and does not weaken it; the piece is his, and he signs it.

teacher.kind: lineage chart carved on the reverse of 月舟載's 行實碑 (譔: 天童懷讓虛禪師), quoted in 《正名錄》
teacher.quote: 碑陰有曹洞正傳宗派圖．曰…芙蓉楷．鹿門覺．青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕…
teacher.note: 雪巖滿 → 萬松秀, carved on stone (碑陰), in sequence, on TWO separate steles (also the 幻休潤行實碑, 0459b24). Note 王山體 — the brief's own warning: this is 王山體, not 玉山師體.

teacher.quote: 雪巖滿禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十三世… 行腳至磁州大明請益雪巖滿禪師，力參二十七日，於滿言豁然大悟… 師依雪巖二年，語言相契，盡其底蘊。滿徑付衣鉢。
teacher.note: Roster teacher CONFIRMED (roster's 'Xueyan Huiman' = 雪巖滿 of the sources). Note his EARLIER teacher 勝默光 and the 潭柘亨 he also consulted — association, not transmission; the robe and bowl are Xueyan's.

dates.quote: 金世宗大定六年（《釋氏疑年錄》卷九）… 元定宗元年丙午閏四月七日卒（《釋氏疑年錄》卷九）

links.label: DILA Authority A000408
links.confirms: dates, teacher, the Congrong lu, Yelu Chucai

notes: Influential Caodong master active during the late Jin dynasty and early Mongol period. Compiler of the Book of Serenity (從容錄, Congrong Lu, 1224), his prose commentary on Hongzhi Zhengjue's 100 verse-comments on old cases, composed at the urging of his lay disciple Yelü Chucai. Self-styled 'Old Man of Ten Thousand Pines' (萬松老人). Abbot of Bao'en Temple in Yanjing from 1197 until his death. His lineage became the dominant Chinese Caodong transmission through his disciple Xueting Fuyu at Shaolin.

teacher: Jogye Wono 曹溪圓悟和尚
bio: Of the Bak clan of Ungjin, son of a jinsa. A Confucian's son who became a monk; sharp as a boy and tireless as he grew. He took first place in the Nine Mountains examination, then threw off his robes and went to the Diamond Mountains, and after the summer moved to Mt. Jiri, eating without relish, refusing a second coat in the cold, not letting his side touch the mat for years on end: the more he hid, the more his name spread. King Chungnyeol ordered him to Samjang-sa. He went on to head the Nangwol, Unheung and Seonwon communities, and his disciples reached seven hundred; scholar-officials past counting gathered their robes and entered his community. Mengshan Deyi of Wu, seeing his writings, praised them without stopping, matched a dozen of his verses, and sent him the sobriquet Godam. Tenth master of Suseonsa; posthumously National Teacher Hyegam.

steles.title: 海東曹溪山修禪社第十世別傳宗主重續祖燈妙明尊者贈諡慧鑑國師碑銘并序
steles.author: 李齊賢
steles.author_note: Yi Je-hyeon (1287-1367), the foremost Goryeo statesman and man of letters of his generation.
steles.quote: 諱萬恒。俗姓朴氏。考進士。諱京升。熊津郡人。師以儒家子為僧。幼頴悟。能自強於學。長益不怠。赴九山選。中魁科… 忠烈王。命住三藏社。其師曹溪圓悟和尚。亦諭之乃往。
steles.note: THE STELE, in the 朝鮮佛教通史 — and it NAMES A DIFFERENT TEACHER THAN THE ROSTER. The same inscription is carried independently at X88n1671 lb 0680b06, where the wording is identical (「其師曹溪圓悟和尚亦諭之，乃往」).

teacher.quote: 忠烈王。命住三藏社。其師曹溪圓悟和尚。亦諭之乃往。
teacher.note: CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER. The roster gives Chungji 冲止 (National Teacher Wongam, 1226-1292). His own stele calls his teacher 曹溪圓悟和尚 — National Teacher Wono of Jogye. Two independent witnesses to the same inscription (B31n0170 lb 0646a09; X88n1671 lb 0680b06) agree. I have taken the STELE, per the brief's rule that a named man writing at a named grave outranks a compilation. I do NOT further identify 圓悟 with any particular monk, because no source I found does so. The roster's Chungji attribution has NO source I could locate.

school.quote: 海東曹溪山修禪社第十世別傳宗主

bio.quote: 召松廣寺僧萬恆赴會。及還賜所御軺子遣之… 又與萬恆同輦，幸溟福寺。點燈凡八日。萬恒設酌，王懽甚自歌。
bio.note: 1313: the retired king summons him from Songgwang-sa, gives him his own carriage, rides in the same palanquin with him, and sings at his feast. At lb 0361a08 (1315) the king gives him 130 catties of silver. Contemporary court annals — a rare, concrete picture of a Korean master's standing.

notes: 10th National Teacher of Suseonsa. Bridges into the 14th century.

school: Korean Seon / Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Hong clan of Hongju; his father was a chancellor. Born on the 21st of the 9th month of 1301. He entered Hoeam-sa under Gwangji at thirteen and took up the huatou 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one' at nineteen. In 1337, at thirty-seven, he lodged at the Sandalwood Garden working on the word 'No', and at the fifth watch on the seventh of the first month following he broke open. In 1346, aged forty-six, he went to Yuan China; hearing that Zhuyuan Sheng had died, he went instead to Shiwu Qinggong on Mt. Xiawu in Huzhou, laid out what he had attained and offered his Song of Taego Hermitage. Shiwu tested him, then handed him his kasaya as a token — 'this old monk can now stretch out his legs and sleep' — kept him half a month, and at parting gave him his staff. The Yuan emperor had him open the hall at Yongning monastery. Home in Korea he was made royal preceptor and then National Teacher, and is credited with drawing the Nine Mountain schools into a single order. Died 1382, aged 82.

steles.title: 圓證國師塔銘 (高麗國國師大曹溪嗣祖傳佛心印…諡圓證塔銘并序)
steles.author: 李穡
steles.author_note: Yi Saek (1328-1396), Han-san Buwongun, the leading Goryeo Confucian of the age — writing by royal command (奉教撰); calligraphy and seal-script by 權鑄.
steles.quote: 國師諱普愚，號太古，俗姓洪氏，洪州人也… 以大德五年辛丑九月二十一日生… 十三投檜巖廣智禪師出家，十九參萬法歸一話… 至正丙戌師年四十六，遊燕都…至湖州霞霧山見石屋珙禪師，具陳所得，且獻太古菴歌。石屋深器之…遂以袈裟表信曰：「老僧今日展脚睡矣。」屋臨濟十八代孫也。留師半月，臨別贈以柱杖。
steles.note: The stupa inscription, by royal command. Gives the birth date exactly, the age at the meeting with Shiwu (46, in 1346), and the transmission itself — the kasaya handed over as a token of trust.

teacher.quote: 至湖州霞霧山見石屋珙禪師…石屋深器之…遂以袈裟表信曰：「老僧今日展脚睡矣。」屋臨濟十八代孫也。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Shiwu Qinggong CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription, at the moment of transmission.

teacher.quote: 師生楊根郡大元里，遊學中國，嗣臨濟十八代孫石屋清珙禪師之法，則於臨濟為十九代之孫也。石屋贈法衣禪杖以表相契。東還，玄陵禮以為王師，尋加國師。
teacher.note: A SECOND independent inscription in the same collection, again naming Shiwu Qinggong and placing Taego as the 19th generation of Linji.

teacher.quote: 自臨濟十八傳而為石室清珙，麗朝太古普愚得珙之傳。
teacher.note: Third agreement (writing 石室 for 石屋).

teacher.quote: 為石屋清珙禪師（1272-1352）法嗣… 至湖洲霞霧山天湖庵參謁石屋禪師，得付法，成為高麗傳臨濟宗嫡流之第一人。

dates.quote: 以大德五年辛丑九月二十一日生
dates.note: Birth 1301 from the stele. Death 1382 per DILA (A022525) and the stele's narrative.

school.quote: 嗣臨濟十八代孫石屋清珙禪師之法，則於臨濟為十九代之孫也。

links.label: DILA Authority A022525
links.confirms: dates, teacher Shiwu Qinggong, the Yuan journey

notes: The most important institutional figure in Korean Seon history, credited with unifying the Nine Mountains Seon schools into a single Jogye Order. He traveled to Yuan China and received dharma transmission from the hermit-poet Shiwu Qinggong (Stone House) on Tianmu mountain, returning with Shiwu's robe (cassock) and staff as physical proof of transmission. As Royal Teacher (wangsa) under King Gongmin, he reorganized Korean Seon, ending centuries of fragmentation among rival mountain schools. His unification established the institutional framework that persists in Korean Buddhism today. Though Ahn (2019) has questioned the later Joseon-era lineage claims connecting Hyujeong back through Taego, Taego's own Chinese transmission is well documented. Attested in UNDV 2011 conference paper: confirms the Shiwu transmission with physical evidence including the cassock and cane still preserved.

bio: Of the Li clan of Shundefu. He studied for the civil examinations before shaving his head at Kaiyuan monastery, then went to Shaolin on Mt. Song to Yuezhou Wenzai, under whom he laboured EIGHT YEARS before receiving the seal. From 1532 he opened the dharma at Xingde monastery and held Tianqing and Wutai. In 1557 the assembly asked him to take Shaolin, which he did — the abbacy in which he sent the monastery's fighting monks against the Japanese pirates. Later he went to the capital and lived at Zongjing hermitage, and at the end wandered to the Three Studies Cave in the western hills and spent his last summer retreat there. Died on the 16th of the 12th month of 1567, aged 68; his bones were divided in three, for Zongjing, for the ancestral graves at Shunde, and for Shaolin.

steles.title: 小山禪師行實碑銘 (敕賜住持少林寺曹洞正宗第二十四世當代傳法小山禪師行實)
steles.author: 碑陰題《混元三教九流圖讚》 by 朱載堉 (Prince Zhu Zaiyu)
steles.path: EXTANT STONE, Shaolin Temple, before the bell tower (not in the CBETA corpus)
steles.quote: 正面為小山禪師行實碑銘，碑文記載了少林寺24世宗師小山禪師的生平
steles.note: 嘉靖四十四年 (1565), i.e. erected two years before his death. 3.35 m tall, 1.15 m wide. Verified via zh.wikipedia 混元三教九流圖贊碑 (fetched). The CBETA corpus does NOT contain this text — this is exactly the 'off-corpus document' the brief asked for.

teacher.source: zh.wikipedia 小山宗書 (citing 五燈會元續略卷一, 五燈全書卷六十一, 續燈正統卷三十七)
teacher.quote: 二十歲，前往少林寺投文載禪師門下。隨侍八年，列為曹洞宗第二十四代傳人。
teacher.note: The teacher (月舟文載) still rests on the lamps + DILA. The STELE is the upgrade to his life, not (so far as I could verify) to the filiation — I have not read the 行實碑 text itself, only reliable descriptions of it. Honest limit.

teacher.quote: 復往嵩山少室參月舟文載禪師，歷經八年方得印可。
teacher.note: Roster teacher CONFIRMED (roster's 'Yuezhou Wenzai' = 月舟文載). Eight years to the seal.

dates.quote: 世壽六十八，法臘三十六。（X80n1566_p0460c16）
dates.note: Death on the 16th of the 12th month of 隆慶元年 = 1568-01-24 Gregorian; the roster's 1567 is the Chinese-year rendering. Birth 1501 is DILA's back-calculation.

links.label: DILA Authority A008304
links.confirms: dates, teacher, Shaolin, the threefold division of his relics

notes: Shaolin Monastery abbot (1557-1566). Sent warrior monks against Japanese pirates. Key bridge figure connecting Yuan-era Shaolin Caodong to the late Ming revival.

bio: Of the Pei clan of Chongren, Fuzhou. His mother's labour was hard and his grandfather recited the Diamond Sutra until she was delivered, so they named him Jing ('Sutra'). At nine he asked his schoolmaster what exactly the 'flood-like qi' of Mencius was. At twenty-one he picked up the Diamond Sutra on a layman's table, could not finish it, and was as glad as a man recovering something he had lost; he gave up meat and wine and left home. He went to Yunkong Changzhong, then preaching at Linshan, and attended him three years. Withdrawing to Efeng he swore not to come down the mountain until the matter was settled, and lived there three years unknown to anyone. Reading the Chuandeng lu, at Xingshan's 'What is the Way?' — 'a fine mountain!' — he was stopped dead, and the doubt did not leave him day or night. One day, heaving at a stone that would not move, he threw his whole strength into it and broke open. He revived the Shouchang line and its work-ethic, and brought Dahui's huatou method into Caodong. Died on the 17th of the first month of 1618, aged 71.

steles.title: 壽昌無明大師塔銘(有序)
steles.author_note: Author's name not in the portion I could recover; the writer says he is working from the 行狀 (「謹按狀」) and had met the man (「予於壽昌禪師見其人矣」).
steles.quote: 謹按狀：師諱慧經，號無明，撫州崇仁裴氏子… 時邑之蘊空忠禪師說法於廩山，遂往依之，即其本名曰慧經。執侍三載，凡聞所教，不違如愚… 一日，因搬石堅不可舉，極力推之，豁然大悟。
steles.note: The stupa inscription, appended to his own recorded sayings. Names the teacher, the three years of attendance, and the stone.

teacher.quote: 時邑之蘊空忠禪師說法於廩山，遂往依之，即其本名曰慧經。執侍三載。
teacher.note: Roster teacher CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription (roster's 'Yunkong Changzhong' = 蘊空常忠/蘊空忠).

teacher.quote: 壽昌無明慧經禪師，蘊空常忠禪師法嗣… 依廩山忠禪師，執侍三年。

dates.quote: 「生於嘉靖戊申。」（〈壽昌無明大師塔銘〉）… 「萬曆戊午正月十七日未時，壽七十一。」（〈壽昌無明大師塔銘〉）
dates.note: BOTH dates are taken by DILA directly from the stupa inscription.

links.label: DILA Authority A003828
