notes: 68th Caodong patriarch. Founded the Shouchang sublineage. Revived work-ethic monastic practice. Promoted Dahui's kanhua Chan within Caodong.

bio: Of the Cai clan of Jianyang — fourteenth-generation descendant of the Song Confucian Cai Yuanding, and a Neo-Confucian scholar before he was anything else. At twenty-five he took the Surangama, Lotus and Perfect Enlightenment sutras from Zhao Yuzhai; at twenty-six he met Wuming Huijing, and sitting up one night over Nanquan's cat he had his first opening. He did not actually shave his head until he was forty, under Huijing. Three years after, in Fujian, he heard a fellow traveller chanting a sutra and broke wide open. He held Jinxian and Baoshan hermitages, Yongquan monastery on Mt. Gushan (which he restored in 1634), Kaiyuan in Quanzhou and others, and left some thirty fascicles of recorded sayings, essays and miscellany, besides temple gazetteers for Gushan and Quanzhou Kaiyuan. He died at midnight on the 7th of the 10th month of 1657, aged 80, with forty-one years in robes. He brought the Shouchang Caodong line into Fujian.

steles.title: 福州鼓山白雲峯湧泉禪寺永覺賢公大和尚行業曲記
steles.author_note: In his own 廣錄, 卷30. A second version, 〈鼓山永覺賢公禪師行業記〉, stands in the 鼓山寺志 卷8.
steles.quote: 萬曆戊寅七月十九日生。 … 丁酉十月七日子時。
steles.note: DILA takes both his birth and death from this 行業曲記, quoting it verbatim. I located the fascicle but could not isolate the passage in the tag-stripped text; the quotes here are DILA's citations OF it, not my own reading of the line — flagged honestly.

steles.title: 永覺賢公大師行業曲記
steles.author: 林涵齋居士 (the corpus gives only this form; I do not expand it)
steles.quote: 卷首，其他備乎林涵齋居士行業曲記云。
steles.note: The 廣錄's own front matter points to a 行業曲記 by the literatus 林涵齋 (Lin Hanzhai). Recorded here as a pointer only — I did not locate the full 行業曲記 text in the corpus, so I do not rest the teacher edge on it. The 拈香 above is sufficient and stronger.

teacher.quote: 遂登座，拈香云：此一瓣香，端為祝延今上聖壽萬安…；此一瓣香，恭為兩院三司、各郡官僚…；此一瓣香，恭為真寂堂上聞谷大師，伏願生生永坐旃檀林，在在常為獅子吼；此一瓣香，恭為壽昌堂上本師無明大和尚，仰酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FOUR sticks. Yuanxian himself keeps them apart exactly as the tradition requires: emperor / officials / 聞谷大師 (真寂 聞谷廣印 — his precept master, gets a blessing, NOT the dharma-milk) / 壽昌堂上本師無明大和尚 — and ONLY this last one carries 仰酬法乳之恩. This is the textbook case of the 'take only the dharma-milk stick' rule, decided by the master in his own voice.

teacher.quote: 字永覺，為壽昌慧經禪師（1548-1618）法嗣… 年四十投壽昌落髮。
teacher.note: Roster teacher Wuming Huijing CONFIRMED. Sources: 永覺元賢禪師廣錄 卷30〈行業曲記〉, 正源略集 卷3, 五燈全書 卷63, 鼓山寺志 卷8.

dates.quote: 「萬曆戊寅七月十九日生」…「丁酉十月七日子時」《永覺元賢禪師廣錄》卷 30〈行業曲記〉
dates.note: Both from the 行業記.

links.label: DILA Authority A000135
links.confirms: dates (from the 行業記), teacher, the Gushan restoration

notes: Brought Shouchang Caodong to Fujian. Restored Gushan Yongquan Monastery (1634). Over 100 volumes of writings. Called 'the last successful Caodong Chan master.'

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Li clan of Shenyang. At twenty-four he took the robe under Zhenyi at Pilu monastery in Gaoyang; after full ordination he went to Meng'an Chaoge at Li'an monastery and received his transmission. He taught first at the Great Thousand-Buddha monastery west of the capital, then Bailin, then Li'an, Guizong and Dajue. In old age he kept no fixed dwelling. He edited the Zongjian falin in 72 fascicles and re-edited the Chanzong zadu hai, and left something over a hundred fascicles in all. He was the Chan teacher of the Yongzheng emperor before his accession. He died on the 29th of the 7th month of 1726, aged 56, with 33 years in robes; the emperor posthumously titled him Chan Master Yuantong Miaojue Dazhi and he was interred at Dajue in the western hills.

steles.title: 御製臣僧性音語錄序 (imperial preface to his recorded sayings)
steles.author: 世宗憲皇帝 (the Yongzheng emperor)
steles.path: attested in GA/GA021/GA021n0019.xml (the gazetteer references the imperial序; text of the序 itself not in this file)
steles.quote: 臣僧性音…奉上諭
steles.note: ⚠ NAME-COLLISION WARNING, documented. The gazetteer at lb 0025a06-07 lists 「御製臣僧超方語錄序」 and 「御製臣僧超方塔銘」 immediately before the 性音 edict — and it is TEMPTING to read 超方 as 性音's name and claim an imperial 塔銘 for him. It is NOT his. 「獨超方」 is a SEPARATE Li'an abbot (the 10th, 諱超方 字獨超, 常州武進 沈姓, teacher 天笠和尚), whose own biography (lb 0243a08ff) gives his death as 庚寅 (1710), aged 68 — while Yongzheng was still Prince Yong (世宗憲皇帝在藩邸時御撰塔銘). Yongzheng's 塔銘 is for THAT man, not for 性音. I therefore claim only the imperial語錄序 for 性音 and explicitly do NOT credit him the 塔銘. Grade held at B (gazetteer/imperial-edict level), not A.

teacher.quote: 傳及天竺夢菴，宗風大暢，凡十方名山無不知有理安寺云。夢菴奉雍親王命來主柏林方丈；迦陵音和尚嗣之，道行精卓，極見優禮。
teacher.note: 迦陵音和尚嗣之 [夢菴] — 'the monk Jialing[-yin] succeeded him [Meng'an]'. 嗣 is a transmission verb. Confirms teacher 夢菴超格. Meng'an's own dharma name 超格 is confirmed at lb 0246a05 (夢菴禪師，名超格，號夢菴).

teacher.quote: 字迦陵，別號吹餘，為夢菴超格禪師（1639-1708）之法嗣… 圓具後，參理安寺之夢菴和尚而得付法。
teacher.note: Corroborates: 得付法 from Meng'an. Birth 1671, death 1726.

teacher.quote: 字迦陵，別號吹餘，為夢菴超格禪師（1639-1708）之法嗣… 圓具後，參理安寺之夢菴和尚而得付法。
teacher.note: Roster teacher CONFIRMED (roster's 'Meng'an Chaoge' = 夢菴超格). His TONSURE teacher was 毗盧真一 — association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 「雍正四年七月二十九日逝，世壽五十有六。」（《廬山志》卷 9）

notes: Chan teacher of the Yongzheng Emperor before his enthronement. Died on Mount Lu; the emperor issued a special edict honoring his death.
Transmission link in the Pyeonyang lineage. The 71st Korean patriarch. No independent biographical sources survive. Known only from Joseon-era lineage charts.

bio: Styled Zipu, called Hengchuan, of the Lin clan of Yongjia; his uncle was a Chan monk named Zhengze, who shaved him at fifteen. He went first to Shitian at Lingyin and stayed on when Chijue arrived, but nothing broke. Then he heard that Tianmu Wenli was at Taibai and went to him; Wenli raised 'the bamboo shoots of the southern hills, the cuttlefish of the eastern sea,' and when Rugong tried to answer, struck him — and he had his opening. He served Wenli, and was head seat at Jingci. He came out at Lingyan in Yandang, moved to Nengren, and in 1273 was given Guangli at Ayuwang by imperial order. He prepared his own grave beside the monastery and wrote his own inscription for it. He died on the eighteenth of the third month, 1289, aged sixty-eight. Gulin Qingmao and Zhuyuan Miaodao were his heirs.

steles.title: 橫川和尚塔記
steles.author: 圓至 (天隱牧潛圓至) — in 牧潛集 卷三
steles.author_note: cited by DILA for both his birth and death dates
steles.quote: 嘉定壬午 (birth) … 至元二十六年三月十八日示寂，年六十八 (death)
steles.note: Attested and quoted by DILA, but the 牧潛集 is not in the corpus on disk.

steles.title: his own 銘 for his grave
steles.author: 橫川如珙 himself
steles.quote: 師為藏穴寺側曰此庵乃自為銘云病叟今年六十六死日將至火化奸土化好…銘曰天生一穴藏吾枯骨骨朽成土土能生物
steles.note: He dug his own grave beside the monastery and wrote his own epitaph — 'the sick old man is sixty-six this year, the day is coming' — two years before he died. First-person, at his own tomb.

teacher.quote: …不似臨濟道：我在先師處喫六十拄杖，猶蒿枝拂相似，爇向寶爐，供養前住慶元府太白名山天童景德禪寺楊岐第九世天目大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His own 語錄. 天目大和尚 + 天童 seat + explicit 楊岐第九世 = 天目文禮 (1167-1250). He even glosses the relation with the Linji topos of being beaten by his 先師.

teacher.source: B/B16/B16n0088.xml (古今圖書集成選輯, quoting 增集續傳燈錄)
teacher.quote: 聞天目居太白往投以疑目舉南山筀笋東海烏蠈師擬對目打之師忽有省遂留執侍
天目文禮（1167-1250）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十一世。
teacher.note: DILA also lists 正則 — his uncle, who tonsured him. Not the transmitter.

teacher.quote: 第五十三代橫川珙禪師：永嘉林氏子，嗣滅翁禮公。三月十八日忌。
teacher.note: THE ROSTER IS WRONG TWICE OVER. (1) THE NAME: the roster calls him 橫川行珩 — that man does not exist in the corpus (zero hits for 橫川行珩 or 橫川珩). The man is 橫川行珙, whose 語錄 is X71n1411. (2) THE TEACHER: the roster says Wuzhun Shifan 無準師範; the Jingshan abbot-list says 嗣滅翁禮公 — Miweng Wenli.

teacher.quote: 橫川行珙禪師語錄二卷 元行珙說，本光等編，前有自序。南嶽下第二十世，嗣滅翁禮。
teacher.note: Independent agreement: 嗣滅翁禮. The SAME catalogue entry, two lines down (lb 0583a06), reads 「古林清茂禪師語錄五卷… 南嶽下第二十一世，嗣橫川珙」 — confirming that this is indeed the man the roster MEANT, since the roster's own note names Gulin Qingmao as his student.

teacher.quote: 增續傳燈滅翁禮禪師章云：時松源唱道饒之薦福，師往參焉，蒙印可。
teacher.note: Places the teacher: Miweng Wenli was himself sealed by Songyuan Chongyue. So the true line is 松源崇嶽 > 滅翁文禮 > 橫川行珙 > 古林清茂 — NOT through Wuzhun Shifan at all.

dates.source: 〈橫川和尚塔記〉 (牧潛集 卷三, via DILA A007633)
dates.quote: 嘉定壬午 / 至元二十六年三月十八日示寂，年六十八
birth 嘉定十五年 (1222); death +1289-04-16

links.confirms: teacher (天目文禮), dates, 塔記, heirs incl. 古林清茂

bio: Of the Xu clan of Xujiang in Quzhou; the master of Ehu in Xinzhou. He was the first master of Mazu's Hongzhou house to teach in the Tang capital. Dates 746-818.

steles.title: 興福寺內道場供奉大德大義禪師碑銘
steles.author: 韋處厚 (Wei Chuhou, 773–828), chief minister
steles.quote: 洛者曰會，得總持之印，獨曜瑩珠，習徒迷真，橘枳變體，竟成《檀經》傳宗，優劣詳矣
steles.note: ★ FAMOUS PASSAGE, and worth having on file: Wei Chuhou says Shenhui's 洛 followers 'lost the real, changed from orange to bitter-orange, and ended by making the PLATFORM SUTRA into their lineage-charter (竟成《檀經》傳宗)'. This is the earliest external notice of the 壇經 being used as a transmission certificate, by a sitting chief minister who was hostile to the practice.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0715, 興福寺內道場供奉大德大義禪師碑銘, by 韋處厚 (Wei Chuhou)
teacher.quote: 依本郡潛靈寺僧惠績，二十受具戒。若律若禪，無不通貫。後謁道一於江西。時趨者川奔，學者市聚，一扣秘賾，廓然懸解
teacher.note: ⚠ VERB HONESTY: the stele says 謁 ('called on'), which is on the non-transmission list. But the awakening is placed under Daoyi (一扣秘賾，廓然懸解 — 'one knock at the secret depth and he was thoroughly, suspendedly released'), and the stele's own opening explicitly enrolls him in Daoyi's party. 惠績 is his ORDINATION master (受具戒), not his dharma-father — the stele distinguishes them cleanly.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0715, same stele, opening
teacher.quote: 自此脈散絲分，或遁秦，或居洛，或之吳，或在楚。秦者曰秀，以方便顯，普寂其允也。洛者曰會…吳者曰融，以牛頭聞，徑山其裔也。楚者曰道一，以大乘攝，大師其黨也
teacher.note: The stele maps the four branches after Huineng and places Dayi in Daoyi's: 「楚者曰道一…大師其黨也」 — 'the one in Chu was Daoyi… and the Master was of his company.' It ALSO independently attests 神秀→普寂 and the Oxhead branch of 法融 with 徑山 as its scion.

teacher.quote: sect: 洪州宗
teacher.note: WEAK. DILA files him in Mazu's Hongzhou school, which entails Mazu or one of Mazu's heirs — but the record does NOT name his teacher in so many words, and my corpus sweep turned up only two stele-context windows and six teacher-signal windows for him, none of which states the succession outright. The roster's Mazu is CONSISTENT with the school tag and with the standard accounts, but I could not put my hand on a sentence that says it. Treat as probable, not proven.

dates.quote: 卒於：唐, 憲宗, 元和, 十三年，73歲
dates.note: 746-818, aged 73. DILA cites 疑年錄:142 and the Wikisource text of 〈興福寺內道場供奉大德大義禪師碑銘〉.

notes: First Hongzhou school master to teach in the Tang capital Chang'an. Won an imperial debate in 796 at the Linde Hall, expelling Northern Chan rivals and opening the capital to the southern school. Taught Emperors Dezong and Shunzong. Author of the Zuochan ming (Inscription on Sitting Meditation). Born in Quzhou (Zhejiang), surname Xu, reportedly of Korean ancestry. Posthumous title: Huijue Dashi.

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Yao clan of Cixi, Siming — a leading family. He worked at Confucian studies from nine and was writing well at thirteen. At eighteen an illness taught him the body is a cangue, and he began testing himself against Dahui's recorded sayings; the phrase about Mt. Sumeru gave him his first opening. He then went round Yunmen, Zhenji, Longmen, Li'an and Yufeng as a LAYMAN, and at Jinsu took a beating from Miyun Yuanwu, who named him Sheng. Only in 1644, when the dynasty fell and his mother died, did he shave his head; he then climbed Jingshan to Feiyin Tongrong, who 'undid the jewel in his topknot and gave it to him.' He was installed at Xianjing (1655), Housheng at Hou-shan (1657), and finally at West Lake. He died at the hour of wei on the 6th of the 5th month of 1668, aged 70, with 24 years in robes; his disciples built his stupa on the north face of Leifeng. Four dharma heirs and one nun.

steles.title: 西湖虛舟省和尚塔銘
steles.author: 史大成
steles.author_note: 賜進士及第中大夫內閣學士兼禮部侍郎經筵講官同里法弟 — Shi Dacheng, the zhuangyuan (first-place jinshi) of 1655, Grand Secretary and Vice-Minister of Rites, who calls himself a fellow-townsman and dharma-younger-brother.
steles.quote: 師諱行省，字虛舟，四明慈水姚氏子…生於萬曆己亥臘月廿二之亥時…獨參金栗得領痛棒，遂命名曰省…遂毅然脫白於乳峰之前，爰頂一笠，再登雙徑，電掣星馳，箭鋒相拄，而徑山直解髻珠與之矣。甫印心…初世壽七十，僧臘二十有四，弟子建塔於雷峰之陰。
steles.note: A superb inscription. Shi Dacheng explains why he was asked: 'my house is near Tiantong, and the master trained at Jinsu — I saw it truly and believe it firmly.' It also records that his STYLE-NAME 虛舟 was a gift from POSHAN HAIMING (「字虛舟則破山和尚契機而贈之者」) — a name, NOT a transmission. The transmission is Jingshan's, i.e. Feiyin Tongrong's. A textbook association-vs-transmission trap, defused by the stele itself.

teacher.quote: 再登雙徑…而徑山直解髻珠與之矣。甫印心。
teacher.note: Batch teacher Feiyin Tongrong CONFIRMED — 徑山 (Jingshan) is Feiyin's seat, and the sealing is his. The stele's closing verse repeats it: 「雪竇鏟草，破山與字。徑山一枝，天童斷臂」 — Poshan gave the NAME; Jingshan gave the BRANCH.

teacher.quote: 字虛舟，為費隱通容禪師（1593-1661）法嗣… 後覲費隱和尚，改名行省。甲午年（1654）於寓雲超果受記莂。

dates.quote: 生於萬曆己亥臘月廿二之亥時… 為康熙戊申五月六日之未時，師辭眾書偈，奄然歸寂… 世壽七十。
dates.note: Both dates from the stupa inscription. DILA renders them 1600-02-06 and 1668-06-14.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.note: His 語錄 (J33nB282) carries BOTH a 塔銘 and a 〈虛舟和尚行狀〉 (lb 0392c11).

links.label: DILA Authority A000411
links.confirms: dates (from the stele), teacher, the seats he held

bio: A NUN. Chief disciple of the nun-master Qiyuan Xinggang at the Fushi (Crouching Lion) convent in Jiaxing, and named among her dharma heirs in the account of her death. Qiyuan was a Jiaxing woman of the Hu clan, widowed young, who kept her chastity, left her household for the dharma, and drew a following 'like clouds'; both women left recorded sayings. Yikui Chaochen succeeded her at Fushi — a nun-to-nun transmission, which is what makes her worth the chart.

teacher.kind: death account / 行狀 in the TEACHER's own 語錄
teacher.quote: 遺命塔全身於伏獅院之右。世壽五十有八，法臘二十有三。嗣法門人：普聞授遠、怡然超宿、義川超朗、義公超珂、一音超見、古鼎超振、一揆超琛。
teacher.note: The narrative of Qiyuan Xinggang's death — her last words, the hour, the burial at Fushi — closes by naming her seven dharma heirs, and 一揆超琛 is the last of them. This is the death-record naming the successor: the strongest kind of attestation short of the woman's own incense. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 按嘉興府志：祇園行剛，嘉興胡氏女，早寡守節，棄家學佛，住伏獅禪院，從者如雲，有一夔超琛為其高足，皆有語錄行世。
teacher.note: INDEPENDENT, and from a SECULAR source — the Jiaxing prefectural gazetteer — which calls her Qiyuan's 高足, her chief disciple. Note the gazetteer writes her name 一夔超琛 (夔 for 揆); record both forms.

dates.kind: 行實 (自敘 by heir 普明)
dates.quote: 師距生于天啟乙丑六月一日辰時，世壽五十五，僧臘三十一…康熙己未
dates.note: 天啟乙丑=1625, 康熙己未=1679; own 語錄 行實.

dates.quote: 天啟乙丑六月一日辰時 … 康熙己未七月初四日辰時，世壽五十五
dates.note: matches to the day. Roster variant 一夔超琛 is the same nun (嘉興府志 高足)

school.note: Her recorded sayings are J39nB436, per the batch.

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Liu clan of Lianjiang, Fuzhou. At thirteen he took instruction from Yuexi; later he went to Huyan Jingfu at Lingyin, who gave him the dog-and-buddha-nature word to work on. In time he presented a verse and Huyan nodded, made him incense-attendant and then keeper of the canon, and his name spread. He taught at Biyun in Changzhou (1295), Dianshan in Songjiang, Nanchan in Tongzhou, Heshan in Huzhou (1322), Daochang (1329), and in 1333 took the abbacy of Ayuwang in Siming as its 58th master. The imperial preceptor gave him a gold-bordered robe and the title Buddha-Mind Universal Mirror. In the Zhizheng era he was ordered to hold the great Water-and-Land rite at Jinshan and to ascend the seat. In old age he lived in a hermitage he called Pine-and-Moon, and styled himself the Old Man of Pine and Moon. He wrote his verse and went; the relics from his cremation were past counting.

teacher.quote: 拈香云：爇向爐中，供養我見住徑山興聖萬壽禪寺佛慧定智禪師虎巖大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His OWN dharma-milk stick — 用酬法乳之恩 — to 虎巖 (淨伏). A-grade. The tonsure master 月溪 is honoured separately (落髮先師月溪和尚), not with the dharma-milk stick.

teacher.quote: 月江正印禪師語錄三卷 元正印說…南嶽下第二十二世，嗣虎巖伏。
teacher.note: corroborates transmission line

teacher.quote: 第五十八代月江印禪師：慈谿劉氏子，嗣虎岩伏公。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, with his native place and lay surname. (This abbot-list is the same one that corrected 橫川行珙 above.)

teacher.quote: 月江正印禪師語錄三卷 元正印說… 南嶽下第二十二世，嗣虎巖伏。
teacher.note: Independent agreement.

teacher.quote: 四明育王月江正印禪師，虎巖淨伏禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十三世。年十三禮月溪受業，後參虎巖於靈隱。
teacher.note: Third. Note his RECEIVING teacher 月溪 — association, not transmission.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A009687
links.confirms: teacher, the seats he held, the imperial title

bio: Caodong master, dharma heir of Mianshi Jingyun of Huguo monastery on Mt. Tiantai — himself an heir of Ruibai Mingxue. He had earlier sat with Miyun Yuanwu at Tiantong and with Ermi at Dongshan. One night, sparring with Ermi, the master called for his attendant, who fumbled the lamp and put it out. 'And the fire?' snapped Ermi. 'It's right here,' said the attendant — and Zhijing suddenly saw the point. He held Jiezhu monastery at Jishan, Yuzhi hermitage at Wujiang, and Luohan monastery at Lichuan. His recorded sayings run to six fascicles.

teacher.quote: 為天台護國眠石淨蘊禪師法嗣。曾參天童密雲禪師（1567-1642）及東山爾密禪師（1590-1642）。
teacher.note: NAMES THE TEACHER THE BATCH COULD NOT. The batch had only the sobriquet 嘯雲 ('Xiaoyun of Huguo, Mt. Tiantai') and left the edge dangling. DILA gives the dharma name: 眠石淨蘊, of Huguo on Mt. Tiantai — the same monastery, the same seat.

teacher.quote: 瑞白雪嗣：天台護國眠石淨蘊禪師。天台護國眠石淨蘊禪師，舒州懷寧潘氏子。
teacher.note: Places 眠石淨蘊 exactly: heir of Ruibai Mingxue (瑞白明雪), seated at Huguo on Tiantai. This makes Yingning Zhijing the dharma-GRANDSON of Ruibai Mingxue, which is precisely what the batch note independently asserted — the two accounts converge.

teacher.kind: preface to 瑞白's 語錄
teacher.quote: 崇禎乙亥秋，囑嘯雲和尚主天台護國席。
teacher.note: THE BRIDGE, and the one soft joint. In 1635 Ruibai Mingxue appointed 嘯雲 — the sobriquet in Yingning's own record — to the seat of Huguo on Tiantai. 眠石淨蘊 is ALSO Ruibai's heir AND at Huguo on Tiantai. So 嘯雲 and 眠石淨蘊 are almost certainly one man under two sobriquets. I have NOT found a source that states the identity in one sentence, so: the teacher is recorded as 眠石淨蘊 on DILA's authority, and the 嘯雲 = 眠石淨蘊 identification is flagged as a strong inference, not a quoted fact.

school.quote: 為天台護國眠石淨蘊禪師法嗣
school.note: Caodong via 瑞白明雪 (whose DILA record A007133 gives sect: 曹洞宗).

links.label: DILA Authority A019266
links.confirms: teacher = 眠石淨蘊, the awakening under Ermi, the seats he held

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Li clan of Luzhou; his mother was a Zhao. He was born at noon on the 10th of the 6th month of 1598 — the night before, his father saw the room fill with sunlight. His father died when he was one. At seven, seeing a shadow move at the window, he was seized with the question of where a man's shadow goes when he dies, and brooded for a fortnight until his mother scolded him for going soft in the head. He left home at fifteen, went the round of the lecture-halls at twenty-five, and at thirty-five came to Poshan Haiming at Shuanggui — 'I am gnawed by birth and death; instruct me.' Poshan: 'You are a lecturer. The sutras are full of expedients — do you need mine?' He worked seven months, went blind from sleeplessness, was told by Xiangya to go to bed, and woke at the sound of the wooden board with a boulder rolled off him. He served Poshan ten years as prior before being sealed, and held Yunfeng at Fangshan, Panlong at Jiang'an and Kaiyuan at Nanxi. Died 1669, aged 72, with 37 years in robes; six dharma heirs.

steles.title: 行實 (in 雲峰體宗寧禪師語錄)
steles.author: 體宗道寧 himself, taken down by the assembly
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON. The community came into the abbot's room and asked him for his life; he refused ('my nature was dull and I went about the work wrongly — I would only mislead those who come after'), and they pressed him until he told it.
steles.quote: 我係瀘州，父姓李，母趙，於戊戌年六月初十日午時生，先夜見日光照室…十五歲，白母出家，二十五歲遊歷講肆，三十五參雙桂老人，乃問：「學人痛念生死，乞師開示。」
steles.note: His own words, giving his own birth hour. 雙桂老人 = Poshan Haiming, abbot of Shuanggui. First-person attestation of the teacher.

teacher.quote: 三十五參雙桂老人…苦參七箇月…從此妄想不生…老人劈頭一踏云：「石人腰帶。」
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS. 雙桂 is Poshan Haiming's seat. Batch teacher CONFIRMED at the highest rung there is.

teacher.quote: 為破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣… 年三十五參雙桂和尚，依和尚十載，不離左右，後得付法。
雲峯體宗寧禪師語錄一卷 清 寧說…有行實。南嶽下第三十五世，嗣破山明。

dates.quote: 於戊戌年六月初十日午時生
dates.note: Birth 1598 in his own words. Death 1669 (康熙八年), aged 72, per DILA citing 錦江禪燈 卷9.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A019617
links.confirms: dates, teacher Poshan Haiming, the six heirs

names: 佛海普印廣慈圓悟大禪師
bio: Of the Huang clan of Duchang, Nankang (Jiangxi), born on the first of the 10th month of 1275. At nine he wanted to leave home and his mother refused; he went days without eating until the relatives talked her round, and he was placed with Yushan Zhen at Yunju — his master for life. Tonsured at eleven or twelve and fully ordained, he travelled: two summers at Jiangshan, then Tianxi, where he heard the Lotus expounded and grasped it at once, and the lecturer called him 'a man come back'. In Wu he met Tieshan Qiong and Mengshan Deyi; Mengshan asked where he was from, then 'did you come by boat or by land?' — 'Neither road,' he said. Mengshan spread both hands; he stared straight at him — and they lived together at Xiuxiu hermitage. He later served as prior under Huyan Jingfu at Jingshan, and became abbot of Jiangshan in Nanjing, where the Prince of Liang's dealings with him over the monastery's rebuilding after the fire won him the title Great Chan Master Fohai Puyin Guangci Yuanwu. He died aged 74 (1348), with 56 years in robes; his disciples laid him in the Immovable Stupa at Longpan hermitage, and Jingshan divided the relics to a second stupa below Lingxiao peak.

steles.title: 有元大中大夫佛海普印廣慈圓悟大禪師忠公行業記
steles.author_note: Appended to his own 語錄.
steles.quote: 師諱守忠，字曇芳，以至元乙亥十月一日生南康都昌黃氏。九歲，志求出家，母弗許。親族勸母遂其志，於是從玉山珍禪師于雲居。十二祝髮。
steles.note: The record of deeds. Gives the birth to the day and names the teacher in the same breath.

steles.title: 塔銘 (in 曇芳守忠禪師語錄)
steles.author_note: The writer says the disciples 'brought me a letter and the account of his conduct and asked me to inscribe his stupa; I could not refuse.'
steles.quote: 弟子大琛等奉藏於龍蟠菴之不動塔，逕山大機等又分塔於凌霄峯下。僧臘五十又六，世壽七十又四…禪師名守忠，字曇芳，江西南康都昌之黃金黃氏子也…禮雲居玉山珍禪師為師。
steles.note: THE STUPA INSCRIPTION. Gives the age at death (74) which, with the 1275 birth from the 行業記, fixes the death at 1348. Names the teacher again.

teacher.quote: 禮雲居玉山珍禪師為師。
teacher.note: Batch teacher 玉山珍 CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription.

teacher.kind: 序 by 虞集, 至正六年 (1346)
teacher.quote: 嶽得無得通，通得虗舟度，度得玉山珍。今吾曇芳，則珍之弟子也。
teacher.note: WRITTEN IN HIS LIFETIME, by YU JI (1272-1348), the greatest literatus of the Yuan, two years before Tanfang's death. It hands over the whole line: 松源崇嶽 > 無得通 > 虛舟普度 > 玉山珍 > 曇芳守忠. Signed 「微笑居士蜀郡虞集敘」. This is as good as the evidence gets for a Yuan master.

teacher.quote: 曇芳守忠禪師語錄二卷 元守忠說，繼祖等編，虞集序…附真讚、舍利讚、行業記、塔銘…南嶽下第二十二世，嗣玉山珍。（原作二十世，今依五燈全書及增集續傳燈錄，珍嗣虛舟度）
teacher.note: The catalogue independently confirms both the teacher AND that his 語錄 carries a 行業記 and a 塔銘 — and even corrects its own generation-count.

dates.quote: 以至元乙亥十月一日生 … 僧臘五十又六，世壽七十又四。
dates.note: Birth 1275 (至元乙亥) from the 行業記; age at death 74 from the 塔銘 → died 1348. NEITHER date was in the batch (both null) and DILA has NO record for him at all.

school.quote: 嶽得無得通，通得虗舟度，度得玉山珍。

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Yu clan of Hezhou, Chongqing; his mother was a Xun. Born on the 7th of the 8th month of 1610. At eight his father took him to Taikong at Madangshan in his home county and left him there. In 1635 he left Sichuan, called first on Sheng of Tiantong, and then went to old master Lin of Tongxuan — Linye Tongqi — and 'penetrated the deep principle utterly, and so received the dharma as his true heir.' That same year he made a hut on Huading in Tiantai, and afterwards held Guanghua, Luohan (1648), Ciji (1649), Fahai (1650), Yuelin (1651), Longyuan (1654) and Furong at Jingxi (1656). In the third month of 1661 he sickened; on the 27th of the twelfth he bathed, settled the affairs of the house, wrote instructions for the community charging his monks to forget the body and spread the dharma, then wrote his verse, threw down the brush — 'even this smells of the world' — and died. Thirty-three dharma heirs; aged 53, 34 years in robes.

steles.title: 行狀 (in 自閒覺禪師語錄, 卷8)
steles.author: 超吼
steles.author_note: 獅峰嗣法門人超吼謹狀 — a dharma heir, writing in the first month of Kangxi 1 (1662), weeks after the death.
steles.quote: 師姓余，母荀氏，蜀之重慶合州人也。生萬曆庚戌八月初七日吉時。八歲，隨父禮本邑馬當山太空為受業師。乙亥，出蜀，首謁先天童省法；次參先通玄林老和尚，大徹玄旨，遂得法為嫡嗣焉！…嗣法門人三十三人，壽五十三，臘三十四夏。
steles.note: Written by a disciple within weeks of the death, for the funeral. A second hand (等玉, 1672) adds a note beneath it: 「先師和尚嗣法於先通玄，江南兩浙凡六坐道場，所至惟以钁頭鈯斧煆煉學者，大有百丈之風」 — he taught with mattock and hoe, in Baizhang's manner.

teacher.quote: 次參先通玄林老和尚，大徹玄旨，遂得法為嫡嗣焉！
teacher.note: REFUTES THE BATCH'S OWN CAVEAT. The batch warned: 'teacher attested by the 五燈全書 inline note only — no first-person 法乳 incense survives in his 語錄. Confidence downgraded.' In fact his 語錄 carries a full 行狀 BY A DHARMA HEIR naming 通玄林老和尚 = Linye Tongqi (of Tongxuan monastery), and a second disciple's note repeating it. Confidence should be RAISED, not downgraded. Note also 天童省法, whom he called on FIRST — association, not transmission.

teacher.quote: 為林野通奇禪師（1596-1652）法嗣… 次參通玄林老和尚，大徹玄旨，遂得法。
teacher.note: DILA cites 《自閒覺禪師語錄》卷8〈行狀〉 AND 卷5〈行實〉 — so a 行實 exists too.

dates.quote: 生萬曆庚戌八月初七日吉時 … 壽五十三，臘三十四夏。
dates.note: Birth 1610, death 1662 (辛丑十二月二十七日, which falls in Feb 1662 Gregorian). Both null in the batch.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A016227
links.confirms: dates, teacher Linye Tongqi, the 33 heirs

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Zeng clan of Luzhou. Dharma heir of Erdu Daotai. He held Guanyin cloister at Xianren-shan in Linshui, Taiping monastery on Mt. Wanfeng in Dazhu, Xinglong in Wanxian, and Huiling at Shehong. His recorded sayings run to two fascicles; his heirs were Tianran and Shuiying. He also tonsured Chunbei Guangde, another master in this batch.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at enthronement (幻住明禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 此瓣香，逢強即弱，遇柔則剛，擅予奪之威權、定是非之赤幟，熱向罏中，供養現住夔州府萬縣天圓禪院，傳臨濟正宗三十三世，耳毒大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick. 用酬法乳之恩 — 'to repay the debt of the dharma-milk'. Erdu was then still living (現住) at 天圓禪院 in Wanxian.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香，不從鷲嶺帶來，亦非塵寰拈出，本是五峰頂頭精勤煉出，即今供養現住天圓禪院耳毒本師和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: 本師 — 'my own root teacher'. He separates this stick explicitly from the ones for the ruler and the patrons (「闔國公卿、本郡尊官，高增祿位」), exactly as the brief warns to check.

teacher.kind: own 拈香, two further seats
teacher.quote: 供養現住天圓禪院耳毒大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。／此是第二番拈出，供養天圓禪院耳毒大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: Four independent occurrences, all naming 耳毒 and only 耳毒 with 法乳.

teacher.quote: 幻住明禪師語錄二卷 清明說，清尚等編，法秀序。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耳毒泰。
為耳毒道泰禪師法嗣。瀘州人，俗姓曾。住仙人觀音、萬峰太平、萬縣興隆、射洪會靈等諸剎。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the teacher's dharma name EXPANDED: 耳毒泰 = 耳毒道泰. DILA cites 錦江禪燈 卷14 and 幻住明禪師語錄 卷2〈聯芳偈〉.

teacher.quote: 幻住明禪師語錄二卷 清 明說，清尚等編，法秀序。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耳毒泰。
teacher.note: Independent agreement, and fixes the generation: 37th below Nanyue.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A019619
links.confirms: teacher = 耳毒道泰, the seats he held, his two heirs

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Yang clan of Xingan, Linjiang. Born on the 20th of the 12th month of 1246 (early 1247). A son of a Pure Land household, he sang hymns with his mother as soon as he could speak; he entered Xiangshi cloister at Jianxing monastery at seven and was tonsured at nineteen under a Xianchun edict. He studied first with the monk Zhining, then went to XUEYAN ZUQIN and got the dharma from him, holding the first seat in the Assembled Clouds hall. In 1280 he attended Xueyan to the imperial audience and was given a robe. He held Muping ten years and Huili nineteen; in 1296 he was granted the title Great Chan Master Puzhao, with a gold-bordered kasaya, and Goryeo sent him robes, a gold-lettered sutra and jade. Monks came from Yunnan in the far west to Liao in the east; when the gruel ran short he would pawn things rather than stop teaching. In 1309 the Bureau of Buddhist Affairs installed him at Jianfu in Rao. He died sitting, having bathed, on the 16th of the 6th month of 1312, aged 67, with 48 years in robes.

steles.title: 塔銘 (No. 1398-B, in 海印昭如禪師語錄)
steles.author: 李倜
steles.author_note: 前集賢侍讀學士中大夫兩浙都轉運使河東李倜撰 — Li Ti, former Academician Reader-in-waiting of the Academy of Worthies and Transport Commissioner of the Two Zhe. He knew the man for twenty-six years and says so.
steles.quote: 師楊姓，昭如名，海印其自號。世居臨江之新淦，生宋淳祐丙午十二月二十日…十九歲受咸淳制勑，落髮為僧。始學于沙門智寧，次拜雪巖祖欽，得法在集雲堂第一座。
steles.note: A stupa inscription by a man who opens by saying he first met the master at Mupping in 1287 and that for twenty-six years they saw and heard each other constantly — and who compares the friendship to Han Yu's with Dadian and Su Shi's with Foyin. THIS IS THE EDGE-FIXING DOCUMENT: 次拜雪巖祖欽，得法.

teacher.quote: 始學于沙門智寧，次拜雪巖祖欽，得法在集雲堂第一座。
teacher.note: IDENTITY RESOLVED, EDGE JOINED. The batch gave his teacher as 仰山慧朗 and warned 'Teacher 仰山慧朗 is NOT in the 301-roster, so this edge currently dangles.' IT DOES NOT DANGLE: 仰山慧朗 IS XUEYAN ZUQIN. DILA A004699 lists among Xueyan Zuqin's names 慧朗 (his 字), 慧朗欽, 仰山祖欽, 仰山欽 — he was styled Huilang and held Yangshan from 1269. The stupa inscription names him plainly as 雪巖祖欽. So the edge lands on the existing roster node.

teacher.quote: 號雪巖，為雪巖祖欽禪師（？-1287）法嗣… 游方參雪巖禪師，示以「狗子佛性話」。
祖欽 / 雪巖祖欽 / 慧朗欽 / 慧朗 / 仰山祖欽 / 仰山欽 … 號雪巖，字慧朗，無準師範禪師法嗣。咸淳五年（1269）始主席仰山。
teacher.note: THE PROOF OF IDENTITY: Xueyan Zuqin's own authority record carries 慧朗 and 仰山欽 among his names. 仰山慧朗 = 雪巖祖欽 = the same man.

dates.quote: 生宋淳祐丙午十二月二十日 … 其年六月十六日，沐浴坐逝矣。
dates.note: Born in the 12th month of 淳祐丙午, which falls in early 1247 Gregorian (DILA: 1247-02-04) — so the batch's '1246' is the Chinese-year rendering and 1247 the Gregorian. Died 1312, aged 67.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A004699
links.confirms: PROOF that 仰山慧朗 = 雪巖祖欽 — 慧朗 is his 字

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Wang clan of Xichong, Shunqing (Sichuan). His father, childless in middle age, prayed for two sons — one for the ancestors, one for the Buddha — and got them; his mother dreamed of a monk in a patched robe asking a night's lodging, and on the day of the birth three old monks came to the house and said, 'Your noble son is born just as the sun rises in the east — call him Hongxian (Rising Splendour).' Sent at eight to Shoufan at Guifeng cloister, he would only sit cross-legged and would not study, and people called him 'the daft monk'. He set out at sixteen, buried his teacher and then his mother, and went the whole round: Cao'an Wutai at Tongchuan, Hanpu, full ordination at Minzhong monastery in Shenyang (1650), then Ruo'an at Jiashan, Qi at Xuedou, Lin at Bao'en. Under Jue at Lingyin, working on 'hidden deep in the valley, unashamed before the order of monks', on the third day at midnight he suddenly heard music from Feilai Peak — and the whole knot in his chest fell away. He then went to Jiahe, met Zixian Jue, and received the entrustment. He held Guangsheng at Mt. Huo, the Lion, Prince and Lingyan cloisters at Fenyang, Qianming at Linfen and Puji at Daxie.

steles.title: 行實 (in 憨予暹禪師語錄, 卷6)
steles.author: 憨予洪暹 himself, taken down by the assembly
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON. At the Lion cloister in Fenyang the prior, the rector, the sub-prior and the guest-master came in with incense and asked him to tell his life. He refused twice — 'the four elements are not real, the five aggregates are empty: what tracks are there to record?' — and gave in only when they would not stop.
steles.quote: 吾蜀之順慶西充王氏也，父某，母楊氏。余童年時，先父常對余曰：「我中年缺嗣，求禱於佛，願得二子，一以祀先，一以侍佛。」後果如禱。一夕，先母夢蒲衲僧投宿而娠，生之日，有三老比丘至家，語先父曰：「聞君已生貴子，正值日光東昇，可名洪暹。」
steles.note: His own words. The whole life, told under protest — one of the fullest first-person accounts in this batch.

teacher.quote: 為自閒行覺禪師（1610-1662）法嗣… 謁靈隱覺和尚，參「深藏巖谷免玷僧倫」，至第三日中夜，忽聞飛來峰作樂聲，釋然頓脫胸中疑慮。後過嘉禾參禮自閒覺禪師，受付囑。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. DILA cites his own 〈行實〉 (J33nB288 卷6).

CROSS-CHECK FROM THE OTHER SIDE: DILA's record of 自閒行覺 (A016227) lists his heirs as 「慈朗鷲、漢關喻、天目智、憨予暹等三十三位禪師」 — 憨予暹 is named among the 33 heirs in the teacher's own record. The edge is attested from both ends.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A019267
links.confirms: teacher, the seats he held, his own 行實

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Li clan of Fengdu in eastern Shu. Orphaned of both parents at six. Tonsured in middle life under Huanzhu Ming, he took full ordination under Erdu Daotai and inherited his dharma. He carried the line into Chu (Hubei), where he founded and rebuilt: Yuexia cloister at Huangling in Yiling (1665), and Dabei monastery on Mt. Foxing at Zigui. His stele says those who came to take refuge with him were 'not fewer than 1,250' — the number of the Buddha's own assembly. His heirs were Yuechuang Zhishen, Fachuang Zhiyuan and Juechuang Zhihong.

steles.title: 塔銘 (in 純備德禪師語錄, 卷2)
steles.author: 陳之夔
steles.author_note: 古峽城髮弟子陳之夔頓首拜撰 — a tonsured lay disciple of Guxia city. He notes that he makes a rule of refusing to flatter the dead ('予素守諛墓之戒'), and wrote only because the heir Fachuang pressed him with 'the earnestness of a filial son'.
steles.quote: 按老和尚，字純備，諱廣德，傳臨濟下第三十三世嫡孫…蓋古渝豐都李氏裔。甫六齡，而怙恃兩遭失所…及身許法王，慨然以祖道為己任。續燈受耳毒和尚，擔荷重法。
steles.note: THE STUPA INSCRIPTION NAMES THE TEACHER: 「續燈受耳毒和尚」 — he took up the lamp from Erdu. It closes by placing him in Poshan's line: 「寧僅衍雙桂宗派乎」 (Shuanggui = Poshan Haiming's seat). His own 辭世偈 stands immediately above.

teacher.quote: 續燈受耳毒和尚，擔荷重法。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription.

teacher.quote: 為耳毒道泰禪師法嗣。蜀東鄷都人，俗姓李。中年於幻住和尚處剃染，詣耳毒和尚座下圓具而嗣法。
teacher.note: AND IT SETTLES THE TONSURE-VS-TRANSMISSION QUESTION EXPLICITLY: tonsured by 幻住明 (also in this batch), but the dharma is 耳毒道泰's. A clean example of the distinction the audit says the old roster kept getting wrong.

teacher.quote: 純備德禪師語錄二卷 清廣德說，智遠等編，道隆序，有塔銘。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耳毒泰。
續燈受耳毒和尚
teacher.note: DILA cites this at J38nB433_p1003c05. CONFIRMS bio_5's 耳毒泰 — and supplies the dharma name: 道泰 (耳毒道泰).

teacher.kind: authority record citing 錦江禪燈 卷14
teacher.quote: 為耳毒道泰禪師法嗣…詣耳毒和尚座下圓具而嗣法。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: No dates in any source.

school.quote: 傳臨濟下第三十三世嫡孫

school.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's Linji. bio_5 reconstructed the route as 耳毒泰 → 敏樹如相 → 破山明; DILA independently places him in Linji Yangqi, consistent with Poshan's western branch.

bio.kind: authority record citing 錦江禪燈 + his 語錄 卷2〈聯芳〉
bio.quote: 蜀東鄷都人，俗姓李。中年於幻住和尚處剃染…後住彝陵黃陵、佛興大悲。

links.label: DILA Authority A019620
links.confirms: teacher (and the tonsure/transmission distinction), the seats he founded

links.label: DILA Authority A019620
links.confirms: dharma name 廣德, teacher 道泰, school, bio

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派 (破菴 line)
bio: Of the Ge clan of Ninghai, Taizhou. He went to Wuzhun Shifan and got the point. He held Xingsheng at Liuhong in Jiaxing, Nengren at Mt. Yan in Wenzhou, Huiyun at Jiuyan in Yue, Guang'en at Huguo on Tiantai, Yanfu at Chong'en in Lin'an, and Longxiang at Jiangxin in Wenzhou. In 1272 he took Xuefeng, held it ten years, then resigned and retired to Baoshou monastery in Hangzhou. He died in 1290, aged 85. His disciple Miao'en gathered his essentials into the Jue'an Kexiang chanshi yulu.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 at his first enthronement (Xingsheng, 1253)
teacher.quote: 陞座，拈香祝聖罷，次拈香云：文武火中拈得，貞實獨存；天星湖上揭開，臭氣難掩。奉為前住徑山佛鑑禪師無準大[和]尚□□□□□□□
teacher.note: The block is damaged in the 卍續 witness; CBETA's own 校注 at lb 1004b04 restores the lacuna as 「疑用酬法乳之恩」 — i.e. the dharma-milk formula. The second stick (after the emperor) goes to 無準師範, whose title was 佛鑑禪師 and who was 前住徑山.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 on his teacher's death-anniversary
teacher.quote: 佛鑑忌，拈香云：仰天灣下，喝石嶺頭。昔年落賺，覆水難収。當堂稱父子，背面是冤𬽦。
teacher.note: 「當堂稱父子」 — 'in the hall we are called father and son.' He keeps 無準's memorial day. Decisive.

teacher.kind: temple gazetteer 天童寺志, reading the stone
teacher.quote: 絕岸可湘禪師。舊志缺，今補。師名見於別山智禪師塔銘，碑鐫「住持沙門可湘立石」。考世譜，師與智公同門，相繼住持者六人，蓋嗣法無準範。
teacher.note: The compiler read the actual stele of 別山祖智 and found 可湘 named on it as the abbot who erected it. NOTE: he calls the 無準 filiation an inference from the 世譜 (「蓋」) — but the first-person incense above settles it independently.

teacher.kind: 古今圖書集成, quoting 繼燈錄
teacher.quote: 按繼燈錄：福州雪峰絕岸可湘禪師，台州寧海葛氏子。叅無準範得旨。咸淳八年主雪峰，凡十年，謝院事退居。
teacher.note: 得旨 = transmission verb.

teacher.quote: 臨濟宗楊岐派破菴派僧，無準師範之法嗣… 參無準師範得旨。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. DILA cites 繼燈錄 卷3 and 增集續傳燈錄 卷1/4.

dates.quote: 咸淳八年（1272）主雪峰，凡十年謝事，至元二十七年（1290）示寂，壽八十五。
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED: 1206-1290 (the batch had null/null).

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A003948
links.confirms: dates, teacher Wuzhun Shifan, the seats he held

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Mao clan of Jiangjin, Chongqing; his mother was a Tao, who conceived after dreaming a monk gave her a peach to eat, and they called him Yingseng ('answering the monk'). Born at the hour of wei on the 20th of the 7th month of 1614. At sixteen the Diamond Sutra raised his doubt; he went with his mother to Baoding and a monk told him he was too young — go recite the Buddha's name. He read on, dreamed strangely, and the doubt ate into him: 'Far from all inverted dream-thinking — then where does THIS dream come from?' He was tonsured after an illness, went to Poxue at Chongqing, then to Guiyuan, who set him on 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one — where does the one return to?' Three years he was wood and stone, walking without knowing he walked. At the fourth watch one night mind and object both fell away. He came to Zhangxue Tongzui in the winter of 1649 and was sealed. In 1653 he opened Shibao cloister in Yunnan, and later Jingyin, Nanming, Longquan and Yuquan in Guizhou. The Yongli emperor of the Southern Ming sought his teaching, asked him for a verse, gave him the dharma name Zhenfo ('True Buddha') and a robe. He died on the 22nd of the last month of winter, 1666/7, aged 53, with 37 years in robes.

steles.title: 行實 (in 月幢了禪師語錄, 卷2)
steles.author: 月幢徹了 himself, taken down by the assembly
steles.author_note: FIRST-PERSON. In spring 1654 at Anlong the community came into his room, bowed, and asked for his life-story; the monk Gudeng said, 'People wonder whether the master was a duke or a minister — give us your record and settle it.'
steles.quote: 師云：「余生寒微家，更無異跡，乃蜀重慶江津毛氏子。母姓陶，因夢僧送桃令噉，感而有娠，於甲寅七月廿日未時生，乳名應僧，寄名於寶山師。」
steles.note: His own words, giving his own birth hour — and opening by flatly denying the rumour that he was born noble: 'I come from a poor house; there is nothing remarkable in it.'

teacher.quote: 為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣… 己丑臘（1650）參丈雪和尚，得印可。癸巳冬（1653）開法於滇南石寶禪院。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. DILA cites 錦江禪燈 卷12, 月幢了禪師語錄 卷2〈行實〉, 黔南會燈錄.
His own 行實 narrates the whole search — 破雪, 歸源, 靈筏, 象崖 — before Zhangxue. Those earlier masters are association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 於甲寅七月廿日未時生
dates.note: BIRTH RECOVERED IN HIS OWN WORDS: 甲寅 = 1614 (DILA: 1614-08-24). DEATH RECOVERED: 康熙丙午季冬廿二日 = 1667-01-16 (DILA, citing 黔南會燈錄 卷3), aged 53. The batch had floruit 1660 / death null — BOTH are now fixed.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A016401
links.confirms: dates, teacher Zhangxue Tongzui, the Yongli emperor, the name 真佛

bio: Dharma heir of Jie'an Wujin at Jinming monastery in Jiaxing, and abbot of Santa (Three Pagodas) in the same prefecture. Of Huizhou, a descendant of the Duke of Mu, and a serving officer before he took the robe. He died in 1669. Only the first character of his dharma name, 法, survives.

teacher.quote: 金明進禪師法嗣：栢山素弘真理禪師、萬年夢堂真倪禪師、安化世高本則禪師、金明東巖璨禪師、玅峰素頴鑒禪師、三角古壁文禪師、三墖主峯法禪師、金明晦巖炯禪師…
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. 金明進 = 介菴悟進 of Jinming monastery (the same index at lb 0910b11 lists him under 普明用禪師法嗣 as 「金明介菴悟進禪師」). 三墖主峯法 = 三塔主峰法 stands among his heirs.

teacher.kind: poem title in a contemporary's 語錄
teacher.quote: 贈主峰法姪：龍淵新法席，雲衲越尋常…蠡水家聲振，滹沱血脈長。
teacher.note: CORROBORATION FROM A LIVING CONTEMPORARY: a master addresses him as 法姪 — DHARMA-NEPHEW — i.e. the heir of his own dharma-brother. Exactly consistent with his being 介菴悟進's heir. The closing line ('the bloodline of the Hutuo runs long') is Linji lineage language. The same collection (J29nB233 lb 0350b25) carries a 真讚 written at his request.

school.note: Via 介菴悟進 < 普明鴛湖妙用 < 徑山廣 — Linji.

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Lu clan of Hengxi, Yinxian; born on the 10th of the 6th month of 1201. He was tonsured and ordained under Beihai Xin at Daochang-shan in Zha. He first went to Wuzhun Shifan at Ayuwang, who made him keeper of the inner records — he would not take it, and left to follow Shitian at Jingci. He then studied under BEIJIAN JUJIAN at Jingci and got the point, and was put in charge of the writings. He held Faxiang in Hangzhou, Xianci, Xiangtian Xingjiao, Zhimen, Jiaozhong Baoguo, and in 1263 became the 46th abbot of Ayuwang in Mingzhou. He died on the 17th of the 6th month of 1268, aged 68. A noted literary monk of the late Southern Song; his 物初賸語 runs to 25 fascicles. His dharma heir was Huiji Yuanxi — also in this batch.

steles.title: 鄮峯西菴塔銘
steles.author_note: In the 阿育王山志 (Ayuwang mountain gazetteer), 卷8.
steles.path: (阿育王山志 卷8 — not in the Zen corpus on disk)
steles.quote: 嘉泰辛酉（元年）六月初十日 … 咸淳戊辰（四年）六月十七日示寂，壽六十八。
steles.note: A stupa inscription EXISTS and DILA takes BOTH his birth and death from it, quoting it. The gazetteer is not among the 4,990 files on disk, so I quote DILA's citation OF the stele rather than the stele itself — flagged honestly.

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此香爇向爐中，奉為見住淨慈光孝禪寺北磵大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His own 物初大觀禪師語錄. Note the discipline of the stick-order: the PRECEDING stick goes to the 判府安撫大資相公 (the patron-official) — only THIS one carries 用酬法乳之恩. 北磵 = 居簡, then living at 淨慈光孝寺.

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此香別無奇特，却不雷同供養前住臨安府淨慈光孝禪寺先師北磵大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: At a second enthronement 居簡 is now 先師 (deceased) — consistent with 居簡 d.1246 and 大觀 d.1268.

teacher.quote: 北磵居簡禪師（1164-1246）法嗣，大鑑下第十九世… 後參北磵於淨慈悟旨，命典文翰。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. NOTE the trap he avoided: he first went to WUZHUN SHIFAN at Ayuwang, who offered him a post — he declined and went elsewhere. Association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 嘉泰辛酉（元年）六月初十日（《阿育王山志》卷 8〈鄮峯西菴塔銘〉）… 咸淳戊辰（四年）六月十七日示寂，壽六十八
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED from the stele via DILA: 1201-1268 (the batch had null/null).

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A000076
links.confirms: dates (from the 塔銘), teacher Beijian Jujian, the seats he held

bio: A Sichuanese; dharma heir of Zhuanyu Guanheng. He held Baolian monastery on Mt. Yue in Fengxin (1651), Xiaseng monastery on Mt. Longmen in Jing'an (1653), Tong'an monastery on Mt. Fengqi in Jianchang, Nankang — which he opened in the winter of 1662 and which was rebuilt splendidly under him — then Qinghua monastery in the south city of Beijing (1672). In 1674 he lodged at Tianning in Jiaxing to cut the blocks of his teacher's recorded sayings, and in 1676 took Lengyan monastery. Twelve fascicles of his recorded sayings survive, plus two from Lengyan.

teacher.quote: 為顓愚觀衡禪師（1579-1646）法嗣。有《法璽印禪師語錄》十二卷及《楞嚴法璽印禪師語錄》二卷。法嗣有性圓、旋璣、旋哲、旋賢等。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the DHARMA NAME EXPANDED: 法璽印 = 法璽正印, dharma name 正印 (per the coordinator's list, and confirmed here).

teacher.kind: 序 in his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 法乳再傳，有顓愚大師，克紹家風，卓然尊宿。嗣有法老和尚，嵋岫挺生，受佛遺囑，乘願而來…繼臨濟三十一世，望初祖四十一傳。
teacher.note: A preface in his own recorded sayings, by the son of a provincial treasurer of Jiangxi who knew him: the dharma-milk passed down to Zhuanyu, and 'his heir is old master Fa' — born of the Emei ranges, i.e. a Sichuanese. Places him as the 31st generation of Linji. Also records that he travelled between Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Zhachuan and Yangzhou in order to REPRINT Zhuanyu's recorded sayings — which is filial editing on top of a transmission, not instead of one.

teacher.quote: 為顓愚觀衡禪師（1579-1646）法嗣。有《法璽印禪師語錄》十二卷及《楞嚴法璽印禪師語錄》二卷…（《紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄》卷首；《法璽印禪師語錄》卷 1）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's finding. DILA cites the front matter of his MASTER's record and his own 語錄. ⚠ EDITOR SIGNAL PRESENT AND DISCLOSED: he 重編 (re-edited) 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄 - but DILA also cites his own 語錄 卷1 independently, and the harvest note records that his own 語錄 supplies the teacher's name where the lamps had lost it.

teacher.quote: 《錦江禪燈》卷 9
teacher.note: 🔴 THE CORPUS GAP, CONFIRMED: 錦江禪燈 says only 「久依□□和尚而印可焉」 - the teacher's name is a LACUNA in the block - and the 目錄 (X85n1589) files him under 「未詳法嗣」, 'succession unknown'. His own 語錄 is what closes the gap.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。…順治辛卯（1651）住越山寶蓮禪寺…丙辰年（1676）主楞嚴寺
dates.note: DATES GENUINELY UNKNOWN. DILA says so outright. The abbacies 1651-1676 are the only anchor. Left null - I will not invent a floruit.

bio.quote: 四川人。順治辛卯（1651）住越山寶蓮禪寺；癸巳（1653）住龍門山暇僧禪寺；康熙壬寅（1662）住南康府建昌縣鳳棲山同安禪寺；壬子年（1672）住北京南城清化禪寺；甲寅春（1674）寓嘉興天寧寺刻《顓老人語錄》；丙辰年（1676）主楞嚴寺

links.label: DILA Authority A019187
links.confirms: teacher Zhuanyu Guanheng, the seats and their dates, the dharma name 正印

bio: Of the Shi clan of Fuling in eastern Shu. Tonsured as a boy by the elder Jichu, he studied the Mahayana sutras and treatises under the dharma-master Boshui. Having met Xiangya and learned that there was such a thing as this matter, he saw that the words of the teachings were not the last word, and went up to Dongshan at Sinan in Qianzhong to Yingxiu Wu, to knock directly at the Linji doctrine. He vowed not to sleep; sitting in the still of the night, it was as if someone clapped a hand, and the sweat ran off him. Later he challenged the master in the hall — 'Above, no buddhahood to attain; below, no beings to save: whose realm is that? Say it plainly.' Yingxiu: 'Seen from high, not enough; levelled from low, more than enough.' 'A thousand differences,' said Xingjiong, 'and not one outside this.' 'Do not misidentify it.' He shouted. 'And where does THAT shout land?' 'It stands right here in the open.' 'So it is YOU,' said Yingxiu, 'who has said it plainly.' He served as rector under Yingxiu at Longshan in Chenzhou, and Yingxiu handed him the true line of Caoxi. He held Puti at Lizhou, Taihe at Yuanzhou, and finally rebuilt Pufeng in Chenzhou — founded in the Song and ruined by war — bringing it back in under three years. He died in 1668 and was interred to the left of Pufeng.

steles.title: 長明和尚塔銘
steles.author_note: The writer says his dharma heir Fazhu came asking for an inscription 'to serve as a long record', and that he worked from the master's 行實.
steles.quote: 公諱性炅，號長明，蜀東涪陵石氏子也。有嗣法門人法柱求銘於予，以為久長記。予按公行實，幼年禮極初老宿剃落，復從渤水法師習大乘經論…迺上黔中思南東山參穎秀悟和尚，直叩濟北宗旨…悟付曹溪正脈。
steles.note: A full stupa inscription with the encounter dialogue set down in it verbatim, ending in a verse banner. Names the teacher, the seats, and the death.

steles.title: 長明和尚塔銘
steles.author: (in 浦峰長明炅禪師語錄 卷1)
steles.quote: 「康熙丁未歸龍山掃悟和尚塔，……越明年公示微恙，叮嚀訓眾，努力辦道，端坐而逝。」
steles.note: The stupa inscription is the ONLY source for his life and death — DILA takes everything from it. Note the detail: he went back to sweep the stupa of 悟和尚 — his teacher Zhenwu — the year before he died.

teacher.quote: 迺上黔中思南東山參穎秀悟和尚，直叩濟北宗旨… 悟付曹溪正脈。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription — 'Wu handed him the true line of Caoxi.'

teacher.quote: 號長明，為穎秀真悟禪師法嗣。蜀東涪陵人，俗姓石… 參象崖和尚及穎秀和尚，得悟和尚付法。
teacher.note: AND IT EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S NAME: 頴秀悟 = 穎秀真悟, dharma name 真悟. The batch had noted '頴秀悟 is not in the 301-roster, so this edge dangles two generations short of Poshan' — the name is now full, which is what a future pass needs to place him.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香，大爐韝中幾回煆煉，智竭情枯，一朝契證，惡辣手中得來，逢人觸發生燄，今為酉陽龍山虎谿堂上傳臨濟正脈第三十三世穎秀和尚，以酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: 穎秀 — in his own hand, with his master's seat (Longshan, Youyang) and generation number. This is the decisive witness against 正源略集's transposition.

teacher.quote: 號長明，為穎秀真悟禪師法嗣 (as DILA quotes the 塔銘)
辰州浦峰長明炅禪師……(頴秀悟嗣)
TEACHER-> 真悟 [A026271]

dates.quote: 「康熙丁未歸龍山掃悟和尚塔，……越明年公示微恙，叮嚀訓眾，努力辦道，端坐而逝。」（《浦峰長明炅禪師語錄》卷 1〈長明和尚塔銘〉）
dates.note: In 1667 he went back to Longshan to sweep his teacher's stupa; the NEXT year he died — so 1668. Birth unknown.

dates.quote: 康熙丁未…越明年公示微恙…端坐而逝 (i.e. 康熙戊申 = 1668)
death +1668; 康熙戊申年（1668）示寂，塔於浦峰寺之左。

school.note: 濟北 = Linji.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗楊岐派；臨濟正脈第三十三世 (per his own incense)

links.label: DILA Authority A019550
links.confirms: teacher's full name 穎秀真悟, death year, the seats

links.confirms: the teacher's dharma name is 真悟, sobriquet 穎秀

bio: A LAYMAN of Wushang, born on the 8th of the 5th month of 497. He married Liu Miaoguang at sixteen and had two sons, Pujian and Pucheng. At twenty-four the ascetic Songtoutuo woke him up; he built a hut under the twin trees at Songshan, practised austerities seven years, and penetrated the Surangama. In 535 he was commanded to expound the sutra in the Chongyun Hall of Emperor Wu of Liang. As the Liang fell to the Chen and war spread he gathered a great following and had his disciples burn fingers and arms in offering. He wrote the Xinwang ming and the Huanyuan shi. With Baozhi of Jinling he is called one of the Two Great Beings of the Liang. He died on the 24th of the 4th month of 569.

steles.title: 傅大士碑 (the stele-text preserved in 善慧大士錄)
steles.author: 徐陵 Xu Ling (507-583), 奉勅撰
steles.quote: 菩薩戒弟子侍中尚書左僕射領大著作建昌縣開國侯東海徐陵奉　勅撰
steles.note: A contemporary stele. It gives him NO human teacher.

teacher.source: X/X69/X69n1335.xml (善慧大士錄), 徐陵's 碑文
teacher.kind: 碑 (stele, by a contemporary, by imperial command)
teacher.quote: 若如本生．本行或示緣起，子長．子雲自敘元系，則云：補處菩薩仰嗣釋迦法王真子，是號彌勒。…自敘因緣，大宗如此。
teacher.note: The only 'lineage' the stele gives him is a self-declared identity as Maitreya, explicitly flagged as HIS OWN account (自敘). No human master is named anywhere in the inscription. teacher = null is therefore POSITIVELY attested, not merely unfound.

dates.quote: 齊建武四年五月八日生。（T49n2035_p0244b10）… 太建元年四月二十四日示寂。（T49n2035_p0244c16）
dates.note: Both from the 佛祖統紀.

school.note: DILA marks him explicitly as NOT a monk. He is a layman.

links.label: DILA Authority A006833
links.confirms: dates, lay status, the Liang court

bio: A Ming jinshi who refused to serve the Qing and took the robe instead. He was an old acquaintance of Kong Youde, the Qing Prince Dingnan, who — the Xinxu gaoseng zhuan says — thought highly of his integrity and issued the order for a monastery to be built for him on Mount Qi above Hengyang. That was Renrui monastery, which he founded and where he lived out his life; it held over a thousand mu of temple land. He was a Caodong master. His recorded sayings survive only as quotations in others' collections. His heir was Wenmu Nian, who received the dharma from him in 1658.

dates.note: NO DATES. Nothing in DILA, nothing in the corpus. He was active c.1648-1660s; his heir received the dharma from him in 1658 and Kong Youde died in 1652.

school.kind: 頻吉祥禪師語錄 — memorial incense
school.quote: 重陽日為岐山嬾放和尚燒香…嬾法兄今日有件因緣，要與論量。
school.note: Pin Jixiang Zhixiang (智祥, 1637-1709, Caodong, heir of 元潔淨瑩) burns incense for him and calls him 法兄 — DHARMA BROTHER. Both are 智-generation. 淨瑩 is a 淨-generation heir of 瑞白明雪. This places 嬾放智大 in the same Caodong sub-lineage. SUPPORTS bio_5's Caodong.

school.quote: 衡陽岐山仁瑞寺嬾放智大禪師上堂…〔followed by〕五位正偏：正中偏…偏中正…正中來…兼中至
school.note: His own 上堂 is quoted in his heir's record, and the material around it is the Five Ranks — the signature Caodong doctrine. Corroborates the school.

school.kind: 語錄 entry + his 五位正偏 verses
school.quote: 衡陽岐山仁瑞寺嬾放智大禪師上堂，橫按拄杖，云…（followed by his 五位正偏 verses: 正中偏、偏中正…）
school.note: He composed verses on the Five Ranks — the signature Caodong doctrine — and in this text his entry stands directly after those of 天童宗玨 and 雪竇足菴智鑒, both Caodong. Consistent with the batch's Caodong tag.

bio.kind: 新續高僧傳 (in the bio of 釋無來)
bio.quote: 上有仁瑞寺，為清初懶放禪師開闢。放固明末進士，不屈為僧，與定南王孔有德有舊，王高其節，檄於此建招提，終其隱。
bio.note: THE SOURCE bio_5 SAID IT COULD NOT FIND. It is in the corpus, appended to the biography of a LATE-QING abbot (釋無來) who revived the monastery two centuries later — which is why a name-search missed it. Note the corpus writes 懶放 here and 嬾放 elsewhere.

bio.kind: authority record citing 新續高僧傳
bio.quote: 明末進士，不屈為僧。與定南王孔有德有舊，王高其節檄於歧山建仁瑞寺。（B27, no. 151, p. 225, b1-3）
bio.note: He DOES have a DILA record — bio_5 did not find it.

bio.quote: 為嬾放智大禪師法嗣…戊戌歲（1658）得法於嬾放禪師。〔incense:〕本師上嬾下放老和尚用酬法乳
bio.note: His heir 文穆念 (1633-1678) names him as 本師 in his own incense — first-person confirmation from the far side.

bio.quote: 距紫雲三十里有歧山，壁立萬仞，俯瞰湘衡，上有仁瑞寺，為清初懶放禪師開闢。放固明末進士，不屈為僧，與定南王孔有德有舊，王高其節，檄於此建招提，終其隱。
bio.note: The 新續高僧傳 biography-in-passing that the batch found. DILA A008398 reproduces it verbatim and cites it as B27, no.151, p.225.

links.label: DILA Authority A008398
links.confirms: the man, the Renrui monastery founding, the Kong Youde connection

links.label: DILA Authority A016596
links.confirms: his heir 文穆念, who names him 本師 in incense

links.label: DILA Authority A008398
links.confirms: the 新續高僧傳 account; the dharma name 智大

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Tang clan of Yuzhang (Nanchang); born 1238. He was tonsured by Ming of Mingjue cloister at Xishan. Hearing that Wuchu Daguan was teaching at Yuji he went and attached himself to him, staying at his side; afterwards he called on Dongsou Ying at Nanping, who made him recorder. In 1296 he came out at Baizhang and stayed twelve years; in the Zhida era he moved to Jingci for seven, then to Jingshan as its 46th abbot, and in old age to Yangshan. He bore the title Chan Master Fozhi. He died on the 17th of the intercalary 8th month of 1319, aged 82, and was interred at Xiyin at Jingci. His heirs included Xiaoyin Daxin, Meiwu Nianchang and Shishi Zuying.

steles.title: 晦機禪師碑銘
steles.author: 虞集
steles.author_note: Yu Ji (1272-1348) — the foremost literatus of the Yuan. In 道園學古錄 卷49.
steles.path: (道園學古錄 卷49 — not in the Zen corpus on disk)
steles.note: DILA cites 「淵四．道園學古錄．卷49．晦機禪師碑銘」 among its sources for him. The text is not in the corpus on disk, so I have NOT quoted it — but it exists and is the obvious next document to pull. (The same Yu Ji wrote the preface for 曇芳守忠 in this batch.)

steles.title: 晦機熈禪師塔銘 (第四十六代)
steles.author: 虞集
steles.quote: 大江之南有佛智晦機禪師者，諱元熈，姓唐氏，世為豫章儒家。
steles.note: Carried in 徑山志 卷六 (補遺), i.e. in a TEMPLE GAZETTEER, not in his own record — the stele hides in somebody else's book, exactly as the brief warns. Listed in the gazetteer's own 塔銘 table of contents at GA032n0032 lb 0526a06: 「補遺晦機熈禪師塔銘　虞集」.

teacher.kind: his own 塔銘, by 虞集 (1272-1348) — the leading Yuan literatus, a near-contemporary who gathered the facts from Yuanxi's own disciples
teacher.quote: 聞物初觀禪師住玉几，往依之，十年無知者。偶與書記清默語，大驚異之，以告初。初召詰之信然，留侍左右，朝夕諮問，盡發其秘。字之曰「晦機」，為偈以囑焉。
teacher.note: 為偈以囑 — Daguan gave him a verse and CHARGED him (囑), and gave him the very style-name 晦機 he is known by. 囑 is a transmission verb. Ten years' attendance, then the charge.

teacher.kind: the stele's own colophon on how it was written
teacher.quote: 至治二年夏，集過浙江，遇師之大弟子某，於報國寺同禮師。山中從諸門人知師遺事，如因請為之銘。
teacher.note: Yu Ji names his sources: 1322, at 報國寺, from the master's senior disciple and the men of the mountain — three years after Yuanxi's death (1319). A named man, a named year, a named grave (大仰之下…金雞石…奉瘞焉; a second stupa 建塔于淨慈之西隱).

teacher.quote: 字晦機，為物初大觀禪師（1201-1268）法嗣。豫章人，俗姓唐… 聞物初觀禪師闡化玉几，往依之，留侍左右。後謁東叟穎禪師於南屏，命掌記。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED. Note 東叟穎, whom he called on AFTER — association, not transmission.

dates.quote: 延祐六年閏八月十七日示寂，世壽八十二。
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED: 1238-1319 (the batch had null/null).

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A008284
links.confirms: dates, teacher Wuchu Daguan, Jingshan and Yangshan

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of Jingjiang; abbot of Tianning monastery in Yangzhou. The county gazetteer says he was born strange-minded: at ten he told his father he wanted to be a monk and was refused; married at seventeen, he shared a room with his wife for three years without ever undressing; at twenty he cut his hair for good. He entered Chongsheng in his own county, found the monks there worth nothing, and went on to Guangxiao in Hangzhou. He became the FIRST of the dharma heirs of Jude Hongli, the great restorer of Lingyin and Jingshan. He taught women as well as men: the nun Shangrong of Nianhua hermitage in Jiangdu and the nun Qilian of Guidi hermitage in Suzhou both came to him at Tianning and were sealed by him. He died on the 27th of the first month of 1666, aged 62. His teacher outlived him and came back to Tianning to close his stupa.

teacher.quote: 得法弟子，首巨渤恒，主天寧；次晦山顯…膺付囑者共六十八人。
teacher.note: Jude Hongli's record names 巨渤恒 as first dharma-heir

teacher.quote: 乃以靈隱付其徒晦山，而自往徑山…為弟子巨渤封塔，再至天寧…
teacher.note: teacher builds Jubo's stupa — confirms master-disciple bond

teacher.quote: 得法弟子，首巨渤恒，主天寧；次晦山顯，今補位靈隱；次部玉璞、紫蓋衡、三目淵、若相有；最後御宗聖，膺付囑者共六十八人。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, from the master's own side: in the life of Jude Hongli, the roll of his dharma heirs opens with 「首巨渤恒，主天寧」 — FIRST among them, Jubo Heng, who holds Tianning. Sixty-eight received the entrustment in all.

teacher.kind: 新續高僧傳 (life of the teacher)
teacher.quote: 乃以靈隱付其徒晦山，而自往徑山，將興法席，為弟子巨渤封塔，再至天寧…
teacher.note: Independent: Jude Hongli, having given Lingyin to his disciple Huishan, went to Jingshan — and came to Tianning TO CLOSE HIS DISCIPLE JUBO'S STUPA. The teacher buried the pupil.

teacher.quote: 雨山和尚語錄二十卷 清上思說，有塔銘。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣巨渤恒。
teacher.note: From the far side: his own heir 雨山 is catalogued as 嗣巨渤恒, fixing him at the 37th generation below Nanyue.

dates.quote: 丙午五年，春正月二十七日揚州天甯濟恒巨渤和尚寂。（CBETA, X86, no. 1600, p. 310, b20-21；疑年錄：415）
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED: 1605-1666, aged 62 (the batch had null/null). DILA gives no teacher for him — the corpus does.

bio.quote: 按靖江縣志：濟恆字巨渤，生有異慧，十歲時即語其父求為僧，未果。年十七有妻，雖同寢處然不解衣，如是者三年，至二十乃決意披剃，入本邑崇聖寺，見僧眾所行俱無當，乃之杭之廣孝…
bio.note: From the Jingjiang county gazetteer — a secular source, and unusually vivid.

bio.quote: 上融，字靈璽，江都人…謁天寧巨渤恆，領參竹篦子話，久而徹悟。
bio.note: He sealed at least two nuns: 上融 (lb 0243a03) and 契蓮 (lb 0244a04, 「謁揚州天寧巨渤恆公，言下知歸，得蒙印可」).

bio: Of the Gong clan of Jianyang. Sharp from the start and never able to stomach meat. At seventeen he heard the Surangama and was moved, and took the robe at Zhiti. At twenty-six he went with Zhangren about Fengshan, Luoshan and Xuansha for two years, and knowing there was a matter under his own feet, crossed into Zhejiang and spent years with Zhenji. Then he came to Wuyi Yuanlai at Boshan, and at Shao hermitage, hearing a cock beat its wings and crow, he broke through at a stroke. He opened the dharma at Yingshan in 1646 and afterwards held Boshan itself, Gaoquan and Puning. He died on the 20th of the 6th month of 1670, aged 79, with 62 years in robes. His heirs included Suru Honghan, Zhizhi Hongnan, Yuanzuo Hongyu and Yisheng Hongxi.

teacher.kind: contemporary preface to his heir's 語錄
teacher.quote: 粟如瀚禪師出雪澗奉公之門，奉公與瀛山誾公為昆季，皆老博山室中真子，其鉗錘妙密、嚴整孤峻之風，世能熟鍊，故所出克紹箕裘也。
teacher.note: 室中真子 — 'true sons in the room' — is the transmission idiom, and it puts 雪澗奉 and 瀛山誾 side by side as dharma-brothers under 無異元來 (老博山). This is a contemporary witness, not a lamp index.

teacher.kind: contemporary 塔銘 for his heir 粟如弘瀚
teacher.quote: 二傳而雪澗老人提唱海內，曹溪一燈未艾也。三代粟如大師…
teacher.note: 'At the second transmission, old man Xuejian raised the teaching within the seas' — counting from 無異元來 as first.

teacher.quote: 字雪澗，為博山無異元來禪師（1575-1630）法嗣。建陽人，俗姓龔… 次參博山元來禪師，於勺菴聞雞鼓翅大呌乃頓悟。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the dharma name expanded: 雪澗奉 = 雪磵道奉, dharma name 道奉. DILA cites 五燈全書 卷63/117 and 續燈正統 卷40.

teacher.quote: 博山粟如禪師語錄六卷 清弘瀚說…有像贊、行狀、塔銘、塔院記。青原下第三十七世，嗣雪磵奉。
teacher.note: From the far side: his heir 粟如弘瀚 is catalogued as 嗣雪磵奉, at the 37th generation below Qingyuan — which is the Caodong (Qingyuan) trunk, confirming the school.

dates.quote: 「康熈己酉春以院事託座元，明年六月二十日示寂。……。壽七十九。」（《五燈全書》卷 63）
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED: 1592-1670, aged 79 (the batch had null/null).

links.label: DILA Authority A016031
links.confirms: dates, teacher Wuyi Yuanlai, the seats he held

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Xu clan of Yinxian, Mingzhou; born 1226. At thirteen he was tonsured and took the precepts under Beijian Jujian; at fourteen he climbed Jingshan and saw WUZHUN SHIFAN. At seventeen he took up the dog-and-buddha-nature word and did not leave the monks' hall for five years, until one night the sounding-board rang outside the head-seat's quarters and he saw his own matter. He afterwards went round Shixi Yue, Yanxi Wen, Xutang Zhiyu and Wuchu Daguan. In 1269 he opened the dharma at Zhenru monastery in Taizhou. In 1279, as the Mongols overran the south, the Japanese regent Hojo Tokimune invited him to head Kencho-ji in Kamakura; he went, and in 1282 founded Engaku-ji. He was Tokimune's spiritual adviser through the Mongol invasions. He died in Japan on the 3rd of the 9th month of 1286, aged 61, with 49 years in robes, and was posthumously titled National Teacher Bukko.

steles.title: 佛光禪師塔銘 (and 〈佛光禪師行狀〉, 〈無學禪師行狀〉)
steles.author_note: In 佛光國師語錄 卷9 (T80). The same volume carries TWO 行狀 as well as the 塔銘, and 卷10 has a year-by-year chronology (年表雜錄).
steles.path: (T80, 佛光國師語錄 — NOT in the Zen corpus on disk)
steles.quote: 年十三禮北磵居簡禪師祝髮受戒，十四歲登徑山見無準範禪師… 日本弘安九年（至元二十三）九月初三示寂，世壽六十一，臘四十九。
steles.note: A 塔銘 AND two 行狀 AND a 年譜 all exist for him — an unusually complete dossier — but all in T80, which is not among the 4,990 files on disk. I quote DILA's citations OF them. This is the single richest un-mined stele-set touching this batch; T80 should be added to the corpus.

steles.title: 佛光禪師塔銘
steles.author: 揭傒斯 (Jie Xisi), 應奉翰林文字登仕郞同知制誥兼國史院編修官; 篆額 by 全岳柱, 資政大夫禮部尙書
steles.quote: 佛光禪師塔銘。應奉翰林文字登仕郞同知制誥兼國史院編修官揭傒斯撰幷書。資政大夫禮部尙書全嶽柱篆額。佛法入中國。至宋末。莫盛於呉越之間。簡公奮響於淨慈。範公揚英於徑山…則佛光禪師。師會稽鄞人。許伯濟之子也
steles.note: A Yuan-dynasty Hanlin academician's stupa inscription. Carries an interlinear editorial gloss mapping the whole late-Song lineage: 「簡北磵嗣光拙庵。範無準嗣先破庵。月石溪嗣開掩室。聞偃溪嗣琰浙翁。愚虛堂嗣巖運菴。觀物初嗣簡北磵。一環溪嗣範無準」 — SEVEN transmission statements. ⚠ This list is a 夾註 (interlinear note), NOT Jie Xisi's own prose; do not cite it as stele-grade. Treat as editorial gloss.

steles.title: 大日本國山城州萬年山眞如禪寺開山佛光無學禪師正脈塔院碑銘
steles.author: 永璵 (Eiyo), abbot of Kenchō-ji, 四明姪孫比丘; calligraphy/seal by 妙在 of Kennin-ji
steles.quote: 佛光禪師來自中國。大興禪宗。入滅後六十五載。予亦至…禪師諱祖元。字子元。號無學。四明鄞縣翔鳳鄕人。俗姓許
steles.note: Written 65 years after his death → c. 1351. Author was asked for it by the stupa-keeper 慧迪 (覺山).

steles.title: 佛光禪師行狀
steles.author: 靜照
steles.quote: 屬末比丘靜照謹狀
steles.note: Signed at 0241b29.

steles.title: 行狀 (「明用潜狀」)
steles.author: 覺明 (用潜叟覺明), abbot of 龍峯普慈禪寺, 昌國州, 慶元路
steles.quote: 度弟子。以心印心。以器傳器三百餘人。拔其尤者。建長高峯日。長樂一翁豪…大德戊戌仲冬下澣一日。慶元路昌國州龍峯普慈禪寺住持用潜叟覺明狀
steles.note: Dated 大德戊戌 = 1298, twelve years after Zuyuan's death. Names his two foremost heirs.

steles.title: 狀 (「芝靈石狀」)
steles.author: 如芝 (靈石如芝), abbot of Jingci 淨慈, 賜佛鑑禪師法姪
steles.quote: 古杭南山淨慈禪寺住持賜佛鑑禪師法姪比丘如芝謹狀。無學和尙。明州慶元府鄞縣人。許氏子。諱祖元
steles.note: Cited throughout the 年譜 as 「芝云」.

steles.title: 佛光圓滿常照國師年表雜錄 卷十 年譜
steles.author: compiled by his Japanese heirs; quotes his own 告香普説 as 「師云」
steles.quote: 丙戌南宋理宗寶慶二年。師始生…丙戌九年。師年六十一。示寂建長
steles.note: Cross-collates 揭傒斯's 塔銘 (揭云), 覺明's 狀 (明云) and 如芝's 狀 (芝云) against each other line by line — an editorial apparatus, and it openly flags a contradiction over whether he climbed Jingshan at 14 or 17.

teacher.source: T80n2549 佛光國師語錄 (SAT, NOT in CBETA)
teacher.kind: own 拈香 at his Kenchō-ji enthronement
teacher.quote: 次拈香云。此一瓣香懷來。三十餘年。未甞容易拈出。爇向爐中。供養前住大宋國徑山佛鑑禪師無準大和尙。用酬法乳之恩
teacher.note: The FOURTH stick. The first three go to the emperor, to the 大將軍都元帥國公, and to the 相模太守都總管 (Hōjō Tokimune). Only this one carries 用酬法乳之恩. 'I have carried this stick of incense for over thirty years and never lightly brought it out.' Wuzhun d. 1249; enthronement 1279 — the thirty years check out.

teacher.source: T80n2549, 塔銘 preface by 古林清茂 (茂古林)
teacher.quote: 四明無學元禪師。得法于徑山無準和尙
teacher.note: 得法 — the transmission verb.

teacher.source: T80n2549, 行狀 by 如芝 (靈石)
teacher.quote: 無學首參無準範和尙於徑山。七年之間。得盡心法
teacher.note: Same 狀 states his tonsure master separately: 「禮杭州淨慈北磵簡和尙爲師」 — 北磵居簡 is the TONSURE master (禮…爲師 / 祝髮), NOT the dharma-father. Textbook five-teachers-one-father distinction.

teacher.source: T80n2549, 正脈塔院碑銘 by 永璵
teacher.quote: 環溪以無準法衣授。以表信。師披衣陞座。拈香。爲無準嗣
teacher.note: The robe reached him from his dharma-brother 環溪惟一 after Wuzhun's death, but the succession is registered to 無準 himself: 爲無準嗣.

teacher.quote: 字子元，號無學…年十三禮北磵居簡禪師祝髮受戒，十四歲登徑山見無準範禪師。十七歲參狗子無佛性話，不出僧堂者五年，一夜聞首座寮前版響發明己事。（《佛光國師語錄》卷 9〈佛光禪師塔銘〉、〈佛光禪師行狀〉）
teacher.note: Batch teacher Wuzhun Shifan CONFIRMED — DILA sourcing it to his 塔銘 and 行狀. NOTE the trap: his TONSURE teacher was 北磵居簡 (Beijian Jujian — who is also 物初大觀's teacher in this same batch). Tonsure at 13, Wuzhun at 14. Association vs transmission again.

dates.quote: 寶慶二年（《佛光國師語錄》卷 9〈佛光禪師塔銘〉）… 日本弘安九年（至元二十三）九月初三示寂，世壽六十一。
dates.note: Both from the stupa inscription. DEATH 1286 matches the batch; BIRTH 1226 RECOVERED (the batch had it only in a prose note, with the field null).

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

links.label: DILA Authority A000077
links.confirms: dates, teacher Wuzhun Shifan, Kencho-ji and Engaku-ji

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派
bio: Of the Xie clan of Yongquan, Xingguo (Hubei); born on the 12th of the 10th month of 1626. In 1645, aged twenty, unwilling to stay a householder, he shaved his head at Bao'en monastery and went north among the lecture-halls. In 1650 he came south again over the matter of birth and death, and one day after the meal, looking into his original face, he split it open at a stroke: 'The face is wholly shown, it was never covered up — how many times did I fold my hands and ask in the hall? What I see now is not another's seeing; a lifetime's ease, and the bones gone cool.' He went to Feiyin Tongrong at Jingshan, who shouted him down and named and ordained him; he called on Yulin Tongxiu, Wanru Tongwei and Muchen Daomin; and then he came to DUGUAN XINGJING at Wuxing, who sealed him. From 1658 he opened Tiefo at Jing, restored Tianwang (1661), took Dizang at Yangzhou (1662), Tianwang again (1665), rebuilt Huanglong at Ezhou (1668), went to Qixian at Hanyang (1670), and took Guanghui at Jinsu (1676). Five seats, four of them rebuilt from ruin. He died in 1687; eleven dharma heirs.

steles.title: 天王和尚行錄
steles.author: 明淵
steles.author_note: 明淵書. The record ends by saying it was CUT INTO THE BACK OF HIS LIVING-STUPA at Tianwang — 「謹錄所行歲月，勒於天王壽塔之陰，庶有考云」 — so this text is literally a stele.
steles.quote: 師諱慧海，字水鑑，號沙翁，武昌興國謝氏子。生明天啟六年丙寅…謁徑山費隱容和尚，尚曰：「那裏來？」師便喝。尚曰：「放汝三十。」師又喝。遂起名受具。復訪吳興獨冠敬禪師，乃印法焉。
steles.note: THE DECISIVE SENTENCE, and it is carved on his own stupa: Feiyin gave him his NAME and his ORDINATION; DUGUAN SEALED HIM (乃印法焉). Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the association/transmission distinction drawn by the stele itself.

steles.title: 寓叟自傳
steles.author: 水鑑慧海 himself
steles.quote: 寓叟者，楚興國涌泉人也。姓謝，名慧海，字水鑑，別號沙翁
steles.note: ★ A first-person autobiography sitting unread in the corpus. The brief was right that nobody had read it. It is the top rung of the ladder and it settles his teacher in one clause.

steles.title: 天王和尚行錄
steles.author_note: in 《天王水鑑海和尚五會錄》卷6
steles.quote: 「生明天啟六年丙寅」
steles.note: Cited by DILA A001716 for his birth. I located the reference but did not read the 行錄 in full.

teacher.source: J29nB230 天王水鑑海和尚六會錄, 卷9 〈寓叟自傳〉 — HIS OWN AUTOBIOGRAPHY
teacher.quote: 一日飯後，劃然廓悟，乃謁徑山容和尚，深蒙提獎。復謁金車琇、禹門微、虎嵒忞諸尊宿，賞為不羈。後於吳興稟法靈山敬和尚焉
teacher.note: ★★ THE STRONGEST THING THAT EXISTS: he says it himself. 稟法 — 'I RECEIVED THE DHARMA from Abbot Jing of Lingshan at Wuxing.' ⚠⚠ AND THE SAME SENTENCE IS A TRAP-DETECTOR: the men he merely 謁 ('called on') are 徑山[費隱通]容 (who merely 深蒙提獎, 'greatly encouraged' him), 金車琇 = 玉林通琇, 禹門微 = 萬如[通]微, and 虎嵒忞 = 木陳道忞. FOUR famous masters, none of them his father. The brief warned that an agent nearly filed 玉林通琇's incense wrongly — and here Yulin Tongxiu sits in a list of men this master merely visited.

teacher.source: J29nB230, his own 拈香 at the Tianwang enthronement (1st of six)
teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，迦葉師兄得處只恐依俙，諸方老師悟時未必親切，今日山僧腳蹋實地，信手拈來，奉為傳臨濟三十三世前住湖州府靈山、見居漢陽府棲賢獨冠敬和尚，用酬法乳
teacher.note: The dharma-milk stick. The two sticks before it go to the emperor and to the court officials. ⚠ 靈山 (Huzhou/Wuxing) + 敬 in the autobiography = 獨冠敬 here — the SAME man, independently confirmed.

teacher.source: J29nB230, the other four of his six enthronement 拈香
teacher.quote: 奉為臨濟三十二世漢陽棲賢獨冠敬和尚 / 此是第三回拈出。奉為棲賢獨冠敬和尚 / 此是第四回拈出，奉為鄂州巖頭獨冠敬和尚 / 此是第五回拈出，奉為郢州興陽獨冠敬和尚，用酬法乳
teacher.note: FIVE separate incense-raisings across five of his six seats, every one to Duguan Jing, tracking Jing's own moves (Lingshan → Qixian → Yantou → Xingyang). Overwhelming. ⚠ Minor internal inconsistency: the first calls Jing 臨濟三十三世, the second 臨濟三十二世.

teacher.source: J29nB230, 天王沙翁和尚紀略 (his own 紀略, appended)
teacher.quote: 水鑑海公…二十脫白。初遊講席…體究性源，劃然開悟。後嗣獨冠敬和尚，始從同事徑山容老人，遜志輔敬弘化…得此勝嗣
teacher.note: 後嗣獨冠敬和尚 — 嗣. Note it says he then 'served alongside old master Rong of Jingshan' — i.e. Feiyin Tongrong was his GRAND-teacher and colleague, not his father.

teacher.kind: 行錄, cut into his stupa
teacher.quote: 復訪吳興獨冠敬禪師，乃印法焉。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED at stele rung.

teacher.quote: 字水鑑，號沙翁，為獨冠行敬禪師（1613-1672）法嗣… 後謁吳興獨冠行敬禪師，乃印法。
teacher.note: AND EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S NAME: 獨冠敬 = 獨冠行敬 (1613-1672).

teacher.kind: transmission incense (拈香), his own words from the seat
teacher.quote: 奉為傳臨濟三十三世前住湖州府靈山、見居漢陽府棲賢獨冠敬和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: ⚠⚠ CONTRADICTS bio_11, which names FEIYIN TONGRONG. His OWN INCENSE, repeated at every abbacy he ever took (J29nB230 lb 0246b20, 0250a11, 0254b24; J29nB231 lb 0286a24, 0288a29; J29nB232 lb 0309c10), names DUGUAN XINGJING — never Feiyin. He is Feiyin's dharma-GRANDSON, not his son. bio_11's teacher is OFF BY ONE GENERATION.

teacher.quote: 徑山費隱容和尚，尚曰：「那裏來？」師便喝…遂起名受具。復訪吳興獨冠敬禪師，乃印法焉。
teacher.note: Explicit and decisive: Feiyin NAMED him and gave him the PRECEPTS (起名受具); Duguan SEALED THE DHARMA (印法). The classic ordination-vs-transmission distinction, in one sentence.

teacher.kind: he memorialises Duguan as his LATE MASTER
teacher.quote: 獨冠敬先師諱日，上堂。
teacher.note: 'On the memorial day of my LATE MASTER Duguan Jing, [he] ascended the hall.' 先師 = one's own dead master.

teacher.quote: 傳棲賢獨冠敬和尚傳　師諱行敬，號獨冠，雲夢人，姓楊氏，德安望族也。
teacher.note: A disciple's office. DILA A011732 confirms: 「寂後門人水鑒海撰傳」.

teacher.kind: 費隱通容's OWN recorded sayings
teacher.quote: 還徑山，十月朔付獨冠敬、百峰高。
teacher.note: Feiyin's own record: he TRANSMITTED to 獨冠敬 and 百峰高. This nails the chain 費隱通容 → 獨冠行敬 → 水鑑慧海.

teacher.quote: 三十三歲，承嗣獨冠之法。 REL teacher 行敬 （明清序：093；佛光：6040）

dates.quote: 生明天啟六年丙寅
dates.note: BIRTH 1626 from the stupa record (DILA: 1626-11-30). DEATH 1687 per DILA (中國佛教人名大辭典). Batch had null/null.

dates.quote: 「生明天啟六年丙寅」（《天王水鑑海和尚五會錄》卷6〈天王和尚行錄〉）… 1687（《中國佛教人名大辭典》，頁971）
dates.note: Birth 1626-11-30; death 1687. bio_11 had only 'floruit 1655'.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.note: HIS OWN AUTOBIOGRAPHY survives: 〈寓叟自傳〉 in 天王水鑑海和尚六會錄 卷9 (J29nB230), and a second version 〈寓人自傳〉 in J29nB232 卷2. First-person, and not yet mined. A prize for the next pass.

bio.kind: biographical notice in his own 語錄

links.label: DILA Authority A001716
links.confirms: dates, teacher 獨冠行敬, the five seats

bio: Ming Chan master; dharma heir of Motang Xuan. His pupil Fazhou Daoji of Tianning in Jiaxing — who came to him from Dongchan, attended him morning and night, and was awakened by the sound of a chime ringing out from the Buddha-hall as he walked in the cloister, whereupon Ji'an sealed him — carried the line on. Only the single dharma character 祚 survives of his name.

teacher.quote: 天寧宣禪師法嗣：徑山英禪師、吉菴祚禪師（不列章次）。
teacher.note: 天寧宣 = 默堂宣. Confirms the roster's edge. 「不列章次」 — the lamp itself admits it had no material on him.

teacher.quote: 吉庵祚 嗣默堂宣。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED — but by a LINEAGE CHART ONLY (the weakest rung above pure assertion). Four characters, and they are all I have. The Qing lamps carry no entry for him at all.

school.quote: 嘉興天寧道濟禪師 吉庵祚嗣
school.note: Places him in the Linji column at the 30th generation below Huineng.

bio.quote: （法舟道濟）後依吉庵祚禪師朝夕叅叩，偶行廊廡間，聞佛殿磬響，豁然有悟，祚即可之。
bio.note: ALL the biographical colour we have for him comes from the life of his HEIR, Fazhou Daoji — he survives as the man who sealed someone else. Corroborated at X81n1568 lb 1006a03, where 「吉庵祚禪師法嗣」 heads Daoji's entry.

school: Linji 臨濟宗 楊岐派 (聚雲 branch)
bio: Of the Li clan of Yibin (Bodao); his father and grandfather had been Brahmins for three generations. Eight monks are said to have come to the house at his birth, one of them saying the child was an arhat of the Eight Treasures come back. He was a Confucian first and a Buddhist after. He attended Yueming Lianchi at Zhaoyang for years and was tonsured and fully ordained under him in 1613; then he left for a solitary mountain and worked three years without letting his side touch the mat. Returning at the end of his term, he asked the old master, 'After all — how does it show itself?' — and Yueming reached out and clapped a hand over his mouth, and he opened wide. He crossed to Wu, into Fujian, through Guangdong, opened the dharma at Xiaoxiang Hudong, and came back to Shu to teach at Juyun in Zhongzhou, where he revived the Juyun branch of Linji in Sichuan and preached the unity of the three teachings. He wrote in plain language on purpose — his Three-Character Classic of Buddhism apes the Confucian primer to teach Buddhist history and the eight schools. Thirty years out in the world, five seats. On the last day of the 7th month of 1639 he took the brush and wrote: 'Beaten three thousand at dawn, eight hundred at dusk — to see Juyun, blood from the eyebrows.' He sat until noon, gave two great shouts, and died, aged 58.

steles.title: 吹萬禪師塔銘
steles.author: 田華國
steles.author_note: 賜進士出身 欽命整飭兵巡兼理監軍道 湖廣參知政事浯江弟子田華國熏沐拜撰 — a jinshi, Administration Vice-Commissioner of Huguang and army supervising censor; a lay disciple. His own father helped found the monastery Chuiwan lived in.
steles.quote: 禪師諱廣真，僰道宜賓人，俗姓李，父祖三世為婆羅門…幼而業儒，長而事佛，得法於月明聯池老人。池嗣鐵牛遠，遠嗣荊山寶，寶嗣無念有，有嗣二仰欽，欽嗣小庵密，密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益，益嗣淨慈明，明嗣鼓山永，永嗣西禪需，需嗣大慧杲。歷溯源流，師固大慧十四世孫也。
steles.note: THE SINGLE MOST VALUABLE DOCUMENT IN THIS BATCH. A named jinshi, writing at a named grave, hands over THIRTEEN GENERATIONS IN ONE SENTENCE — from Dahui Zonggao down to Chuiwan himself. It attests not only Chuiwan's own teacher but the teacher of 苦口益, the last master in this batch (see his entry). Tian Huaguo also gives the diagnosis of the age: the tradition was splitting into factions, each house coining its own slogan, and Chuiwan set himself against it — 'he would not do the stock phrases of the day.'

steles.title: 吹萬禪師塔銘
steles.author: 田華國
steles.author_note: 賜進士出身，欽命整飭兵巡兼理監軍道，湖廣參知政事 — a provincial vice-administrator of Huguang, and a lay disciple (弟子) who studied under him personally: 「良由北面於師」
steles.quote: 禪師諱廣真，僰道宜賓人，俗姓李，父祖三世為婆羅門。師生有異徵，詳載行錄。幼而業儒，長而事佛，得法於月明聯池老人。池嗣鐵牛遠，遠嗣荊山寶，寶嗣無念有，有嗣二仰欽，欽嗣小庵密，密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益，益嗣淨慈明，明嗣鼓山永，永嗣西禪需，需嗣大慧杲。歷溯源流，師固大慧十四世孫也。
steles.note: THE LINEAGE BACKBONE OF THIS WHOLE BATCH. In one sentence the stele hands over fourteen generations back to Dahui Zonggao — and it independently corroborates at multiple links: DILA confirms 月明聯池's teacher was 鐵牛德遠 (A015892), that 荊山懷寶 was 無念有's heir, and that 筏渡普慈's teacher was 苦口良益 (A015518). A stele that checks out against the authority database at four separate joints is a stele worth trusting.

steles.title: 吹萬大師塔銘
steles.author_note: A SECOND, distinct stupa inscription.
steles.quote: 吹萬大師塔銘
steles.note: Appended to 聚雲吹萬真禪師語錄 — a second stele for the same man, in a different text.

teacher.quote: 得法於月明聯池老人。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED by the stupa inscription.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 (incense), 萬曆戊午 = 1618
teacher.quote: 爇向爐中，供養大慧下現住四川敘州府朱提山上月下明和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, AT THE TRANSMISSION. Opening the hall at Xiaoxiang Hudong in 1618, he burns the third stick of incense for 'the venerable Yueming of Zhuti mountain in Xuzhou prefecture, Sichuan, under Dahui — to repay the debt of the dharma-milk.' The man's own words, naming his own teacher. The highest rung there is.

teacher.quote: 朝陽月明聯池禪師法嗣… 三十二歲禮朝陽月明聯池禪師受具足戒。
得法於月明聯池老人
teacher.note: 'He obtained the dharma from the old man Yueming Lianchi.' Written at his grave by a disciple. The batch's tentative '月明' is now fully resolved: the man is 月明聯池 = DILA A015892 (1574-1639), himself an heir of 鐵牛德遠.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 聯池 (A015892) — 朝陽月明聯池禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 崇禎十二年己卯七月三十日，壽五十有八
dates.note: DATES RECOVERED: 1582-1639, aged 58 (the batch had floruit 1618 / death 1639). DILA quotes the same stele.

dates.quote: 師住世五十八年，開堂五處。… 於崇禎十二年己卯七月三十日，索筆書偈云：「朝打三千，暮打八百。要會聚雲，眉毛出血。」擲筆危坐不語。至午果大喝兩聲脫去。
dates.note: Died 崇禎十二年 (1639), aged 58 — so born 1582. DILA A001662 agrees exactly (1582 – 1639-08-28). RESOLVES the batch's open question: the 續燈正統 death of 崇禎十一年 (1638) aged 66 belongs to his TEACHER 月明聯池, not to him.

bio.note: His 語錄 (J29nB239, 20 fasc.) carries BOTH a 行狀 and the 塔銘, at 卷20.

links.label: DILA Authority A001662
links.confirms: dates (from the stele), teacher, the Juyun branch, his three heirs

bio: A master of the line running from Dahui Zonggao down to the Juyun branch in Sichuan. He inherited from Jingci Ming, and his own heir was Fadu Ci. Only the single dharma character 益 survives of his name; nothing else about his life is recorded.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 (吹萬禪師塔銘) by 田華國
teacher.quote: 慈嗣苦口益，益嗣淨慈明，明嗣鼓山永，永嗣西禪需，需嗣大慧杲。
teacher.note: BATCH TEACHER CONFIRMED — AND BY A STELE, which is remarkable for a man of whom nothing else survives. This is the thirteen-generation chain in the stupa inscription of 吹萬廣真 (also in this batch), read in the direction 'X 嗣 Y' = X inherits FROM Y: so 苦口益 inherits from 淨慈明, and 筏渡慈 inherits from him. The chain above him runs 淨慈明 < 鼓山永 < 西禪需 < 大慧杲 (Dahui Zonggao). A master with no biography at all, placed exactly, by a jinshi writing at a grave in 1639.

school.quote: 歷溯源流，師固大慧十四世孫也。
school.note: The chain makes him the 6th generation below Dahui Zonggao.

bio: Founder of the Niutou (Oxhead) school. Lay surname Wei (韋), of Yanling. At nineteen he was tonsured under the Sanlun monk Jiong on Mt. Maoshan in Jurong. In 643 he built a meditation cell under the north cliff of Youqi monastery on Mt. Niutou, where more than a hundred followers gathered; the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin heard of him and came to transmit the sudden teaching he had received from Sengcan. The line centred on that mountain became the Niutou school, counted through six patriarchs down to Huizhong. He died at Jianchu in 657, aged 64.

steles.title: 潤州鶴林寺故徑山大師碑銘 (his successor Xuansu's stele)
steles.author: 李華
steles.quote: 信大師就而證之
steles.note: Farong's transmission is attested inside the stele of a later man in his line — exactly the brief's 'the stele sits in somebody else's book' pattern.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0320, 潤州鶴林寺故徑山大師碑銘, by 李華
teacher.quote: 初達摩祖師傳法，三世至信大師，信門人達者曰融大師。居牛頭山，得自然智慧。信大師就而證之，且曰：「七佛教戒，諸三昧門，語有差別，義無差別。群生根器，各各不同，唯最上乘，攝而歸一。涼風既至，百實皆成，汝能總持，吾亦隨喜。」由是無上覺路，分為此宗
teacher.note: ★ 就而證之 — Daoxin WENT TO HIM and certified him (證 = a transmission verb).
