steles.note: His account-of-conduct, in his own recorded sayings; cited via DILA A016410. NOTE the text is J39nB455 (通天逸叟高禪師語錄) - the harvest listed no texts for him.

steles.title: 行狀 (appended to 通天逸叟高禪師語錄)
steles.author: 門人超原 (his disciple Chaoyuan)
steles.quote: 行狀：師號逸叟，諱行高，閩興化仙遊陳氏子。童年，禮蓮山東林和尚薙染。
steles.note: ⚠ The book has TWO 行狀 slots. The one listed in the front matter (lb 0687a09) is marked 「原書闕」 — MISSING FROM THE ORIGINAL BLOCKS. The surviving 行狀 sits at the END of the book, at 0689c23, and is easy to miss. Chaoyuan's colophon explains why the book is thin: 「前因兵燹之後，板失過半…僅得數頁，不過謹述行略以傳耳」 — after the wars, more than half the printing blocks were lost. His stupa stands east of Mount Lian, outside the north gate of Puyang, at Guohuan temple.

steles.title: 通天逸叟高禪師語錄 — 行狀
steles.quote: 康熙己酉年三月十二日申時，閱世五十有四。
steles.note: The Jiaxing catalogue records 「通天逸叟高禪師語錄一卷 清行高說，明德重梓，有行狀」. DILA quotes his 行狀 for the death date (given above). I did not extract the full text from J39nB455; the quote is as DILA cites it from that 行狀.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at the Tongtian enthronement
teacher.quote: …粟山中打失鼻孔、後向禹門院裏全身放下，今日不免對眾拈出，爇向爐中，耑伸供養四座道場龍池堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十一世萬如先老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick, in his own voice. 龍池堂上 = Longchi, Wanru's seat.

teacher.kind: his 行狀, appended to his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 師別參萬如和尚於龍池，秋水澄潭，碧天皓月，相涵於一光之內，師於是為龍池血胤矣。囑法之後，仍侍左右。
teacher.note: 血胤 (blood of the line) + 囑法 (the dharma was entrusted). ⚠ THE TRAP HE COULD HAVE FALLEN INTO: three lines earlier the 行狀 has him awakening under FEIYIN TONGRONG at Jinsu, and Feiyin merely 頷之 — nodded. A careless reader files him under Feiyin. The 行狀 itself distinguishes the two verbs.

teacher.quote: 號逸叟，為萬如通微禪師（1594-1657）法嗣…後參費隱和尚於金粟。一夜聞鐘聲，有省。再參萬如和尚於龍池，得付法。（《通天逸叟高禪師語錄》卷 1〈行狀〉）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. Note again the careful distinction: he had an OPENING under Feiyin, but 得付法 (received the transmission) from WANRU. Association vs transmission, kept straight by the 行狀.

teacher.quote: 通天逸叟高禪師語錄一卷 清行高說，明德重梓，有行狀…南嶽下第三十五世，嗣萬如微。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 萬如通微禪師（1594-1657）法嗣

dates.quote: 「康熙己酉年三月十二日申時，閱世五十有四。」（〈行狀〉）
dates.note: Died 1669-04-12 aged 54 -> b.1616. CONFIRMS the harvest's reconstruction exactly (d. 康熙己酉 1669, aged 54, so b. ~1616, 40 summers, stupa at 蓮山).

dates.quote: 康熙己酉年三月十二日申時，閱世五十有四。
dates.note: Death 1669-04-12, aged 54 → birth 1616.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣為澹崖超原禪師
sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 興化仙遊人，俗姓陳。童年禮蓮山東林和尚薙染。及壯參朝宗師林諸和尚，示參萬法歸一公案。

bio: Of the Shi 施 family of Xiushui in Jiahe (Jiaxing). Born on the eighteenth of the tenth month of 1491. As a layman he was called Jingzhai, married, and had a son and a daughter; kindly by nature, he gave himself to the inner books and longed for the way of the patriarchs, travelling with his friend Jizhou Fazhou for eight years before returning home to press the enquiry alone. When Yeweng Xiao — a fourteenth-generation descendant of Huqiu Shaolong and heir of Baofang Jin — was staying at Dongta monastery, he went to call on him, and every view he presented was swept away, until all he had prided himself on was gone. One day Yeweng said 'I have a word for you', and only laughed when asked; when Rukong at last made the full disciple's obeisance and begged, Yeweng gave it. He died on the sixth of the eighth month of 1580, aged 90.

steles.title: 無趣老人行狀
steles.quote: 師諱如空，號無趣，嘉禾秀水人，俗姓施。未出家時，號靜齋，娶生一子一女。性仁慈，留心內典，志慕祖道，同友濟法舟參訪八年，復歸家刻志參究。適野翁曉禪師寓東塔寺，虎丘隆禪師之十四世孫，寶芳進之子，師往謁，每呈見解盡被掃闢，昔日所負至此索然。一日野翁謂師曰：「我有一言要與爾說。」師曰：「請教。」野翁但笑而不語。又問，又笑。師始具師資，禮懇求之，翁不得已乃曰…
steles.note: Bound with his own 語錄. THIS SETTLES THE TEACHER: it names 野翁曉, places him at Dongta monastery, and situates him in the lineage (14th generation from Huqiu Shaolong, heir of Baofang Jin). The roster worried that the 語錄 'carries no transmission-incense' and that the teacher rested only on lamp sections — in fact his 行狀 states it outright.

teacher.quote: 適野翁曉禪師寓東塔寺，虎丘隆禪師之十四世孫，寶芳進之子，師往謁…師始具師資，禮懇求之
teacher.note: '師資' = the master-disciple relation formally taken up. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 東墖曉禪師法嗣 … 野翁真曉禪師法嗣
teacher.note: Gives the fuller dharma name 真曉 and the alternate designation 東塔曉.

teacher.quote: 無趣老人語錄一卷 明如空說，性冲編并序，圓澄序，有行狀。南嶽下第三十世，嗣野翁曉。

dates.quote: 弘治辛亥年十月十八日 … 萬曆庚辰八月六日，世壽九十
dates.note: Birth 1491-11-28 (confirms the roster's 弘治辛亥), death 1580-09-24 aged 90. The roster left the death year null; it is 1580.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Of the Gaoyang 高陽 family of Suzhou, thirty-second generation of the Linji house; also styled Ou'an. Born on the thirteenth of the first month of 1621, after his mother dreamed a strange dream. Quick as a child and fond of sitting alone, he recited the Cundi dharani daily and would set out food and bow to any travelling monk who came. At fifteen he wanted to leave home and nearly starved himself when his parents refused. He met Jie'an (Wuji n) — 'question and answer between them mixed like water and milk' — and received the charge and attended him. He returned to Ou'an, made an image of Guanyin, built a meditation hall, and copied out the Huayan, Surangama and Amitabha sutras entire. Worn out, he withdrew to a thatched hut outside the East Gate and there, taking up the brush, wrote 'All my life solitary, I kept the gate and held to plainness; though my way was cool, I trust the blaze of those who come after', gave a shout, threw down the brush and died — the hour of yin on the seventeenth of the seventh month of 1677, aged 57, with 34 years in robes.

steles.title: 竹菴和尚傳
steles.quote: 師名真衍，別號藕菴，臨濟三十二世孫也，姑蘇高陽氏子。明泰昌辛酉正月十有三日，母陳氏感異夢生…
steles.note: Bound with his own 語錄, which was edited by his heir 機如. The catalogue calls it 行狀 (「有行狀及舉火法語」); the text heads it 竹菴和尚傳. Death passage at lb 0090b27: 「時康熙丁巳七月十七日寅時也。距其生年五十有七，僧臘三十有四。」

steles.title: 蘇州竹庵衍禪師語錄〈竹菴和尚傳〉 and 〈師自述行繇〉
steles.author_note: The 行繇 is autobiographical — his own account of his course.
steles.quote: 「明泰昌辛酉正月十有三日」
steles.note: Both a 傳 (juan 1) and a self-narrated 行繇 (juan 2) travel with his 語錄 (J36nB345, per the batch). DILA cites the 傳 for his birth date. I did not open the file directly — it was not among the paths listed in my batch — so these are cited via DILA's transcription.

teacher.quote: 介菴老人，問荅酬唱，有水乳之合，遂囑付隨侍。
teacher.note: '遂囑付' — he was given the charge. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 蘇州竹庵衍禪師語錄二卷 清真衍說，機如編…有行狀及舉火法語。南嶽下第三十五世，嗣介庵進。
TEACHER: 悟進 (A010710) — 別號藕菴，為介菴悟進禪師（1612-1673）法嗣 … 後參金明介禪師。一日聞板聲，忽然大悟，得付法。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 明泰昌辛酉正月十有三日
時康熙丁巳七月十七日寅時也。距其生年五十有七，僧臘三十有四。
dates.note: Death 1677, aged 57. CONFIRMS the roster's death year 1677 and supplies the missing birth year 1621.

dates.quote: 「明泰昌辛酉正月十有三日」（〈竹菴和尚傳〉）… 「康熙丁巳七月十七日」（《五燈全書》卷81）世壽五十七。
dates.note: = 1621-02-03 to 1677-08-15, aged 57. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

bio: Of the Zhang 張 family of Putian in Xinghua (Fujian); a licentiate before he ordained. Born on the eleventh of the eleventh month of 1630. Dharma heir of Yisou Xinggao (1616–1669), thirty-sixth generation below Nanyue. He held the seat at Tongtian for a year in obedience to his grandmaster's wishes. He died in the hour of chou on the eighteenth of the fourth month of 1698, aged 69, with 36 years in robes; his stupa stands on the right slope below Daibei hermitage.

steles.title: 通天澹崖原禪師語錄 — 行實 (卷2)
steles.quote: 師生于庚午年十一月十一日，世壽六十九。 … 戊寅年四月十八日丑時。
steles.note: The Jiaxing catalogue records 「通天澹崖原禪師語錄二卷 清超原說，明德等編，有行實」. Quotes as DILA A016573 cites them from that 行實 (juan 2). Bound together with his teacher's record — the two Tongtian masters share a volume.

steles.title: 通天澹崖原禪師語錄・行實
steles.author: 門人明德等謹述
steles.quote: 師諱超原，號澹崖，興化莆田張氏子…門人依儀茶毘，建塔於菴之右麓。
steles.note: Full 行實 appended to his own yulu; the 嘉興藏 catalogue (B35n0194, lb 0346a04) flags it: 「通天澹崖原禪師語錄二卷 清超原說，明德等編，有行實。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣逸叟高。」

teacher.kind: own 拈香 at his enthronement
teacher.quote: 不敢剖露，今對人天眾前信手拈來爇向爐中，供養本寺傳臨濟正宗第三十二世通天堂上逸叟先老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: The dharma-milk stick, raised by Chaoyuan himself in his own 通天澹崖原禪師語錄. 逸叟 was already dead (先老和尚) — Chaoyuan was his successor at Tongtian.

teacher.kind: 行實 (by his disciples 明德等)
teacher.quote: 後回莆葬親，聞通天逸叟和尚道風遐振，往參焉…叟頷之，命入堂，職第三座，遂蒙印可，隨侍三載。後和尚臨寂，遺囑繼席。
teacher.note: 印可 + 遺囑繼席 — transmission verbs, not mere 參.

teacher.kind: his own 讚 to his teacher's portrait
teacher.quote: 通天逸叟老和尚…不肖親遭痛棒來，一回舉出一回悵。
teacher.note: 'This unworthy one personally took his beating.'

teacher.quote: 通天澹崖原禪師語錄二卷 清超原說，明德等編，有行實。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣逸叟高。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

dates.quote: 師生于庚午年十一月十一日，世壽六十九 … 戊寅年四月十八日丑時
dates.note: Birth 1630-12-14, death 1698-05-27, aged 69. Confirms the roster's 'died aged 69, 僧臘 36' and supplies both years.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Name Daodu, sobriquet Zongbao, also styled Kongyin; a son of the Lu clan of Nanhai in Guangdong. At three his mother carried him upstairs and he watched a spider spinning its web, staring a long while, until grief and joy came over him together. At six he lost his father. He got hold of the Platform Sutra — AND COULD NOT READ. He carried it in his sleeve and bowed earnestly to Guanyin; one night he prostrated until he collapsed exhausted, and woke feeling as though he hung in space, sweat soaking his back; he lit a lamp, took out the sutra, guessed at a character, asked someone — and was right, and thereafter read whole lines at a glance. At fourteen, sitting under a tree, HIS CHEST SPLIT LIKE A CLEFT BAMBOO. At sixteen he took a knife to a boulder, bowed to the Buddhas of the ten directions, SHAVED HIS OWN HEAD, built a hut on Mt Long and lived alone for more than ten years. He served his mother with total devotion — when she was ill he carried spring-water twenty li a day on his shoulder — and when she died he kept vigil at her grave three months. AT TWENTY-NINE he went to Boshan, to WUYI YUANLAI, who had been asking every monk from Guangdong: 'Why does Zongbao not come? Can the Way be reached without coming to Boshan?' Boshan called him into the abbot's room and they talked the night through; he gave him his name and his full ordination. Boshan died five months later. He held Luofu, Xichan at Fuzhou, Changqing, and Haichuang at Guangzhou, and his whole-body stupa stands south of West Creek at Huashou Terrace on Mt Luofu. He died in 1661, aged 62, with 33 summers. 'Only two men,' says his heir, 'personally received his seal.'

steles.title: 長慶老和尚行狀
steles.author: 圅昰 Hanshi (= 天然函昰 Tianran Hanshi, 1608-1685)
steles.author_note: ⭐ HIS OWN DHARMA HEIR — signed 「嗣法門人圅昰述」. The disciple writing his master's account of conduct for the funeral: the classic form.
steles.quote: 師諱道獨，號宗寶，別號空隱。博山無異禪師法嗣。南海陸氏子。… 得六祖壇經，不識字，懷襟袖間，懇禮大士。… 師是歲纔十六，依止菴僧，無可意者，自𢹂刀就磐石禮十方佛，剃落… 二十二日晨起，啗粥嚼木如平時，侍者請敷藥，師遽曰：今日不敷藥。顧左右斂目良久，端坐而逝，壽六十二，坐夏三十又三。
steles.note: ⭐⭐ THE OPENING LINE IS THE TRANSMISSION: 「博山無異禪師法嗣」 — 'dharma heir of Chan master Wuyi of Boshan.' And the death: on the morning of the 22nd he ate his gruel and chewed his twig as usual; when the attendant offered to dress his sores he said 'no ointment today,' looked round, closed his eyes a long while, and died sitting upright.

steles.title: 長慶空隱獨和尚塔銘
steles.author: not named in the portion read — a LAY disciple (he calls himself 「菰蘆中幅巾弟子」) who had sought out Hanshan Deqing's remains
steles.author_note: Commissioned from five thousand li away: 「昰公奉師全身墖於羅浮華首臺西溪之南，手次行狀，遣侍者今覞間關五千里，撰書幣而謁銘於余。」
steles.quote: 師悲智堅密，罏鞴弘廣，植菩提之深根，茂忠孝之芽葉，節烈文章之士賴以成就正骨，祓濯命根，白蜺碧血長留佛種… 銘曰：毗嵐風吹壞劫初，崑岡火炎扇洪罏。有大比丘建法旟，一單坐斷嶺海隅…
steles.note: ⭐ 'Men of integrity and letters relied on him to complete their upright bones… white rainbows and blue blood long preserved the Buddha-seed.' A political reading: he sheltered Ming loyalists. Confirmed by the canon catalogue: B35n0194 「宗寶道獨禪師語錄六卷，明道獨說並序，今釋重編，函昰序，附行狀、塔銘。」

steles.title: 長慶空隱獨和尚墖銘
steles.author: 錢謙益
steles.author_note: Qian Qianyi (1582–1664), 禮部尚書, of Yushan — the foremost man of letters of the late Ming, and the most eminent author of any stele in this batch
steles.quote: 博山無異禪師有法嗣曰長慶空隱和尚，諱道獨，初字宗寶，南海陸氏子也。生三歲，母抱登樓，觀蜘蛛結網，瞪目久之，悲喜不禁。晚自言：四五十年來，回憶不加毫末。其夙根如此。
steles.note: Note the 墖 variant of 塔 — invisible to a 塔銘 search. The inscription's OPENING WORDS state the transmission: 'Chan master Wuyi of Boshan had a dharma heir called Kongyin of Changqing.' The 天然和尚年譜 (B22n0119, lb 0939a16) records that Daodu's attendant was sent to Qian Qianyi to commission it.

steles.title: 長慶老和尚行狀
steles.author: 天然函昰
steles.author_note: written by his own dharma heir, signing himself 嗣法門人 — a disciple's account for the funeral
steles.quote: 長慶老和尚行狀／嗣法門人　圅昰　述／師諱道獨，號宗寶，別號空隱。博山無異禪師法嗣。南海陸氏子。
steles.note: Both the stele AND the 行狀 sit in Daodu's own 語錄. The 行狀 is doubly valuable: it attests Daodu's teacher AND, by its signature, attests that Hanshi is Daodu's heir.

teacher.kind: 行狀 by his heir Hanshi
teacher.quote: 師諱道獨，號宗寶，別號空隱。博山無異禪師法嗣。
者一瓣香雖本自天然，不從他得，然畢竟有箇緣起爇向爐中，奉為江西廣信府博山先師無異大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: ⭐⭐ FIRST-PERSON, AND BEAUTIFULLY GUARDED: 'This stick of incense is of itself so, and was not got from another — yet after all there is an occasion for it, so I burn it in the censer for MY LATE MASTER, the Great Reverend WUYI of Boshan in Guangxin prefecture, Jiangxi, to repay the milk of the dharma.' He acknowledges the paradox of a transmission that transmits nothing, and offers it anyway.

teacher.quote: 字宗寶，別號空隱，博山無異禪師法嗣。 [TEACHER 元來 (A000114)]
博山無異禪師有法嗣曰長慶空隱和尚，諱道獨
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 師諱道獨，號宗寶，別號空隱。博山無異禪師法嗣。
長慶宗寶禪師語錄六卷 明道獨說并序，今釋重編，圅昰序，有塔銘、行狀…青原下第三十六世，嗣無異來。
字宗寶，別號空隱，博山無異禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 壽六十二，坐夏三十又三
dates.note: d. 順治十八年七月廿二日 = 1661-08-16, aged 62 → b. 1600. DILA A001554 agrees exactly.

dates.quote: 順治辛丑七月二十二日，世壽六十二 (via DILA A001554)
dates.note: Death 1661-08-16, aged 62 → birth 1600.

school.quote: Caodong (壽昌 branch); the Dafo temple source calls him the 33rd generation, 天然 the 34th

links.label: DILA Authority A001554
links.confirms: dates 1600-1661, teacher Wuyi Yuanlai, the 塔銘 title, heirs Tianran Hanshi and Hanke

links.label: Baidu 道独
links.confirms: his abbacies incl. Luofu, Changqing, Xichan, Haichuang

bio: Of the Pan 潘 family of Shanghai; also called Daoxiong. Born on the third of the fifth month of 1632. Dharma heir of Zhu'an Zhenyan — 'the true son of Zhu'an, whose tallying with him was deepest' — he opened the dharma at Lianhua monastery at Wumen (Suzhou), where his eye of the way was clear and his forging of students exacting. His record was edited by his own disciples and prefaced in 1673 by Luo Zhenxing, who wrote that he was fit to revive the way of Cheqi and Jinming and shed light on Duanqiao.

teacher.kind: 序 by 羅真性 to his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 竹菴和尚真子，機契最湥，開法吳門之蓮華寺，道眼圓明，鉗錘妙密，洵足振興車溪、金明之法道，而有光於斷橋矣。…康熙癸丑仲春，秀水羅真性敬書。
teacher.note: '真子' — true (dharma) son of Zhu'an. A named contemporary, 1673. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 古林如禪師語錄四卷 清機如說，全威等錄，羅真性序，項謙序，有像、贊、傳、啟。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣竹庵衍。

dates.source: DILA A001805 (《古林如禪師語錄》卷1〈古林如禪師傳〉)
dates.quote: 崇禎壬申年午月之三日誕生
dates.note: Birth 1632-06-20. No death date attested.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Linji master of Xiangyan, thirty-seventh generation below Nanyue. Dharma heir of Xianglin Zhen (象林本真, 1620–1691). He re-cut and reissued his teacher's recorded sayings and also re-edited the collected writings of Zhengjue Runguang Ze — the acts of a literary executor to his own line. His own 語錄 carries a 行實.

steles.title: 香巖洗心水禪師語錄 — 行實
steles.note: The Jiaxing catalogue records 「香巖洗心水禪師語錄一卷 清照水說，實雲、海清等編…文止跋、有行實」. Recorded as existing; I did not extract the text and quote nothing from it.

steles.title: 行實
steles.author: Zhaoshui himself, taken down by the assembly (「眾啟求再三，義固難辭，遂據坐」)
steles.quote: 余乃建康江寧人…
steles.note: First-person autobiography. The 語錄 also carries 「附瑞巖碑記」 and 「附瑞巖訪…」 in its table of contents (lb 0714a03).

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his enthronement
teacher.quote: 次拈香云：「此瓣香，空王殿裡少分相應，香巖堂前和盤托出，數十年徹骨冰寒，四威儀尋復得失，供養臨濟正宗第三十三世本師象林大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。」斂衣就座。
teacher.note: The dharma-milk stick, explicitly to 本師 (root-teacher) 象林. ⚠ The stick immediately BEFORE this one goes to 「當道宰官、現前檀越」 — the officials and patrons. Only this one carries 用酬法乳之恩.

teacher.source: J/J39/J39nB459.xml, 行實 — his own autobiography
teacher.quote: 末後轉楚，行至東山阻雪，聞白雲象林和尚道風孤高，鉗錘惡辣，因破雪至彼參見。…遂執侍左右，受誨一載。癸亥春日，以源流頂像授之，余辭曰：『某尟能薄德，敢當大任？』尚云：『老僧悉知，汝勿固辭。』余不敢違命，即九拜受之，時年三十矣。受付囑後，仍歸陝西，拜禮剃度師翁。
teacher.note: 癸亥 = 1683. 源流 (lineage scroll) + 頂像 (the master's portrait) handed over; 付囑 is the transmission verb. In his own words. ⚠ Note the careful distinction HE HIMSELF draws: having received the transmission from Xianglin he goes back to Shaanxi to pay respects to his TONSURE master (剃度師翁) — two different men, two different relations.

teacher.quote: 香巖洗心水禪師語錄一卷 清照水說…有行實。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣象林真。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's 象林真.
Supplies the teacher's dates, 1620–1691.

teacher.quote: 白雲象林本真禪師語錄一卷 清本真說，照水重梓，妙心序，有行實。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣鐵關能。
teacher.note: Identifies the teacher as 白雲象林本真, heir of 鐵關能 — the generation directly above 照水's 三十七世, which fits. ⚠ I do NOT rest the identification on 照水's re-cutting of this record (照水重梓): editing is not transmission ('editor trap'). The identification is carried by DILA A016469 below, independently.

teacher.quote: 本真/象林/象林真/象林本真 — 隨州人，姓丘，蘄州白雲僧人。（疑年錄：451）
teacher.note: ⭐ THIS SETTLES THE ROSTER'S OPEN QUESTION, AND WITHOUT THE EDITOR SIGNAL. The roster wrote: 'The 象林真 of 蘄州白雲 in 五燈全書 is the only 象林 found in the lamp records and is a plausible identification, but the 語錄 gives no monastery to confirm it.' DILA confirms it outright — 象林真 = 象林本真 IS the 蘄州白雲 man, of Suizhou, Qiu 丘 family. Two independent sources (DILA + the catalogue's 白雲象林本真) now agree, so the roster's tentative identification is CONFIRMED. Teacher's dates 1620–1691 (DILA A019630).

teacher.quote: 行能/鐵關能/鐵關行能 — 字鐵關，為萬如通微禪師（1594-1657）法嗣。福建清流人，俗姓趙。
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE GRANDFATHER'S BARE NAME: 鐵關能 = 鐵關行能, and gives HIS teacher — 萬如通微. So the line is 萬如通微 → 鐵關行能 → 象林本真 → 洗心照水. Note this makes Xixin Zhaoshui a collateral of Yisou Xinggao (also 萬如通微's heir) — the two Tongtian/Xiangyan lines converge one generation up.

bio: Of the Zhu 朱 family of Linhai in Taizhou; styled Liao'an, sobriquet Nantang, later 'the old man left over from Nantang'. Orphaned at nine, he went with an uncle to Mount Shuangjing as a novice; at sixteen he passed the sutra examination under Huyan Fu and was ordained. He studied under Gulin Qingmao and became his heir, and also visited Dongyu Hai and Dongzhou Yong. He went out to Kaifu at Lishui in 1329, moved to Benjue at Jiaxing in 1333 and sat there ten years, was granted the title Ciyun Puji Chanshi by the Imperial Preceptor, and in 1345 took Lingyan at Wuzhong. His calligraphy was famous, and his letters reached Japan, where they are treasured as bokuseki. He died on the twenty-fifth of the eighth month of 1367, aged 76; when the body was burned, red and white lights circled the coffin, and the skull, tongue and teeth did not burn.

steles.title: 慈雲普濟禪師了菴欲公行道記
steles.author: 宋濂
steles.author_note: Song Lian (1310–1381), 翰林學士亞中大夫知制誥兼脩國史 — the leading prose master of the early Ming and chief compiler of the Yuan History
steles.quote: 至正癸卯秋八月二十五日辛酉，了菴禪師示寂於嘉禾千佛慈雲塔院。九月朔日丁卯，闍維菩提園中，當火之方熾，有紅白二圓光盤旋龕頂，浮空而滅。及火餘，頂骨、舌根、齒牙俱不壞，設利滿地，不可以數計。
steles.note: Appended to his own 語錄ORL (X71n1414-B). Song Lian notes that his life's deeds were already recorded in an inscription by 危素 of the national history office — so a second, independent stele existed.

steles.title: 了菴清欲行狀
steles.author: unnamed (recorded in 目錄, not printed in the surviving edition)
steles.quote: 目錄載有行狀，末刊入
steles.note: A 行狀 was catalogued for him but not printed in the extant edition; text not recoverable from the corpus.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 — 了菴清欲禪師語錄
teacher.quote: 爇向爐中，奉為前住保寧古林茂和尚用酬法乳之恩。斂衣就座，上首白椎云：法筵龍象眾，當觀第一義。
teacher.note: 用酬法乳之恩 for 古林清茂 (古林茂, former abbot of 保寧), raised by 清欲 himself. First-person.

teacher.quote: 了庵清欲禪師語錄九卷　元清欲說…目錄載有行狀，末刊入，又云慈雲普濟禪師語錄。
teacher.note: 南嶽下第二十二世，嗣古林茂; had a 行狀 (not printed in this edition).

teacher.quote: 古林清茂（1262-1329）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十三世 … 字了菴，號南堂，為古林清茂禪師（1262-1329）法嗣。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 南堂了庵欲禪師語錄二十二卷 明清欲說，元皓等編，宋溓序，有附錄。南嶽下第二十二世，嗣古林茂。
古林清茂禪師語錄五卷 元清茂說，元浩、清欲、應槐編…南嶽下第二十一世，嗣橫川珙
teacher.note: Gives the GRANDFATHER edge: 古林清茂 嗣橫川如珙. ⚠ 清欲's co-editing of this record is NOT cited as evidence of his own transmission (the 'editor trap'); that rests on DILA and the 嗣古林茂 tag above, which are independent.

dates.quote: 至正癸卯秋八月二十五日辛酉，了菴禪師示寂 … 師世壽七十有六。
dates.note: DISAGREEMENT INSIDE THE SOURCES: Song Lian's 行道記 dates the death to 至正癸卯 = 1363, while DILA's structured record and its own concise entry give 至正二十七年 (丁未) = 1367, also aged 76. DILA's death field says +1367-09-27 but quotes the 癸卯 passage — DILA is internally inconsistent. I took 1367 (matching DILA's structured field and the 至正二十七年 reading), but the stele itself says 癸卯/1363. BOTH RECORDED; this needs an eye on the original.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第二十三世

bio: Lay name Xu Ji'en (also Xu Shichen) of Qiantang. He passed the mingjing examination and lived as a scholar, only ordaining at about forty-six. Caodong heir of Sanyi Mingyu (1599–1665), himself an heir of Zhanran Yuancheng; thirty-seventh generation below Qingyuan. He was abbot of Ciyun, Fanshou and Xiansheng. A prolific writer, he left the Xuefo kaoxun, the Qiyuan zhitong (a Chan reading of the Zhuangzi) and Yuejing shi'er zhong, besides his eighteen-juan record — a scholar's bibliography as much as a monk's. He was born on the fourth of the tenth month of 1615 and died on the twenty-fourth of the ninth month of 1684, aged 70.

steles.title: 俍亭挺禪師塔誌銘
steles.author: 毛奇齡
steles.author_note: Mao Qiling (1623–1716), the Qing classicist — the inscription is in his 西河文集, vol. 9
steles.quote: 生於明萬曆四十三年十月四日 … 卒於清康熙二十三年九月二十四日，世壽七十。
steles.note: NOT IN THE CBETA CORPUS — it survives in Mao Qiling's collected works. Cited via DILA A001106, which quotes it for both dates. I have not seen the full text, so I quote only what DILA quotes.

steles.title: 洞宗二十九世傳法五雲俍亭挺禪師塔誌銘
steles.author: 毛奇齡 (西河)
steles.path: 外 (西河文集 / 淵四·西河集·卷109 — not in CBETA corpus)
steles.quote: 生於明萬曆四十三年十月四日…卒於清康熙二十三年九月二十四日，世壽七十。
steles.note: pagoda-epitaph by the eminent Qing literatus Mao Qiling; quoted verbatim in DILA. Text is external to the CBETA corpus but is a genuine, documented stele.

teacher.quote: 雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄十八卷 清淨挺說…盂老人序，有自述。青原下第三十七世，嗣三宜盂。
teacher.note: transmission line 嗣三宜盂 (三宜明盂); teacher wrote the preface.

teacher.quote: 錢塘徐氏子。以居士身參雲門盂。（洞上；X82n1571_p0680c07；西河集…俍亭挺禪師塔誌銘）
teacher.note: entered as a layman; Caodong 29th generation.

teacher.quote: 雲溪俍亭挺禪師語錄十八卷 清淨挺說，智淙、智沇等編…盂老人序，有自述。青原下第三十七世，嗣三宜盂。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster. Note that the record carries a 自述 — a SELF-ACCOUNT, the first-person rung — and that his teacher 三宜明盂 wrote a preface to it, which is itself an attestation of the relationship.

dates.source: 塔誌銘 by 毛奇齡, 《西河文集》冊9 (via DILA A001106)
dates.quote: 生於明萬曆四十三年十月四日 … 卒於清康熙二十三年九月二十四日，世壽七十。
dates.note: 1615-11-24 to 1684-11-01, aged 70. The roster gives no dates at all.

bio: From Wanxian in eastern Shu (Sichuan). Abbot of the Huangling Chan cloister. Dharma heir of Chunbei Guangde, thirty-eighth generation below Nanyue — the last generation recorded in the Jiaxing canon's Linji sequence. He co-edited his teacher's recorded sayings.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at enthronement (法幢遠禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: …壑之中，培養根深蒂固。時逢作者，不敢囊藏，只得對人天眾前華劈，信手拈來，供養我現住大悲堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十四世純備先師大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: 先師 + 用酬法乳之恩. Unambiguous, and in his own mouth.

teacher.quote: 法幢遠禪師語錄一卷 清智遠說，通慧等編，弘源序。南嶽下第三十八世〔嗣純備德〕。／純備德禪師語錄二卷 清廣德說，智遠等編，道隆序，有塔銘。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耳毒泰。
teacher.note: Note the reciprocity: Zhiyuan EDITED Guangde's yulu, and Guangde's yulu HAS A 塔銘 — so the teacher is stone-attested even though the pupil is not.

teacher.quote: 法幢遠禪師語錄一卷 清智遠說，通慧等編，弘源序。南嶽下第三十八世，嗣純備德。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's 純備德.

teacher.quote: 純備德禪師語錄二卷 清廣德說，智遠等編，道隆序，有塔銘。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耳毒泰。
teacher.note: RESOLVES THE ROSTER'S DANGLING EDGE. The teacher's full dharma name is 廣德 (so 純備廣德, not the bare '純備德'), his record HAS a 塔銘, and the grandfather edge is named: 耳毒泰. The roster worried this edge dangles 'unless he is added' — here is the evidence to add him. ⚠ 智遠's co-editing of this record is NOT cited as evidence of transmission (the 'editor trap'); his edge rests on the 嗣純備德 tag and DILA, independently.

teacher.quote: 為純備廣德禪師法嗣 … 生卒年不詳。
廣德/純備/純備德/純備廣德 — 為耳毒道泰禪師法嗣。蜀東鄷都人，俗姓李。有《純備德禪師語錄》二卷。（《錦江禪燈》卷14）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S BARE NAME: 純備德 = 純備廣德, of Fengdu in eastern Shu, Li 李 family.

teacher.quote: 道泰/耳毒道泰/天圓耳毒泰 — 長壽徐氏，敏樹如相弟子。（X82n1571_p0481c11）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE GRANDFATHER'S BARE NAME: 耳毒泰 = 耳毒道泰, and carries the chain one further back — he is the disciple of 敏樹如相 (DILA A010077). So the full line is 敏樹如相 → 耳毒道泰 → 純備廣德 → 法幢智遠.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: DILA states outright that his dates are unknown. None found.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Linji master of the Yangqi line, tenth generation. His dharma name is never given — the record calls him only 'the venerable Yuejian'. He followed Xiyan Liaohui, abbot of Tiantong, for six years. On the third day of the third month of 1264 he was invited from the head-seat quarters at Jianfu in Raozhou to take Ehu Renshou monastery in Xinzhou; he later held Tianning and Jianfu in Raozhou, and Jianfu a second time. At the anniversary of Xiyan's death he offered incense year after year with fierce, mocking affection: 'he is a man of the Penglai mountains — only Penglai incense will do to offer him.' His record was edited by his heir Miaoyin and prefaced in 1284.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香爇向爐中，奉為　揚岐第十世前住慶元府太白名山天童景德禪寺西巖大和尚，用醻法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, AT HIS INSTALLATION. He burns the dharma-milk incense for XIYAN, tenth-generation Yangqi, former abbot of Tiantong. CONFIRMS the roster's Xiyan Liaohui — this is the strongest rung of evidence there is.

teacher.quote: 山僧隨這老漢六年
teacher.note: 'I followed this old man six years.'

teacher.quote: 西巖和尚忌日祝香
teacher.note: He keeps Xiyan's death-anniversary — repeatedly (also lb 1041a13, 1053b17).

dates.quote: 師於　宋景定五年歲次甲子三月初三日，自饒州薦福首座寮受請。
dates.note: 1264 — the only firm date. CONFIRMS the roster's floruit 1264. No birth or death year is recorded anywhere.

bio: Of the He 何 family of Tongchuan in Chengdu. Dharma name Chaochuan 超船, sobriquet Zizhou. Born in the hour of chen on the sixteenth of the third month of 1619. Dharma heir of Eryin Mi, thirty-sixth generation below Nanyue. He was abbot at Tanxi in Xiangyang and at Lumen. Zhang Lian, who wrote the preface to his record, describes climbing Lianhua peak in 1642 to see Eryin at Lianxin hermitage and talking with him till dawn — 'truly kin in the dharma across the generations'.

steles.title: 檀溪梓舟船禪師語錄 — 行實 (卷3)
steles.quote: （萬曆47年）己未年三月十六日辰時
steles.note: The record's own table of contents lists 行實 (at lb 0337b23), and the catalogue confirms 「卷三有行實」. DILA A012041 quotes that 行實 for the birth date (above). I did not extract the full text.

teacher.quote: 檀溪梓舟船禪師語錄三卷 明 船說，明法等編，張聯序，卷三有行實。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣二隱謐。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 二隱謐禪師法嗣
行謐/二隱/二隱謐/二隱行謐 — 古渝昌州人，姓金，屺山保安僧人。（疑年錄：417）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S BARE NAME: 二隱謐 = 二隱行謐, of Changzhou in old Yu (Chongqing), Jin 金 family, a monk of Bao'an on Mount Qi. The roster noted this edge 'dangles' because 二隱謐 has no node — here is the record with which to create one. ⚠ CAUTION FLAG: 二隱謐 is the very master to whom 芝巖秀 was falsely attached on an editor signal. This edge is NOT of that kind — it rests on the catalogue's 嗣二隱謐 tag on 梓舟's OWN record, plus DILA.

teacher.quote: 二隱大和尚也。余壬午登蓮華峰，參二隱於蓮心精舍，話心達旦，誠世代法親也
teacher.note: A named contemporary connects him to Eryin in the preface to his own record.

dates.quote: （萬曆 47年）己未年三月十六日辰時
dates.note: Birth 1619-04-29. No death date attested.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

names: 盛京奉天般若古林禪師
bio: Of the Li 李 family of Changsha in Huguang. Tonsured on Mount Emei at six, he served twelve years at Shuanggui — Poshan Haiming's monastery — before his own awakening. Dharma heir of Yusong Chuanyi. He carried the Linji line to Shengjing/Fengtian (Mukden), the northernmost Chan seat in this batch: at his installation a monk asked 'whose tune do you sing, whose house do you succeed?' and he answered 'not before Maitreya, not after Sakyamuni' — and when the monk pressed, 'then you got the seal at Emei and now spread it wide beyond the passes', he said 'you flatter me to death'. Born 1623; he sat down and died in the night of the sixteenth of the eleventh month of 1695, aged 73.

steles.title: 盛京奉天般若古林禪師語錄 — 行狀 (卷6)
steles.quote: 師於康熙乙亥十一月十六日夜間坐逝，世壽七十有三。
steles.note: Listed in the record's own table of contents (行狀, lb 0921a01). DILA A016498 quotes it for the death (above).

teacher.quote: 語嵩裔大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, AT HIS INSTALLATION — he burns the dharma-milk incense for Yusong Yi. CONFIRMS the roster.
Supplies the teacher's dates: 1611–1666.

teacher.quote: 傳裔/語嵩裔/語嵩傳裔/德山語嵩
teacher.note: ⚠ SELF-CORRECTION — EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S BARE NAME, AND CORRECTS MY OWN ERROR. The roster gives only '語嵩裔'. In my first pass I wrote the expansion '語嵩通裔' — I INVENTED that 通, extrapolating from a truncated context string, which is exactly what the brief forbids. DILA A010703 gives the real dharma name: 傳裔. The teacher is 語嵩傳裔, also 德山語嵩. Live-verified by curl (aid=A010703 → 人名：1 筆, renders 傳裔). NOTE a possible inconsistency in DILA itself: A010703's concise describes a death in 康熙乙亥 (1695), while A016498 gives the teacher's dates as 1611–1666. I flag rather than resolve it; the NAME is the load-bearing part here and is firm.

dates.quote: 師於康熙乙亥十一月十六日夜間坐逝，世壽七十有三。
dates.note: Death 1695-12-21, aged 73 → birth 1623. The roster gives no dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Of the Peng 彭 family of Meishan; his clan-ancestor was Xiatang Huiyuan, the Chan master who answered Xiaozong on the dharma and was titled Fohai. Quick as a child — he knew to bow to monks and images at three or four — he begged his parents' leave at sixteen and went to Zhiming at Fabao cloister on Mount Shilong in Danling; he was tonsured and fully ordained at twenty-two. Travelling south through Hunan he visited the patriarchs' traces, and while living near Shishuang he walked the hundred and twenty li to bow at Daowu's stupa on every new and full moon, never stopping even in old age; one night in a thunderstorm the stupa was said to have moved to meet him, and it is called the Thunder-moved Stupa to this day. He went on to Wuyong Quan at Tiantong and Kongsou Yin at Maofeng, and finally, hearing of the renown of Po'an at Qionglong in Wu, went and stayed — Po'an knew him at once for a vessel of the dharma. He was abbot of Lingyin. He died on the eleventh of the first month of 1245, aged 75.

steles.title: 石田和尚語錄 — 行狀
steles.quote: 師名法薰，號石田，眉山彭氏，前靈隱瞎堂遠公…其族祖也。師生而敏，三四歲時，見佛僧即知禮敬。年十六，懇怙恃，欲出家，往從丹稜石龍山法寶院智明…二十二，薙髮受具戒。…已而聞吳門穹窿破菴禪師道望，遂往依焉。一見則為法器
steles.note: No. 1386-C, bound with his own 語錄 (juan 4). It states the teacher outright and gives the whole itinerary.

teacher.quote: 已而聞吳門穹窿破菴禪師道望，遂往依焉。一見則為法器
teacher.note: His 行狀: he went to PO'AN at Qionglong and was recognised at first sight. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 號石田，破庵祖先禪師法嗣 … （破庵祖）先（1136-1211）禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 淳祐五年正月十一日，壽七十五 (via DILA A008260, citing 《石田法薰禪師語錄》卷4〈行狀〉)
dates.note: Death 1245-02-16, aged 75 → birth 1171. THE ROSTER DECLINED TO ASSERT dates, saying 'the commonly cited 1171–1245 is not attested in the text' — it IS attested, in his own 行狀 in that very text. 1171–1245 stands.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Styled Shunfu; his mother was of the He 賀 family. Born in the hour of chen on the ninth of the tenth month of 1612. Dharma heir of Yuanhu Miaoyong, thirty-fourth generation below Nanyue. He wrote and prefaced his own ten-juan record, to which a 源流頌 (verses on the lineage) is appended — a man keenly conscious of his own succession. He was a prolific teacher: the Jiaxing catalogue lists at least seven masters as 嗣介庵進, including Zhu'an Zhenyan, Shanduo Zhenzai, Daxiao and the layman Lu Ying. He died on the twenty-third of the ninth month of 1673, aged 62, with 37 years in robes.

teacher.quote: 號舜甫，母賀氏。鴛湖妙用禪師法嗣
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's 鴛湖妙用.

teacher.quote: 介庵進禪師語錄十卷附源流頌一卷 清悟進說并序，真理等編…南嶽下第三十四世，嗣鴛湖用。
鴛湖用禪師語錄二卷 清妙用說，悟進、悟元等編，明方序，朱喬秀序，有行狀、塔銘。南嶽下第三十四世，嗣南明廣。
teacher.note: Establishes that 鴛湖妙用 is a real master with his own 行狀 AND 塔銘, and gives the GRANDFATHER edge (嗣南明廣 = 南明慧廣). ⚠ 悟進's co-editing is NOT cited as evidence of transmission (the 'editor trap'); his edge rests on DILA and the 嗣鴛湖用 tag above.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at the opening of the hall
teacher.quote: 奉為徑山無幻師祖、南明師翁同伸供養。復拈香，云：…爇向爐中，供養福建建寧府普明堂上傳臨濟正宗三十世鴛湖先師老和尚，以酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: The third incense is always for the transmitting master. He names Yuanhu Miaoyong as 先師 and, in the incense before it, his dharma-grandfather 無幻 and dharma-uncle 南明 — the upper chain, in his own words.

teacher.quote: 鴛湖妙用禪師法嗣。（J29nB233_p0343a21）

dates.quote: 萬曆壬子十月初九日辰時
康熙癸丑九月二十三日，世壽六十有二
dates.note: Death 1673-11-01, aged 62. The roster gives no dates.

dates.quote: 萬曆壬子十月初九日辰時
death 「康熙癸丑九月二十三日，世壽六十有二」（《五燈全書》卷68）

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.source: 《徑石滴乳集》卷5 + 《五燈全書》卷68 (via DILA A010710)

bio: Linji master of Langpan in YUNNAN — one of the very few Chan seats that far southwest. Dharma heir of Poshan Haiming. The 五燈全書 preserves his teaching: 'Shitou said, a needle cannot pierce it. Yaoshan said, flowers grow on stone. Here at Langpan it is not so — it is like standing in a thicket of a hundred flowers: whose nose has no fragrance in it?' His heir Banshui Yuan of Sanfeng carried the line on.

teacher.kind: preface by 聖可德玉 to 雲峰體宗寧禪師語錄, 康熙乙丑 (1685)
teacher.quote: 德玉於未薙染初，竊響慕之，欲求為披剃師而不可得。易菴、大吼，遺聞諸兄親炙錘拂之下，而室中皆不肯可。
teacher.note: A named contemporary and fellow heir of 破山 places 大吼 among 破山's elder disciples ('the elder brothers, personally under the hammer and whisk'). It is not an incense stick and not a stele — but it is a living witness, not a lamp index. ⚠ TRAP AVOIDED: the 用酬法乳之恩 incense in this same file (lb 0976a02, 「破山本師明和尚」) belongs to 雲峰體宗寧, whose yulu this is — NOT to 大吼. 大吼 has no yulu of his own in the corpus.

teacher.quote: 雲南狼盤大吼印傳禪師…破山明嗣

teacher.kind: 嘉興藏 catalogue, via his heir
teacher.quote: 三峯半水元禪師語錄一卷 清元說，光深等錄，華岩玉序。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣大吼傳。
teacher.note: ⚠ generation problem: this makes 大吼 the 35th generation, i.e. a peer of 破山's heirs — consistent with 大吼 being 破山's heir only if the catalogue's counting slips by one. Recorded, not resolved.

teacher.kind: 五燈全書 inline succession statement
teacher.quote: 雲南狼盤大吼印傳禪師…破山明嗣
teacher.note: The inline 「破山明嗣」 tag sits directly on HIS entry. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 破山海明弟子。
三峯半水元禪師語錄一卷 清 元說，光深等錄，華岩玉序。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣大吼傳。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS THE ROSTER'S CONFLICT-RESOLUTION. The roster reported that 五燈全書 appeared to tag 半水元 as 「慧覺衣嗣」, contradicting 半水元's own incense to 大吼 — and judged that a stripped-text artefact. The independent Jiaxing catalogue says plainly 嗣大吼傳. The roster was right: there is no conflict. 半水元 is 大吼印傳's heir.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: The great Chan patriarch of Lingnan. Born in the hour of hai on the fourteenth of the tenth month of 1608; styled Lizhong. In 1642, at the invitation of Chen Zizhuang and others, he opened the dharma at Helin and the Chan wind rose again in Guangdong, which had been in decline since the Yuan. Dharma heir of Zongbao Daodu, whose 行狀 he wrote as 嗣法門人. He was abbot of Haiyun, Haichuang and Huashou, and founded Biechuan monastery on Danxia; he was a noted calligrapher. Though a monk, he held up loyalty, filiality, integrity and honour to his students, and when the Ming fell, scholars, officials and loyalist remnants took refuge with him in their thousands — many of his disciples, as his modern chronicler observes, 'had somewhere to flee to and something they meant to do', and their taking of the robe was not their first intent. He died in the hour of you on the twenty-seventh of the eighth month of 1685, aged 78.

steles.title: 本師天然是和尚行狀
steles.author_note: written by a disciple (今辯 — the 天然和尚年譜 at B22n0119 lb 0988a11 cites 「今辯撰『行狀』」)
steles.quote: 生于明萬曆戊申歲十月十四日亥時 … 示寂於清康熙乙丑歲八月二十七日酉時，世壽七十有八。
steles.note: Cited via DILA A010057, which quotes it for both dates. The 行狀 itself is not in the CBETA corpus as a separate text; quotes are limited to what DILA reproduces.

steles.title: 天然和尚年譜
steles.author: 汪宗衍
steles.author_note: Wang Zongyan — a MODERN scholar (20th c.), not a contemporary. Rung: external, not stele.
steles.quote: 吾粵佛教，自六祖後，宋世盛於雲門，元明寖衰。崇禎壬午間，天然昰和尚應陳子壯諸人之請，開法訶林，宗風大振。顧天然雖處方外，仍以忠孝廉節垂示及門，迨明社既屋，文人學士，搢紳遺老，多皈依受具，一時禮足凡數千人，創立海雲、海幢、別傳諸剎
steles.note: A full year-by-year chronological biography in the corpus, densely footnoted to primary sources — the richest single source for this master. NOT a stele: it is modern scholarship, so I rung it 'external'.

teacher.kind: the 行狀 he wrote for his own teacher
teacher.quote: 長慶老和尚行狀／嗣法門人　圅昰　述
teacher.note: DECISIVE AND FIRST-PERSON: he signs himself 'dharma-heir disciple Hanshi' on his teacher's account of conduct. One does not sign that of another man's master. CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 廬山天然禪師語錄十二卷 明圅昰說，今辯重編，圅修序…
sect: 曹洞宗

dates.source: 〈本師天然是和尚行狀〉 (via DILA A010057)
dates.quote: 生于明萬曆戊申歲十月十四日亥時 … 示寂於清康熙乙丑歲八月二十七日酉時，世壽七十有八。
dates.note: 1608-11-21 to 1685-09-25, aged 78. CONFIRMS the roster's 1608–1685.

bio: Of the Pan 潘 family of Huaining in Shuzhou. Caodong master of Huguo monastery on Tiantai. Dharma heir of Ruibai Mingxue. His teaching in the 五燈全書: asked to set aside the wondrous mind of nirvana and simply declare the treasury of the true dharma eye, he said 'auspicious vapour fills the courtyard'; asked then what the wondrous mind of nirvana might be, he said 'lucky clouds cupping the sun'.

teacher.kind: he WROTE and SIGNED his master's 行狀
teacher.quote: 崇禎十四年辛巳十月十有四日，住天台護國寺嗣法門人寂蘊，於弁山室中和南謹狀
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. He signs himself 嗣法門人 — dharma-heir — of 瑞白明雪, as abbot of 天台護國寺, at the master's own seat 弁山, in 1641. The 行狀 he wrote opens 「師諱明雪，字瑞白，入就別號也」 (0822a08). He also signed the 跋 (0824a14: 「門人寂蘊和南謹跋」) and the whole 語錄 carries his byline: 「明住天台護國寺嗣法門人寂蘊編」 (0751a02 et passim). This is NOT the editor trap — the byline reads 嗣法門人…編: dharma-heir WHO edited.

teacher.kind: preface by 陳函煇 (1590–1646), a named contemporary literatus
teacher.quote: 瑞白大師為雲門湛然大師嫡嗣…宗風大暢將二十年，嗣法門人三十餘數。崇禎乙亥秋，囑嘯雲和尚主天台護國席。丙子夏，囑久默禪師主弁山龍華席。
teacher.note: 囑 — THE CHARGE VERB. 瑞白 personally charged 嘯雲 with the 天台護國 seat in autumn 1635, and 久默 with 弁山龍華 in 1636. 嘯雲 is this man's 別號 (正源略集 X85n1587, 0044b16: 「天台護國眠石蘊禪師…別號嘯雲」). A contemporary, naming the charge, at a dated moment.

teacher.kind: he appears inside his master's own record as 西堂
teacher.quote: 眠石西堂問：「上既無佛可成，下亦無生可…」
teacher.note: 眠石 sits in 瑞白's assembly as 西堂 (senior/West Hall) and exchanges dharma with him — he is physically in the master's record under his own sobriquet.

teacher.quote: 瑞白明雪弟子。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster. DILA also files him as 曹洞宗, confirming the roster's 'Caodong, not Linji' correction.

bio.quote: 天台護國眠石淨蘊禪師，舒州懷寧潘氏子。上堂。僧問：涅槃玅心則且置，正法眼藏請師宣。師曰：瑞氣滿庭。曰：祇如涅槃玅心又作麼生指示？師曰：祥雲捧日。

bio: Yunmen-house master of Beichan at Changning in Hengzhou (Tanzhou). Dharma heir of Fuyan Liangya. Asked at his installation 'whose tune do you sing, whose house do you succeed?', he answered 'the peaks of Zhibo stand fair, their fame carried beyond the seas' — and when the monk said 'in days past you got the seal from Fuyan in person; today you convert the lost here', he replied 'you have had your fill of the monastery, at least'. The 續傳燈錄 records seven dharma heirs for him, among them Fachang Yiyu and Xinghua Shaoxian.

teacher.quote: 福嚴雅禪師法嗣　北禪智賢禪師　衡州常寧北禪智賢禪師
teacher.note: 福嚴雅 = 福嚴良雅. 法嗣 = dharma-heir. His own reply in the lamp confirms the succession: 「昔日福嚴親得旨，今朝此地化迷途」.

teacher.kind: 續傳燈錄 section heading + entry
teacher.quote: 福嚴雅禪師法嗣 / 北禪智賢禪師 衡州常寧北禪智賢禪師
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's 福嚴良雅.

teacher.quote: 僧問：師唱誰家曲，宗風嗣阿誰？師曰：擲盋峯巒秀，名高海外傳。僧云：昔日福嚴親得旨，今朝此地化迷途。師曰：終是飽叢林。
teacher.note: HIS OWN ASSEMBLY says it to his face — 'in days past you got the seal from FUYAN in person' — and he does not deny it. As close to first-person as a lamp record gets.

teacher.quote: 福巖雅禪師法嗣三人 / 北禪智賢禪師…
sect: 雲門宗

school.quote: sect: 雲門宗 — confirms the roster's 'Yunmen, not Linji' correction.

bio: Of the Wang 王 family, originally of Huguang; his father was a tax officer at Danyang and the family settled there. His mother dreamed a monk entered the door carrying a bundle. At seven he dreamed he sat in a crowd waving a whisk and expounding; his mother said 'that is how monks preach — one day you shall leave home'. At fourteen he was tonsured under Zhanran at Miaojue monastery, who asked him 'what have you come for?' — 'to become a Buddha', he said, and Zhanran marvelled. When Zhanran was transferred to Shushan he went to Songyin, teaching at Yunjian, and vowed in a small hermitage not to return until he had penetrated; after six days in samadhi he raised his head, saw a pine, and broke open. Thereafter he never slept, sitting like an iron banner — whence 'Chan of the iron spine'. At Xuanmu he met Guolin, who fitted him like needle to mustard-seed and then pointed him to BAOZANG CHI — the master under whom, after being scolded ('the dharma is like a great ocean, deeper the further in — why moor here?'), he broke through to the source of the dharma on the second night and received the charge. In 1404 he climbed Tianmu for a thousand-day retreat; in 1408 he came to Anxi, found the peaks fine, and stayed. He sat in retreat there more than thirty years, never leaving the mountain, and from 1427 built out the monastery — Dongming — until hundreds lived there. He died on the twenty-seventh of the sixth month of 1441, aged 70.

steles.title: 附刻東明寺虛白慧旵禪師塔銘
steles.author: 胡濙
steles.author_note: Hu Ying (1375–1463), 資德大夫正治上卿禮部前太子賓客兼國子祭酒 — Minister of Rites, Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, Chancellor of the National University. Calligraphy by 朱孔陽, seal-script title by 程南雲.
steles.quote: 師諱慧旵，字東明，號虛白，姓王氏。其先湖廣人也，父為丹陽稅課司副使，遂家焉。母黃氏，方娠，一夕夢僧頂包入門。
steles.note: ⚠ APPENDED TO ANOTHER MASTER'S RECORD — it sits in the 萬峯和尚語錄 (Wanfeng Shiwei's record, J40nB492), not in any record of his own. The Jiaxing catalogue flags it: 「萬峯和尚語錄一卷 明時蔚說…附三玄原頌、慧旵禪師塔銘」. This is precisely the case the brief warns about, and it is the single richest biographical source for him.

steles.title: 東明旵祖塔銘
steles.author: 胡濙 (毘陵忠安公)
steles.quote: 且東明旵祖塔銘．乃毘陵忠安公胡濙所撰。據山茨際公自述崇禎乙亥住東明．於破笥廢紙中所得銘中．並無海舟之事
steles.note: CRITICAL NEGATIVE EVIDENCE. Recovered by 山茨通際 in 1635 from a broken box of waste paper while he was abbot of Dongming. It contains nothing about Haizhou. 寶華通忍's inference: 「若嗣東明之海舟．果屬萬峯之徒．乃法門千古大關係．何以銘中不及一言」 (0477a01)

steles.title: 東明旵祖塔銘 — names the sitting abbot
steles.author: 胡濙
steles.quote: 旵祖銘中云．今其上首本寺住持明覺令僧某某齎行狀徵予為銘。則海舟傳云四眾苦留乃繼其席。然乎否耶
steles.note: the stele names 明覺, not Haizhou, as chief disciple and abbot — destroying the forged claim that Haizhou 'succeeded to his seat'

teacher.quote: 萬峯蔚禪師．寶藏持禪師．東明旵禪師．海舟慈禪師．雲溪瑛禪師
曰．有虛白和尚．說法不異高峯。曰．是誰弟子。曰．寶藏
teacher.note: 虛白 = 慧旵, 'whose disciple?' — 'Baozang's'

teacher.kind: 密雲圓悟 闢妄救 world-sequence, quoted in 正名錄
teacher.quote: 第二十五世萬峯時蔚．二十六世寶藏普持．二十七世東明慧旵
teacher.note: even the party that COMMITTED the forgery keeps this edge — it is not in dispute

teacher.quote: 見果林和尚，針芥相投，然後指示見寶藏持禪師。師具陳悟因，藏斥之曰：「佛法如大海，轉入轉深，那裏泊在此處？」師遂親炙於座下。…師乃發憤，忘寢食。至第二夜，驀然徹法源底。…藏笑曰：「雖然如是，也須善自護持。時節既至，其理自彰。」師受囑別去。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, from the stupa inscription: he broke through under BAOZANG CHI and 受囑 (received the charge). CONFIRMS the roster.

teacher.quote: 俗姓王，寶藏普持禪師法嗣

dates.quote_zh: 正統六年辛酉六月二十七日忽集眾敘謝訣別，眾請偈，師曰：「一大藏教無人看著，爭用得者幾句閒言語」。
dates.note: Death 1441, aged 70 → birth 1372. The roster gives no dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Of Baixiang county, Zhaozhou, in the north — surname Li. Tall, with silkworm brows and a beard curled like a snail-shell; he had been a glazier's craftsman. Tonsured in middle age by Wujin of Tiantai, he could not read a word and spent sixteen years wandering the mountains at practice. In 1633 he went to Emei to feed the monks, met bandits who killed his companions, and escaped alone. Sent on to Chuiwan Guangzhen at Zhongzhou, he was recognised at sight — 'one of ours has come' — and set to sweeping the hall. When Tiebi asked why he did not take the proper road, he answered: 'I'm a northerner, I don't know one character; you're a man of letters, my work isn't yours.' Chuiwan gave him 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one', and after twenty-five sessions he broke through, laughing, and named himself 'the Three-Slaps monk'. He opened the hall four times, passed his robe to Er'an, and died in 1650 aged 65.

steles.title: 三巴掌和尚行狀
steles.author: 譚正乾 (悟眉居士)
steles.author_note: A lay disciple, 'Layman Wumei'
steles.quote: 三巴掌和尚，北直趙州柏鄉縣李氏子。其人脩長，蠶眉河目，廣額豐頤，鬚如螺結。先為琉璃廠藝，中歲從天台無盡禪師披剃。崇禎六年，詣峨眉飯眾，遇寇，徒眾被害，師僅以身免。過忠州，司馬少游馬公送至吹萬大師處，大師一見，即云：「我家人來了。」
steles.note: A full account of conduct, written by a named lay disciple.

steles.title: 三巴掌和尚行狀
steles.author: 悟眉居士 譚正乾
steles.quote: 行狀　三巴掌和尚行狀　悟眉居士譚正乾稽首拜撰　三巴掌和尚，北落趙州柏鄉縣李氏子。
steles.note: A full 行狀 by a named lay disciple, appended to 鐵眉三巴掌禪師語錄. (Quote given as printed; the graph at 「北直」 reads 北直 = Beizhili.)

steles.title: 鐵眉三巴掌禪師語錄 卷一〈三巴掌和尚行狀〉
steles.quote: (卷一; the 語錄 was compiled by his dharma-grandsons 性養 and 性亮)
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own one-fascicle record; DILA cites it as 《鐵眉三巴掌禪師語錄》卷1〈三巴掌和尚行狀〉.

steles.title: 三巴掌和尚行狀
steles.note: DILA A010142 records the existence of a 〈三巴掌和尚行狀〉. My corpus sweep found the catalogue entry for his 語錄 (which lists only 「附文安之巴掌歌」, no 行狀) but not the 行狀 text itself. Recorded as attested-by-DILA, text not located; nothing quoted.

teacher.kind: 行狀 (三巴掌和尚行狀), by 悟眉居士 譚正乾, appended to his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 隱師令見吹大師，師詣方丈禮拜，起拍三掌，大師云：「不許拍掌。」師頓足三下，大師云：「不許頓足。」師叩齒三下，大師云：「一切都不許。」師正身立，大師復令呈偈，師遽答云：「參得三巴掌，真是法中王，不昧家中寶，人香萬里香。」大師可之。
teacher.note: 可之 = 印可, sanctioned him. The sanctioning master is 吹大師 = 吹萬廣真, identified at lb0682b26 (「馬公送至吹萬大師處」).

teacher.kind: 行狀, quoting 吹萬廣真's deathbed verse
teacher.quote: 大師臨終書偈云：「九百星辰一齊下，老僧如象亦如馬，正看鐵眉恁麼來，江頭灩澦實瀟灑。」與更號鐵眉有三巴掌，迺老僧萬里外弟子之囑。
teacher.note: The teacher, dying, names him and gives him the name 鐵眉 — the relation asserted from the TEACHER's side, in the teacher's own words.

teacher.quote: 中歲從天台無盡禪師披剃。
teacher.note: COUNTER-EVIDENCE PROPERLY PLACED: 天台無盡 was his TONSURE master (披剃), not his dharma-father. Association is not transmission.

teacher.quote: 隱師指問吹大師，大師示萬法歸一話頭，苦參數載，始有入處。
teacher.note: Chuiwan gave him his huatou; the 行狀 is unambiguous that Chuiwan was the teacher.

teacher.quote: 鐵眉三巴掌慧麗禪師，則北直趙州柏鄉人。之三公者，皆師入室弟子也。
teacher.note: Named from the teacher's grave as one of three intimate disciples — with his birthplace matching his own 行狀 exactly.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 廣真 (A001662)
慧麗 / 鐵眉 / 鐵眉慧麗 / 三巴掌 / 巴掌 — 聚雲真禪師法嗣。（X84n1583_p0502c09）
teacher.note: Batch CONFIRMED. DILA relation type=teacher -> A001662 廣真 (聚雲吹萬廣真). DILA carries all five of his name-forms under one record, which is what makes the identification safe.

teacher.quote: 崇禎辛巳十月望日，師住夔州府石砫牛南山華嚴寺，結制上堂，拈香祝聖畢，復拈云：此瓣香供養過去吹萬本師，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: DECISIVE — 吹萬本師, in his own words, in 1641.

teacher.quote: 吹萬廣真禪師法嗣…吹大師示萬法歸一話頭苦參數載，始有入處…云我名三巴掌和尚，得吹大師可之。
teacher.note: Note DILA's terse 'concise' field instead says 聚雲真禪師法嗣 — but 聚雲 is the monastery of the same man (聚雲吹萬廣真); not a contradiction.

teacher.quote: 鐵眉三巴掌禪師語錄一卷 明鐵眉號三巴掌說，性養、性亮錄，附文安之巴掌歌。南嶽下第二十九世，嗣聚雲真。
teacher.note: 聚雲真 = 聚雲吹萬廣真 (聚雲is his monastery). CONFIRMS the roster's 吹萬廣真.

teacher.quote: 聚雲真禪師法嗣 … 吹萬廣真禪師法嗣
teacher.note: DILA carries BOTH designations, settling that they are one man.

teacher.quote: 聚雲吹萬真禪師語錄三卷 明廣真說，燈來編，熊汝學序，有塔銘。南嶽下第二十八世，嗣瑞池明。
teacher.note: Proves 聚雲真 = 吹萬廣真 in one line, and gives the grandfather edge: 瑞池明. (吹萬廣真's own 塔銘 exists too.)

teacher.quote: 聯池/月明聯池/瑞池明 — 敘州人，俗姓范，范郡司馬之後。敘州朝陽僧人。（疑年錄：383）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE GRANDFATHER'S BARE NAME: 瑞池明 = 月明聯池, of Xuzhou, Fan 范 family. This corroborates the BIO_BRIEF's own worked example, which quotes 吹萬's stele as 「得法於月明聯池老人」 — the same man. Full line: 月明聯池 → 吹萬廣真 → 鐵眉慧麗.

dates.quote: +1586 … 「順治庚寅十月初十日，壽六十五」（《續燈正統》卷17）
dates.note: Died 1650-11-03 aged 65, giving birth 1586. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

dates.quote: birth +1586; death +1650-11-03 「順治庚寅十月初十日，壽六十五」（《續燈正統》卷17）
dates.note: Batch had no dates; now 1586-1650, age 65.

dates.quote: birth +1586；death +1650-11-03「順治庚寅十月初十日，壽六十五」（《續燈正統》卷17）；臘三十有二。塔於觀音山熊耳菴後。
順治庚寅十月初十日，壽六十五
dates.note: Death 1650-11-03, aged 65 → birth 1586. The roster gives no dates.

school.quote: 柏鄉 (Baixiang, Hebei); Linji, 聚雲 branch
sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派
sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.note: The Zhonghua dazangjing catalogue knows him only as 三巴掌 — the batch's point that the full name must be recovered elsewhere is correct.

bio: Of the Lin 林 family of his own prefecture (Fuzhou). He took the jinshi examinations young and had a name as a scholar. At twenty-five, reading the Sutra of Bequeathed Teachings, he said 'I was nearly ruined by the Confucian cap' and wanted to leave home; his mother resisted, as his marriage was already fixed, and he broke it off with a verse — 'peach red and apricot pale, I hand them all to the spring wind; green bamboo and yellow flower shall be my companions in the Way from here on.' He was ordained under Baoshou Le, travelled Hunan with a single staff, called on every notable master, found the dharma had no different flavours, and came home to build a hut. He was awakened under Dahui Zonggao and became his heir. He was abbot of Xichan on Mount Yi in Fuzhou. He died on the fifteenth of the seventh month of 1153, aged 62, with 37 years in robes.

teacher.kind: the TEACHER's own portrait-inscription, written at Dingxu's request (自讚)
teacher.quote: 鼎需禪人求讚：「身心一如。身外無餘。咄這瞎驢。付與鼎需。」
teacher.note: 付與鼎需 — 'CONFERRED upon Dingxu'. 付 is the transmission verb. This is Dahui's own hand, handing his own likeness over. The strongest thing in the file short of an incense-stick.

teacher.kind: the TEACHER's stele — 大慧普覺禪師塔銘, by 張浚 (少師保信軍節度使充醴泉觀使魏國公), a contemporary and personal friend
teacher.quote: 師壽七十有五。坐夏五十八年。僧俗從師得法悟徹者。不啻數十人。皆有聞于時。鼎需、思嶽、彌光、悟本、守淨、道謙、遵璞、祖元、冲密。
teacher.note: 得法悟徹 — 'obtained the dharma and awakened through'. 鼎需 is named FIRST in the list. The stele-writer says of Dahui 「嗚呼我識師之早。此心默契」 — he knew the man. Exactly the brief's rule: the stele sits in somebody else's book.

teacher.kind: the teacher's dharma-instruction addressed to him (示鼎需禪人)
teacher.quote: 示鼎需禪人
teacher.note: Dahui teaching him by name.

teacher.quote: 大慧宗杲禪師法嗣 … （參大慧）禪師徹悟。住福州怡山西禪寺。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster. He is a genuine, well-attested heir of Dahui — the edge reaches the existing roster, as the roster itself says.

dates.quote: 紹興癸酉七月望示寂，世壽六十二
dates.note: Death 1153-08-13, aged 62 → birth 1092. CONFIRMS the roster's 1092–1153.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 福州西禪懶庵鼎需禪師，本郡林氏子。幼舉進士有聲。年二十五，因讀遺教經，忽曰：幾為儒冠誤。欲去家，母難之，以親迎在期。師乃絕之曰：夭桃紅杏，一時分付春風；翠竹黃華，此去永為道伴。竟依保壽樂禪師為比丘。一錫湖湘，徧參名宿，法無異味，歸里結庵。

school: Not Chan — a Kumarajiva-school Madhyamaka exegete (see note)
bio: A Chang'an man of the Zhang clan who began as a devotee of Laozi and Zhuangzi, and turned to Buddhism after reading the Vimalakirti Sutra. He became one of Kumarajiva's closest disciples, serving as amanuensis (筆受) in the translation bureau for the Vimalakirti, the Larger Prajnaparamita, the Middle Treatise and others. In 404 he presented his 'Prajna Is Without Knowing' to Kumarajiva, who praised it; his essays were later collected as the Zhaolun, the first mature synthesis of Madhyamaka in Chinese. He died at Chang'an in 414, aged 31.

teacher.quote: 長安張氏，鳩摩羅什高弟
teacher.note: 'Eminent disciple of Kumarajiva.'

teacher.quote: 右後秦𪪺始八年沙門鳩摩羅什於大興善寺譯，僧肇筆受
teacher.note: Sengzhao served as scribe for Kumarajiva's Vimalakirti translation — documentary evidence of discipleship, not hagiography. He appears as 筆受 in a dozen further colophons (0077a07, 0199a04, 0326a09, 0281b02...).

dates.quote: 東晉義熙十年卒於長安，年三十一 (T50n2059_p0366a29)
dates.note: Died Yixi 10 (414) at Chang'an, aged 31; hence b. 384. Source is the 高僧傳.

bio.quote: 初好《老》、《莊》，及讀《維摩經》有悟，遂出家…喻為「解空第一」。弘始六年（404），羅什譯出《大品般若經》，師撰〈般若無知論〉呈之
百論序釋僧肇作

notes: Author of the Zhao Lun, the first mature synthesis of Madhyamaka thought in Chinese.

bio: A Runan man of the Zhou clan who left home at thirteen and first studied treatises under Xuanzang before going to the Fifth Patriarch Hongren on Mt Fengmao. He settled at Dechun monastery in Zizhou (Sichuan) and is named in every early list of Hongren's ten chief disciples. In 696 Empress Wu summoned him and gave him the robe said to descend from Bodhidharma. He died in 702 aged 94, having passed the robe to Chuji; his line became the Sichuan Jingzhong/Baotang school.

teacher.quote: 十三歲出家，初從玄奘習經論，後投馮茂山五祖弘忍。 [TEACHER 弘忍 A000237, cited X80n1564_p0003a10]

teacher.kind: Zongmi, list of Hongren's chief heirs
teacher.quote: 陞堂入室者，即荊州神秀、潞州法如、襄州通、資州智詵、越州義方、華州慧藏…
teacher.note: Zhishen is in the canonical ten. Repeated at X09n0248 lb 0261b09.

teacher.kind: 楞伽人法志, Hongren's own words
teacher.quote: 如吾一生教人無數，好者並亡，後傳吾道者，只可十耳…資州智詵，白松山劉主簿，兼有文性。
teacher.note: Hongren himself naming his ten. As close to the transmission as this era gets.

dates.quote: 至其年七月六日夜。奄然坐化。時年九十四。(T51n2075_p0184b28)
dates.note: From the 曆代法寶記. d. 702-08-07, aged 94; hence b. 609. A minority (Foguang-derived) reading gives 608.

bio.quote: 萬歲通天二年（696）七月，則天武后詔入內，賜予達磨所傳、慧能所持之袈裟。著有虛融觀三卷、緣起一卷、般若心經疏一卷。
命處寂扶侍吾。遂付袈裟云。此衣是達摩祖師所傳袈裟。則天賜吾。吾今付汝。
bio.note: The transmission to Chuji, confirming the roster's claim.

links.label: 中文維基 智詵
links.confirms: 609-702, became Hongren's disciple 657, Dechun-si, disciple Chuji

notes: Student of the Fifth Patriarch Hongren. Settled in Zizhou, Sichuan. Empress Wu Zetian gave him a patriarchal robe. Died in seated meditation at age 94. Transmitted to Chuji.

bio: A Silla monk of the Kim clan, ordained at thirty. He first received Chan from Beomnang in Korea; after Beomnang's death he crossed to Tang China and served Chigong for three years, receiving transmission. Chigong was an inner disciple of Puji of the Northern School, so Sinhaeng carried Shenxiu's Northern Chan into Silla. He died at Danseoksa on Jirisan in 779, aged 76.

steles.title: 海東故神行禪師之碑 (斷俗寺神行禪師碑)
steles.author: 金獻貞 (Kim Heonjeong)
steles.author_note: 皇唐衛尉卿國相兵部令兼修城府令伊干 — a senior Silla official. Calligraphy by the monk 靈業 of Donggyesa.
steles.path: not in corpus — text preserved in 全唐文 vol. 718
steles.quote: 遂就于志空和上。和上即大照禪師之入室。
steles.note: Carved 813 CE, 34 years after his death. 大照禪師 is Puji's posthumous title — so the stele itself states Chigong was Puji's inner disciple. This is the decisive document.

teacher.source: 全唐文 vol.718, 海東故神行禪師之碑
teacher.quote: 更聞法朗禪師在䠒踞山，傳智慧燈，則詣其所，頓受奧旨。… 遂就于志空和上。和上即大照禪師之入室。
teacher.note: Both teachers, in sequence, from the stele: Beomnang first, then Chigong in Tang.

teacher.quote: 普寂入室弟子，海東神行師父。
teacher.note: 'Inner disciple of Puji; teacher of Sinhaeng of Haedong.' Decisive.

teacher.quote: 嵩山普寂, 651-739, alt. 大照禪師
teacher.note: Proves 大照 = Puji.

dates.quote: 大曆十四年十月廿一日，終於南嶽斷俗之寺

school.quote: 志空 ← 普寂 ← 神秀
school.note: Northern School.

links.label: 全唐文 卷718 (the stele text)
links.confirms: the stele's own words on Chigong/Puji; death at Danseoksa 779

links.label: Korean Heritage epigraphy DB
links.confirms: stele author 金獻貞, calligrapher 靈業, 813 CE

notes: Early Korean Seon figure (704-779). First studied under Beomnang at Mt. Hogeo, then traveled to Tang China and received transmission from Chigong (a Korean disciple of Puji of the Northern School). Bridges the Beomnang lineage with the Northern School tradition. Attested in the Jijeungdaesa stele (893 CE, composed by Choe Chiwon).

school: Chan — 洪州宗 (Mazu's Hongzhou school) per DILA
bio: A Piling (Changzhou) man of the Xuan clan. He first went to Mazu Daoyi, under whom he was tonsured and fully ordained; the lamp records classify him among Mazu's dharma heirs. He later travelled to Shitou Xiqian and told him 'if one word tallies I stay, if not I go' — Shitou simply sat, and as Lingmo walked out Shitou called after him: 'From birth to death it is just THIS. Why turn your head and swivel your brains?' At that he had a great awakening. He lived at Baisha on Tiantai from the Zhenyuan era, then Pujiang, and finally Mt Wuxie in Wuzhou, where students gathered. He died in 818, aged 72.

steles.title: (title not preserved)
steles.author: 志閑 (Zhixian)
steles.author_note: DILA asserts this; NOT independently confirmed, and the text does not survive in the corpus.
steles.note: DILA: 「志閑為撰碑文」. Recorded as a lead, not as a source.

steles.title: （唐婺州五洩山靈默）碑文
steles.author: 志閑
steles.path: documented in T/T50/T50n2061.xml (宋高僧傳 biography bylined 志閑)
steles.quote: 唐婺州五洩山靈默傳 志閑
steles.note: 志閑 composed Lingmo's near-contemporary 碑文; the 宋高僧傳 biography carries his byline and derives from it. The stone text itself is not preserved verbatim.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 biography (from 志閑's 碑)
teacher.quote: 承豫章馬大師聚眾敷演。造禪關，馬師振容而示相，默密契玄機，便求披剃。
teacher.note: 密契玄機 (mind sealed) under Mazu, then asked for tonsure. Shitou service noted elsewhere; lamps assign transmission to Mazu.

teacher.quote: 南嶽第三世江西馬祖一禪師法嗣…婺州五洩靈默禪師
teacher.note: 傳燈 catalogue places him under Mazu.

teacher.quote: [TEACHER] 道一 (A003623); sect 洪州宗
teacher.note: DILA files him under Mazu and in Mazu's SCHOOL.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, 法嗣 index
teacher.quote: 南嶽第三世江西馬祖一禪師法嗣…婺州五洩靈默禪師
teacher.note: Listed under Mazu's heirs.

teacher.quote: 婺州五洩山靈默禪師，毗陵人，姓宣氏。初謁馬祖，遂得披剃受具。後謁石頭…
teacher.note: 'FIRST he called on Mazu, and thereby got tonsured and fully ordained. LATER he called on Shitou.' The order matters.

teacher.quote: 馬祖一禪師法嗣…五洩靈默禪師
teacher.note: Six independent lamp indices, all Mazu. Not one files him under Shitou.

dates.quote: (元和)十三年三月二十三日…壽齡七十二，法臘四十一。(T50n2061_p0769a10)
dates.note: 宋高僧傳. d. 818 aged 72 → b. 747.

bio.quote: 石頭曰：從生至死，祇是這箇。回頭轉腦作麼？師言下大悟，乃抝折拄杖而棲止焉。
自貞元初入天台，住白沙道場，復居五洩。

notes: Dharma heir of Shitou Xiqian. Named after Mount Wuxie where he resided.

school: Chan — 石頭宗 (Shitou line) per DILA
bio: A Jianchang man of the Zhang clan (one account says Wang), and by some reports the blood brother of Yunyan Tansheng. He sought release young, served the monk Nirvana, took the precepts, and then went to Yaoshan Weiyan, who 'showed him the mind's decision.' He later settled on Mt Daowu in Changsha, where students swarmed to him 'like bees and ants to their king.' He died in 835, aged 67, and was granted the posthumous title Chan Master Xiuyi. His exchanges with Yunyan and Jianyuan became koans (Blue Cliff Record 55, the condolence call).

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988) — 唐潭州道吾山圓智傳
teacher.quote: 釋圓智，俗姓張，豫章海昏人也。總丱之年，頓求出離，禮涅槃和尚，躬執鉼屨。爰登戒地，誓叩禪門，見乎藥山，示其心決。
teacher.note: 示其心決 — Yaoshan showed him the mind's decision. Note the precision the brief praises: 禮 for his tonsure master 涅槃和尚, 見…示 for the dharma-father. Two men, two verbs.

teacher.quote: 智公初領悟藥山宗旨，儼師誨之曰…
teacher.note: 領悟藥山宗旨 — he grasped Yaoshan's essential point; 儼師 = 惟儼 instructing him by name.

teacher.quote: 曰藥山惟儼禪師，其所出法嗣九人：一曰道吾圓智者，一曰雲巖曇晟者，一曰華亭船子德誠者…
[TEACHER] 惟儼 (A010510); 見乎藥山，示其心決
曰藥山惟儼禪師。其所出法嗣九人。一曰道吾圓智者。一曰雲巖曇晟者。一曰華亭船子德誠者…
teacher.note: Yaoshan's nine heirs, Daowu first.

dates.quote: 以太和九年乙卯九月十一日長逝，享年六十七。(T50n2061_p0776a04)
dates.note: 宋高僧傳. d. 835 aged 67 → b. 769.

dates.quote: 九月，道吾圓智禪師示寂，壽六十七，敕諡脩一大師

bio.quote: 俗姓張，潭州道吾山僧人，一說姓王，雲巖和尚親弟。總丱之年，頓求出離，禮涅槃和尚…後居長沙道吾山，海眾相從，猶蜂蟻之附王焉。

notes: Featured in the 'condolence call' koan (Blue Cliff Record, Case 55).

school: UNRESOLVED — see flags. Not securely Guiyang.
bio: A woman of Quzhou, known as 'Iron Grindstone Liu' for the sharpness of her Chan. The gazetteer tradition makes her a NUN of Jingxin hermitage in Quzhou who trained under Zihu Lizong for several years, awakened, RECEIVED THE DHARMA, and returned to her hermitage to teach; she is said to have died standing on her head. She kept a hut ten li from Guishan, and her celebrated exchange with Guishan Lingyou — he greets her 'Old cow, you've come!'; she answers 'Tomorrow there is a great feast on Mount Tai. Are you going?'; he lies down; she walks out — is Blue Cliff Record case 24.

teacher.kind: 古今圖書集成, quoting 衢州府志
teacher.quote: 劉鐵磨，按衢州府志，劉鐵磨比丘尼也。參子湖…受法回庵，廣興化益…後倒立而化。
teacher.note: 受法 (received the dharma) under 子湖 — the only explicit TRANSMISSION statement for her, from the gazetteer. This is the attested landing place for the reroute away from 溈山.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, in 溈山's 機緣
teacher.quote: 師（溈山）一日見劉鐵磨來，師曰：「老牸牛，汝來也。」磨曰：「來日臺山大會齋，和尚還去麼？」師乃放身作臥勢，磨便出去。
teacher.note: The famous 溈山 dialogue — an ENCOUNTER between peers/associates, NOT a 嗣法. Association ≠ transmission.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, in 子湖利蹤's 機緣
teacher.quote: （子湖）師曰：「汝莫是劉鐵磨否？」曰：「不敢。」師曰：「左轉右轉？」曰：「和尚莫顛倒。」師便打。
teacher.note: Her exchange with 子湖 — consistent with the gazetteer's transmission claim.

teacher.quote: 一日參子湖禪師，湖曰：「汝莫是劉鐵磨否乎？」磨曰：「不敢。」湖曰：「左轉，右轉？」磨曰：「和尚莫顛倒。」湖便打。侍座數年，悟徹玄關，受法回庵，廣興化益…後倒立而化。
teacher.note: 'She attended him for some years, awakened through the mystic barrier, RECEIVED THE DHARMA (受法), and returned to her hermitage.' This is the ONLY source I found that states a transmission for her. It is late (a modern supplement to the Biographies of Nuns).

teacher.kind: 古今圖書集成, citing 衢州府志
teacher.quote: 劉鐵磨按衢州府志，劉鐵磨比丘尼也。叅子湖…
teacher.note: The Quzhou Prefectural Gazetteer: 'Liu Tiemo was a BHIKSUNI.' Same Zihu story.

teacher.quote: 紫胡和尚嗣南泉，在衢州…師因勘劉鐵磨云：「見說有劉鐵磨，莫便是不？」尼云…
teacher.note: The 祖堂集 (952 CE, the earliest lamp) has the Zihu encounter and calls her 尼 (nun). It notes Zihu was NANQUAN's heir — so if Zihu transmitted to her, she is in the Nanquan/Mazu line, NOT Guiyang.

bio.quote: 溈山因劉鐵磨來。云：老牸牛，儞來也。磨云：來日臺山會上有齋，和尚還去麼？溈山作臥勢。磨便出去。
bio.note: The Guishan encounter — BCR 24. An ENCOUNTER, not a transmission.

bio.quote: 劉鐵磨久參，機鋒峭峻，人號為劉鐵磨。去溈山十里卓庵。
bio.note: 'She practised long; her edge was steep and sharp... She pitched a hut ten li from Guishan.'

notes: Formidable laywoman nicknamed 'Iron Grindstone' for her relentless debating style. One of few women in the lamp records.

bio: A Silla monk of the Bak clan from Hanju, who crossed to Tang China in 825 and received the dharma seal from Nanquan Puyuan, an heir of Mazu Daoyi. He returned to Silla in 847 with Beomil, and King Gyeongmun took refuge with him. He settled at Ssangbongsa in Hwasun; his line, carried on by his disciple Jingso Jeolchung, became the Sajasan school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools. He died in 868, aged 71, with 44 years in robes, and was posthumously titled Cheolgam Seonsa.

steles.title: 雙峯山故澈鑒禪師碑銘 (화순 쌍봉사 철감선사탑비)
steles.author: unknown — not recorded
steles.note: ⚠ THE STELE BODY IS LOST. Only the tortoise base (귀부) and capstone (이수) survive; the ten seal-script characters of the title are on the capstone. No text, no author. His stupa (철감선사탑) is Korean National Treasure no. 57. Recorded here because the monument exists — but it yields no quotable evidence.

steles.title: 新羅國師子山興寧禪院教諡澄曉大師寶印之塔碑銘并序
steles.author: 朝請大夫守執事侍郎賜紫金魚袋臣崔仁渷 (奉教撰); 崔潤 wrote the characters
steles.quote: 至十九於某寺。受具足戒。聞楓岳□潭寺。有道允和尚。遠遊華夏。纔返故鄉。特詣禪扉。敬投五體。和尚曰。靈山別後。記得幾生邂逅相逢。來何暮矣。大師既蒙入室。因師事焉。
steles.note: The stele of 折中 (澄曉大師, 826-900), Doyun's own disciple. Doyun's OWN stele does not survive; this is the closest stone to him.

teacher.kind: 塔碑銘 of his DIRECT HEIR — 興寧禪院 澄曉大師(折中) 寶印之塔碑銘, by 崔仁渷 (奉教撰)
teacher.quote: 和尚。〈謂道允也〉曩於中國。先謁南泉。以此南泉。承事於江西。江西繼明於南岳。南岳即曹溪之嫡子也。其高峻可知矣。所以大師。從此服膺。不離左右。得嗣東山之法。
teacher.note: The stele carries an INTERLINEAR GLOSS 「和尚。謂道允也」 — 'the Reverend, meaning Doyun' — and then lays out Doyun's own pedigree 南泉→江西(馬祖)→南岳(懷讓)→曹溪(慧能) precisely to establish that his heir 折中 stands in a high line. This is a named author, at a named grave, in a named year, one generation from the man.

teacher.quote: 雙峰和尚嗣南泉
teacher.note: 'The Reverend of Ssangbong succeeded Nanquan.'

teacher.quote: 嗣南泉普願
825년 당나라에 가서 보원(普願)의 문하에서 수학
teacher.note: Went to Tang 825, studied under Puyuan, who 'recognised him as a dharma vessel and transmitted the dharma seal.'

dates.quote: 咸通九載四月十八日……報年七十有一，僧臘四十四霜。

school.note: Sajasan; but see flag.

bio.quote: 847년 범일과 함께 귀국

links.label: EncyKorea 도윤
links.confirms: 798-868, teacher Puyuan, 825 to Tang, 847 return, Cheolgam

links.label: EncyKorea 철감선사탑비
links.confirms: stele body lost; only 귀부+이수 with the title 雙峯山故澈鑒禪師碑銘

notes: Silla monk who studied under Nanquan Puyuan in Tang China. Founded the Sajasan school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools of Korean Seon. His transmission from Nanquan places him in the Mazu Daoyi lineage.

bio: A dharma heir of Linji Yixuan who held Baoshou cloister in Zhenzhou. The lamp records group him with Xinghua Cunjiang, Sansheng Huiran, Dajue and Guanxi Zhixian — Linji's inner circle. Zhaozhou came to see him and he sat with his back turned; his exchange with the tinker Hu ('Can you nail down empty space?' — 'Then smash it open for me, Reverend!' — and Baoshou hit him) is among the best-known Linji-school encounters. His heir was Xiyuan Siming; a second-generation Baoshou, whose name is lost, succeeded him.

teacher.quote: 鎮州臨濟義玄禪師法嗣二十二人…鎮州寶壽沼和尚
teacher.note: teacher 臨濟義玄 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 鎮州寶壽沼和尚第一世住…趙州諗和尚來。師在禪床背面而坐…
teacher.note: his encounter-dialogues; name given as 寶壽沼, no 延, no dates.

teacher.quote: 鎮州保壽沼禪師嗣臨濟玄
teacher.note: 'Chan master Baoshou Zhao of Zhenzhou, HEIR OF LINJI XUAN.' An explicit 嗣 statement — the strongest form.

teacher.kind: 頌古聯珠通集, generational index
teacher.quote: 六祖下第六世興化獎八則，寶壽沼六則，三聖然三則，大覺二則，灌溪閒二則
teacher.note: Grouped with Linji's other heirs at the same generation.

teacher.quote: 臨濟義玄（767-866）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第六世。住鎮州寶壽院。法嗣有西院思明、寶壽和尚。

bio.quote: 鎮州寶壽沼和尚。僧問：萬境來侵時如何？師曰：莫管佗。…趙州諗和尚來，師在禪牀背面而坐。
bio.note: The Zhaozhou encounter — the roster's 'exchanges with Zhaozhou' confirmed.

bio.quote: 胡釘鉸謁保壽沼禪師，師云：莫便是胡釘鉸麼？…師云：還釘得虗空不？云：請和尚打破來。師便打。

links.label: DILA Authority A010726
links.confirms: heir of Linji Yixuan; name variants incl. 保壽沼

bio: A Fuzhou man who took his early training under Huanzhong of Mt Daci in Hangzhou. Yantou and Xuefeng, seeing him expound, judged him a vessel of the dharma and the three travelled together to Deshan Xuanjian. Yantou and Xuefeng each received Deshan's seal — Wensui did not: when he pressed Deshan on what Tianhuang and Longtan had said, Deshan told him to quote them, and struck him as he opened his mouth ('That's so,' said Qinshan, 'but you hit me too hard'). He found his opening instead under Dongshan Liangjie and became Dongshan's heir, settling at Mt Qinshan in Lizhou. He had two heirs: Shanglan Zigu and the prefect of Lizhou, Lei Man.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄, 澧州欽山文邃禪師
teacher.quote: 澧州欽山文邃禪師，福州人也。少依杭州大慈山寰中禪師受業。時巖頭雪峯在眾覩師吐論，知是法器，相率遊方。二士緣契德山，各承印記。師雖屢激揚而終然凝滯。…自此邃師於洞山。存、豁二士同嗣德山。
teacher.note: The passage explicitly SEPARATES the three: 存 (雪峰)、豁 (巖頭) 同嗣德山, but 邃師於洞山 — 文邃's dharma-father is 洞山良价, NOT 德山. This is the exact association-vs-transmission distinction the tradition drew. 大慈寰中 was his 受業 (early) master.

teacher.quote: 澧州欽山文邃禪師　青五　洞山价嗣
teacher.note: 洞山价嗣 stated flatly.

teacher.quote: 自此邃師於洞山。存、豁二士同嗣德山。
teacher.note: 'From this, [Wen]sui took DONGSHAN as his master; Cun (Xuefeng) and Huo (Yantou), the two men, together succeeded DESHAN.' The text explicitly splits them.

teacher.quote: 澧州欽山文邃禪師，福州人也。少依杭州大慈山寰中禪師受業。時巖頭雪峯在眾覩師吐論，知是法器，相率遊方。二士緣契德山，各承印記。師雖屢激揚而終然凝滯。
teacher.note: Note the precision: the two received Deshan's seal; he 'remained stuck.'

teacher.quote: 澧州欽山文邃禪師 青五 洞山价嗣
一曰澧州欽山文邃者
teacher.note: Among Dongshan's heirs.

teacher.quote: 袁州洞山良价禪師法嗣，福州人。少依杭州大慈山寰中禪師受業。 [TEACHER 良价]

bio.quote: 德曰：汝試舉天皇、龍潭道底看。欽擬進語，德便打。欽曰：是即是，打我太煞。
曰澧州欽山文邃禪師。其所出法嗣二人。一曰洪州上藍自古者。一曰澧州太守雷滿者。

links.label: DILA Authority A020722
links.confirms: teacher Dongshan Liangjie, native of Fuzhou, first teacher Dazi Huanzhong

notes: From Fuzhou. First studied under Deshan Xuanjian alongside Yantou and Xuefeng, then became a dharma heir of Dongshan Liangjie. Achieved great enlightenment at age twenty-seven and became abbot of Mount Qin. Known for the 'one arrow piercing three barriers' exchange.

bio: A Fuzhou man of the Liu clan, of Houguan county, who served as Shishuang Qingzhu's attendant and received his seal. When Shishuang died the assembly moved to install the head monk; Daoqian objected that one must first understand the late master's meaning, and quoted Shishuang's words — 'cease, desist; go cold and desolate; go one-thought-ten-thousand-years; go cold ash and withered wood; go like the censer of an old shrine; go like a single strip of white silk.' The head monk answered that it only clarified 'the matter of the One Colour'; Daoqian rejected him. The head monk then sat down and died on the spot — and Daoqian still would not acknowledge him. He taught at Mt Jiufeng in Junzhou and left ten heirs, among them Tong'an Changcha.

teacher.quote: 潭州石霜慶諸禪師法嗣：筠州九峰道虔禪師…福州劉氏子。師為石霜侍者，霜遷化…
teacher.note: 傳燈 — attendant of and heir to 石霜慶諸.

teacher.quote: 筠州九峯道虔禪師。福州侯官人也。姓劉氏。遍歷法會。後受石霜印記。化徒於九峯焉。
teacher.note: 景德傳燈錄 — 受石霜印記 (received the seal), transmission confirmed.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, entry under heading
teacher.quote: 潭州石霜慶諸禪師法嗣：筠州九峰道虔禪師…福州劉氏子。師為石霜侍者，霜遷化…
teacher.note: Under Shishuang's 法嗣 heading; and he was Shishuang's ATTENDANT.

teacher.source: T/T51/T51n2076.xml (景德傳燈錄 j.16, via subagent)
teacher.quote: 筠州九峯道虔禪師。福州侯官人也。姓劉氏。遍歷法會。後受石霜印記。化徒於九峯焉。
teacher.note: 'He received SHISHUANG'S SEAL (印記).'

teacher.quote: 青五 石霜諸嗣：九峰道虔、湧泉景欣、覆船洪薦
[TEACHER] 慶諸

school.note: 青原下 = Qingyuan/Shitou branch, 5th gen.

bio.quote: 在石霜典侍司，會霜遷化，眾欲舉首座繼席，峰白眾曰：須明得先師意始可住。座曰：先師有什麼意？峰遂問：先師道：休去，歇去，冷湫湫地去，一念萬年去…
舉九峰道虔禪師不肯泰首座機緣，「香煙未斷，便能脫去，若非昔日工夫，焉能如此？」
bio.note: 'Before the incense smoke had ceased he was able to slough off' — the head monk (Head Monk Tai) dying on the spot, and Daoqian still refusing him. This is Book of Serenity case 96.

bio.quote: 曰筠州九峰道虔禪師。其所出法嗣凡一十人。…一曰洪州同安常察者。

links.label: DILA Authority A020114
links.confirms: teacher Shishuang Qingzhu, native of Houguan/Fuzhou, surname Liu; NO dates

notes: After Shishuang's death, challenged the assembly about understanding the late master.

bio: A KOREAN — a man of Silla — who came to Tang China and became a dharma heir of Nanta Guangyong at Mt Yangshan, arriving (per Terebess) at twenty-eight. He taught at Mt Bajiao in Yingzhou and carried the Guiyang school in the fourth generation from Guishan. He is the master of the staff: 'If you have a staff, I will give you a staff; if you have no staff, I will take your staff away' — after which he leaned on his staff and left the hall. That is case 44 of the Gateless Gate. His heirs included Jicheve Jiche, Xingyang Qingrang and Yougu Faman.

teacher.quote: 〔南塔光涌〕禪師法嗣五人：越州清化全付禪師　郢州芭蕉山慧清禪師　韶州黃連山義初禪師　韶州慧林鴻究禪師…洪州黃龍山忠和尚
teacher.note: The list immediately preceding 「袁州仰山西塔光穆禪師法嗣」 — i.e. it belongs to 南塔光涌, the other of the two Yangshan pagoda-masters. The two are one character apart (涌/穆) and are the classic way to get this man wrong.

teacher.quote: 郢州芭蕉慧清禪師　南六　南塔涌嗣
芭蕉五世徹禪師嗣芭蕉慧清，清嗣南塔光湧，湧嗣仰山徹，乃溈山五世孫也。
曰袁州仰山南塔光涌禪師。其所出法嗣五人。…一曰郢州芭蕉慧清者。
teacher.note: Nanta Guangyong's five heirs.

teacher.quote: 郢州芭蕉慧清禪師 南六 南塔涌嗣

bio: A Jizhou man of the Jia clan who was ordained at about twenty at Baoshou cloister in Yizhou, then travelled south. In 986 he met Shoushan Shengnian, who held up a bamboo staff: 'Do not call it a bamboo staff. Call it a bamboo staff and you touch it; do not call it a bamboo staff and you turn your back on it. What do you call it?' Guisheng stepped forward, snatched it, hurled it down the steps and said 'Where is it?' Shoushan barked: 'Blind!' — and at that word he had a great awakening. He stayed at Shoushan's side for several years carrying his towel and water-jar. In 1009 he took over the Guangjiao Chan cloister at Shexian in Ruzhou. His heirs included Fushan Fayuan, through whom the Caodong line was preserved.

bio: A Qingshe man of the Li clan who went forth at seven and passed the sutra examination at fifteen. He turned to the Huayan, and on the words 'the mind itself is one's own nature' had an opening — people called him 'Qing the Huayan.' He then studied six years under Fushan Fayuan at Shengyan, where he awakened; Fayuan, a Linji master holding the portrait, robe and sandals of the long-dead Caodong master Dayang Jingxuan in trust, entrusted them to Yiqing and ORDERED HIM TO SUCCEED DAYANG. He led Baiyun Haihui from 1073, then Mt Touzi. He died in 1083, aged 52, with 37 years in robes, and was granted the title Great Master Miaoxu. His chief heir was Furong Daokai; through him the Caodong line survived.

teacher.note: ⚠ THE TRAP CORRECTLY NAVIGATED. He raises THREE sticks: the first for the emperor, the second for the officials, and the THIRD — 'do you all know where it lands?' — 恭為 大陽山明安禪師 (Dayang Jingxuan). His dharma-incense goes to Dayang, NOT to Fushan Fayuan who actually taught and awakened him. This is exactly why the batch's teacher field (Dayang Jingxuan) is right and must NOT be 'corrected' to Fayuan.

teacher.quote: 又經三年，遠曰：曹洞宗風實難紹舉…末後見郢州大陽明安禪師，凡數年方默契，而明安以皮履直裰付囑…吾今以大陽真像、衣信、讖偈付囑於汝，汝當續大陽宗風。
teacher.note: The 行狀 explains the 代囑 (proxy transmission): Fushan Fayuan held Dayang's tokens in trust (明安以皮履直裰付囑 [Fayuan]) and passed them to Yiqing (付囑於汝，汝當續大陽宗風). Transmission verb 付囑, twice. This is one of the most famous cross-house proxy transmissions in Chan history.

bio: A Yishui man of the Cui clan, 'hard, unbending and solitary by nature.' As a youth he practised Daoist grain-abstention in the Yiyang mountains before ordaining in the capital. He met Touzi Yiqing at Haihui on Mt Huai and awakened at a word; he served as Touzi's cook. From 1082 he taught in the north — Xiandong, Zhaoti Longmen, Dayang, Dahong — and 'the wind of the Caodong house blew hard through the northwest.' In 1104 he was ordered to the capital's Jingyin cloister, and in 1107 to Tianning, where he was granted the purple robe and the title Chan Master Dingzhao. HE REFUSED IT, and was punished: stripped, made to wear lay clothes, and banished under surveillance to Zizhou. Pardoned the next winter, he built a hut on Furong Lake; in 1117 it was granted the name Huayan Chan Monastery, and he died there the following year without illness, aged 76.

bio: Lay surname Xi, of Ningguo in Xuanzhou; styled Tanhui, known as Miaoxi. At twelve he threw an inkstone at a classmate, hit the teacher's cap, paid the fine and went home saying 'better than reading worldly books is to investigate the dharma that goes beyond the world' - and entered Huiyun cloister. He took the robe at seventeen, studied first among Caodong elders, then with Zhantang Wenzhun, who on his deathbed sent him to 'Qin of Sichuan' - Yuanwu Keqin. Under Yuanwu at Tianning, hearing him raise Yunmen's 'East mountain walks on water', he fell away front and back and had his great awakening. He held Yunju, Yangyu, Jingshan, Hengzhou, Meizhou and Ayuwang. In 1141, entangled in the politics of his friend Zhang Jiucheng, he was stripped of his robe and ordination certificate and banished to Hengyang for years; Gaozong later pardoned him and Xiaozong gave him the name Dahui chanshi. He died in the Bright Moon Hall at Jingshan on 10/8 of 1163, aged 75, and was posthumously titled Pujue, his stupa named Baoguang. He had seventy-five heirs, and his koan-introspection Chan reshaped the tradition.

steles.title: 大慧普覺禪師塔銘
steles.author: 張浚
steles.author_note: 少師保信軍節度使充醴泉觀使魏國公 - Zhang Jun, Chancellor and Duke of Wei, the leading Southern Song statesman.
steles.quote: 隆興元年。八月十日。大慧禪師宗杲。示寂于徑山明月堂。皇帝聞之嗟惜。詔以明月堂為妙喜菴。賜諡普覺。塔曰寶光。用寵賁之。其徒以師全身。葬於菴之後。使了賢來請銘。
steles.note: A first-rank stele by a named chancellor, appended to fascicle 6 of Dahui's own recorded sayings. 'The emperor sighed at the news, ordered the Bright Moon Hall to become Miaoxi hermitage, granted the posthumous name Pujue and named his stupa Baoguang... his disciples buried his whole body behind the hermitage and sent Liaoxian to ask for this inscription.' Also carried in the Jingshan gazetteer (GA032n0032 0527a05).

steles.title: 大慧普覺禪師年譜
steles.author: 祖詠
steles.author_note: with a preface by 張掄 and a postface by 宗演
steles.quote: 師宣州寧國縣人也，姓奚氏。其母初夢神人衛一僧，黑頰而隆鼻，造于臥室。問其何所居？對曰：「嶽北。」覺而有娠。及誕之日，白光透室，舉邑歎異，實是年十一月初十日巳時也。
steles.note: A full year-by-year chronicle. ⚠ AND IT IS A DOCUMENTED CASE OF EDITORIAL CORRECTION: the postface (0807b09) records that Zongyan, finding the 年譜 full of errors, obtained Yunwo's critical notes and in 1205 「刪入六十餘處」 - amended it in over sixty places - 'otherwise the argument over right and wrong will never rest.' A chronicle that had to be fixed.

teacher.quote: 堂疾革，囑師曰：「吾去後，當見川勤，必能盡子機用。」勤，即圓悟…師至天寧，一日聞悟陞堂，舉僧問雲門：「如何是諸佛出身處？」門曰：「東山水上行。」…師於言下忽然前後際斷。

bio: Born at Songyuan in Longquan, Chuzhou, of the Wu clan — he took his sobriquet from his birthplace. He left home at twenty-three and took the five precepts at Tianming monastery. He went first to Lingshi Miao, then to Dahui Zonggao at Jingshan; hearing Dahui praise Ying'an Tanhua as 'direct and quick with people,' he set out before daybreak. Under Ying'an he raised the 'dog has no buddha-nature' huatou at midnight and broke through. Ordained in 1164 at the White Lotus retreat by the West Lake, he wandered, sailed to Fujian, and finally met Mi'an Xianjie at Xishan in Quzhou. One day Mi'an, entering the hall, asked a monk 'not mind, not buddha, not a thing' — and Songyuan, standing in attendance, had a great awakening. He came forth at Chengzhao in Pingjiang AS MI'AN'S HEIR, and held Guangxiao, Yefu, Jianfu, Xiangshan and Huqiu before being appointed to Lingyin by imperial order in 1197. He died there in 1202, aged 71, with 40 summers.

steles.author: 陸游 Lu You (1125-1210)
steles.author_note: THE poet — Chancellor-rank literatus, Song China's most famous man of letters. He wrote it in his eighties, ill in bed by Mirror Lake.
steles.quote: 松源禪師名崇岳，生於處州龍泉之松源吳氏，故因以自號。… 一日密庵入室次，問傍僧：不是心、不是佛、不是物。師侍側，豁然大悟。… 旋出世於平江澄照，為密菴嗣。… 跏趺而寂，實嘉泰二年八月四日也，得年七十有一，坐夏四十。奉全身塔於北高峰之原。
steles.note: ⭐⭐ THE PRIZE. An explicit transmission statement — 「為密菴嗣」 — from a named man at a named grave. Lu You even records his own commissioning: 「塔成之四年，香山遣其侍者道孚以銘属某。某方謝事居鏡湖上，年過八十，病臥一榻，得書不覺起立」 — 'Four years after the stupa was finished, Xiangshan sent his attendant Daofu to ask me for an inscription. I had retired to Mirror Lake, past eighty, lying ill; on reading the letter I rose without thinking.' Also appended to his own 語錄 (B35n0194: 「附塔銘」). Confirmed by four further corpus witnesses: X77n1524 lb 0203a14, X84n1585 lb 0045a09 (「待制陸游放翁銘其墖」 — naming Lu You), X86n1600 lb 0374b06, B34n0193 lb 0114b15.

teacher.quote: 旋出世於平江澄照，為密菴嗣。…然後知師真臨濟正宗，應庵、密庵之真子孫也。
teacher.note: ⭐ 'He came forth at Chengzhao in Pingjiang AS MI'AN'S HEIR… a true son and grandson of Ying'an and Mi'an.'

teacher.quote: 松源崇嶽禪師語錄二卷…附塔銘…南嶽下第十八世，嗣密庵傑。
密菴傑禪師（1118-1186）法嗣，大鑑下第十九世。 [TEACHER 咸傑]

dates.quote: 跏趺而寂，實嘉泰二年八月四日也，得年七十有一，坐夏四十。
dates.note: ⭐ Jiatai 2 = 1202, 8th month 4th day; aged 71 → BORN 1132. This is the primary document and it is unambiguous.

dates.quote: 跏趺而寂，實嘉泰二年八月四日也，得年七十有一，坐夏四十。
dates.note: All four independent witnesses read 嘉泰二年 (1202). Not one reads 嘉定二年.

dates.quote: +1202-08-29; 嘉泰二年八月四日也。得年七十有一（渭南文集．卷40 = Lu You's collected works）

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 年二十三棄家，衣掃塔服，受五戒於天明寺。首造靈石妙禪師，繼見大慧杲禪師於徑山…中夜自舉狗子無佛性話，豁然有得…慶元丁巳年適靈隱虗席…居六年

links.label: DILA Authority A001037
links.confirms: teacher Mi'an Xianjie; structured dates 1132-1202 (note the internal contradiction in its prose)

links.label: zh.Wikipedia 釋崇岳
links.confirms: 1132-1202, died 8th month 4th day aged 71, whole-body stupa at North High Peak

notes: Founded the Songyuan sub-lineage. His two main dharma heirs Po'an Zuxian and Yunan Puyan produced the lineages of Wuzhun Shifan and Xutang Zhiyu respectively.

bio: A Xiangshan man of Siming, of the Chen clan, ordained at sixteen at Puming monastery. He first went to Xuedou Huan and Zhong'an Jiao, and got the point under Yun'an Puyan.
