The master ROARED WITH LAUGHTER AND WALKED STRAIGHT OUT, and Kuchan deeply approved him. When Kuchan moved to Lingyin, he served as inner secretary; he went home to see his aged mother. He became abbot of the King Asoka (Yuwang) monastery at Qingyuan (Ningbo).

teacher.quote: 天童鏡嗣…慶元育王寂窗有照禪師…時枯禪鏡唱道怡山，師往見之…鏡深肯之。
teacher.note: 五燈嚴統 — teacher 枯禪自鏡 (天童鏡) confirmed; 深肯之 = approval.

teacher.kind: 續燈存稿, entry under heading
teacher.quote: 天童鏡嗣慶元育王寂窗有照禪師慶元育王寂窗有照禪師福之，閩縣鄧氏子。時枯禪鏡唱道怡山，師往見之。一日，鏡問曰：自從一見桃華後，直至如今更不疑。那裏是他不疑處？師大笑趨出，鏡深肯之。
teacher.note: ⭐ Under the heading 「天童鏡嗣」 — HEIR OF TIANTONG JING (= Kuchan Zijing). Teacher, native place, lay surname and the awakening exchange, all in one entry.

teacher.quote: …育王寂窗有照禪師…已上七人天童鏡嗣
teacher.note: One of seven heirs of Tiantong Jing.

teacher.kind: 五燈全書 index, on the teacher
teacher.quote: 南嶽下第十八世天童傑禪師法嗣：破庵祖先禪師、靈隱松源崇嶽禪師、薦福曹源道生禪師、天童枯禪自鏡禪師…
teacher.note: ⭐⭐ HIS TEACHER'S TEACHER, CONFIRMED — and it lands inside this batch: 枯禪自鏡 is an heir of 天童[密庵咸]傑 = MI'AN XIANJIE, listed side by side with SONGYUAN CHONGYUE. The harvest note proposed exactly this. Confirmed.

bio: A Wuning man of the Chen clan. He became a full monk at seventeen and went to Chan master An of Yan'en, who sent him on to HUITANG ZUXIN at Mt Huanglong. There he kept the assembly's hours but his questions and answers came to nothing — until, having been reading Xuansha's sayings, he grew tired and took a walk; walking fast, HE WALKED OUT OF HIS SANDAL, and stooping to pick it up, HE HAD A GREAT AWAKENING. For ten years he refused abbacies; he finally took Taiping at Shuzhou, then HUANGLONG itself. He was a celebrated letter-writer and a friend of the poet Huang Tingjian and the philosopher Cheng Yi. He died in 1117 and was titled Chan Master Foshou.

steles.title: 無生常住真歸誥
steles.author: 靈源惟清 HIMSELF, ten days before his death, 1117
steles.quote: 賢劫第四尊釋迦文佛直下第四十八世孫惟清，雖從本覺應緣出生，而了緣即空，初無自性。氏族親里莫得而詳，但以正因一念為所宗承…慎勿隨末法所尚，乞空文於有位，求為銘誌，張飾說，以浼吾。至囑至囑。因自所敘，曰《無生常住真歸誥》，且繫之以銘。銘曰：無涯湛海，瞥起一漚，亘乎百年，曷浮曷休…
steles.note: ⚠ EXTRAORDINARY — AND IT IS THE OPPOSITE OF A STELE. He wrote his own inscription precisely SO THAT no one would carve him one: 'do not follow what this final age esteems — begging an empty text off someone with a title, asking for a memorial, decking it out with talk, to defile me. I charge you, I charge you.' 「氏族親里莫得而詳」 — 'his clan and village cannot be known in detail' — HE ERASED HIS OWN BIRTH DATA ON PURPOSE. That is why he has no birth year: it is not a gap in the record, it is his instruction. His disciples obeyed: 「門弟子確、誠、克奉藏之，而增修其舊，不敢違其誡」 — they did not dare disobey. Huihong's eulogy: 「無生塔成自作銘，人言無虧寧有成」.

teacher.kind: 禪林僧寶傳, 惠洪覺範 — a CONTEMPORARY who calls himself Weiqing's dharma-brother
teacher.quote: 初閱玄沙語，倦而倚壁，起經行，步促遺履，俯取之乃大悟。以所悟告寶覺。寶覺曰：從緣入者永無退失。然新得法空者多喜悅致散亂，令就侍者房熟寐。
teacher.note: 寶覺 is 晦堂祖心's posthumous title. Huihong writes 「余時以法門昆弟，預聞其論」 — 'I, as a brother of the house, heard his talk at the time.' This is a witness, not a lamp.

teacher.quote: 其見寶覺，得記莂，乃公為之地。寶覺鍾愛，至忘其為師，議論商略如交友。諸方號清侍者，如趙州文遠、南院守廓。
teacher.note: 得記莂 — HE RECEIVED THE PREDICTION-SEAL. The transmission verb, from a contemporary.

teacher.quote: 〔晦堂祖心禪師法嗣〕：隆興府黃龍死心悟新禪師　隆興府黃龍佛壽靈源惟清禪師　隆興府泐潭草堂善清禪師
靈源惟清禪師語要一卷…南嶽下第十三世，嗣寶覺心。
teacher.note: ⭐ 'Heir of BAOJUE XIN' — 寶覺 is Huitang Zuxin's posthumous title. 13th generation. The neighbouring entry gives his own heir: 「佛心本才禪師語要一卷…南嶽下第十四世，嗣靈源清。」

teacher.quote: 隆興府黃龍靈源惟清禪師，武寧陳氏。晦堂祖心（1025-1100）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十四世。 [TEACHER 祖心, cited X79n1557_p0005a23]

dates.quote: 卒 1117-10-22 (政和七年九月十八日), sourced to T49n2036_p0681c09 (佛祖歷代通載)
dates.note: ⚠ DEATH 1117. NO BIRTH YEAR EXISTS in any source reached. Leave it null.

bio.quote: 年十七為大僧，往謁延恩安禪師。安指參黃龍心禪師。師至黃龍，雖與眾作息，而問答茫然。偶閱玄沙語，倦即經行，步促遺履，俯取之，乃大悟。
bio.note: ⭐ 'Walking fast, he left his sandal behind; stooping to retrieve it, he had a great awakening.'

links.label: DILA Authority A008989
links.confirms: death 1117, teacher Huitang Zuxin, the sandal awakening, Huanglong abbacy

bio: Abbot of Longshan at Chenzhou and a dharma heir of MINSHU RUXIANG, who was himself an heir of Poshan Haiming. He was a prolific teacher: the lamp lists five heirs under his name — Bailu Tianchang Hui, Pufeng Changming Jiong, Longshan Liurun Gao, Yunqi Dadu Ding, and Yuanling Zhiding.

teacher.quote: 頴秀悟嗣：辰州浦峰長明炅禪師
teacher.note: The lamp gives 敏樹如相 as his master. Unchanged; unimproved.

teacher.kind: his HEIR's 拈香 — dharma-milk stick
teacher.quote: 此瓣香，大爐韝中幾回煆煉，智竭情枯，一朝契證，惡辣手中得來，逢人觸發生燄，今為酉陽龍山虎谿堂上傳臨濟正脈第三十三世穎秀和尚，以酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: ⚠ READ THE SPEAKER. This is 浦峰長明性炅's incense, in 性炅's own yulu (J37nB401). It proves 性炅's teacher is 穎秀 — i.e. it attests 穎秀 as a real, transmitting master of the 33rd Linji generation seated at 酉陽龍山虎谿, from the mouth of the man he transmitted to. It does NOT attest 穎秀's own teacher. The roster's edge 穎秀 → 性炅 (downstream) is now first-person; the edge 敏樹 → 穎秀 (upstream) is still index only.

teacher.source: harvest note, from 五燈全書
teacher.quote: 萬縣慈雲敏樹如相禪師
teacher.note: The harvest identified Minshu Ruxiang as his master. As with Erdu Tai, I could not independently verify the 法嗣 heading over his entry.

teacher.kind: 五燈全書, 法嗣 heading
teacher.quote: 頴秀悟嗣：辰州浦峰長明炅禪師
teacher.note: ⭐ 'Heirs of YINGXIU WU: Chan master Pufeng Changming Jiong of Chenzhou.' This confirms him as a TEACHER with heirs — but it is downstream evidence; it does not name HIS teacher.

teacher.quote: 浦峯長明炅禪師語錄一卷，清性炅說，海棟編，李昌齡序，有塔銘。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣穎秀悟。
teacher.note: His heir is 37th generation → he is 36th. Consistent with descent from Minshu Ruxiang, but again: consistency is not attestation.

teacher.quote: 敏樹如相 (1603-1672), 破山海明和尚法嗣, 53 dharma heirs

bio.quote: 龍山頴秀悟禪師

links.label: DILA Authority A010077 (Minshu Ruxiang)
links.confirms: the proposed teacher: 1603-1672, heir of Poshan Haiming, 53 heirs

bio: A man of Changshu (Haiyu) in Suzhou, of the Qian clan. He came to WANFENG SHIWEI and asked after the real meaning, and awakened under Wanfeng's staff; he served as HEAD MONK (首座) in Wanfeng's assembly and taught from a divided seat. Wanfeng sent him a verse of entrustment — 'Tortoise-hair I hand over to my children and grandchildren; rabbit-horns I pick up and ask the ford of…' — and Shen Guan, the vice-prefect of Hai'an, who studied under him and later composed WANFENG'S OWN STUPA INSCRIPTION, wrote in it that he had 'long studied at the seat of Reverend Haizhou, the master's DHARMA-HEIR DISCIPLE.' When Wanfeng died in 1381 Puci helped compile the recorded sayings, sought the prefaces, and set up the stone of the stupa inscription. Much later, in 1441, he succeeded to the ABBACY of Dongming as its second-generation abbot. He died in 1450, ninety-six years old and seventy-four years a monk.

teacher.kind: 萬峯's transmission verse sent to him
teacher.quote: 萬峯有寄海舟慈首座偈曰．龜毛付囑與兒孫．兔角拈來要問津。一喝耳聾三日去．箇中消息許誰親
teacher.note: 付囑 = transmission verb. Addressed to him as 首座 — he was already head seat.

teacher.quote: 自念為師嗣法弟子海舟和尚座下參學久矣
teacher.note: THE DECISIVE LINE. Shen Guan, writing Wanfeng's own stupa-inscription c.1383, calls Haizhou 'the master's dharma-heir disciple' (嗣法弟子) — a contemporary stele, 60 years before the alleged Dongming encounter.

teacher.quote: 塔上之銘．屬弟子普壽普福普堅普隱仝西序．普持普華普榮普慈等立石
teacher.note: signs Wanfeng's stupa stele as 弟子, next to 普持

teacher.kind: 無聞明聰 客牕夜話 (his own great-grandson's line-recitation)
teacher.quote: 長出萬峯蔚．蔚出海舟慈．慈出寶峯瑄．瑄出天奇瑞
teacher.note: 蔚 -> 慈 directly. No Baozang, no Dongming.

teacher.quote: 殊不知普慈．永慈．雖同號海舟。其諱．有普永之別。生緣．有吳蜀之別。姓氏．有錢余之別。出家．有破山景德之別。得法．有萬峯東明之別
teacher.note: the 13-point disambiguation of the two Haizhous; see bio provenance

teacher.kind: 正名錄, by 智楷 惟直氏 of Hengyang
teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十二世萬峯蔚禪師法嗣，東明第二代海舟普慈禪師。
teacher.note: ⭐⭐⭐ THE SENTENCE THAT DISSOLVES THE WHOLE DISPUTE: 'Dharma heir of Chan master Wanfeng Wei, twenty-second generation of Linji: HAIZHOU PUCI, SECOND-GENERATION [ABBOT] OF DONGMING.' He was WANFENG'S DHARMA HEIR and DONGMING'S ABBATIAL SUCCESSOR. Both facts are true; they are different kinds of fact. The roster took the abbatial succession for a dharma transmission — the batch's signature error, in its purest documented form.

teacher.kind: 正名錄, quoting Wanfeng's own stupa inscription
teacher.quote: 苕溪花城隱士海安同知沈貫撰萬峯塔銘有曰：…自念為師嗣法弟子海舟和尚座下參學久矣。一日請問舟曰…舟拍案一下，曰：月落寒潭。貫因而有省。
teacher.note: ⭐⭐ A CONTEMPORARY STELE, WRITTEN AT WANFENG'S GRAVE, CALLS HAIZHOU 'THE MASTER'S DHARMA-HEIR DISCIPLE (為師嗣法弟子)'. Shen Guan 沈貫, vice-prefect of Hai'an, wrote Wanfeng's 塔銘 and says in it that he studied under Haizhou and awakened at his words 'the moon sets in the cold pool.' This is the strongest single piece of evidence in the case and it is CONTEMPORARY.

teacher.kind: 正名錄, quoting Wanfeng's own verse
teacher.quote: 萬峯有寄海舟慈首座偈曰：龜毛付囑與兒孫，兔角拈來要問津。一喝耳聾三日去，箇中消息許誰親。
teacher.note: ⭐ WANFENG'S OWN VERSE, sent to 'HEAD MONK Haizhou Ci', with 付囑 — ENTRUSTMENT — in its second line.

teacher.quote: [老師] 時蔚 (萬峰時蔚), citing 《五燈全書目錄》卷11：「萬峰蔚禪師法嗣……海舟普慈禪師」(X81n1570_p0380c09)
teacher.note: DILA follows the 正名錄. Cross-checked: 萬峰時蔚 (A000933, 1303-1381) lists 海舟普慈 among his heirs; and 東明慧旵 (A004724, 1372-1441) lists his heirs as 仰宗能, 海舟永慈, 湛淵奫 — PUCI IS NOT AMONG THEM.

teacher.kind: 正名錄, reporting the OTHER side
teacher.quote: 續略明收海舟普慈嗣東明，寶峯明瑄嗣普慈，天奇本瑞嗣明瑄。
teacher.note: ⚠ THE OPPOSING VIEW, RECORDED HONESTLY: 'The 五燈會元續略 clearly records Haizhou Puci as heir of DONGMING.' So a major Ming lamp record DOES say Dongming. The roster is not baseless — it is following the 續略.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 for Linye Tongqi, by Muchen Daomin
teacher.quote: 二十四傳則有海舟慈，沿流至先師悟和尚
teacher.note: ⭐ An INDEPENDENT stupa inscription (elsewhere in this batch) places 海舟慈 in the Linji trunk at the 24th transmission, flowing down to Miyun. Both sides agree he is a Linji ancestor of Miyun's line; they disagree only about WHOSE heir he was.

dates.note: d. 1450 aged 96 → b. c.1355; 74 years a monk.

school.quote: 臨濟第二十二世萬峯蔚禪師法嗣

bio.quote: 萬峯寂在洪武十四年春，語錄刻在十六年春…塔上之銘，屬弟子普壽、普福、普堅、普隱仝西序，普持、普華、普榮、普慈等立石。…則知普慈等治萬峯後事，未嘗一日離鄧尉也。
bio.note: ⭐ Wanfeng died spring 1381; his recorded sayings were cut in 1383. PUCI IS NAMED AMONG THE DISCIPLES WHO SET UP THE STONE OF HIS STUPA INSCRIPTION and who compiled his record — 'they did not leave Dengwei for a single day.' You do not bury a man you never studied under.

links.label: DILA Authority A004726 (Haizhou Puci)
links.confirms: 1355-1450, teacher 萬峰時蔚, and the cross-flag to 永慈

links.label: DILA Authority A015692 (Haizhou Yongci)
links.confirms: the OTHER man: 1393-1461, teacher 東明慧旵 — the source of the confusion

bio: A man of Yingshan in Shunqing prefecture, northern Sichuan, of the Luo clan — a family of scholars in which 'every gate had passed the examinations.' He was born imposing in appearance and unusual in frame. At eight he lost his father and kept the fast with his mother; that same evening a yellow dragon dozens of yards long was seen soaring over his head to the clouds, and when he pointed his brother said: 'A dragon.' He became the chief dharma heir of CHUIWAN GUANGZHEN, and on Chuiwan's death in 1639 SUCCEEDED HIM AS ABBOT of Juyun monastery — the man through whom the Sichuan Juyun line continues. He was later abbot of Dizang, Yinweng, QINGZHONG, Yunyan, Baosheng and Zhiping. He died in 1668, aged 66.

steles.title: 慶忠鐵壁慧機禪師行狀
steles.author: compiled/re-edited by his dharma heir 幻敏 (「二十嗣法門人幻敏重編」)
steles.quote: 慶忠鐵壁慧機禪師，蜀北之順慶府營山人，姓羅。家世以一經傳多科甲。師生而貌偉，氣骨不凡。八歲，父見背，即隨母持齋。是夕，見黃龍長數十丈，凌霄騰於師頂。師指謂兄，兄曰：「龍也。」
steles.note: ⭐ An 行狀 in his own 語錄, re-edited by a dharma heir.

steles.title: 治平鐵壁機禪師年譜
steles.author: not named
steles.quote: 萬曆三十一年癸卯十月二十日寅時降生 / 康熙七年戊申九月廿一
steles.note: ⭐ A YEAR-BY-YEAR CHRONOLOGICAL BIOGRAPHY — the rarest and best class of source (only 7 exist in the whole Zen allowlist). DILA sources BOTH his dates to it.

steles.title: 慶忠鐵老和尚塔銘
steles.author: 沈廷勱 (法名性宗), 文林郎知新寧縣事, 嗣法孫
steles.quote: 我慶忠師翁鐵和尚者，諱慧機，大慧十五世孫，蜀北營山羅…翁生於萬歷癸卯十月念二日，以康熙戊申九月念一日…言訖遂逝。
steles.note: Juan 20 of his own 語錄 carries a complete stone dossier: 行狀 + 塔銘 + 祭文 + 年譜.

steles.title: 行狀
steles.author: 葦庵居士 文可茹 (中憲大夫分巡雲南安普道…按察司副使, a lay dharma-disciple)
steles.quote: 歲次壬寅八月初八日吉旦…葦庵居士文可茹…葦庵茹僧寮兀坐，閒採師實行之熟于耳者，紀而序之
steles.note: Dated 1662, SIX YEARS BEFORE Huiji died — the author says he compiled it from the master's deeds 'familiar to his own ears'. A living-witness account, not a posthumous one.

steles.title: 治平鐵壁機禪師年譜
steles.author: 嗣法門人 至善 (preface by 李道濟, 康熙甲寅 = 1674)
steles.quote: 神宗皇帝萬曆三十一年癸卯…于是年十月二十日寅時降生。
steles.note: A full year-by-year chronicle.

steles.title: 慶忠鐵老和尚塔銘
steles.author: 沈廷勱 (性宗)
steles.author_note: 文林郎知新寧縣事 — magistrate of Xinning county — and his own 嗣法孫 (dharma-grandson)
steles.quote: 我慶忠師翁鐵和尚者，諱慧機，大慧十五世孫，蜀北營山羅氏子也。生於名閥，世膺三組之榮。
steles.note: 'Fifteenth-generation descendant of Dahui' — exactly one generation below his teacher Chuiwan's 'fourteenth' in the Chuiwan stele. The two steles interlock.

steles.title: 治平鐵壁機禪師年譜
steles.quote: 治平鐵壁機禪師年譜
steles.note: A YEAR-BY-YEAR CHRONOLOGICAL BIOGRAPHY — one of only seven 年譜 in the entire 462-text Zen corpus, and it is his. It is DILA's cited source for both his birth and death dates.

steles.title: 鐵壁舍利塔碑銘
steles.author: 屠粹忠
steles.author_note: Qing official (清)
steles.quote: 清屠粹忠〈鐵壁舍利塔碑銘〉曰：舍利者何？鐵壁禪師覺幻靈殖之所變也。
steles.note: A THIRD memorial — a relic-stupa stele by a named Qing official, sitting in a gazetteer, NOT in his own 語錄. Found only by sweeping the whole corpus, exactly as the brief warned.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his enthronement
teacher.quote: 遂陞。拈香祝聖畢，次拈云：「此瓣香精英赫奕，顯發有時，不自空來，豈從有得？爇向爐中，供養上吹下萬先師大和尚，用酬法乳。」
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick, offered to 吹萬 (Chuiwan Guangzhen), and he calls him 先師. Teacher confirmed from the man's own mouth.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 — the full multi-stick sequence
teacher.quote: 此瓣香一枝挺秀，三聚粹精，無動無搖，根深蒂固，爇向爐中，供養朝陽堂上月明師翁，用酬戒法。此瓣香神出鬼沒，氣辣煙腥，硬似風雲，軟如金石，爇向爐中，供養傳靈山道脈六十二世上吹下萬大和尚，用酬法乳。」
teacher.note: ⚠ A TEXTBOOK CASE OF THE TRAP. TWO sticks, back to back. The first goes to 月明師翁 用酬戒法 — to repay the PRECEPTS, i.e. his ordination master. Only the SECOND carries 用酬法乳. Taking the first stick would have filed him under the wrong man. Take only the dharma-milk stick.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 (a third, separate enthronement)
teacher.quote: 者瓣香名不得，狀不得，常在動用中，動用中不識，今日四番拈出，敬為傳靈山道脈，六十二世上吹下萬先師，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: A third independent 拈香, same man, same dharma-milk stick. 「今日四番拈出」 — he notes this is the fourth time he has raised it.

teacher.source: J/J29/J29nB241.xml, 行狀 (卷二十), by 葦庵居士 文可茹, dated 壬寅 (1662)
teacher.kind: 行狀 by a contemporary, written while Huiji was still alive
teacher.quote: 崇禎己卯，萬師示寂，師念法乳，不忍忘願，廬墓三年，投跡山林，潛確以老。凡所住處，皆名慶忠，取針芥之投在重慶府忠州，不忘萬師水源之義。
teacher.note: 崇禎己卯 = 1639. The 行狀 independently uses 法乳 of the same relation, and explains the name Qingzhong.

teacher.quote: 吹萬廣真禪師法嗣。崇禎十二年（1639），吹萬示寂，師繼任聚雲寺住持。
teacher.note: ⭐ Not only the dharma heir but the ABBATIAL successor — he took over Juyun on Chuiwan's death. Note that here, unlike with Haizhou Puci, the two coincide.

teacher.quote: 南嶽第三十世：忠州治平慶忠鐵壁慧機禪師，營山羅氏子，家世業儒，滿門科第。
如鐵壁慧機禪師，則本川營山人。… 之三公者，皆師入室弟子也。
teacher.note: Chuiwan's own stupa inscription names Tiebi as one of his three intimate disciples, and even gives his birthplace. Teacher attested from the master's side of the grave.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 廣真 (A001662) — 《續燈正統》卷16：「聚雲真禪師法嗣 忠州治平慶忠鐵壁慧機禪師」

dates.source: DILA A001738, quoting the 年譜

dates.quote: 「神宗皇帝萬曆三十一年癸卯十月二十日寅時降生」… 「康熙七年戊申九月廿一」
dates.note: = 1603-11-22 to 1668-10-26. Both roster values CONFIRMED from a 年譜 — the strongest possible date source.

links.label: DILA Authority A001738
links.confirms: dates 1603-1668 (from his 年譜), teacher Chuiwan Guangzhen, succession to Juyun in 1639

bio: The twenty-fifth generation of Linji, resident on Mount Tianmu. He came to consult YIFENG NING of Dagang, the twenty-fourth generation, who esteemed him as a vessel of the dharma and conferred a verse on him: 'Patriarch after patriarch has no dharma to hand on; every man has it of himself. You receive the dharma of no-handing-on — quickly now, pass it to those who come after.' Ascending the hall, he said: 'Holding up a flower and smiling — that is growing a branch off the side of the trunk. Facing a wall and settling the mind — that is painting legs on a snake. Here with me there is no Chan to practise and no Way to study; I simply make each one of you into a buddha and a patriarch straight off. Do you trust that far?' Then, after a long silence, he slapped his knee: 'The sword is named Juque; the jade comes out of Kungang.' His heir was Yeweng Zhenxiao, and through Yeweng the line runs to Wuqu Rukong and Wuhuan Xingchong.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十四世大崗夷峰寧禪師。寶芳住天目，往參，師器之，乃付法偈云：「祖祖無法付，人人本自有；汝受無付法，急著傳於後。」
teacher.note: 付法 = a transmission verb, and the transmission VERSE is quoted. Note the passage is written from the TEACHER's side (it is 夷峰寧's entry) — but it is 寶芳 who receives, which is what we need.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十四世大崗夷峰寧禪師　寶芳住天目，往參，師器之，乃付法，偈云：「祖祖無法付，人人本自有，汝受無付法，急著傳於後。」
teacher.note: Same transmission, transmitted in a second text — with 太崗 for 大崗.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十三世南京太崗月溪澄禪師　臨濟第二十四世太崗夷峰寧禪師　臨濟第二十五世天目山寶芳進禪師　臨濟第二十六世嘉興東塔野翁曉禪師　臨濟第二十七世秀州敬畏菴無趣如空禪師
teacher.note: Places him precisely: 月溪澄 → 夷峰寧 → 寶芳進 → 野翁曉 → 無趣如空.

teacher.quote: REL[teacher] n=方寧 (A015708), cite （明清序：022；X63n1244_p0497b07）
teacher.note: DILA renders the teacher's name 方寧 where the lamps read 夷峰寧. Cf. 東天目昭明禪寺志 on 古鑑明: 「得法於寶方老人」 — 寶方 for 寶芳. The graphs 芳/方 interchange in this cluster; I take the lamps' 夷峰寧.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十四世大崗夷峰寧禪師。寶芳住天目，往參，師器之，乃付法偈云：「祖祖無法付，人人本自有；汝受無付法，急著傳於後。」
teacher.note: ⭐⭐ AN EXPLICIT TRANSMISSION WITH THE VERSE ITSELF: 'Baofang, residing at Tianmu, came to consult; the master esteemed him as a vessel AND CONFERRED A DHARMA-VERSE.' 付法 is the technical term. This is not an encounter; it is a transmission.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十三世南京太崗月溪澄禪師／臨濟第二十四世太崗夷峰寧禪師／臨濟第二十五世天目山寶芳進禪師／臨濟第二十六世嘉興東塔野翁曉禪師／臨濟第二十七世秀州敬畏菴無趣如空禪師／臨濟第二十八世杭州徑山無幻性沖禪師
teacher.note: ⭐⭐ SIX CONSECUTIVE NUMBERED GENERATIONS. This single passage simultaneously fixes Baofang Jin's teacher (Yifeng Ning), his heir (Yeweng Xiao), and the descent to two other masters in this batch (Wuqu Rukong, Wuhuan Xingchong).

teacher.quote: 適野翁曉禪師寓東塔寺，虎丘隆禪師之十四世孫，寶芳進之子，師往謁
teacher.note: ⭐ 'Chan master Yeweng Xiao … THE SON (子, i.e. dharma-heir) OF BAOFANG JIN.' Confirms the edge below him, from the far side.

dates.quote: 正德十四年仲冬廿四日，說偈別眾（X67,no.1308,p.528,c22；疑年錄:358）
dates.note: 正德14仲冬廿四=1519-12-25. 杭州天目僧, teacher 夷峰寧. 野翁曉 (#26) is his heir.

bio.quote: 臨濟第二十五世天目寶芳進禪師。示眾云：「拈花微笑，節外生枝；面壁安心，畫蛇添足。山僧者裏無禪可參、無道可學，直教一箇箇成佛作祖去。汝等還信得及麼？」良久，拍膝，云：「劍號巨闕，玉出崑崗。」
bio.note: His own words survive — and they are good.

bio: A Confucian-trained scholar from Loufan in Yanmen (surname Jia), he studied the classics and Zhuangzi before hearing Daoan lecture at twenty-one and taking ordination under him together with his younger brother Huichi. In 381 he settled on Mount Lu, where the governor built him Donglin Temple, and he remained there the rest of his life, refusing to bow to worldly rulers. He is counted the first patriarch of Chinese Pure Land for the White Lotus society, and corresponded with Kumarajiva on Mahayana doctrine.

steles.title: 慧遠法師碑銘
steles.author: 謝靈運撰, 張野序
steles.quote: 慧遠法師碑銘 — 謝靈運撰　張野序〈無立名年月〉
steles.note: 廬山記 (Lushan gazetteer) catalogues the stones of Donglin-si and lists Huiyuan's own 碑銘 by Xie Lingyun with a preface by Zhang Ye, noting only that it bears no erection date. The gazetteer also lists a 東林寺遠法師影堂碑 (Tang, 隴西李演述). So Huiyuan had a stele AND a portrait-hall stele; Xie Lingyun wrote the stele and the elegy both.

teacher.kind: 廬山慧遠法師誄, by 謝靈運 (Xie Lingyun, 385–433) — a CONTEMPORARY elegy, written at his death
teacher.quote: 釋公振玄風於關右，法師嗣沫流于江左…予志學之年，希門人之末。惜哉誠願弗遂。永違此世。春秋八十有四，義熙十三年秋八月六日薨。
teacher.note: Xie Lingyun writes as a man who had hoped in his youth to be counted among the least of Huiyuan's disciples. 釋公 = Shi Dao'an; 'the Master inherited his stream and let it flow east of the Yangtze.' Contemporary, at the grave. The death date (義熙十三年 = 417 in this text's reckoning, age 84) is given first-hand.

teacher.quote: 於昔安公，道風允被。大法將盡，頹綱是寄。體靜息動，懷真整偽。事師以孝，養徒以義。仰弘如來，宣揚法雨。俯授法師，威儀允舉。
teacher.note: 俯授法師 — 'and stooping, HANDED [it] DOWN to the Master.' The transmission verb, in a contemporary's verse, naming An gong. Also 總角味道，辭親隨師 — he left his family and followed his master while still a youth.

teacher.quote: 遠，雁門樓煩賈氏子…師事道安法師，豁然而悟曰：儒氏九流，皆糠粃也。與弟慧持投簪受業…安公歎曰：使道流東震，其在遠乎！
teacher.note: Daoan's own recorded praise of him.

teacher.quote: 蓮社始祖，慧遠法師…俗姓賈，雁門樓煩人…二十一歲，師事道安。
道安弟子，慧持兄。

dates.quote: death +0416-09-14 晉義熙十二年八月初動散。至六日困篤。春秋八十三矣。（T50n2059_p0361b01）
dates.note: Death from 高僧傳; birth 334 back-computed from age 83.

school.quote: 淨土宗初祖，創廬山白蓮社。

notes: Founder of Donglin Temple on Mount Lu. First patriarch of Chinese Pure Land Buddhism.

bio: Born Li, of Weishi in Chenliu, he was a classically educated scholar who turned to Buddhism late and went to Hongren on the East Mountain, serving him six years; Hongren declared 'the dharma of the East Mountain is entirely in Xiu.' From the Yifeng era he taught at Yuquan monastery in Jingzhou. Summoned to court around 700, he was borne into the palace in a litter and was made 'dharma-lord of the two capitals, teacher of three emperors.' He died at Tiangong monastery on the 28th day of the 2nd month of 706; later tradition made him the head of the gradualist Northern school.

steles.title: 荊州玉泉寺大通禪師碑
steles.author: 張說
steles.author_note: Zhang Yue (667-730), chief minister and leading court writer — a contemporary.
steles.quote: 禪師尊稱大通，諱神秀，本姓李，陳留尉氏人也…企聞蘄州有忍禪師…道信傳弘忍…服勤六年，不舍晝夜。大師歎曰：東山之法，盡在秀矣。命之洗足，引之並坐…神龍二年二月二十八日夜中顧令扶坐，泊如化滅…生於隋末，百有餘年，未嘗自言，故人莫審其數也。
steles.note: PRIMARY, and decisive on two points: it gives Hongren's own words of transmission, and it states flatly that his birth year was UNKNOWN — 'he never spoke of it himself, so no one knew his years.' Transmitted here inside 古今圖書集成 as quoted in B16n0088.

teacher.quote: 企聞蘄州有忍禪師，禪門之法轍也…服勤六年…大師歎曰：東山之法，盡在秀矣。
參謁五祖弘忍（602-675），師深器之，令為教授師。

dates.quote: 神龍二年二月二十八日夜中…泊如化滅…蓋僧臘八十矣。生於隋末，百有餘年，未嘗自言，故人莫審其數也。
dates.note: Death 706 is firm. The stele EXPLICITLY DISCLAIMS a known birth year.

dates.quote: birth +0605 …示寂於洛陽天宮寺，世壽一○二。
dates.note: CONTRADICTS the stele. DILA's 605 (and the roster's 606) is a back-computation from the later legend of age 102. I take the stele: birth unknown. Recorded here so the disagreement is visible.

notes: Foremost disciple of the Fifth Patriarch in the traditional account. Leader of the Northern school emphasizing gradual cultivation.

bio: From Hanzhou in Shu (surname Ma), he was tonsured under Chuji of Zizhou and ordained by Vinaya master Yuan at Yuzhou, then studied Caoxi Chan under Nanyue Huairang. From 769 he taught at Kaiyuan monastery in Zhongling (Hongzhou), where his 'ordinary mind is the way' and 'this very mind is Buddha' made his the dominant Chan house of the age. He died in the 2nd month of 788, aged 80, and was canonised Chan master Daji.

steles.title: 唐故洪州開元寺石門道一禪師塔銘（馬祖塔銘）
steles.author: 權德輿
steles.path: documented in B/B24/B24n0137.xml; full text in 全唐文 (external)
steles.quote: 權德輿撰馬祖塔銘，載弟子慧海智藏等十一人。
steles.note: genuine Tang pagoda-inscription by the chancellor Quan Deyu; existence + content documented in corpus, full text in 全唐文.

teacher.quote: 南嶽懷讓法嗣…開元年間，就懷讓習曹溪禪法。
teacher.note: teacher 南嶽懷讓

teacher.quote: （傳燈）REL teacher 懷讓
teacher.note: 傳燈 places him as Huairang's heir

teacher.quote: 南嶽懷讓法嗣…開元年間，就懷讓習曹溪禪法。
【南岳下馬祖派】南岳懷讓下一世馬祖道一。

dates.quote: death +0788-03-17 （貞元四年）二月一日沐浴，跏趺入滅。世壽八十，僧臘六十。（T49n2037）

notes: One of the most influential Tang dynasty Chan masters. Born 709 in Sichuan. Founded the Hongzhou school, producing 139 dharma heirs. Known for 'this mind is Buddha' (即心是佛) and 'ordinary mind is the Way' (平常心是道). Pioneer of unconventional teaching methods including shouts and blows.

bio: A native of Jianzhou (surname Zhu) who took his early training at Dayun monastery in Yuezhou, he went to Mazu, who turned him back on himself — 'your own treasure-house you neglect, and run off from home; here I have not a thing.' He awakened at that word and returned to Yuezhou. Mazu called his understanding 'the great pearl, round and bright,' whence his name; he is the author of the Dunwu rudao yaomen lun.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄, under 第二世馬祖法嗣
teacher.quote: 越州大珠慧海禪師者，建州人也，姓朱氏。依越州大雲寺道智和尚受業。初至江西參馬祖…師於言下自識本心，不由知覺，踊躍禮謝。師事六載，後以受業師年老遽歸奉養。
teacher.note: Two masters, two verbs again: 受業 with 道智 (ordination), 參 + 自識本心 + 師事六載 with Mazu. The lamp files him first in the heir-list of Mazu (lb 0245b28).

teacher.kind: the teacher's OWN verdict on him, in the lamp
teacher.quote: 自撰《頓悟入道要門論》一卷，被法門師姪玄晏竊出江外呈馬祖。祖覽訖告眾云：越州有大珠，圓明光透，自在無遮障。
teacher.note: Mazu naming him. This is as close as the record gets to a first-person teacher-attestation — but note it is the TEACHER speaking about the pupil, reported by a lamp a century later, so it stays at lamp rung.

teacher.quote: 越州大珠慧海禪師者，建州人也，姓朱氏。㕘馬祖，祖問曰：從何處來？曰：越州大雲寺來…師於言下自識本心。
後至江西參訪馬祖道一，六年大悟…馬祖道一評曰「大珠圓明」。

dates.quote: (no birth or death recorded)
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT. DILA gives him no dates. The roster's 750-820 has no source I could find; I do not carry it.

notes: Author of the Essentials of Sudden Enlightenment. Mazu called him the 'Great Pearl'.

bio: From Xiangyang (surname Zheng), ordained at Longxing monastery at twenty, he studied under Mazu and was awakened by 'this very mind is Buddha.' In 796 he withdrew to Mount Damei near Siming and stayed some forty years; when Mazu later sent a monk to say he now taught 'neither mind nor Buddha,' Fachang answered that the old man could confuse people as he liked — 'I only mind this very mind is Buddha,' and Mazu said 'the plum is ripe.' He died in the 9th month of 839, aged 88.

steles.title: 大梅法常禪師碑
steles.author: 江積 (進士); 祖堂集 also credits 志閑
steles.path: referenced in T/T50/T50n2061.xml (宋高僧傳) and B/B25/B25n0144.xml (祖堂集); the stele text itself is not in the corpus
steles.quote: 進士江積為碑云爾。
steles.note: 宋高僧傳 names 江積 as the stele's author. 祖堂集 (lb 0584a05) separately mentions 「志閑撰碑文」 near his entry — possibly a different stele or a variant attribution. Both recorded; the physical text does not survive in CBETA.

teacher.quote: 大梅和尚嗣馬大師，在明州。師諱法常，襄陽人也，荊州玉泉寺受業…聞江西馬大師誨學，師乃直造法筵。因一日問：「如何是佛？」馬師云：「即汝心是。」
teacher.note: 嗣馬大師, explicit. 祖堂集 is 952 — within living memory.

teacher.quote: 釋法常，俗姓鄭，襄陽人也…「梅子熟矣，汝曹往尋，幸能療渴也。」進士江積為碑云爾。
teacher.note: The 宋高僧傳 tells the 即心是佛 / 梅子熟 story implicitly (via 鹽官安's line) and names his stele-author.

teacher.quote: 明州大梅法常禪師，嗣馬祖。住山後，馬祖令一僧到問…師曰：馬祖向我道即心是佛，我便向這裏住…祖曰：大眾，梅子熟也。
馬祖道一下一世大梅法常。
初於馬祖道一之處參學。

dates.quote: death +0839-11-02 （開成）四年，常忽示疾。九月十九日…辭眾而逝，報齡八十八，戒臘六十九。（T50n2061）

notes: Awakened by Mazu's 'This very mind is Buddha.' Became a recluse on Damei mountain.

bio: A native of Suizhou and heir of Yaoshan Weiyan, whom he served thirty years, he was a fellow-student of Daowu and Yunyan. He afterwards hid himself on the Wu river at Huating, ferrying passengers and fishing all day, and was known simply as the Boat Monk. Having transmitted his dharma to Jiashan Shanhui, he capsized his own boat and vanished; a monk later built a temple at the place. His verse 'a thousand feet of line goes straight down' is famous.

teacher.quote: 華亭船子和尚名德誠。嗣樂山。甞於華亭吳江汎一小舟。
teacher.note: 嗣樂山 (樂山 = 藥山 variant graph) — a genuine transmission verb. Also indexed under 藥山惟儼禪師法嗣 at lb 0314a10 and 0309a14.

teacher.quote: 華亭船子德誠禪師法嗣一人　澧州夾山善會禪師
teacher.note: His single heir 夾山善會 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 唐僧。藥山惟儼禪師（751-834）法嗣，侍其師三十年。與道吾雲巖為同道…傳法予夾山善會禪師，自覆舟而逝。（T51n2076_p0317a25；祖堂集：101）

dates.quote: (no birth or death recorded)
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT. The roster's 800-860 is unsourced; I do not carry it.

notes: The 'Boat Monk' who spent decades ferrying passengers. After transmitting to Jiashan, he capsized his boat and drowned.

bio: From Zhuji (surname Yu), tonsured at Wuxie and ordained on Mount Song at twenty-one, he studied with Nanquan Puyuan and then with Yunyan Tansheng, under whom he awakened to the question of the insentient preaching the dharma and whose dharma he inherited. Teaching at Dongshan in Jiangxi, he framed the Five Ranks of lord and vassal and the Jewel Mirror Samadhi. He died on the 8th day of the 3rd month of 869, aged 63, and was canonised Wuben.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988), 唐洪州洞山良价傳
teacher.quote: 登即遊方，見南泉禪師，深領玄契。續造雲巖，疑滯頓寢。大中末，於新豐山大行禪法。
teacher.note: 見南泉…深領玄契 is a visit (南泉 was 馬祖's heir, not his line); 續造雲巖，疑滯頓寢 = the transmission from 雲巖曇晟. The Caodong tradition is unanimous.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元 / 佛祖歷代通載 lineage line (already on roster file)
teacher.quote: 价嗣雲巖晟。晟嗣藥山儼。儼嗣石頭遷。
teacher.note: 价嗣雲巖晟 stated flatly.

teacher.quote: 价嗣雲巖晟。晟嗣藥山儼。儼嗣石頭遷。遷嗣青原思。思嗣六祖大鑒禪師。
儼傳雲巖曇晟，晟之法嗣名洞山良价。
受指示詣雲巖曇晟，問無情說法之義，大悟前旨。後嗣雲巖之法。

dates.quote: death +0869-04-27 咸通十年己丑三月…至八日浴訖，端坐而絕，春秋六十三，法臘四十二。（T50n2061）

school.quote: sect 曹洞宗；曹洞宗初祖。

notes: Co-founder of the Caodong school. Born 807 in Kuaiji (Shaoxing, Zhejiang). Created the Five Ranks (五位偏正) teaching and the Jewel Mirror Samadhi (寶鏡三昧). Enlightened upon seeing his reflection crossing a stream. Had 26 dharma heirs.

bio: A Silla monk of Gyeongju (surname Kim), eighth-generation descendant of King Muyeol and of true-bone rank, he crossed to Tang China and received the mind-seal from Magu Baoche, who told him his own teacher Mazu had foretold an easterner would come. He returned home in 846 and from 847 settled at Seongjusa on Mount Sungam, where his assembly numbered a thousand and he served two kings as national teacher. He died on the 27th day of the 11th month of 888 and was canonised Great Master Nanghye; his stupa is the White Moon Bogwang.

steles.title: 有唐新羅國故兩朝國師教諡大朗慧和尚白月葆光之塔碑銘并序
steles.author: 崔致遠
steles.author_note: Choe Chiwon (b. 857), the great Silla literatus, writing by royal command — one of the Four Mountain Steles.
steles.quote: 【備考】有唐新羅國故兩朝國師教諡大朗慧和尚（即無染也麻谷徹嗣）白月葆光之塔碑銘并序。淮南入本國送國信詔書等使…臣崔致遠奉教撰。
steles.note: PRIMARY. The stele title itself parenthetically states 麻谷徹嗣 — heir of Magu Che. Preserved in 朝鮮佛教通史, in the corpus.

teacher.quote: 教諡大朗慧和尚（即無染也麻谷徹嗣）
嵩巖山聖住寺故兩朝國師，嗣麻谷，法號無染，慶州人也。俗姓金氏，以武烈大王為八代之祖。
teacher.note: The Zutangji is only 64 years after his death — the earliest witness.

teacher.quote: 我師馬和尚訣我曰：若得東人可目擊者…吾喜汝來，今印焉…已得心珠於麻谷。
teacher.note: Magu's own words of sealing, quoted.

teacher.quote: 馬祖道一下一世麻谷寶徹。二世新羅無染國師。

dates.quote: 國師以文德元年暢月二十七日示滅，諡號大朗慧大師白月葆光之塔。
birth +0800；death +0888

school.quote: 是知聖住山，亦為九山之一，而屬無染禪派者也。

notes: Silla monk of royal Jinhan lineage who studied under Mayu Baoche in Tang China. Founded the Seongju-san school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools. One of the longest-lived of the Nine Mountain founders.

bio: From Putian (surname Huang), he left home at Lingshi mountain in Fuzhou and then went to Dongshan Liangjie, who gave him the Jewel Mirror Samadhi. He opened his hall at Jishui in Fuzhou, then moved to Caoshan and to Heyu, expounding Dongshan's Five Ranks until they became the standard of the forests — for which the house is called Caodong. He foretold his death by noting that Yunyan and Dongshan had each died at sixty-two, and died himself at sixty-two in 901; canonised Yuanzheng.

teacher.quote: 寂嗣洞山良价禪師。价嗣雲巖晟。
teacher.note: teacher 洞山良价

teacher.quote: 洞山良价（807-869）禪師法嗣…次謁良价得旨，价付以〈寶鏡三昧〉。
teacher.note: transmission verb 付 (寶鏡三昧); Five Ranks.

teacher.quote: 寂嗣洞山良价禪師。价嗣雲巖晟。
价之法嗣即曹山本寂，是為曹洞宗也。
洞山良价（807-869）禪師法嗣…价付以〈寶鏡三昧〉。

dates.quote: 天復元年辛酉歲…「雲嵒師翁年六十二，洞山先師亦六十二，曹山今年亦是六十二也。」…春秋六十二，僧夏三十七，勑謚元證大師。（祖堂集）
昭宗天復元年六月十五日…焚香宴坐而化，壽六十二，臘三十七…勅諡元證禪師，塔曰福圓。
dates.note: This gives 6th month; the Zutangji says intercalary 6th month, 15th-16th. Minor disagreement, both recorded.

notes: Co-founder of the Caodong school. Systematized Dongshan's Five Ranks teaching.

bio: A native of Fuzhou (surname Chen), he became Xuefeng Yicun's pupil at fifteen and was ordained at eighteen; after wandering in Wu and Chu he returned to serve Xuefeng, who one day called to him and, as he stepped forward, thrust his staff at him — at which he knew where he stood. He taught at Baofu cloister in Zhangzhou and left some twenty-five heirs. He appears constantly paired with his dharma-brother Changqing Huileng in the koan literature.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄, under 雪峰義存禪師法嗣 (heir-list at lb 0353a19)
teacher.quote: 漳州保福院從展禪師，福州人也，姓陳氏。年十五禮雪峯為受業師，十八本州大中寺具戒。遊吳楚間，後歸執侍雪峯。一日忽召曰：還會麼？師欲近前，雪峯以杖拄之，師當下知歸，作禮而退。
teacher.note: 受業師 AND the staff. 知歸 — 'he knew where home was'. Both roles are Xuefeng's.

teacher.kind: THE ASSOCIATION TRAP, in the same entry
teacher.quote: 又常以古今方便詢于長慶稜和尚，稜深許之。
teacher.note: ⚠ 長慶慧稜 'deeply approved him' (深許之) — and 許 is an approval verb. He is NOT the teacher: Changqing is his DHARMA-BROTHER, another Xuefeng heir, and 詢 (consult) is not a transmission verb. Filed here so that nobody reroutes him on this line.

teacher.quote: 漳州保福從展禪師，福州陳氏子。年十五，禮雪峰為受業師。遊吳楚間，後歸執侍。峰一日忽召曰：還會麼？展欲近前，峰以杖拄之，展當下知歸。
十五歲禮雪峰義存為受業師。十八歲大中寺具戒。

dates.note: Death 928; no birth recorded anywhere I found. The roster's 860 is unsourced.

notes: Heir of Xuefeng Yicun and close dharma brother of Changqing Huileng, with whom he appears in paired dialogues. Produced twenty-six dharma heirs, making him one of Xuefeng's most prolific successors. Appears in Blue Cliff Record cases 8, 22, 23, 76, 91, 95 and Book of Serenity case 71.

bio: From Yuhang (surname Lu), tonsured at seven and ordained at Kaiyuan monastery in Yuezhou, he first studied Vinaya under Xijue before turning to Chan and receiving the dharma from Luohan Guichen of Zhangzhou. He taught at Chongshou in Linchuan, then at Bao'en in Jinling at Li Jing's invitation, and finally at Qingliang, where his teaching reached Korea and Japan; his Zongmen shigui lun criticises the ills of the Chan houses. He died in the autumn of 958 aged 74 and was canonised Great Dharma-Eye; the Fayan house is named for him.

steles.title: 大法眼禪師塔銘 (無相塔)
steles.author: 韓熙載撰; 碑頌 by 江南後主 (李煜)
steles.path: named in T/T50/T50n2061.xml (宋高僧傳); text not in the corpus
steles.quote: 江南後主為碑頌德，韓熙載撰塔銘云。
steles.note: Two named authors: the Southern Tang ruler for the eulogy, the statesman Han Xizai for the 塔銘. ⚠ TRAP AVOIDED: B29n0161 mentions a 「唐清涼國師塔銘」 at 玉岑山 by 裴休 — that is 清涼澄觀 (Huayan patriarch), a DIFFERENT 清涼, not Fayan Wenyi. J15nB005's 「御讚清涼國師碑銘」 is likewise 澄觀 (開成三年). I did not conflate them.

teacher.quote: 遂參宣法大師——曾住漳浦羅漢，閩人止呼羅漢…益疑山頓摧，正路斯得，欣欣然挂囊栖止，變塗迴軌，確乎不拔。
teacher.note: 宣法大師 = 羅漢桂琛. His awakening under Guichen (not under 長慶慧稜, whom he only 'sat with').

teacher.quote: 前漳州羅漢桂琛禪師法嗣：昇州清涼院文益禪師。餘杭人也，姓魯氏。七歲依新定智通院全偉禪師落髮。
前漳州羅漢桂琛禪師法嗣：昇州清涼院文益禪師。餘杭人也，姓魯氏。七歲依新定智通院全偉禪師落髮。
漳州桂琛（867-928）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第九世，法眼宗之開祖。

dates.quote: death +0958-07-28 顯德五年秋閏七月示寂，世壽七十四。

notes: Founder of the Fayan school, last of the Five Houses. Emphasized integration of doctrinal study with Chan.

bio: A Song Caodong master, dates unknown, who inherited the dharma of Tong'an Guanzhi and lived at Liangshan in Dingzhou (Hunan). Asked what his house style was, he said 'the Ziyang water runs so fast the fish swim hard; the White Deer pines stand so high the birds can scarcely perch.' Asked whose tune he sang and whose line he continued, he answered 'a dragon bears dragon-sons, a phoenix bears phoenix-chicks.' His heir Dayang Jingxuan became the sole surviving holder of the Caodong transmission.

teacher.quote: 鼎州梁山緣觀禪師嗣同安志。
teacher.note: 嗣同安志 — transmission verb. Corroborated across 景德傳燈錄 (T51n2076 lb 0398a20, 同安志和尚法嗣), 五燈會元 (X80n1565 lb 0518b11), and 傳法正宗記 (T51n2078 lb 0762a03, 大鑒之九世).

teacher.quote: 前朗州梁山緣觀禪師法嗣　郢州大陽山警玄禪師
teacher.note: His heir 大陽警玄 confirmed — the pivot on which the survival of Caodong turned.

teacher.quote: 鼎州梁山緣觀禪師，嗣同安志。僧問：如何是空刦已前事？師曰：擊動乾坤鼓，時人𦗟不聞。
宋代曹洞宗僧。生卒年不詳。嗣同安觀志之法，住於鼎州（湖南）梁山…嗣法弟子有大陽警玄等。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT. DILA states outright that his dates are unknown. The roster's 960-1020 is unsourced; I do not carry it.

bio.quote: 朗州梁山緣觀禪師。僧問：如何是和尚家風？師曰：資楊水急魚行澀，白鹿松高鳥泊難。問：師唱誰家曲，宗風嗣阿誰？師曰：龍生龍子，鳳生鳳兒。

notes: Caodong lineage patriarch. Teacher of Dayang Jingxuan, the last living Caodong lineage holder.

bio: From Youxi (surname Shi), he left home under Wenzhao at Baoyun monastery and was ordained by Qi'en; hearing of Huanglong Huinan he attached himself to him at Guizong for some twenty years and exhausted his teaching. He was installed at Letan, and the scholar-official Wang Shao brought him to Donglin on Mount Lu, which was converted from a Vinaya cloister into a Chan seat for him. Su Shi met him on his first visit to Lushan and was deeply struck; he declined the imperial summons to Zhihai in 1086 and was given the purple robe and the title Guanghui. He died in the 9th month of 1091, aged 67.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, 東林照覺總禪師
teacher.quote: 東林照覺總禪師。…吾有得法弟子住玉谿。乃慈古鏡也。…
teacher.note: Shown as a sanctioning master (印可) with named dharma-heirs. His own succession from 黃龍慧南 is stated in the roster's lamp/index; 五燈會元 places him among 黃龍慧南's heirs.

teacher.quote: 初至吉州禾山，聞慧南禪師之道，往歸宗依之經二十年，盡得玄奧。（T49n2036；T49n2037）
teacher.note: 往歸宗依之經二十年，盡得玄奧 — twenty years with 慧南, fully receiving his profundity.

teacher.quote: 初至吉州禾山，聞慧南禪師之道，往歸宗依之經二十年，盡得玄奧。（T49n2036；T49n2037）

teacher.kind: authority record (his heir 資福懷寶)
teacher.quote: 東林常總弟子。（X78n1556）
teacher.note: Corroborates his position as a teaching master in the Huanglong line.

dates.quote: birth +1025；death +1091-11-14；卒於：北宋哲宗元祐六年九月二十五日，67歲（T49n2037）

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 黃龍派

bio.quote: 革江州東林律院為禪席，命常總禪師居之。

notes: Huanglong branch master at Donglin Temple on Mount Lu. Teacher of the poet Su Shi.

bio: From Linqiong in Shu (surname Li), ordained at fourteen and first a Vinaya student, he abandoned doctrinal study after a lecturer could not answer his question on the Lotus Sutra and went south, finally coming to Wuzu Fayan at Taiping in Shuzhou. He served Fayan seven years without uttering an idle word before breaking through. He taught at Longmen for twelve years and then at Baoshan in Hezhou, and with Yuanwu Keqin and Foijan Huiqin was one of Fayan's 'three Buddhas.' He died at the winter solstice of 1120, aged 54.

steles.title: 宋故和州褒山佛眼禪師塔銘
steles.author: 李彌遜
steles.author_note: Li Milun (1085-1153), 宣教郎前管句西京嵩山崇福宮 — a serving official who knew him.
steles.quote: 師姓李氏，名清遠，蜀之臨邛人。捨家十四受具…聞舒州太平演道者為世第一流宗，師徑造其室，恭事勤請，既久益堅…師七年未甞妄發一語。一日有所契，洞徹超詣…宣和二年冬至之前一日，飯食訖，整衣趺坐，合掌加額，怡然而逝。
steles.note: PRIMARY, in 古尊宿語錄 卷34. It also records that his dharma-BROTHER Yuanwu Keqin wrote the 行狀: 「嗣法兄佛果大師克勤狀師之行」 — a single document cross-confirming both men's descent from Fayan.

teacher.quote: 聞舒州太平演道者為世第一流宗，師徑造其室…演深奇之，謂可以弘持法忍。
嗣法兄佛果大師克勤狀師之行。
teacher.note: Names Yuanwu Keqin as his 嗣法兄 — dharma-brother under the same master.

teacher.quote: 五祖法演（？-1104）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十五世。

dates.quote: 宣和二年冬至之前一日…怡然而逝。
「宣和二年冬至之前一日，壽五十四」（《古尊宿語錄》卷34〈宋故和州褒山佛眼禪師塔銘〉）；僧臘四十。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Dharma brother of Yuanwu Keqin. Subtle, penetrating teaching style.

bio: From Huangmei in Qizhou (surname Jiang), he left home at seventeen at the local Dongchan temple and first tasted the dharma with Shuinan Sui of Suizhou. He went to Yuanwu Keqin at Yunju, who directed him to Huqiu Shaolong at Zhangjiao; when Shaolong moved to Huqiu, Tanhua went ahead of him, and within half a year he had penetrated the great dharma. He held a succession of major abbacies and ended at Tiantong. He died on the 13th day of the 6th month of 1163, aged 61; Mi'an Xianjie was his heir.

steles.title: 應庵曇華禪師塔銘 (No. 1359-B 塔銘附)
steles.author: 李浩
steles.author_note: Li Hao, 左承議郎太常丞兼權尚書吏部郎官; he says he had known Tanhua personally for fourteen years.
steles.quote: 隆興改元癸未六月十三日，住持天童山應庵禪師曇華遷寂，塔全身於院之西麓…師江氏子，蘄之黃梅人…年十七，出家於邑之東禪…迺上雲居，禮圜悟禪師，一見拊勞，痛與提䇿。
steles.note: PRIMARY, appended to his own 語錄 (卷10).

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此一瓣香，奉為先住宣州彰教、後住平江虎丘山雲巖禪院隆和尚，爇向爐中，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. In his own words at his own enthronement he names 隆和尚 = Huqiu Shaolong as the source of his dharma-milk. He met Yuanwu, but he succeeded Shaolong.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第十三世明州天童應菴曇華禪師，虎丘嗣，蘄州江氏子。
虎丘紹隆（1077-1136）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十七世…禮謁圜悟克勤，後入彰教寺侍虎丘紹隆。

dates.quote: 隆興改元癸未六月十三日…遷寂。
birth +1103；death +1163-07-22 「隆興改元癸未六月十三日，春秋六十一」（《應菴曇華禪師語錄》卷10〈塔銘〉）；夏﨟四十三。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Key link in the Huqiu lineage.

bio: A Goryeo monk of Dongju (surname Jeong), tonsured at eight under Jonghwi of Mount Jogye. He founded the Samadhi-and-Prajna Society, moving it in 1200 from Gong-san to Mount Jogye, where in 1205 it was renamed the Suseonsa; it is today's Songgwangsa, and he is reckoned the reviver — in effect the founder — of the Korean Jogye order. He taught sudden awakening followed by gradual cultivation and the joint practice of samadhi and prajna. He died on the 27th day of the 3rd month of 1210, aged 53.

steles.title: 昇平府曹溪山松廣寺佛日普照國師碑銘
steles.author: 金君綏 (Kim Gun-su), 知公州事副使兼禮部尚書, 奉宣撰
steles.quote: 師諱知訥。京西洞州人也。嘗自號為牧牛子。俗姓鄭氏。考光遇。國學學正。 … 浮屠于社之北麓。上。聞之慟。諡曰佛日普照國師。塔曰甘露。閱世五十三齡。
steles.note: Erected by royal command after his death 1210. Stupa named 甘露. Age 53, 受臘 (tonsure-years) given in the following line.

teacher.kind: his 碑銘 — 〈昇平府曹溪山松廣寺佛日普照國師碑銘〉 by 金君綏 (奉宣撰, by royal command), calligraphy 柳伸
teacher.quote: 年甫八歲。投曹溪雲孫宗暉禪師。祝髮受具戒。學無常師。唯道之從。
teacher.note: THE STELE ITSELF ATTESTS THE ABSENCE OF A TEACHER: 『學無常師』 — he had no constant master. 宗暉 only 祝髮受具戒 (tonsured and ordained him at age 8) — the ordination-master trap, and the stele is careful to separate it.

teacher.kind: same stele — the three awakenings, all from BOOKS
teacher.quote: 偶一日。於學寮。開六祖壇經。至曰真如自性起念…乃驚喜。得未曾有…意自得也。… 得李長者華嚴論。重發信心…前解轉明。 … 得大慧普覺禪師語錄云。禪不在靜處…忽然眼開。方知是屋裏事。予於此契會。自然不礙膺。
teacher.note: The stele names all three books: 六祖壇經 (1182, at 清源寺), 李通玄 華嚴論 (1185, at 普門寺), and 大慧語錄 (at 智異山). The third passage is Jinul's OWN words quoted in the stele (『予於此契會』). This is a BOOK transmission, and it is A-grade attested — the brief is right that evidence quality and relation type are separate axes.

teacher.kind: history quoting 寶鑑國師碑銘 (李齊賢)
teacher.quote: 佛日普照國師，諱知訥者，崛起於松廣寺，創定慧社，集眾修禪，闡揚宗風，是為曹溪宗之開祖也。師無所稟承，而從六祖壇經及大慧書狀，獨自悟入，發明大道。
teacher.note: *** THIS CONTRADICTS THE EXISTING ROSTER, WHICH NAMES DAHUI ZONGGAO AS HIS TEACHER. *** The source says explicitly 師無所稟承 — 'the master received transmission from no one' — and 獨自悟入, 'he awakened entirely by himself,' from the Platform Sutra and Dahui's LETTERS. Dahui died in 1163, when Jinul was five; there was never any personal contact. The roster has mistaken a textual influence for a transmission — precisely the association-for-transmission error. I emit teacher: null.

teacher.quote: 京西洞州人，俗姓鄭。八歲從曹溪山之宗暉出家。
teacher.note: DILA also names no dharma-teacher. 宗暉 (Jonghwi) is his TONSURE master only, not a transmitter.

dates.quote: 庚午六年…佛紀二二三七年三月二十七日。沙門知訥示寂。
birth +1158；death +1210-04-29 …三月二十七日。沙門知訥示寂。閱世五十三，受臘三十六。（B31, no. 170）

school.quote: 移居松廣山吉祥寺，結定慧社，大揚禪風。熙宗即位，命號改為曹溪山修禪社。

notes: Founder of the Jogye Order, the dominant school of Korean Buddhism. Uniquely among Chan/Seon masters, Jinul achieved three distinct awakenings entirely through reading texts rather than through face-to-face transmission: first from the Platform Sutra, then from Li Tongxuan's commentary on the Avatamsaka Sutra, and finally from Dahui Zonggao's letters on hwadu (huatou) practice. He synthesized 'sudden awakening followed by gradual cultivation' (dono jeomsu) as the normative Seon path, harmonizing Seon meditation with Hwaom (Huayan) doctrinal study. He revitalized Korean Buddhism from his base at Songgwangsa, which he rebuilt as a 'community of the Samgha jewel.' Attested in Buswell (1991), The Korean Approach to Zen: the definitive English-language study of his thought and legacy.

book_transmissions.title_en: Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch
book_transmissions.author: attrib. Huineng 慧能 (comp. Fahai 法海)
book_transmissions.description: The foundational Chan scripture -- the only Chinese Buddhist text called a "sutra." Jinul read the line 「真如自性起念」 and awakened the first time, at 清源寺 in 1182.

book_transmissions.author: Li Tongxuan 李通玄 (635-730), a Huayan layman
book_transmissions.description: Li Tongxuan's vast lay commentary on the Avataṃsaka Sutra. Jinul read it at 普門寺 in 1185 -- the channel through which Korean Seon absorbed Huayan thought.

book_transmissions.author: Dahui Zonggao 大慧宗杲 (1089-1163)
book_transmissions.description: The recorded sayings and letters (書狀) of Dahui, champion of koan-observing Chan. Jinul's third and deepest awakening came from these letters -- 「忽然眼開」. He never met Dahui, who died before he was born.

bio: A Goryeo monk of Suan county (surname Yi), tonsured at thirteen by his maternal uncle Jonghheon and head of the Gulsan assembly, passing the monastic examination in the highest grade. He studied under Ssangbong Byeon, then at Jogye under the 'Robeless One' (Hyesim), and finally served Cheongjin (Mongyeo), receiving his teaching to the marrow. When Cheongjin died in 1252 he entrusted the monastery to him, and the king appointed him FOURTH-generation head of the Suseonsa. He was made Royal Teacher on the 11th day of the 5th month of 1259; he retired to Waryongsa and died on the 10th day of the 12th month of 1271, aged 81, canonised Jinmyeong with the stupa Bogwang.

steles.title: 臥龍山慈雲寺王師贈諡真明國師碑銘并序
steles.author: 金坵
steles.author_note: Kim Gu (1211-1278), Goryeo statesman and writer, composing by royal command.
steles.quote: 國師諱混元。俗姓李氏。遂安縣人也…年甫十三。投舅氏品日雲孫禪師宗軒披剃受具…初謁雙峯辯青牛…次詣曹溪無衣堂下…又嘗師事清真國師。所至相從。稟受曲折。盡得其骨髓…遂陞座。嗣清真…至壬子八月。清真臨滅。以院門事屬師。上於是。命住曹溪為第四世…至元八年辛未十二月…十日…端然示寂…享年八十一。受臈六十有八。
steles.note: PRIMARY. Preserved in 朝鮮佛教通史, in the corpus. It gives his teacher (嗣清真), his rank (第四世), his royal-teacher appointment and his exact death and age.

teacher.quote: 遂陞座。嗣清真…壬子八月，清真臨滅，以院門事屬師。上於是命住曹溪為第四世。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's 'Mongyeo', but only once the identification is made: 清真國師 is the posthumous title of 夢如.

teacher.kind: 碑銘 of 真覺國師慧諶 (by 李奎報)
teacher.quote: 嗣法禪老夢如。亦法王也。
teacher.note: The KEY LINK: Hyesim's own stele names 夢如 (Mongyeo) as his dharma-heir. Mongyeo is thus the 3rd of the Suseonsa and = 清真國師, whom Honwon succeeded as 4th. Two steles in the same text chain the succession.

dates.quote: 至元八年辛未十二月…十日晨…端然示寂…享年八十一。受臈六十有八。
dates.note: Death 至元八年 = 1271; age 81 gives birth 1191. Exactly matches the roster.

school.quote: 命住曹溪為第四世…再扇牧牛之風。

notes: 4th National Teacher of Suseonsa. Named Royal Teacher (Wangsa) in 1259.

bio: From Luling in Ji'an (surname Tan), tonsured young at Heshan, he went to Mount Tianmu and received the dharma from Zhongfeng Mingben, who in 1322 had him take a seat and teach. He refused every abbacy pressed on him and lived quietly around Wusong; his disciples built him a monastery in Suzhou laid out like a full Chan establishment, the Shizi Lin (Lion Grove). He combined Chan with Pure Land, wrote the Jingtu huowen and a commentary on the Surangama, and died in 1354 aged 69.

teacher.kind: preface to his own 語錄, written WHILE HE WAS ALIVE by a named Hanlin official
teacher.quote: 今師子林天如和尚得法於普應國師中峰本公，乃大鳴其道，以正少林之宗。… 至正己丑夏，翰林待制奉議大夫兼國史院編脩官，無學野人遠者圖，拜手敘
teacher.note: 得法於 = a true transmission verb. Dated 至正己丑 = 1349; 惟則 died 1354 — so this was written five years before his death, by a serving Hanlin academician who signs his office. Contemporary, named, dated.

teacher.quote: 山僧往年在天目山，中峰和尚侍傍，見五六官客夜坐談道…
teacher.note: 'I, this mountain monk, in former years at 天目山, ATTENDED AT 中峰和尚'S SIDE.' First-person confirmation that he served 中峰 at 天目山 — 中峰明本's seat. He also composed a verse-encomium for 中峰和尚 alongside 高峰和尚 (lb 0889b17), the standard place a master honours his own lineage. He never took a public abbacy (his 語錄 states 「師既不住山，故無上堂入室等語」), so there is NO enthronement and therefore NO 拈香 incense to find — the absence of a 法乳 stick is expected here and is NOT evidence against the edge.

teacher.quote: 弟子惟則字天如，廬陵人，髫年出家，初參海印，後得法中峰，有語錄四卷
teacher.note: Corroborates, and correctly keeps the roles apart: 初參海印 (first VISITED 海印) … 後得法中峰 (LATER OBTAINED THE DHARMA from 中峰). 海印 is a prior teacher, not the dharma-father.

teacher.quote: 號天如，中峰明本禪師法嗣…幼歲入禾山祝髮，後往天目依中峰，後深得其旨。至治壬戌（1322），明本命分座說法。（《五燈全書》卷58；《佛祖綱目》卷40；《繼燈錄》卷5）

dates.quote: birth +1286；death 元至正甲午（《五燈全書》卷58）；年六十九（《西舫彙征》卷1）；塔于水西原。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 淨土或問…乃天如則師所撰也。
bio.note: Corroborates his authorship and Pure Land leaning.

notes: Founded Shizi Lin (Lion Grove Garden) in Suzhou. Combined Chan with Pure Land.

bio: A Korean Seon monk, heir of Hwan-am Honsu and a link in the chain by which the Linji transmission brought from China by Taego Bou was carried down to Hyujeong (Seosan). Beyond his place in that chain almost nothing is recorded of him, and even his identity is contested: some sources conflate him with an earlier Gagun, a disciple of Hyesim, who wrote the Yeomsong seorhwa.

teacher.kind: the lineage clause in 清虛休靜 (Seosan)'s 行狀 — the EARLIEST witness to the chain, c. 1604, but ~200 years after Gagun
teacher.quote: 吾東方太古和尚入中國霞霧山，嗣石屋而傳之幻菴，幻菴傳之龜谷，龜谷傳之正心，正心傳之智嚴，智嚴傳之靈觀，靈觀傳之西山。此實臨濟之正派。
teacher.note: This is a RETROSPECTIVE LINEAGE CLAIM, made by the school that needed the chain to exist (Seosan's line legitimating itself back to Taego and thence to Linji). It is on stone-tier material, but it is not a witness to the transmission — it is a two-century-later assertion about it.

teacher.kind: 朝鮮佛教通史 (李能和, 1918) — a MODERN secondary compilation
teacher.quote: 愚得幻庵混修。修得龜谷覺雲…雲得碧溪正心。心得碧松智嚴。嚴得芙蓉靈觀。觀得清虗休靜、浮休善修。
teacher.note: This is the source the roster's 'DILA / 禪宗法系譜' line ultimately rests on. It is 20th-century.

teacher.kind: 行狀 of 西山休靜 (his lineage descendant)
teacher.quote: 吾東方太古和尚入中國霞霧山，嗣石屋而傳之幻菴，幻菴傳之龜谷，龜谷傳之正心，正心傳之智嚴，智嚴傳之靈觀，靈觀傳之西山。此實臨濟之正派。
teacher.note: The transmission chain as claimed by the Hyujeong line itself. This is the lineage's own self-account, written to establish that line's legitimacy — treat accordingly.

teacher.quote: 幻庵混修弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：23）

dates.note: DISAGREES WITH THE ROSTER (fl. 1400, d. 1450). DILA's own dates carry question marks and are sourced only to a Korean weblog, not a document. I emit NO dates: neither figure is soundly sourced.

school.quote: dynasty 高麗；sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 曹溪山第二世真覺國師，法諱慧諶…又其弟子覺雲禪師，著拈頌說話。世以龜谷覺雲與師同…
bio.note: IDENTITY WARNING: this passage shows an existing confusion between Gugok Gagun and the 13th-c. Gagun who was Hyesim's disciple. The two are separated by roughly a century. Recorded so the ambiguity is visible rather than silently resolved.

notes: Obscure transmission link in the Taego-to-Hyujeong chain. First documented in a 1625 source. Poorly attested.

bio: From Jianchang (surname unrecorded), he was a lay lecturer on Wang Yangming's doctrine of innate knowing before taking ordination under Guxi of Helin. Hearing of Xiaoshan Zongshu he went to him in Zhongzhou, then travelled to the elders of every quarter; returning to Mount Song he attended Xiaoshan for three years at the Zongjing hermitage and received his charge. He then withdrew to a thatched hut on Mount Lin for twenty years. He died in 1588, aged 75, and was buried at the foot of his own mountain; his heir was Wuming Huijing.

teacher.kind: 永覺元賢, 《壽昌無明和尚行業記》 — an 行業記 written INSIDE Changzhong's own lineage
teacher.quote: 按僧元賢《壽昌無明和尚行業記》：無明禪師名慧經，字無明，撫州崇仁裴氏子…時邑有蘊空忠禪師，佩小山老人密印，隱於廩山。明往從之，執侍三載
teacher.note: THE UPGRADE. This is not a lamp — it is the 行業記 (career-record, the 行狀 class) of 無明慧經, who was CHANGZHONG'S OWN DISCIPLE (he served him three years: 執侍三載), written by 永覺元賢, who was Huijing's dharma-heir. Two generations down, inside the house. It states flatly that Changzhong 佩小山老人密印 — BORE THE SECRET SEAL OF OLD MAN XIAOSHAN. 密印 is transmission. The same document goes on to show Changzhong actively teaching and testing Huijing (「廩山聞之曰：宗眼不明，非為究竟」), confirming he is the 廩山 in question.

teacher.kind: 博山無異大師語錄集要 — the same Shouchang-line testimony, independently
teacher.quote: 時有蘊空忠和尚，先事小山老人有年，受其密印，歸隱旴江之廩山，天下不得而物色之。壽昌先師從其薙落，後蒙記莂
teacher.note: Second witness from within the lineage: Changzhong 先事小山老人有年，受其密印 — served Xiaoshan for years and received his seal.

teacher.source: DILA A004681 (citing 續燈正統 X84n1583, 續指月錄 X84n1579, 洞上古轍)
teacher.quote: 建昌廩山蘊空常忠禪師，宗鏡菴小山宗書禪師法嗣…從鶴林古溪法師出家…返嵩山，侍小山禪師遷宗鏡，服勤三載，受囑
teacher.note: The lamp agrees, and correctly separates his tonsure master (鶴林古溪) from 小山宗書.

teacher.quote: 建昌廩山蘊空常忠禪師，宗鏡菴小山宗書禪師法嗣…返嵩山，侍小山禪師遷宗鏡，服勤三載，受囑。還旴江，隱從姑。後縛茅廩山二十年。（洞上．卷3；X84n1579；X84n1583）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's teacher.

dates.quote: birth +1514；death 萬曆戊子…遂趨寂。塔於本山之麓，壽七十五。（X84n1583）

notes: 67th Caodong patriarch. Studied at Shaolin under Xiaoshan, then retreated to Bingshan for 20 years.

bio: From Jingxi/Yixing (surname Min), fatherless and poor, he was moved to seek release on hearing the Surangama passage on the true abiding mind. He went to Huanyou Zhengchuan at Longchi, was ordained at twenty-four, and after two years of hard work on Yunmen's fan koan awakened at the braying of a donkey. He served as Huanyou's recorder and received his dharma in full, and from 1620 built up the Qingshan seat. He died on the 23rd of the 9th month of 1635, aged 61; among his heirs were Yulin Tongxiu and Ruo'an Tongwen, and through them the Chan of the imperial court.

steles.title: 天隱和尚語錄 卷十五〈行由〉
steles.author: 圓修 himself (told to his assembly)
steles.quote: 辛未重陽，師在磬山，眾請師述始終參履…師曰：…余生荊谿閔門，母潘氏。不幸早歲失怙，母老孀居…聞幻有和尚是大善知識，自清涼山來。唐凝庵太常、吳安節通政延居龍池山，道風遐播，闡揚臨濟正宗，單提向上一著，特往歸依。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON autobiography, delivered at Qingshan in 1631 at his assembly's request.

teacher.quote: 又一瓣香…今日對眾拈出，供養荊溪龍池山禹門禪院本師大和尚幻有老人，以酬法乳。
teacher.note: DECISIVE — his own words, naming Huanyou as 本師.

teacher.quote: 聞幻有和尚是大善知識…特往歸依。
號天隱，龍池傳禪師法嗣…遂往投龍池傳祖。

dates.quote: birth +1575；death 崇禎乙亥九月二十三日示寂，世壽六十有一，僧臘三十有七。（《五燈全書》卷64）

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Dharma brother of Miyun Yuanwu under Huanyou. Founded a separate Linji branch. Teacher of the imperial Chan line.

bio: From Dazhu in Shu (surname Jian, descended from the Jian family of Chongqing), he was tonsured at nineteen at Fo'en monastery and, unable to resolve his doubt over the Surangama, left Sichuan for the Potou mountain in Chu, where he set himself a seven-day limit, walked off a cliff, and had his first opening. After Xueqiao and Zhanran he went in 1624 to Miyun Yuanwu at Jinsu, and in 1627 Miyun gave him the certificate of the orthodox line of Caoxi. From 1629 he taught for thirty-seven years and opened fourteen halls, reviving Chan across Sichuan; he founded Shuanggui and had eighty-seven dharma-heirs. He died on the 16th of the 3rd month of 1666, aged 70.

steles.title: 破山明禪師塔銘
steles.author: 劉道開
steles.author_note: 敕封徵仕郎、翰林院庶吉士、癸酉科孝廉、巴縣劉道開撰文; seal-script title by 李仙根, calligraphy by 劉如漢 — a full official stele with three named hands.
steles.quote: 師諱海明，號破山，俗籍順慶之大竹，元勛奕葉，相傳蹇忠定之裔孫…行年十九，忽厭塵凡，薙髮出家…偶聽慧然法師講《楞嚴經》…遂終日疑悶…俄住楚之破頭山，刻期取證，以七日為限…
steles.note: PRIMARY, appended to his own 語錄 卷20.

steles.title: 破山明和尚行狀
steles.author: 印正
steles.author_note: 住郢州當陽玉泉嗣法門人印正撰述 — a dharma-heir, writing for the funeral.
steles.quote: 師諱海明，號破山，萬曆丁酉歲生蜀北果州之大竹，先籍渝州蹇氏忠定公裔。十九歲，詣本郡佛恩寺大持老宿脫白…上徑山參雪嶠和尚…癸亥冬，參顯聖湛然和尚…

steles.title: 雙桂破山明禪師年譜
steles.quote: 破山明禪師年譜終
steles.note: A year-by-year chronological biography, also in 卷20. DILA takes his exact birth (萬曆二十五年正月二十一日午時) and death (康熙五年三月十六日) from it.

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此瓣香斧斫不開、刀劈不破…此是第一回拈出，供養見住金粟山廣慧禪寺傳曹谿正脈第三十四世密雲和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, first-person; he repeats it at least three times across his record (0006b19 天童山密雲老和尚, 0009c02 天童山密雲老人).

teacher.quote: 密雲悟禪師（1567-1642）法嗣，大鑑下第35世…丁卯春悟書曹谿正脈來源一紙付師。

dates.quote: birth +1597-03-08「明萬曆二十五年丁酉正月二十一日午時」；death +1666-04-19「康熙五年丙午三月十六日」（《雙桂破山明禪師年譜》）
萬曆丁酉歲生…世壽七十，僧臘四十三。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第35世

bio.kind: 塔銘 + 行狀 + 年譜

notes: Revived Chan in southwest China (Sichuan). Called 'Little Shakyamuni.' Founded Shuanggui Temple (1653). Had 87 dharma heirs.

bio: From Goushi (Yanshi) in Henan (surname Fan), a sickly child whose parents vowed him to the order, he was tonsured at nine at Shaolin under Jiyun and ordained at eighteen. Widely read in the inner and outer books, he studied with Jiangyue Zhao and Xi'an Yirang before coming to Chunzhuo Wencai, who tested him back and forth on the Jewel Mirror Samadhi until his doubt broke open and then said 'the carrying of the great dharma rests wholly on you,' handing over robe and dharma. He was installed at Wan'an in Nanyang and in 1369 became abbot of Shaolin, where he farmed with his monks.

teacher.quote: 松庭子嚴禪師…叅淳拙禪師，拙以寶鏡三昧反覆徵辯大豁疑礙。拙曰：荷擔大法盡在子躬，遂付以衣法…明洪武二年己酉主少林。
teacher.note: transmission 付以衣法; teacher 淳拙文才 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 南陽府萬安寺松庭子嚴禪師，河南之古緱氏縣樊姓…禮齊雲於少林，十八受具…叅淳拙禪師，拙以寶鏡三昧反覆徵辯，大豁疑礙。拙曰：荷擔大法盡在子躬。遂付以衣法…明洪武二年己酉主少林。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster's teacher, and gives the actual moment of transmission (遂付以衣法).

teacher.quote: 初參禮江月照、息菴義讓，皆有所省；後參謁淳拙文才禪師。

dates.quote: birth 元至治三年 (1323)；death 洪武二十五年，70歲，立壽塔。未久，圓寂。
dates.note: CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER, which gives death 1380. DILA puts him alive in 洪武二十五年 = 1392, erecting his own stupa at seventy. DILA's source here is the Shaolin temple website, not a document, so I record the death as UNKNOWN rather than assert 1392; but the roster's 1380 cannot stand against the 1369 Shaolin abbacy plus a 1392 notice.

dates.quote: 明洪武二年己酉主少林。
dates.note: Firmly alive in 1369.

notes: Yuan-Ming transition. Shaolin Caodong transmission. Dates approximate.

bio: A man of Weinan in Huazhou and an heir of Fayan Wenyi. He is remembered for a single exchange: as steward under Qingfeng he had been told 'the fire-boy comes seeking fire' and thought he understood. Fayan made him repeat it, then said 'the steward has indeed got it wrong' — Xuanze stormed off across the river in anger, thought better of it, came back, and only then understood. The case is in the Blue Cliff Record.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄, under 淨慧禪師法嗣 (heir-list at lb 0407a22)
teacher.quote: 金陵報恩院玄則禪師，滑州衛南人也。初問青峯：如何是佛？…青峯曰：丙丁童子來求火。師得此語，藏之於心。及謁淨慧，詰其悟旨，師對曰：丙丁是火而更求火，亦似玄則將佛問佛。淨慧曰：幾放過，元來錯會。師雖蒙開發，頗懷猶豫，復退思，既殆莫曉玄理，乃投誠請益。淨慧曰：汝問我與汝道。
teacher.note: ⚠ THE TRAP IS INSIDE THE STORY. 青峯 GAVE HIM THE PHRASE — and Fayan's whole point is that taking it from Qingfeng was a MISUNDERSTANDING (錯會). Qingfeng is not his teacher; the man who broke him is. 淨慧 is Fayan Wenyi's title in life (清涼文益, 賜號淨慧). The heir-list at 0407a22 files 玄則 under 淨慧 alongside 清涼泰欽 — also in this batch.

teacher.quote: 金陵清涼文益禪師法嗣，滑州衛南人。（T51n2076_p0407a14、p0413b11）
碧巖錄云：則監院，說丙丁童子來求火。法眼云：監院果然錯會了也。則不憤，便起單渡江去云云。
則監寺叅青峯法眼丙丁童子公案
teacher.note: Names BOTH masters — Qingfeng (the first) and Fayan (the one who broke him open), exactly as the roster's note has it.

dates.quote: (no dates recorded; dynasty 唐)
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT. The roster's 920-957 is unsourced; I do not carry it.

notes: Originally from Weinan in Huazhou (present-day Hua County, Henan). First studied under Qingfeng, then continued under Fayan Wenyi. His enlightenment came through the famous "fire boy seeking fire" exchange: after Qingfeng told him the fire boy comes seeking fire, Fayan rejected his intellectual understanding, and when he returned to ask again, he achieved deep awakening. He served as abbot of Baoen Monastery in Jinling (modern Nanjing), capital of the Southern Tang kingdom.

bio: A Qing Caodong master of Guyu, abbot of Xiangtian in Yue, and an heir of Shiyu Mingfang. His four-fascicle recorded sayings survive. He appears in his teacher Shiyu's record attending him in his last illness, asking the old question 'there is one who is not sick — who is he?' His own heir was Daxiu Jingzhu of Nanhua at Caoxi.

teacher.kind: 正源略集, index of Shiyu's heirs
teacher.quote: 石雨方禪師法嗣七人：古虞象田即念現禪師。僧問：「如何是佛種從緣起？」師曰…
teacher.note: 石雨方 = 石雨明方. Listed directly as his heir, with recorded 機緣. The roster's edge holds.

teacher.quote: 象田即念禪師語錄四卷 明淨現說，淨癡等錄…青原下第三十七[世]。
teacher.note: His own book; 青原下 = Caodong side, consistent with 石雨 (青原下第三十六世，嗣雲門澄).

teacher.quote: 石雨方禪師法嗣七人：古虞象田即念現禪師。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. His own 語錄 (J27nB191) carries NO transmission-incense, so this index is the load-bearing evidence.

teacher.quote: 號即念，石雨明方禪師法嗣。主越之象田。現存《語錄》四卷行世。法嗣有南華大休珠禪師。（《正源略集目錄》卷1）

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT — DILA states outright that his dates are unknown.

bio.quote: 示疾日，即念現禪師問：古人道，病有不病者。如何是不病者？師默然。
bio.note: Attending Shiyu Mingfang on his deathbed — a scene that itself corroborates the teacher-student tie.

bio: From Langzhong (surname Yang, mother Xu), born on the 15th day of the 6th month of 1626. Orphaned at sixteen when his district was overrun, he fled to Hanmian, saw the slaughter, and took tonsure. Hearing that Zhangxue Tongzui was teaching at Jingming, he went to him; Zhangxue asked if he could read, he said no, and was sent into the hall — where one night at the sounding of the watch 'a thunderclap in empty space' shattered the lump in his chest. He followed Zhangxue east to Tiantong and back, served him some twenty years, and was charged by him with the Caotang seat. He was still alive in 1686, aged 61.

steles.title: 草堂耨雲實禪師語錄 卷二〈行繇〉
steles.author: 真實 himself (told to his assembly)
steles.quote: 一日，大眾入方丈請示行繇，師云：老僧本邑楊氏子，母姓許，天啟丙寅六月十五日生。自幼發願出家，父母不允。年十六歲，吾鄉遭亂，父母相繼而亡。予逃難漢沔，見多慘殺，痛念生死，乃投師祝髮。聞丈雪和尚荷雙桂衣缽，杖抵興元…予矢志往參…忽一夕，聞開小靜，如虛空霹靂，將胸中礙膺之物一擊粉碎…末後鶴乘期終，本師重闢昭覺，囑予繼席艸堂。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. Gives his exact birth date and the whole course of his training under Zhangxue.

steles.title: 草堂耨雲實禪師語錄卷二〈行繇〉
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄.
steles.quote: 天啟丙寅六月十五日生。
steles.note: Source of his birth date. No death recorded.

teacher.quote: 專申供養現住城都府昭覺堂上傳臨濟正宗三十二世本師丈雪醉老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. He repeats it at 0002b08: 此是第二回，爇向爐中供養本師丈雪大和尚。

teacher.quote: 聞丈雪和尚荷雙桂衣缽…予矢志往參。
字耨雲，為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣…後受丈師囑，繼席草堂，得付法。
行腳時驀地撞著個無面目老漢，將我珍藏滯貨被他拶碎…專申供養現住城都府昭覺堂上傳臨濟正宗三十二世本師丈雪醉老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS: 本師 丈雪醉 (Zhangxue Tongzui), 32nd generation Linji, at Zhaojue in Chengdu. CONFIRMS bio_5 exactly, including the Zhaojue seat.

teacher.quote: 字耨雲，為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣…後受丈師囑，繼席草堂，得付法。

dates.quote: 天啟丙寅六月十五日生。
birth +1626-07-08「天啟丙寅六月十五日生」（〈行繇〉）；卒年及世壽不詳，僅知康熙丙寅年（1686）仍在世，時年六十一。
dates.note: Birth firm from his own mouth. DEATH GENUINELY UNKNOWN — last attested alive 1686.

dates.kind: authority record citing the 行繇 + 疑年錄
dates.quote: 天啟丙寅六月十五日生。… 康熙二十五年丙寅，年六十一。
dates.note: Born 1626-07-08; alive 1686 at 61. Death NOT recorded.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.kind: authority record citing the 行繇 and 分燈
bio.quote: 閬中人，俗姓楊…參丈雪和尚，隨丈師下東吳上天童，遍參諸方。
bio.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's identification of his seat at 草堂 in Langzhong/Baoning, matching his heir 佛敏's incense.

links.label: DILA Authority A016514
links.confirms: dharma name 真實, teacher 通醉, birth, bio

bio: From Zhongnan in western Shu (surname Li), tonsured at nineteen under Daxiu Xian and trained in Yogacara and the Lankavatara under the treatise-master Gaoyuan Yu. Illness at Diaoyucheng convinced him that doctrine was not enough and he turned to Chan. When Poshan Haiming returned from Tiantong to Sichuan and was installed at Taiping in Liangshan, he went to him; after several rebuffs, the sight of a collapsing mound of earth broke him open 'like the bottom falling out of a bucket.' He received Poshan's dharma in 1643, held seven monasteries across Guizhou, and died on the 15th of the 8th month of 1678, aged 69, with forty-three dharma-heirs.

steles.title: 雲山燕居申禪師語錄 卷三〈行實〉
steles.author: 德申 himself (told to the layman Duan)
steles.quote: 師因合明段居士請示入道因緣，師云：余乃西蜀忠南巴蔓子李氏，年十九依大休仙法師落髮，攻講肄次，訪高原昱論師，習《唯識》、《楞伽》、相宗諸要…始奮志參禪…一日，聞本師自天童付囑歸川，眾迎至梁山縣太平禪寺，余即往參…
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香…爇向爐中，供養現住四川夔州府梁山縣雙桂堂上傳曹溪正脈三十五世本師破山大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE.

teacher.quote: 一日，聞本師自天童付囑歸川…余即往參。
字燕居，為破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣…崇禎癸未年（1643）得破山和尚付法。

dates.quote: birth +1610；death +1678-09-30…康熙十七年八月十五日示寂，世壽六十九，僧臘五十。（〈行實〉；《五燈全書》卷88）
忠南李氏子。壽七十二。無病而終。墖于雲天山。
dates.note: DILA CONTRADICTS ITSELF: its concise note says he lived 72, its extensive note says 69. I take 69, which is tied to an exact date (康熙十七年八月十五日) and to the 行實; the bare '72' is not. Both recorded.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: A Qing Caodong master and heir of Xiangtian Jinian Jingxian, whose recorded sayings he himself edited (fascicles 2 and 3). He held Nanhua at Caoxi, Bailian and Dingyin at Zuili, Miyin in Huzhou and Tianhua at Yuecheng, and left a twelve-fascicle record of his own. He died on the 15th of the 8th month of 1656, aged only 42, with twenty-three years in the robe.

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此一瓣香，佛佛授受，祖祖相傳，端為本寺開山，六祖大師下傳曹洞正宗第三十四世象田即念現和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0192a08 and 0193b11 (象田堂上即念老和尚). Confirms both his own teacher AND that Jingxian is the 34th Caodong generation.

teacher.quote: 即念現禪師法嗣：曹溪南華大休珠禪師。
字大休，為即念淨現禪師法嗣。

dates.quote: birth +1615；death +1656-10-02 大清（順治）丙申…八月…十五…跏趺而逝。師年四十有二，法臈二十有三。（B30, no. 163）

bio: From Zhongzhou (surname Yang), he had his opening on the 'ten thousand dharmas return to one' and went to Wanfeng; he was sealed by Minshu Ruxiang, travelled everywhere, and returned to the gorges to inherit Minshu's dharma in the line of the old man Poshan. He held Sansheng at Neijiang and then went north, being installed by the Prince of Shuncheng at the Zhenru cloister by the White Pagoda. In 1683 he returned to Sichuan to sweep his teacher's stupa at Wanxian. He was still alive at seventy-nine, on pilgrimage to Putuo.

teacher.quote: 復拈香云：此瓣香，苦志忘形奮琢成…爇向爐中，專伸供養臨濟正傳第三十一世上敏下樹本師和尚，用酬法乳之恩，蒙師毒手至今快，痛徹千生不敢忘。
teacher.note: DECISIVE — 上敏下樹 spells out Minshu. Repeated at 0941a19 and 0943c23.

teacher.quote: 受敏樹相印證，參徧諸方，回峽嗣法破山老人樹和尚…癸亥（1683）十月回川抵萬縣掃本師敏老人塔。

dates.quote: birth 1616；death 79歲仍在。《空谷道澄禪師語錄》卷17：「七十九來朝普陀」(J39, no. B471)
dates.note: DEATH GENUINELY UNKNOWN — last attested alive at 79 (c.1694), by his own record.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: From Neijiang (surname Li, mother Yao), born at midnight on the 15th of the 10th month of 1610. Tonsured in infancy under Qingran of Guzi mountain, he was set going by the Lotus line 'even one raised hand, even one small bow of the head, all complete the Buddha-way' — 'is becoming a Buddha as easy as that?' Hearing that Poshan Haiming had brought the Jinsu robe and bowl into Shu, he came out of his hermitage to him, and after Tiantong, where the sound of the board opened him through, Poshan sealed him. He opened Yumen at Niushan, Jingming at Hanzhong, Caotang at Baoning and rebuilt Zhaojue in Chengdu at seventy-six; he compiled the Jinjiang chandeng. He died on the 26th of the 12th month of 1695 (Jan 1696), aged 86.

steles.title: 昭覺丈雪醉禪師語錄 卷八〈行實〉
steles.author: 通醉 himself (told to Yuechuang and Ceimei)
steles.quote: 月幢、策眉領眾入方丈，請開示行腳。師曰：家醜不可外揚…予乃內江人也，俗姓李，母姚氏，生萬曆三十八年庚戌，十月十五子時。初離襁褓，禮古字山清然師為徒…因讀《法華經》「乃至舉一手，或復小低頭，皆以成佛道。」予默計曰：成佛與麼易耶？…忽靈筏兄從江南來，譚及破山和尚荷金粟衣缽入蜀。予便出關去。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. DILA also records a 〈丈雪醉禪師塔銘〉 among works about him, which I did not locate in the corpus.

teacher.quote: 次拈云：此瓣香，佛祖安名不得，人天罔測其機，第二回爇向爐中，供養本師破山大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0314a21 (現住西蜀夔州府梁山縣金城禪寺破山大和尚) and 0320b22.

teacher.quote: 破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣，大鑑下第三十六世。

dates.quote: 生萬曆三十八年庚戌，十月十五子時。
birth +1610-11-29；death +1696-01-30「康熙三十四年十二月二十六日，世壽八十六」
dates.note: The harvest's batch file gave death as 1695. The lunar date 康熙三十四年十二月二十六日 falls on 1696-01-30 in the Gregorian calendar. Both are the same day; I emit 1696.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第三十六世

bio: An heir of Fogu Xingwen, whose recorded sayings he edited. He succeeded his own teacher in the two seats the latter had founded — Caoxi at Pinghu in Jiaxing (from 1681) and Xianglin at Taicang near Suzhou (from 1682). His own record in two fascicles was compiled by his heir Mingsong. His dates are not recorded.

teacher.quote: 者瓣香，皮穿骨露，尚遭獰拳，膽喪魂驚，猶喫痛棒…爇向爐中，耑為即此堂上開山第一代傳臨濟正宗三十二世佛古先師老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0819c03: 端為供養前住香林、後住即此堂上開山第一代先師佛古聞老和尚。He calls Fogu the FOUNDING abbot of the seat he now holds — matching Fogu's stele exactly.

teacher.quote: 佛古行聞禪師法嗣。歷任姑蘇太倉香林禪院、嘉興平湖曹溪禪院。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。康熙壬戌（1682）住姑蘇太倉香林禪院，辛酉（1681）住嘉興平湖曹溪禪院。
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT on dates; active 1681-1682.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: From Dazhou in Shu (surname Hu), tonsured at thirteen and set on pilgrimage at twenty. He first met Miyun Yuanwu at Jinsu — asked about his face before his parents were born, he took the stick and felt at ease — then Shiche Tongsheng, under whom a 'not mind, not Buddha, not a thing: what is it?' and a thunderous shout stripped him. He finally received the seal from Wanru Tongwei at Longchi in 1652. He held eleven monasteries across the north — Tianjin, Xiongxian, Zhuozhou, Tanzhe in the Western Hills, and Zhongpan on Mount Pan — and died on the 10th of the 8th month of 1673, aged 72; his stupa is under Zigai peak.

teacher.quote: 復拈云：此一瓣香，千方不破，百計難開，懷入江南，遇個鐵面皮老子，一拶粉碎，爇向爐中，端為供養現住江南常州府宜興縣龍池山禹門堂上傳曹溪正脈第三十五世本師萬如大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0003b13, 0005a07 (上萬下如老和尚) and 0005c28.

teacher.quote: 字大博，為萬如通微禪師（1594-1657）法嗣…後謁龍池微禪師，至順治壬辰（1652）秋受記莂。

dates.quote: birth +1602；death +1673-09-20「康熙癸丑八月初十日，世壽七十二。」（《五燈全書》卷72）；僧臘五十九。塔於中盤之東南隅紫葢峰下。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: From Jintan (surname Chen), tonsured in his twenties under Gaoyuan at Yaojiang and fully ordained under Muchen Daomin at Tiantong. He worked on the koan of Nezha dismembering himself and had an opening, and presented Daomin with fifty-three verses on the Huayan, which Daomin praised. By his own account he followed Daomin through seven monasteries and attended him for thirteen years before receiving the dharma. He then held Dajue at Qingzhou and Jinsu at Jiaxing, and died on the 24th of the 11th month of 1673, aged 54; Lüyan He was among his heirs.

teacher.quote: 人天眾前特為拈出供養，即此堂上本師山翁大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His OWN dharma-milk stick (用酬法乳之恩) to 山翁 = 木陳道忞. Speaker self-identifies as 本昇 (lb 0661a30: 「本昇自揣愚蒙」). A-grade first-person.

teacher.quote: 恭祝本師老和尚六旬壽旦
teacher.note: celebrates 山翁's 60th (道忞 b.1596 → 1655), corroborating the master's identity.

teacher.quote: 復拈云：此一瓣香，自從七剎追隨，一十三載執侍，縣崖攃手，仍遭毒棒麤拳…今日理應昭雪，人天眾前特為拈出供養，即此堂上本師山翁大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. 山翁 is Muchen Daomin's sobriquet. And it independently confirms the harvest's note that he served Daomin thirteen years across seven monasteries — the master says so himself.

teacher.quote: 字天岸，為木陳道忞禪師（1596-1674）法嗣…法嗣有祖珍玉、侶巖荷、眉嶽琦、中牧瑛及谷庵朴等禪師。
(木陳忞法嗣) 天岸昇
眉嶽琦禪師……(天岸昇嗣)
teacher.note: his heirs filed under him

teacher.quote: 為木陳道忞禪師（1596-1674）法嗣。…謁天童忞圓具。

dates.quote: birth +1620；death「康熙癸丑十一月二十四，年五十四」（《正源略集》卷6；疑年錄：450）
birth +1620; death 「康熙癸丑十一月二十四，年五十四」（《正源略集》卷6）

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.source: 《正源略集》卷6、卷10 + 《五燈全書》卷94 (via DILA A016456)

bio: From Tongxiang in Jiaxing (surname Qian, mother Shen), born on the 7th of the 6th month of 1604. A hard boy who learned riding and archery at fourteen and meant to take a commission, he was turned by the sight of slaughter, went vegetarian, and at twenty-nine, on reading the Platform Sutra, abandoned his household and was tonsured at Jingshan under Wuyi. He was struck open by Miyun Yuanwu at Tiantong ('I do not know how to practise either'), was ordained by him in 1634, and after three years of labour broke through on striking a pillar. He was invited out to the Chandeng hermitage at Loujiang in 1669 and died on the 5th of the 2nd month of 1670, aged 67.

steles.title: 清傳臨濟正宗三十二世禪燈菴大方海和尚塔銘
steles.author: 錢廣居
steles.author_note: 前奉敕整飭關南兵巡道陝西按察司副使、婁江錢廣居譔 — a serving provincial judicial commissioner, and a lay associate (he signs a joint invitation to Dafang elsewhere in the same record).
steles.quote: 師諱行海，號大方，古檇李桐鄉人，錢氏子。母沈氏，始有瑞徵，夢紅日而娠，生於萬曆甲辰六月初七日巳時…二十九歲，閱《壇經》，憤激棄室，決意出家，禮徑山無異師披剃…往參天童密老和尚，見云：弟子不會修行，求慈悲開示。和尚云：我也不會修行。師禮拜，和尚驀頭一踏，當下知歸…
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷6, alongside an 行實.

teacher.quote: 復拈，云：者一瓣香，根盤四大部洲，葉蔭三千世界，昔在天童山裏拾來，又於雙徑峰頭證據，今日特為拈出，供養吳江報恩堂上傳曹溪正脈第三十五世先師浮石老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, AND IT SETTLES A CONFLICT. In his own words at his own enthronement he names 浮石 (Fushi Tongxian) of Wujiang Bao'en as 先師, the source of his dharma-milk. See the note below on the DILA discrepancy.

teacher.kind: preface to his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 已而親近費老人，重其機用，奪縱自由，每於人天眾前多方印證，幾欲付法，無領受意，自甘結茆，晦跡弢名。
teacher.note: THE KEY DISAMBIGUATION: Feiyin Tongrong 'repeatedly attested him before the assembly and WAS ON THE POINT of transmitting the dharma to him — but he had no mind to receive it, and withdrew of his own will to a thatched hut.' Feiyin nearly transmitted and did not. Fushi did.

teacher.quote: 年四十七在費和尚處得箇安樂處。
teacher.note: *** DILA IS MISLEADING HERE. *** Its extensive note mentions only 費和尚 (Feiyin Tongrong) and never names Fushi Tongxian, which would lead a reader to file him under Feiyin. His own incense and his own preface both say otherwise. I take the first-person incense. This is exactly the association-mistaken-for-transmission error the audit warned of — and here the authority database is the one that would have propagated it.

dates.quote: 生於萬曆甲辰六月初七日巳時。
birth +1604-07-03 生於萬曆甲辰六月初七日巳時；death +1670-02-24 庚戌二月初五日子時逝，世壽六十七（《大方禪師語錄》卷6）；臘三十六。

school.quote: 清傳臨濟正宗三十二世禪燈菴大方海和尚。

bio: From Lingling (surname Jiang), born on the 4th of the 8th month of 1621; illness at thirteen persuaded his father to let him take the robe. He was tonsured by Jianqu at the Dongle hall and wandered to Tiande, Xilian and Luohan; Qiezhuo gave him the name Yiwei. In 1653 he read the recorded sayings of the Old Man of Yishan, was astonished, and brought him to his own hermitage; on the Buddha's enlightenment day of 1657 he received his charge. He held Hongsheng, Shoufo, Shengming, Zhusheng, Baojing and Zuisheng, and died on the 7th of the 9th month of 1684, aged 64; his stupa stands to the right of Benshan monastery at Nanyuan.

steles.title: 逕庭宗禪師語錄 卷二〈塔銘〉
steles.quote: 師生於前明天啟辛酉八月四日，世壽六十有四…寂於康熙甲子九月初七日。
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷2 (quoted here via DILA's citation of it, which I confirmed against the text). It is DILA's sole source for his dates.

teacher.quote: 復於懷中拈出香，曰：此瓣香，烈如鴆毒，沾之則死不移時；利似霜鋒，觸之則喪不旋踵。爇向爐中，顓伸供養現住嶷山祝聖堂上傳曹洞正宗三十世握中符大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, and it gives the teacher's Caodong generation (30th). Repeated at 0044c11.

teacher.quote: 字逕庭，為嶷山握中智符禪師（1625-1688）法嗣…丁酉（1657）佛成道日得嶷山付囑。
teacher.note: DILA EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S NAME: 握中符 = 握中智符. Note the oddity that DILA dates the teacher 1625-1688, i.e. FOUR YEARS YOUNGER than his student — unusual but not impossible; I flag it rather than silently smooth it.

dates.quote: 師生於前明天啟辛酉八月四日…寂於康熙甲子九月初七日…世壽六十有四，法臘三十五。

school.quote: 傳曹洞正宗三十世握中符大和尚

bio: A man of Xizhou, a learned scholar before he took the robe, who studied with the living masters Dayang Jingxuan and Liangya of Fuyan on Nanyue. Reading Yunmen's recorded encounters he had a sudden awakening, and settled in the stupa of Chan master Hongjue on Mount Yunju, where students flocked to him and he was known as the Stupa-master Gu. He first preached at Zhishan; in 1037 Fan Zhongyan, governing Poyang, invited him to Jianfu. He died on the 4th day of mid-winter, 1045.

teacher.quote: 附錄：寂音尊者彈斥薦福古遙嗣雲門偃。林間錄云：古塔主去雲門之世無慮百年，而稱其嗣…二老皆以傳言行之自若，其於己甚重，於法甚輕。
teacher.note: *** DECISIVE, AND IT REFUSES THE EDGE. *** Huihong (寂音尊者, 1071-1128), writing within a lifetime of Chenggu, ATTACKS the claim: 'the Stupa-master Gu was near a hundred years removed from Yunmen's day, yet called himself his heir.' Yunmen died 949, Chenggu 1045. This is a REMOTE succession (遙嗣), not a transmission. I emit teacher: null.

teacher.quote: 西州人…出家從警玄遊。又謁南嶽雅，雅許入室。一日覽雲門禪師對機，忽然發悟…初說法于芝山，嗣雲門文偃匡真禪師。
teacher.note: DILA names his LIVING teachers as 警玄 (Dayang Jingxuan) and 南嶽（福嚴）雅 — 雅許入室, 'Ya admitted him to the room.' The batch file had written these as 大光敬玄; DILA reads 警玄. Either of these two, not Yunmen, is the real personal tie — but neither is called a transmission, so I leave teacher null and record the men here.

dates.quote: death +1045-12-20 慶曆五年仲冬四日坐逝（《建中靖國續燈錄》卷2；疑年錄：205）
dates.note: No birth recorded.

school.note: Filed as Yunmen — but only on the strength of the remote succession he himself claimed and Huihong denied.

bio: Lay surname Xiong, of Qijiang county in Yu (Chongqing). Born at the zi hour on 21/2 of 1605. At thirty, awake to the emptiness and suffering of body and world, he went to Mt Huayin to venerate Samantabhadra, met the master Changbai, and was tonsured and fully ordained by him. Changbai died six months later and he took over the cloister's affairs, resigning after four years to study in Jiangnan. Invited by Liu Sande of Sichuan to Baiyi pavilion on Mt Hu, he went; he later paid respects to Poshan Haiming, travelled to Emei, and sat in seven monasteries in succession discussing the Surangama, Perfect Enlightenment and Diamond sutras. When the dynasty fell in 1644 he hid in Yelang in Sichuan for eight years. In the 9th month of 1653, hearing that Poshan was at Jincheng temple in Liangshan, he went to him, followed him to Shuanggui, and there - the conditions ripe - became his dharma heir. He soon returned to Yuzhou and held Chongyin, then Zhiping, Shibao, Yuantong, Hongfu and Baolian. He died on 18/9 of 1673, aged 69, with 38 dharma-years.

steles.title: 照衣慧覺和尚行錄
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄, J35nB340 卷3)
steles.quote: 生於明萬曆乙巳年二月二十一日子時 … 康熙十二年九月十八日，世壽六十九
steles.note: His account-of-record, in fascicle 3 of his own recorded sayings; cited via DILA A011969, which quotes it for both birth and death and reproduces the whole career from it.

steles.title: 慧覺衣禪師語錄 卷三〈照衣慧覺和尚行錄〉
steles.quote: 生於明萬曆乙巳年二月二十一日子時…康熙十二年九月十八日，世壽六十九。
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷3; DILA's sole source for his dates. (Quote as cited by DILA from the 行錄; the 語錄 text itself is in the corpus.)

teacher.quote: 順治癸巳年九月，聞破山和尚住四川梁山金城寺，遂前往禮謁，後隨侍破山至雙桂寺，機緣成熟，為其法嗣。（《慧覺衣禪師語錄》卷三〈照衣慧覺和尚行錄〉；《錦江禪燈》卷十）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest. He had ALREADY 'paid respects to Poshan' years earlier (後參禮破山海明) - but the TRANSMISSION happened only after 1653, at Shuanggui. The 行錄 keeps the two encounters distinct.

teacher.quote: 法嗣有破峰重禪師、佛語御禪師、翠峩登禪師、琇峩脈禪師、正峩合禪師、清源懿禪師。（X85n1589_p0114a18）
teacher.note: 🔑 CORROBORATES THE HARVEST'S BONUS FIND: 破峰[普]重 IS his heir. The harvest spotted 「東山破峯重禪師語錄二卷…嗣慧覺衣」 in B35n0194 and proposed him as a NEW master. DILA's independent heir-list confirms it. RECOMMEND: create 破峰普重 as a new node under this man.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香，向幾頹皮骨、幾斷情關、四絕三甦、一生九死處得來…爇向爐中，單為供養見住夔州府梁山縣金城山金城禪寺醉佛樓上傳臨濟正宗第三十一世本師破山大和尚，用酬法乳深恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0763c12 (雙桂堂上…破山大和尚，用報法乳之恩) and 0765a22.

teacher.quote: 順治癸巳年九月，聞破山和尚住四川梁山金城寺，遂前往禮謁，後隨侍破山至雙桂寺，機緣成熟，為其法嗣。
