dates.note: Harvest had no dates.

dates.quote: birth +1605-04-08；death +1673-10-27「康熙十二年九月十八日，世壽六十九」（〈照衣慧覺和尚行錄〉）；臘三十八。

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派
sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 本渝之綦江縣人，俗姓熊…年三十，悟身世苦空，於華銀山參禮普賢大士，值遇常白師，乃依師剃髮受具足戒…順治元年，值甲申之變，隱於四川夜郎八年。

bio: An heir of Tian'an Bensheng of Jinsu, and thus a grand-heir of Muchen Daomin. He held the Longquan hermitage on Mount Wu in Huzhou, the Shizi Lin at Tiaocheng, and the Dongchan monastery on Mount Long in Anji, and left a seven-fascicle record compiled by Chengchun. Only the first character of his dharma name (He) is preserved; his dates are unrecorded. A preface to his record by the elder Xiaoxi calls him 'a thousand-league colt of our house' and rejoices on behalf of 'my dharma-brother Sheng of Jinsu' — his teacher.

teacher.quote: 侶巖荷禪師語錄七卷。清 荷說，成純錄，曉皙序，陳薰序…南嶽下第三十六世，嗣天岸昇。
teacher.note: The catalogue of the Jiaxing canon files his record explicitly as 嗣天岸昇.

teacher.quote: 適侍僧攜侶巖禪姪語錄至，讀未終篇，見其機語穎脫，識見軼群，誠吾家千里駒也…頗為吾金粟 昇兄喜。
teacher.note: The prefacer calls Lüyan his dharma-NEPHEW (禪姪) and Sheng of Jinsu his dharma-BROTHER (昇兄) — which places Lüyan as Sheng's heir, from a contemporary who knew both.

teacher.quote: 為天岸本昇禪師（1620-1673）法嗣。有《侶巖荷禪師語錄》七卷。（《五燈全書》卷94）
法嗣有祖珍玉、侶巖荷、眉嶽琦、中牧瑛及谷庵朴等禪師。
teacher.note: Confirmed from the other direction: Tian'an Bensheng's own record lists Lüyan He among his heirs.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT. No transmission-incense survives in his record either.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；南嶽下第三十六世

bio: A Yuan Linji monk of Cixi and heir of Liao'an Qingyu, whose recorded sayings he helped edit (fascicle 2). He was installed at Mingyan Dafan on Mount Tiantai in 1357, moved to Longhua Baosheng in Hangzhou in 1364, and in 1374, under the new Ming, took Jinshan Longyou at Zhenjiang. He left a one-fascicle record of his own; his heir was Qingyi. His dates are not recorded.

teacher.quote: 次拈香，云：此香亘古亘今，非妙非麤，第三回拈出，供養我金剛幢的嗣千佛慈雲院了庵大和尚，一爐爇却，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, and it defeats the editor-trap. He appears in Liao'an's record only as one of twenty NAMED EDITORS (參學), which by itself would prove nothing — an editor is not an heir. But in his own words he calls himself Liao'an's 的嗣, his TRUE heir, and burns the incense of dharma-milk to him.

teacher.quote: 生卒年不詳。為了菴清欲禪師（1288-1363）法嗣。元至正丁酉（1357）住明巖大梵，至正甲辰（1364）遷龍華寶乘。明洪武甲寅（1374）主金山龍游。編《了菴清欲禪師語錄》第二卷。法嗣為清逸禪師。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT on dates. Attested active 1357-1374.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: From Fuqing in Fujian (surname Chen), turned toward the gate by chancing on the Zhengmai in a temple at Wushan, tonsured at nineteen. He worked three years on the character wu without result, changed to 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one' under Wuyi at Gushan, then found real footing under Miyun Yuanwu at Huangbo, was ordained by him, and followed him out of Fujian to Jinsu — where, by his own account, six years of toil left him still unmatched. He was finally sealed by Poshan Haiming, whom he followed into Sichuan and served as western-hall elder. He opened Longpan, Nianhua, Baolin and Lengqie, held Huangbo twice, and died in the 7th month of 1651, aged 54.

steles.title: 象崖珽禪師塔銘
steles.quote: (in 卷四, alongside the 行狀)
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷4. DILA cites both 〈象崖珽禪師塔銘〉 and 〈象崖珽禪師行狀〉 from this fascicle.

steles.title: 象崖珽禪師行狀
steles.quote: 年歲在辛卯，世壽五十四。
steles.note: DILA's source for his death; quoted by DILA from 《象崖珽禪師語錄》卷四〈象崖珽禪師行狀〉.

teacher.quote: 拈香，云：者瓣香，帶雨露而出淵關，六載辛勤，心燈始契；涉吳楚而栖蜀水，一朝授受，智印方傳…奉為現住紹祖山中慶禪寺傳臨濟正宗三十一世破山大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。惟願生生執巾侍缾，世世續燄聯芳。
teacher.note: DECISIVE, and it narrates the whole arc in one breath: six years of toil (under Miyun) before the mind-lamp met, then the crossing into Shu where 'in one morning the seal of wisdom was handed over' — by Poshan. Repeated at 0535a08 and 0535c01 (萬峰頂上得來，親蒙印可).

teacher.quote: 梁山黃檗象崖珽禪師，福清陳氏。破山海明（1597-1666）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第三十六世…復黃檗參密祖，始覺大有得力處…後參破山和尚，受印可。
嗣法弟子有空外大逵、四維普寬、象崖性珽等共八十七人。
teacher.note: Confirmed from the other direction — Poshan's own record names him among the heirs.

dates.quote: birth +1598；death「年歲在辛卯，世壽五十四」（〈象崖珽禪師行狀〉）；順治八年辛卯坐脫，法臘三十五。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第三十六世

bio: From Yongchuan in western Shu (surname Zhang), born on the 30th of the 1st month of 1637; his father carried him into Guizhou. Tonsured at sixteen under Zhiru of Dongshan, he took the ten precepts at twenty and at twenty-one met Lingyin at Diancheng. In the winter of 1661, serving as precentor at Lingyin's retreat at Guanyin monastery in Doubao, he received the dharma on the Buddha's enlightenment day. He taught across Yunnan and Guizhou — Qingyuan, Huaguang, Yuhuang, Dengjue, Yuange, Yuantong — and went up to Tiantong to sweep Miyun's stupa. He died in the 1st month of 1701, aged 63, and his bones were brought back to Dongshan.

steles.title: 東山梅溪度禪師語錄 卷十〈行由〉
steles.quote: 丁丑正月三十寅時
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷10; DILA's source for his birth.

teacher.quote: 再拈云：此瓣香，得處辛勤，拈來快便，此是第一回拈出，爇向爐中，供養傳臨濟正宗第三十二世光師靈隱文老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Repeated at 0380c12 (先師靈隱文老和尚).

teacher.kind: memorial incense on his teacher's death-day
teacher.quote: 本師靈隱老人忌日，拈香。「二月二十二，吾師涅槃，法乳若為酬，單憑此一句。」
teacher.note: He keeps his teacher's memorial day on the 22nd of the 2nd month — confirming the harvest's note that Lingyin died on that date, from the student's own mouth.

teacher.quote: 為靈隱印文禪師法嗣…年二十一參靈隱禪師於滇城…辛丑（1661）冬靈隱禪師抵黔之竇堡觀音寺結制，赴堂任維那，於佛成道日得付法。
teacher.note: DILA EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S NAME: the corpus's bare 靈隱文 = 靈隱印文, who has his own record (靈隱文禪師語錄, J39nB446) — which Meixi Fudu himself edited.

dates.quote: birth +1637-02-24「丁丑正月三十寅時」（〈行由〉）；death +1701「一月正中天，遂投筆而逝，世壽六十三。」（《黔南會燈錄》卷3）；僧臘四十七。

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派；臨濟正宗第三十二世(師)

bio: From Jiangdu in Weiyang (surname Shi), sent at twelve to the Tianning monastery of his prefecture; he was tonsured by Shaolin Song of Jingci, given the robe by Tieniu Yin of Lingyin, and took Longxi Zuxin of the Dongtang cloister as his teacher of record, serving him five years. Roused one night by the thought that Bodhidharma's heirs had been ordinary men like himself, he set out at dawn and travelled the south, coming at last to Wude Juetong, who was then preaching Songyuan's dharma at Jianfu in Poyang; he followed him to Fuyan and Huazang and was matched to him 'as lodestone to iron.' Coming out at Banshan in Jiankang in the early Chunyou years, he raised the incense as Wude's heir. He held Jinshan, Luyuan, Shushan, Chengtian, Zhong Tianzhu and Lingyin, was summoned to Jingshan in 1277, and died on the 24th of the 4th month of 1280, aged 82.

steles.title: 虛舟普度禪師語錄〈行狀〉 (No. 1407-B)
steles.quote: 師諱普度，維楊江都人，號虗舟，姓史氏…命依郡之天寧出家，時年十二矣…淨慈少林崧為之落䰂，靈隱䥫牛印為之付衣，本郡東堂院龍溪祖信為之受業。師納戒已，歸東堂，服勤信左右者五年…無得通禪師時唱松源之道于番昜薦福，因決意扣請…自此磁鐵相契…淳祐初，制府趙信菴以建康半山敦請出世，舉香嗣無得。
steles.note: PRIMARY, appended to his own 語錄. It carefully distinguishes the four men who each did one thing for him — tonsure, robe, ordination-of-record, and the DHARMA — and says of the last, 舉香嗣無得, 'he raised the incense as heir of Wude.'

teacher.quote: 淳祐初，制府趙信菴以建康半山敦請出世，舉香嗣無得。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. Note that 鐵牛印 gave him the ROBE and 龍溪祖信 was his ordination master — neither is the transmitter. Exactly the distinction the audit says the old roster kept losing.

teacher.quote: 奉為前住常州褒忠顯報華藏禪寺先師無得和尚，爇向爐中，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: In his own words, repeated eight times over thirty years (see 0177a12: 此一瓣香，三十年八回拈出).

teacher.kind: preface by his heir 瓊林
teacher.quote: 儻閱此而知有松源太師祖的傳之旨。
teacher.note: His heir calls Songyuan the 太師祖 — great-grand-teacher — which places Wude Juetong exactly one step between.

teacher.quote: 號虗舟，華藏無得通禪師法嗣。

dates.quote: birth +1199；death +1280-05-31「至元十七年四月二十四日，壽八十二」（〈行狀〉）；坐夏六十八。
dates.note: CORRECTS THE HARVEST. The batch file read his death-verse era as 元貞 and left death null; the 行狀 says 至元十七年 = 1280. Age 82 gives birth 1199.

bio: A Qing Linji monk, recorded only as a disciple of Yuan'an Benliao (遠菴本僼) of Ruiyan and Tiantong. Nothing else about him is preserved: no dates, no seat, no recorded sayings, no stele.

teacher.quote: 遠庵僼嗣　淮陰長壽古律範禪師（補遺）
teacher.note: 遠庵僼嗣 — 'heir of Yuan'an [Ben]liao'. 嗣 is a transmission verb. Confirms teacher 瑞巖遠菴本僼.

teacher.quote: 古律範。遠菴本僼弟子。（X82n1571_p0531b07）
teacher.note: The single line of evidence, resting on 五燈全書 (X82n1571). This agrees with the harvest, which found the 「遠庵僼嗣」 note inside 古律範's own div in the XML. I could NOT independently surface the passage in my tag-stripped corpus cache, so I rest the claim on DILA + its X82n1571 citation and flag it as thin.

bio: From Kunshan (surname Lu), driven to leave home when his sister-in-law's corpse stirred. Tonsured at twenty-one at Tiantong and ordained three years later, he studied with Muyun Tongmen and then attached himself to Muchen Daomin (Hongjue), from whom he received the dharma after fifteen years of hammering. He was installed at Shending in Tanzhou in 1656, succeeded Daomin in the seat of Tiantong in 1661, and then held Ruiyan (1670), Pingyang (1674) and Baiyun (1679). He died in the 4th month of 1682, aged 61; his heir was Yikui Yuankui.

steles.title: 瑞巖遠菴僼禪師塔銘
steles.quote: (in 卷十六)
steles.note: PRIMARY, in his own 語錄 卷16, per DILA's citation.

steles.title: 瑞巖遠菴僼禪師塔銘
steles.author: (named in his 語錄 卷16; cited by DILA)
steles.note: DILA cites 《遠菴僼禪師語錄》卷16〈瑞巖遠菴僼禪師塔銘〉 as a source for his life. His 語錄 (16 fascicles, edited by his heir 元視) carries it.

teacher.quote: 打頭惡似冤家，末後兇如債主，一十五年鍛鍊，直得徹骨徹髓，三回九轉鉗鎚…對此人天拈出，專誠供養兩住天童現坐萬善楊岐正脈二十四世弘覺禪師山翁老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. 弘覺禪師山翁 = Muchen Daomin. Repeated at 0348b24 and 0362c21 (弘覺禪師忞老和尚 — spelling out the 忞).

teacher.quote: 號遠菴，為木陳道忞禪師（1596-1674）法嗣。崑山人，俗姓陸…參牧雲門禪師，後依弘覺忞禪師而得法。
一十五年鍛鍊，直得徹骨徹髓，三回九轉鉗鎚…專誠供養兩住天童現坐萬善楊岐正脈二十四世弘覺禪師山翁老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: '弘覺禪師山翁' is Muchen Daomin by title and sobriquet — named by his heir's own hand, with fifteen years of forging behind it.

bio: A Northern Song Linji master, dharma heir of Guyin Yuncong (Guyin Cong). The Xu chuandeng lu files him under 'the heirs of Chan master Guyin Cong' and records his exchanges; Xiyu Jingduan and Cuiyan Xianchou came from his gate. No dates survive.

teacher.quote: 大鑑下第十一世：谷隱聰禪師法嗣三十五人…龍華齊岳禪師。
teacher.note: Listed among 谷隱蘊聰's heirs.

teacher.quote: 杭州龍華齊岳禪師法嗣二人，一人見錄。

bio: From Chongning in Pengzhou (surname Luo), a boy of a Confucian family who read a Buddhist book at Miaoji monastery and said 'I must have been a monk in a former life.' He studied under a succession of masters — Yuanming Minxing, Zhaojue Sheng, Donglin Changzong, Huitang — before Wuzu Fayan broke him open; of the three who sat with him that night on the pavilion, Fayan said 'the one who will destroy my house is Keqin.' He taught at Zhaojue, Daolin, Jiangshan, Tianning, Jinshan and Yunju, was styled Foguo and then Yuanwu by two emperors, and composed the Blue Cliff Record at Jiayan. He died on the 5th of the 8th month of 1135, aged 73; Dahui Zonggao and Huqiu Shaolong were among forty-six heirs.

steles.title: 圜悟和尚塔銘
steles.author: 張浚 (張德遠)
steles.author_note: Chancellor of the Southern Song - the same statesman who wrote Dahui's stupa inscription.
steles.quote: 謁丞相張公德遠于四安，求圜悟和尚塔銘…又按答佛性泰禪師書：「屬者訪張丞相弟兄艤舟、霅川，為數日之款，已為先師製得塔銘，見刊石，佗日尋便奉寄。」
steles.note: From DAHUI'S OWN 年譜: Dahui went to Chancellor Zhang Jun to request his late master's stupa inscription, and Dahui's own letter to Chan master Foxing Tai reports 'he has already composed the stupa inscription for my late master, and it is now being cut in stone.' First-person testimony to the stele's making. I did not locate the carved text itself in the corpus.

steles.title: 圜悟年譜 (62 fascicles, compiled by 木陳道忞)
steles.author: 木陳道忞
steles.quote: 將先師圓悟語錄一十二卷，與忞所編年譜六十二帙，先經繕寫進呈外，伏乞俯鑒微忱，下頒鈞旨賜收入《大藏》永使流通
steles.note: ⚠ CAUTION: this is a LATE (1660) memorial by Muchen Daomin petitioning the Shunzhi emperor to admit 'my late master Yuanwu's' record and his own 62-fascicle year-chronicle into the canon. Muchen's master was MIYUN Yuanwu (密雲圓悟, d.1642), NOT Yuanwu Keqin. Same name 圓悟, different men, five centuries apart. DO NOT attach this to Keqin. Recorded here only to warn the merge.

teacher.quote: 南嶽下十四世：五祖演禪師法嗣。成都府昭覺寺克勤佛果禪師，彭州駱氏子。
三佛侍師於一亭上夜話，及歸燈已滅。師於暗中曰：各人下一轉語。佛鑑曰：彩鳳舞丹霄。佛眼曰：鐵虵橫古路。佛果曰：看脚下。師曰：滅吾宗者，乃克勤爾。
teacher.note: Wuzu Fayan's own words about him.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 of Foyan Qingyuan (李彌遜)
teacher.quote: 嗣法兄佛果大師克勤狀師之行。
teacher.note: A STELE calls him the 嗣法兄 — elder dharma-brother — of Foyan Qingyuan, who was Fayan's heir. Independent confirmation of his descent from the same master, from a document written at a grave.

teacher.quote: 五祖法演（？-1104）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十五世。
成都府昭覺寺克勤佛果禪師，彭州駱氏。五祖法演（？-1104）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十五世…最後見五祖演禪師，即大悟
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster.

teacher.quote: 堂疾革，囑師曰：「吾去後，當見川勤，必能盡子機用。」勤，即圓悟。
teacher.note: Zhantang Wenzhun on his deathbed sends Dahui to 'Qin of Sichuan' - i.e. Yuanwu. Fixes Yuanwu's identity and his standing.

dates.quote: birth +1063；death +1135-09-21「紹興五年八月五日示寂，春秋七十三」（《佛祖歷代通載》卷20）；坐夏五十五。六年三月，諡真覺禪師。
紹興五年八月五日示寂，春秋七十三（《佛祖歷代通載》卷 20）
dates.note: Died 1135-09-21 aged 73 -> b.1063. Roster CONFIRMED. Posthumous title 真覺禪師 granted 1136.

sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；嗣法弟子有虎丘紹隆、大慧宗杲等四十六人

bio.quote: 偶過妙寂院，見佛書讀之，三復悵然如獲舊物曰：「吾殆過去沙門也。」始棄家祝髮…留居碧岩院，傾心事之

notes: Compiler of the Blue Cliff Record, the most celebrated koan collection in Chan.

bio: A Southern Song Linji monk and heir of Songyuan Chongyue, twentieth generation from Huineng. He taught at Jianfu in Poyang and then held the Huazang Chan monastery at Changzhou (the Baozhong Xianbao Huazang), later moving to Fuyan and Huazang. It was at Jianfu that Xuzhou Pudu came to him and took his dharma. Only a handful of his sermons survive; his dates are not recorded.

teacher.quote: 靈隱嶽禪師法嗣：慶元府天童滅翁文禮禪師…常州華藏無得覺通禪師。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. 靈隱嶽 is Songyuan Chongyue (abbot of Lingyin). He and Miweng Wenli — also in this batch — are listed consecutively as heirs of the same master.

teacher.kind: 行狀 of his heir Xuzhou Pudu
teacher.quote: 無得通禪師時唱松源之道于番昜薦福。
teacher.note: A stele describing him as 'preaching Songyuan's dharma' — corroboration from the next generation down.

teacher.quote: 靈隱崇獄禪師法嗣。宗晉水教，大鑑下二十世，住常州華藏寺。時無得唱道饒州薦福，虛舟普度（1199-1280）謁之，得其法。

dates.note: GENUINELY SILENT.

bio.quote: 常州華藏無得覺通禪師。青苗會，上堂：破一微塵出大經，鳶飛魚躍更分明。不將眼看將心看，已見重敲火裏氷。

bio: From Lin'an in Hangzhou (surname Ruan), whose family lived at the foot of Mount Tianmu — whence his other name. Tonsured at sixteen by Zhiyue of the Zhenxiang monastery, he went to Hunyuan Tanmi at Jingci without result, then to Foizhao Deguang at Ayuwang, who questioned him on the flag and the wind and approved him. But hearing that Songyuan Chongyue was teaching Ying'an's dharma at Jianfu in Rao — and that in his room he drove monks out with the stick at the first hesitation — Wenli suddenly let go of all he understood, went to him, and 'obtained Songyuan's house-dharma, and so became his heir.' He opened at Huiyun in Lin'an in 1212 and held Guangshou, Nengren, Fuquan, Jingci and finally Tiantong. He was learned in the Yijing and exchanged words with Zhu Xi and Yang Jianhu. He died on the 10th of the 10th month of 1250, aged 84.

steles.title: 天目禪師行狀
steles.author: 天台德雲
steles.quote: 天台德雲：天目禪師行狀。師諱文禮，號滅翁，杭之臨安人。姓阮氏，家在天目山之麓，因號云…壽八十四，臘六十八，淳祐十年十月十日卒也。師生于乾道丁亥…十六，依鄉之真相寺智月剃落。走淨慈，參混源密源…謁育王佛照光…松源嶽唱應菴之道于饒之薦福，室中問僧：「不是風動，不是旛動，擬議即棒出！」師聞之，頓忘知解…得松源家法，則為其嗣焉。
steles.note: PRIMARY, in the 天童寺志. It states the transmission in as many words — 得松源家法，則為其嗣焉 — and carefully distinguishes it from Foizhao Deguang, who had merely APPROVED him earlier. Note also that he was buried east of Ying'an Tanhua's stupa at Tiantong; Ying'an is #14 in this same batch.

teacher.quote: 得松源家法，則為其嗣焉。
teacher.note: DECISIVE. And the same document names the men he did NOT succeed — 混源曇密, 佛照德光, 塗毒, 遯菴, 葦堂, 無用 — which is precisely the discrimination the old roster kept failing to make.

teacher.quote: 靈隱嶽禪師法嗣：慶元府天童滅翁文禮禪師。
松源崇嶽（1139-1209）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十世…初參混源曇密禪師、佛照德光禪師，後謁松源嶽禪師得法。

dates.quote: 壽八十四，臘六十八，淳祐十年十月十日卒也。師生于乾道丁亥。
birth 乾道丁亥 (1167)；death +1250-11-12「淳祐十年十月十日卒，壽八十四」（《天童寺志》卷7〈天目禪師行狀〉）

bio: A Ming Linji monk of the Qinling mountains, and the recipient of the dharma from Jingshan Huaibao. He is a hinge, not a figure: almost nothing of him survives beyond the fact of the transmission, and he owes his place entirely to the pedigree that runs through him down to Chuiwan Guangzhen and the Juyun house of Sichuan. Chuiwan's own stele concedes that for Tieniu and his heir Yueming, unlike the ten masters above them, 'only the words of their meeting and the verse of entrustment are recorded.'

teacher.quote: 大師諱廣真，僰道宜賓人，俗姓李…得法於月明聯池老人。池嗣鐵牛遠，遠嗣荊山寶，寶嗣無念有，有嗣二仰欽，欽嗣小庵密，密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益，益嗣淨慈明，明嗣鼓山永，永嗣西禪需，需嗣大慧杲。歷溯源流，師固大慧十四世孫也。
teacher.note: THE THIRTEEN-GENERATION PEDIGREE, in a named man's hand (田華國, 監軍道湖廣參知政事四川觀察使). This is the document in which Tieniu's link is asserted — and it is the SEAM at which the whole chain is grafted onto Dahui.

teacher.quote: 大慧下十尊宿，遞有機緣語錄流傳，至鐵牛、月明，但述相見之語、付囑之偈。
teacher.note: *** THE TELL, AND IT IS IN THE PEDIGREE'S OWN DOCUMENT. *** For the ten masters above, recorded sayings survive. For Tieniu and Yueming — the two links nearest the claimant — there is nothing but 'the words of the meeting and the verse of entrustment.' The stele-writer says so himself. The evidence for this edge is exactly as thin as the harvest suspected.

teacher.quote: 秦嶺鐵牛德遠為荊山寶法嗣。（明清序：016；J40nB487_p0302c01）
懷寶 | 荊山懷寶。明。江陵。臨濟宗 楊岐派。荊山懷寶禪師，渚宮人。為無念有法嗣。（X84n1583）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE TEACHER'S NAME: the corpus's bare 荊山寶 = 荊山懷寶, and DILA independently confirms the next link up (無念有 = 無念深有), matching the pedigree above.

bio: A Ming Linji monk of Hangzhou (surname Qian), who taught at Taigang (Dagang) in Nanjing and was styled Great Master Yuanming Pujue. He stands in the line running from Wuji Mingwu through Yuexi Cheng, and transmitted to Tianmu Baofang Jin of Hangzhou. He died on the 3rd of the 9th month of 1491, cranes circling the hall.

teacher.quote: 俊傳東普無際明悟。悟傳月溪澂。澂傳夷峯寧。寧傳杭州天目寶方進。
teacher.note: teacher 月溪澄 confirmed in the transmission chain.
corroborates 月溪澄 as teacher

teacher.quote: 俊傳東普無際明悟。悟傳月溪澂。澂傳夷峯寧。寧傳杭州天目寶方進。進傳嘉興東塔野翁曉。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher, and places him precisely: 無際明悟 → 月溪澂 → 夷峰寧 → 天目寶方進.

teacher.quote: 方寧 | 夷峯方寧 | 夷峰寧 | 圓明普覺大師。杭州人，姓錢，南京太岡僧人。（祖燈．卷90：1771；疑年錄：356）
teacher.note: EXPANDS THE NAME. The harvest wrote 'Bare sobriquet + one dharma character; NOT expanded.' DILA supplies the full dharma name: 方寧. And 南京太岡 confirms the harvest's 大崗.

dates.quote: death +1491-10-14《徑石滴乳集》卷2：「弘治四年九月三日示疾，時羣鶴遶殿而逝。」（X67, no. 1308；疑年錄：356）
dates.note: Death 1491. No birth recorded.

school.quote: sect 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: A Liu-Song monk of the Wei clan of Julu. He was tonsured under Zhu Fatai, then went to Mount Lu to study with Huiyuan, and later studied under Kumarajiva. He argued that even the icchantika possesses buddha-nature and that awakening is sudden, was denounced as heretical and expelled, and withdrew to Tiger Hill at Pingjiang. When the full Nirvana Sutra was later translated and confirmed his reading, he was called the 'Nirvana sage'. He died seated at the Mount Lu monastery in 434.

teacher.kind: CONTEMPORARY eulogy — 龍光寺竺道生法師誄, by 宋釋慧琳, written at his death (廣弘明集 卷23)
teacher.quote: 元嘉十一年冬十月庚子。道生法師卒於廬山。…法師本姓魏。彭城人也。父廣戚縣令。幼而奇之。携就法汰法師。改服從業。…中年遊學廣搜異聞。自楊徂秦登廬躡霍。羅什大乘之趣。提婆小道之要。咸暢斯旨究舉其奧。
teacher.note: ⚠ READ THE VERBS. The one contemporary witness says 竺法汰 is the master he was taken to and under whom he 改服從業 (changed robes / took up study) — that is a TONSURE-and-study master. Kumarajiva (羅什) and Devaśarman (提婆) appear only as bodies of doctrine whose purport he 'fully expounded and exhausted' (咸暢斯旨究舉其奧) — a curriculum, not a transmission. Neither man 'transmits' to him: 嗣法/得法/付法/印可 appear nowhere.

teacher.quote: 幼依竺法汰（320-387）出家，後入廬山師事慧遠，又從鳩摩羅什受學
teacher.note: THREE teachers, not one. Zhu Fatai tonsured him; Huiyuan taught him at Mt Lu; Kumarajiva he 'studied under' (受學). The roster's single 'Kumarajiva' is defensible but flattens the record. There is no Chan dharma-transmission here at all — he predates the lineage system.

dates.quote: 以宋元嘉十一年冬十月庚子。於廬山精舍……端坐正容隱机而卒。（T55n2145_p0111a18）
dates.note: The death quote is drawn from 出三藏記集 (T2145), a 6th-c. catalogue — the closest thing to a contemporary source. Birth 355 is back-computed from 世壽八十.

bio.source: 金陵梵剎志‧卷48‧青園寺竺道生傳
bio.note: Cited in the DILA mentionedIn field; not independently read.

notes: Argued all beings possess buddha-nature. Championed sudden enlightenment, anticipating Chan.
edge_note: Pre-Chan: doctrinally associated with the 涅槃經 (Nirvana Sutra) but has no dharma transmission -- carries no lineage edge.

bio: The Sixth Patriarch. Of the Lu clan, a native of Xinzhou; Wang Wei's stele calls his ancestral seat Fanyang. He served under Hongren at Huangmei, taking the mill and mortar work, and received transmission. Wang Wei's stele says he then 'hid his treasure and concealed his traces' for sixteen years among ordinary people before Yinzong of Faxing monastery in Nanhai heard him expound and had him tonsured. He taught sudden awakening at Baolin monastery in Caoxi for some thirty years and died in 713.

steles.title: 六祖能禪師碑銘并序
steles.author: 王維
steles.author_note: Wang Wei the poet, Shangshu Zuocheng — commissioned by Heze Shenhui, and thus written within living memory of the disciples. The single most important early source on Huineng.
steles.quote: 六祖能禪師碑銘并序王維……禪師俗姓盧氏本貫范陽人也……年若干事黃梅忍大師願竭其力即安于井臼素刳其心獲悟於稊稗
steles.note: Names Hongren (黃梅忍大師) as his master outright. Also reproduced at G/G155/G155n2590.xml lb 0592a01 (全唐文 卷327). Two further Tang steles are named in the corpus but not reproduced: 柳宗元〈六祖第一碑〉and 劉禹錫〈六祖第二碑〉(G155n2590 lb 0141a08).

teacher.quote: 年若干事黃梅忍大師
teacher.note: Contemporary-adjacent. The strongest evidence on the roster for any early master.

teacher.quote: 往謁五祖弘忍於蘄州黃梅東禪院

dates.quote: 生於：唐, 太宗, 貞觀, 十二年, 二月, 初八日
dates.note: Zhenguan 12 = 638. Death 713 (先天二年) is given in B25n0142 (Hu Shih): 慧能死在先天二年七一三，年七十六。

notes: Sixth Patriarch and pivotal figure in Chan history. Born 638 in Xinzhou, Guangdong, to a poor family. Received secret transmission from Hongren after composing a verse demonstrating sudden awakening. His Platform Sutra (六祖壇經) established the 'sudden awakening' teaching. All Chan lineages descend through his five principal dharma heirs. His mummified body is preserved at Nanhua Temple.

school: 石頭宗 (Shitou line; ancestor of Caodong)
bio: Of the Chen clan of Gaoyao. Barely twenty when he heard that the Sixth Patriarch had come south, he went straight to Caoxi. He took full ordination at Luofu in 728, then went to Luling to study under Qingyuan Xingsi and received his teaching. In the early Tianbao years he built a hut on a rock on Nanyue, from which he was called 'Master Stone-head'. He wrote the Cantongqi and the Caoantge. He died in 790.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988) — 唐南嶽石頭山希遷傳
teacher.quote: 聞大鑒禪師南來，學心相踵。遷乃直往，大鑒衎然持其手…既而靈機一發，廓若初霽…開元十六年羅浮受具戒…後聞廬陵青原山思禪師為曹溪補〔處〕…
teacher.note: ⚠ CAREFUL READING REQUIRED. He met 大鑒 (Huineng) FIRST as a youth — but Huineng died (713) while Xiqian was still young, and the transmission was completed under 青原行思 (思禪師), whom he sought out AFTER. 宋高僧傳's own sequence (Huineng → precepts 728 → THEN 青原) makes 行思 the dharma-father, which is the orthodox lineage. The roster's 青原行思 is correct.

teacher.quote: 〔青原行思大師法嗣〕南嶽石頭希遷大師
teacher.note: Filed as 青原行思's heir — the standard placement in all lamps.

teacher.quote: 青原行思（671-741）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二世……後至廬陵從青原行思，得旨
南嶽石頭希遷大師法嗣
teacher.note: Section heading — i.e. the lamps treat him as a teacher of record in the Qingyuan line.

dates.quote: 卒於：唐, 德宗, 貞元, 六年, 十二月, 二十五日，91歲
dates.note: Zhenyuan 6 = 790, aged 91 → birth 700. Matches the roster.

notes: Ancestor of the Caodong lineage. Author of the Cantongqi (參同契, Harmony of Difference and Sameness). Along with Mazu, one of the two great branches of Tang Chan.

school: Heze 荷澤宗 (so the lineage tradition) / Jingzhong 淨眾 (so the earliest biography)
bio: Of the Zhang clan. The Song Gaoseng Zhuan says he had grasped the deep import of Caoxi but had no one to confirm it, and so went to Master Hui of Jingzhong monastery. From Jiangling he entered Shu, cleared the grass and built a thatched hut on the south bank of the Shu river; followers gathered and it grew into a monastery — this in the first year of Zhenyuan (785). After Gao Chongwen pacified Liu Pi the temple was renamed Yuanhe Shengshou. He died in the early Changqing years (821-824) and was entombed at the monastery. Pei Xiu calls him the dharma-grandfather of Guifeng Zongmi.

steles.title: 圭峯禪師碑銘 (the stele of 圭峯宗密)
steles.author: traditionally 裴休 (the corpus cites the stele by title; I do not assert the author beyond that)
steles.quote: 荷澤傳磁州如，如傳荊南忠，忠傳遂州圓，圓傳禪師。
steles.note: Same text at B35n0195 0852a16 and T49n2036 0635b13. It is a stele for the GRANDSON, not for Nanyin himself — but per the brief, a stele in somebody else's book is still stone, and this one carves the edge we need.

teacher.kind: 圭峯禪師碑銘 — the STELE for his dharma-grandson Zongmi
teacher.quote: 曹溪傳荷澤，荷澤傳磁州如，如傳荊南忠，忠傳遂州圓，圓傳禪師。師於荷澤為五世，於迦葉為三十八世，其宗系如此。
teacher.note: 荊南忠 = 唯忠, i.e. 南印 (俗姓張, hence 裴休's variant 「荊南張」). The lineage 磁州如 → 荊南忠 is carved on the stele of 圭峯宗密 (780–841) — a man only one generation below Nanyin, whose own dharma-grandfather this is. B35n0195 (0852a16) cites the identical line and labels its source: 「（圭峯禪師碑銘）」. THIS OVERTURNS THE BATCH FILE'S OWN FLAG, which asserted the roster's 'Cizhou Zhiru' is unsupported. It is supported — by stone.

teacher.kind: 宗密's own 圓覺經略疏鈔 卷四, quoted
teacher.quote: 磁州法觀寺智如和尚，俗姓王。門下成都府聖壽寺唯忠和尚，俗姓張，亦號南印。
teacher.note: Zongmi in his OWN WORDS names the man, his temple (磁州法觀寺), his lay surname (王), and identifies 唯忠 of 成都聖壽寺 — 亦號南印 — as his disciple. Zongmi is a near-contemporary of Nanyin and had every reason to know his own lineage. Also gives the NAME CORRECTION: the man's dharma name is 唯忠/惟忠; 南印 is a sobriquet.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 — the apparent counter-witness, RECONCILED
teacher.quote: 次成都府元和聖壽寺釋南印，姓張氏。明寤之性，受益無厭，得曹溪深旨，無以為證。見淨眾寺會師，所謂落機之錦，濯以增研，銜燭之龍，行而破暗。印自江陵入蜀…於長慶初示疾入滅。
teacher.note: ⚠ READ IT CAREFULLY — this does NOT contradict the stele. 贊寧 says Nanyin 得曹溪深旨 (already HAD the Caoxi dharma — from whom is left unstated, i.e. from Zhiru) but 無以為證 — HAD NO ONE TO CERTIFY IT. Then he met 淨眾寺會師 (= 淨眾神會 of Chengdu, NOT 荷澤神會 — a name collision to watch), who is described with the image of brocade already woven and merely WASHED to bring up its sheen (落機之錦，濯以增研). That is certification of an existing attainment, not the giving of it. 印順 reads it exactly so (Y40n0038, 0424a05): 「南印曾得曹溪的深法（應是從磁州智如得來），卻沒有人為他印證。淨眾神會為他印證」. Two roles, two men — the classic distinction, and the roster has it right.

teacher.quote: 磁州如禪師嗣荷澤，益州惟忠和尚嗣磁州如
teacher.note: Independent lamp confirmation of the same chain.

teacher.quote: 釋南印，姓張氏。明寤之性，受益無厭，得曹溪深旨，無以為證。見淨眾寺會師
teacher.note: THE EARLIEST BIOGRAPHY GIVES A DIFFERENT TEACHER. 淨眾寺會師 = Shenhui of Jingzhong monastery in Chengdu — a Sichuan Jingzhong-school figure, NOT Heze Shenhui and NOT Cizhou Zhiru.

teacher.quote: 師從淨眾寺神會。貞元初年，自江陵入蜀……裴休《華嚴原人論序》中作「荊州張」，稱南印為圭峯師祖
teacher.note: DILA follows the Song Gaoseng Zhuan (師從淨眾寺神會) while filing him under 荷澤宗 — it carries the conflict unresolved.
'Cizhou Zhiru' (磁州智如) comes from the Zongmi/Pei Xiu lineage chart 荷澤神會→磁州智如→益州南印→遂州道圓→圭峰宗密. I COULD NOT SOURCE IT in the corpus or DILA. It is a lineage-chart claim, not a biographical one.

school.note: implies Jingzhong affiliation

notes: Third generation Heze lineage. Transmitted to Suizhou Daoyuan.

bio: Of the Liu clan of Yichun, a dharma heir of Mazu Daoyi. He had double pupils and treated them with a medicine that he rubbed in, until the corners of his eyes turned permanently red — hence 'red-eyed Guizong'. In the Yuanhe period (806-820) he lived at Guizong monastery on Mount Lu and was good at discoursing on the essentials of Chan; Bai Juyi and Li Bo, prefect of Jiangzhou, both put questions to him. Posthumously titled Zhizhen. His heirs included Dayu, Lingxun and Gaomao.

teacher.quote: 釋智常者，挺拔出倫，操履清約，遍參知識，影附南泉，同遊大寂之門，乃見江西之道。元和中，駐錫廬山歸宗淨院。
teacher.note: 同遊大寂之門 — 大寂 is Mazu Daoyi's posthumous title. He 'entered Mazu's gate together with Nanquan.' This is the transmission.

teacher.quote: （第十五卷）…歸宗和尚…已上馬大師法嗣。
teacher.note: 祖堂集 lists him among 馬大師 (Mazu) heirs.

teacher.quote: 宜春劉氏，馬祖道一禪師（709-788）法嗣

dates.note: DILA gives NO birth or death for him. The roster's 770-840 could not be sourced — treat as conventional, not attested.

notes: Resided at Guizong monastery on Mount Lu. Known for dramatic teaching methods.

bio: Of Jinhua in Wuzhou. The Zutangji records him as living in a hermitage and as heir to Tianlong, who was in turn heir to Damei Fachang. He is remembered for answering every question by holding up a single finger.

teacher.quote: 俱胝和尚嗣天龍，在敬安州。未睹行錄，不決始終。
teacher.note: 嗣天龍 — transmission verb, in the EARLIEST lamp. Lineage table at lb 0302a02: 「天龍下出俱胝和尚」. Also 景德傳燈錄 T51n2076 lb 0288a22 「天龍和尚法嗣　婺州金華山俱胝和尚」.

teacher.quote: 天龍嗣，龍大梅常嗣。婺州金華山俱胝和尚初住庵。（祖堂集：368）
teacher.note: Confirms Tianlong, and places Tianlong under Damei Fachang — so the grandfather is Damei, not Mazu directly.

dates.note: DILA gives no dates. The roster's 800-860 is UNSOURCED.

notes: Famous for answering every question by raising one finger.

bio: A Silla monk of the Kim clan, described in the Zutangji as of an eminent eastern-sea family. He went to Tang China and received transmission from Huaihui of Zhangjing monastery in the capital. His line became the Bongnimsan school, one of the Nine Mountain schools of Korean Seon.

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 (952 CE — the OLDEST surviving Chan lamp, compiled 83 years after his death and preserved in Korea) — quoting HIS OWN DYING WORDS
teacher.quote: 九年秋解夏之始，忽告門人曰：「我今歲內法緣當盡，你等宜設無遮大會，以報百巖傳授之恩，終吾志也。」
teacher.note: HIS DEATHBED CHARGE, AND IT IS THE 酬…恩 FORMULA. He tells his disciples to hold an unrestricted assembly 『以報百巖傳授之恩』 — TO REPAY THE DEBT OF 百巖'S TRANSMISSION — and calls this 終吾志, the completion of his life's intent. This is the dharma-milk stick in its Tang form: first-person, naming the transmitter, at the last possible moment. He died 11/15 of that year, aged 82, 僧臘 60.

teacher.kind: 白居易, 〈西京興善寺傳法堂碑〉 (c. 818) — INDEPENDENT 9th-century confirmation that 百巖暉 = 懷暉, a 馬祖 heir
teacher.quote: 即師與西堂藏、甘泉賢、勒潭海、百巖暉，俱父事大寂，若兄弟然
teacher.note: CROSS-CHECK, and it fell out of another master in this same batch. Bai Juyi — writing within a year or two of 懷暉's death, and a man who knew that generation personally — lists 百巖暉 alongside 西堂智藏 and 百丈懷海 as those who 『父事大寂』 (served 馬祖道一 as a father). So 百巖 = 懷暉 = 章敬懷暉, and 玄昱's dying 百巖 is unambiguous. 祖堂集's own heading says 嗣章敬, and it files 玄昱 in the 章敬 section, immediately before 公畿和尚嗣章敬 (lb 0616b14).

teacher.kind: authority record citing 祖堂集 p.318
teacher.quote: 京兆章敬寺懷惲禪師法嗣。俗姓金氏，東溟冠族。（祖堂集：318）
teacher.note: The Zutangji (952 CE) is an early and Korea-linked source, which makes this stronger than a Qing lamp.

dates.note: DILA carries NO dates. 787-869 is UNSOURCED here. His stele (高達寺 / 鳳林寺) was not located in the corpus.

notes: Silla monk who received transmission from Zhangjing Huaihui in Tang China. Founded the Bongnimsan school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools of Korean Seon. His lineage traces through the Mazu Daoyi tradition.

bio: A Silla monk of the Kim clan of Gyeongju; his grandfather Sul-won was governor of Myeongju. He entered Tang in the Taihe period and received transmission from Yanguan Qi'an, a disciple of Mazu. Returning to Silla he founded the Sagulsan school, one of the Nine Mountain schools of Seon. Posthumously titled Great Master Tonghyo.

steles.title: 溟州崛山寺 通曉大師 塔碑 (豐碑)
steles.author: unnamed in the corpus witness
steles.quote: 弟子開清。朗圓之名修寶塔。立豐碑焉。
steles.note: His disciples 開清 and 朗圓 raised a stupa and erected a great stele for him. The stele's existence is attested by 朝鮮佛教通史; the full text is not in the corpus. (The neighbouring text at 0558b03 is the stele of his OWN disciple 朗圓大師 — read carefully, that one is 朗圓's, not 梵日's.)

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 (952) — the earliest source, a stele-derived biography
teacher.quote: 溟州𡼿山故通曉大師嗣鹽官，法諱梵日，鳩林冠族金氏。祖諱述元，官至溟州都督…爰以元和五年庚寅正月十辰，在胎十三月而誕生。
teacher.note: 嗣鹽官 = inherited 鹽官齊安. The 祖堂集 entry reads as a condensed 行狀/碑 (故通曉大師…祖諱…母…), i.e. it derives from his memorial inscription. Near-first-person for a Silla master.

teacher.kind: 朝鮮佛教通史 quoting 三國遺事
teacher.quote: 梵日國師。鹽官安尉三國遺事云。崛山祖師梵曰。大和年中入唐。遍遊叢席。得法於鹽官。鹽官名齊安馬祖弟子也。以會昌七年丁
teacher.note: 得法於鹽官 — 鹽官齊安, a disciple of Mazu. Independent witness (三國遺事).

teacher.kind: authority record citing 景德傳燈錄
teacher.quote: REL teacher 齊安 — 鹽官齊安禪師法嗣（T51n2076_p0273b13）
teacher.note: 鹽官齊安 confirmed by 景德傳燈錄 too.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 祖堂集 p.319
teacher.quote: 嗣鹽官，鳩林冠族，金氏。（祖堂集：319）
溟州𡼿山故通曉大師嗣鹽官，法諱梵日，鳩林冠族金氏。祖諱述元，官至溟州都督
teacher.note: The 故通曉大師 phrasing ('the late Great Master Tonghyo') and the grandfather's office are stele-style detail carried into the Zutangji.

dates.quote: 生於：唐, 憲宗, 元和, 五年, 正月
dates.note: Yuanhe 5 = 810. Death 889 is given in the DILA extensive note; I did not find an independent corpus witness.

school.quote: 後有崛山祖師梵日。太和年中入唐。到明州開國寺

notes: Founder of the Sagulsan (Mount Sagul) school, one of the Nine Mountains Seon lineages of Korea. He traveled to Tang China and trained under Yanguan Qi'an, a direct disciple of Mazu Daoyi, practicing for six years before receiving dharma transmission. Returning to Silla, he established Gulsan Monastery as his base and built one of the most active Seon communities of ninth-century Korea. His lineage maintained strong ties with the Mazu school's emphasis on everyday-mind-is-the-Way. He received lavish royal patronage, and his stele inscription is an important source for early Korean Seon. Attested in Zutangji (952): records his awakening under Yanguan Qi'an after six years of practice.

bio: Of the Wang clan of Yutian. He took full ordination at Yanshou monastery in Fanyang and studied the Hinayana vinaya, then studied under Wuxue at Cuiwei monastery on Zhongnan. He went on to Dongshan Liangjie and became his heir. He lived first on Mount Sanfeng, then at Mount Yunju where he founded Zhenru monastery and taught for thirty years, greatly extending the Caodong style. Posthumously titled Chan Master Hongjue; his stupa was named Yuanji.

teacher.quote: 玉田王氏，洞山良价（807-869）禪師法嗣

teacher.source: T/T51/T51n2076.xml 景德傳燈錄 卷20
teacher.quote: 洪州雲居山道膺禪師法嗣
teacher.note: Heading — he is a teacher of record in the lamp.

dates.note: DILA gives NO dates for him. 835-902 is UNSOURCED.

notes: Principal dharma heir of Dongshan. Major monastery on Mount Yunju.

school: 石頭宗 (Qingyuan line; father of Fayan)
bio: Of the Li clan of Changshan; a monk of Luohan cloister in Zhangzhou. He was tonsured and ordained under the Great Master Wuxiang at Wansui monastery. He first called on Xuefeng Yicun, then went to Xuansha Shibei, under whose single word all his doubts fell away. His disciples included Fayan Wenyi, founder of the Fayan school.

teacher.source: DILA A010683 (from 宋高僧傳/佛光)
teacher.quote: 依萬歲寺無相大師剃髮受戒。初謁雪峰義存，至福州玄沙師備座下，得一言啟發，廓爾脫落眾惑。
teacher.note: 雪峰 = 謁 (visit); 玄沙師備 = the dharma-father (得一言啟發). 無相 = tonsure.

teacher.quote: 初謁雪峰義存，至福州玄沙師備座下，得一言啟發，廓爾脫落眾惑
teacher.note: Note the shape of it: he FIRST went to Xuefeng, THEN got it from Xuansha. This is exactly the pattern the audit says the old roster kept getting backwards — here the roster has it right.

dates.quote: 卒於：後唐, 明宗, 天成, 三年，62歲
dates.note: Tiancheng 3 = 928, aged 62 → birth 867. Matches the roster.

notes: Direct ancestor of the Fayan school. 'What is this?' about a rock triggered Fayan's awakening.

bio: The third generation of the Yunmen house, active in Zhenzong's reign. A man of Zhejiang, he went into Shu and studied under Xianglin Chengyuan, receiving the mind-seal. He was abbot first at Shuangquan in Suizhou, then moved to Zhimen, then to Chongsheng. His heirs included Xuedou Chongxian, who compiled his discourse record.

teacher.kind: 五燈嚴統 biography, under the heading 香林〔澄〕遠禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 〔香林遠禪師法嗣〕隨州智門光祚禪師，先住北塔。僧問：如何是佛？師曰：踏破草鞋赤脚走。曰：如何是佛向上事？師曰：拄杖頭上挑日月。
teacher.note: Filed directly under 香林澄遠 (益州青城香林院澄遠禪師, Yunmen's heir). Same placement in 五燈會元續略 X80n1564 lb0944b09.

teacher.kind: 續傳燈錄 — the heir's biography naming the seat
teacher.quote: 智門祚禪師法嗣：明州雪竇重顯禪師…貪指南遊，首造智門…門以拂子驀口打，師擬開口，門又打，師豁然開悟。
teacher.note: The transmission FROM Guangzuo TO Xuedou, which anchors his generation (大鑑下第十世).

teacher.quote: 雲門第三世，真宗時人。浙江人，入蜀參香林澄遠，受心印

teacher.source: X/X78 續傳燈錄目錄 卷1
teacher.quote: 隨州智門光祚禪師法嗣

dates.note: DILA carries NO dates — only 真宗時人 (Zhenzong's reign, 997-1022). The roster's 900-960 is UNSOURCED and probably too early: a man who taught Xuedou (980-1052) and was active under Zhenzong cannot have died in 960.

notes: Heir of Xianglin Chengyuan, both from Sichuan. Teacher of Xuedou Chongxian, whom he awakened with two blows of a fly whisk. Xuedou stayed five years and later compiled Zhimen's discourse record. Key link transmitting the Yunmen school to its greatest poet.
date_note: roster death 960 is impossible: he taught 雪竇重顯 (d.1052)

bio: Of the Yu clan of Taiyuan. Orphaned at fourteen, he was tonsured and ordained and took to the road, calling on seventy-one old masters before coming at last to Shoushan Xingnian, under whom he had a great awakening. After Shoushan died in 993 more than a thousand clergy and laity of Xihe begged him to take Taizi cloister at Taiping monastery in Fenzhou, where he sat on one seat and did not cross the threshold for thirty years. He pioneered verse commentary on old cases. He died in 1023 aged 78. His heirs included Ciming Chuyuan.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (開堂 at 崇勝院)
teacher.quote: 師在崇勝院開堂日…遂陞座，拈香云：此一炷香奉為今上皇帝，伏願龍圖永固，玉葉彌芳。又拈香云：此一炷香奉為知郡郎中及諸官僚，福星高照，聖澤長臨。又拈香云：此一炷香為我汾州太子禪院無德禪師，且問諸人：還識無德禪師麼？若也不識，爐煙起處一任觀看。
teacher.note: THREE sticks, correctly sorted: emperor / officials / 汾州太子禪院無德禪師. 無德 is 汾陽善昭's title and 太子禪院 in Fenzhou is his seat — Chuyuan names the SEAT and the TITLE, not just a name, which forecloses any name-collision. The 「我」 in 為我汾州…無德禪師 ('for MY teacher') is the possessive of discipleship. First-person, at his own enthronement.

teacher.kind: byline of his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 住筠州黃檗山嗣法小師　慧南　重編
teacher.note: BONUS — this is not the editor trap, it is the exception the brief names: the record is re-edited by 慧南 explicitly styled 嗣法小師 (dharma-heir disciple). It independently corroborates the 楚圓 → 慧南 edge (master #1 in this batch) from the other end.

teacher.quote: 太原俞氏，首山省念禪師（926-993）法嗣……最後至首山省念，於是大悟言下
汾陽昭禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 卒於：北宋, 仁宗, 天聖, 元年，78歲
dates.note: DISAGREES WITH THE ROSTER BY ONE YEAR. 天聖元年 = 1023, not 1024. Aged 78 → birth 946/947. I take 1023 (the reign-year is explicit); the roster's 1024 has no source.

bio.source: T/T49/T49n2036.xml 佛祖歷代通載 卷18
X/X79 禪林僧寶傳 卷3

notes: Reviver of the Linji school. Pioneered verse commentary on old cases (songgu).

school: Linji, Huanglong branch 臨濟宗黃龍派
bio: Of the Xiong clan of Ganzhou. Sickly as a child, his parents vowed he would be a monk; he was tonsured at fifteen and fully ordained at sixteen. He was head monk at Daowu, then on Yungai Zhi's advice went to Zhenjing Kewen and took his teaching. He came out at Luyuan, and in 1087 took Doushuai at Long'an. He died on the third day of the eleventh month of 1091, aged 48. His lay heir was Zhang Shangying, who sent an emissary with offerings; he was posthumously titled Zhenji.

teacher.kind: the TEACHER's own 行狀, by 惠洪 (石門文字禪), dated 崇寧二年 (1103)
teacher.quote: 嗣法弟子自黃檗道全、兜率從悅而下十人餘，此其平生大概也 … 崇寧二年十月十五日，門人某謹狀
teacher.note: DECISIVE. This is 真淨克文's 行狀 — an A-class document — written by 惠洪 (覺範, 1071-1128), who was KEWEN'S OWN DISCIPLE and therefore CONGYUE'S DHARMA-BROTHER. It is dated 1103: one year after Kewen's death (1102), twelve after Congyue's (1091). It lists Kewen's 嗣法弟子 (dharma-heirs) and 兜率從悅 is named SECOND. The nearest possible witness, writing at the grave, naming his own brother. (Caveat stated: Huihong is a partisan of his own house — but a man listing his own dharma-brothers is precisely the person who would know, and he had nothing to gain by inventing Congyue, who was already dead and famous.)

teacher.kind: heading of his own recorded sayings (續古尊宿語要)
teacher.quote: 兜率悅禪師語，嗣真淨
teacher.note: The Song compilation that carries his 語 titles it 嗣真淨.

teacher.quote: 隆興府兜率從悅禪師，真淨文嗣
teacher.note: Corroborating index.

teacher.quote: 為寶峰克文禪師之法嗣……智指之見眞淨文禪師，深領奧旨
teacher.note: 寶峰克文 and 真淨克文 are the same man; the roster's 'Zhenjing Kewen' is correct.

dates.quote: 卒於：北宋, 哲宗, 元祐, 六年, 十一月, 初三日，48歲
dates.note: Yuanyou 6 = 1091, aged 48 → birth 1044. Matches the roster.

dates.quote: 六年冬十一月三日示寂，壽四十八，臘三十三

notes: Huanglong branch master. Teacher of lay student Zhang Shangying, the Song chancellor.

bio: A Northern Song chancellor and lay Chan patron of Xinjin. Jinshi of 1065; he rose through censor and secretariat posts to Right Vice-Director of the Department of State Affairs and chancellor. Initially hostile to Buddhism, he was won over by the Vimalakirti Sutra. He first called on Donglin Changzong, then on Doushuai Congyue, whose questioning left him sleepless; getting up at the fifth watch he knocked over the chamber pot and broke through. In autumn 1115 Dahui Zonggao walked to Jiangling to ask him for Zhantang Wenzhun's stupa inscription, and he wrote it. He died in 1122 and was posthumously titled Wenzhong. Author of the Hufa lun.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, his own entry (grouped under 兜率從悅)
teacher.quote: 丞相張商英居士，字天覺，號無盡。年十九應舉入京…因入僧寺，見藏經梵夾金字齊整，乃怫然曰：「吾孔聖之書，不如胡人之教人所仰重。」
teacher.note: 五燈會元 places him as 兜率從悅's lay heir; the chamber-pot awakening under 兜率 is the classic account. Upgrades the roster's DILA line to a primary lamp.

teacher.quote: 師趨謁無盡居士，求湛堂塔銘。無盡門庭高，少許可，與師一言相契。
teacher.note: Dahui seeks 湛堂's 塔銘 from 無盡居士 — corroborates his standing and identity, though not his own teacher.

teacher.quote: 兜率從悅（1044-1091）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十五世……後謁兜率悅公，與悅語至更深……公一夜睡不穩，至五更下牀，觸翻溺器，乃大徹
師趨謁無盡居士，求湛堂塔銘。無盡門庭高，少許可，與師一言相契
teacher.note: CAUTION: twenty-two of the corpus 'stele' hits for 張商英 are this scene — him being ASKED for Zhantang's 塔銘. He is the AUTHOR there, not the subject. None of them is his own stele.

dates.quote: 卒於：北宋, 徽宗, 宣和, 四年，79歲
dates.note: DISAGREES WITH THE ROSTER. 宣和四年 = 1122, not 1121. Aged 79 → birth 1043/44. I take 1122.

bio.note: Cited in DILA mentionedIn; not independently read.

notes: High-ranking Song official who became devoted Chan patron. Author of Hufa lun.

bio: A granddaughter of the chancellor Su Song, of the Ding clan of Dantu. Around thirty she began calling on the old masters, and at Jingshan under Dahui Zonggao she awakened on the case of Yaoshan's first meeting with Shitou and his later seeing Mazu. In 1163 the prefect Zhang Xiaoxiang invited her to open the dharma at Zishou monastery in Songjiang. She died in 1170 aged 76 — one of the very few women with an entry of her own in the lamps.

teacher.kind: 大慧普覺禪師語錄 — the TEACHER's own 普說, first person, naming her
teacher.quote: 老僧頃年初住此山，常州許宅有箇無著道人，法名妙總，三十歲便打硬，修行遍見諸方尊宿，皆蒙印可。然渠真實畏生死苦故，要真實理會本命元辰下落去處，特來山中度夏。時同夏者一千七百衲子…
teacher.note: Dahui, from the seat, telling seventeen hundred monks who she is: the Wuzhu daoren of the Xu household of Changzhou, dharma-name Miaozong, who came to spend the summer on his mountain. This is the master's own voice, in his own record.

teacher.kind: 大慧's own account of the 室中 (private-room) encounter — the transmission scene
teacher.quote: 又嘗到室中，老僧問他：「古人不出方丈，為甚麼却去莊上喫油糍？」無著云：「和尚放妙總過，妙總方敢通消息。」老僧向伊道：「我放爾過，爾試道看。」無著云：「妙總亦放和尚過。」老僧云：「爭奈油糍何？」無著喝一喝便出去。是時一眾皆聞渠如此祗對…及雖嘗被邪師印破面門，却能退步，知非決定，以悟為則。故纔見善知識提撕，便於言下千了百當。
teacher.note: She shouts and walks out of his room, and he tells the whole assembly she was right to. Then the crucial clause: 雖嘗被邪師印破面門，却能退步 — 'though she had been SEALED IN THE FACE BY FALSE MASTERS, she was able to step back.' Dahui is explicitly voiding the earlier 印可 she had collected from 諸方尊宿, and claiming her himself. If any competing teacher is ever proposed for Miaozong, this sentence pre-emptively rejects him.

teacher.kind: 大慧's personal dharma-instruction to her: 〈示妙總禪人〉
teacher.quote: 示妙總禪人。古聖云：「道不假修，但莫污染。」山僧道：說心說性是污染，說玄說妙是污染，坐禪習定是污染…畢竟如何是著實得力處？金剛寶劍當頭截，莫管人間是與非。總禪但恁麼參。
teacher.note: A 法語 addressed to her by name and signed off 「總禪但恁麼參」 — 'Zong Chan, just investigate like this.' Teacher to disciple, in the teacher's own collected record.

teacher.kind: 大慧's portrait-eulogy written at her request: 〈無著道人請讚〉
teacher.quote: 無著道人請讚：「汝求吾之讚，復讚吾之真。大海絕涓滴，須彌無一塵…」
teacher.note: She asked her master for an inscription on his portrait; he wrote one. The ordinary intimacy of the master-disciple relation, in his book.

teacher.quote: 大慧宗杲（1089-1163）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十七世……參大慧於徑山

dates.quote: 卒於：南宋, 孝宗, 乾道, 六年, 七月, 十四日，76歲
dates.note: Qiandao 6 = 1170, aged 76 → birth 1095. Matches the roster exactly.

bio.source: 徑山志‧卷3‧資壽尼無著妙總禪師
bio.note: Cited in DILA mentionedIn.

notes: One of the most prominent female Chan masters. Known for her sharp repartee.

bio: Of the Wang clan of Xinming in Guang'an, Shu. He was tonsured under Juan of Deshan in Lizhou, who saw he was a vessel for the dharma and sent him travelling. He called on Weishan Xing, Huqiu Xiatang Huiyuan and Jingci Yuetang Chang, then Shui'an Yiyi at Shuanglin; when Shui'an retired he went to Mi'an Xianjie at Wuju and broke through completely. He was abbot at Jianfu in Changzhou, Lingyan in Zhenzhou, Xiufeng and Qionglong in Pingjiang, and Zifu at Fengshan. He died seated on the ninth day of the sixth month of 1211, aged 76. His heirs included Wuzhun Shifan and Shitian Faxun.

steles.title: 破菴祖先禪師語錄 卷1〈行狀〉
steles.author: unnamed disciple
steles.author_note: Appended to his own discourse record; a 跋 by his dharma-nephew 道巖 of Fuzhen follows.
steles.quote: 行狀附跋福臻法姪道巖
steles.note: The 行狀 exists in his own 語錄 (cited by DILA as 《破菴祖先禪師語錄》卷1〈行狀〉). The far stronger evidence is on the facing page — his own incense-offering, below.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 at his installation
teacher.quote: 奉為見住明州天童景德禪寺密菴大和尚，以醻法乳
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS, at the moment of taking the abbot's seat, naming the man he repays for the 'milk of the dharma'. This is the transmission itself. Mi'an Xianjie, confirmed at the highest rung — the roster is RIGHT, and the roster's own note (which muddled Songyuan Chongyue in) can be discarded.

teacher.quote: 密菴傑（1118-1186）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十九世……遂往見密菴於烏巨，豁然大悟

dates.quote: 卒於：南宋, 寧宗, 嘉定, 四年, 六月, 初九日，76歲
dates.note: Jiading 4 = 1211, aged 76 → birth 1136. Matches the roster.

notes: Dharma heir of Songyuan Chongyue. Teacher of Wuzhun Shifan, through whom his lineage produced Xueyan Zuqin and Gaofeng Yuanmiao. Teacher corrected: the roster had Songyuan Chongyue, who was his dharma-brother, not his master. Both were heirs of Mi'an Xianjie -- attested by two independent lamp records, which place him under a Mi'an Xianjie succession heading.

bio: Of the Zhang clan of Wenshui; the reviving patriarch of Shaolin. A prodigy who could learn a thousand characters a day and was called 'the sage child' in his village. He was tonsured and ordained in 1223, then went to Yanjing to study Chan under Wansong Xingxiu. In 1249 Wansong entrusted him with Shaolin, which he restored over some six years to its Jin-dynasty extent. He died in 1275 aged 73. The Shaolin Caodong transmission descends from him to this day.

teacher.quote: 後赴燕京，投萬松學禪法。1249年，受萬松之託，住持少林寺

teacher.kind: lineage list copied off temple steles
teacher.quote: 青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕．靈隱泰．寶應遇．淳拙才．松庭嚴．凝然改．俱空斌
teacher.note: This chain is transcribed from the 佛祖傳法偈碑 and other steles standing at 勝果寺/萬壽寺 — carved stone, not a lamp compilation. It puts 萬松秀 immediately above 雪庭裕. Independent of DILA.

dates.quote: 卒於：元, 世祖, 至元, 十二年, 七月, 二十日，73歲
dates.note: Zhiyuan 12 = 1275, aged 73 → birth 1203. Matches the roster.

notes: Most historically consequential heir of Wansong. Appointed by Kublai Khan to restore Shaolin Monastery, where he installed the Caodong lineage as the dominant transmission. Composed the 70-character generation poem still used to name Shaolin monks today, institutionalizing the lineage. Through him, Wansong's line became the 'unbroken' Shaolin Caodong transmission continuing through the centuries.

bio: Of the Dong clan of Xiaoshan. Tonsured and ordained at nineteen, he studied vinaya at Lingzhi monastery in Wulin, then took up the 'wu' case under Zhongfeng Mingben, who tested and sealed him and told him to guard it well. He hid in the eastern hermitage at Tianlong, then went to Fulong mountain in Wushang and restored Shengshou Chan monastery. The court heard of him and granted him incense, a robe and the title Puying Miaozhi Hongbian. He died on the fourteenth day of the sixth month of 1357, aged 74. His heirs included Wanfeng Shiwei.

steles.title: 佛慧圓明廣照無邊普利大禪師塔銘
steles.author: 宋濂
steles.author_note: Song Lian, the great early-Ming literatus and Hanlin academician. Preserved both in his own collected works (護法錄) and appended to Qianyan's discourse record.
steles.quote: 佛慧圓明廣照無邊普利大禪師塔銘 至正十七年化。少林氏之道七傳至慧照大師而別為一宗，設三玄門，演暢宗乘，權實兼行，照用雙至。
steles.note: Also at J/J32/J32nB273.xml lb 0233a02 (appended to 千巖和尚語錄, where the opening reads 十一傳 rather than 七傳 — the two witnesses disagree on the generation count). A Ming-era Chan writer notes the commission sourly: 「厥後宋濂為千巖作塔銘」(X65n1281 lb 0457a17).

teacher.quote: 中峰明本禪師（1263-1323）法嗣……後參狗子無佛性話，中峯為之決擇印正，囑師善自護持

teacher.kind: 塔銘 appended to his own 語錄

dates.quote: 卒於：元, 順帝, 至正, 十七年, 六月, 十四日，74歲
dates.note: Zhizheng 17 = 1357, aged 74 → birth 1284. Matches the roster. The 塔銘 itself is headed 至正十七年化.

links.label: DILA Authority A004551
links.confirms: dates, teacher, school, the 塔銘

notes: Yuan dynasty Linji master. Dharma heir of Zhongfeng Mingben. His line continued through Wanfeng Shiwei to the Ming revival.

bio: Of the Fan clan of Wujiang. Before ordination he was a carpenter. While building a stupa-cloister for Haizhou Puci he cut his foot with an axe and demanded wine; Puci came to see him and asked whether, if his head were cut off, a thousand piculs of wine would help him drink. He was struck by this and asked to be made a monk. Serving as fire-keeper, he had his eyebrows singed off one day and, seeing his face in a mirror, awakened. He was abbot at Gaofeng monastery in Jinling. His heir was Tianqi Benrui.

teacher.quote: 舟曰．即此偈語．可紹吾宗。乃付以偈曰．臨濟兒孫是獅子。一吼千山百獸死。今朝汝具爪牙威．也須萬壑深山止
teacher.note: 付以偈 = transmission. This verse is one of the 13 discriminating points: Mingxuan's verse (from Puci) is 「臨濟兒孫是獅子」; Zhixuan's verse (from Yongci) is 「迷悟猶如空裏雲」.

teacher.kind: 無聞明聰 客牕夜話
teacher.quote: 蔚出海舟慈．慈出寶峯瑄．瑄出天奇瑞
teacher.note: 慈 -> 瑄 -> 瑞

teacher.kind: 正名錄 forensic table (瑄 pair)
teacher.quote: 二人雖同號寶峯．其諱．有明瑄智瑄之別。得法．有明瑄受普慈付囑在正統間．智瑄受普慈付囑在景泰五年之別。法偈．有臨濟兒孫是獅子．迷悟猶如空裏雲．之別
teacher.note: NOTE: 智楷 writes 「智瑄受普慈付囑在景泰五年」 but the document he quotes at 0478b19 is signed by 永慈, not 普慈 — an apparent slip of his brush for 永慈. The three discriminating points (諱 / date / verse) stand regardless.

teacher.quote: 吳江范氏，海舟普慈禪師（1355-1450）法嗣……為海舟普慈建造塔院，因斧傷足
按闢妄救．續略．纘續．諸書。所紀．海舟普慈法嗣曰．南京寶峰明瑄。紀明瑄法嗣曰．天奇本瑞。則天奇嗣明瑄明矣。
teacher.note: The 正名錄 is a Ming forensic tract that goes to the actual stupas: 「東明寺左有塔院一所……左第一為寶峯明瑄塔」. It exists precisely to unpick the confusion of two men both styled 海舟 (普慈 vs 永慈) and two 寶峯 (明瑄 vs 智瑄). Its verdict: Mingxuan is Puci's heir.

notes: Early Ming Linji master in the Zhongfeng Mingben line, heir of Wanfeng Shiwei. Active at Baofeng monastery; his transmission continued through Tianqi Benrui and eventually reached Yunqi Zhuhong, the eighth Pure Land patriarch.

bio: Of the Shen clan of Jiangsu (Wujiang/Jurong). Tonsured at seventeen under Mingjue at Huqiu, fully ordained at twenty, he then sealed himself in a three-year retreat at Jingde monastery in Wutang. He broke through on the line 'to cut off deluded thought only adds to the sickness; to head for suchness is likewise wrong.' One of the four great monks of the late Ming. In 1589 he launched the Jiaxing canon, recutting the Southern canon against the Northern in movable-type booklet form. Implicated by enemies in a court case, he entered prison in the twelfth month of 1603 and died there on the seventeenth, aged 61. His whole body was entombed at Wenshu Terrace on Mount Jing.

steles.title: 紫栢大師塔銘
steles.author: 釋德清
steles.author_note: Hanshan Deqing — his closest friend and fellow 'great monk' of the late Ming. A stupa inscription by the one man best placed to write it.
steles.quote: 紫栢大師塔銘 釋德清。夫大地死生，顛瞑長夜，以情關固閉，識鎻難開。有能一擊而碎之，掉臂而獨往者，自非雄猛丈夫，具超世之量者
steles.note: Also indexed as 《徑山志》卷6〈紫栢大師塔銘〉 in DILA. A separate corpus witness (GA031n0032 lb 0337a09) notes simply: 「達觀真可禪師吳江人，塔于文殊臺。詳塔銘。」

steles.title: 達觀大師塔銘
steles.author: 釋德清 (憨山德清)
steles.quote: 師諱真可，字達觀，晚號紫栢…其先句曲人，父沈連季子，世居吳江太湖之攤缺。
steles.note: Catalogued independently at GA/GA032/GA032n0032.xml lb 0526a04 as 「紫柏大師塔銘　釋德清」, and B14n0085 lb 0565a11 pairs 雲棲 and 紫柏's two 塔銘 as the great memorials of the age. The stone is real and its author is named.

teacher.kind: his own 塔銘 — 達觀大師塔銘, by 憨山德清 (Hanshan Deqing), his closest friend and contemporary
teacher.quote: 偶值虎丘僧明覺相顧盻…即解腰纏十餘金授覺，令設齋請薙髮，遂禮覺為師。…年二十，從講師受具戒。
teacher.note: TONSURE, not transmission. Zhenke handed Mingjue his own money to fund the shaving-feast and 'took Jue as his master' — 禮…為師 in the tonsure sense. He was then ordained at 20 by an unnamed 講師 (a lecturer), not by Mingjue.

teacher.quote: 師至京師，參徧融大老。融問：從何來？曰：江南來…融命褫師直裰施傍僧，顧謂師曰：脫了一層還一層。師笑頷之，遂留挂搭。…九年，復歸虎丘省覺。
teacher.note: ⚠ ASSOCIATION IS NOT TRANSMISSION, and here the stele proves it. The verb is 參 — he CALLED ON Bianrong. He hung his bag there and stayed; nine years later he went back to Huqiu to look in on Mingjue. There is no 嗣法, no 得法, no 印可, no 付囑 — I read the entire stele checking for every one of those verbs. Bianrong is a teacher he sat with, not his dharma-father.

teacher.quote: 少從明覺和尚出家，後依徧融九載
teacher.note: TWO men, and the roster names only one. 明覺 tonsured him; 徧融 (Bianrong) he attended for nine years. Neither is described as a formal dharma-transmission — Zibo notoriously had no certified lineage, which is why the Qing lamps struggle to place him.

dates.quote: 生於：明, 世宗, 嘉靖, 二十二年, 六月, 十二日
dates.note: Jiajing 22 = 1543. Death: 萬曆癸卯……臘月五日入獄，十七日索浴，說偈而逝。世壽六十一 — Wanli guimao = 1603, aged 61. Matches the roster.

school.note: The lamps file him, but his transmission is not clean.

bio.kind: 塔銘 by 憨山德清

notes: One of the 'four great monks' of late Ming. Spearheaded the Jiaxing canon printing project. Died in prison.

bio: Of the Zhu clan of Jinhua; a monk of Jinsu monastery in Jiaxing — Miyun Yuanwu's seat. He died on the twelfth day of the second month of 1638, aged 46. He was the teacher of the eminent nun Qiyuan Xinggang.

teacher.kind: his own signed byline in his master's 語錄
teacher.quote: 密雲禪師語錄卷第五 ／ 嗣法門人通乘編
teacher.note: He signs himself 嗣法門人 — DHARMA-HEIR — of 密雲圓悟, and on that basis edits juan 5 of the master's record. This is the phrase the brief tells us to read carefully: not 門人…編 (the editor trap) but 嗣法門人…編 — the heir who edited. His own hand, his own claim.

teacher.kind: 密雲圓悟's 年譜 (chronological biography), appended to his own record, compiled by his heirs
teacher.quote: 剃度弟子自通壽……等凡三百餘人，嗣法自大溈如學、萬峰法藏、東塔海明、天童通容、金粟通乘、寶華通忍、禹門通微、廣潤道忞、雪竇通雲、古南通門、報恩通賢、通玄通奇一十二人，各各入廛，垂手分化一方。
teacher.note: THE CLOSED LIST. 密雲's 年譜 names his dharma-heirs — exactly twelve — and keeps them strictly separate from the 三百餘人 he merely TONSURED (剃度弟子). 金粟通乘 is on the heir list. The seat matches DILA's 「嘉興金粟僧人」 exactly. A 年譜 is stele-class evidence and this one draws the association/transmission line for us.

teacher.kind: 伏獅義公禪師語錄 — his own heir's record
teacher.quote: 第三十五世石車通乘禪師
teacher.note: Generation 35 in the Linji reckoning — consistent with 密雲 at 34.

teacher.quote: 金華人，姓朱，嘉興金粟僧人
teacher.note: DILA DOES NOT STATE HIS TEACHER. All it gives is that he was a monk of Jinsu — which was Miyun Yuanwu's seat. That is circumstantial, not a transmission claim. I could not find a 法嗣 statement for him in the corpus.

dates.quote: 卒於：明, 思宗, 崇禎, 十一年, 二月, 十二日，46歲
dates.note: Chongzhen 11 = 1638, aged 46 -> birth 1593. The roster's floruit 1598 is therefore not his birth; birth is 1593.

notes: Dharma heir of Miyun Yuanwu. Teacher of the eminent nun Qiyuan Xinggang. Used huatou (critical phrase) practice.

school: Linji, Yangqi branch (founder of Japanese Obaku)
bio: Of the Lin clan of Fuqing. As a boy he lay under the pines on quiet nights watching the river of stars turn, and wanting to understand what held it, conceived the wish for the buddha-way. He was tonsured under Jianyuan, went to Jinsu to see Miyun Yuanwu, then to Feiyin Tongrong at Huangbo, who tested him and handed over the transmission face to face. He came out at Huangbo in the winter of 1637, then held Fuyan at Chongde and Longquan at Changle. In autumn 1654 he accepted an invitation and sailed for Nagasaki; the Japanese court granted him land for a new Manpuku-ji at Uji, and he became the founder of the Obaku school in Japan.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 — the dharma-milk incense, at his enthronement (隱元禪師語錄, 清 隆琦說　海寧等編)
teacher.quote: 眾會麼？昔年在這裏落節，今日向這裏拔本，爇向爐中，專為現住浙江溫州府永嘉縣法通禪寺，傳曹溪正脈三十五世費隱容和尚，用酬法乳之恩。」遂斂衣就座。
teacher.note: This is THE stick — 用酬法乳之恩, to repay the debt of the dharma-milk — and it names 費隱容 (通容) and no one else. First-person, at the transmission. The other sticks in the same 上堂 go elsewhere; this is the one that counts.

teacher.quote: 費隱通容禪師（1593-1661）法嗣……次謁費師翁于黃檗，翁勘驗入室機緣，覿面分付
teacher.note: 覿面分付 — 'handed over face to face'. Note he ALSO saw Miyun Yuanwu (機扣有省) — that is the association that could tempt a roster-builder into naming Miyun. The roster gets it right.

dates.quote: 生於：明, 神宗, 萬曆, 二十年, 十一月, 初四日
dates.note: Wanli 20 = 1592. Matches the roster.

bio.note: Named in DILA mentionedIn; in 《中華佛教人物傳記文獻全書》冊52, not in the CBETA Zen corpus.

notes: Chinese Chan master who emigrated overseas in 1654. Entirely Chinese-trained; his departure was a loss for Chinese Chan. CBETA: J27nB193.

bio: Of the Ren clan of Songyang. At fourteen (1348) he was tonsured under the proctor Xun at Shaolin; ordained at twenty-one (1355). He studied under Songting Ziyan, then abbot of Shaolin, and became his heir. In 1387 he withdrew to the Second Patriarch's hermitage at Shaolin; in 1390 he became abbot of Shaolin, retiring in 1392, and took the abbacy again in 1411 at seventy-seven. He died in 1421 aged 87, carrying the Caodong transmission across the Yuan-Ming transition.

teacher.quote: 參嵩山少林寺住持松庭子嚴，嗣法

teacher.kind: lineage list transcribed from temple steles
teacher.quote: 雪庭裕．靈隱泰．寶應遇．淳拙才．松庭嚴．凝然改．俱空斌
teacher.note: Carved-stone lineage from the Shaolin/Wanshou steles, placing 松庭嚴 directly above 凝然改. Independent of DILA and of any lamp.

dates.quote: 卒於：明, 成祖, 永樂, 十九年，87歲
dates.note: Yongle 19 = 1421, aged 87 -> birth 1335. Confirms the roster's death year and supplies the missing birth.

notes: Sixth-generation Shaolin Caodong master, heir of Songting Ziyan. Served as abbot of Shaolin Monastery in the early Ming, maintaining the Caodong transmission through the Yuan-Ming dynastic transition.

bio: Of the Ding clan of Jian'an, Jianning. In his own words: his mother, childless at thirty, prayed to Guanyin and conceived; a monk passing the door told her the child was the Buddha's, not hers. He was born on the second day of the eleventh month of 1615. At fourteen he nearly died of illness and his mother vowed him to the sangha; he was sent to White Cloud monastery east of the prefecture and tonsured the next year. He studied under Yongjue Yuanxian at Gushan, served as proctor, and after a scolding sat sleepless till the fourth watch, rolled up the blind, stepped out, and broke through completely. Yuanxian at eighty entrusted him with the dharma, and he succeeded to the seat, holding Gushan for over twenty years. Author of the Huayan jing shulun zuanyao.

steles.title: 旅泊幻蹟
steles.author: 為霖道霈 himself
steles.author_note: His own account of his life, written under pressure from his students after thirty years of refusing. Appended to the 還山錄.
steles.quote: 余名道霈，乃先師所命，字為霖，則聞谷老人所賜也，目號旅泊，亦云非家叟。本貫建寧建安丁氏……時萬曆乙卯歲十一月二日卯時也。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. He names himself, gives his clan and birthplace, and dates his own birth to Wanli yimao (1615) — and says the name 道霈 was given him by his late master. Better than any stele.

teacher.quote: 余名道霈，乃先師所命
teacher.note: 'My name Daopei was conferred by my late master' — the master being Yongjue Yuanxian, whom the same text goes on to describe.

teacher.quote: 建安丁氏，鼓山元賢禪師（1578-1657）法嗣……賢年八十，付屬大法，寂後遂繼其席
teacher.note: Note he ALSO went to Miyun Yuanwu at Tiantong — again the association that could mislead. The transmission is Yuanxian's.

dates.quote: 時萬曆乙卯歲十一月二日卯時也
dates.note: Wanli yimao = 1615. His own word.

dates.quote: 生於：明, 神宗, 萬曆, 四十三年, 十一月, 初二日
dates.note: Independently agrees: Wanli 43 = 1615.

notes: Only dharma heir of Yongjue Yuanxian. Established Gushan Yongquan Monastery as a hereditary Caodong dharma-transmission seat. The Gushan Caodong line continued through his successors for 250 years, eventually producing Xuyun.

bio: Of the Hua clan of Qua in Jiangsu. During the Daye years of the Sui he was a general officer and won repeated distinctions in the field. At forty he entered Mount Wangong in Shuzhou and took orders under the Chan master Baoyue. In 643 he entered Mount Niutou, met Farong, awakened, and succeeded to his teaching — the second patriarch of the Oxhead school. He died on the tenth day of the first month of 677, aged 78.

teacher.source: T/T50/T50n2060.xml (續高僧傳, 道宣, d. 667 — CONTEMPORARY)
teacher.quote: 武德四年。從鎮州南定淮海。時年四十。審榮官之若雲。遂棄入舒州𡷗公山。從寶月禪師披緇入道。 … 貞觀十七年。還歸建業依山結草…
teacher.note: ⚠⚠ MAJOR NEGATIVE FINDING. I read the ENTIRE Xu gaoseng zhuan biography (1,280 characters, from 「釋智巖。丹陽曲阿人」 to the start of the next life) and checked mechanically: the string 法融 does NOT occur in it, and the character 融 does not occur in it AT ALL. Daoxuan — writing within roughly a decade of Zhiyan's death, and the single most authoritative contemporary source — knows nothing of any connection between Zhiyan and Farong. The master he names is 寶月禪師, and the verb is 披緇入道 (taking the robe) — a TONSURE relation, not a transmission. The Oxhead patriarchate (法融→智巖→慧方→法持→智威→慧忠) is therefore not attested by the contemporary record; it appears only in the later lamps. Per the rules I do NOT cut the edge — I cannot name an attested dharma-father to replace it, and 寶月 is only his tonsure master — so I mark it `disputed` and say so loudly.

teacher.source: B/B29/B29n0160.xml (牛頭山志, a Niutou-shan gazetteer, reproducing 景德傳燈錄's 智巖禪師傳略)
teacher.quote: 師貞觀十七年歸建業入牛頭山謁融禪師發明大事。禪師謂師曰。吾受信大師真訣。所得都亡。設有一法勝過湼槃。吾說亦如夢幻。…汝今已過此見。吾復何云。山門化導。當付之於汝。師稟命為第二世。以後正法付方禪師。
teacher.note: The OTHER side, recorded as required. This is the lamp's account: in the SAME year (643) that Daoxuan says he simply 'returned to Jianye and built a grass hut', the lamp has him enter Mt. Niutou, meet Farong, and receive the succession with the verb 付 (當付之於汝). The two accounts describe the same year and are irreconcilable. The gazetteer is honest about its source — it labels the piece 「傳燈錄」.

teacher.quote: 貞觀十七年（643），入牛頭山，謁法融禪師而開悟，承嗣正法
法嗣弟子有道綦、道憑與智巖等
teacher.note: The teacher's record names him as heir — the edge is confirmed from BOTH ends.

teacher.quote: 法融一祖有記傳．智巖二祖有傳略．慧方三祖有傳．法持四祖有傳

dates.quote: 卒於：唐, 高宗, 儀鳳, 二年, 正月, 初十日，78歲
dates.note: Yifeng 2 = 677, aged 78 -> birth 600. Matches the roster.

bio.source: 金陵梵剎志‧卷33‧智巖禪師傳略
bio.note: Cited in DILA mentionedIn; not independently read.

notes: Second patriarch of the Niutou (Oxhead) school. He trained under Farong at Mount Niutou and formalized the contemplative practices Farong had developed, emphasizing the teaching that all dharmas are empty and that the mind-ground is originally pure. He appears in the Jingde Chuandeng Lu (juan 4).

bio: Of the Chen clan of Ziyang, Chengdu, born on the twenty-fourth day of the first month of 1613. In his own account, a corpse in a stream being eaten by fish turned his mind to impermanence; asked his tutor over the Analects line 'hearing the Way in the morning, one may die at evening' where the Way is when the breath does not return, and got no answer, he shut the book and resolved to leave home, starving himself for days until his parents relented. He was tonsured at Baofeng monastery on Jingju mountain. He called on Xinxuan, Yinxin, Miyun Yuanwu and Wanfeng, then late in life entered Tiantai and attended Linye Tongqi for seven years, receiving the seal. He held ten seats over his life, the longest being the ancient Fengxue monastery in Ruzhou, which he restored. He died at Jinsu cloister in Xincai on the thirteenth day of the fourth month of 1676, aged 64.

steles.title: 風穴雲峨老和尚衣髮塔銘并序
steles.author: an heir of the Fengxue house (unnamed in the text; the record was compiled by 關中張恂 and 益州記室繼堯)
steles.author_note: A robe-and-hair stupa inscription — his body was entombed at Jinsu, his robe and hair at Xingshan. Appended not to his own 語錄 but to a NEIGHBOURING text (J37nB384), which is exactly the displacement the brief warns about.
steles.quote: 如吾先師喜老和尚者，蜀之資陽人也，族姓陳氏，系出隆昌……師諱行喜，號曰雲峨，天童密雲師祖之孫，通玄林野師翁之子，住河南汝州風穴白雲禪寺最久，閱世六十有四，僧臘四十有六，示寂於新蔡金粟禪林，康熙十五年丙辰四月十三日也。
steles.note: 'Grandson of Miyun of Tiantong, SON of Linye of Tongxuan' — the stele states the transmission in one line and distinguishes the grandfather from the father. Kangxi 15 = 1676, aged 64 -> birth 1613.

teacher.quote: 天童密雲師祖之孫，通玄林野師翁之子
teacher.note: Written at his grave. Names Linye Tongqi as the transmitting master and Miyun only as the grandfather — pre-empting the very error the audit found elsewhere.

teacher.quote: 林野通奇禪師（1596-1692）法嗣……晚入天臺，參林野奇和尚，親依七載，命充副寺，受記莂

dates.quote: 余乃成都之資陽人也，俗姓陳，母張氏，生於萬曆四十一年癸丑，正月二十四日子時
dates.note: HIS OWN WORDS, spoken to the assembly when they pressed him for his life story. Wanli 41 = 1613.

dates.quote: 閱世六十有四……康熙十五年丙辰四月十三日也
dates.note: Death 1676, aged 64.

links.label: DILA Authority A010007
links.confirms: birth, teacher, school, the 塔銘

bio: Of the Qian clan of Kuaiji, Shaoxing, descended from the royal house of Wu-Yue; born on the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of 1634. His father, childless at thirty-seven, prayed to Guanyin, and his mother dreamed a Tiantai monk entered the room. Born with his eyes sealed shut for forty days, he was opened (says his own account) after a wandering monk told his parents the child's pure eye simply would not yet look on filth. He was tonsured at twenty-two, ordained four months later, called on Yunyan of Liling and Erzhan of Shishuang, and awakened watching a waterfall fall from the sky on Mount Huangyan. He called on Yulin Tongxiu, Muyun, and Hongjue, and finally received the mind-seal from Yuan'an at Tiantong. He held Yuezhang Shousheng, Yonglong at Jingshan, Shending Zisheng, Ruiyan and Tiantong.

steles.title: 神鼎一揆禪師壽塔銘有序
steles.author: a retired official living at Jinling (names himself only as a former official, 'twenty-odd years lodging at Jinling')
steles.author_note: A LIVING stupa inscription — commissioned while he was still alive, which is why there is no death date in it.
steles.quote: 按禪師諱元揆，字一揆，號昂叟，體真於威音那畔，示蹟於會稽錢氏……露囊錐於太白，受心印於遠公，為平陽弘覺國師法孫。
steles.note: 'Received the mind-seal from Elder Yuan' and 'dharma-grandson of the National Preceptor Hongjue' — i.e. Muchen Daomin is the grandfather, Yuan'an the father. Exactly matches the roster's note.

teacher.quote: 受心印於遠公，為平陽弘覺國師法孫
字一揆，為遠庵本僼禪師（1622-1682）法嗣……後謁天童遠庵和尚，得付法

dates.quote: 山僧乃浙江紹興府會稽縣錢氏子……生於明季崇禎七年甲戌歲四月二十七申時也
dates.note: HIS OWN WORDS. Chongzhen 7 = 1634.

dates.quote: 卒年及世壽不詳，僅知康熙三十六年（1697）仍在世，時年六十四
dates.note: DEATH UNKNOWN. He was still alive in 1697. I leave death null rather than invent one.

bio: A dharma heir of Bie'an Xingtong. He took the seat at Jiedai monastery in Wenzhou on the fifth day of the fifth month of 1696, and also held Ciyun at Wuxi. His attendants Purun and Faquan recorded his discourse record in three fascicles; Yang Yongjian wrote the preface. Almost nothing else survives: his record is verse and dharma-talk, with no life attached.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at enthronement — 斗南暐禪師語錄
teacher.quote: 第二回拈出，爇向爐中，專申供養前領高峰、現住普陀、永壽、聖因、徑山及當山堂上六坐道場傳臨濟正宗第二十八世本師上別下庵統老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: 本師 ('my own master') + 用酬法乳之恩 — the dharma-milk stick, raised by 斗南暐 HIMSELF. The 上…下… honorific brackets the name 別庵統 = 別庵性統.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香, first enthronement (溫州接待禪寺)
teacher.quote: 今日信手拈來，爇向爐中，專伸供養現住普陀鎮海堂上傳臨濟正宗第二十八世上別下庵統老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: The FIRST raising, at 接待禪寺. Distinguish carefully: the stick immediately before this one is the 祝聖 stick for the emperor — this is the one that carries 用酬法乳之恩, and it is the only one that does.

teacher.kind: 普陀洛迦新志 — memorial notice of 別庵性統, listing his chief heirs
teacher.quote: 嗣法小師，燕京無際、信州玉峯、括蒼映文、東甌斗南，其最著者。
teacher.note: The teacher's own memorial names 東甌斗南 (Dounan of Wenzhou) among his four most eminent dharma-heirs — independent confirmation from the other end of the relation.

teacher.quote: 斗南暐禪師語錄二卷 清 暐說，普潤，法權等錄，楊雍建序。南嶽下第三十二世，嗣別庵統。
字斗南，為別庵性統禪師（1661-1717）法嗣。住溫州接待、無錫慈雲等禪寺。

dates.note: NO DATES ANYWHERE. Neither DILA nor the catalogue nor his own record gives a year of birth or death. The only fixed point is 康熙三十五年丙子 (1696), when he took Jiedai.

school.quote: 南嶽下第三十二世，嗣別庵統

bio.kind: his own 語錄 (no 行實 attached)
bio.quote: 康熙三十五年丙子五月初五日，師受溫州接待禪寺

bio: Of the Zhang clan of Tongchuan (Sichuan). He studied under Yun'e Xi and received his transmission, then went out as abbot of Fahai monastery in Xichuan. He preached at Funing monastery in Lingxia (Ningxia). His discourse record runs to two fascicles.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (開堂, first enthronement)
teacher.quote: 拈香。「此一瓣香…端為祝延今上皇帝聖壽萬歲…」次拈云：「此一瓣香…奉為滿朝文武、闔國勳貴、本郡縣宰…」又拈云：「此一瓣香，十載遍參，後入龍池會裏惡浪滔天，幸是不曾沾他涓滴，而今毒發恨深，恭對人天眾前拈出，供養現住河南汝州風穴堂上雲峨老和尚，爇向爐中，用酬法乳之恩。」
teacher.note: THE FULL FORMULA — 用酬法乳之恩 — and it goes to 雲峨, named by his living seat (現住河南汝州風穴堂上). Three sticks, and the other two are emperor and officials, so there is no competing candidate. Note the honesty of the third stick: he wandered ten years and passed through 龍池's assembly first (後入龍池會裏) — and pointedly says he took not a drop there (不曾沾他涓滴). He himself rules out the other association.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (second enthronement, 海寶禪寺, 寧夏)
teacher.quote: 此瓣香第二回拈出，供養見住風穴堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二代雲峨大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HE DID IT TWICE. A second, independent enthronement years later, same formula, same man, now with the generation number attached (臨濟正宗第三十二代) — which makes 斌雅 the 33rd. Two first-person attestations of one edge is as good as this evidence gets.

teacher.quote: 字斌雅，為雲峨行喜禪師（1613-1676）法嗣。潼川人，俗姓章。參雲峨喜得法，出住浙川法海寺。（《錦江禪燈》卷14）
法嗣有雪兆性、冲涵恒、斌雅鑑、憨休乾等多位
teacher.note: The TEACHER's record names him as heir — the edge is confirmed from both ends.

teacher.quote: 大用志嗣 淅川法海斌雅鑑禪師（補遺）
teacher.note: *** THE LAMP IS WRONG. *** 五燈全書 files him under 大用志. Both DILA (following 錦江禪燈) and his own teacher's heir-list say 雲峨喜. This is a live instance of the lamp-drift the brief warns about — and a sanity check on the whole method: never trust a single lamp tag.

teacher.quote: 法海斌雅鑑禪師 / 風穴憨休乾禪師
teacher.note: Listed side by side with Hanxiu Ruqian — who is independently a heir of Yun'e Xi. Consistent with the Yun'e attribution, not with 大用志.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳
dates.note: NO DATES.

bio.source: DILA A018935 / 錦江禪燈 卷14

bio: Of the Li clan of Neijiang, born on the fifteenth day of the eighth month of 1626. He was tonsured at twenty-three (1648) under Zhangxue Tongzui at Yumen. In 1654 he accompanied Tongzui to pay respects to Poshan Haiming at Shuanggui. He was fully ordained in 1657 under Tongrong at Yaofeng, called on Eryin Xingmi at Longyuan, and returned to Jingming. In 1660 Tongzui handed him the source-scroll and the whisk. From 1670 he held Zhugu Chan cloister, then Zhaojue in Chengdu, Chaoyin, and Bore. He was still alive in 1693, aged 68. He edited his master's discourse record; his own runs to twelve fascicles.

steles.title: 佛冤禪師語錄 卷10〈行繇〉
steles.author: compiled by his disciples (性純 et al.)
steles.author_note: Named in the DILA record and in the Jiaxing catalogue; a 行繇 is an account-of-conduct in the same family as 行狀.
steles.note: The catalogue B35n0194 lb 0337a05 records: 「佛冤禪師語錄十二卷 清徹綱說，性純等編……徹了跋，有行繇，附耄耋錄。南嶽下第三十六世，嗣丈雪醉。」 I confirmed the 行繇 exists and is tagged to Zhangxue; I did not extract its opening lines.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香諸佛命脈，列祖淵源…此是第二回爇向寶爐，供養傳臨濟正脈三十二世丈雪本師大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His OWN dharma-milk stick (用酬法乳之恩) to 丈雪 (通醉). Also lb 0014a25 the昭覺 enthronement stick. A-grade first-person.

teacher.quote: 字佛冤，為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣……順治戊子歲（1648）年二十三時於禹門通醉和尚會下削染……庚子年（1660）通醉咐源流拂子
teacher.note: Tonsured by him AND given the source-scroll by him — tonsure master and dharma master are the same man here.

teacher.quote: 南嶽下第三十六世，嗣丈雪醉

dates.quote: 生於：明, 熹宗, 天啟, 六年, 八月, 十五日 / 清康熙三十二癸酉，年六十八
dates.note: Tianqi 6 = 1626. Still alive in 1693 aged 68. DEATH UNKNOWN — I leave it null.

links.label: DILA Authority A016519
links.confirms: birth, teacher, school, the 行繇

bio: Of the Shen clan of Songzhou; his father was named Lun, his mother of the Ren clan. Born on the eighth day of the fourth month of 1660. His mother dreamed Guanyin told her the child was no householder and must be given a good name. Sent at one year old to Rushan at Miaojue monastery, he was ordained under Shenghui. Reading the Lotus at a donor's request, he stuck on the line 'the father young, the son old', found no one to ask, and left Songzhou for Zhaojue. He served a year under Zhangxue, went home, sealed himself in for three years, and returned to Zhaojue, where Foyuan Chegang now held the seat; after being beaten out of the abbot's room and struck repeatedly on the path, he broke through and received the transmission. He held Zhaojue at Weifeng, Chongshan, Dabei, Wuliang and Fazang. His discourse record runs to six fascicles; his heirs number eighty-three monks and six laymen.

steles.title: 昭覺竹峰續禪師語錄 卷5〈行實〉
steles.author: 自述 — spoken by himself, taken down by his proctor 實悟
steles.author_note: Not a stele but better: a first-person account extracted from him by his own monks.
steles.quote: 予乃松州人也，父姓沈諱綸，母任氏，生於順治十七年庚子四月初八日辰時……三載後，復參昭覺，時本師老人主席，余參見，問本來面目，師直打出方丈。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. 本師老人 — 'my own master, the elder' — is Foyuan Chegang, then abbot of Zhaojue. Shunzhi 17 = 1660.

teacher.quote: 時本師老人主席……余震威一喝，師連打數棒
為佛冤徹綱禪師（1626-？）法嗣。松州人，俗姓沈……時佛冤和尚主席……得付法

dates.quote: 生於順治十七年庚子四月初八日辰時
dates.note: Shunzhi 17 = 1660. DEATH NOT RECORDED anywhere.

bio: Of the Zhao clan of Mianyang in Chu; his father was named Shijie, his mother of the Du clan, a family in the Confucian line. Orphaned young, he was tonsured at sixteen at the West Chan hall of Donglin monastery in Huang'an, Huangzhou — the very place the Fifth Patriarch first crossed. At eighteen, spurred on by his uncle-in-dharma Tongshan, he broke his ties and set out. He went first to Miyun at Taibai peak, then to Ruigong at Longhua on Mount Bian and Feigong at Jinsu in Wuyuan. Weary of wandering he built a hut at Jiangyin and rested some years, then went to Longchi and met Wanru Tongwei, from whom he received the milk of the dharma. He was made abbot of Ruru hermitage at Jiahe, then Puji cloister in the capital (1656), then restored Haiyun and Baoguo, and ended at Wanshou. He died on the ninth day of the fourth month of 1670, aged 60, in his fifty-third year as a monk, after six great abbacies; ten men received his dharma.

steles.title: 介為舟禪師語錄 卷10〈塔銘〉
steles.author: unnamed; commissioned by his chief disciple 超修 and his heir Haiyan
steles.author_note: Written after his full-body burial west of Wanshou monastery, more than a year after his death.
steles.quote: 介為禪師，以康熙庚戌四月九日示寂於松陵之萬壽寺。越明年十二月二十七日，弟子超修奉全身塔於寺西上甯元字圩。世壽六十，僧臘四十有四……謹案狀：師諱行舟，字介為，別號扣寂，楚之沔陽趙氏子……後往龍池，遇萬老和尚，承法乳之弘慈
steles.note: 'At Longchi he met Elder Wan and received the great compassion of the milk of the dharma' — Wanru Tongwei named at the transmission. Kangxi gengxu = 1670, aged 60 -> birth 1611. A 行狀 also sits in the same fascicle (lb 0272a11).

teacher.quote: 後往龍池，遇萬老和尚，承法乳之弘慈，傳真如之玅諦
字介為，別號扣寂，萬如通微禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 以康熙庚戌四月九日示寂……世壽六十，僧臘四十有四
卒於：大清, 聖祖, 康熙, 九年, 四月, 初九日，60歲
dates.note: Independently agrees: 1670, aged 60 -> birth 1611.

links.label: DILA Authority A000406
links.confirms: dates, teacher, school, the 塔銘

bio: Of the Jiang clan of Tianshui in Qinzhou, born on the third day of the third month of 1647. He lost his mother at three and his father in boyhood, took a wife of the Wang clan at thirteen to eke out a living with his stepmother, and at fifteen left the world for the Haihui hall in his own prefecture under the elder Taixu; his wife died soon after. Fully ordained at eighteen. In 1666 he went south; his master told him 'here we do not know Chan — Zhaojue in western Shu is Yuanwu come again; go and see him.' He went to Zhangxue Tongzui, who slapped him across the face and later set him on the 'original face' case, but after some years he made no headway and left, calling on Changpo, Danzhu and Lianyue with no result. Finally he came to Nouyun at Caotang and received the transmission in 1669. He was abbot at Guhuang and the Dabei cloister in Guanxi.

steles.title: 印心佛敏訥禪師語錄 卷2〈行實〉
steles.author: 自述 — his own account
steles.author_note: First-person throughout, beginning 予生於… ('I was born in…').
steles.quote: 予生於順治丁亥三月三日戌時，字佛敏，諱寂訥，秦州天水蒼平頭人也。俗姓姜，母陳氏……乃棄俗依本州海會堂太虛和尚脫白
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON, and it settles the name: he calls himself 寂訥, not 寂納. Shunzhi dinghai = 1647.

steles.title: 重興印心寺碑記
steles.author: 佛敏寂訥 himself (手記), 1677
steles.quote: 監督通府張公易其名為印心，而協鎮莊浪副總兵陳公又題其額曰選佛場…時康熙丁巳中秋日，雙桂下第三世佛敏寂訥手記。
steles.note: This is a temple-founding stele he wrote himself, not a memorial to him — but it is a dated inscription in stone-record form and it names him, his generation, and the year.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at enthronement (印心佛敏訥禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 第一回拈出供養現住四川保寧府草堂堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十三世本師耨雲大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick, own voice. 本師 = root teacher; 現住…草堂 = Nouyun then living at Caotang, Baoning, Sichuan.

teacher.quote: 後參草堂本師…己酉七月，因業師年高，有書召予省侍，辭師，師出源流衣拂授予云：此是從上來底公文，汝善護持。予拜受。
teacher.note: 出源流衣拂授予 — the master handed over the lineage-robe-and-whisk, the physical transmission tokens, in HIS OWN account. ⚠ THE TRAP: earlier in the same 行實 he awakens (有省) on the road near 昭覺 and under 丈雪 — but the ROBE came from 草堂耨雲. He distinguishes the two himself.

teacher.quote: 印心佛敏訥禪師語錄二卷 清寂訥說……有行實。南嶽下第三十七世，嗣耨雲實。
teacher.note: And the entry immediately above it fixes the generation above him: 「草堂耨雲實禪師語錄二卷 清實說，寂訥等錄……南嶽下第三十六世，嗣丈雪醉。」 So the chain is 丈雪通醉 -> 耨雲實 -> 印心佛敏寂訥, and Jina EDITED his own master's record.

teacher.quote: 字佛敏，為耨雲徹實禪師法嗣……末入閬中草堂，參耨雲禪師。俄於掌下領旨，始紹其裔
teacher.note: Note his own 行實 shows he went to Zhangxue Tongzui FIRST and failed there — the transmission is Nouyun's. His tonsure master was a third man, 太虛. Three men, one teacher.

dates.quote: 予生於順治丁亥三月三日戌時
dates.note: 1647. DEATH NOT RECORDED.

dates.quote: birth +1647-04-07「生於順治丁亥三月三日戌時。」/ 卒年及世壽不詳

links.label: DILA Authority A019546
links.confirms: birth, teacher, school, the 行實

bio: Of the Xu clan of Fengling in western Shu, a family of Confucian scholars; born on the fifteenth day of the twelfth month of 1638. Precocious — at six he could recite and explain the Confucian classics. At ten he was tonsured alongside Wanfeng Shan and served Qingzhong Tiebi Huiji; the two novices were famous in the assembly for their quick tongues and their verses. Told by Qingzhong to make a verse on a lamp, he answered on the spot: 'Bright as a lightning flash, it can pierce the void; a lamp in time to come — is it bronze, or iron?' He was ordained at Chongsheng, went to Wuyun, and returned to his master, who wrote him a transmission verse. He kept the record-keeper's office and attended Qingzhong for twenty-one years, and on his death succeeded to the seat. He later moved to Fangguang and to Lengyan in Zhejiang.
