dates.note: ⚠ CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER, which carries death 1700. DILA states plainly that his dates are unknown. I could not source 1700 and have left both dates null.

bio.quote: 住新州龍山，遷潮州靈山。編述唐代大顛和尚事蹟，為《正弘集》一卷。
19 岁出家, 师事报资寺旷圆和尚。
bio.note: SUPPORTS the roster's Nguyen Thieu claim — but note the source is a modern scholarly article, and it names the temple 報資寺, not Longshan. The transmission-to-Vietnam story stands; the temple detail in the roster note does not.

links.label: DILA Authority A021838
links.confirms: teacher, school, Nguyen Thieu; states dates UNKNOWN

notes: Based at Longshan Temple in Guangdong. Transmitted Miyun's Linji lineage to the Vietnamese monk Nguyen Thieu, who brought it to Cochinchina in 1665.

bio: Third patriarch of the Oxhead school, lay surname Pu, of Yanling. Ordained at Kaishan monastery, he went to Mount Niutou and received the mind-seal from Zhiyan. He stayed more than ten years without leaving the woods and students gathered to him; he then handed the dharma to Fachi and withdrew alone to Maoshan. He died in 695, aged sixty-seven.

teacher.source: B/B29/B29n0160.xml (牛頭山志, reproducing 景德傳燈錄's 慧方禪師傳)
teacher.quote: 慧方潤州延陵人投開善寺出家及進具洞明經論後入牛頭山謁巖禪師諮詢秘要巖觀其根器堪任正法遂示以心印師豁然領悟…乃以正法付法持禪師遂歸茅山
teacher.note: 示以心印 — 'showed him the mind-seal' — is transmission language, and 付 for his own onward transmission to Fachi. This is the best evidence that exists for this edge. BUT it is lamp-level, and it inherits the problem above: I could find NO contemporary source for the Oxhead patriarchate at all. Daoxuan (d. 667) does not connect Zhiyan to Farong, and Huifang would have been about 38 when Daoxuan died, so his absence from the contemporary record is itself notable. Marked `disputed` for the same reason as Zhiyan: the whole Oxhead succession rests on the lamps.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 景德傳燈錄
teacher.quote: 後入牛頭山，禮謁智巖禪師，諮詢祕要，智巖觀其根器堪任正法，遂示以心印 (T51n2076_p0223b15)
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster.

dates.kind: authority record citing 佛光/疑年錄
dates.quote: 武后天冊萬歲元年示寂，世壽六十七。
dates.note: 695, aged 67 → birth 629. CONFIRMS the roster exactly.

school.quote: 牛頭宗 … 牛頭宗第三祖

bio.quote: 於牛頭山參契，逾十年不出林藪，四方學者皆雲集來訪。後欲行隨機利物，而以正法傳付法持禪師，獨自歸隱茅山。

notes: Third patriarch of the Niutou school. He resided at Mount Niutou continuing the tradition established by Farong and Zhiyan. Under his stewardship the Niutou community maintained its independence from the northern and southern Chan lineages centered on Hongren's successors.

bio: A nun. Born 1606 in Hengzhou, Huguang, lay surname Liu. She read Tongji's Nanyue Chandeng lu, went to him for instruction, and sat forty-nine days and nights before breaking through; he tonsured and ordained her, she being thirty-four. After his death she went to Muyun at Helin and to Ruoan at Jiashan, and finally to Wanru Tongwei at Longchi, who sealed her. She held Huideng in Suzhou, Pudu at Xinghua, Guofu and Shanhu. Her record runs to four fascicles.

steles.title: 季總徹禪師語錄卷二〈行實〉
steles.author_note: In her own 語錄.
steles.quote: 於萬曆丙午年八月十八日夜出生。
steles.note: The 行實 is the source of her exact birth date (1606-09-19), cited by DILA. Her death year is not recorded.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香當陽拈出，爇向爐中供養現住禹門堂上本師萬如大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HER OWN WORDS, naming 萬如 (Wanru Tongwei) as 本師 and repaying the 'dharma-milk'. This is the strongest class of teacher evidence there is. CONFIRMS.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 五燈全書
teacher.quote: 為萬如通微禪師（1594-1657）法嗣

dates.kind: authority record citing her 行實
dates.quote: 於萬曆丙午年八月十八日夜出生。（《季總徹禪師語錄》卷 2〈行實〉）
dates.note: Birth 1606-09-19. Death NOT recorded anywhere I could reach.

school.quote: 明 清；萬如通微 (Miyun's heir) → Linji Yangqi

bio.kind: authority record citing her 行實 and 五燈全書
bio.quote: 湖廣衡州人，俗姓劉…一日讀通際所集《南嶽禪燈錄》，即往見求開示。際痛切究竟，頓發疑情，苦參四十九晝夜不倦。際與祝髮、受具，時年三十四…後謁龍池通微，機契，記莂。
bio.note: Note the careful distinction, which the source itself makes: 通際 (綠蘿通際) tonsured and ordained her; 通微 sealed her. Only the second is the dharma teacher.

links.label: DILA Authority A018939
links.confirms: teacher, birth, bio, the 行實

bio: From Yongjia in Wenzhou, lay surname Ye. He was tonsured by Tuiweng Hongchu at Lingyan in Suzhou and later received his dharma. He held Guoqing and Zhenru on Mount Tiantai and Tongxuan, and in 1705 named Bin Yuanzhang to succeed him at Tongxuan. His record runs to eight fascicles; he also left a set of matching-rhyme poems to Hanshan.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 — the dharma-milk incense (翼菴禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 末上拈香曰：「此一瓣香，根源豎窮南岳，枝葉橫亙天台。…爇向爐中供養，開萬世宗眼，集千古大成，即此景德堂上，前住靈巖，後住南岳先師退翁老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。」斂衣就座。
teacher.note: Three sticks, and I took only the third. Stick 1 (0667a13) goes to 始祖釋迦文佛 — the Buddha. Stick 2 (0667a19) goes to 飲光尊者…先祖大和尚 and the temple's founding masters (當山歷代開法諸大知識) — the lineage-at-large and the 開山. ONLY the third (末上) carries 用酬法乳之恩, and it names 退翁 — 前住靈巖, 後住南岳, which matches Hongchu's seats exactly. This is the DILA-style error the brief warns of, avoided.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 五燈全書 卷86
teacher.quote: 字翼菴，為退翁弘儲禪師（1605-1672）法嗣…依退翁薙染於蘇州靈巖，後得付法。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster. Here tonsure AND transmission happen to be the same man — which the source states explicitly, so it is safe.

dates.kind: authority record citing 長谷部幽蹊 2008
dates.note: NEW — the roster had neither date. Source is modern scholarship (Hasebe Yukei), not a primary; DILA's own prose elsewhere says 生卒年不詳, so treat with mild caution.

bio.quote: 歷住天台國清、真如、天台通玄等諸禪寺。乙酉年（1705）舉彬遠璋禪師繼住通玄。有《翼菴禪師語錄》八卷。
bio.note: ⚠ NOTE AN INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY IN DILA: it dates him 1625-1700 yet has him naming a successor in 1705. One of the two is wrong. I record the dates but flag them.

bio: 'Crazy Ji'. From Linhai in Tiantai, lay surname Li. He was tonsured at eighteen at Lingyin under Xiatang Huiyuan and inherited his dharma. He drank, ate meat and drifted through the markets, and was called Ji the Madman; after Huiyuan died he went to Jingci under Dehui and served as secretary. He died in 1209, aged sixty, after forty-two years in robes. He became, over the following centuries, the most popular saint in Chinese Buddhism.

steles.title: 湖隱方圓叟舍利銘
steles.author_note: Prefixed to the 濟顛道濟禪師語錄 (X69n1361). A relic-inscription — the funerary genre for him.
steles.quote: 湖隱方圓叟舍利銘
steles.note: Cited by DILA as a source for his life. Present in the corpus.

steles.title: 湖隱方圓叟舍利銘
steles.author: 北磵居簡 (1164–1246), a contemporary who knew him
steles.quote: 叟名道濟，曰湖隱，曰方圓叟，皆時人稱之。嘉定二年五月十四死於淨慈。
steles.note: Preserved as appendix 1361-A, noted 出于北磵文集. Confirms his real name, his two sobriquets, his lay descent (great-grandson-line of 李文和), his death date and place, and his ordination master. Also confirmed present in the 閱藏知津-type catalogue B35n0194 (0577a16): 「濟顛道濟禪師語錄一卷…附舍利銘」.

teacher.kind: contemporary 舍利銘 by 北磵居簡
teacher.quote: 叟天台臨海李都尉文和遠孫，受度於靈隱佛海禪師。狂而踈，介而潔，著語不刊削…叟名道濟，曰湖隱，曰方圓叟，皆時人稱之。嘉定二年五月十四死於淨慈，𣇑人分舍利藏於雙岩之下。
teacher.note: ⚠ READ THE VERB. 北磵居簡 (1164–1246) knew Daoji personally — Daoji asked him to write the eulogy for 祖覺, and Ju-jian wrote this 舍利銘 for Daoji himself right after his death (嘉定二年 = 1209, the date given). This is the ONLY contemporary witness to the man, and it says 受度於靈隱佛海禪師 — he was TONSURED/ordained by 佛海 (= 瞎堂慧遠's posthumous title). 受度 is ordination, NOT 嗣法/得法/印可. The contemporary record therefore fixes the ASSOCIATION with 慧遠 beyond doubt but does NOT itself assert dharma transmission.

teacher.kind: lamp — filed under 瞎堂遠禪師 as 法嗣
teacher.quote: 〔補輯〕瞎堂遠禪師 / 湖隱濟顛書記
teacher.note: The 嗣法 claim itself rests on the lamps (also X81n1570, X76n1517 補續高僧傳, X65n1278). No 拈香, no 印可 record, and Daoji left no authentic 語錄 (the 錢塘湖隱濟顛禪師語錄 X69n1361 is a late popular-fiction compilation — the 舍利銘 survives only as an appendix to it, 'out of 北磵文集').

teacher.kind: authority record citing 五燈全書
teacher.quote: 靈隱遠禪師法嗣……淨慈濟顛道濟禪師 (X81n1570_p0374a24)
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster (瞎堂慧遠, 1103-1176).

teacher.kind: authority record citing 淨慈寺志
teacher.quote: 年十八從靈隱寺瞎堂遠（1103-1176）出家，嗣其法。

dates.kind: authority record citing 淨慈寺志 卷10
dates.quote: 紹興十八年十二月初八 … 嘉定二年五月十六日，壽六十
dates.note: 1149-01-26 – 1209-06-26. Death 1209 CONFIRMS the roster; birth 1149 (the roster's 'floruit 1148' is the same lunar year read as Western).

bio.kind: authority record citing 淨慈寺志 / 舍利銘
bio.quote: 風狂嗜酒肉，浮沉市井，人稱濟顛。遠寂往依淨慈德輝，為記室。

bio: From Changzhou in old Yu (Sichuan), lay surname Jin, born 1606. Tonsured at Wofo monastery, he was set going by Poshan Haiming, then went to Tianyin at Qingshan, Xuejiao at Jingshan, and finally to Miyun Yuanwu at Tiantong, where he awakened one midnight at the sound of the bell. He spent six years in retreat on Lotus Peak. When Miyun died and Linye Tongqi took the seat at Tongxuan, Linye called him back by verse and gave him the transmission in the winter of 1644. He held Falun, Faxiang, Qizhen, Daming, Fashen, Longyuan and finally Bao'an at Qishan. He died in 1665, aged sixty.

steles.title: 二隱謐禪師語錄卷十〈塔銘〉
steles.author_note: Appended to his own 語錄.
steles.quote: 康熙乙巳六月廿八日午時，壽六旬。
steles.note: Source of his death date and age, cited by DILA.

teacher.quote: 爇向爐中，供養浙江嘉興路棲真堂上、傳曹溪正脈南嶽下第三十五代林野大和尚，用酬法乳之恩！
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS naming 林野 (Linye Tongqi) and repaying the dharma-milk. CONFIRMS the roster decisively.

teacher.quote: 為林野通奇禪師（1596-1652）法嗣…順治甲申冬（1644）得奇付囑。

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 康熙乙巳六月廿八日午時，壽六旬。（《二隱謐禪師語錄》卷 10〈塔銘〉）
dates.note: 1606 – 1665-08-09. NEW: the roster had no dates.

bio.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘 and 錦江禪燈
bio.quote: 古渝昌州人，俗姓金…因參東塔破山，和尚示以偈，遂決意深究禪宗…後上天童參密雲悟老和尚…一夕坐至中夜，忽聞鐘聲，豁然有省。
bio.note: Note the source distinguishes clearly: Poshan STARTED him, Miyun's assembly was where he awakened, but Linye gave the 付囑. Only Linye is the teacher.

links.label: DILA Authority A016193
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔銘

bio: From Yongfeng, lay surname Yu, born 1630. At twenty-one he left the world and became a monk under Xuejian Daofeng at Boshan, who gave him the Chuanzi 'hiding the body' case to work on; he broke through on the Poisao Duo story after a night of hearing ghosts cry. He received Xuejian's transmission in 1668 and held Boshan Nengren in Xinzhou, Gaoquan and Yingshan. He died in 1706, aged seventy-seven, after fifty-four years in robes. His record carries both an account of conduct and a stupa inscription.

steles.title: 青原三十三世博山第六代住持粟如瀚大師塔銘
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄, 卷6. The title itself fixes his lineage position: 33rd generation under Qingyuan, 6th abbot of Boshan.
steles.quote: 生則明崇禎庚午二月初三巳時，世壽七十七。… 歿則今康熙四十五年丙戌二月二十七申時也。
steles.note: Gives birth and death to the hour. His 語錄 卷6 also carries a separate 行狀.

steles.title: 博山粟如瀚禪師行狀
steles.author_note: Also in 卷6.
steles.quote: 二十一齡棄而為僧，師事博山雪澗奉
steles.note: Names the teacher outright.

teacher.quote: 二十一齡棄而為僧師事博山雪澗奉
teacher.note: DILA cites this at J40nB490_p0471c07. CONFIRMS bio_5's 雪澗奉 — and supplies his dharma name: 道奉 (雪澗道奉, 1592-1670).

teacher.quote: 字粟如，別號勺菴，為雪澗道奉禪師（1592-1670）法嗣…戊申年（1668）得雪澗禪師付法。

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 生則明崇禎庚午二月初三巳時 … 歿則今康熙四十五年丙戌二月二十七申時也。
dates.note: 1630-03-16 – 1706-04-10. NEW: the roster had no dates.

school.quote: 青原三十三世博山第六代住持粟如瀚大師塔銘
school.note: '33rd generation under Qingyuan' = Caodong. CONFIRMS the roster's school, from the stele's own title.

bio.kind: authority record citing 行狀 + 塔銘

links.label: DILA Authority A000243
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔銘 and 行狀

bio: From Dazhou in western Shu, lay surname Luo. He heard the Diamond Sutra at seven and was tonsured at eight by the long-browed monk of Lanhua monastery. He went to Wutai in the famine years of the late Ming, then south — to Yunwo, to Gunan Muyun (who gave him 'your face before your parents were born'), to Judé at Tianning, to Xuedou, Yunmen and Tiantong, and finally spent twelve years under Yulin Tongxiu at Bao'en. In 1661 he passed through Yixing, sparred with Eryin Mi, and received a whisk and verse. He held the Shuiyue Chan cloister at Jiangling and Tanhua monastery at Zhijiang, and edited Eryin Mi's record in ten fascicles.

steles.title: 芝巖秀禪師語錄卷下〈行實〉
steles.author: 超秀 himself (spoken, recorded by disciples)
steles.author_note: A first-person 行由 told to the assembly at Tanhua monastery.
steles.quote: 老僧西蜀達州古蒙溪鍾子山人也，族姓羅…辛丑春，過宜興屺山，正值二隱和尚上堂…師拂袖便出。至晚，到方丈辭別，過龍池隨喜道場，和尚命兩序堅留不放，命充知藏。於二月念二日將拂并偈付囑。
steles.note: This is the crux. Read plainly it says: he sparred with Eryin, LEFT, went on to Longchi, and it was the abbot THERE who detained him and gave him the whisk and verse.

teacher.quote: 燒向爐中，端申供養前住船子道場、現住宜興屺山保安堂上傳曹溪正脈三十六代二隱老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: FOR 二隱謐. His own public incense names 二隱 as the man he repays the dharma-milk to, and the description fits Eryin Mi exactly — formerly abbot of the Chuanzi monastery, now at Bao'an on Qishan in Yixing (Eryin was at 船子法忍寺 from 1653 and 保安寺 from 1659).

teacher.source: J/J28/J28nB212.xml lb 0472b14 (colophon of Eryin's own 語錄)
teacher.quote: 二隱謐禪師語錄卷第一…嗣法門人超巨超秀等編
teacher.note: FOR 二隱謐, from the other side: Eryin's own record calls 超秀 an 嗣法門人 — a DHARMA HEIR, not merely an editor.

teacher.quote: 至晚，到方丈辭別，過龍池隨喜道場，和尚命兩序堅留不放，命充知藏。於二月念二日將拂并偈付囑。
teacher.note: AGAINST 二隱謐. His own account of conduct puts the actual handover (whisk + verse) at LONGCHI, from an unnamed 和尚, AFTER he had taken his leave of Eryin.

teacher.quote: 為龍池道場和尚法嗣…辛丑春（1661）過宜興屺山參二隱和尚，後過龍池隨喜道場和尚，受付囑。
teacher.note: AGAINST 二隱謐. DILA reads the 行實 as making him heir of a 'Venerable Daochang of Longchi'. ⚠ But I believe DILA has MIS-PARSED: 道場 here is not a personal name (no such master exists in DILA's own 49,190 records) — 隨喜道場 means 'attended the dharma-assembly'. So DILA's named teacher is likely a ghost.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: No dates in any source.

school.quote: 傳曹溪正脈三十六代二隱老和尚
school.note: 36th generation — Linji via Miyun → Linye → Eryin.

links.label: DILA Authority A019011
links.confirms: dharma name 超秀, bio; teacher DISPUTED

bio: Dharma heir of Yuzhao Yunfen (Xiaotang). He held Xinghua at Nanyun, Pilu at Fangguang, Faxing at Tongquan, and Ciming and Yijiao in Beijing. He was still alive in 1683, aged fifty. He edited his master's record in six fascicles; his own runs to six. One heir is recorded.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense, at enthronement (teacher still living)
teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，不自西域將來，不從東土拈出…爇向爐中，供養現住東巖同真堂上沒意味的嘯堂大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: First-person, at the transmission. 「現住」 = still alive, so this enthronement predates 允汾's death (1680).

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense, at a later enthronement (teacher now dead)
teacher.quote: 爇向爐中，供養九座道場、十回說法，前住此山上俞下昭先老和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: Same man after death: 「前住此山」 + 先老和尚 (deceased). 嘯堂 = 允汾 = 俞昭 is one person — J37nB389's preface calls him 「嘯堂汾和尚」 (lb 0505a22) and its 目錄 header calls him 「俞昭禪師」 (lb 0505a01). A third stick, lb 0537a22, repeats 「供養報國堂上不識冷暖的嘯堂老和尚，用酬法乳」.

teacher.quote: 門人上睿、理祚等，奉師全身塔於京山潼泉
teacher.note: 上睿 personally interred 允汾's body and raised his stupa. He is also styled 「住北京翊教寺嗣法門人上睿等編」 throughout the teacher's 語錄 — DHARMA-HEIR who edited (the 燮雲濟璣 pattern, not the editor trap).

teacher.kind: authority record citing 五燈全書
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's 嘯堂汾 — AND RESOLVES THE CONFLICT bio_5 flagged. 嘯堂, 允汾 and 俞昭 are ONE MAN (DILA A014466 lists all three as his names). The second incense in Chulin's 語錄 honouring 「前住此山上俞下昭先老和尚」 is therefore honouring the SAME master, not a rival claimant. There is no conflict.

teacher.source: DILA A014466 (Yuzhao's record, rel student, n=上睿)
teacher.quote: 法嗣有京都報恩楚林上睿禪師
teacher.note: Confirmed from the teacher's side.

dates.quote: 康熙癸亥，五旬誕辰。（《北京楚林禪師語錄》卷 4）
dates.note: Alive in 1683 at fifty → born c.1634. Death year NOT recorded.

bio.quote: 歷住南雲興化、放光毘盧、桐泉法興、北京慈明及北京翊教等諸寺…編有《洪山俞昭允汾禪師語錄》六卷；自有《北京楚林禪師語錄》六卷。

links.label: DILA Authority A014466
links.confirms: his teacher = 允汾 = 嘯堂 = 俞昭, one man

bio: Lay surname Li. He was tonsured by Dongxu Xinguang and received the dharma from Guyun Pei. He held Yongzhen at Jianxi, Xiting at Bailu and Caoan at Qingyun, and gave the precepts at Qingyun in Fengcheng, Yuantong in Fuliang and Tianzhu in Chongren. He was still alive in 1737, aged fifty-six. His record runs to six fascicles.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 正源略集 卷14
teacher.quote: 古雲沛禪師法嗣，劒溪永鎮樸夫拙禪師 (X85n1587_p0085a05)
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5. Note DILA ALSO records 心光 as a teacher — but its own quote makes clear that is the TONSURE master (遂剃染於海福菴師 / 薙髮於洞虛光禪師), not the transmission. Kept separate.

teacher.kind: 附洞虛禪師塔銘 (by 李燉, 1722)
teacher.quote: 師諱心光，字靈鑒，號洞虛…而牧亭大師者，於師為剃度師
teacher.note: The stupa inscription for 洞虛心光, appended to Pufu Zhuo's own record, states the relation explicitly: 心光 was Pufu Zhuo's TONSURE master. Confirms the distinction.

dates.quote: 卒年及世壽不詳，僅知乾隆丁巳年（1737）時年五十六。
dates.note: Alive 1737 at 56 → born c.1682. Neither birth nor death is directly recorded; I leave both null.

dates.quote: 辛丑年三月十八日，預言時至，趺坐示寂。壬寅年正月廿五日，塔於慶雲菴之西偏
dates.note: 辛丑: abbot from 雍正4(1726) and teacher 古雲沛 died 1771, so 辛丑=乾隆46=1781, 塔 壬寅=1782. NOTE the nearby '康熙61壬寅' belongs to the appended 洞虛禪師塔銘, a different man.

school.note: ⚠ NO SOURCE. DILA assigns him NO sect. His seat 磬山 was the Linji house of 天隱圓修, which makes Linji likely — but that is inference from a building, not evidence about the man. bio_5 left school null and I keep it null. This is the honest answer.

bio.kind: authority record citing 正源略集 + his 語錄 卷6〈傳〉
bio.quote: 字樸夫，為古雲沛禪師法嗣。俗姓李…住劍溪永鎮、白鷺西汀、青雲艸菴等剎。

links.label: DILA Authority A019780
links.confirms: dharma name 實拙, teacher, floruit; NO school

bio: From Wutang, lay surname Ju; fostered into the Zhang family of Danghu. He married and had a son. At twenty-seven a pair of dreams turned him toward leaving home; at thirty-one he abandoned his household and went to East Mountain at Tianmu to be tonsured by Bianzhi of western Shu, who set him on 'your face before your parents were born'. He met Miyun at Tiantong, then attached himself to Linye Tongqi, following him to Guanghua and Tongxuan. Linye gave him the transmission in the spring of 1649. He opened the dharma at Guanghua Chan monastery in Yuhang. Four or more heirs are recorded.

steles.title: 笑堂和尚語錄卷一〈行實〉
steles.author: 笑堂行明 himself (spoken to the assembly, 1657)
steles.author_note: A first-person account of conduct, given at the request of the prior.
steles.quote: 丁酉春…監院等請師說行由，遂拊掌大笑云：「若問老僧顛末，摠屬一笑而已…余乃武塘居氏仲子也…至三十一歲，塵牢頓破，秉志棄家，直往天目東山，懇投西蜀遍知師剃度，令參父母未生前話。」
steles.note: One of the best documents in this batch: the man telling his own life, laughing.

teacher.quote: 往參天童密師翁…予至西堂寮，禮覲先師，敘話間喜之不勝，從此晨參夕叩…先師後住通玄
teacher.note: In his own words: Miyun is 師翁 (grand-teacher), and 先師 — his own late master, the one he followed to Guanghua and Tongxuan — is Linye Tongqi. CONFIRMS bio_5.

teacher.quote: 為林野通奇禪師（1596-1652）法嗣…順治己丑（1649）仲春三日授囑。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: No dates recorded. He was 31 when he left home and told his story in 1657.

school.quote: Linji, via 林野通奇 (Miyun's heir)

links.label: DILA Authority A016202
links.confirms: dharma name 行明, 字悅可, teacher, bio

bio: From Xinhua county, Baoqing prefecture (Hunan), lay surname Deng, born 1636. Tonsured at seventeen, he roamed with his master; reading Huangbo's Essentials of Mind set him going. He took the precepts from Qushan and later went to the Venerable Lüluo. He received the transmission from Hengxiu Falin in 1670 and held Mituo, Yuanming and Baojue in Yunnan. He returned to the Lüluo stupa-cloister ill in his last years and died in 1685, aged fifty, after thirty-two years in robes; his stupa stands to the left of the old man's.

steles.title: 長目電禪師語錄卷二〈行狀〉
steles.author_note: Appended to his own record.
steles.quote: 生於明崇禎丙子十一月初三日 … 康熙乙丑七月二十八
steles.note: Gives birth and death; DILA takes both from it.

teacher.quote: 拈來爇向爐中，供養現住彌陽大隱堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十三世本師恒秀老人，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS: 本師 恒秀, 33rd generation Linji, at Miyang. CONFIRMS bio_5's 恒秀林, and the Miyang location matches. Dharma name is 發林 (恒秀發林).

teacher.quote: 為恒秀發林禪師（1626-？）法嗣…康熙庚戌（1670）得付法。
teacher.note: ⚠ NOTE: DILA's bibl for this relation quotes 「參綠蘿大和尚」, which is about a DIFFERENT man (綠蘿), and DILA's prose says he 'later went to the Venerable Lüluo. In 1670 he received the transmission' — leaving it ambiguous whether Lüluo or Hengxiu gave it. His own incense settles it: 恒秀 is 本師.

dates.kind: authority record citing the 行狀
dates.quote: 生於明崇禎丙子十一月初三日 … 康熙乙丑七月二十八 … 世壽五十，僧臘三十二。
dates.note: 1636-11-29 – 1685-08-27. NEW: the roster had no dates.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十三世

links.label: DILA Authority A016618
links.confirms: teacher 發林, dates, the 行狀

bio: From Taizhou, lay surname Yu, born 1630. He went to Tianning in his prefecture, where Jubo Jiheng was carrying on Lingyin's line and 'making the single lamp of Sanfeng burn north of the Yangtze'. He was tonsured at Jingye hermitage and took the precepts from Jiheng; he then went south to Judé at Lingyin, who told him 'your affinity lies at Tianning — go'. He returned, received Jiheng's dharma, and succeeded him. He held Jinghu on Lushan, Qingyun, Falun, Baiyun, Tianning at Yangzhou, Dajue, Jile and Qingliang. He died in 1688, aged fifty-nine.

steles.title: 揚州天寧雨山思和尚塔銘并序
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄, 卷20. Opens by quoting Bodhidharma on 'those who pass beyond measure'.
steles.quote: 公名上思，字雪悟，晚號雨山，族出泰州於氏…乃走郡之天寧，以圖出世。時方丈恒和尚繼靈隱老人法化，大唱臨濟之道於淮南…嗣後始就淨業菴，禮新開上人薙染，從恒和尚而納具焉。
steles.note: Gives the name, the lineage, and separates tonsure (新開上人) from ordination and transmission (恒和尚). Death: 實康熙戊辰仲春二月二十五日也，壽五十有九。

teacher.quote: 時方丈恒和尚繼靈隱老人法化，大唱臨濟之道於淮南…從恒和尚而納具焉…恒遙見喜曰：「吾待子久，不意遲至今日。」
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's 巨渤恒. Dharma name 濟恒 (巨渤濟恒, 1605-1666). The 塔銘 also names his TONSURE master separately (新開上人) — kept distinct.

teacher.quote: 字雪悟，晚號雨山，為巨渤濟恒禪師（1605-1666）法嗣

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 實康熙戊辰仲春二月二十五日也，壽五十有九。
dates.note: 1630 – 1688-03-26. Death 1688 CONFIRMS bio_5 (which had it from 宗統編年); birth 1630 is NEW.

bio: From Tongcheng, lay surname Yang, born 1584; his father died when he was young and he served his mother. Tonsured at twenty at Julong hermitage on Jiuhua, he was given a verse to hold by Zibo Zhenke, took full precepts at Yunqi in 1608, and in 1610 went to Zhanran Yuancheng at Yunmen Xiansheng monastery in Shaoxing. Yuancheng broke him open — 'the four elements are false, the deluded mind is empty: who is dragging this corpse of yours here?' — and he came through on the seventh night. He succeeded Yuancheng at Yunmen, then moved to Bianshan in Huzhou and finally to Baizhang in Hongdu, nine seats in all. He died in 1641, aged fifty-eight; his whole body was interred in a stupa at Longhua on Bianshan.

steles.title: 入就瑞白禪師語錄卷十八〈行狀〉
steles.author: 大音 (久默大音)
steles.author_note: His own dharma heir — the 行狀 is signed 「大音狀」.
steles.quote: 大音狀。師諱明雪，字瑞白，號入就，族姓楊。父一舉，桐城人…庚戌，聞會稽雲門顯聖寺有悟道知識湛然和尚，世所希有，忻然往參。門曰：「向作甚麼？」曰：「持毘舍偈。」門曰：「四大是假，妄心是空，阿誰拖你者死屍來！」師鈍置疑甚…閱六日，聞鐘聲大徹。
steles.note: An heir's account of conduct, naming the teacher and narrating the awakening. His 語錄 卷18 also carries a 塔銘 and a 傳.

teacher.kind: 行狀 by his heir 大音
teacher.quote: 庚戌，聞會稽雲門顯聖寺有悟道知識湛然和尚…忻然往參…閱六日，聞鐘聲大徹。
teacher.note: 湛然 = Zhanran Yuancheng. CONFIRMS bio_5. (Also in this batch — the pair is internally consistent.)

teacher.quote: 雲門澄禪師（1561-1627）法嗣，大鑑下第三十七世

dates.kind: authority record citing the 行狀
dates.quote: 生於萬曆甲申十一月二十六日戌時 … 寂於崇禎辛巳三月十九日午時，世壽五十有八
dates.note: 1584-12-27 – 1641-04-28. Birth 1584 CONFIRMS bio_5; DEATH 1641 IS NEW (bio_5 had death null).

links.label: DILA Authority A007133
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 行狀

bio: From Tongbai in Nanyang, lay surname Gu, born 1610. He asked at ten, hearing a neighbour weep, 'everyone dies — what then?' He married at nineteen and left home anyway, was tonsured at Daolin monastery in 1630 and took full precepts at Baoguo the next year. A monk from the south told him 'you will never settle birth-and-death this way — there is a Chan road', so he went: Jiuhua, the southern sea, Fujian and Yue. He came to Ruibai Mingxue at Bianshan, was struck, and awakened at the sound of the bell during a seven-day sitting. He held Zhaoqing, Longfu, Longhua, Nengren, Yunmen Xiansheng, Foguang, Shanquan and Shanqing. He died in 1665, aged fifty-six. Forty-two heirs are recorded.

steles.title: 百愚斯大禪師塔誌銘
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄, 卷20. The text even records the stone: 「銘碑高六裁尺，闊三尺，分二十六行，每行六十四字」 — six feet by three, twenty-six columns of sixty-four characters.
steles.quote: 我百愚大師乃洞上嫡傳正宗主也。師法諱淨斯，別號百愚，姓谷氏，生於河南南陽之桐柏…聞弁山瑞白雪和尚宗風大振，乃往白雀參之…師遂豁然有省。
steles.note: One of the very few steles on this roster that describes its own physical stone.

teacher.quote: 聞弁山瑞白雪和尚宗風大振，乃往白雀參之…吾機緣終在弁山也…師遂豁然有省。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5. His teacher is also in this batch.

teacher.quote: 號百愚，為瑞白明雪禪師（1584-1641）法嗣…聞鐘聲大悟，記莂。

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔誌銘
dates.quote: 生萬曆庚戌五月廿一寅時。 … 終康熙乙巳八月廿八卯時，世壽五十六。
dates.note: 1610-07-11 – 1665-10-06. Death 1665 CONFIRMS bio_5 (which had dated it from an heir's memorial 上堂); birth 1610 is NEW.

school.quote: 我百愚大師乃洞上嫡傳正宗主也
school.note: 'Direct transmission of the Caodong house' — from the stele itself.

links.label: DILA Authority A016277
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔誌銘

bio: From Xi'an in Guizhou, lay surname Zhang. Tonsured at seventeen at Fahai monastery, he met Shanquan Dawei two years later, who set him on 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one'. He took full precepts on Mount Yunjiu, worked with Yuefeng on Tiantai, and returned to Shanquan at Songkui to be sealed. After his master's death he travelled ten years. His dharma-uncle Guyuan put him in at Tianlong; he moved to Songkui and back to Tianlong. Finding that the lamp records held nothing from Guizhou, he collected the recorded sayings of the whole province and compiled the Qiannan huideng lu.

steles.title: 善一純禪師語錄卷三〈行實〉
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄.
steles.note: Cited by DILA as the source of his life. No dates in it.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香自松巋花擘之後…耑申供養松巋堂上傳臨濟正宗三十四世上善下權先師老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS: 善權, 34th generation Linji, at Songkui, 先師 ('my late master'). CONFIRMS bio_5's 善權位. Dharma name 達位 (善權達位, 1618-1684).

teacher.quote: 字善一，為善權達位禪師（1618-1684）法嗣…復上松巋參善權和尚，得印證。

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳。
dates.note: No dates in any source.

bio.kind: authority record citing his 行實 and 黔南會燈錄〈源啟〉
bio.quote: 見古今尊宿名目多在江浙諸省，惟黔中未見片言點墨，故彚收全黔諸家《語錄》，綴以管見，編輯成書，名曰《黔南會燈錄》。
bio.note: His reason for compiling the Guizhou lamp record, in his own preface. The roster's 'converted some thirty prefectures around Guiyang' I could NOT source and have left out.

links.label: DILA Authority A000345
links.confirms: teacher 達位, bio, the 黔南會燈錄

bio: From Zhangzhou, lay surname Lin, born 1005. Ordained at Chongfu in his home prefecture, he travelled widely — Fushan Fayuan, the hermit of Bajiao, Yuantong — and stayed longest with Beichan Zhixian of Tanzhou, under whom he awakened. Late in life he spent three years in the deep ravines of the Western Hills, then took the invitation to Fachang: a few old rooms in Fenning, Hongzhou, where he farmed with hoe and fire and was content. He died in 1081, aged seventy-seven.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, 法昌倚遇禪師
teacher.quote: 法昌倚遇禪師漳州林氏子。幼棄家。依郡之崇福得度。有大志。自受具游方。名著叢席。浮山遠和尚嘗指謂人曰。此後學行脚樣子也。參北禪。禪問。近離甚處。師曰。福嚴。…
teacher.note: 參北禪 = 北禪智賢; the ensuing sparring is his awakening exchange. DILA A014423: 「後參智賢得悟」 (得悟 under 智賢).

teacher.quote: 北禪智賢禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十一世…留北禪最久，於是師資敲唱，妙出一時…後參智賢得悟。
teacher.note: 得悟 under 智賢.

teacher.quote: 北禪智賢禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十一世…留北禪最久，於是師資敲唱，妙出一時…後參智賢得悟。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5.

dates.kind: authority record citing 疑年錄 + 續傳燈錄/嘉泰普燈錄/宗統編年
dates.quote: 元豐四年示寂，年七十七。
dates.note: 1081, aged 77 → birth 1005. NEW — bio_5 had NO dates ('the 語錄 preface is dated 崇寧四年 (1105), after his death'), and this fixes them.

bio.quote: 晚至西山睠，雙嶺深邃，棲息三年，始應法昌之請…後住洪州法昌老屋數間，刀耕火種，安樂於道。

bio: From Daizhou (Shanxi), lay surname Bian, born 1608. He would not eat meat as a child and liked to sit still; he was tonsured barely past ten and travelled widely. He took full precepts from Miyun Yuanwu at Tiantong and had his first opening at the sound of a rockfall. He then went to Feiyin Tongrong and received his dharma. In 1661 he was installed at the Xuanfochang at Kunshan near Suzhou at the invitation of the Bordered Yellow Banner general Li and the local gentry; he later held Weimo monastery at Changshu. He died in the winter of 1678, aged seventy-one, after sixty-one years in robes, and his stupa stands at Weimo. Over twenty heirs are recorded.

steles.title: 性空臻禪師語錄卷六〈塔銘〉
steles.author_note: Appended to his own record.
steles.quote: 康熙十七年冬，壽七十一。… 塔在常熟縣之西維摩寺。
steles.note: Source of his death and burial place.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，太白山前腳跟點地，語溪橋畔得路還家，專為先住天童、後住徑山，傳臨濟正宗第三十一世上費下隱容老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS: 費隱通容, 31st generation Linji, formerly of Tiantong, later of Jingshan. CONFIRMS bio_5 exactly.

teacher.quote: 字性空，為費隱通容禪師（1593-1661）法嗣…後謁費隱和尚，得付法。

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 康熙十七年冬，壽七十一。（《性空臻禪師語錄》卷 6〈塔銘〉）
dates.note: 1608 – 1678. NEW: bio_5 had only floruit 1661.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十一世

bio.quote: 順治辛丑年，欽命正黃旗將軍李公，同銓部李瑤圃、司理葉嵋初、太史徐彥禾，暨闔邑紳衿，請就本院開堂。
bio.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's note: he took the Xuanfochang at Kunshan in 1661 (順治辛丑) at the invitation of the Bordered Yellow Banner general Li. A nice trace of Manchu patronage of Chan.

links.label: DILA Authority A016222
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔銘

bio: From Changguo in Ming prefecture, lay surname Li, born 1242. Small of body and fierce of temper. He was tonsured by Zhiweng Deju and went to the bottom of the Caodong teaching under him. He held Shimen at Cixi, Xiangshan, Zhimen and Tianning, and finally Tiantong, where students came from Korea and Japan. He wrote the Baojing sanmei xuanyi. He died in 1324, aged eighty-three, after sixty-five years in robes.

steles.title: 天童雲外禪師傳
steles.author: 雪竇山無印 (無印大證)
steles.author_note: His own dharma heir — DILA names 雪竇大證 as his one heir. Prefixed to his 語錄.
steles.quote: 師諱雲岫，字雲外，別號方嵓，俗姓李氏。世為明之昌國人。生而身裁眇少，精悍有餘。師事直翁舉公剃落，究明曹洞宗旨，盡其源底…分洞上一宗之傳獨賴之。三韓、日本諸師亦嚮風趨慕，四方訪參者無虗日。
steles.note: An heir's biography, naming the teacher. NOT a 塔銘 — see the correction below.

teacher.kind: 傳 by his heir 無印
teacher.quote: 師事直翁舉公剃落，究明曹洞宗旨，盡其源底。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's 直翁德舉. NOTE the sources vary the middle character: the 傳 and DILA's prose write 直翁可舉, DILA's relation writes 德舉. Same man.

teacher.quote: 從直翁德舉得度，並嗣其法。

dates.quote: 泰定元年示寂，世壽八十三，法臘六十五。
dates.note: 1324, aged 83 → birth 1242. NEW: bio_5 had no dates.

school.quote: 究明曹洞宗旨…分洞上一宗之傳獨賴之

bio: From Lingling in southern Chu, lay surname Tang, born 1625; the youngest of four sons, orphaned early. He slipped away at thirteen to be tonsured by the master Hongren at Dading hermitage, took the seven-piece robe from the Venerable Wuxue the next year, and studied vinaya and the sutras. He found no connection with Shanci Ji at Nanyue; at Xishan he served Suigu Yuan for years and had his opening there, blowing on a dying cooking-fire that flared through the whole hermitage. But it was Baizhang Jingle who gave him the dharma, in 1647, after testing him on the Five Ranks. He opened Yishan in 1655 and moved to Xiangshan in Quanzhou. He died in 1688, aged sixty-three.

steles.title: 疑山握中符禪師塔銘
steles.author_note: ⚠ IT IS IN HIS HEIR'S RECORD, NOT HIS OWN — the 逕庭宗禪師語錄 (J40nB475), the 語錄 of his disciple 逕庭德宗. This is precisely the pattern the brief warns about, and it is why this stele had gone unmined.
steles.quote: 禪師諱智符，字握中，別號疑山，楚南零陵人也…乃潛往大定菴，禮弘忍師剃落，時年十有三矣。次年秋，值無學和尚於本菴開戒，遂授以七條…乃造南嶽，謁山茨際，不契。復往西山，參邃谷源…丁亥冬，丈命呈行腳，復以五位綱宗一一徵驗，師立為頌出，丈乃喜曰：「見地清白，機用超群，堪為當家種艸。」遂以大法囑之，為洞宗三十世。
steles.note: The single most important document in this batch. It lays out FOUR different relationships and keeps them distinct — and the old roster collapsed them.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 (in his heir's 語錄)
teacher.quote: 丈乃喜曰：「見地清白，機用超群，堪為當家種艸。」遂以大法囑之，為洞宗三十世。
teacher.note: ⚠⚠ THE TEACHER IS 百丈淨泐 (丈), NOT 邃谷源. This is decisive: 以大法囑之 — 'entrusted him with the Great Dharma' — and made him the 30th generation of the Caodong house. bio_5 named 邃谷源 and this is WRONG, and wrong in exactly the systematic way the audit identified.

teacher.quote: 復往西山，參邃谷源…師遂服勤隨侍焉。及源歸西山，授師滿分尸羅
teacher.note: What 邃谷源 actually gave him: he SERVED him (服勤隨侍) and received FULL PRECEPTS (滿分尸羅) from him. Ordination and long association — NOT transmission. Mistaking this for transmission is the error.

teacher.quote: 禮弘忍師剃落…次年秋，值無學和尚於本菴開戒，遂授以七條
teacher.note: And the other two: 弘忍 tonsured him; 無學 gave him the precepts robe. FOUR men, ONE of whom is the teacher.

teacher.kind: authority record quoting the 塔銘
teacher.quote: 為百丈泐禪師法嗣
teacher.note: DILA reads the stele the same way I do.

teacher.quote: 淨泐 / 百丈淨泐 / 石澗淨泐 … 瑞白明雪弟子。曹洞宗。
teacher.note: Identifies the man: 百丈淨泐 (d.1709), a Caodong heir of 瑞白明雪 — WHO IS ALSO IN THIS BATCH. The chain closes: 湛然圓澄 → 瑞白明雪 → 百丈淨泐 → 握中智符.

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 師生于明天啟乙丑二月二十四日，世壽六十三。… 康熙戊辰十月…黎明，端坐而逝。

school.note: Caodong, 30th generation — CONFIRMS bio_5's school. Independent check: 智朴, heir of 百愚淨斯 (another 瑞白明雪 heir, also in this batch), is likewise called 洞宗三十世 in B27n0151 lb 0457b20. The generation arithmetic works only if 智符's teacher is a 淨-generation master — i.e. 淨泐, not 邃谷源.

links.label: DILA Authority A027430
links.confirms: identifies 百丈淨泐, heir of 瑞白明雪

bio: Linji master, a man of Nankang; dharma heir of Xuzhou Pudu. He was abbot of Lingyin in the early Yuan, was summoned to an imperial audience, and was granted the title Foguang Haiyin dashi ('Great Master Buddha-Light Ocean-Seal') on returning. His verses are said to have come out of his mouth already finished, as though composed beforehand. He compiled his master's recorded sayings. His heir was Tanfang Shouzhong of Jiangshan (Longxiang), through whom the line continues.

teacher.quote: 徑山虗舟度禪師法嗣……靈隱玉山德珍禪師
teacher.note: 增集續傳燈錄 — teacher 虛舟普度 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 玉山德珍禪師，臨濟宗，南康人，嗣虛舟度。元初住靈隱，奉旨入覲，賜號「佛光海印大師」以歸。偈頌脫口，宛如宿成。
teacher.note: 🔑 THE 'LAMP BLACK HOLE' IS FILLED - AND NOT BY AN EDITOR SIGNAL. A temple gazetteer gives him an actual BIOGRAPHY: Linji school, a man of Nankang, HEIR OF XUZHOU PUDU (嗣虛舟度), abbot of Lingyin in the early Yuan, imperial audience, imperial title. This is independent of both the lamps and the editorship.

teacher.kind: 行業記 of his HEIR 曇芳守忠
teacher.quote: 師諱守忠，字曇芳，以至元乙亥十月一日生南康都昌黃氏。九歲，志求出家，母弗許…於是從玉山珍禪師于雲居。十二祝髮，既受具，出游方
teacher.note: The account-of-deeds of his DHARMA HEIR places the boy Shouzhong with 玉山珍 at Yunju. Corroborates the man's existence and his teaching seat from below, at stele rung.

teacher.quote: 徑山度禪師法嗣：玉山德珍禪師不列章次，徑山淨伏禪師
teacher.note: Filed under Xuzhou Pudu's (徑山度) heirs in FIVE lamps - X80n1566, X83n1574 0737a01, X84n1582 0470a07, X84n1584 0010a17, X86n1605 0709a03 - each marked 不列章次 / 無傳 / 無錄 ('no chapter', 'no biography', 'no record'). They know he is Pudu's heir; they simply have nothing to say about him.

teacher.quote: 曾編《虛舟普度禪師語錄》。worksInTripitaka: 虛舟普度禪師語錄(X1407)
teacher.note: ⚠ THE EDITOR TRAP, NAMED AND DISARMED. DILA's ONLY note on him is that he EDITED his master's record - and the coordinator flags 玉山德珍 as one of three men bitten by exactly this false signal. Editing is NOT transmission. But in this case the edge does not rest on the editorship at all: it is independently carried by a gazetteer bio, five lamp indexes, and his heir's 行業記. The edge STANDS - for reasons other than the one DILA gives.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 增集續傳燈錄
teacher.quote: 徑山虗舟度禪師法嗣……靈隱玉山德珍禪師 (X83n1574_p0263a11)
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5. IMPORTANT: this is a flat 法嗣 index entry, INDEPENDENT of the fact that he also edited Xuzhou Pudu's 語錄 — so this is NOT an editor-trap case. The transmission is attested on its own.

dates.note: NO DATES IN ANY SOURCE. DILA carries none.

school.quote: 元 / 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 曾編《虛舟普度禪師語錄》。
bio.note: This is the ENTIRE DILA record. bio_5 called him 'a genuine lamp black hole' — appearing in five lamp records ONLY as the section heading over his single heir. DILA adds exactly two facts: his dharma name (德珍) and that he was at Lingyin. He remains very nearly a name.

links.label: DILA Authority A001674
links.confirms: dharma name 德珍, teacher, Lingyin

bio: From Dongguan in Kuaiji, lay surname Xia, born 1561. His family was destitute after his parents died and he served as a postal runner; having misdelivered a dispatch and facing arrest, he fled to Yinfeng, who gave him 'who is it that recites the Buddha's name?' — and he had his first opening in three days and nights, aged twenty. Tonsured at Tianhuang, ordained at Yunqi, he sealed himself in retreat at Baolin and broke through on Qianfeng's 'raise one, not two'. Cizhou Fangnian, come south from Beijing, confirmed him. He opened the dharma at Yunmen Guangxiao in 1614, then held Jingshan, Dongta and Yunmen Xiansheng. He died in 1627, aged sixty-six. He revived the Caodong house in Zhejiang; six heirs, including Ruibai Mingxue (also in this batch). He wrote the Kaigu lu and the Zongmen huowen.

steles.title: 會稽雲門湛然澄禪師塔銘
steles.author_note: In his own 語錄, 卷8 (X72n1444). The record was edited by 丁元公 and 祁駿佳, both laymen.
steles.quote: 嘉靖辛酉八月五日 … 天啟丙寅十二月四日示寂，享年六十六
steles.note: Source of both his dates. His 語錄 卷8 carries the 塔銘 and a 行狀.

teacher.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
teacher.quote: 大覺慈舟方念禪師法嗣…慈舟念禪師自北京來說法，止風塗。師以所悟求證，呈偈相印可。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5. Note the sequence the source preserves: 妙峰 tonsured him, 雲棲袾宏 ordained him, 隱峰 gave him his first koan — and 慈舟方念 SEALED him. Only the last is the teacher.

dates.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘
dates.quote: 嘉靖辛酉八月五日 … 天啟丙寅十二月四日示寂，享年六十六
dates.note: 1561-09-23 – 1627-01-20. NEW: bio_5 had neither date.

bio.kind: authority record citing the 塔銘 + 五燈會元續略
bio.quote: 親沒窶甚，充郵卒，因錯投公牒被攝。懼辱走投隱峰，峰示「念佛是誰？」三日夜有省，時年二十矣。
bio.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's 'both of his dangling heirs': DILA names six heirs — 明懷、明盂、明方、明澓、明有、明雪 — including BOTH 瑞白明雪 and 三宜明盂.

links.label: DILA Authority A005648
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔銘, the six heirs

bio: From Lishui in Chuzhou, lay surname Wu, born 1304. Tonsured at fifteen at Chanzhi monastery under Kongzhong Jia, he practised sitting so hard he went three years without sleeping through a night. He wandered Fujian and found no one; back home he rebuilt the old Fulin cloister on Mount Baiyun and read the Surangama and the Yuanjue. He got nowhere with Lingshi at Jingci or Duanya at Xifeng — but hearing that Wujian Xiandu was teaching on Huading he went, and 'at one sight cut out his own heart', serving him for years. He returned to Fulin in 1354 and later held Puci, Maoshan and Wufeng. Summoned by the Hongwu emperor in 1369 to the great assembly at Jiangshan, he went. He died in 1370, aged sixty-seven; his cremation yielded five-coloured relics.

steles.title: 處州福林院白雲禪師度公塔銘
steles.author: 宋濂 (Song Lian)
steles.quote: 銘曰：華頂之峰，有道所居…我福林師，聞風而起，當機一喝，兩耳為聾…葉落歸根，古今一軌，塵緣既盡，翛然而化。擲筆坐脫，如人赴家。世相有滅，其性常在，若謂師亡，青山可改。
steles.note: In 宋文憲公護法錄 (J21nB110), Song Lian's collected Buddhist prose — exactly the 'stele sits in a literatus's collected works' case the brief flags. His 語錄 is also referenced (X81n1570 lists 福林白雲智度 under 華頂覩).
steles.author_note: Song Lian 宋濂 (1310-1381), Ming founding scholar.

teacher.kind: 宋濂 (Song Lian), 處州福林院白雲禪師度公塔銘 — a named literatus's stele
teacher.quote: 時無見睹公說法天台華頂峰，大振圓悟之道。師復踰濤江，往拜之，問曰：西來密意未審何如？無見曰：待娑羅峰點頭，卻與汝言。師以手搖曳欲答，無見遽喝…服勤數載…無見囑之曰：昔南嶽十五歲出家，受大鑒記莂，後得馬祖授之以心法…須真正見解，著於行履，方為報佛之深恩耳。師佩服之，弗敢忘。
teacher.note: 服勤數載 + 囑之 (entrusted/charged him) under 無見先睹 at Huading. Wujian's own words invoke the Nanyue→Mazu 心法 transmission as the model. This is a full STELE by Song Lian, the pre-eminent scholar of the early Ming.

teacher.quote: 世之知師者，孰不曰無見有子而方山有孫者乎？…自圓悟八傳，至於無見，究其所得所證，何莫不由於此也。
teacher.note: 'A son to Wujian and a grandson to Fangshan' — Fangshan 方山 = 方山文寶, Wujian's teacher. The whole descent from Yuanwu spelled out.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 五燈全書
teacher.quote: 華頂覩禪師法嗣 福林白雲智度禪師 (X81n1570_p0380b09)
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 補續高僧傳/釋鑑稽古略續集
teacher.quote: 聞無見覩說法華頂，往叩之，一見刳心焉，服勤數載，盡揭底蘊。
teacher.note: Note the source is careful: 空中假公 tonsured him, 靈石芝 and 斷崖義 did NOT connect (俱不契) — only 無見先覩 took. The distinction is preserved.

dates.kind: authority record citing 新續高僧傳
dates.quote: 洪武庚戌三月一日也，壽六十七，臘五十二 (B27n0151, p. 160, a17-18)
dates.note: 1370-04-05, aged 67 → birth 1304. NEW: bio_5 had only floruit 1369.

bio.quote: 明高帝洪武己酉詔徵天下高僧，建法會于蔣山。師應詔…闍維得五色舍利，塔於院之西。
bio.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's summons to court in 1369 (洪武己酉).

bio: From Songling in Wujiang, lay surname Yu, born 1604 into a bookish family — his father owned a cartload of books. Passing a mountain temple at sixteen he saw the Surangama and was troubled by it; he went to Tianyin Yuanxiu at Qingshan, who gave him 'your face before your parents were born'. He was tonsured at twenty-four at Li'an under Foshi, went to Miyun Yuanwu at Jinsu — 'fire-snakes burned my face, my bones and hair went cold' — and returned to Qingshan, where he awakened one night in a gale on the cliff. He held Li'an at Nanjian for ten years, and Zhulin, Longyou and Guloutze. He died in 1655 at Yingtian monastery in Wujiang, aged fifty-two. He compiled the Xudeng cungao. A dharma-brother of Yulin Tongxiu, the Shunzhi emperor's teacher.

steles.title: 南澗箬菴問禪師塔銘
steles.author: 木陳道忞
steles.author_note: ⚠ IT IS NOT IN HIS OWN RECORD — it is in Muchen Daomin's 布水臺集 (J26nB181), i.e. in ANOTHER MASTER's collection entirely. Muchen says so himself: his disciples came to Tiantong in 1657 to beg an inscription. Muchen Daomin is also on this roster.
steles.quote: 順治十三年乙未之歲，箬菴問禪師解夏磬山預告逝期。至年秋二十七日，蛻化于吳江之應天寺，世壽五十二，坐二十九夏…其門人曉菴輩來天童丐銘住山僧道忞…年方弱冠，遊神道涯；偶閱楞嚴，思益超遐。孰牖我明？燦發心葩；長跽磬山，乞敲鎖枷。
steles.note: Written in rhymed couplets, numbered. 長跽磬山 — 'kneeling long at Qingshan' — is the teacher, named by his seat.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 by 木陳道忞
teacher.quote: 長跽磬山，乞敲鎖枷。山為徵詰，疑情愈加…磬山仍陟，文殊復參；豁爾開覺，風聲指南。
teacher.note: 磬山 = 天隱圓修's seat. The stele has him going to Qingshan twice, the second time awakening. CONFIRMS bio_5.

teacher.quote: 為天隱圓修禪師（1575-1635）法嗣…復歸磬山圓修。一夕聞大風迸崖而悟。

dates.kind: authority record citing 宗統編年 + the 塔銘
dates.quote: 順治乙未十二年九月二十七日，世壽五十二。
dates.note: 1604 – 1655-10-26. ⚠ bio_5 said 'Corpus gives no birth/death year, so both left null' — BOTH ARE NOW RECOVERED. Note a slip in the stele itself: it writes 順治十三年乙未, but 乙未 is 順治TWELVE (1655). DILA reads 1655 and so do I.

bio.quote: 著《五會語錄》、《磬室後錄》、《續燈存稿》。
bio.note: CONFIRMS bio_5: he compiled the 續燈存稿 (X84n1579).

links.label: DILA Authority A013268
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, the 塔銘

bio: From Hanzhou in Shu (Chengdu prefecture); dharma heir of Eryang Yuanqin. He died in 1534. His heir was Jingshan Huaibao of Zhugong.

teacher.kind: transmission-genealogy in 吹萬廣真's work
teacher.quote: …顯傳西京小菴行密，密傳二仰圓欽，欽傳壽州無念智有，有傳荊山懷寶，寶傳秦嶺鐵牛德遠…真傳忠州治平慶忠鐵壁[慧機]。
teacher.note: 欽傳壽州無念智有 — 二仰圓欽 → 無念智有 stated as a link in the house's own genealogy. Upgrades the roster's DILA line to a primary corpus source.

teacher.quote: 蜀之漢州人，為二仰圓欽法嗣（X63n1244_p0497a24）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS bio_5's 二仰欽 — and gives the dharma name: 圓欽 (二仰圓欽).

dates.kind: authority record citing 續燈正統
dates.note: Death 1534. NEW: bio_5 had none.

school.note: NEW: bio_5 had Linji but no source.

bio.quote: 荊山懷寶禪師，渚宮人。為無念有法嗣。（X84n1583_p0498a20）
bio.note: Attested from the heir's side.

links.label: DILA Authority A019849
links.confirms: dharma name 智有, teacher 圓欽, death 1534

bio: Second patriarch of Chan. Lay surname Ji; from Hulao. He left home under Baojing at Xiangshan, Longmen (Luoyang), took full ordination at Yongmu temple, and studied Confucian and Daoist learning before turning to Chan. DILA places his meeting with Bodhidharma at Shaolin in 520 and six years of study under him; in 552 he transmitted the dharma to Sengcan, then taught the meaning of the Lankavatara in Ye for over thirty years, keeping himself deliberately obscure. The famous severed-arm story is legend, not something I could source to an early witness.

teacher.kind: 續高僧傳 卷16 (道宣, completed 645) — his own 傳; the earliest biography of Huike that exists, ~50 years after his death and four centuries before any lamp
teacher.quote: 釋僧可，一名慧可，俗姓姬氏，虎牢人…年登四十，遇天竺沙門菩提達摩遊化嵩洛。可懷寶知道，一見悅之，奉以為師，畢命承旨，從學六載，精究一乘。
teacher.note: 奉以為師，畢命承旨 — took him as master and followed his instruction to the end of his life; six years of study. Note what is ABSENT even here: no robe, no 付法, no verse, no severed arm (Daoxuan says elsewhere his arm was cut off BY BANDITS). The famous transmission-drama is all later.

teacher.kind: the same book's 菩提達摩傳 — written from the record kept by Bodhidharma's OWN CIRCLE (the 二入四行 treatise, 「錄其言誥，卷流于世」)
teacher.quote: 有道育、慧可，此二沙門，年雖在後而銳志高遠。初逢法將，知道有歸，尋親事之，經四五載，給供諮接，感其精誠，誨以真法。如是安心謂壁觀也。
teacher.note: From the teacher's side, and from the teacher's own circle's document: Bodhidharma had exactly TWO close disciples, 道育 and 慧可, who served him four or five years and were then 誨以真法. This is as close to the event as the record ever gets — the text Daoxuan is reproducing is the treatise that Bodhidharma's own disciples wrote down.

teacher.quote: 北魏正光元年（520）參謁達磨祖師於嵩山少林寺，從學六年。達磨西歸後，師於北齊天保三年（552）授法予弟子僧璨
teacher.note: DILA's concise bio, citing 佛光:6023, 疑年錄:42, T50n2060_p0551c27 (續高僧傳).

dates.quote: 卒於：隋, 文帝, 開皇, 十三年, 三月, 十六日，107歲 / death +0593-04-24 時年一百七歲
dates.note: Death 593 (Kaihuang 13, 3rd month, 16th day), aged 107; birth 487 back-calculated (依記錄推算). Cites T49n2037_p0803b05.

school.quote: sect: 禪宗；俗姓姬，禪宗二祖

bio.quote: 幼時於洛陽龍門香山依寶靜出家，於永穆寺受具足戒。早年周遊聽講，精研孔老之學與玄理

notes: Second Patriarch. Famous for cutting off his arm to demonstrate sincerity to Bodhidharma.

bio: Sichuan Chan master, lay surname Tang (the Song gaoseng zhuan gives Zhou instead). Orphaned of his father at ten. He served Zhishen, and is the second link in the Jingzhong (Sichuan) line: Zizhou Zhishen - Zizhou Chuji - Yizhou Wuxiang - Baotang Wuzhu. He is said to have gone north to practise austerities and to have been summoned by Empress Wu, who gave him a kasaya. Mazu Daoyi is recorded as having been tonsured under him at Zizhou.

teacher.kind: 曆代法寶記 (c. 774) — the Baotang school's own lineage record
teacher.quote: 長安二年六日，命處寂扶侍吾，遂付袈裟云：此衣是達摩祖師所傳袈裟，則天賜吾，吾今付汝，善自保愛。至其年七月六日夜，奄然坐化，時年九十四。處寂禪師，綿州浮城縣人也，俗姓唐
teacher.note: THE TRANSMISSION ITSELF. 智詵, dying in 長安二年 (702), calls Chuji to attend him and 付袈裟 — HANDS OVER THE ROBE — with the words 吾今付汝 ('I now entrust it to you'). 付 is the transmission verb. The Lidai fabao ji was compiled c. 774, roughly forty years after Chuji's death (734), by the school that descends directly from him (智詵→處寂→無相→無住). The nearest surviving witness by three centuries.

teacher.quote: 不言是詵和上、唐和上所說 … 緣詵和上、唐和上不說了教
teacher.note: 詵和上 (Zhishen) and 唐和上 (Chuji, so called from his lay surname 唐) are paired throughout as the two successive ancestors of the house.

teacher.quote: 出家後，師事智詵；或謂師事寶修禪師…淨眾宗由資州智詵-資州處寂-益州無相-保唐無住
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the roster teacher (Zhishen). DILA records a DISSENTING tradition that he served 寶修 instead; it does not adopt it. Cites 宋僧索引:150, 佛光:4347/4783, 疑年錄:108.

dates.quote: death +0734-02-13 ~ +0734-03-13 開元二十二年正月示滅。享年八十七。（T50n2061_p0836b28）或開元二十年……五月二十七日……坐化。處寂大師時年六十八。（T51n2075_p0184c10）
dates.note: SOURCES DISAGREE. 宋高僧傳 (T50n2061): died 734, aged 87 -> b.648. 歷代法寶記 (T51n2075): died 732, aged 68 -> b.665. I take 734/87 (DILA's own choice, birth 648). The roster's 'floruit 669, death 736' matches NEITHER witness.

school.quote: sect: 禪宗；淨眾宗由資州智詵-資州處寂-益州無相-保唐無住

bio.quote: 俗姓唐，《宋高僧傳》另載為姓周。十歲喪父…資州山北蘭若僧人，釋道一（709-788）依資州唐和尚（即處寂）剃染。弟子有淨眾寺無相

notes: Received patriarchal robe from Zhishen in 702. Key link in the Sichuan Chan lineage recorded in the Lidai fabao ji.

bio: Lay surname Zhang, from Dongyang. He was certified by Jingshan Guoyi (Daoqin), then studied with Mazu Daoyi and Shitou Xiqian, and settled on Mt Ziyun at Dangyang in Jingzhou before being invited to Tianhuang monastery in Jingzhou, whose 'Tianhuang house style' is named for him. His heir was Longtan Chongxin, whose heir was Deshan Xuanjian - so the Yunmen and Fayan houses descend through him.

steles.title: 天皇道悟塔記 (符載撰) / 天王道悟塔記 (丘玄素撰)
steles.author: 符載 / 丘玄素
steles.author_note: TWO rival Tang stupa-records, at the heart of the most famous lineage forgery dispute in Chan.
steles.quote: 道悟似有兩人。無盡居士後於達觀頴禪師處。得唐符載所撰天皇道悟塔記。又討得丘玄素所作天王道悟塔記。
steles.note: NOT a stele I can hand to him cleanly. 符載's 塔記 makes 天皇道悟 Shitou's heir; 丘玄素's makes 天王道悟 Mazu's heir. Zhang Shangying used the pair to argue Deshan/Dongshan split. Later critics (J33nB294 0782c09) call the whole thing 「瞞天造謊」 - a fabrication - noting 達觀穎 died ~60-70 years before 覺範/無盡 could have got both carvings from him.

steles.title: 天皇道悟碑銘
steles.author: 符載 (太常協律, Tang)
steles.quote: 時太常協律符載著文頌德焉
steles.note: Named in SGSZ; the stele text itself survives only via 佛祖歷代通載.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 唐荊州天皇寺道悟傳 (988, Zanning — built on 符載's Tang stele, which the bio names)
teacher.quote: 遂蹶然振策，投徑山國一禪師。悟禮足始畢，密受宗要…斷諸疑滯，無畏自在，直見佛性，中無緇磷。服勤五載，隨亦印可，俾其法雨潤諸叢林。
teacher.note: ⚠ The ONLY 印可 in the earliest biography belongs to 徑山國一 (= 徑山法欽/道欽, 714-792, Niutou line) — after five years of service (服勤五載). This is the exact verb the tradition reserves for transmission.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳, same bio, continued
teacher.quote: 故重有諮訪，會其真宗。建中初，詣鍾陵馬大師；二年秋，謁石頭上士。於戲！自徑山抵衡嶽凡三遇哲匠矣。至此即造父習御，郢人運斤，兩虛其心，相與冥合。
teacher.note: Mazu is a 詣 (a call) and Shitou a 謁 (a visit). The text says he met THREE masters (凡三遇哲匠) and 'converged' (冥合) with Shitou — it never says 嗣法/付法/印可 of Shitou. The lamps' flat assignment 嗣石頭 is not what the earliest source says.

teacher.quote: 比丘慧真、文賁等，禪子幽閑，皆入室得悟之者…時太常協律符載著文頌德焉。世號天皇門風也。
teacher.note: 符載 (太常協律) wrote his encomium — the Tang stele Zanning worked from. His in-room heirs are named as 慧真、文賁、幽閑 — 崇信 appears in SGSZ only as an附見 cake-seller devotee.

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 (952) — the earliest lamp, confessing its own ignorance
teacher.quote: 天皇和尚嗣石頭，在荊南。師諱道悟，未睹行狀，不決終始之要。
teacher.note: The lamp that asserts 嗣石頭 ADMITS in the same breath that it never saw his 行狀 (未睹行狀) and therefore cannot settle the details. That is the lamp confessing it is guessing.

teacher.kind: 五燈嚴統解惑編 (費隱通容) — the two-stele dossier
teacher.quote: 唐正議大夫戶部侍郎平章事荊南節度使丘公玄素為天王悟撰碑銘，出北藏佛祖通載。唐恊律郎符公載所撰天皇悟碑銘，亦佛祖通載所出也。
teacher.note: The Ming/Qing 天王 vs 天皇 war: a Linji-side partisan produced 丘玄素's 天王道悟碑 to move 龍潭崇信 (and therefore 德山→雪峰→雲門/法眼) out of the Shitou line into Mazu's. Both 'steles' are transmitted only through 佛祖歷代通載 — neither survives on stone. This is a documented forgery-grade dispute; do not treat either as clean evidence.

teacher.quote: 天皇和尚嗣石頭，在荊南。師諱道悟，未睹行狀，不決終始之要。
teacher.note: EARLIEST witness (Zutangji, 952): 'Tianhuang inherited from Shitou.' It states outright that it has NOT seen a 行狀 for him.

teacher.quote: 今以二碑參合。則應以天皇道悟嗣石頭。以慧真．文責．幽閑嗣之。而於馬祖法嗣下增入天王道悟。以龍潭．崇信嗣之。
teacher.note: The 'two-men' resolution: 天皇道悟 (Shitou's heir) and 天王道悟 (Mazu's heir) are DIFFERENT men. This is the settlement most lamps adopt.

teacher.quote: 參謁徑山國一，而蒙印可。後參訪馬祖道一、石頭希遷，盡得玄旨
teacher.note: DILA sect: 石頭宗, but has him CERTIFIED (印可) by Jingshan Guoyi first, then visiting both Mazu and Shitou.

dates.quote: death +0807-06-13 元和丁亥歲有背痛疾…以夏四月晦奄然入滅。春秋六十。僧臘三十五。（T50n2061_p0769c18）
dates.note: Died 807 aged 60 -> b.748. NOTE the rival 天王道悟 is given d.818 aged 82 (b.737) at B24n0137 0454a25 - different dates for the 'other' man.

bio.quote: 師初問石頭：「離卻智慧，何法示人？」

notes: Student Longtan transmitted line that produced Deshan Xuanjian.

bio: Lay surname Du, from Shangluo; a monk of Kaiyuan temple in Fenzhou. At nine he entered Kaiyuan temple under Zhiben, who taught him the Diamond, Lotus, Vimalakirti, Siyi and Huayan sutras - he is said to have read five lines at a glance and forgotten nothing. Fully ordained at twenty under Vinaya master You in Xiangzhou. Hearing that Mazu (Daji) was foremost in the Chan gate, he went to pay respects and became his heir. Emperor Xianzong summoned him to the palace; he pleaded illness and did not go. He died in 822, aged 62, telling his disciples that the nature of seeing, hearing and knowing is coeval with empty space.

steles.kind: 碑頌 (LOST — attested but not recovered)
steles.title: a 碑頌 for 無業
steles.author: 州牧 楊潛 (prefect Yang Qian), from an account given by the monk-registrar 靈準
steles.quote: 業遷化之歲，州牧楊潛得僧錄準公具述其事，遂為碑頌。
steles.note: NOT RECOVERED. Recorded so the next hunter knows it exists and where it was reported.

teacher.kind: biography (compiled from the stele — see below)
teacher.quote: 後聞洪州大寂，禪門之上首，特往瞻禮。…大寂曰：「只未了底心即是，別物更無。…亦猶手作拳，拳全手也。」業言下豁然開悟…業既傳心印，尋詣曹溪禮祖塔
teacher.note: 業既傳心印 — 'Wuye having received the transmission of the mind-seal'. 傳心 is on the transmission list. The dialogue itself is given at length and the awakening is unambiguous. 大寂 = Mazu Daoyi's posthumous title.

teacher.quote: 後聞洪州大寂，禪門之上首，特往瞻禮
teacher.note: 洪州大寂 = Mazu Daoyi. CONFIRMS roster. Cites 祖堂集:292, 疑年錄:150, T50n2061_p0773a27.

teacher.quote: 洪州百丈惟政禪師 洪州泐潭法會禪師 … 池州魯祖寶雲禪師
teacher.note: 汾州無業 appears in the same Mazu heir-list block; cf. X66n1297 0005a01 「大達無業二則」 listed among Mazu's heirs.

dates.quote: 壬寅長慶二年三月…言訖端坐。至中夜而逝。年六十二。（T49n2037_p0835b26）
dates.note: Died Changqing 2 (822), 3rd month, aged 62 -> b.761. Roster's 'death 823' is off by one; roster 'floruit 760' is really near his birth.

bio.quote: 姓杜氏，汾州開元寺僧人。年至九歲，啟白父母，依止本郡開元寺志本禪師…年二十受具足戒於襄州幽律師

notes: Known for his teaching that the three poisons are themselves the three disciplines.

bio: Master of Hangzhou; dharma heir of Damei Fachang, and thus in Mazu's line. The Zutangji says flatly that no account of his conduct was available even in 952. He is remembered as the teacher of Juzhi, to whom he transmitted the one-finger Chan.

teacher.quote: 天龍和尚嗣大梅。未睹行錄，不決化緣始終。
teacher.note: 嗣大梅 = inherited 大梅法常. The same sentence admits his life is unrecorded — an unusually honest lamp.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 — 大梅山法常禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 明州大梅山法常禪師法嗣三人：…天龍和尚已上二人見錄
teacher.note: Listed among 大梅法常's heirs.

teacher.quote: 大梅常禪師法嗣，住杭州。（祖堂集：323；X80n1564_p0004c18）
teacher.note: 大梅法常 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 天龍和尚嗣大梅。未睹行錄，不決化緣始終。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster: 'Tianlong inherited from Damei.' The same sentence admits no record of his life survived even in 952 - which is why his dates are empty.

teacher.quote: 大梅常禪師法嗣，住杭州。（祖堂集：323；X80n1564_p0004c18）

bio.quote: 天龍和尚嗣大梅。未睹行錄，不決化緣始終。

notes: Dharma heir of Damei Fachang in the Mazu lineage. Teacher of Juzhi, to whom he transmitted the one-finger Chan teaching.

bio: Master of Mt Luzu in Chizhou; a dharma heir of MAZU DAOYI. He is famous for one gesture: whenever a monk came to see him, he simply turned and faced the wall. Nanquan Puyuan - his fellow-student, not his teacher - said of it: 'I keep telling monks to realise it before the Buddha ever appeared in the world, and still not one or half a one gets it. At that rate he will go on till the year of the donkey.' Dongshan Liangjie came to him, bowed, stood a while, went out, and came back in; Luzu said, 'Just so, just so - that is why it is like this.'

teacher.quote: 懷讓禪師第二世中四十五人馬祖法嗣…池州魯祖山寶雲禪師
teacher.note: 景德傳燈錄 — teacher 馬祖道一 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 池州魯祖寶雲禪師 馬祖一嗣
teacher.note: corroborates

teacher.quote: 懷讓禪師第二世中四十五人馬祖法嗣… 池州魯祖山寶雲禪師
teacher.note: CONTRADICTS THE ROSTER. He is filed under 馬祖法嗣 - Mazu's heirs - in the Jingde chuandeng lu itself.

teacher.kind: 拈古 collection, inline lineage tag
teacher.quote: 池州魯祖寶雲禪師 馬祖一嗣
teacher.note: Explicit tag: 'heir of Mazu Yi.' Same tag at X66n1296 0637a04 「南二馬祖一嗣」.

teacher.quote: 池州魯祖山寶雲禪師嗣馬祖
池州魯祖山寶雲禪師嗣馬祖
中唐時代禪僧。生卒年不詳。為馬祖道一之法嗣。以池州魯祖山（安徽貴池）為開山演法之地
teacher.note: sect: 洪州宗. Note 生卒年不詳 - dates unknown.

bio.quote: 洞山來參禮拜後侍立少頃而出。却再入來。師云。只恁麼只恁麼
池州魯祖山寶雲禪師。凡見僧來。便面壁。自達磨九年之後。無人再行此令…南泉是他同參。
bio.note: THE SMOKING GUN: 「南泉是他同參」 - 'Nanquan was his FELLOW-STUDENT.' Both were Mazu's heirs.

notes: Known for sitting facing the wall when visitors came.

bio: Lay surname Zhou, from Chanzhou. He left home at Kaiyuan temple in Youzhou and took full ordination at the proper age, then entered the room of Nanquan Puyuan. He came to Mt Mati in Quzhou and lived in a thatched hut; a local man, Weng Qiangui, gave land below Zihu crag and a cloister was built there. He died in the Guangming era without illness, and a stupa was raised on his own mountain. He is remembered for the sign at his gate - 'Beware of the dog!' - and for setting it on visitors.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 biography, under 南泉普願禪師法嗣 (heir-list at lb 0273b06)
teacher.quote: 衢州子湖巖利蹤禪師，澶州人也，姓周氏。幽州開元寺出家，依年受具，後入南泉之室。乃抵于衢州之馬蹄山結茅宴居。唐開成二年邑人翁遷貴施山下子湖創院，咸通二年勅賜額曰安國禪院。
teacher.note: 入南泉之室 — 'entered Nanquan's room', the idiom for becoming his intimate disciple. Listed among Nanquan's heirs at 0273b06, beside 趙州從諗.

teacher.quote: 幽州開元寺出家，依年受具，後入南泉之室
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. 「入南泉之室」 - entered Nanquan's room, the idiom for becoming his heir. Cites 祖堂集:337, 疑年錄:158, X80n1565_p0096c11.

dates.note: Died Guangming 1 (880) aged 81 -> b.800. Roster's 800/880 CONFIRMED.

bio.quote: 澶州人，姓周，衢州子湖巖僧人…唐開元二年。邑人翁遷貴施山下子湖創院。廣明中。無疾歸究。塔于本山。

notes: Known for the 'watch the dog!' koan.

bio: Korean (Silla) Seon master. Lay surname Pak, a man of Paegang; his forebears were powerful local gentry who served for generations as frontier commanders, and his mother was of the So clan. He crossed to Tang China and became the dharma heir of Yangshan Huiji of the Guiyang house, then returned to found his teaching at Ruiyun (Seounsa) monastery on Mt Ogwan. His entry in the Zutangji (952) is one of the longest in that collection; he is distinctive for synthesising Chan with Huayan doctrine.

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 (952, near-contemporary) — his own full entry
teacher.quote: 五冠山瑞雲寺和尚，嗣仰山寂禪師，師諱順之。俗姓朴氏，浿江人也。祖考並家業雄豪，世為邊將…及乎竹馬之期，漸有牛車之量，已至十歲，精勤好學。
teacher.note: 嗣仰山寂禪師 — explicit, in the earliest full lamp, which gives him a substantial biography. Far stronger than the roster's 'lamp' grade suggested.

teacher.quote: 五冠山瑞雲寺和尚，嗣仰山寂禪師，師諱順之。俗姓朴氏，浿江人也。祖考並家業雄豪，世為邊將，忠勤之譽，遺慶在鄉。母昭氏，柔範母儀，芬芳閭里。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. 「嗣仰山寂禪師」 - heir of Yangshan Huiji (寂 = 慧寂). The Zutangji is compiled within living memory of him and is a Korean-transmitted text.

teacher.quote: 五冠山瑞雲寺和尚嗣仰山寂禪師，師諱順之，俗姓朴氏。（祖堂集：370）
teacher.note: dynasty: 新羅; sect: 溈仰宗.

bio.quote: 俗姓朴氏，浿江人也。祖考並家業雄豪，世為邊將

notes: Korean monk with the second-longest entry in the Zutangji (952). Studied under Yangshan Huiji of the Guiyang school. Uniquely synthesized Chan with Huayan doctrine.

bio: Lay surname Zeng, of Nan'an, Quanzhou; born 822 to a devoutly Buddhist family. At twelve he went with his father to Yujian temple in Putian, met the vinaya monk Qingxuan and declared 'This is my teacher'; he was tonsured at seventeen. He was fully ordained at Baocha temple in Youzhou, and became the dharma heir of Deshan Xuanjian at Wuling. Emperor Yizong gave him the title Zhenjue dashi. His community on Mt Xuefeng ran to fifteen hundred monks; of his fourteen heirs Yunmen Wenyan is the most eminent, and the Yunmen and Fayan houses descend from his line. He died in 908, aged 87.

steles.title: 雪峰真覺大禪師碑銘
steles.author: 黃滔
steles.author_note: 字文江, of Putian - a Tang literatus and contemporary of Xuefeng's circle.
steles.quote: 大師法號義存，長慶二年壬寅，生於泉州南安縣曾氏。自王父而下，皆友僧親佛，清淨謹志…九歲請出家，叶而未即。十二從家君遊莆田玉澗寺，寺有律僧慶玄，持行高潔，遽拜之曰：「我師也。」遂留為童子焉。十七落髮
steles.note: A GENUINE TANG STELE, preserved in the 雪峰志 (temple gazetteer). Gives his birth year, clan, and the whole early life. The gazetteer adds at 0630a05 that the physical carving 「皆不存」 - the stone is lost, the text survives.

steles.title: 雪峰真覺大師年譜
steles.author: unnamed; the 語錄 was tracked by 雪峰嗣祖比丘悟逸 (postface, 至治辛酉 = 1321)
steles.quote: 唐穆宗皇帝長慶二年壬寅：師泉州南安縣人也，姓曾氏，父諱勉，是年師降誕。
steles.note: A year-by-year chronological biography appended to his 語錄. Names his father (勉). Also carried in the 雪峰志 (B24n0140 0586a17).

teacher.quote: 福州雪峰義存禪師，德山宣鑑（782-865）禪師法嗣…後至武陵德山參謁宣鑒
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster.
黃滔's stele carries his life; cited for the biography as a whole.

dates.quote: 長慶二年壬寅，生於泉州南安縣曾氏
dates.note: Birth 822 from the stele itself.

dates.quote: death +0908-06-08 戊辰年春三月示疾。……夏五月二日……。其夜十有八刻時滅度。俗壽八十有七。（T50n2061_p0782b24）
dates.note: Died 908 aged 87. Roster's 822/908 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 石頭宗；法嗣十四人，以雲門文偃為最著，乃雲門宗之祖

notes: Community of 1500+ monks. His students founded the Yunmen and Fayan houses.

bio: From Anji. He received Xuefeng Yicun's seal and opened a large teaching seat at Cuiyan. In the Qianyou era (948-950) he led a company of Chan elders at the cloister of the samgha-rector Sixian in Qiantang. His heirs include Zixing of Longce temple in Hangzhou and Zhimo of Wenzhou. He is remembered for the koan of 'Cuiyan's eyebrows': at the end of a summer retreat he asked the assembly whether his eyebrows were still there, having spent the whole summer talking.

teacher.quote: 明州翠巖永明令參大師…湖州人也。自雪峯受記，止于翠巖大張法席。
teacher.note: 自雪峯受記 — 'received prediction/sealing from Xuefeng' — a genuine transmission phrase. Indexed among Xuefeng's heirs at lb 0343c25.

teacher.quote: 明州翠巖令參禪師法嗣二人
teacher.note: His two heirs confirmed.

teacher.quote: 自雪峯義存禪師受記，止于翠巖大張法席
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster: 'received the prediction/seal from Xuefeng Yicun.' Cites 祖堂集:198, 宋僧索引:219, T51n2076_p0352c15.

school.quote: sect: 石頭宗；dynasty: 五代十國

bio.quote: 漢乾祐（948-950）中，錢塘報恩寺釋慧明自山出，時翠巖參公率諸禪伯於僧主思憲院。法嗣弟子有杭州龍冊寺子興禪師、溫州知默禪師

notes: 'Cuiyan's eyebrows' koan — tested whether his teaching had been in error.

bio: Caodong master at Tong'an in Hongzhou; dharma heir of Tongan Daopi, and the link that carries the Caodong line on to Liangshan Yuanguan. Almost nothing of his life survives beyond his place in the succession.

teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. 同安丕 = Tongan Daopi.

teacher.kind: 洞宗正統圖 (碑陰, stele-back lineage chart)
teacher.quote: 青原思．石頭遷．藥山儼．雲巖晟．洞山价．雲居膺．同安丕．同安志．梁山觀．大陽玄．投子青．芙蓉楷
teacher.note: The Caodong orthodox-succession chart carved on the BACK of 幻休潤's 行實碑記 (by 袁了凡): ...同安丕 -> 同安志 -> 梁山觀... Confirms both the teacher above him and the heir below him.

school.quote: sect: 曹洞宗；dynasty: 五代十國

notes: Caodong lineage patriarch. Transmitted the Caodong dharma from Tongan Daopi to Liangshan Yuanguan.

bio: Lay surname Li, from Quanzhou. He left home at twenty-two at Yinjing temple on Mt Xiang. Hearing of Fenyang Shanzhao's reputation he went to him, was refused admission to his room for two years and abused whenever he appeared; then one day he had a great awakening at Fenyang's word and served him for seven years. He went on to Tangming Zhisong, debated the way with the literati Yang Yi and Li Zunxu, spent three years with Dongshan Xiaocong, and was warmly praised by Shending Hongyin. He taught at Nanyuan, Daowu, Shishuang, Fuyan and Xinghua, and died at Xinghua temple in Tanzhou in 1039, aged 54. His two great heirs, Huanglong Huinan and Yangqi Fanghui, founded the two branches of the Linji house.

steles.title: 重修石霜慈明圜祖塔記
steles.author: unnamed (in 密雲圓悟's 語錄, J26nB181)
steles.quote: 慈明圜祖者，望臨濟七世，是為汾陽嫡子。捩轉黃龍之鼻，故肆譏訶；摧殲諲老之鋒，平空脫賺。
steles.note: ⚠ NOT his original stele - this is a LATE MING/QING record of the REPAIR of his stupa, written centuries after his death. Its value is that it independently states 「是為汾陽嫡子」 - 'the direct son of Fenyang.' Rung is 'lamp', not 'stele'.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense (開堂 at 崇勝院)
teacher.quote: 師在崇勝院開堂日…遂陞座，拈香云：此一炷香奉為今上皇帝，伏願龍圖永固，玉葉彌芳。又拈香云：此一炷香奉為知郡郎中及諸官僚，福星高照，聖澤長臨。又拈香云：此一炷香為我汾州太子禪院無德禪師，且問諸人：還識無德禪師麼？若也不識，爐煙起處一任觀看。
teacher.note: THREE sticks, correctly sorted: emperor / officials / 汾州太子禪院無德禪師. 無德 is 汾陽善昭's title and 太子禪院 in Fenzhou is his seat — Chuyuan names the SEAT and the TITLE, not just a name, which forecloses any name-collision. The 「我」 in 為我汾州…無德禪師 ('for MY teacher') is the possessive of discipleship. First-person, at his own enthronement.

teacher.kind: byline of his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 住筠州黃檗山嗣法小師　慧南　重編
teacher.note: BONUS — this is not the editor trap, it is the exception the brief names: the record is re-edited by 慧南 explicitly styled 嗣法小師 (dharma-heir disciple). It independently corroborates the 楚圓 → 慧南 edge (master #1 in this batch) from the other end.

teacher.quote: 俗姓李，臨濟義玄六世孫，汾陽善昭法嗣…聞善昭道望遂往見，依止二年未許入室，見輒詬謗。某日言下大悟，服役七年
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster.

teacher.quote: 慈明圜祖者，望臨濟七世，是為汾陽嫡子

dates.quote: 寶元二年正月五日。沐浴加趺而逝。壽五十四。夏三十二。（X79n1559_p0293c21）
dates.note: Died Baoyuan 2, 1st month, 5th day = 1039-02-06, aged 54 -> b.986. ROSTER SAYS 1040 - off by one; the Chinese year Baoyuan 2 begins in 1039.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗；法嗣有黃龍慧南、楊岐方會等多人

bio.quote: 年二十二依湘山隱靜寺出家…後開法南源、遷道吾、石霜、福嚴、興化

notes: His two greatest students founded the Huanglong and Yangqi branches.

bio: Lay surname Wu, of Shixing in Nanxiong. A promising scholar who went blind at nineteen; his parents vowed him to the order and his sight returned, so he entered Longshan temple under Huiquan. He abandoned a comfortable career for the monasteries, spent three years with Yunfeng Wenyue, then went to Huanglong Huinan; reading the Chuandeng lu at Shishuang Chuyuan's place he broke through, returned to Huanglong and was sealed. He held Mt Huanglong for twelve years, disliked administration, resigned five times, and named his room 'Huitang'. He died in 1100, aged 76. Huang Tingjian, who was his student, managed his funeral and wrote his stupa inscription.

steles.title: 黃龍心禪師塔銘
steles.author: 黃庭堅
steles.author_note: The great Song poet and calligrapher - Huitang's own lay student, who as 太史 took charge of the funeral.
steles.quote: 後作晦堂塔銘曰。某夙承記莂堪任大法。道眼未圓而來瞻窣堵。實深宗仰之嘆。乃勒堅珉。敬頌遺美。
steles.note: 'I long ago received his prediction and was entrusted with the great dharma; my dharma-eye is not yet round, and now I come to gaze on his stupa... so I cut the hard stone and reverently praise what he left.' Huang Tingjian ALSO offered a food-offering and wrote him a poem: 「海風吹落楞伽山，四海禪徒著眼看。一把柳絲收不得，和煙搭在玉闌干。」 The full 塔銘 is in 豫章黃先生文集 卷24 (per DILA); the corpus preserves this excerpt at T51n2077, X79n1559 0317a01, X82n1571 0872a06, X87n1620 0494a07 and D60n9021 0071a04.

steles.title: 晦堂行狀
steles.author: 靈源惟清
steles.author_note: Huitang's own dharma heir.
steles.quote: 靈源作晦堂行狀，有云：早不奉戒律，且逢橫逆。天柱靜公以書力詆其不當言。
steles.note: His heir Lingyuan Weiqing wrote his account-of-conduct - and was PUBLICLY ATTACKED for it: Tianzhu Jinggong wrote to say he should never have put in print that Huitang 'did not keep the precepts early on and met with adversity.' A rare glimpse of a stele being contested by contemporaries.

teacher.kind: contemporary preface to his OWN 語錄, by an eyewitness at the enthronement
teacher.quote: 熈寧二年，洪州黃龍山南禪師宴寂，郡以其徒心師繼焉，而陞座於縣之雲巖院。余邀同學十數人，焚香側立，以聽其所謂示眾者。
teacher.note: 徐禧 (西安徐禧, d. 1082) — a contemporary official who says he was PHYSICALLY PRESENT, incense in hand, at Zuxin's first 陞座 in Xining 2 (1069), the year 慧南 died. He calls Zuxin 其徒 — Huinan's disciple — and the prefecture installed him as Huinan's successor at Huanglong. He then studied under Zuxin for years (「四年造焉，舍于堂之西房者踰兩月」) and was asked by Zuxin's attendant 子和 to write this preface.

teacher.quote: 隆興府黃龍祖心寶覺禪師，南雄鄔氏。黃龍慧南（1002-1069）禪師法嗣…徑返黃龍獲印可
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster.

teacher.quote: 宋觀文王韶嗣法黃龍心
teacher.note: His own heirs are tagged 'heir of Huanglong Xin', fixing him at Huanglong.

dates.quote: 元符三年十一月十六日中夜而没，住世七十六年（《豫章黃先生文集》卷24〈黃龍心禪師塔銘〉）
dates.note: From the STELE itself: died Yuanfu 3 (1100-12-25), aged 76 -> b.1025. Roster CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 黃龍派；法嗣有死心悟新、靈源惟清、草堂善清等人

bio.quote: 年十九而目盲，父母許以出家輒復見物，乃往依龍山寺沙門惠全…住持黃龍山十二年，性真率，不樂事務，凡五辭乃退，揭其室曰「晦堂」

notes: Taught Huang Tingjian using the scent of osmanthus.

names: 溫州淨居尼定光大師妙道
bio: A NUN, and one of the very few women given a full place in the Song lamp records. She was the daughter of Huang Shang, Minister of Yanping. She became the dharma heir of Dahui Zonggao - his first and most celebrated female heir - and abbess of Jingju temple in Wenzhou, with the title Dingguang dashi.

teacher.kind: her teacher's own 法語 to her, in his own 語錄 (示妙道禪人)
teacher.quote: 示妙道禪人。定光大師妙道問雲門：此心此性迷悟向背如何？乞省要處指示。雲門良久不答。妙道再問。雲門笑曰：若論省要處，則不可指示於人；若可指示，則不省要矣。
teacher.note: Dahui, speaking of himself as 雲門 (his residence, 雲門庵), answering her by her full title 定光大師妙道 — which matches the roster's name for her exactly. This is his voice, in his lifetime, teaching her personally. It is the strongest thing that exists. HONEST LIMIT: it is a teaching exchange, NOT an 印可 or 付法 — no transmission verb appears. Teaching is not yet transmission, and I am not going to pretend it is.

teacher.lb: (see 妙道禪人求讚, T47n1998A vol. 12)
teacher.quote: 妙道禪人求讚：這村僧無明大，少柔和多褊隘…
teacher.note: She asked Dahui for a 讚 on his portrait — a disciple's request, and he answered with a mock self-excoriation. Mild caution: the 讚 says only 妙道禪人, without the 定光大師 title, so the identification here is probable rather than certain.

teacher.quote: 溫州淨居尼妙道禪師，延平尚書黃裳之女。大慧宗杲（1089-1163）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十七世。住溫州淨居寺。（T51n2077_p0692a12；X84n1579_p0004b08）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. Note 尼 - she is explicitly recorded as a nun.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；dynasty: 南宋

bio.quote: 延平尚書黃裳之女…住溫州淨居寺

notes: Female Chan master of the Southern Song.

bio: Lay surname Du, of Siming (Qingyuan fu); styled Shaozhan. Even as a boy he would not go along with worldly life and pressed to be tonsured. He first went with Shigu Yi to see Wuyong Quan and other elders; in 1184 he came to Songyuan Chongyue, and attended him for eighteen years, at one point holding the first seat at Lingyin. He returned home on his mother's account and lived at Yun'an in Siming. In 1206 he took up the invitation to Dasheng in Zhenjiang, then moved to Tianning in Zhenzhou and Daochang in Huzhou. He died seated on the 4th day of the 8th month of 1226, aged 71. His heir Xutang Zhiyu carried the line to Japan.

steles.title: 炎宋安吉州道場山護聖萬歲禪寺運菴禪師行實
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 師諱普巖，字少瞻，高宗紹興廿六年丙子生於四明，杜氏也。稍長，泊然不肯從俗，屈首亟從剃落。初與石鼓夷公謁無用全公洎諸老。孝宗淳熈十一年甲辰春正月，松源岳禪師出世平江澄照，唱密菴之道…參叩勤確，時年三十也。
steles.note: His account-of-deeds, appended to his own recorded sayings. Gives birth year (1156), clan, and the exact moment he came to Songyuan (1184, aged 30). This is the primary source for everything above.

teacher.quote: 孝宗淳熈十一年甲辰春正月，松源岳禪師出世平江澄照，唱密菴之道…參叩勤確，時年三十也
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. His own 行實 places him at Songyuan Chongyue's feet from 1184.

teacher.quote: 湖州道場普巖禪師，四明杜氏。松源嶽（1139-1209）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十世…隨侍松源十八年…法嗣有虗堂智愚、石帆衍等

dates.quote: 高宗紹興廿六年丙子生
dates.note: Born Shaoxing 26 = 1156.

dates.quote: 寶慶二年丙戌秋八月初四日坐化，享年七十一
dates.note: Died 1226-09-04 aged 71. Roster 1156/1226 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Dharma heir of Songyuan Chongyue. Teacher of Xutang Zhiyu.

bio: Korean Seon master, fifth National Teacher of the Suseonsa (Jogye) community. Lay surname Yang; father Taekchun, mother of the Kim clan. Born 13/6 of 1215. He was ordained under Jingak Guksa (Hyesim) at Jogye at fifteen; in 1233 he was made head of the assembly at a Seon convocation, and in 1236 he passed the monastic examination in the top grade. He then studied under Cheongjin Guksa (Mongyeo) and received the essentials of the dharma from Jinmyeong Guksa (Honwon). Under the patronage of the Choe dictators he was made Samjung daesa, then Seonsa (1248), held Dansoksa, and from 1250 headed the Seonwonsa. In 1256 Jinmyeong resigned and nominated Cheonyeong to replace him; the king ordered him to succeed at Jogye, and he entered it on 19/9. He died at Bultaesa in Goheung on 12/2 of 1286, quoting Moguja (Jinul) with his last breath: 'A thousand kinds, ten thousand sorts - all of it is right here.'

steles.title: 曹溪山修禪社第五世慈真國師碑
steles.author: 李益培
steles.author_note: 奉命撰 - composed by royal command. The stele stands at Bultaesa (佛臺寺), Goheung county.
steles.quote: 師諱天英。俗姓梁氏。考宅椿。妣金氏。高宗二年乙亥六月十三日誕生。十二年己丑。詣曹溪真覺國師得度。年甫十五…時清真國師。盛化曹溪徑造參扣。慧能增明。又從真明國師。諮稟法要…四十三年丙辰秋。真明國師。乞退休。而舉師自代。上。命師嗣曹溪。
steles.note: HIS OWN STELE, from the Korean 朝鮮佛教通史 (B31n0170) - exactly the goldmine the brief pointed at. It names all three of his masters and, decisively, records that Jinmyeong (Honwon) RESIGNED AND NOMINATED HIM AS HIS OWN REPLACEMENT (舉師自代), whereupon the king ordered him to 嗣 (succeed to) Jogye. NOTE a dating wrinkle in the stele: 「十二年己丑」 - Gojong 12 is 1225 (乙酉), but 己丑 is 1229 (Gojong 16); age 15 fits 1229, so the year-number appears corrupt and the cyclical 己丑 is to be preferred.

teacher.quote: 又從真明國師。諮稟法要…四十三年丙辰秋。真明國師。乞退休。而舉師自代。上。命師嗣曹溪。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS ROSTER. 真明國師 = 混元 Honwon, 4th National Teacher of Suseonsa. He gave Cheonyeong the 法要 and named him successor. The verb 嗣 (succeed/inherit) is used of the Jogye seat.

teacher.quote: 詣曹溪真覺國師得度
teacher.note: His ORDINATION master was 真覺國師 = Hyesim (2nd National Teacher) - tonsure, not transmission. 清真國師 = Mongyeo (3rd) also taught him. The roster's note 'Studied under Hyesim, Mongyeo, and Honwon' is CORRECT and now sourced.

dates.quote: 高宗二年乙亥六月十三日誕生
dates.note: Born Gojong 2 = 1215, 6th month, 13th day.

dates.quote: 忠烈王十二年丙戌二月十二日。受請。而抵高興郡佛臺寺…言訖。泊然而化
dates.note: Died Chungnyeol 12 = 1286, 2nd month, 12th day, at Bultaesa. Roster's 1215/1286 CONFIRMED from the stele.

school.quote: 曹溪山修禪社第五世慈真國師

notes: 5th National Teacher of Suseonsa. Studied under Hyesim, Mongyeo, and Honwon.

bio: Lay surname Zhu, of Xiangshan in Mingzhou; styled Chushi, childhood name Tanyao. Born 1296, the night his mother dreamt the sun fell into her breast. Orphaned at four and raised by his grandmother, who taught him the Analects. He studied the sutras under Neweng Mo at Tianning Yongzuo in Haiyan, and was fully ordained at sixteen at Zhaoqing temple in Hangzhou. Reading the Surangama he had an opening; he went to Yuansou Xingduan, and later, hearing a drum sound on a tower at dawn in Yandu, had a great awakening. He returned east, went again to Yuansou at Jingshan, and received transmission. He held Tianning Yongzuo, Baoguo in Hangzhou, and Benjue and Guangxiao in Jiaxing. In 1347 he was given the title Foti Puzhao Huibian chanshi. He was the foremost Chan poet-monk of the Yuan, and in retirement at Yongzuo wrote the Pure Land Poems of the Western Studio. He died 26/7 of 1370, aged 75.

steles.title: 楚石和尚行狀
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his 語錄, X71n1420 卷20)
steles.quote: 師諱梵琦，字楚石，小字曇曜，明州象山人，姓朱氏。父杲，好善有隱德。母張，事佛惟謹。以大元元貞二年丙申之歲六月丁巳，夢日墮懷中而生師…四歲失怙恃，祖母王氏鞠之，口授以論語，輙能成誦。
steles.note: His account-of-conduct. Names father (杲), mother (張), the dream, the orphaning at four, and the grandmother who taught him.

steles.title: 佛日普照慧辯禪師塔銘
steles.author: 宋濂 (per DILA: also carried in 護法錄 卷1 as 〈佛日普照慧辨禪師塔銘〉)
steles.author_note: Song Lian, the leading literatus of the early Ming.
steles.quote: （洪武）三年之秋，……師厲聲一喝，泊然而化，時七月二十六日也。
steles.note: Quoted via DILA A001082, which cites 《楚石梵琦禪師語錄》卷 20〈佛日普照慧辯禪師塔銘〉 for the death. The Jiaxing catalogue (B35n0194 0584a05) independently confirms the 語錄 'has 行狀 and 塔銘' appended: 「楚石梵琦禪師語錄二十卷 元梵琦說…有行狀、塔銘」.

steles.title: 佛日普照慧辯楚石大師塔銘 (行狀)
steles.author: 宋濂 (宋文憲公)
steles.quote: 有行狀、塔銘，內題佛日普照慧辯楚石禪師語錄。
steles.note: His 塔銘/行狀 by 宋濂 accompanies the 語錄 (per Jiaxing catalogue). The 塔銘 text is not separately in the flattened CBETA corpus body I scanned; its existence and author are catalogue-attested. 宋濂's 護法錄 preserves it.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 at enthronement — 楚石梵琦禪師語錄
teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，奉為見住徑山元叟端和尚，用酬法乳之恩。斂衣就座。天寧老和尚白槌云：法筵龍象眾，當觀第一義。
teacher.note: 本師 stick, 用酬法乳之恩, raised by 梵琦 himself for 元叟行端 (元叟端), then abbot of 徑山. First-person, the strongest rung.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香, second enthronement
teacher.quote: 妙喜第四世天下老和尚元叟端禪師，以酬法乳。
teacher.note: Names 元叟端 as 4th-generation heir of 妙喜 (Dahui Zonggao) and himself as the next — 以酬法乳.

teacher.quote: 楚石梵琦禪師語錄二十卷　元梵琦說，祖光、文玹、曇紹等編，錢惟善序，明宋濂序，有行狀、塔銘，內題佛日普照慧辯楚石禪師語錄。
teacher.note: 南嶽下第二十世，嗣元叟端; and note it carries 行狀 + 塔銘 (by 宋濂).

teacher.quote: 字楚石，自號西齋老人，為元叟行端禪師（1255-1341）法嗣…東歸，再參元叟禪師於徑山，得付法
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster (Yuansou Xingduan).

teacher.quote: 元叟行端禪師語錄八卷 元行端說，法林、曇噩、祖銘、梵琦等編
teacher.note: ⚠ EDITOR SIGNAL PRESENT: Fanqi was one of the EDITORS of Yuansou's record. On its own that would prove nothing (the editor trap). But the transmission is independently attested by DILA's 得付法 and by his own 行狀, so the edge stands on more than the editorship.

dates.quote: 以大元元貞二年丙申之歲六月丁巳，夢日墮懷中而生師
dates.note: Born Yuanzhen 2 = 1296.

dates.quote: 洪武三年（1370）七月二十六日示寂，世壽七十五，僧臘六十三
dates.note: Roster 1296/1370 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；後隨元叟行端，為大慧宗杲第五傳弟子

notes: Ordained at age nine at Tianning Temple in Haiyan, Zhejiang. Studied calligraphy under Zhao Mengfu and became one of the foremost Chan poet-monks of the Yuan dynasty, composing over a hundred Pure Land poems. Yunqi Zhuhong later ranked him first among the most eminent monks of the era.

bio: Lay surname Jiang, of Zhongling in Nanchang; styled Tianqi, known as the Old Man of Solitary Desolation. At twenty he was tonsured by Wushuo Neng at Jingmen and set to the huatou 'the one returns to what?'. He wandered through Shu and Chu, and after a severe illness - during which a lecturer told him how Dahui had been cured by a back abscess - he broke through. He went to Baofeng Mingxuan at Gaofeng temple in Nanjing and received his mind-seal. He taught at Jingling and Jingmen, promoting huatou Chan, and left direct commentaries on the verses of Tiantong Zhengjue and Xuedou Chongxian. He had thirty-nine heirs, including Wuwen Mingcong. He died in 1508 and his stupa was built at Baiyun temple in Huixian, Weihui fu, in 1498.

steles.title: 天奇塔銘 (with a 塔碑 dated 1498 at 白雲寺)
steles.author: unnamed
steles.quote: 天奇塔銘載法嗣曰．高峯第八代遠孫二百餘人。塔在衛輝府輝縣白雲寺
steles.note: The stupa inscription survives in quotation inside a POLEMIC. The disputant 霽崙 reports at 0485a11: 「余嘗躬到白雲．見天奇塔背．有碑曰．弘治十一年歲次戊午某月日立」 - 'I went in person to Baiyun and saw, on the back of Tianqi's stupa, a tablet dated Hongzhi 11 (1498).' The stele's own statement that his heirs are 'eighth-generation descendants of Gaofeng' is used as the decisive proof of where he sits in the line.

steles.title: 天奇塔銘 (stupa-tablet, 白雲寺, 衛輝府輝縣白鹿山)
steles.quote: 見天奇塔背．有碑曰．弘治十一年歲次戊午某月日立…碑前載天奇法嗣曰．高峯第八代遠孫二百餘人
steles.note: erected 1498. Inspected in person by 智楷. The generational count on the stone is the decisive arithmetic against the forgery.

teacher.kind: 明瑄's transmission of robe, whisk and verse
teacher.quote: 瑄留過冬。明春．師告辭。瑄付以衣拂。偈曰．濟山棒喝如輕觸．殺活從茲手眼親。聖解凡情俱坐斷．曇花猶放一枝新
teacher.note: 付以衣拂 = transmission

teacher.kind: 天奇塔銘 (stupa-tablet, Baiyun si), read in person by 智楷
teacher.quote: 余嘗躬到白雲．見天奇塔背．有碑曰．弘治十一年歲次戊午某月日立。…按碑前載天奇法嗣曰．高峯第八代遠孫二百餘人。夫天奇法嗣．稱高峯八代。則天奇當高峯七代。以是驗無聞笑巖等數種祖訓．皆為可徵可信也
teacher.note: THE 1498 STONE. Zhikai's own eyewitness inspection. 'Eighth-generation descendants of Gaofeng' -> Tianqi is the seventh -> no room for Baozang and Dongming.

teacher.quote: 天奇法嗣既稱高峯第八代孫．則天奇當高峯第七代孫．而寶藏東明為疊出明甚
teacher.note: 疊出 = the two generations are a duplication/insertion

teacher.quote: 明瑄傳中機緣．與天奇錄中機緣相同．則天奇嗣明瑄．不待辨而自明矣
teacher.note: the Mingxuan encounter-dialogue is verbatim in Tianqi's OWN record

teacher.kind: 行實 quoted in a lineage polemic
teacher.quote: 天奇行實．自謂到南京高峯寺．參寶峯瑄和尚。則天奇嗣明瑄又明矣。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS ROSTER, and does so against an attack. 天奇's OWN 行實 says he went to Gaofeng temple in Nanjing and called on Abbot Xuan of Baofeng.

teacher.quote: 明瑄傳中機緣．與天奇錄中機緣相同．則天奇嗣明瑄．不待辨而自明矣。
teacher.note: 🔴 A DOCUMENTED LINEAGE FORGERY FIGHT. A rival (霽崙) tried to substitute 智瑄 for 明瑄 as Tianqi's master, reassigning him to a different branch. The defender lists TEN pieces of evidence - 「萬峯偈．沈貫銘．明瑄傳．天奇錄．及塔銘．無聞客牕夜話．傳法記序．笑巖聯芳敘．曇芝偈．廣通序」 - and shows (0484b18) that the rival 「削去普慈付明瑄之偈．插入永慈付智瑄之偈」 - deleted one transmission verse and inserted another. This is the brief's 'forged charts' in the raw. I follow the defence: teacher = 寶峰明瑄.

teacher.quote: 臨濟宗僧。鍾陵江氏，寶峰明瑄法嗣…後至高峰謁寶峰明瑄，得其心印

dates.quote: death +1508-02-11 ~ +1509-01-30 （明武宗）戊辰三年臨濟第二十六世金陵祖示寂。（《宗統編年》卷 29）
dates.note: Death 1508 CONFIRMED. BIRTH: DILA gives NONE. Roster's 'floruit 1450' is unsourced - left null.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有無聞明聰、大休實等三十九位

bio.kind: 行實 (皇明名僧輯略 卷1) via authority record
bio.quote: 年二十禮荊門州無說能和尚披剃，教看「一歸何處？」…後患痢疾甚重，有山東靜東暉法師示大慧杲禪師患背疽因緣而豁然
