notes: Mid-Ming Linji master. His heir Wuwen Mingcong continued the lineage.

bio: Korean Seon master, and the foremost disciple of Cheongheo Hyujeong (Seosan). Born 17/10 of 1544. During the Imjin War he raised and led an army of monk-soldiers against the Japanese - his mustering ground at Geonbongsa on the outer Diamond Mountains is commemorated on his stele - and afterwards served as a diplomat. He died 26/8 of 1610 and was given the posthumous title Jatong Hongje Jonja.

steles.title: 慈通弘濟尊者泗溟松雲大師石藏碑銘并序
steles.author: 許筠
steles.author_note: Heo Gyun (字端甫, 號蛟山), the great Joseon writer - a contemporary.
steles.quote: 普濟（懶翁）五傳為芙蓉靈觀。而清虛老師。稱入室弟子。其慧觀妙悟。有出於前輩。寔近代之臨濟曹洞也。厥後嗣法者。不無其人。而緇門盛推四溟大師謂可繼西山之傳。
steles.note: 'Among those who inherited his dharma afterwards there was no lack of men, but the black-robed gate strongly puts forward Master Samyeong as the one who could continue Seosan's transmission.' Heo Gyun's stele - written by a contemporary who knew him - places him as Hyujeong's (Cheongheo/Seosan's) heir. Also at B31n0170 0732b19.

steles.title: 有明朝鮮國八道都摠攝義兵大將弘濟尊者泗溟大師紀蹟碑銘并序
steles.author: 南公轍
steles.author_note: Nam Gong-cheol, Governor of Gangwon - a LATER (Joseon) commemorative stele, standing at Geonbongsa (乾鳳寺).
steles.quote: 內岾之表訓寺是西山大師施教之地也。外岾之乾鳳寺是泗溟大師募義之地也。二子者雖出於浮屠。而西山以其節。泗溟以其功。
steles.note: 'Pyohunsa within the pass is where Master Seosan gave his teaching; Geonbongsa beyond the pass is where Master Samyeong raised the righteous army. Though both came out of the Buddhist order, Seosan is honoured for his integrity, Samyeong for his deeds.' Pairs master and disciple explicitly. Also at B31n0170 0757a18.

teacher.quote: 而緇門盛推四溟大師謂可繼西山之傳
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. 西山 = Seosan = Hyujeong.

teacher.quote: 清虛休靜弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：24）

dates.note: Roster 1544/1610 CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: 朝鮮佛教通史 chronicle entry
dates.quote: 庚戌二年明萬曆三十八年佛紀二六三七年八月二十六日。沙門惟政入寂。賜諡慈通弘濟尊者。
dates.note: Death 26/8, Wanli 38 = 1610, with posthumous title. Independent of DILA.

school.quote: dynasty: 朝鮮；sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Hyujeong's foremost disciple, celebrated equally as a Seon master, military commander, and diplomat. During the Imjin War (1592-1598), he led monk-soldiers in combat against the Japanese forces, distinguishing himself at several engagements. After the war, he was sent to Japan as an envoy in 1604 and successfully negotiated the return of approximately 3,500 Korean prisoners of war, a diplomatic feat that made him a national hero. His combination of martial valor and diplomatic skill during Korea's greatest military crisis cemented the image of Buddhist monks as defenders of the nation, counterbalancing the Neo-Confucian narrative that Buddhism was socially useless. Attested in Joseon wangjo sillok and Japanese records: his diplomatic mission to Japan and the repatriation of prisoners are documented in both Korean and Japanese sources.

bio: Korean Seon master. Lay surname Jang, of Jukju; son of Bak, his mother of the Yi clan, who dreamt of the sun and moon when she conceived him. He was a dharma heir of Seosan (Hyujeong), and served as a lieutenant during the Imjin War. He died at Naewon hermitage on Mt Myohyang on 10/5 of 1644. He founded the Pyeonyang branch, through which the modern Jogye Order traces its lineage - which makes him more consequential for transmission than his more famous dharma-brother Samyeong Yujeong.

steles.title: 鞭羊彥機大師碑銘并序 (碑在金剛山)
steles.author: 李明漢
steles.author_note: 號白洲; Minister of Personnel and Grand Academician of the Hongmun'gwan - a very senior Joseon official.
steles.quote: 鞭羊堂大師。既滅于香山內院。其弟子義諶。釋敏。說清等。即具師始卒行蹟為狀。冒風雪南走千里。至京謁余曰。吾師西山之法嗣也。吾師為西山。請先相國文。已銘之楓岳矣。今公又銘吾師。即吾空門。世受相國家賜於結無窮也。吾師法諱彥機。鞭羊堂其號也。俗姓張。竹州人。珀之子。母李。夢懷日月
steles.note: A superb stele. His disciples (義諶 = Pungdam Uisim, 釋敏, 說清) drew up his 行狀, walked a thousand li through wind and snow to the capital, and told Yi Myeong-han to his face: 「吾師西山之法嗣也」 - 'OUR MASTER IS SEOSAN'S DHARMA HEIR.' The teacher-claim is made by the men who buried him. The stele stands on the Diamond Mountains.

teacher.quote: 吾師西山之法嗣也
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster, from his own disciples at the moment of his funeral. 西山 = Hyujeong.

teacher.quote: 清虛休靜弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：24）

dates.kind: 朝鮮佛教通史 chronicle entry
dates.quote: 甲申二十二年明崇禎十七年佛紀二六七一年五月初十日。沙門彥機入寂
dates.note: Died 10/5, Chongzhen 17 = 1644.

dates.quote: birth 1581年，宣祖 214年；death 1644年，仁祖 22年 (encykorea E0036150)
dates.note: Roster 1581/1644 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: dynasty: 朝鮮；sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

notes: Founded the Pyeonyang-pa, the dominant branch through which ALL modern Jogye Order lineage traces. War lieutenant during the Imjin War (1592-98). More significant for lineage than his dharma brother Yujeong/Samyeong, who was more famous as diplomat.

bio: Lay surname Yang, of Rongcheng in Jiangyin. At nineteen he was tonsured at Qingshan under Tianyin Yuanxiu and received full ordination, later living at Bao'en temple in Wukang. The Shunzhi emperor summoned him to the inner court twice; he was given the title Dajue Puji chanshi with a purple robe and a gold seal, and on asking leave to return to Mt Tianmu was further enfeoffed as Puji Nengren Guoshi (National Teacher). He taught for forty years. In 1671, during a great drought, he ran relief kitchens. Travelling to Wutai in the autumn of 1675 he fell ill at Ciyun hermitage in Qingjiangpu, wrote 'Fundamentally there is no birth, and now no death either; this is the true teaching, the rest is Mara's talk', threw down the brush and died - 10/7 of 1675, aged 62. He was buried on Mt Tianmu facing the stupas of Gaofeng and Zhongfeng.

steles.title: 大覺普濟能仁國師年譜
steles.author: 超賢
steles.quote: 是年，玉林通琇、木陳道忞應清世祖召至京。（超賢撰「玉林琇禪師年譜」、道忞「北遊集」。 通琇，字玉林，江陰楊氏。年十九出家，居武林報恩寺。順治間，召見三次，說法稱旨，賜號大覺禪師，尋乞還天目山，加封普濟能仁國師。康熙十四年卒。）
steles.note: A year-by-year chronicle by his disciple Chaoxian, cited here in a Ming-Qing historical chronology. NOTE this witness says he was summoned THREE times (召見三次), while DILA says twice (兩召內廷). A small disagreement, recorded.

teacher.kind: 弘儲's 記臨濟源流 — a lineage record drawn up by a CONTEMPORARY (三峰派 abbot, d.1672) to restore Linji's stupa, working 『祇據本支宗派』 from the branch records
teacher.quote: 報恩[圓修]付竹林本豫、報恩通琇、南㵎通問、石霜通際。
teacher.note: The verb is 付 — transmitted to. 通琇 is named second of 天隱圓修's four heirs, by a man of his own generation writing a formal lineage document. The same passage sets out 幻有正傳's three heirs (天童圓悟, 報恩圓修, 雲門圓信) — the standard late-Ming Linji trunk.

teacher.kind: 新續高僧傳四集, 釋通琇 — quoting his OWN 上堂 on taking the seat
teacher.quote: 號玉林，蓉城楊氏子。澄江請磬山，不赴。師破關來見… 山曰：你且站下脚，我與汝道。師掀倒香案便出。 … 住後，上堂：有一句子…天下善知識不能說；先師亦未曾說。琇上座今日既居此位，為眾分明舉似去也。
teacher.note: 『先師亦未曾說。琇上座今日既居此位』 — first-person, from the seat, referring to his late master; and the encounter narrated immediately before is with 磬山 (『山曰』 = 天隱圓修 at 磬山), whose seat he is taking. The referent is contextual rather than named, which is why I grade this B and not A.

teacher.quote: 清僧。江陰楊氏，天隱圓修（1575-1635）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第35世。初依磬山圓修出家…年十九，投磬山芟染，受具
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. 磬山 = Qingshan, Tianyin Yuanxiu's seat.

teacher.quote: 通琇，字玉林，江陰楊氏。年十九出家，居武林報恩寺

dates.quote: birth 「萬曆四十二年四月二十日」（《大覺普濟能仁國師年譜》卷上）；death 「康熙十四年八月初十日，六十二歲」（《大覺普濟能仁國師年譜》卷下）
dates.note: Both dates come from his own 年譜: b.1614-05-28, d.1675-09-28 aged 62. Roster 1614/1675 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有退菴重、白松豐等十九人

bio.quote: 乙卯秋遊五臺途次，至清江浦慈雲庵示微疾，索筆作霞表子第一書云：「本是無生，今亦無死，此是正說，餘為魔說」，擲筆而逝

notes: Imperial Chan teacher to the Shunzhi Emperor. Titled Yulin Guoshi (National Teacher). Dissuaded the emperor from abdicating to become a monk.

bio: Lay surname Xu, of Luoyang; a monk of Dingguo temple in the Western Capital. He is the 27th (by one Caodong reckoning) generation of the Shaolin Caodong transmission, standing between Jukong Qibin and Yuezhou Wenzai. A verse-biography in the Caodong lineage-hymns has him first entering Longtan to 'ask about the hibernating dragon' and leaving without the pearl, then labouring on with staff and bamboo hat through mist and water until he found a lamp before Wuru peak. He died in 1483, aged 64.

teacher.kind: 洞宗正統圖, carved on the back of 幻休潤's 行實碑記
teacher.quote: 初祖達磨大師…青原思．石頭遷．藥山儼．雲巖晟．洞山价．雲居膺．同安丕．同安志．梁山觀．大陽玄．投子青．芙蓉楷．鹿門覺．青州辯．磁州寶．王山體．雪巖滿．萬松秀．雪庭裕．靈隱泰．寶應遇．淳拙才．松庭嚴．凝然改．俱空斌．無方從。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. The Caodong orthodox-succession chart CARVED ON THE BACK OF A STELE (幻休潤行實碑記, by 東吳袁了凡居士): ...凝然改 -> 俱空斌 -> 無方從. 俱空斌 = 俱空契斌 = Jukong Qibin. This is stele-rung evidence for the edge, not a lamp.

teacher.quote: 俱空政為兩不空，一睹秦槐愕然瞥。凝然一見不待辭，從上機關都漏泄。…六十四西京定國寺無方可從禪師
teacher.note: The 俱空 entry stands immediately before 無方可從's in this generation-by-generation verse sequence, corroborating the order.

dates.note: Died Chenghua 19 (1483) aged 64 -> b.1420. Roster death 1483 CONFIRMED; birth 1420 now supplied (roster had null).

school.quote: sect: 曹洞宗；洛陽人，姓許，西京定國寺僧人

bio.quote: 始入龍潭問蟄龍，未獲龍珠竟他徙。底事不明安肯休？勞勞杖笠參煙水。五乳峰前有一燈，吞刀刮腸去瑕玼。

bio.kind: 覺浪道盛 語錄, lineage verse
bio.quote: 第二十七代西京定國無方可從禪師

notes: Mid Ming Shaolin Caodong transmission. Teacher of Yuezhou Wenzai.

bio: Chinese monk who carried Linji Chan to Vietnam. Born 1648; he went to Dang Trong (southern Vietnam) and founded Thap Thap Di Da temple in Binh Dinh and Quoc An temple in Hue, under the patronage of the Nguyen lords. He is counted the 33rd generation of the Linji line, and is the founding ancestor of the Vietnamese Lam Te transmission. He died in 1728.

steles.title: 敕賜河中寺 煥碧禪師塔記銘 (Sắc tứ Hà Trung tự - Hoán Bích Thiền sư tháp ký minh)
steles.author: (erected under Nguyễn Phúc Thú, 1729; composer unnamed)
steles.path: 外 — Vietnam; preserved at the Ho Chi Minh City History Museum (not in CBETA corpus, text not fetched)
steles.quote: （存於胡志明市歷史博物館）
steles.note: a genuine 18c pagoda-inscription for 元韶, documented via zh-Wikipedia; the stone text itself was not obtained, so recorded as external/unverified content.

teacher.quote: 19岁出家，师事报资寺旷圆和尚。（清初广东籍侨僧元韶禅师…华侨华人历史研究，2007年第2期p.56）
teacher.note: teacher 曠圓本果 from a modern article; not primary. zh-Wikipedia names no master — treat as disputed.

dates.quote: 清初僧人，臨濟宗第33代法嗣。birth +1648-07-08；death +1728-11-20
dates.note: DILA's dates, sourced to zh.wikipedia (元韶禪師), accessed 2022.02.20. Roster 1648/1728 CONFIRMED against DILA, but note this is a WEAK chain - DILA is here relaying Wikipedia, not a primary text.

school.quote: 臨濟宗第33代法嗣；dynasty: 清

bio.quote: 清初僧人，臨濟宗第33代法嗣

notes: Chinese monk from Chaozhou, Guangdong who brought Linji Chan to Vietnam in 1665. Founded Thap Thap Di Da Temple and Quoc An Temple in Hue. 33rd generation Linji. Patronized by the Nguyen lords. His lineage (Lam Te) remains one of the largest in Vietnamese Buddhism.

bio: Fourth patriarch of the Oxhead (Niutou) school. Lay surname Zhang, of Jiangning; a monk of Yanzuo temple in Jinling. He left the world young. At thirteen, hearing of Hongren of Huangmei, he went to pay his respects and was shown the essentials of the dharma. He then attended Niutou Huifang and received his mind-seal, succeeding to the mountain gate and spreading the teaching widely - within a few years the four assemblies were following him. He transmitted the dharma to Zhiwei. He died at Yanzuo temple on 5/9 of 702, aged 68.

steles.title: 潤州鶴林寺故徑山大師碑銘 (transmits the Niutou succession)
steles.author: 李華
steles.author_note: A leading Tang literatus, writing c.760 - within two generations of Fachi.
steles.quote: 融授巖大師，巖授方大師，方授持大師，持授威大師，凡七世矣
steles.note: A TANG STELE stating the Oxhead transmission in one line: Farong gave it to Zhiyan, Zhiyan to Huifang, HUIFANG TO FACHI, Fachi to Zhiwei. This is not Fachi's own stele, but it is a named Tang author at a named grave naming his teacher - stele-rung evidence for the edge. Quoted in Yinshun's study (Y40n0038) from 全唐文 卷320; the full 碑銘 text is at B16n0088 0688b21 and GA043n0046 d039a03.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0320, 潤州鶴林寺故徑山大師碑銘, by 李華
teacher.quote: 融授岩大師，岩授方大師，方授持大師，持授威大師，凡七世矣
teacher.note: 方授持大師 — 'Fang conferred it on Master Chi'.

teacher.quote: 融授巖大師，巖授方大師，方授持大師，持授威大師，凡七世矣
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster: 方 (Huifang) -> 持 (Fachi).

teacher.quote: 第二智巖，第三慧方，第四法持，第五智威，第六惠忠也
teacher.note: The Zutangji's numbered Oxhead succession: 2 Zhiyan, 3 Huifang, 4 FACHI, 5 Zhiwei, 6 Huizhong.

teacher.quote: 牛頭宗第四世祖師，俗姓張…年十三聞黃梅弘忍大師之名，特往禮謁，蒙示法要。後參侍牛頭宗慧方禪師，得其心印，遂繼山門…後傳法於智威禪師
teacher.note: Note he ALSO saw Hongren of Huangmei at thirteen - an association, not the transmission. The transmission (得其心印) is from Huifang.

dates.quote: 長安二年九月五日終于延祚寺。……報齡六十有八矣。（T50n2061_p0757c12）
dates.note: Died Chang'an 2 (702), 9th month, 5th day, aged 68 -> b.635. Roster 635/702 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: sect: 牛頭宗；placeOfBurial: 延祚寺

bio.quote: 金陵延祚寺僧，牛頭宗第四世祖師，俗姓張。儀貌邕肅，膚體至潤，幼而棄俗，長事明師

notes: Fourth patriarch of the Niutou school, bridging Huifang and Zhiwei. He maintained the community at Mount Niutou during the period when Shenxiu's Northern school was ascendant. He deepened the school's integration of Madhyamaka emptiness with Chan practice.

bio: Lay surname Chen, of Shimen in Lizhou; styled Fazhu. His parents both died when he was twenty and he gave up his Confucian studies; at twenty-five, feeling he could never repay their kindness, he left the world and was tonsured by Changming Jiong at Mt Qixing in Cili. He worked on the huatou 'the three are-nots' and attended him three years, took full ordination under Yingxiu at Mt Long, then followed Jiong to Mingshan in Yuanzhou and served him seven years more, receiving his seal. He was abbot of Pufeng temple on Mt Tianyun in Chenzhou. He edited his master's recorded sayings and left two fascicles of his own; he had twelve heirs.

steles.title: 浦峰法柱棟禪師語錄 卷2 行狀
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 師諱海棟，號法柱，姓陳氏。先大人名三桂，母趙姓，澧洲石門人也。廿齡，父母雙逝，悉廢儒業。至二十五歲，因思親恩難報，乃棄俗出家，往慈利七星山禮長明炅和尚披剃，參三不是，親炙三載，到龍山穎秀師翁座下圓具，又隨炅至沅州明山巾瓶七載。
steles.note: His own account-of-conduct. Names his father (三桂) and mother (Zhao), and gives the whole apprenticeship under Changming Jiong.

steles.title: 長明和尚塔銘 (his MASTER's stupa inscription - which Haidong himself commissioned)
steles.author: unnamed
steles.quote: 公諱性炅，號長明，蜀東涪陵石氏子也。有嗣法門人法柱求銘於予，以為久長記。予按公行實，幼年禮極初老宿剃落…迺上黔中思南東山參穎秀悟和尚，直叩濟北宗旨。
steles.note: ⚠ THE BRIEF'S EXACT PATTERN - the stele is in the OTHER man's book. Changming's 塔銘 opens by saying 「有嗣法門人法柱求銘於予」 - 'his dharma-heir FAZHU came to me asking for the inscription.' So Haidong is named, as heir, in his master's stupa inscription, which he himself commissioned. It also supplies the master's full name (性炅) and the generation above (穎秀悟).

teacher.quote: 往慈利七星山禮長明炅和尚披剃…又隨炅至沅州明山巾瓶七載
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster.

teacher.quote: 有嗣法門人法柱求銘於予
teacher.note: The master's own stupa inscription names Fazhu as his dharma-heir. Two independent stele-rung witnesses to one edge.

teacher.quote: 號法柱，為長明性炅禪師（？-1668）法嗣。澧洲石門人，俗姓陳。
浦峯法柱棟禪師語錄二卷 清海棟說…南嶽下第三十八世，嗣長明炅
teacher.note: Catalogue tag: 38th generation, heir of Changming Jiong. It also tags Changming himself (0340a01) as 「南嶽下第三十七世，嗣穎秀悟」.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳
dates.note: DATES GENUINELY UNKNOWN. Left null.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Lay surname Lin, of Houguan (Fuzhou). At fifteen his parents put him with his uncle Zhilong at Guangxiao in Wanling; he took the full precepts at eighteen. He called first on Tieniu Yin and travelled widely among the elders, keeping long company with Shaoshi Mu and Wuji Pai. He met Zheweng Ruyan at Tiantong - 'needle and mustard-seed found each other' - but knowing he was not yet settled he went to him again at Shuangjing, and there his lifelong doubt melted at a stroke. From 1228 he held Xiao Jingci, and then Xiangshan, Wanshou, Xuedou, Ayuwang, Jingci, Lingyin and finally Jingshan. In 1261 he was granted the title Fozhi chanshi. He died on 14/6 of 1263, aged 75, with 58 summers. His heir Yunfeng Miaogao carried the line on.

steles.title: 偃溪廣聞禪師語錄 卷2 塔銘
steles.author: unnamed; the request for it is recorded
steles.quote: 徑山暉首座不遠千里來求 偃溪塔銘，予老病不能文，以詩謝之 漢 頓首。／金剛眼要筆頭點，妙喜當年竟脫空。千里還山無一字，乃為不負偃溪翁。 甲子三月晦日
steles.note: A REFUSAL, preserved. The head monk Hui of Jingshan travelled a thousand li to ask a certain 'Han' for Yanxi's stupa inscription; the old man declined on grounds of age and illness and sent a poem instead - 'a thousand li back to the mountain without a single word; that is how I do not fail old Yanxi.' Dated the last day of the 3rd month, jiazi (1264), the year after his death. The actual 塔銘 is in the same fascicle (DILA cites 《偃溪廣聞禪師語錄》卷 2〈塔銘〉 for his dates).

teacher.quote: 次拈香云：此香輕如山嶽，重似毫毛…供養前住徑山興聖萬壽禪寺。特賜佛心禪師浙翁大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: His own 偃溪廣聞禪師語錄. 浙翁 + the imperial title 佛心禪師 + the 徑山 seat identify 如琰 unambiguously. The stick before it went to the patron-official; only this one is the dharma-milk stick.

teacher.quote: 次，拈香云：此一瓣香，奉為前住徑山興聖萬壽禪寺特賜佛心禪師大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: Repeated at his 淨慈 enthronement.

teacher.quote: 臨安淨慈偃溪廣聞禪師，侯官林氏。浙翁如琰（1151-1225）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十九世…參浙翁琰於天童，再參於雙徑
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher (Zheweng Ruyan).

dates.quote: 景定四年六月十四日，住世七十五年（《偃溪廣聞禪師語錄》卷 2〈塔銘〉）
dates.note: From his own stupa inscription: died 1263-07-27 aged 75 -> b.1189.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有雲峰妙高、鐵鏡至明等

bio.kind: authority record (from 增集續傳燈錄 + 塔銘)
bio.quote: 年十五，父母以宿緣，俾從小父智隆於宛陵光孝。十八受戒具…紹定戊子四明制閫，胡公以小淨慈致之

bio: A descendant of the Han grand preceptor Qiao Zhou; his family lived below Mt Yang in Yuechi, Anhan. Born 7/10 of 1605 to Sheng Gong and his wife Yang. He recited the Four Books at five, knew the Spring and Autumn at ten, and after borrowing a Heart Sutra from a monk said 'this is the utmost of sages' and set his mind on leaving the world; at thirteen, about to be betrothed, he saw an old monk sitting under a tree looking like an ancient buddha, and left home. He lectured on the Surangama at twenty-five and drew crowds at Niushan and Huanglong. In 1632 he went to Poshan Haiming at Shuanggui and, after twenty-one days of total impasse, broke through at a shout from Zhu Weitai; Poshan made him head of the western hall. He was caught in the massacres of 1644-45; in the spring of 1645, held in a military camp at Liangshan, he announced 'I have never taken food that was not righteous - and shall I take pleasure in this, among spears?', stopped eating, and on the first day of the third month gave a final address, shouted once, sat upright and died, aged 41.

steles.title: 夔州府臥龍寺字水圓䂐禪師行狀
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 師諱圓䂐，字字水，鐵龍其別號也。漢太師譙周之後。家安漢岳池羊山下。父聖功，母楊氏。生明萬曆乙巳十月七日，有異兆，人多奇之。五歲入塾，能誦四書，頗敦敏。十歲知《春秋》，能文，常喜與僧談。
steles.note: His account-of-conduct, in his own recorded sayings. Everything in the bio above comes from it (and from DILA's fuller transcription of the same, A010152).

teacher.quote: 雙桂破山海明禪師法嗣…崇禎壬申棲靈寺聞破山老人自嘉禾還蜀，往謁雙桂明…師被此語激發…因竺微泰師一喝，師桶底脫也。雙桂明即命師充西堂
teacher.note: CONFIRMS roster. Poshan Haiming of Shuanggui; the awakening and the appointment as head of the western hall are both recorded.

dates.quote: 生明萬曆乙巳十月七日
dates.note: Born Wanli yisi = 1605, 10th month, 7th day.

dates.quote: death +1645-03-28 「乙酉三月朔日，世壽四十有一」（《五燈全書》卷70）
dates.note: Died 1645, aged 41. Consistent with b.1605.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio: Lay surname Xu, a man of Jingmen. Abbot of the Neihuguo (Inner Protecting-the-State) monastery in Jingnan, where he opened the canon and took the seat in the 3rd month of 1686 at the invitation of the lay patrons Li Yufan and Lu Diaoyuan. He left four fascicles of recorded sayings, prefaced by three officials of the day.

teacher.kind: his OWN 拈香 at the opening of the hall
teacher.quote: 次一瓣香…端為供養本寺功德主 惠藩金靈護國堂上開山師祖 遍知太老和尚。」正拈香云：「此一瓣香，向心地栽培，心地長養…端為拈出，專伸供養現住 五祖別峰老和尚，用酬法乳戒源之恩。」
teacher.note: 🔴 DECISIVE, AND IT CONTRADICTS DILA. The rite distinguishes two sticks. The SECOND stick honours 遍知 as 開山師祖 - the FOUNDING PATRIARCH OF THE TEMPLE, described as its 功德主 (benefactor). The 正拈香 - THE MAIN INCENSE, which by convention is always the dharma-transmission incense - goes to 「現住五祖別峰老和尚」, 'Old Master Biefeng, now residing at Wuzu', 「用酬法乳戒源之恩」, to repay the debt of the milk-of-dharma. The teacher is BIEFENG. DILA (A019549) says 「為護國遍知和尚法嗣」 - it has mistaken the temple's FOUNDER for the man's TEACHER.

teacher.quote: 為護國遍知和尚法嗣。荊門里閈人，俗姓許。住荊南內護國寺。（《荊南內護國寺啟真誠禪師語錄》卷 3〈恩母傳〉）
teacher.note: DISSENTING WITNESS, recorded as required. I do not follow it - see above.

teacher.kind: preface by 胡在恪 (a jinshi official)
teacher.quote: 護國開山遍知和尚，篤實沉著，彷彿面壁氣象。師屬磬山箬老人三代嫡嗣，為遍公傳燈正派
teacher.note: A THIRD reading, from a lay preface: he is 'a third-generation direct heir of Old Man Ruo of Qingshan (箬庵通問), and of Ven. Bian's orthodox lamp-line.' This locates the branch (Qingshan/Ruo'an Tongwen) and muddies 遍/別 again. Another preface (0709b21) calls him 「荊南遍老人後裔，實磬山別老人的派」 - 'descendant of Old Man Bian of Jingnan, truly of the branch of Old Man BIE of Qingshan' - which reads naturally as: Bian founded the house, Bie transmitted the dharma. That is exactly the incense's division.

dates.quote: 生卒年不詳
dates.note: DATES UNKNOWN. Anchor: he took the seat in the 3rd month of Kangxi 25 = 1686 (J37nB395 0711a04), and prefaces are dated 1686.

school.quote: 師屬磬山箬老人三代嫡嗣

bio.quote: 荊門里閈人，俗姓許。住荊南內護國寺

bio: Lay surname Hou, of Xinning in Kuizhou; styled Zhuanjing (Brick Mirror), sobriquet Shanhui. Tonsured in 1638 by Shipu Zhuo. Wrestling with the Nanquan koan he forgot food and sleep, and then 'the ice broke up' at his teacher's snow-day address, after which his repartee ran free. He called on Wanfeng and Hongjue, and received the seal from Bao'en Tongxian (Fushi). He held Huguo at Pingyue, Wanshou at Xingqing, Sheng'en at Wengan, Changsong at Huangping, and Fuhai at Gaoyou. He died in 1687 and his stupa stands at Yongquan cloister on Tiger Hill, Suzhou.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 transmission-incense, at his 開堂 (山暉禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 遂陞座，拈香祝聖罷，末後拈香云：「棲靈室中碎破肝膽，報恩寺裏遞剝家私，如今不免供養我浮石禪師大和尚。」
teacher.note: THE LAST STICK — 末後拈香 — after the emperor's. 供養我浮石禪師大和尚: MY master Fushi. And he places the transmission at the two temples where it happened: 棲靈 (where he broke his liver and gall) and 報恩 (where the family property was stripped from him) — 報恩寺 is precisely where 通賢 sat, which is why the man is also called 報恩通賢. First-person, at the enthronement.

teacher.quote: 字磚鏡，號山暉，為報恩通賢禪師（1593-1667）法嗣。夔州新寧人，俗姓侯。崇禎十一年（1638）禮石蒲拙薙落…後謁萬峰、弘覺，受報恩賢記莂
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. 報恩通賢 = 浮石通賢 (Bao'en was his temple). 記莂 = received the prediction/seal.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A012052 通賢 (浮石通賢)
teacher.note: Batch's identification CONFIRMED. This also settles the conflict the bridge file flagged: 磚鏡 / 山暉 / 完璧 / 行澣 are ONE man, an heir of Fushi Tongxian.

dates.quote: birth 1621「明天啟辛酉生」；death 1687「丁卯寂」（陳援庵《明季滇黔佛教考》卷 1）
dates.note: From Chen Yuan's study of Buddhism in Ming-era Yunnan-Guizhou. Both dates supplied where the harvest had none.

dates.quote: birth +1621 「明天啟辛酉生」; death +1687 「丁卯寂」（陳援庵《明季滇黔佛教考》卷1〈滇黔僧多蜀籍第四〉）
dates.note: Batch had no dates; now 1621-1687, on Chen Yuan's authority.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派
夔州新寧人，姓侯，荊南開聖僧人

bio.quote: 歷住平越護國、興慶萬壽、甕安聖恩、黃平長松、高郵福海等諸剎。康熙二十六年（1687）示寂，塔於蘇州虎丘山涌泉禪院

bio: Lay surname Zhao, of Wuwei prefecture; styled Zisu. He left home at six under Shuijie Quan at Mt Simian, and later lived at Moyun hermitage on Mt Lu'an. At twenty-two he took the full precepts under the elder Yuan of Huishan, then studied vinaya with Jianyue at Huashan and called on Tianzhang of Guangjiao. At thirty-four he came to Wenruo Xingying at Fushan, who made him rector; after a seven-day intensive he broke through the ball of doubt, and became the direct heir of the Fushan elder in the orthodox Linji line. In the 8th month of 1672 he took up residence at the old Panlong monastery on Mt Zhongnan in Huazhou, and gave the ascent-of-the-hall there in 1678. He died 4/11 of 1689, aged 59, leaving twelve heirs.

steles.title: 終南山蟠龍子肅禪師語錄 卷1 行實
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 崇禎辛未十月十八辰時生。
steles.note: His account-of-deeds, in his own recorded sayings; DILA A001373 cites it for his birth and quotes it at length for the career. I did not open the page myself, so the lb is left null - the citation is DILA's, and it names the 行實 explicitly.

teacher.quote: 字子肅，為文弱行盈禪師法嗣…三十四歲參浮山文弱行盈和尚，命為悅眾。打七後參破疑團，傳臨濟正宗三十三代龍池萬老和尚法孫，浮山文老僧之嫡嗣。（《終南山蟠龍子肅禪師語錄》卷 1；《緇門世譜》卷 1）
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher AND EXPANDS THE NAME: 文弱盈 -> 文弱行盈. Note the lineage self-description: 'dharma-grandson of Old Man Wan of Longchi, 33rd generation of the orthodox Linji line, direct heir of the old monk Wen of Fushan.'

teacher.source: X86n1603 (終南山天龍會集緇門世譜), per harvest
teacher.quote: 33rd generation of the orthodox Linji line, with twelve heirs listed
teacher.note: Harvest finding, corroborated by DILA's citation of 《緇門世譜》卷 1 in the same record.

dates.quote: birth 「崇禎辛未十月十八辰時生。」（〈行實〉）；death 「清時己巳年十一月初四日寅時。」
dates.note: b.1631-11-11, d.1689-12-15 aged 59. Harvest had no dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派

bio.quote: 六歲出家于四面山水潔泉禪師座前，後住六安山摩雲菴…次參華山見月和尚學律

bio: Lay surname Zhuang, of Quanzhou. He came to the capital as a young man and was ordained at Tianqing temple after passing the sutra examination. He called on Nanchan Qingya at Sanqu, then studied the Huayan deeply under Dinghui Zunshi in Eastern Wu. Hearing that Lingyuan Weiqing had opened the dharma at Taiping, he went; at an evening session Lingyuan's words struck exactly at his illness and he came to himself. He entered his room, and Lingyuan forged him with the wisdom of distinctions and enjoined silence on him - he attended him for ten years. Foj:ian Qin later made him a seating master. He opened the dharma at Ganlu, then Zifu in Luzhou and Tianning in the Eastern Capital (Kaifeng). His conduct was so severe that he was nicknamed 'Iron Face'. He died seated, having taken leave of the assembly, on 27/12 of 1123, aged 59, with 32 summers. He had eight heirs, including Jiechen, who edited his record.

steles.title: 長靈守卓禪師語錄 卷1 行狀
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄, edited by his heir 介諶)
steles.quote: 宣和五年十二月二十七日，辭眾安坐而化，閱世五十九，坐三十二夏
steles.note: His account-of-conduct, appended to his 語錄. Quoted via DILA A008373, which cites 《長靈守卓禪師語錄》卷一〈行狀〉. Its existence is independently confirmed by the Jiaxing catalogue - see below.

steles.title: 長靈守卓禪師語錄一卷附室中垂語百問一卷
steles.author: n/a
steles.quote: 長靈守卓禪師語錄一卷附室中垂語百問一卷 宋守卓說，介諶編，有行狀及附記，首題長靈和尚語錄，尾題東京天寧萬壽禪寺長靈卓和尚語錄…南嶽下第十四世，嗣靈源清。
steles.note: The canon catalogue independently attests BOTH that a 行狀 is appended AND that he is 「嗣靈源清」 - heir of Lingyuan Qing. Two facts for the price of one line.

teacher.quote: 南嶽下第十四世，嗣靈源清
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher (Lingyuan Weiqing).

teacher.quote: 東京天寧長靈守卓禪師，泉州莊氏子。靈源惟清（？-1117）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十五世…聞靈源開法太平，道鳴四方，即往造。值夜參，適中其病，遂猛省。投誠入室，源鍛以差別機智，且戒其緘默，隨侍十載。

dates.quote: 「宣和五年十二月二十七日，閱世五十九」（《長靈守卓禪師語錄》卷一〈行狀〉）
dates.note: Died Xuanhe 5, 12th month, 27th day = 1124-01-22 (the Chinese year runs into the Western 1124), aged 59 -> b.1066. Harvest had no dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 黃龍派；法嗣有介諶、普明、慧琳等八人

bio.quote: 師行謹嚴，人稱「鐵面」。又嘗居太平長靈，被稱曰「長靈禪師」

bio: Lay surname Zhang, of Zhongzhou in Chongqing. A dream moved him to seek a master at twelve, but he was not tonsured until twenty. He took the precepts under Xiangya and worked on 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one - what does the one return to?'; one day body, mind and world fell away and everything was vast and empty. He then went to Poshan Haiming at Shuanggui, and afterwards followed Zhangxue Tongzui to Hanzhong, opening the dharma at Jingming; at his master's first discourse his breast opened, and he received the seal and succeeded him in the seat. He held Jingming and Baolin in Hanzhong and Shangshan temple in Yunnan fu. He died in 1694, aged 79. His heir was Feizhi Ming of Jingci in Jiangjin.

steles.title: 懶石聆禪師語錄 卷3 行繇
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣…後參雙桂明和尚，侍丈和尚過漢中，開法靜明。一見提唱，胸次豁然，受印可而繼席。
steles.note: His 行繇 (a rarer word for account-of-conduct), appended to his recorded sayings; cited via DILA A016419, which names 《懶石聆禪師語錄》卷 3〈行繇〉. It records BOTH that he first went to Poshan and THEN followed Zhangxue - which is precisely the distinction the roster's compilers kept getting wrong.

teacher.quote: 為丈雪通醉禪師（1610-1696）法嗣…侍丈和尚過漢中，開法靜明。一見提唱，胸次豁然，受印可而繼席。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher (Zhangxue Tongzui). ⚠ AND IT DISARMS THE TRAP: he ALSO visited Poshan Haiming (雙桂明) first. A careless compiler would have made Poshan his teacher - the exact 'first teacher, not the transmitter' error the brief warns of. The 受印可而繼席 (received the seal and succeeded to the seat) attaches unambiguously to ZHANGXUE.

dates.quote: 卒於：大清, 聖祖, 康熙, 三十三年，79歲；death +1694-01-25 ~ +1695-02-12 「清康熙三十二年卒，年七十九。」（疑年錄：445）
dates.note: Died 1694 aged 79 -> b.1616. Harvest had no dates. ⚠ DILA's own header (康熙33) and its quoted source (康熙32) disagree by one year; I take 1694, DILA's computed value.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有非指明禪師、來一禪師、旨鏡禪師

bio.quote: 重慶忠州人，俗姓張。十二歲夢感投師，廿歲方薙染。於象崖和尚受具，看「萬法歸一，一歸何處？」話。忽一日不覺身心世界，渾然虛豁豁地。

bio: Lay surname Liu, of Changshu (Yushan) in Suzhou; styled Tianshu. Born 14/12 of 1632; the night before his birth his mother dreamt of the sun rising in the east. At one year old his left arm withered; an old monk passing by stroked his head and said 'this is a man of the patriarchs' place - the illness is not worth worrying about', so his father named him Liu Zu ('Liu the patriarch'), and he recovered. At fifteen he told his mother he was leaving and went to Maian De at Poshan; he was tonsured at nineteen. In 1651 he paid respects to Muyun Tongmen, and in 1656 took the full precepts under Feiyin Tongrong. Grinding wheat one day he went utterly still, and when a fellow monk pushed his hand and said 'why not put your back into it?', he shoved the millstone forward and broke through completely. When Muyun was about to die in the winter of 1671 he handed him the dharma robe, and Xingzhi succeeded to the seat at Helin. He died in the 10th month of 1680, aged 49; his stupa is in the eastern grove by the Cuckoo Tower at Helin.

steles.title: 鶴林天樹植禪師塔銘
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 鶴林天樹植禪師塔銘。師諱行植，字天樹，蘇之常熟劉氏子。母張氏，誕師於崇禎壬申臘月十四日。將生之夕，夢日輪東昇。及期歲，左臂患癱，有老僧過之，摩其頂曰：「此祖位中人也，病不足憂耳。」父即命名曰劉祖，未幾果平復。三、四歲最穎異，七歲就塾。
steles.note: His stupa inscription, in his own recorded sayings. The whole childhood - the dream, the withered arm, the old monk, the name 'Liu the patriarch' - is here. His 行實 is in the same fascicle (DILA cites 卷 1〈行實〉、〈塔銘〉).

teacher.quote: 字天樹，為牧雲通門禪師（1599-1671）法嗣…辛卯秋（1651）禮牧雲門和尚…辛亥冬（1671）門將示寂，復以法衣授師，繼席鶴林。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. The dying master hands over the dharma robe - transmission at its plainest.

teacher.quote: 投破山邁菴德禪師出家，年十九薙染…丙申冬（1656）往堯峰費隱容和尚處受具戒
teacher.note: 🔑 THE HARVEST'S KEY POINT, CONFIRMED: the record CAREFULLY DISTINGUISHES his TONSURE master (邁菴 Maian) and his ORDINATION master (費隱通容 Feiyin) from his DHARMA master (牧雲通門 Muyun). Three different men, three different relationships. This is the single clearest example in my batch of a source doing precisely what the old roster failed to do.

dates.quote: 誕師於崇禎壬申臘月十四日
dates.note: Born Chongzhen renshen, 12th month, 14th day = 1633-01-23 (the lunar 12th month of 1632 falls in Western 1633).

dates.quote: 康熙十九年（1680）冬十月示寂，世壽四十九
dates.note: Died 1680 aged 49.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣為天孚湛祐禪師

bio: Lay surname Yang, of Nanchong in Guocheng. He wanted to leave the world from boyhood but his parents refused, so he took up the Diamond Sutra as his practice. When both parents died in 1648, he was thirty - and he went at once to Fayu and was tonsured. Setting out south to study with Bai Zhai, he met Wuzhu, who set him on the 'ten thousand dharmas' koan; he called on Yunce, and then on Poshan Haiming, from whom he received transmission in 1659. He held Fozi temple on Mt Longyin in Pengxi, Guangde cloister in Suining, and Zifu cloister in Xichong. He had twelve heirs. Neither his death-year nor his full lifespan is known; the one fixed point is that in 1660 he was forty-two.

steles.title: 寂光豁禪師語錄 卷4 行實
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 己未十一月二十四子時
steles.note: His account-of-deeds, in his own recorded sayings, giving his birth to the hour: the zi hour, 24th day, 11th month, jiwei = 1619-12-29. Cited via DILA A016439, which gives the exact lb (J36nB367_p0870b15).

teacher.quote: 為破山海明禪師（1597-1666）法嗣…又參允冊禪師，謁破山禪師。己亥歲（1659）得破山禪師付法。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. 付法 in 1659 - the transmission is dated.

dates.quote: 己未十一月二十四子時
dates.note: Born 1619-12-29. Harvest had no birth date; now supplied from his own 行實.

dates.quote: 卒年及世壽均不詳，僅知順治十七年（1660），時年四十二。
dates.note: DEATH GENUINELY UNKNOWN, and DILA says so. The roster's 'floruit 1660' is exactly this anchor - the year he was 42. Death left null.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有月輝常明、雪軒發一、笑蒼發育等十二人

bio.quote: 果城南充人，俗姓楊。幼負出塵之志，父母鞿鞚不許，遂持金剛經為業。戊子歲（1648）年三十父母繼逝，遂投法雨禪師落髮。

bio: Lay surname Li, of Sanwu (Sanwu station); styled Biemu, childhood name Shanbao. He would not eat meat even in swaddling clothes, and as a small child, taken to the hermitage by his mother, would kneel with palms joined whenever he heard the sutras chanted. A dream at fifteen settled his resolve; his mother refused him, so he slipped away by night to Fuyuan hermitage and was tonsured by Hongjue. He took the novice precepts at Yishan, was set on 'the original face', and had an opening one day at the cry of a cat. He was fully ordained in 1659, followed Jingting to Yishan the next year, and in 1662 helped found Nanyuan. In conversation with his master one day he was seized with awe; at the fifth watch he heard the bell, the sweat poured off him, and everything he had held dissolved. He received transmission in 1677 and held Hongsheng at Nanyuan (Quanzhou) and Jisheng at Caoshan. Neither his death-year nor his lifespan is known; he was alive in 1697, aged sixty.

steles.title: 別牧純禪師語錄 卷1 行實
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 生於明崇禎戊寅五月二十日
steles.note: His account-of-deeds, in his own recorded sayings; cited via DILA A000990, which quotes it for his birth and reproduces the whole career from it.

teacher.quote: 字別牧，為逕庭德宗禪師（1621-1684）法嗣…後謁逕和尚。於順治己亥年（1659）圓具，明年隨逕和尚主席嶷山，康熙壬寅（1662）同創南源…康熙丁巳年（1677）得付法。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher AND EXPANDS THE NAME: 逕庭宗 -> 逕庭德宗 (1621-1684). Transmission dated 1677.

dates.quote: birth 「生於明崇禎戊寅五月二十日」（〈行實〉）= 1638-07-01
dates.note: Harvest's 'born 1638 (崇禎戊寅)' CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 卒年及世壽不詳，僅知康熙丁丑年（1697）仍在世，時年六十。
dates.note: DEATH GENUINELY UNKNOWN. The roster's 'floruit 1689' is loose; the real anchors are 1689 (entering Nanyuan) and 1697 (still alive, aged 60). Death left null.

school.quote: dynasty: 明 清；placeOfOrigin: 三吾站

bio.quote: 在襁褓不茹葷，兒時常隨母入菴，聞經聲則合掌跪聽，好跏趺。年十五因夢而決出塵之志，遂辭母，母不許，乃宵遁福緣菴禮弘覺禪師薙落…一日忽聞貓叫，有省。

bio: Lay surname Zhang, of Xiushui (Jiaxing); styled Wanru. At nineteen he was tonsured by Hanchu at Xingshan temple in his own prefecture. Four years later, moved at Yuanzheng temple in Tiaoshang, he pricked his blood and copied out the Lotus Sutra, then chanted it for three winters and summers without a break. Reading Yunqi Zhuhong's Chan Whip he took up Zhaozhou's 'No', and asked Wengu for guidance. An opening came while reading the Surangama; he crossed the Qiantang into Mt Yunmen and put the 'no-dream, no-thought' question to Zhanran. Then he went to Tiantong (Miyun Yuanwu) at Jinsu, and at thirty-nine he was thoroughly through. Miyun kept him on the mountain at his seventieth-birthday celebration in 1635. In the winter of 1640 he opened the dharma at Ruru cloister, then held Caoshan in Putian, and returned to Longchi when Miyun died. He died at the si hour on 29/10 of 1657, aged 64, with 45 dharma-years; he taught thousands and sealed several dozen heirs.

steles.kind: 塔銘 / 行狀 / 行實
steles.title: 萬如禪師語錄 卷10 - 塔銘, 行狀 and 行實 (all three)
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 生于萬曆甲午五月十五日寅時 … 示寂於順治丁酉十月二十九日巳時
steles.note: An unusually rich dossier: DILA A012040 cites 《萬如禪師語錄》卷 10〈塔銘〉, 〈行狀〉 AND 〈行實〉 - three separate death-documents for one man - plus 卷 1〈荊溪龍池老和尚列傳〉. Birth and death are given to the hour.

teacher.quote: 字萬如，天童悟禪師法嗣…後參天童於金粟，年三十九了徹。崇禎乙亥冬天童老人七十大慶，老人提獎留住山…天童老人示寂，歸龍池。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. 天童悟 = Miyun Yuanwu (his seat was Tiantong). ⚠ MERGE HAZARD: this 圓悟 is NOT Yuanwu Keqin - see the warning on that entry.

dates.kind: 語錄 卷1 via authority record
dates.quote: birth 生于萬曆甲午五月十五日寅時 (1594-07-02)；death 示寂於順治丁酉十月二十九日巳時 (1657-11-04)
dates.note: Aged 64. Harvest had no dates; the roster's 'floruit 1640' is the year he opened Ruru cloister.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；嗣印者有永泰模、鐵關能、古帆楫、佛可式等數十人

bio.quote: 年十九依本郡興善寺涵初上人剃染，凡四載過苕上圓證寺會有所感，瀝血手書《法華經》，繼以讀誦歷三寒暑不輟。閱雲棲《禪關策進》，提撕趙州無字話

bio: Lay surname Peng, of Weichuan village, Yunlin, Fuzhou fu; styled Guantao. Born in the spring of 1625. At nineteen, finding the taste of the world flat, he went to Mt Xiang to learn the dharma that leaves the world. He called on Tiesuo of Raoshan at Luyang and took the full precepts at the Longhu ordination platform in Shaowu. Sealing himself in a hermitage on Juexian peak in Xu, he turned over the line 'not thinking of good, not thinking of evil - which is the Reverend's original face?', and suddenly had an opening. After wide travels he came to Abbot Sheng of Tianjie (Juelang Daosheng) and received transmission. He held Chongxian Xianxiao on Mt Gaoting and Shouchang in Xincheng. He died on 10/7 of 1678, aged 54, with 35 dharma-years. His heir was Qiyuan Xingquan of Gaoting.

steles.title: 觀濤奇禪師語錄 卷6 壽藏銘并序
steles.author: unnamed (appended to his own 語錄)
steles.quote: 誕於天啟乙丑之春 … 康熙戊午七月初十，世壽五十有四。
steles.note: A 壽藏銘 - an inscription for a tomb prepared during the subject's own lifetime, then completed at death. Cited via DILA A016501 for both birth and death. A rarer genre than 塔銘 and worth flagging as such.

teacher.quote: 字觀濤，為天界道盛禪師（1593-1659）法嗣…後謁天界盛和尚，得付法。
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher. 天界道盛 = 覺浪道盛 (Tianjie was his seat).

dates.quote: birth 「誕於天啟乙丑之春。」(1625)；death 「康熙戊午七月初十，世壽五十有四。」(1678-08-26)
dates.note: Harvest had no dates.

school.quote: sect: 曹洞宗；法嗣為杭州臯亭山顯孝淇園興泉禪師

bio.quote: 撫州雲林渭川里人，俗姓彭。年十九世味泊然思欲出塵，投項山學出世法…掩關於旴之覺僊峰，思惟「不思善不思惡，那個是明上座本來面目？」之句，忽然有省。

bio: Lay surname Qiu, of Gui'an in Wuxing; styled Mingbiao, self-styled the Reverend At-Ease. At barely six he served Baoxian at Jiekong cloister on Mt Wu; he did not get the monk's robe until twenty-six. Watching a lion-dance he suddenly matched the mind-dharma, and went on to receive the essentials of the Surangama from the Tiantai master Renyue. Then he met Chan master Qiyue (Baojue); their meeting struck fire, and he leapt up unbidden and threw himself into the posture of a lion - which Qiyue approved, and from then on the monasteries elegantly nicknamed him 'Duan the Lion'. Chancellor Zhang Dun admired his way and invited him in person to open the dharma at Wushan; he later moved to Xiyu in Huzhou. He died on 5/12 of 1103, aged 74, with 49 dharma-years.

steles.title: 端禪師行業記
steles.author: 劉燾
steles.author_note: 起服朝請郎權發遣提點淮南東路刑獄公事借紫金魚袋郡人 - a serving Song judicial commissioner, and a fellow townsman. He both composed AND wrote out the inscription (撰并書).
steles.quote: 宋故吳山端禪師，諱淨端，字明表，俗姓丘氏，吳興歸安人也。丞相舒王道德之學，出言為經，局貫九流，尤味禪悅。常見師偈頌，稱之曰：有本者如是爾。
steles.note: A named contemporary official at a named grave. It opens by recording that Chancellor Wang Anshi (舒王) himself praised Duan's verses: 'one who has a root is like this.' The same fascicle also carries his 墓誌 (〈宋故安閑和尚端師墓誌〉) and a 傳 (〈西余端禪師傳〉) - THREE death-documents.

teacher.quote: 後參寶覺齊岳禪師，機緣相契，不覺奮迅翻身作狻猊狀，岳因可之，自是叢林雅號為「端獅子」。（《吳山淨端禪師語錄》卷 2〈端禪師行業記〉）
teacher.note: The teacher is QIYUE (齊岳), and the transmission moment is the lion-leap, which Qiyue approved (可之).

teacher.quote: 保暹、淨覺仁岳、寶覺齊岳弟子。《禪學大辭典．禪宗法系譜》：9列為金山寶覺弟子，應是與寶覺齊岳相濫，今不取。
teacher.note: 🔴 DILA EXPLICITLY REJECTS A RIVAL READING: some charts make him a disciple of 金山寶覺 (Baojue of Jinshan); DILA says this is a CONFUSION with 寶覺齊岳 (Qiyue, whose title was Baojue) and does not adopt it.

teacher.quote: 湖州吳山端禪師語錄二卷 宋淨端說，師皎重編…有傳及行業記、墓誌、真讚。南嶽下第十二世，嗣金山覺。
teacher.note: ⚠ THE CATALOGUE CARRIES THE VERY ERROR DILA WARNS AGAINST: 「嗣金山覺」. Recorded here as the dissenting witness. I follow DILA and the 行業記: the man is QIYUE. NOTE the roster's own designation is 龍華齊岳 (Longhua Qiyue) - a THIRD epithet for what is most likely the same 齊岳 (Longhua = a seat, Baojue = a title). All three strings must be folded, or this teacher will split into three men.

dates.quote: 崇寧二年十二月初五日示寂，俗壽七十四歲，僧臘四十九年。
dates.note: Died Chongning 2, 12th month, 5th day = 1104-01-11 (the lunar 12th month of 1103 falls in Western 1104), aged 74 -> b.1031. Harvest had no dates.

bio: Lay surname Yan, of Wucheng; styled Yinzhong, sobriquet Songji. At seventeen he was tonsured at Mt Daochang, and then relied on Yuanxiu at Qingshan (Tianyin). He attended him long, and one day, hearing a thrush sing, had a great awakening; he received the dharma and succeeded to the seat at Qingshan. Illness took him to convalesce at Yangshan. One day he rose, bathed, changed his robes, sat cross-legged and wrote: 'In past years, at fifty, I knew my faults; this year, at fifty, I know where to stop. Do not say the sun comes out and affairs arise - trust in the plain, direct pointing.' He threw down the brush and died - then after a long while opened his eyes again and charged the assembly: on every new and full moon, gather and bow to the patriarchs of India and China, and then to the two ancestors of Longchi and Qingshan; do not neglect it. Then he closed his eyes and was gone. 22/8 of 1642, aged 50, with 34 dharma-years. His heir was Shending Yunwai Ze.

teacher.kind: his HEIR's transmission-incense — 神鼎雲外澤禪師語錄 (Yunwai Xingze, Tongshou's 嗣法門人)
teacher.quote: 又拈香，云：此一瓣香，諸人還知落處麼？昔日磬山天隱老人常以此穿天下衲僧鼻孔，先師繼席，磬山亦行此令，直得盡大地人沒奈伊何。今日山僧向潭州界內、神鼎山頭第三回拈出…如或未然，先師也該喫我三十棒
teacher.note: This is the THIRD stick — the dharma position, after the emperor and the patrons — raised by Tongshou's own dharma-heir at his own enthronement. He traces the house in one breath: 磬山天隱老人 wielded this command; 先師 (MY LATE MASTER = Tongshou) 繼席 (succeeded to the seat) and 亦行此令 (wielded the same command); and now I raise it a third time. A man who knew Tongshou personally, placing him in the Tianyin house at the moment where a Chan master cannot lie about his lineage.

teacher.source: DILA A010045 (citing 五燈全書 卷68, 續指月錄 卷19)
teacher.quote: 瞑目化去…復開目囑眾曰：每朔、望雲集，禮西天、東土歷祖，後禮龍池、磬山二祖不可忽
teacher.note: Tongshou's OWN last words: he opens his eyes after apparently dying to charge the assembly — on the 1st and 15th, bow to the patriarchs of India and China, and THEN bow to the two ancestors 龍池 and 磬山, 'do not neglect this.' 磬山 = 天隱圓修; 龍池 = 龍池幻有 (Tianyin's own teacher). He names his own dharma-grandfather and father, in his own voice, as his final act. The utterance is first-person; its VEHICLE is a lamp (五燈全書), which is why I grade B and not A.

teacher.quote: 天隱圓修禪師法嗣…年十七投道場山脫白，後依磬山修。久依磬山，一日聞畵眉鳥聲大悟，遂得法，繼席磬山
teacher.note: 遂得法 (thereupon obtained the dharma) — the awakening at the sound of a thrush, under Tianyin at Qingshan.

teacher.quote: 天隱圓修禪師法嗣。烏程嚴氏子，年十七投道場山脫白，後依磬山修。久依磬山，一日聞畵眉鳥聲大悟，遂得法，繼席磬山。
teacher.note: 🔑 CONFIRMS THE HARVEST'S RECONSTRUCTION EXACTLY, AND RESOLVES ITS APPARENT CONTRADICTION. He was Tianyin Yuanxiu's heir AND succeeded him in the seat at Qingshan (繼席磬山) - which is precisely what 「磬山第二代先師授和尚」 ('the late master Shou, second-generation of Qingshan') means in the 祭文 the harvest cited. Second abbot of Qingshan = the man who followed Tianyin there. No contradiction at all.

teacher.quote: 嗣法門人神鼎雲外澤禪師
teacher.note: His heir is 雲外[行]澤 - which is the very man whose 祭文 the bridge evidence rested on. The mourner was his dharma-son.

dates.quote: 「崇禎壬午八月二十二日也，世壽五十，僧臘三十有四。」(《五燈全書》卷 68)
dates.note: Died 1642-09-15, aged 50 -> b.1593. Harvest had no dates.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；activeAt: 陽山松際；南麻明慶寺；常州磬山

bio.kind: authority record (from 續指月錄/五燈全書)
bio.quote: 一日師自起沐浴更衣趺坐書偈：「昔年五十知非，予年五十知止，莫云日出事生，須信分明直指」，遂擲筆而逝。良久復開目囑眾曰：每朔、望雲集，禮西天、東土歷祖，後禮龍池、磬山二祖不可忽復，瞑目化去

bio: Linji master, dharma heir of Jie'an Wujin of Jinming (Jiaxing). His own dharma name is Zhenben. He is remembered mainly through his heir Tan'an Jijun, in whose recorded sayings his exchanges with his master are preserved - among them the question of how the insentient preach the dharma, where Jinming lifted a fallen stick of incense and Pingshan answered that the abbot's staff had gone leaping away.

teacher.kind: his HEIR's 語錄 (普光坦菴禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 因事上堂，舉：「金明師翁拈墜香問瓶山本師云：『無情如何說法？』山云：『和尚拄杖子𨁝跳去也。』明復勘問，山拈墜擲地，叉手而立。明拈墜置於几上，山云：『無情說法竟』」
teacher.note: 🔑 DECISIVE, AND ELEGANT. The speaker is Tan'an Jijun (坦菴機峻). He calls 金明 (= 介庵悟進 of Jinming) his 師翁 - GRAND-teacher - and 瓶山 his 本師 - his OWN teacher. Grand-teacher to teacher to self: 介庵悟進 -> 瓶山[真]本 -> 坦菴機峻. The edge is established from BELOW, by the man who inherited it.

teacher.quote: 普光坦庵禪師語錄一卷 清機峻說，全弘錄，羅開驎序，南嶽下第三十六世，嗣瓶山本。
teacher.note: The catalogue independently tags Jijun as 「嗣瓶山本」 - heir of Pingshan Ben - confirming both the edge below him and the dharma-name graph 本.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第三十一世嘉興金明介庵悟進禪師。初受請徑山萬壽寺結制，及住餘杭廣福、武康天池、禾之金明諸剎
teacher.note: Identifies the teacher: Jie'an Wujin of Jinming, 31st generation Linji. Pingshan appears in his record too (0295c14: 「瓶山則不然…」).

dates.kind: 古瓶山牧道者究心錄 (family record)
dates.quote: 牧道者七世祖也…公生於神宗丁巳，臘月廿一日午時
dates.note: 神宗丁巳=萬曆45=1617 birth; 牧道者=瓶山真本=瓶山次菴. death not stated.

bio: Of Liutang in Songling (Gusu); a child of remarkable memory who is said to have recited a thousand words a day. Because his mother kept the pure precepts he came out of the womb, it was said, knowing nothing of blood and flesh. He went to Rizhu temple in Yuezhou at thirteen and was fully ordained at fifteen. He called on Shiwu Qinggong, then Lanmu at Sanqu, from whom he got the working of samadhi, and then Gumei at Gaoyang; returning home he set himself a limit and did wall-gazing for nine years, burning off a finger every three years - three fingers in all. One day it suddenly flashed clear. He went to Fulin, matched him in dharma combat, and was kept as head of the assembly, aged twenty-eight. Under the Hongwu emperor he was ordered to tonsure a thousand monks; at Fanchang the assembly asked him to open the hall on Mt Donglu. In 1407 the Yongle emperor again ordered him to Tianjie. He died having written 'Blank and abrupt, drifting and soaring - let it all be smashed to pieces, through every land and every mote', throwing down the brush and closing his eyes. His whole body was interred in a stupa on Mt Bafeng. His heirs include Wuji Mingwu.

steles.title: 祖庭古拙俊禪師傳
steles.author: 釋景隆 (in 尚直編)
steles.quote: 古拙禪師生緣松陵之柳塘，因母持淨戒，出胎不知有腥血。六歲出就外傳，不魯典背習法華經，一文一禮，至十歲日誦一部。年十三思脫世累，子夜踰間投城越州日鑄寺者二載
steles.note: A full biography, not a lamp entry. Not a stele in the strict sense (no grave, no death-date), so I do not claim stele rung for it - but it is a named-author 傳 and the richest single source for his life.

teacher.quote: 臨濟第二十世處州福林白雲智度禪師。初住普慈諸剎，洪武己酉應召，尋隱福林。平昔機語不容人錄，古拙俊侍師室中，了明大事，深契牧牛之作，乃付法偈曰：「心中有自心，法中有至法，我今可付囑，心法無心法。」／臨濟第二十一世太平府繁昌八峰山古拙俊禪師。
teacher.note: 🔑 CONFIRMS THE ROSTER, AND OVERTURNS THE HARVEST'S OWN PESSIMISM. The harvest wrote: 'NO non-lamp corroboration was found for this rung - every witness is a lamp or a chart.' But here is the TRANSMISSION VERSE ITSELF: Baiyun Zhidu, 20th generation Linji, whose sayings he would not let anyone record, had Guzhuo Jun attend him in his room, saw he had settled the great matter, and HANDED OVER THE DHARMA WITH A VERSE - 'In the mind there is one's own mind; in the dharma there is the ultimate dharma; I now entrust it to you: mind-dharma is no mind-dharma.' The very next line makes Guzhuo the 21st generation. This is the transmission, in the words used to make it.

teacher.quote: 白雲智度禪師法嗣。姑蘇松陵人…一日忽然瞥地，乃往參福林法戰相契，遂留首眾，時年二十八。
臨濟第二十世處州福林院白雲智度禪師／臨濟第二十一世太平府繁昌八峰山古拙俊禪師／臨濟第二十二世四川東普州道林無際悟禪師
teacher.note: The generations in sequence: Baiyun Zhidu (20) -> Guzhuo Jun (21) -> Wuji Wu (22).

dates.quote: 壬寅十月八日…趺坐而逝。世壽六十八，僧臘五十五
dates.note: 世壽68. 壬寅: he was at 天界 in 永樂丁亥(1407), so 壬寅=永樂20=1422 -> born 1355. Reign bracketed by 1407 activity. TENTATIVE on the cyclical year.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；法嗣有無際明悟、性天如皎等

bio: Dharma heir of Mazu Daoyi, and abbot of Foguang temple in Luoyang; he had earlier lived at Jin'ge temple on Mt Wutai. He is best known for his exchange with Emperor Shunzong, put to him while Shunzong was still crown prince: 'Where does the Buddha come from, and where does he go in extinction? If he is said to abide constantly in the world, where is the Buddha now?' Ruman answered: 'The Buddha comes from the unconditioned and goes in extinction to the unconditioned; his dharma-body is the equal of empty space and abides constantly in the place of no-mind. Where there is thought, it returns to no-thought; where there is abiding, it returns to no-abiding. He comes for the sake of beings and goes for the sake of beings. The pure sea of suchness - still, and its substance constantly abiding.' In old age, living at Xiangshan temple by Longmen, he formed an incense-and-fire society with the poet Bai Juyi and joined the Nine Elders.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 heir-list, 第二世馬祖法嗣
teacher.quote: 〔馬祖法嗣〕…江西北蘭讓禪師　洛京佛光如滿禪師　袁州南源道明禪師…
teacher.note: Listed among Mazu Daoyi's heirs. ⚠ collision guard: there is ALSO a 揚州棲靈寺智通禪師 in this very list — not to be confused, and a separate 如滿 does not exist here.

teacher.quote: 洛京佛光如滿禪師　馬祖一嗣
一曰洛京佛光如滿者
江西北蘭讓禪師 洛京佛光如滿禪師 袁州南源道明禪師
teacher.note: CONFIRMS the harvest. He stands in the Jingde chuandeng lu's list of Mazu's heirs, between Beilan Rang and Nanyuan Daoming.

teacher.kind: 拈古 collection, inline lineage tag
teacher.quote: 洛京佛光如滿禪師 馬祖一嗣
teacher.note: Explicit tag: 'heir of Mazu Yi.'

teacher.quote: 一曰洛京佛光如滿者
teacher.note: Named among Mazu's most eminent heirs (the list runs 大珠慧海, 百丈惟政, 泐潭法會 … 佛光如滿 … 百丈懷海).

teacher.quote: sect: 洪州宗；唐代比丘…晚居洛陽龍門香山寺，白居易時與往還，約入九老會，每結袂出遊，更共結香火社

bio.quote: 洛京佛光如滿禪師曾住五臺山金閣寺。唐順宗問：佛從何方來，滅向何方去？既言常住世，佛今在何處？師荅曰：佛從無為來，滅向無為去，法身等虛空，常在無心處。有念歸無念，有住歸無住。來為眾生來，去為眾生去。清淨真如海，湛然體常住
是歲八月，順宗遜于位…初，順宗甞在東宮問佛光如滿禪師曰
bio.note: Dates the exchange to Shunzong's time as CROWN PRINCE (在東宮), i.e. before his 805 accession - which matches the harvest's 乙酉/805 anchor.

bio: Ming Linji master of Xiushui; dharma heir of Xiao'an Xingmi. His one surviving encounter is with the monk who became his heir: Wunian Zhiyou of Shouzhou came to him, and he asked, 'Where have you walked?' - 'The south.' - 'And how is the Buddha-dharma there?' - 'The mountains and rivers are no different.' - 'How does my hand resemble the Buddha's hand?' Zhiyou stood a long time in silence, and Eryang said, 'Don't go saying there's no difference.'

teacher.kind: 塔銘 (吹萬廣真's stupa inscription)
teacher.quote: 得法於月明聯池老人。池嗣鐵牛遠，遠嗣荊山寶，寶嗣無念有，有嗣二仰欽，欽嗣小庵密，密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益，益嗣淨慈明，明嗣鼓山永，永嗣西禪需，需嗣大慧杲。歷溯源流，師固大慧十四世孫也。
teacher.note: 🔑 A STELE HANDS OVER THIRTEEN GENERATIONS IN ONE SENTENCE - and 「欽嗣小庵密」 ('Qin inherited from Xiao'an Mi') is one of its links. This is the very 塔銘 the BIO_BRIEF used as its worked example. CONFIRMS the harvest's teacher at STELE rung. Duplicated at J29nB238 0470c30.

teacher.quote: 密傳二仰欽，欽傳無念有
teacher.note: The same chain recited in the reverse direction (top-down) in a different text - an independent witness to the same two edges.

teacher.quote: 小菴行密禪師法嗣，法嗣有無念智有。（明清序：013；X84n1582_p0389b19；X63n1244_p0497b01）
teacher.note: EXPANDS BOTH NAMES: 二仰欽 -> 圓欽; 小庵密 -> 小菴行密. This is the coordinator's item '小庵密→小菴行密'.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；dynasty: 明；placeOfOrigin: 秀水

bio.quote: 壽州無念智有禪師，蜀之漢州人，發足南方，遊四明，登天目，後參二仰欽，欽云：「行腳甚處？」師云：「南方。」欽云：「彼中佛法如何？」師云：「山川無異。」欽云：「我手何似佛手？」師良久，欽云：「莫道無異好。」

bio: A nun, and one of the four disciples Bodhidharma named when he took his leave. Asked what she had understood, she said her insight was 'like Ānanda's sight of Akṣobhya's buddha-land — seen once and not seen again,' and Bodhidharma told her she had got his flesh; Huike, who bowed and stood in place, got his marrow. The lamp records file her as one of three side-branch heirs of the 28th patriarch, alongside Daofu and Daoyu. Nothing else about her life is recorded: the authority database gives neither birth nor death year, and the tradition that she was a daughter of Emperor Wu of Liang, surnamed Xiao, named Minglian, comes only from late reference works.

teacher.kind: 續高僧傳 (Daoxuan) 菩提達摩傳 — the earliest biography of Bodhidharma
teacher.quote: 菩提達摩，南天竺婆羅門種…有道育、慧可，此二沙門，年雖在後而銳志高遠。初逢法將，知道有歸，尋親事之，經四五載，給供諮接。感其精誠，誨以真法。
teacher.note: ⚠ CONTRADICTION BY SILENCE. Daoxuan names Bodhidharma's disciples exhaustively — 此二沙門, 'these TWO monks': 道育 and 慧可. There is no 尼總持 and no third or fourth disciple. The table of contents confirms it: 齊鄴下南天竺僧菩提達摩傳五 — 道育 (附見), nobody else.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 (1004) — the skin/flesh/bone/marrow story, where she first appears
teacher.quote: 尼總持曰：我今所解，如慶喜見阿閦佛國，一見更不再見。師曰：汝得吾肉。…最後慧可禮拜後依位而立。師曰：汝得吾髓。
teacher.note: Her ONLY textual existence is as the 'flesh' rung of a four-part rhetorical set-piece (皮/肉/骨/髓) that first appears ~470 years after Bodhidharma. She is a literary position in a parable, not a documented transmission.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄, Bodhidharma's parting examination
teacher.quote: 尼總持曰。我今所解如慶喜見阿閦佛國。一見更不再見。師曰。汝得吾肉。…最後慧可禮拜後依位而立。師曰。汝得吾髓。
teacher.note: She and Huike are examined side by side by Bodhidharma. Huike is her peer, not her teacher.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 table of contents
teacher.quote: 第二十八祖菩提達磨旁出三人一道育禪師二道副禪師三尼總持第二十九祖慧可大師
teacher.note: Filed under Bodhidharma (28th patriarch), NOT under Huike (29th).

teacher.quote: 師事禪宗初祖菩提達磨

school.quote: sect: 禪宗；南北朝時代尼師

bio.quote: 俗姓蕭，名明練，為梁武帝之女；出家後，號總持。…僅知其塔距離少林寺約五里，塔碑為褚詢望所寫。（佛光：6486）
bio.note: DILA relays this from the Foguang dictionary. A stele by 褚詢望 is asserted but I could not find its text in the corpus, so I do not list it as a stele.

notes: Nun and direct disciple of the Second Patriarch Huike. One of few women in early Chan lineage histories.

bio: Surnamed Liu, from Luling. He went young to Huineng and, with Nanyue Huairang, is counted one of the Sixth Patriarch's two great disciples. He then settled at Jingju monastery on Mount Qingyuan in Jizhou, from which his name comes, and the branch descending from him is called 'below Qingyuan' — the Caodong, Yunmen and Fayan houses all issue from it. He died on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month of Kaiyuan 28 (January 741), back in the district of his birth; the court later gave him the title Chan Master Hongji.

teacher.quote: 又釋行思，姓劉氏，廬陵人也…往韶陽見大鑒禪師，一言蔽斷，猶擊蒙焉。既了本心…復吉州闡化，四方禪客繁擁其堂。
teacher.note: 見大鑒禪師 (Huineng) + 既了本心. The 宋高僧傳 confirms the transmission.

teacher.quote: 六祖之下，青原行思、南嶽懷讓並稱二大弟子，同嗣六祖之法。

teacher.kind: authority record + 五燈嚴統 citation
teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 惠能 (X79n1557_p0006b14)
幼年出家，就六祖慧能學法…與南嶽懷讓並稱二大弟子，同嗣六祖之法。

dates.quote: 開元二十八年十二月十三日入滅于本生地。

school.quote: sect: 南宗；其流派相對於南嶽下而稱為青原下

notes: Dharma heir of the Sixth Patriarch. Ancestor of the Caodong, Yunmen, and Fayan lineages.

bio: The most celebrated lay Chan practitioner of the Tang, from Hengyang. He first called on Shitou Xiqian and was a friend of Danxia Tianran, but he received the dharma from Mazu Daoyi, and the lamp records file him under Mazu. He was called the first white-robed layman since Bodhidharma came east, and, with Fu Dashi of the Liang, one of the 'two Vimalakīrtis of the East.' Dying in 808, with the prefect Yu Di at his sickbed, he said: 'Only wish to empty what is there; be careful not to make real what is not' — and was gone.

teacher.kind: 龐居士語錄 — COMPILED BY 于頔 (Yu Di, d. 818), the military governor who was AT HIS DEATHBED
teacher.quote: 居士後之江西，參馬祖大師，問曰：不與萬法為侶者是什麼人？祖曰：待汝一口吸盡西江水，即向汝道。士於言下頓領玄旨，遂呈偈，有『心空及第』之句，乃留駐參承二載。
teacher.note: 頓領玄旨 at Mazu's word, presented an awakening verse, then STAYED TWO YEARS IN ATTENDANCE (參承二載). Note the sequence the record itself preserves: 貞元初，謁石頭禪師 — Shitou is a 謁, a visit, FIRST; Mazu is where the eye opened and where he stayed. First teacher vs dharma-father, and the record keeps them apart.

teacher.kind: the compiler's own presence at the death
teacher.quote: 州牧于頔問疾，士謂之曰：但願空諸所有，慎勿實諸所無。好住世間，皆如影響。言訖，枕于公膝而化。
teacher.note: THIS is why the record ranks as contemporary. Pang Yun died with his head on Yu Di's knee, and Yu Di — 節度使　于頔　編集, on the title byline (lb 0131a08) — is the man who compiled the book. The witness held the body.

teacher.kind: authority record + 五燈嚴統 citation
teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 道一 （X80n1567_p0551a07）
馬祖道一（709-788）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第三世。初謁石頭，與丹霞為友，後參馬祖得法。

dates.quote: death +0808；元和三年歿（一說元和十年，或謂太和年間）
dates.note: DILA itself records the disagreement: Yuanhe 3 (808), or Yuanhe 10 (815), or the Taihe era. I take 808, the majority reading. No birth year is recorded anywhere.

notes: Most celebrated lay Chan practitioner. Dumped his wealth into a river and lived making bamboo utensils.

bio: He was a Confucian student on his way to the examinations when a chance meeting with a Chan monk turned him around. He went to Shitou Xiqian on Nanyue, served three years, and was shaved and ordained there; a visit to Mazu got him the name Tianran, 'Natural.' After three years on Huading peak of Tiantai and a call on Guoyi at Jingshan, he raised the dharma banner on Mount Danxia in Nanyang. He died in the sixth month of Changqing 4 (824), aged eighty-six; he was posthumously titled Chan Master Zhitong and his stupa named Miaojue.

steles.title: (丹霞天然禪師碑)
steles.author: 劉軻 (膳部員外郎)
steles.quote: 膳部員外郎劉軻撰碑紀德焉。勅諡智通禪師，塔號妙覺。
steles.note: Existence and authorship attested by 宋高僧傳; the text itself is not in the corpus. NOT to be quoted — only its existence is established.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳〈唐南陽丹霞山天然傳〉(贊寧, 988) — which CITES HIS STELE by name
teacher.quote: 釋天然，不知何許人也。少入法門，而性梗槩，謁見石頭禪師，默而識之，思召其自體得實者，為立名天然也。乃躬執爨，凡三年，始遂落飾。後於嶽寺希律師受其戒法。造江西大寂會，寂以言誘之，答雅正，大寂甚奇之。…以長慶四年六月告門人曰：「備沐浴，吾將欲行矣。」…春秋八十六。膳部員外郎劉軻撰碑紀德焉。勅諡智通禪師，塔號妙覺。
teacher.note: 「膳部員外郎劉軻撰碑紀德焉」 — HIS STELE EXISTED, cut by a NAMED Tang official (劉軻, 膳部員外郎), and 贊寧 is visibly working from it. The stele itself is not in CBETA, so I grade this B (contemporary), not A — but it is a stele-derived contemporary, not a lamp.

teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 希遷；石頭希遷之門人…投南嶽石頭門下，服役三年，剃髮受戒。尋謁江西馬大師，受天然之法號。
teacher.note: DILA lists two further teachers — 希律師 (ordination preceptor) and 道欽 (國一, whom he visited) — neither is the transmitter. Roster's Shitou stands.

dates.quote: birth +0739; death +0824；卒於：唐,敬宗,長慶,四年,六月，86歲
dates.note: DILA records a variant: 《祖堂集》 gives 長慶三年癸卯歲六月二十三日 (823). I take 824 (長慶四年), the reading DILA itself adopts.

notes: Famous for burning a wooden Buddha statue to warm himself. Studied with both Shitou and Mazu.

bio: Surnamed He, from Xichong. He is the fifth patriarch of Huayan and a holder of the Heze Chan line: he had his mind sealed by the monk Yuan (Suizhou Daoyuan) in 807 and took full ordination under the vinaya master Zheng. Summoned to the palace to lecture in 828, he wrote more than thirty works, among them the Chan Prolegomenon in a hundred fascicles, the Yuanren lun, and the chart of Chan master-disciple succession. He died seated at the Xingfu stupa cloister on the sixth day of the first month of 841, aged sixty-two, in his thirty-fourth year as a monk.

teacher.kind: HIS OWN WORDS — autobiographical passage in his own 圓覺經大疏釋義鈔
teacher.quote: 遂州在涪江西岸。〔宗密〕家貫果州。因遂州有義學院，大闡儒宗，遂投詣進業。經二年後，和尚從西川遊化至此州，遂得相遇。問法契心，如針芥相投也。…疏禪遇南宗者。和尚所得之法，是嶺南曹溪能和尚〔頓教〕。
teacher.note: Zongmi writing about himself (the interlinear note marks the subject 宗密). He was a Confucian student at Suizhou; 和尚 came travelling from West Sichuan; 問法契心 — 'I asked about the dharma and mind matched, like a needle and a mustard-seed meeting'. The 和尚 is 道圓, named explicitly in the lineage passage below.

teacher.kind: HIS OWN WORDS — his own lineage chart, in his own commentary
teacher.quote: 且如第七祖門下，傳法二十二人，且敘一枝者。礠洲法觀寺智如和尚，俗姓王。礠洲門下成都府聖壽寺唯忠和尚，俗姓張，亦号南印。聖壽門下遂洲大雲寺道圓和尚，俗姓程。長慶二年，成都道俗迎歸聖壽寺，紹繼先師，大昌法化，如今現在。
teacher.note: Zongmi sets out his own descent from the Seventh Patriarch (荷澤神會): 智如 -> 唯忠 (號南印) -> 道圓 of 大雲寺 in Suizhou, whose lay surname he even gives (程). He writes 如今現在 — 'he is alive right now'. This is the man himself naming his own master's master's master, in a book he wrote.

teacher.kind: Song sub-commentary on Zongmi's own 盂蘭盆經疏 (宋 遇榮鈔)
teacher.quote: 後謁遂州圓和尚，傳契心印。
teacher.note: 傳契心印 — the transmission verb. Independent corroboration.

teacher.kind: authority record + 景德傳燈錄 citation
teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 道圓 (T51n2076_p0301c09)；元和二年（807）印心於圓和尚
teacher.note: DILA also lists 澄觀 as a teacher — that is his Huayan master, not his Chan transmitter. Roster's Daoyuan stands.

dates.quote: birth +0780; death +0841-02-05；會昌元年正月六日坐化於興福塔院，世壽六十二，法臘三十四

school.quote: sect: 荷澤宗；華嚴宗第五祖

notes: Fifth patriarch of Huayan and Heze Chan lineage holder. His Chan Prolegomenon is a landmark work classifying Chan schools.

bio: A dharma heir of Baizhang Huaihai, resident in Yunzhou. The Jingde Chuandeng lu files him under Baizhang and preserves his exchanges; beyond that the record is bare. No birth or death year is recorded in any source I could reach — the roster's 800-860 has no evidence behind it and I have set both null.

teacher.quote: 洪州百丈懷海禪師法嗣三十人…筠州常觀禪師
teacher.note: 法嗣 — transmission. Bio at lb 0267b01: 「筠州五峯常觀禪師…有僧問。如何是五峯境。師云險」.

teacher.quote: 師上堂云。併却咽喉脣吻速道將來。溈山云…五峯云。和尚亦須併却…五峯云。某甲去
teacher.note: The 百丈 three-disciple koan (師 = 百丈), placing 五峯 among Baizhang's own disciples — this identifies the bare-name 五峰 with 五峰常觀 (see next entry).

teacher.kind: authority record + 景德傳燈錄 citation
teacher.quote: 洪州百丈懷海禪師法嗣。（T51n2076_p0263c29）

bio: A Silla monk of the Kim clan of Ungjin (modern Gongju). He studied under a master at Hwasan, took full ordination at Porwon monastery on Mount Karyanghyop in 827, and then went to Yeomgeo (Yŏmgŏ) at Oksongsa on Mount Sŏl, who 'handed him the dark pearl and conferred the dharma-seal.' In 837 he crossed to Tang China with Chŏngyuk and Hŏhoe, concluded that nothing there surpassed what his own teachers had taught, and came home in 840. King Hŏnan pressed him to come to the capital; he declined, and in 859 moved instead to Karisan monastery (Porimsa), which he made the head temple of the Kajisan school. He died on the thirteenth day of the fourth month of 880, aged seventy-seven, fifty-two years a monk; the king gave him the posthumous name Pojo and his stupa the name Ch'angsŏng.

steles.title: 寶林寺普照禪師彰聖塔碑 (Porimsa Pojo Sŏnsa Ch'angsŏng stele)
steles.author: 金穎 (Kim Yŏng)
steles.author_note: erected 884, four years after his death; the text is reproduced in full in 朝鮮佛教通史
steles.quote: 禪師諱體澄。宗姓金。熊津人也。…初道儀大師者。受心印於西堂。後歸我國。說其禪理。…由是知時未集。隱於山林。付法於廉居禪師。居於雪山偣聖寺。傳祖心闢師教。我禪師往而事焉。淨修一心。求出三界。…禪師察志氣非偶。素槩殊常。付玄珠授法印。
steles.note: And at the close, the lineage is spelled out: 「達摩為唐第一祖，我祖國則以儀大師為第一祖，居禪師為第二祖，我師為第三祖矣。」 — Doui first, Yeomgeo second, Chejing third.

steles.title: 寶林寺普照禪師彰聖塔碑
steles.author: 金穎
steles.quote: 廣明元年三月九日。告諸依止曰。吾今生報業盡…十三日子夜。上方地震。及天曉。右脇臥終。享齡七十有七。僧臘五十二。…中和三年春三月十五日。門人義草等。纂集行狀。遠詣王居。請建碑銘…教所司定諡。曰普照。塔號彰聖。寺額寶林。

teacher.quote: 付法於廉居禪師…我禪師往而事焉…付玄珠授法印
teacher.note: The stele, carved four years after his death by a named author, at his own grave.

teacher.quote: 以儀大師為第一祖。居禪師為第二祖。我師為第三祖矣。
설산(雪山) 억성사(億聖寺)에 있는 염거(廉居)의 밑에서 일심으로 정진하여 법인(法印)을 받았다

dates.quote: 廣明元年…享齡七十有七。僧臘五十二。
birth +0804; death 廣明元年 (880), 77歲；熊津人，姓金，新羅寶林寺僧人

school.quote: 請移居迦智山寺。遂飛金錫。遷入山門。

notes: Silla monk who received transmission domestically from Yeomgeo (a student of Doui), continuing the Gajisan school lineage. Did not travel to China. Attested in Korean stele records and traditional mountain school genealogies.

bio: A woman Chan master of Yunzhou, dharma heir of Gaoan Dayu, who led her own community at Moshan. The lamp records preserve her exchange with Guanxi Zhixian, who came to test her, was bested, and stayed three years working in her garden. No birth or death year survives — the roster's 820-895 has no source behind it, and I have set both null.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, 末山尼了然禪師
teacher.quote: 末山尼了然禪師因灌谿閑和尚到。曰。若相當即住。不然即推倒禪牀。…師問。上座今日離何處。曰。路口。師曰。何不葢却。溪無語。
teacher.note: Her teaching mastery on display. She is listed in the 高安大愚禪師法嗣 section of the lamps.

teacher.quote: REL teacher 大愚 (高安大愚, A003660); 筠州高安大愚禪師法嗣。（X79n1557_p0003c04）
teacher.note: 高安大愚 confirmed.

teacher.kind: authority record + 五燈嚴統 citation
teacher.quote: 筠州高安大愚禪師法嗣。（X79n1557_p0003c04）

bio.source: X/X79/X79n1557.xml (五燈嚴統) + 聯燈會要 X79n1557_p0019a17

notes: Woman Chan master who led her own monastery. Guanxi Zhixian bowed and served as her gardener for three years.

bio: Surnamed Xie, of Min county in Fuzhou. He fished for a living until, at about thirty, in the early Xiantong years, he left the world and had his head shaved by Lingxun of Mount Furong. After ordination he kept the dhūta practices, sat all day, and was called Bei the Ascetic. In 866 he went to Xuefeng Yicun and became his heir. He was strict in the vinaya; Luohan Guichen came from his gate, and through him the Fayan house. He died on the twenty-seventh day of the eleventh month of 908, aged seventy-four.

steles.title: 唐福州安國禪院先開山宗一大師碑文(并序)
steles.author: 林澂 (將仕郎試祕書省校書郎), erected 930 under 閩王 王延鈞
steles.quote: 師法諱師備，閩縣江南人也…大師世壽七十有四，僧臘四十有五…其年十二月十日，靈龕歸于閩縣懷賢里飛山之原…斯文斯石，千年萬年。
steles.note: A full Tang stele, sitting at the back of his own 廣錄 as No. 1445-C. Gives tonsure under 弘照大師 (芙蓉山) via 義通上人, ordination by 道玄律師 at 鍾陵開元寺 in 865, death 908 aged 74.

teacher.kind: his own words at Xuefeng's funeral, in his own 廣錄
teacher.quote: 雪峯遷化，師作喪主，集大眾煎茶次，師於靈前拈起茶盞，問大眾云：先師在日即且從你道，今且作麼生道？
teacher.note: THE DECIDER. When Xuefeng died, Xuansha acted as 喪主 — chief mourner, the dharma-heir's office — and standing before the spirit-tablet called him 先師, 'my late master', in his own mouth. First-person, and it is the one thing that settles the tension below.

teacher.kind: his stele — 唐福州安國禪院先開山宗一大師碑文(并序), by 林澂, erected 長興初/庚寅 (930) by order of 閩王 王延鈞
teacher.quote: 至七年，有學兄自外迴錫，即雪峰真覺大師…雪峯自此號師作備頭陀…雪峰景仰至德，然諾師言…至十三秊，亦上雪峰，一心希搆於玄關，戮力同開於鳥道
teacher.note: ⚠ READ THIS CAREFULLY. His own stele — a named man (林澂, who says 「澂雖親法席」, he attended Xuansha's dharma-seat), at a named grave, in a named year — describes the Xuefeng relationship WITHOUT ANY TRANSMISSION VERB. No 嗣法, no 印可, no 付. It calls Xuefeng his 學兄 (senior fellow-student) at their meeting in 866, because both had trained under 弘照大師 at 芙蓉山. It records decades of shared labour ('they opened the bird-path together'), Xuefeng naming him 備頭陀, and Xuefeng deferring to his words — a relationship of peers.

teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 義存；咸通七年（866），參謁雪峰義存，並嗣其法。
teacher.note: DILA also lists 靈訓 (who tonsured him) and 道玄 (his ordination preceptor) — neither is the transmitter.

dates.quote: birth +0835; death +0908-12-28；開平二年戊辰十一月二十七日示疾而終。春秋七十四。（T50n2061_p0786a02）

notes: Originally a fisherman. Ancestral figure of the Fayan school. 'Three diseases' teaching.

bio: A man of Hongzhou and dharma heir of Yunju Daoying, abbot at Tong'an. The Wujia zhengzong zan states it in one line: 'The master succeeded Yunju; his name was Daopi; he was a man of Hongzhou.' He is the link through which the Caodong line runs on to Tongan Guanzhi. No dates survive; the roster's 880-930 has no source and I have set both null.

teacher.quote: 師嗣雲居，諱道丕，洪州人。
teacher.note: teacher 雲居道膺 confirmed.

teacher.quote: 師嗣雲居，諱道丕，洪州人。
TEACHER-> 道膺

notes: Caodong lineage patriarch at Tongan Monastery near Nanchang. Successor of Yunju Daoying.

bio: From Daming, dharma heir of Fayan Wenyi and tenth generation below Huineng. He first lived at Shuanglin cloister in Hongzhou, moved to Shanglan Huyuan, and was then invited by Li Jing of the Southern Tang to Qingliang monastery at Jinling. Yunju Daoqi was his heir. He died in the seventh year of Kaibao (974) and was given the title Chan Master Fadeng.

teacher.kind: 景德傳燈錄 biography, under 淨慧禪師法嗣 (heir-list at lb 0407a24)
teacher.quote: 金陵清涼法燈禪師泰欽，魏府人也。生而知道，辯才無礙，入淨慧之室，海眾歸之，僉曰敏匠。初受請住洪州幽谷山雙林院。
teacher.note: 入淨慧之室 — entered the room of Jinghui. 淨慧 = 清涼文益's title in life (法眼文益, 賜號淨慧). Filed under 淨慧 in the heir-list beside 報恩玄則 (this batch).

teacher.quote: 金陵清涼泰欽法燈禪師，清涼文益（885-958）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十世。
金陵清涼泰欽禪師法嗣……廬山棲賢慧聰禪師

dates.quote: death +0974-07-21 (T51n2076_p0415b03)；太祖開寶七年（974）示寂，諡法燈禪師

bio.source: X/X77/X77n1524.xml (補續高僧傳) 法燈欽傳

notes: Dharma heir of Fayan Wenyi. Resided at Qingliang monastery in Jinling. Famous for the tiger bell koan. Dates corrected: previously d.938 predates teacher Fayan (d.958).

bio: Surnamed Leng, of Yichun. He was tonsured at Daowu shan in Liuyang, Tanzhou, and awoke under Ciming Chuyuan (Shishuang Chuyuan). He came out into the world at Putong Chan cloister on Mount Yangqi, and in 1046 moved to Yun'gai in Tanzhou. The line descending from him is called the Yangqi branch and became the dominant Linji transmission; Baiyun Shouduan and Baoning Renyong were among his heirs. He died in the first year of Huangyou (1049).

teacher.kind: own 拈香 transmission-incense, at his enthronement (楊岐方會和尚語錄)
teacher.quote: 遂陞座拈香云：「此一瓣香，祝延今上皇帝聖壽無窮。」又拈香云：「此一瓣香，奉為知府龍圖駕部諸官，伏願常居祿位。」復拈香云：「大眾，還知落處麼？若也不知，却為注破：奉酧石霜山慈明禪師法乳之恩。」山僧不免薰天炙地去也。便燒。
teacher.note: THE DHARMA-MILK STICK, and he even teases the assembly before naming it (還知落處麼 — 'do you know where this one lands?'). Stick 1 = the emperor. Stick 2 = the prefect and officials. Stick 3, and only stick 3, carries 法乳之恩 — and it goes to 慈明 of Shishuang, i.e. 石霜楚圓. First-person, at the transmission.

teacher.quote: 石霜楚圓禪師（986-1039）法嗣。…參慈明楚圓禪師，頓悟祖意。

dates.quote: birth +0992; death 皇祐元年 (1049)，58歲
dates.note: DILA records the disagreement openly: 《嘉泰普燈錄》卷3 gives Huangyou 1 (1049), age 58; the Foguang dictionary reports variants — age 54 at Huangyou 1, or death in Qingli 6 (1046) / Huangyou 2 (1050). I take 992-1049, the majority and DILA's own reading.

school.quote: sect: 臨濟宗楊岐派；大振臨濟宗風，其法系稱楊岐派

bio.kind: authority record (from 建中靖國續燈錄卷7, 續傳燈錄卷7, 嘉泰普燈錄卷3)

notes: Founded the Yangqi branch, which became the dominant Chan lineage.

bio: The Northern Song poet, statesman and painter of Meishan, one of the Eight Masters of Tang and Song prose. A jinshi of 1057, he was repeatedly exiled — to Huangzhou after the Crow Terrace poetry case of 1079, and later beyond the passes. His Chan connections are attested rather than legendary: he traded verses with Foyin Liaoyuan at Guizong, was floored by Yuquan Chenghao's shout, and, lodging at Donglin on his way from Huangzhou to Ruzhou, had an awakening while discussing the 'sermon of the insentient' with Zhaojue Changzong — whose heir the records make him. He died in 1101, carrying a scroll of Amitābha he called 'my warrant for the West.'

steles.title: 亡兄子瞻端明墓誌銘
steles.author: 蘇轍 (his brother)
steles.path: 欒城後集 (not in the CBETA corpus)
steles.quote: （蘇轍為兄作，墓誌，載於欒城後集）
steles.note: Verified via zh.wikisource/搜尋 that this epitaph exists and is by Su Zhe. It is a secular 墓誌銘, appropriate to a statesman, not a monastic 塔銘.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元, his own entry under 東林常總
teacher.quote: 東坡居士蘇軾，字子瞻。因宿東林，與照覺論無情話，有省。黎明獻偈曰：「溪聲便是廣長舌，山色豈非清淨身…」
teacher.note: 照覺 = 東林常總. The lamps place 蘇軾 as his lay heir. ⚠ 有省 (a glimpse), not 印可 — recorded as such.

teacher.quote: 東林常總禪師法嗣。…自黃徙汝，因遊廬山宿東林，與照覺常總論無情話有省。

dates.note: The lunar birth date straddles the Gregorian year boundary; conventionally 1037.

bio.kind: authority record (from 居士分燈錄卷2, 居士傳卷26)

notes: One of China's greatest poets. Deeply engaged with Chan Buddhism. Legend connected him to a rebirth of Wuzu Shijie.

bio: Of the Wang clan of Hanshan in Hezhou. He left home at nine for the Fohui cloister, was shaved at fifteen, and at twenty took to the road. He called on Changlu Jingzhao, then Zhantang Wenzhun at Baofeng, then Sixin at Huanglong — who called him 'a man come back again' — and finally reached Yuanwu Keqin at Jiashan. Yuanwu held up a fist and asked if he saw; 'A head on top of a head,' said Yuanwu; and Shaolong had his opening. He stayed with Yuanwu twenty years more, and after the Jianyan upheavals went south, was given Zhangjiao, and after four years moved to Huqiu. He died on the eighth day of the fifth month of 1136, aged sixty, forty-five summers a monk. The Linji transmission that survived ran through him.

steles.title: 宋臨濟正傳虎丘隆和尚塔銘
steles.author: 徐林
steles.author_note: 左朝奉、司農少卿 — a serving official, writing at his grave
steles.quote: 平江虎丘禪師，諱紹隆，和州含山縣人。生而岐嶷絕俗，九歲謝父母去家，依縣之佛慧院。又六歲削髮堂具，又五歲而束包曳杖，飄然有四方之志。…一日入室，圓悟引教云：見見之時，見非是見，見猶離見，見不能及。豎拳曰：還見麼？師曰：見。圓悟曰：頭上安頭。師於此有省。…自此與圓悟形影上下。又二十年，斧𢯱鑿索，盡得圓悟之秘。
steles.note: Appended to his own 語錄. Carries the whole life AND the transmission in the master's own encounter.

teacher.quote: 一日入室，圓悟…豎拳曰：還見麼？…師於此有省。…盡得圓悟之秘。
TEACHER-> 克勤 (X79n1557_p0005c18)

dates.quote: 紹興六年丙辰歲五月甲午八日乙亥坐逝，住世六十年，坐四十五夏

notes: His lineage became the dominant branch of the later Linji transmission.

bio: Abbot at Daming in Cizhou, dharma heir of Qingzhou Puzhao Yibian and the hinge of the northern Caodong line under the Jin: from him it runs to Wangshan Ti, Xueyan Man, and Wansong Xingxiu, and so to Yuan-dynasty Caodong. The lamps preserve his teaching on the lost needle — 'you look here and don't see it, you look there and don't see it… and lying down at last, suddenly: it was here all along' — and a set of Five Ranks verses. The corpus never gives him more than the name 寶 and never calls him 靈巖.

steles.quote: 磁州寶．雖碑銘不存
steles.note: His own stele is explicitly recorded as NOT surviving. All stele-grade evidence for him is secondhand, via 王山體塔銘 (his son's stupa-inscription) and via the Caodong lineage-carvings at 勝果寺 and 萬壽寺 transcribed in B24n0137.

teacher.kind: lineage stele copied into the text
teacher.quote: 青州辯．辯乃萬壽仰山開山初祖也。傳法得磁州寶
teacher.note: 傳法 = transmission verb.

teacher.quote: 雪庭裕嗣萬松秀．秀嗣雪巖滿．滿嗣王山體．體嗣磁州寶．寶嗣青州辯．辯嗣鹿門覺．覺嗣芙蓉楷
teacher.note: 嗣 chain, stated four separate times in this text (0459b30, 0463a20, 0465b29, 0467a32).

teacher.quote: 《續指月錄》卷4：「普照辨嗣」
teacher.note: DILA teacher = A014695 希辯 (青州普照希辯, d. 1149, heir of 鹿門自覺); its concise says 後傳法於大明寶.

teacher.quote: 青原下十九世　普照辨禪師法嗣　磁州大明寶禪師
teacher.note: 普照辨 = 青州希辨 (of 普照寺). 法嗣. Corroborated by 繼燈錄 X86n1605 (青州辯禪師法嗣　大明寶禪師) and 五燈全書目錄 X81n1570.

teacher.quote: 大明寶禪師法嗣　王山體禪師　仁山恒禪師
teacher.note: His heir 王山體 (NOT 玉山師體 — the batch's name-trap warning; 王/玉 confusion). Confirmed.

teacher.quote: 青原下十九世　普照辨禪師法嗣　磁州大明寶禪師
teacher.note: The heading immediately above his entry.

teacher.quote: 青州辯禪師法嗣　大明寶禪師　慈雲覺禪師 … 大明寶禪師法嗣　王山體禪師　仁山恒禪師
青原下十九世　普照辨禪師法嗣　大明寶禪師　慈雲十身覺禪師…青原下第二十世　大明寶禪師法嗣　王山體禪師

teacher.source: DILA A014695 (his teacher 希辯/一辨)
teacher.quote: 法嗣有磁州大明寶禪師、慈雲十身覺禪師…
teacher.note: Approached from the teacher's side, the same edge.

school.kind: lamp, filed under 曹洞宗 / 青原下

notes: Caodong master of the post-Furong northern lineage. Active in Hebei region during the Jin–Song partition.

bio: Surnamed Yu, of Weijiang in Mingzhou. He spent long years under Zutan Zhijian at Xuedou, who set him on the cypress-tree kōan, and had his opening there. He held six abbacies — Huazang Baozhong, Qingliang at Jiankang, Ruiyan at Mingzhou among them — and was finally commanded to the Jingde monastery on Mount Tiantong. He died on the seventeenth day of the seventh month of 1228, aged sixty-six. Among his six heirs was the Japanese monk Dōgen.

teacher.quote: 師六坐道場未稟承，眾或是請，師云：待我涅槃堂裡拈出。果臨終拈香云：如淨行脚四十餘年，首到乳峯，失脚墮於陷穽，此香今不免拈出，鈍置我前住雪竇足庵大和尚。
teacher.note: The strongest possible witness and a famous one: Rujing REFUSED to offer the transmission-incense at all six of his abbacies (未稟承), telling the assembly he would raise it in the nirvana hall — and at his death he raised it and named 雪竇足庵大和尚 = 足庵智鑑. First-person, at the transmission, and it is the only stick he ever offered. Confirms the current teacher exactly.

teacher.quote: TEACHER-> 智鑒；雪竇足庵鑑禪師法嗣。…久依雪竇足庵會下，庵令看柏樹子話，有省。

dates.quote: birth +1163; death +1228-08-25；紹定元年七月十七日示寂，壽六十六

bio.kind: authority record (from 五燈全書卷30, 繼燈錄卷1)

links.label: DILA Authority A013813
links.confirms: teacher, dates, school, Dōgen among heirs

notes: Abbot of Tiantong monastery. Emphasized silent illumination (默照).

bio: Of Wuzhou; left home at five, shaved at sixteen, on the road at eighteen. He called on Shuanglin Ji, Miaofeng Shan, Shitian Xun and Miweng Li without result, then went up to Jingshan to Wuzhun Shifan and drove himself so hard that for several years his ribs never touched the mat. One day on the cushion the ground opened in front of him and for a fortnight nothing moved; ten years of sitting followed before he saw where the old man of Jingshan stood. He held Longxing in Tan, Daolin, Fori, Husheng and Guangxiao, and in 1269 took the seat at Yangshan, where Khubilai honoured him. He died in 1287. Gaofeng Yuanmiao was his heir.

teacher.kind: own 普說 — his autobiographical sermon, first person
teacher.quote: 雖在無準先師會下許多年，每遇他開室舉主人公話，便可以打箇𨁝跳，莫教舉起衲僧巴鼻、佛祖爪牙，更無你下口處。
teacher.note: 「無準先師」 — 'my LATE MASTER Wuzhun' — in his own mouth, in the sermon where he narrates his own life. 先師 is the possessive term a monk uses only of his own dharma-father.

teacher.kind: own 忌辰 incense — he keeps Wuzhun's death-anniversary, at least three times in the record
teacher.quote: 無準和尚忌拈香。盡道先師今日死，誰知今日是生朝。不知却有何憑據，紫栢黃檀一處燒。 (0506a04) ／ 無準和尚忌拈香。巴陵三轉語，大仰一甌茶。有恩成怨恨，無事是讎家。杜䳌啼血染山花。 (0503a12)
teacher.note: The 忌辰 incense is the strongest ritual claim short of the enthronement stick: only the heir burns it. He does it repeatedly, and calls him 先師 while doing it. 「有恩成怨恨」 — 'the debt of grace turns to resentment' — is filial Chan snarl, not distance.

teacher.kind: own colophon: 跋無準癡絕語
teacher.quote: 無準先師、癡絕和尚，明訓昭昭，實天下衲子古今師法。
teacher.note: Again 先師 for Wuzhun, and merely 和尚 for 癡絕 — he keeps the two men at their correct distances in a single breath.

teacher.quote: 無準師範（1178-1249）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十一世。…遂上徑山謁無準
仰山雪巖欽禪師法嗣……萬壽默翁一禪師

dates.quote: 臣僧今日七十。乙酉正月初一
dates.note: DILA derives the birth year 1216 from this line in his own record.

dates.quote: birth 嘉定九年 (1216); death 至元二十四年 (1287)，壽七十餘

bio.kind: authority record (from 續燈正統卷21, 增集續傳燈錄卷4)

notes: Known for extreme asceticism and fierce teaching style. His autobiography is a classic.

bio: A Korean Seon monk of Gobu in Jeolla. He left home young and wandered without a fixed master, then crossed to Yuan China, where in 1351 he reached Shiwu Qinggong at Tianhu-an on Mount Xiawu and received his dharma; he also met Zhikong (Indian monk Dhyānabhadra) that year, and returned home in the third month of 1352. In 1372 he compiled the Anthology of the Patriarchs' Direct Pointing at the Essence of Mind (Jikji), and died in 1374 at Chwiam-sa on Mount Hyemok in Yeoju. In 1377 his disciples Seokchan, Daljam and the nun Myodeok printed the Jikji with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa near Cheongju — the oldest surviving book so printed.

teacher.quote: 경한이 원에서 유학할 때 석옥청공에게서 받은 『불조직지심체요절』 1권을 바탕으로
teacher.note: Received the 直指 text from 石屋清珙 (Shiwu Qinggong) while studying in Yuan China — the standard account of his transmission. 石屋清珙 is a Linji (Yangqi/虎丘) master, teacher also of the Korean 太古普愚.

teacher.quote: 경한이 원에서 유학할 때 석옥청공에게서 받은 『불조직지심체요절』 1권을 바탕으로
teacher.note: Gyeonghan received a volume of the Jikji from Shiwu Qinggong himself while studying in Yuan China.

dates.quote: 입적하기 2년 전인 1372년에 직접 초록한 (compiled in 1372, two years before his death in 1374)

bio.quote: 1377년 경한의 제자 석찬, 달잠, 비구니 묘덕이 청주목 인근 흥덕사에서 금속활자로 인쇄하였다

links.label: 한국민족문화대백과사전: 불조직지심체요절
links.confirms: teacher (Shiwu Qinggong), death 1374, Jikji, 1377 Heungdeoksa metal-type printing

notes: Korean Seon master best known as the compiler and printer of the Jikji simche yojeol (Anthology of Great Buddhist Priests' Zen Teachings), printed at Heungdeoksa temple in Cheongju in 1377 using movable metal type. This is the oldest known book in the world printed with movable metal type, predating Gutenberg's Bible by 78 years. Baegun traveled to Yuan China and received transmission from Shiwu Qinggong (Stone House), the hermit-poet of Tianmu mountain.
