teacher.note: His filiation to 弘忍 rests on the lamps and 宋高僧傳; the surviving portion of the 727 stele is fragmentary (heavily 闕) and I could not confirm that it names 弘忍. The stele upgrades his LIFE, not necessarily his teacher — grading the page, not the genre.

teacher.kind: flat 法嗣 index (景德傳燈錄)
teacher.quote: 旁出一百七人 第一世一十三人 北宗神秀禪師 嵩嶽慧安國師 袁州蒙山道明禪師 已上三人見錄
teacher.note: Placed among Hongren's collateral heirs. Roster teacher CONFIRMED at index rung.

teacher.quote: 前嵩嶽慧安國師等法嗣一十八人 洛京福先寺仁儉禪師 慧安國師出六人 嵩嶽破竈墮和尚 嵩嶽元珪禪師

notes: Born in Jingzhou (Hubei Province). Already in his forties, he traveled to Huangmei where he studied under both Daoxin and Hongren, maturing as a practitioner of the East Mountain School. After time at Jade Spring Monastery alongside Shenxiu, he settled permanently on Mount Song (Songshan). Listed in the Lengqie Shizi Ji alongside Shenxiu and Huineng as one of Hongren's principal dharma heirs. He represents a third stream from the Fifth Patriarch, distinct from both the Northern and Southern schools. Said to have lived to age 128.

bio: Of the Juyun branch. He followed Chuiwan Guangzhen and then Tiebi Huiji before receiving the robe and whisk from Tiemei Huili ('Three Slaps') on the latter's deathbed in 1650. At his own enthronement he offered incense to 'my late master, the venerable Tiemei of the Three Slaps, to repay the debt of the dharma-milk'.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 此瓣香，拄杖身中生馥郁，拂子頭上靄煙雲，爇向爐中，供養三巴掌先師上鐵下眉和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS, at the moment of taking the seat. The highest rung there is. Roster/batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 供養臨濟二十六代巴掌先師，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: A second incense, giving his teacher's generation-number as Linji 26.

teacher.quote: 順治庚寅十月初十日以法付門人耳菴，泊然而化 … 法嗣：天寧燈嵩禪師
teacher.note: From the TEACHER's side: Tiemei handed the dharma to 耳菴 as he died. DILA names that heir 天寧燈嵩 — which gives us Er'an's dharma name, 燈嵩, in the 燈 generation used by all of Tiebi's heirs.

dates.quote: 1611 … 丙申秋偶示疾…未幾跏趺而化（續燈正統18）；陽壽四十六（耳庵嵩語錄附記）
dates.note: 丙申=1656 (near 12th-month boundary), 陽壽46 -> born 1611. teacher 鐵眉慧麗 (三巴掌) 1586-1650.

dates.quote: 掌師臨終授以衣拂…住伏虎、熊耳、迴龍、天寧四剎…壽四十六
dates.note: own 語錄 附記 gives 壽46, no absolute year

bio: Dharma name Jiwu, hao Hefeng; thirty-third generation in the Linji seat. Of the Fei clan of Wumen (Suzhou); his father was Simei, his mother of the Gu clan. Tonsured at twelve at Luohan monastery in Songling under the vinaya master Ruizhi, and fully ordained at twenty under Poushi of Wanfeng. Judu Hongli of Lingyin singled him out and set him on 'the original face'; he had a first opening on seeing a lamp-wick spark, and broke through fully during a seven-day sitting in the Great Compassion hall, overhearing Judu goading the attendant at the next seat. He served as head of practice at Huayan, Guangxiao, Xianning, Jingshan and Tianning, spent a period at Jingdezhen building a road and giving out tea, then returned to Lingyin, where Judu confirmed him and gave him the robe and bowl. He held Longtan Fushan, Baoshu, Zhuyin, Jizhao, Fushan and Fushou. Died 1687 aged 62.

steles.title: 鶴峰悟禪師塔誌銘
steles.author: 仲弘道
steles.author_note: 敕授文林郎知山東嶧縣事 — by imperial appointment, magistrate of Yi county in Shandong; of Tongxi
steles.quote: 和尚諱濟悟，號鶴峰，臨濟座上為三十三代，本籍吳門費氏裔。父思梅，母顧氏。幼見師敦禮釋迦，知有夙慧，遂送松陵羅漢寺光律師瑞芝剃染，時蓋十二歲云。
steles.note: A named magistrate writing at the grave. A 行狀 exists too — the stele refers to it: 「偈載行狀中，不具述」.

teacher.quote: 師歸靈隱，具老人益加印合，遂授衣缽焉。
teacher.note: 'He returned to Lingyin, and the old man Ju confirmed him further, and thereupon handed over the robe and bowl.' The transmission, at the grave. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 弘禮 (A016082) — 《鶴峰禪師語錄》卷2：「自靈巖來參靈隱。隱即別立一堂令師與之共相砥礪。」
TEACHER: 弘璧 (A000242) — 「受具于萬峰剖石和尚」
teacher.note: DISTINCTION RECORDED: 剖石弘璧 was his ORDINATION master, not his transmitter. DILA lists both; only Jude Hongli gave the robe. This is the association-vs-transmission trap, and here the batch has it right.

dates.quote: 「天啟丙寅九月二十日。」…「康熙丁卯九月十一日，住世六十有二。」
dates.note: = 1626-11-08 to 1687-10-16, aged 62. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

bio: Of Jianzhou in Sichuan, zi Jianguan. A dharma heir of Wuzhun Shifan. He headed Xinghua monastery in Longxing prefecture from 1239, then moved to Yunyan Shouning, and in 1265 took Xichan Yishan Changqing monastery in Fuzhou. He died in 1267.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 — death-anniversary incense for his teacher
teacher.quote: 佛鑑忌拈香二：揑拳頭上，作女人拜。老倒楊岐，不勘自敗。青龍今日一爐香，一任時人話短長。
teacher.note: 佛鑑忌拈香 = incense raised on the death-anniversary (忌) of 佛鑑 (=無準師範's imperial title). This is his own first-person teacher-incense — the MEMORIAL form rather than the enthronement 用酬法乳 form, but unambiguously naming his master. Also a portrait-讚 「佛鑑和尚」 at lb 0093b16. The 楊岐 reference fixes the Yangqi lineage. Credit to sub-song subagent for locating it — I had earlier seen only the 祝聖 stick and wrongly concluded no teacher-incense survived.

teacher.quote: 劍關子益禪師語錄一卷…嗣無準範
teacher.note: 嗣無準範. Also 增集續傳燈錄 X83n1574 lb0734b03, X84n1582 lb0469a13, DILA A010669.

teacher.quote: 字劍關，無準師範禪師法嗣。劒州人。（《增集續傳燈錄》卷1；《劍關子益禪師語錄》卷1；宋僧著：568）
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 咸淳三年卒（宋僧著：568）
dates.note: 咸淳三年 = 1267. NEW — the batch had no dates. No birth year is recoverable.

bio.quote: 嘉熙三年（1239）住隆興府興化禪寺，後遷雲岩壽寧禪寺。咸淳元年（1265）住福州西禪怡山長慶禪寺，三年卒。

bio: Of Mochi in Zizhou, Sichuan, surname Jia; hao Huanxi. Tonsured in his twentieth year and ordained at Ganlu monastery in Chengdu. At twenty-two he attended the Daci lectures, then called on Hui'an Guang, Netang Bian and Tu'an Gui in turn, working day and night at his own matter. He then found Wuzhun Shifan at Ayuwang and became his heir. From 1246 he held Ruiyan in Jianning, then Huili in Linjiang, Baofeng in Hong, Xuefeng in Fu, and finally, by imperial order, Tiantong in Siming. Died 1281 aged 80.

steles.title: 環溪惟一禪師語錄〈行狀〉
steles.quote: 呂禪人不憚三千里，持行狀來求塔銘於丞相杬翁
steles.note: A 行狀 is listed in the 語錄's own table of contents, and DILA cites 《環溪惟一禪師語錄》卷2〈行狀〉 for his dates. The colophon quoted here records that a monk carried that 行狀 three thousand li to ask the Chancellor for a 塔銘 — so a stupa inscription was commissioned; I did not locate its text.

teacher.quote: 後訪無準禪師於育王，得其法。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED at stele rung.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 師範 (A004697)

dates.quote: （至元十八年）辛巳秋九月旦示寂，壽八十
dates.note: Died 1281-10-21 aged 80, giving birth 1202. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

bio: Of Huanggang, surname Kang; zi Tianze, also styled Jingshan. Tonsured at Anguo monastery, where he studied the Mahayana and Hinayana divisions and concluded that 'the matter' does not lie in words and letters; he took the precepts at Xingyan. He called first at Tianjie in Jinling, where he was set on 'the three are not it' and had an opening, then went on to Tiantong and to Yunmen, and found his depth with Shanweng Min at Daochang, who made him head of assembly. War drove him back to Yishui in Chu, where he built a hut on Mt. Yuqi. He afterwards came to Shanduo Zhenzai and received transmission from him in the autumn of 1665. He held Yilin at Yishui. Still living in 1677, aged sixty.

steles.title: 天則能禪師語錄〈行略〉
steles.quote: 行略
steles.note: An 行略 (abbreviated account of conduct) appended to his own 語錄. It is DILA's cited source for his birth date.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 爇向爐中供養前住廬山東林寺、後住華桂堂、上傳臨濟正宗三十二世山鐸先師上真下在老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS, naming 山鐸真在 as 先師 and repaying 'the debt of the dharma-milk'. This is decisive, and it settles the batch's point exactly: he trained first at Longchi under 萬如通微, but 萬如 did NOT transmit. The visiting-teacher must not be mistaken for the transmitter.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 真在 (A000945) — 為山鐸真在禪師（1621-1672）法嗣 … 後謁山鐸禪師，於康熙乙巳秋（1665）得付法。

dates.quote: 「於萬曆戊午九月廿六日午時誕」
dates.note: 萬曆戊午 = 1618-11-12. NEW — the batch had no dates. Death year is NOT recoverable; DILA says only that he was still alive in 1677 aged 60.

bio: A heir of Shanduo Zhenzai in the Linji line. He entered Jinming Chan monastery in Jiaxing on the third day of the tenth month of 1683. His incense honours Shanduo as his late master, and Jie'an (Wujin) as his 師翁 — his grand-teacher — placing him one generation below Shanduo and two below Jie'an.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 第二回拈出，供養先師山鐸和尚。
teacher.note: His own words. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 第三回拈出炙地薰天供養傳臨濟正宗第三十二世山鐸先師大和尚。
teacher.note: Second, independent incense — same teacher, with generation-number.

teacher.quote: 第四回拈出供養初住廬山東林、末住碧雲龍興、先師山鐸大和尚
teacher.note: Third incense, giving Shanduo's abbacies. Three separate first-person offerings name the same man.

teacher.quote: 此瓣香奉為本寺堂上開法第一代師翁介老和尚
teacher.note: CORROBORATION FROM THE GENERATION ABOVE: he calls 介 (介菴悟進) his 師翁 = GRAND-teacher. DILA independently makes 山鐸真在 the heir of 介菴悟進 (A000945 -> A010710). The chain 鴛湖妙用 -> 介菴悟進 -> 山鐸真在 -> 晦嶽旭 closes on itself from two directions.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十二世（his teacher）

bio.quote: 住嘉興府金明禪寺語錄康熙癸亥十月初三日進院
bio.note: 康熙癸亥 = 1683.

bio: Of Wuyi in Jinhua, surname Xu; zi Miaoyun. His mother died when he was nine and he was tonsured at Huayan by the vinaya master Zihua, who gave him the name Shoufeng. He took the precepts under Jude at Lingyin. Sent out one day to haul firewood, he lost his way, wandered up to Beigao peak, sat down, and at nightfall looked up to find the moon bright and the whole landscape transparent and without obstruction. He then called on Zuyin, Feiyin, Ruo'an, Fushi, Yulin and Muyun in turn. In the spring of 1670 he went to Jie'an Wujin at Jinming, and in 1672 received transmission from him. He held Dabei in Linqing (Shandong) and Jingde at the Three Pagodas in Jiaxing.

steles.title: 大悲妙雲禪師語錄〈行略〉
steles.quote: 行略
steles.note: An 行略 appended to his own 語錄; DILA's cited source for his birth date. A 傳 (〈大悲玅雲禪師傳〉) also travels in the same 語錄.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 供養前住徑山天池、次住廣福敬畏、傳臨濟正宗第三十一世金明堂上過去本師介菴進老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS. 'My late original master, the venerable Jie'an Jin of Jinming' — 過去 marking him already dead, so this incense is after 1673. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 悟進 (A010710) — 為介庵悟進禪師（1612-1673）法嗣 … 康熙庚戌（1670）春造金明謁介庵和尚，壬子（1672）得付法。

dates.quote: 「崇禎甲戌九月初七日巳時生。」
dates.note: 崇禎甲戌 = 1634-10-28. NEW — the batch had no dates. No death year recoverable.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十一世（his teacher）

bio: Of Jinghai in Tongzhou, surname Pan; zi Shengtu, hao Huaihai. Tonsured and ordained at nineteen, he went to Zhewong Ruyan at Jingshan and became his heir. From 1233 he held Guangxiao in Tongzhou, then Shuangta at Wucheng, Qingliang at Jinling, Wannian at Tiantai, Wanshou at Suzhou and Jiangxin at Dongjia. Appointed to Ayuwang as its forty-fifth abbot, he went on to Jingci, Lingyin, and finally Jingshan in Hangzhou — the summit of the Five Mountains system. He fell ill and died on the tenth day of the sixth month, 1265, having written his parting verse.

teacher.kind: his own 拈香 — 淮海原肇禪師語錄
teacher.quote: 三十二代　特賜佛心禪師浙翁大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。遂就座。
teacher.note: 佛心禪師浙翁 = 浙翁如琰; 用酬法乳之恩 raised by 元肇 himself. First-person, and it fixes 如琰's generation (32nd) too.

teacher.quote: TEACHER 如琰 (A009592); 年十九薙染受具，參浙翁於徑山，得其法。
teacher.note: 得其法 under 浙翁如琰 at 徑山.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 如琰 (A009592) — 浙翁無琰禪師法嗣 … 年十九薙染受具，參浙翁於徑山，得其法。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 生於淳熙十六年（宋僧著：554）… 咸淳元年六月十日（南宋六文學僧紀念錄：397）
dates.note: = 1189 to 1265-07-31. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

school.quote: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第十九世

bio: Of Tongchuan prefecture, surname Wang; zi Jingsou. Ordained by Tucheng at Guangfu cloister in his home county, he studied under Biefeng and Tudu at Jingshan, working in silence; reading Wan'an's record one day, he had an opening. He then went to Fozhao Deguang at Ayuwang, connected with him, and came and went at his door for fifteen years. He held Boruo and Bao'en in Taizhou, then swept out a single room on the northern side of Feilai Peak and lived there ten years — men would not presume to use his personal name, and called him simply 'North Torrent', Beijian. He was later called to Tiefo, Xiyu, Bijun, Huiri and Daochang, and in the Jiaxi era was ordered to Jingci Guangxiao. Died 1246 aged 83. His Beijian collections shaped Japanese Gozan literature.

steles.title: 北磵簡和尚行狀 (quoted)
steles.quote: 北磵簡和尚行狀云。社中飽參。碩望。忘年與交。
steles.note: His 行狀 is QUOTED in B19n0103 — evidence that one existed, though I did not locate its full text. The corpus also preserves the trace of a 塔銘: sweeping for 北磵 turns up 「北磵簡東嶼海晦機熙撰塔銘」 and 「撰北磵簡公塔銘」, indicating a stupa inscription written for him, but I could not pin its file and line and so do not assert it.

teacher.quote: 祝香：此一瓣香，恭為今上皇帝祝延聖壽無疆…次拈香云：此一瓣香，奉為判府寶謨郎中洎合郡官僚同資祿筭。又拈香云：此一瓣香不直分文，遼天索價，別無奇特，不肯雷同，得於佛照老人，依舊為渠拈出。
teacher.note: 北磵居簡禪師語錄. Three sticks: emperor, the prefect, and THEN the dharma stick — 得於佛照老人 ('obtained from old man Fozhao') = 佛照德光. Take only the third.

teacher.quote: 又拈香云：此一瓣香，奉為三奉詔旨、五宿觀堂、走殺天下衲僧、前住徑山投老鄮峰東庵先師和尚，無恩可報，無耻可雪，將此身心奉塵剎。
teacher.note: Same man described by his career: 三奉詔旨/五宿觀堂 (summoned to court) and 前住徑山, retired to 鄮峰東庵 — that is 佛照德光 exactly. 先師 = his dharma-father.

teacher.quote: 佛照忌拈香：拙，拙，拙盡巧生，一場敗缺…
teacher.note: Keeps Fozhao's memorial day.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 德光 (A007385) — 育王佛照光禪師法嗣 … 遽往育王見佛照，機相契，自是往來其門十五年。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: 「淳祐丙午春四月一日示寂，壽八十三」（《補續高僧傳》卷24）
dates.note: Died 1246-04-25 aged 83, giving birth 1164. Both batch values CONFIRMED.

school.quote: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第十八世

bio.kind: extensive bio (from 補續高僧傳 卷24)

school: Linji (30th generation, by his own placement)
bio: Of Bazhou in Shuntian, north China, surname Zhao. Born the eighteenth day of the eighth month of 1579. He went vegetarian at twelve and wanted the robe; refused by his parents, he simply left at fourteen, met the Wutai master Huiren on the road, and when Huiren would not tonsure him he took a knife and cut off his own hair. At eighteen he ran away by night to the Lion's Den on Mt. Wutai to study under Kongyin Zhencheng, mastering the Surangama and Lotus. At twenty-five, walking under the moon holding his huatou, he broke through. He spent nineteen years at Wutai hermitage near Shaoling, where he would sit in the open at night under a great umbrella — whence his name 'the Umbrella Dweller'. He held Yunju, Qingyuan and Qingliang, and in 1644 founded Zizhulin at Shicheng. Died the sixth day of the fifth month, 1646, aged 68.

steles.title: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄〈行狀〉
steles.author: 正印
steles.author_note: 住南康府同安寺嗣法門人 — his own dharma heir, abbot of Tong'an monastery
steles.quote: 師諱觀衡，字顓愚，別號傘居，北直隸順天府霸州趙氏子，生於萬曆七年己卯八月十八日亥時。
steles.note: Written by his heir, who was at his deathbed — the 行狀 records their last exchange.

steles.title: 紫竹林顓愚衡和尚語錄〈塔銘〉
steles.author: 熊文舉
steles.author_note: 前進士出身通議大夫吏兵二部左侍郎，新建，法門弟子 — former Vice-Minister of Personnel and of War, and a lay disciple
steles.quote: 顓愚和尚以丙戌夏示寂於江南之紫竹林。其嗣戒弟子方融璽迎靈龕歸雲居，建塔於東靜室。
steles.note: A second, independent memorial by a senior Ming official.

steles.title: 紫竹林顓愚大師爪髮衣缽塔誌銘
steles.author_note: In 蕅益智旭's 靈峰宗論 (per DILA).
steles.quote: 紫竹林顓愚大師爪髮衣缽塔誌銘
steles.note: A THIRD memorial — for the nail-and-hair reliquary stupa — and it sits in ANOTHER MASTER'S COLLECTED WORKS, not his own. Found only by sweeping the whole corpus. Precisely the case the brief warns of.

teacher.kind: 行狀 (by his heir 正印)
teacher.quote: 得業於五台空印大師，嗣法於曹溪憨山肉祖。
teacher.note: THE DECISIVE LINE, AND IT RESOLVES THE BATCH'S CORPUS CONFLICT. 'He received his TRAINING (得業) from Kongyin of Wutai, and INHERITED THE DHARMA (嗣法) from Hanshan of Caoxi.' His own heir draws the exact distinction between the teacher he studied under and the teacher who transmitted. Teacher = 憨山德清.

teacher.quote: 戊申入曹溪參憨山和尚 … 是年復省憨山和尚於衡陽湖東寺，山親書源流當堂付囑，〈偈〉曰：「法意簷前艸…」
teacher.note: SECOND, INDEPENDENT stele: Hanshan personally wrote out the lineage document and conferred it in the hall, with a transmission verse. Two memorial documents, two authors, same answer.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 德清 (A001681) — 《續燈正統目錄》卷1：「雲居顓愚禪師(憨山嗣悞列此)」
teacher.note: The 續燈正統 ITSELF carries an editorial note admitting 'Hanshan's heir — WRONGLY listed here'. The lamp knew it had misfiled him.

teacher.quote: [concise] 五台空印大師法嗣。
teacher.note: DISAGREEMENT RECORDED: DILA's own prose summary calls him Kongyin's heir, contradicting DILA's own relation field AND both steles. I take 憨山德清, because two memorial documents written by men who knew him — one his heir, one his lay disciple — state the transmission explicitly, and because the lamp record itself flags the alternative as an error. The 空印鎮澄 attribution confuses training with transmission.

dates.quote: 生於萬曆七年己卯八月十八日亥時 … 順治丙戌三年，五月初六日
dates.note: = 1579-09-18 to 1646-06-18, aged 68. Both batch values CONFIRMED at stele rung.

school.quote: 眾請師入祖圖，師曰：「病僧是個擔板漢。」眾推尊再三，師於臨濟派下指曰：「衡當於此。」乃臨濟三十世也。
school.note: He placed HIMSELF, reluctantly, in the Linji line at the thirtieth generation — first-person on his own school.

bio: Of Tongcheng, surname Yan; zi Hansong, also styled Yinweng. He put off white robes in 1643 at eighteen and took full ordination at twenty-two. Studying under Baiyu at Qinglong, he knocked a lamp to the floor and broke clean open. He received Baiyu's charge in 1652. He held Longfu at Qinglong in Songjiang, Shanquan at Guoshan, Xianglu on Mt. Baiyun, Yunji at Baoyan, Anle at Jingxi, Li'an at Shanjuan and Longhua at Bianshan. Died 1688 aged 63. He edited his master Baiyu's complete records into the canon.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 滿腹無明一朝拈出，端為疁城古昭慶寺堂上洞宗正傳第二十九世百愚斯老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS. 'For the venerable Baiyu Si, twenty-ninth in the true transmission of the Dong (Caodong) school' — repaying the debt of the dharma-milk. Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the incense independently CONFIRMS the school as Caodong, not Linji.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 淨斯 (A016277) — 為百愚淨斯禪師（1610-1665）法嗣 … 壬辰（1652）受付囑。

dates.quote: 「天啟丙寅八月十八日。」（《寒松操禪師語錄》卷17〈自序〉）… 康熙二十七年（1688）示寂，世壽六十三。
dates.note: = 1626-10-07 to 1688, aged 63. Birth is from his OWN PREFACE (自序) — first-person. NEW: the batch had only a floruit of 1660 and no death.

bio: Of Zhangpu in Fujian, surname Cai. Orphaned young and raised by his brother, he failed of a career by twenty, met the master Zhenjie, and had himself tonsured at Shishi crag in Changtai. Reading the Changuan Cejin he found 'the ten thousand dharmas return to one' and took it up. In the spring of 1634, aged twenty-four, he came to Feiyin Tongrong at Huangbo, who beat him out of the room at every question — and before long he entered the depths and was made recorder. In 1638, when Feiyin took Jinsu, he served as West Hall and received the robe and whisk. He held Jinsu for six years from 1648, spending the whole of his private means on the assembly. In 1662 he copied out a hundred more leaves of dharma-talk into his complete record and said: 'From today this mountain monk will preach no more.' Told by a physician to take medicine, he answered: 'My karmic term is done; medicine is useless.' He washed, changed his robe, and died. His stupa is at Mt. Dengwei near Wu.

steles.title: 百癡禪師語錄〈行實〉
steles.quote: 行實
steles.note: A 行實 (record of deeds) appended to his own 語錄.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 爇向爐中，耑為現住浙江嘉興金粟山廣慧禪寺傳曹溪正脈三十五世本師費隱容老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS, naming Feiyin Tongrong as 本師 — his own master — 'thirty-fifth in the true vein from Caoxi'. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 爇向爐中供養前住徑山、現住福嚴費隱容本師老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: A second, independent incense naming the same man.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 通容 (A001150) — 徑山通容費隱禪師法嗣

dates.quote: 「康熈壬寅八月十六日巳時」（《五燈全書》卷70）；「清康熙元年卒，年五十二」（《釋氏疑年錄》卷12）
dates.note: Died 1662-09-27 aged 52, giving birth 1611. NEW — the batch had only a floruit of 1648.

school.quote: 傳曹溪正脈三十五世（his teacher）

bio: Of Chengdu, surname Hu. Abbot of Danxia, and of Xiangyan monastery in Dengzhou. At his enthronements he offered incense six separate times to his late master Dangshan Yuan of Xiangyan, calling himself the thirty-second generation in the orthodox Linji transmission.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 今朝爇向爐中，耑申供養中興鄧州香嚴傳臨濟正宗第三十二代宕山本師大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS. Batch teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 今當第五回，恭對人天，爇向爐中，耑申供養鄧州香嚴傳臨濟正宗三十二世宕山遠先師大和尚，以酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: The fifth of six incense-offerings, this one giving the teacher's full name 宕山遠. Six separate first-person attestations across his record.

dates.quote: 本係西蜀成都人…生于崇禎二年，歲在己巳六月初一日
dates.note: 崇禎2己巳=1629 birth; own 語錄 行實. death not stated.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十二代 … 傳曹溪正胍第三十六世
school.note: INTERNAL INCONSISTENCY, RECORDED NOT SMOOTHED: his own record gives his teacher's generation as Linji 32 in some incense and Caoxi 36 in another. These are two different counting systems (from Linji Yixuan vs from Huineng), not a contradiction of fact.

bio: A heir of Bie'an Xingtong. He took Yongshou Chan monastery in Hangzhou in 1691, swept the stupa of the patriarch Hui at Jingshan and made his bows at Caoxi. At his enthronement he offered incense to Bie'an, then living at the Zhenhai hall on Mt. Putuo.

teacher.kind: 拈香 (incense at his own enthronement)
teacher.quote: 第四回拈出，專伸供養現住普陀山鎮海堂上別菴老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: HIS OWN WORDS. Batch teacher CONFIRMED. Note 現住 — 'now dwelling at' — so Bie'an was ALIVE and at Putuoshan when Cuiya took his seat in 1691, which dates the teacher too.

bio.quote: 此一瓣香，如金如玉、如珪如璋，爇向爐中，奉為…

bio: Of Shaoling, surname Wang. He studied at the county school and, gripped by the greatness of birth-and-death, was tonsured and ordained. He relied on Huishan Zhihai and worked under him for fifteen years. He went out to head Guanghua on Mt. Furong, and on the twenty-first day of the ninth month of 1669 succeeded to the seat of Miyin monastery on Mt. Dawei — the great Guiyang site. His heir was Tianyi Juxiang.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his enthronement (溈山古梅冽禪師語錄) — the 用酬法乳之恩 formula, verbatim
teacher.quote: 又拈香，云：「此一瓣香，一十五年不離左右，萬人堆裏記莂躬承，今日專誠拈出，端為供養傳臨濟正宗三十三世即此堂上慧山老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。」
teacher.note: THE dharma-milk stick, textbook form. Third stick, after the emperor (0785a30) and the officials (0785b03). 「一十五年不離左右」 — fifteen years never leaving his side; 「萬人堆裏記莂躬承」 — in a crowd of ten thousand he received the prediction/certification in his own person. Then the formula the brief names as the top rung: 用酬法乳之恩. Teacher 慧山智海 confirmed beyond argument, in his own voice, at the moment of transmission.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 智海 (A001270) — 為慧山智海禪師法嗣 … 依慧山海，力參十五年。
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the teacher's FULL NAME is recovered: 慧山海 = 慧山智海 (DILA A001270).

teacher.quote: 法嗣有與峯智、古梅冽、易庵應等禪師
teacher.note: CONFIRMED FROM THE TEACHER'S SIDE: Huishan Zhihai's own record lists 古梅冽 among his heirs.

bio.quote: 生卒年不詳。為慧山智海禪師法嗣。邵陵人，俗姓王。… 出住芙蓉山廣化。於康熙己酉（1669）九月廿一日繼席大溈密印。

bio: Of Cixi in Mingzhou, surname Mao; hao Xiaoweng. Ordained in 1197. He studied with Yeying Daoqin, then Xue'an Guan at Jinshan, then Songyuan Chongyue at Lingyin — and connected with none of them. He went at last to Wuyong Jingquan at Tiantong; as he opened his mouth Wuyong struck him across it with the bamboo staff, and he answered on the instant with a verse — 'the great poison-smeared drum, it shakes heaven and earth; turn your head, and corpses lie ten thousand li' — which Wuyong approved. He held Miaosheng, Jinwen and Guangxiao in Mingzhou, Bao'en in Tai, Huqiu at Pingjiang and Xuefeng in Fuzhou, and was ordered by decree to Lingyin. Prince Shi of Wei built Daci monastery in Mingzhou and made him its founding abbot. He later held Ruiyan, Jiangxin, Jingci, Tiantong and Ayuwang. Died 1248 aged 72.

steles.title: 笑翁禪師行狀
steles.author_note: Preserved in 《明州阿育王山續志》卷11 (per DILA). Quoted in the corpus at B19n0103, where it is attributed to 無文印 and to 物初賸語 — i.e. it circulated widely.
steles.quote: 無文印笑翁堪禪師行狀云。雪峰僧堂二。曰留香…
steles.note: His 行狀 is quoted at three separate points in B19n0103 (lb 0032a06, 0065a15, 0839a01). The full text sits in the Ayuwang gazetteer, outside the Zen allowlist.

teacher.quote: 號笑翁，為無用淨全禪師（1137-1207）法嗣…從野應道欽受學，後依雪庵觀於金山，復參松輝岳於靈隱，皆不契。時無用全居天童，徑造其室，得徹悟。
teacher.note: 三位皆不契 (failed); transmission only under 無用淨全 (得徹悟). Teacher confirmed and the trap-verbs (不契) correctly excluded.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 淨全 (A008961) — 號笑翁，為無用淨全禪師（1137-1207）法嗣。
teacher.note: BATCH'S PROPOSED CORRECTION CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 參松源岳禪師於靈隱，次謁無用全禪師於天童。一日擬開口，無用禪師以竹篦劈口便打，師應聲呈偈云：「大茶毒鼓，轟天震地，轉腦回頭，橫屍萬里。」無用禪師頷之。
teacher.note: THE DECISIVE PASSAGE. He CALLED ON (參) Songyuan Chongyue at Lingyin — and it went nowhere. He then went to Wuyong Jingquan, who struck him and APPROVED him (頷之). The secondary literature that makes him Songyuan's heir has mistaken the visit for the transmission. This is the audit's signature error, and the batch caught it. Teacher = 無用淨全.

dates.quote: 「戊申淳祐八年明州育王山笑翁禪師三月二十七日入寂，世壽七十二歲。」（《釋氏稽古略》卷4）
dates.note: Died 1248-04-29 aged 72, giving birth 1177. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

school.quote: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第十八世

bio: Of Huai'an circuit. Abbot of Jingshan in Hangzhou, twenty-second generation below Huineng. In 1284 Khubilai asked after masters of Southern Chan; the Right Chancellor Harghasun put his name forward, and he presented a verse arguing against the taking of life, which the emperor accepted with approval, receiving the precepts from him. His heirs include Nanchu Shiyue and Yuejiang Zhengyin.

teacher.kind: his own signed byline in his master's 語錄
teacher.quote: 住杭州靈隱禪寺法嗣　淨伏　編
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. He signs as 法嗣 — dharma-heir — of 虛舟普度, identifying himself by his then-seat (靈隱禪寺). The record's own author-line confirms the roles were kept distinct: 「(嗣法)淨伏、(門人)行佑．德珍．瓊林 等編」 — 淨伏 is 嗣法 (heir); the others are merely 門人 (disciples). This is not the editor trap; the text itself grades the editors.

teacher.kind: INSIDE the master's own live record — 虛舟普度 acknowledging him as 法嗣
teacher.quote: 石霜虎巖伏長老法嗣。書至，上堂：猿啼枯木，虎嘯斷巖，一燈發焰，萬象同觀。
teacher.note: STRONGEST OF ALL. A letter arrives from 虎巖伏, styled 法嗣, then abbot at 石霜 — and 虛舟普度 ASCENDS THE HALL to answer it, in his own record, in his own lifetime: 「一燈發焰，萬象同觀」 — one lamp casts its flame, the ten thousand images look on together. The teacher, alive, calls him his heir.

teacher.quote: 虛舟普度禪師語錄一卷（宋普度說，淨伏編，瓊林序，祖欽題記，附行狀。南嶽下第二十世，嗣無得通。）… 南嶽下第二十二世，嗣虎巖伏。
teacher.note: Generation arithmetic checks out: 普度 = 南嶽下第二十世; 虎巖伏's own heirs = 第二十二世; therefore 虎巖伏 = 第二十一世, i.e. 普度's immediate heir.

teacher.quote: TEACHER: 普度 (A013823) — 杭州徑山虎岩淨伏禪師，徑山虗舟普度（1199-1280）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十二世。（X84n1585_p0719b16）
teacher.note: Batch teacher CONFIRMED, and the teacher is dated 1199-1280.

school.quote: 臨濟宗 楊岐派；大鑑下第二十二世

bio.quote: 至元二十一年（1361），世祖問南禪方家，右相和禮霍孫舉師，師進偈明戒殺，上嘉納，即受帝戒。
bio.note: DILA's parenthetical '(1361)' for 至元二十一年 is an ERROR in DILA — 至元二十一年 under Khubilai is 1284. I have used 1284 in the bio and flag DILA's slip here rather than repeat it.

bio: Of Duchang, surname Liao. Tonsured at fifteen at Xianglin on Mt. Lu. He called on the master of Shishuang at Yangshan, then on Chijue at Jingshan in Zhe, without connecting; he then came to Wuzhun Shifan at Jingshan, and afterwards to Xiyan Hui at Tiantong. His presentation of the teaching followed Wuzhun's throughout, and he secretly matched his intent; he was made keeper of the canon, and later first seat under Wuwen Can at Kaixian. In the Jingding era he headed Yuantong, then Donglin, in 1292 moved to Ayuwang, and withdrew to Xuedou. In 1300 he took Tiantong. Died 1308 aged 88.

steles.title: 東巖日禪師塔銘
steles.author: 袁桷
steles.author_note: 元學士．文清 — Yuan Hanlin Academician, posthumously styled Wenqing. A major Yuan literatus.
steles.quote: 袁桷：東巖日禪師塔銘 — 元學士．文清袁桷撰銘，序曰：紹定辛卯，蜀破，…
steles.note: A NAMED YUAN ACADEMICIAN writing at the grave — and it sits in a GAZETTEER (GA014), not in any 語錄 of his own. Found only by sweeping the whole corpus for '<name>塔銘'. Exactly the case the brief predicted.

steles.title: 東巖日禪師塔銘
steles.author: 袁桷 (元學士．文清)
steles.quote: 生嘉定辛巳，終至大戊申，年八十有八，僧臘七十有一。將示寂，戒其徒，書韻語以示曰：「天為蓋兮地為函，吾奚為乎塔與菴，灰吾骨兮山阿，言已矢兮勿鑱。」
steles.note: Dates match the roster exactly (嘉定辛巳 = 1221, 至大戊申 = 1308, age 88). Poignantly, he forbade his disciples to build him a stupa or carve him anything ('scatter my ashes on the hillside; I have said it — do not engrave') — and they built one and engraved it anyway. The gazetteer also CORRECTS the earlier gazetteer on where the stupa stands: 「塔建于西巖之清風塢，舊志悞載于幻智菴後」. Note where they buried him: at 西巖's own 清風塢 — beside his master.

teacher.kind: his 塔銘 — 「東巖日禪師塔銘」, by 袁桷 (元學士．文清袁桷, 1266-1327), a contemporary; commissioned by his heir 如砥 (「如砥等來請銘」). In 天童寺志 — the temple gazetteer, not his own book.
teacher.quote: 師諱淨日，號東嵓，俗居南康之都昌，姓廖氏。…明年祝髮于廬山香林。訪道仰山石霜，遂入浙，見沖師于靈隱。越二夏，不契，乃登徑山，見無準師，範大許之…後見西嵓惠于天童。惠，無準大弟子，其提示與無準無異。危機敏鋒，迎拒莫覩；風止水息，渙然帖順。遂密契其旨，卒服從之，俾守藏室。
teacher.note: ⚠ THE STELE ITSELF WALKS THE AGENT PAST FOUR MEN AND KEEPS THEM APART — this is the single cleanest example of the brief's rule I found. 廬山香林 TONSURED him (祝髮). 癡絕道沖 at 靈隱: 「越二夏，不契」 — TWO YEARS AND IT FAILED. 不契 means it failed. 無準師範 at 徑山: 「範大許之」 — he approved him, and that approval is why the lamps and DILA keep drifting the edge toward Wuzhun. But the man he 「遂密契其旨，卒服從之」 — deeply matched and finally submitted to, who put him in charge of the library — is 西嵓惠 = 西巖了慧. The stele even explains the confusion in advance: 「惠，無準大弟子，其提示與無準無異」 — Liaohui was Wuzhun's great disciple and his teaching was indistinguishable from Wuzhun's. THAT is why the record blurs. The stele does not blur.

teacher.quote: 登徑山見無準禪師，後謁天童西巖慧師。其提示一秉於準，遂密契其旨。
teacher.note: AMBIGUITY RECORDED, NOT SMOOTHED. DILA's concise bio says his exposition 'followed Wuzhun throughout' and that he 'secretly matched HIS intent' — the 其 most naturally refers to Wuzhun, yet he is conventionally filed under Xiyan Liaohui, whom he approached later. The batch assigns 西巖了慧; DILA does not state a transmission explicitly either way. I keep the batch's 西巖了慧 but flag the teacher as NOT cleanly attested.

dates.note: 至大元年 = 1308, aged 88, giving birth 1221. NEW DATES — the batch had none.

bio: Abbot of Guangshan monastery on Mt. Bafeng in Taiping prefecture — the same mountain held by his dharma-grandfather Guzhuo Jun. He was a teacher of consequence in his day: the Buxu Gaoseng Zhuan records that Cuifeng Deshan 'burned his incense as an heir to the venerable Tan'.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元續略 heir-index, 東林悟禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 東林悟禪師法嗣：天成紹琦禪師　廣善潭禪師　太崗澄禪師　伏牛圓信禪師…
teacher.note: TAKEN, and it CONFIRMS the roster. 東林悟 is identified in the SAME book (0978a07) as 「普州東林無際悟禪師，蜀人」 — i.e. 無際明悟. So 廣善潭 (=寶月潭) is the heir of 無際明悟, exactly as the roster had it. His co-heir 天成紹琦 = 楚山紹琦.

teacher.quote: 廣善潭禪師法嗣：天寧宣禪師　東方古〔？〕禪師　伏牛月天禪師…
teacher.note: 天寧宣 = 默堂宣 (this batch), which cross-locks the identification 廣善潭 = 寶月潭 = 八峰潭.

dates.quote: 太平八峰山僧人，明成化間卒（疑年錄:356）
dates.note: death only bracketed to 成化間=1465–1487; no single year is defensible. teacher 無際明悟.

bio.quote: 瓣香為潭公嗣
bio.note: From the batch's own reading: Cuifeng Deshan's incense declares him an heir of 'the venerable Tan'. This attests that Baoyue Tan was a transmitting master with heirs — it does NOT attest who HIS teacher was.

bio: A late master of the Linji line, thirty-eighth generation below Nanyue (his heirs stand at the thirty-ninth). Two sobriquets are confirmed for the one man — his heir's record uses both 古雲沛 and 廬夢沛.

dates.kind: 正源略集 (in heir 樸夫拙's entry head)
dates.quote: 乾隆辛卯八月初十日示寂，世壽六十一，僧臘四十三，塔于蓮花峯之陽
dates.note: 乾隆辛卯=1771 death, 世壽61 -> born 1711. This is 古雲沛 himself (death precedes his 法嗣 header).

school.note: From the batch's own reading of his heir's record. I could not independently re-verify the file and line, and so do not assert a corpus path.

bio: A master in the line that runs from Dahui Zonggao down to the Juyun branch of Sichuan. His teacher was Fadu Puci of Fenzhou; his heir was Xiao'an Mi. He is otherwise invisible — he survives only as a link in a chain, named in the stupa inscription of a descendant five generations below him.

teacher.kind: 塔銘 (吹萬禪師塔銘, 田華國撰)
teacher.quote: 密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益
teacher.note: 'Mi inherited from Yiyan Xian; Xian inherited from Fadu Ci; Ci inherited from Kukou Yi.' From the stupa inscription of Chuiwan Guangzhen — five generations his junior — which recites the whole fourteen-generation chain. Batch teacher CONFIRMED at stele rung.

teacher.quote: 慈傳一言顯，顯傳小菴密，密傳二仰欽，欽傳無念有，有傳荊山寶，寶傳鐵牛遠，為妙喜一支未絕
teacher.note: A SECOND corpus witness, in a different text, reciting the same chain in the same order — 'so that Miaoxi's (Dahui's) branch was not cut off'. Two independent attestations of a man who has no record of his own.

teacher.quote: 筏渡普慈 … 《續燈正統》卷13：「太原益禪師法嗣，汾州筏渡普慈禪師」
teacher.note: CORROBORATION FROM ABOVE: DILA confirms 筏渡普慈 is a real person (1264-1351), of Fenzhou, and that HIS teacher was 苦口良益 (太原益) — exactly as the Chuiwan stele's chain claims. The stele checks out at the link immediately above Yiyan Xian.

school.note: Chuiwan is Dahui's 14th-generation descendant; Yiyan Xian stands six generations above Chuiwan in the same recitation, i.e. Dahui's 8th generation. Fourteenth-century, given his teacher's dates (1264-1351).

links.label: DILA Authority A015518 (his teacher 筏渡普慈)

bio: Silla monk, traditionally the first to carry Chan to Korea. The only near-contemporary witness is Choe Chiwon's stele for Doheon (Jijeung Daesa, erected at Bongam-sa), which traces the Korean line from the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin: Daoxin -> Beomnang -> Sinhaeng -> Junbeom -> Hyeeun -> Doheon. The same stele states that Beomnang studied under Daoxin himself at Shuangfeng. The compiler of Joseon Bulgyo Tongsa attaches an interlinear doubt to the name ('Beomnang is perhaps an error for Beommyeong'), so even this attestation is not clean. No dates, no birthplace, no independent biography survives; every later Korean lineage chart depends on this one stele.

steles.title: 鳳巖山寺智證大師寂照塔碑銘 (the stele of his 4th-generation heir Doheon, which is the source for Beomnang)
steles.author: 崔致遠 (Choe Chiwon)
steles.author_note: Silla's foremost literatus; the stele is one of the 四山碑銘
steles.quote: 唐四祖為五世父。道信之旁出東漸于海。遡流數之雙峯（子）法朗。孫信行。曾孫遵範。玄孫惠隱。末孫大師也。朗大師從大醫四祖
steles.note: Not his own stele — his heir's. 大醫 is Daoxin's posthumous title, so 「朗大師從大醫」 = Beomnang studied under Daoxin. The corpus text carries an editorial gloss 「法朗恐是法明之誤」 casting doubt on the name itself.

teacher.kind: 塔碑銘 (quoted in 朝鮮佛教通史)
teacher.quote: 朗大師從大醫四祖
teacher.note: Choe Chiwon's stele for Doheon, c. 924. Confirms the roster's teacher (Daoxin), but see the 法明 gloss.

school.note: 'Daoxin's collateral branch flowed east across the sea' — the Korean Seon origin claim.

notes: Traditionally credited as the first to bring Chan teachings to Korea from the Fourth Patriarch Daoxin. Semi-legendary but foundational for Korean Seon.

bio: Of Ankang, Du clan. Ordained young, first studied Vinaya, then went to Caoxi and served the Sixth Patriarch Huineng for fifteen years. After Huineng's death he settled at Boruo monastery on Mount Nanyue, where his teaching produced Mazu Daoyi — through whom the Linji and Guiyang houses descend. Died 744.

steles.title: 衡州般若寺觀音大師碑銘（並序）
steles.author: 張正甫 (元和十年 = 815)
steles.quote: 元和中，名儒張正甫製其銘…大師諱懷讓，京兆杜氏。
steles.note: Also quoted in T49n2036 佛祖歷代通載 (0596a01, same opening 「大師諱懷讓。京兆杜氏」) — two independent transmissions of the same stele text inside the corpus. Attribution to 張正甫 and the 全唐文 provenance are corroborated by 印順《中國禪宗史》 Y40n0038 (0321a01).

teacher.kind: his stele 碑銘, quoted at length
teacher.quote: 元和中，名儒張正甫製其銘曰：天寶三載，觀音大師終于衡嶽，春秋六十八，僧臘四十八。元和十年，故大師弟子道一之門人曰惟寬、懷暉，感塵劫遽遷，塔樹已拱…大師諱懷讓，京兆杜氏…以荊土律藏之微密也，大士智京在焉，攝衣從之…以嵩嶽禪之泉海也，長安長老在焉，稽首咨之…厭離文字，思會宗元。周法界以冥搜，指曹溪而遐舉。能大師方弘法施，學者如歸…師以後學弱齡，分於末席。虗中而若無所受，善閉而唯恐有聞。能公異焉，置之座右…同受秘印，因為宗師。
teacher.note: This is 張正甫's 〈衡州般若寺觀音大師碑銘並序〉 (元和十年 = 815), reproduced at length in 祖琇《隆興編年通論》X75n1512. THE STELE ITSELF IS A MODEL OF THE DISTINCTION THE ROSTER KEEPS GETTING WRONG: it names 大士智京 (vinaya study), then the 嵩嶽 'Chang'an elder' (consulted), and ONLY THEN 曹溪 — where 能公 (Huineng) singled him out, seated him at his right, and 同受秘印 ('received the secret seal') 因為宗師. The stele was commissioned by Mazu Daoyi's own disciples 惟寬 and 懷暉 precisely because the old men who remembered him were dying (懼絕故老之口). Stele-grade, and it independently confirms the roster dates: died 天寶三載 (744), age 68 → b. 677.

teacher.quote: 參曹溪，為六祖慧能（638-713）之高足，留侍十五年
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A001719 惠能, citing X79n1557_p0002a06.

dates.quote: birth +0677-05-17 儀鳳二年四月八日降誕 (X68n1315_p0002c20); death +0744-09-26 師天寶三年八月十二日終 (祖堂集：88)
dates.note: Both ends carry a source. Matches the roster's 677/744.

school.quote: 開南嶽一系…弟子馬祖道一（709-788）繼其法流，發展成臨濟、溈仰等宗派

notes: Dharma heir of Huineng. Ancestor of the Linji and Guiyang houses. Famous for 'polishing a tile' exchange with Mazu.

bio: Heir of Heze Shenhui and a link in the Heze line that ran into Sichuan. Zongmi's 圓覺經略疏鈔 identifies him as 'Zhiru of Faguan monastery in Cizhou, lay surname Wang', and Pei Xiu's stele for Zongmi gives the chain in one line: Heze transmitted to Zhiru of Cizhou, Zhiru to Zhang of Jingnan (Nanyin Weizhong of Chengdu), Zhang to Yuan of Suizhou, and on to Shenzhao of the Eastern Capital. Nothing else about his life survives.

teacher.kind: 碑銘 quoted (裴休, 圭峯禪師碑銘)
teacher.quote: 裴休云：「荷澤傳磁州如，如傳荊南張，張傳遂州圓，又傳東京照。」（圭峯禪師碑銘）
teacher.note: Pei Xiu's stele for Guifeng Zongmi (9th c.) names the chain. Shenhui -> Zhiru.

teacher.quote: 磁州法觀寺智如和尚，俗姓王。門下成都府聖壽寺唯忠和尚，俗姓張，亦號南印。
teacher.note: Zongmi, two generations down, names his monastery and lay surname.

teacher.quote: 俗姓王，礠州法觀寺僧，荷澤神會弟子。（X09n0248_p0863a18）
teacher.note: NOTE: this AID is in the downloadable authority XML but returns 人名：0 筆 on authority-old, so I emit no URL for it.

school.quote: 神會傳磁州智如，智如傳益州南印，南印傳東京神照

notes: Second generation Heze lineage. Dharma heir of Shenhui.

bio: Of Jiangzhou, Han clan. Ordained under Huizhao in the Western Hills, took full precepts from the Vinaya master Xicao at Hengyue. Widely read in the sutras and strict in discipline, he then went to Shitou Xiqian, also visited Mazu Daoyi, awoke under Shitou and served him three years before receiving his dharma. He taught at Yaoshan monastery in Lizhou; the layman Li Ao was among his callers. His heir Yunyan Tansheng carries the line that becomes Caodong. Posthumous title Hongdao.

steles.title: 澧州藥山故惟儼大師碑銘（并序）
steles.author: 唐伸 Tang Shen
steles.path: T/T49/T49n2036.xml (quoted in full by 佛祖歷代通載; the CBETA collation apparatus of 宋高僧傳 T50n2061 also cites the inscription by this exact title)
steles.quote: 澧州藥山禪師惟儼卒。大儒唐伸為之碑曰…銘曰。一物在中。觸境而搖。我示其源。不境不跳。…曹溪所傳。徒藏于密。身世俱空。
steles.note: The stele survives complete. It is the single most important document for this man and it is NOT what the lineage charts say.

teacher.source: T/T49/T49n2036.xml (佛祖歷代通載), quoting 唐伸's stele 「澧州藥山故惟儼大師碑銘（并序）」 IN FULL
teacher.kind: 碑銘 (stele) — the earliest source for this man
teacher.quote: 是時南嶽有遷。江西有寂。中岳有洪。皆悟心契。乃知大圭之質豈俟磨礱…自是寂以大乘法聞四方。學徒至於指心傳要。眾所不能達者。師必默識懸解。不違如愚。居寂之室垂二十年。寂曰。汝之所得。可謂浹於心術布於四體。欲益而無所益。欲知而無所知。渾然天和合於本無。吾無有以教矣。…爾當以功德普濟群迷。宜作梯航無久滯此。
teacher.note:
⚠⚠ THE LARGEST CONTRADICTION IN THIS BATCH — recorded, not silently resolved. The stele names Shitou ('遷') ONCE, only inside a list of the three eminent masters then alive (南嶽有遷、江西有寂、中岳有洪). It does NOT say Weiyan studied under him. What it says instead is that he 「居寂之室垂二十年」 — lived in JI's room for nearly TWENTY YEARS — where 寂 is Mazu Daoyi (posthumous title 大寂禪師), and that it was Mazu who dismissed him with the transmission formula 「吾無有以教矣」 ('I have nothing left to teach you') and sent him out to teach. On the evidence ladder the stele outranks the lamp, and a mechanical application of the ladder would set this man's teacher to 馬祖道一.

I have NOT flipped the field, and here is why, stated openly. (1) The received tradition — 祖堂集, 景德傳燈錄, 宋高僧傳 and Weiyan's own recorded dialogues (the famous 石頭路滑 exchanges) — is unanimous for Shitou, and Weiyan is the hinge on which the ENTIRE Caodong house hangs (惟儼 → 雲巖曇晟 → 洞山良价). Rerouting him re-parents Caodong under Hongzhou; that is a decision for the project, not for one subagent. (2) The rule is that a contradiction is a reroute, not a deletion — and I can name the landing place (馬祖道一), so this is a live reroute proposal, not a cut.

MY READING: the stele is the better evidence for what actually happened, and the Shitou affiliation looks like part of the later construction of the Qingyuan/Shitou line. I flag `transmission: disputed` and escalate. Do not let this pass unadjudicated.

teacher.source: T/T51/T51n2076.xml (景德傳燈錄) and the whole later tradition
teacher.quote: (the received line: 惟儼 as heir of 石頭希遷, with a subsidiary visit to 馬祖)
teacher.note: The OTHER side of the contradiction, recorded as required. The lamps make him Shitou's heir. They are 175+ years later than the stele.

teacher.quote: 石頭希遷禪師（701-791）法嗣，大鑑下第三世…後謁石頭希遷，參馬祖道一，言下契悟，奉侍三年。及還，嗣法
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A010291 希遷. He also has a second teacher relation, 慧照 (his tonsure master), which is NOT the transmission. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0746; death +0829-01-18 （大和二年）十二月六日 (全唐文：2444)
dates.note: DISCREPANCY WITH ROSTER: roster says 745-828. The lunar death date 大和二年十二月六日 falls on 18 Jan 829 Gregorian; the Chinese year is 828. Both are defensible — I take DILA's 746/829 and flag the difference.

bio.kind: authority record (citing 全唐文 2444, his 碑)

notes: Pivotal figure linking Shitou's lineage to the later Caodong school through his student Yunyan.

contested_by.rival_evidence: 唐伸's stupa inscription, written 8 years after his death from the disciples' own 行狀: 「居寂之室垂二十年」 -- twenty years in the chamber of 寂 (馬祖道一), released with the completion formula. 石頭希遷 appears only as one of three eminent contemporaries and transmits nothing.
contested_by.kept_evidence: 宋高僧傳 (988), 160 years later. Index-grade, and it never mentions Mazu.
contested_by.stake: Carries the whole Caodong line (藥山→雲巖→洞山), Dogen included.

bio: Of Haimen, Li clan, said to descend from the Tang imperial house. Left home under Chan master Yuncong, took full precepts from the Vinaya master Zhiyan at Nanyue. He met Mazu Daoyi, awoke under him and inherited his dharma. From the end of the Yuanhe era he taught at the Haichang cloister in Yanguan, where his converts included the future Emperor Xuanzong. Posthumous title Wukong. The Korean Beomil was among his heirs.

teacher.kind: 宋高僧傳 (988), 唐杭州鹽官海昌院齊安傳
teacher.quote: 後聞南康龔公山大寂禪師隨化度人，慈緣幽感。裹足振錫，一日造焉。大寂欣其相依，論持不倦。
teacher.note: 大寂禪師 = 馬祖道一 (posthumous 大寂). 雲琮 was his tonsure master, 智嚴 his vinaya master — three teachers, one dharma-father, exactly the tradition's own pattern.

teacher.quote: 參謁馬祖道一（709-788），得其鉗槌而悟道，並嗣其法
teacher.note: 嗣其法 = inherited his dharma.

teacher.quote: 參謁馬祖道一（709-788），得其鉗槌而悟道，並嗣其法
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A003623 道一, citing X80n1564_p0004a03. Two further teacher relations (雲琮 tonsure, 智嚴 ordination) are NOT the transmission. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: death +0843-01-29 以會昌二年壬戌十二月二十二日。泊然宴坐俄爾示滅。（T50n2061_p0776c15）
dates.note: DISCREPANCY WITH ROSTER: roster says died 842. The lunar date 會昌二年十二月二十二日 = 29 Jan 843 Gregorian. Chinese year 842, Gregorian 843. I take 843 and flag it. NO BIRTH DATE is attested anywhere — the roster's floruit 750 is unsourced.

school.quote: 法嗣有…梵日 (鹽官齊安禪師法嗣, T51n2076_p0273b13)

bio.kind: authority record (citing 宋高僧傳 T50n2061)

notes: Known for the 'rhinoceros fan' koan (Blue Cliff Record, Case 91).

bio: Chan master of Dayu monastery in Gao'an, Hongzhou. He was the dharma heir of Guizong Zhichang, in the fourth generation from Huineng. Huangbo sent the young Linji Yixuan to him, and it was in Dayu's hut that Linji awoke — the most famous thing about him. The nun Moshan Liaoran of Junzhou was his dharma heir. No dates survive.

teacher.kind: 祖堂集 (952), 臨濟義玄 entry — quoting 黃檗希運's OWN ADDRESS TO HIS ASSEMBLY
teacher.quote: 黃蘗和尚告眾曰：「余昔時同參大寂道友，名曰大愚。此人諸方行腳，法眼明徹，今在高安，願不好群居，獨棲山舍。與余相別時叮囑云：『他後或逢靈利者，指一人來相訪。』」
teacher.note: READ IT SLOWLY. 黃檗希運, speaking to his own monks, calls 大愚 『余昔時同參大寂道友』 — MY FELLOW-STUDENT UNDER 大寂, i.e. under 馬祖道一 (大寂 is Mazu's posthumous title; cf. 白居易's 傳法堂碑, 『一諡曰大寂』). He also places him at 高安 and describes his solitary life there — every detail matches. If 大愚 studied under 馬祖 alongside 黃檗, he is a MAZU heir, one generation ABOVE where the roster has him. 歸宗智常 is himself a Mazu heir; the roster makes 大愚 Zhichang's student, i.e. Mazu's GRANDson. The earliest witness says otherwise, and says it in the voice of a man who knew him personally.

teacher.kind: same entry — 大愚's own deathbed charge
teacher.quote: 師因此侍奉大愚，經十餘年。大愚臨遷化時囑師云：「子自不負平生，又乃終吾一世，已後出世傳心，第一莫忘黃蘗。」
teacher.note: CONTEXT THE ROSTER SHOULD SEE. In the 祖堂集's version, 臨濟義玄 served 大愚 for TEN-ODD YEARS (侍奉大愚，經十餘年) and 大愚 said of him 『不期今日卻得一子』 — today I unexpectedly got a son. On his deathbed 大愚 charges him: when you go out and transmit mind, first of all do not forget Huangbo. This is a substantially different account from the familiar 三頓棒 story in which Linji bounces back to Huangbo. It bears on the LINJI edge, not mine, and I flag it without touching it.

teacher.quote: 洪州高安大愚禪師，廬山歸宗智常（765-870）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第四世。住持大愚寺，臨濟嘗往參之。法嗣有筠州末山尼了然禪師。（T51n2078；X80n1565_p0220c20）
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A003865 智常. Guizong Zhichang's OWN record (A003865) independently says 法嗣有大愚, so the edge is attested from both ends. Roster CONFIRMED.

notes: Reclusive monk in Gao’an, Jiangxi. Triggered Linji Yixuan’s great awakening when Huangbo sent Linji to him. Teacher of Moshan Liaoran.

bio: Born in the Silla capital, Kim clan; named Doheon, styled Jiseon. Father Chan'goe, mother of the Yi clan. He lost his father at nine, studied at Buseok-san, took full precepts at seventeen, and received the profound teaching from Hyeeun — a domestic line, so unlike the other Nine Mountain founders he never crossed to Tang China for transmission. He founded the Huiyang-san school at Bongam-sa. Born 824, died 882, aged 59, with 43 summers of ordination. Posthumously Jijeung Daesa; his stupa stele, by Choe Chiwon, is one of the celebrated Four Mountain Steles.

steles.title: 有唐新羅國故鳳巖山寺教諡智證大師寂照之塔碑銘
steles.author: 崔致遠 (Choe Chiwon)
steles.author_note: Silla's greatest literatus, writing within a generation of the man; one of the 四山碑銘
steles.quote: 其世緣則。王都人。金姓子。號道憲。字智詵。父贊瓖。母伊氏。長慶甲辰歲。現于世。中和壬寅曆。歸于寂。宴坐也四十三夏。歸全也五十九年。
steles.note: The stele gives his birth (長慶甲辰 = 824), death (中和壬寅 = 882), age 59 and 43 dharma-summers, and names his teacher: 「探玄于惠隱嚴君」.

steles.title: 有唐新羅國故㬢陽山鳳巖寺教諡智證大師寂照之塔碑銘并序
steles.author: 崔致遠 (Choe Chiwon), by royal command
steles.quote: 有唐新羅國故㬢陽山鳳巖寺教諡智證大師寂照之塔碑銘并序…臣崔致遠奉教撰　序曰。五常分位。配動方者曰
steles.note: ONE OF THE 四山碑銘. Full text in the corpus at B31n0170; also transmitted in 全唐文拾遺 j.44. The stone still stands at 鳳巖寺 (Bongamsa), Mungyeong.

teacher.kind: 崔致遠's stele, 智證大師寂照塔碑銘, quoted in full in 朝鮮佛教通史
teacher.quote: 有唐新羅國故㬢陽山鳳巖寺教諡智證大師寂照之塔碑銘并序　入朝賀正兼延奉皇華等使朝請大夫前守兵部侍郎元瑞書院學士賜紫金魚袋臣崔致遠奉教撰
teacher.note: The stele itself, with Choe Chiwon's full official title, 奉教撰 = composed by royal command.

teacher.kind: authority record citing 全唐文．拾遺．卷四十四 (the same 崔致遠 stele)
teacher.quote: 曾孫遵範，玄孫慧隱，來孫大師也。（全唐文．拾遺．卷四十四．大唐新羅國故鳳巖山寺教謚智證大師寂照之塔碑銘）
teacher.note: The generational chain in the stele: 遵範 → 慧隱 → 道憲. DILA's own bio line: 「新羅惠隱弟子。」 The stele is ALSO transmitted in 全唐文拾遺 j.44 — a second, independent textual witness to the same stone.

teacher.quote: 終上達也。探玄于惠隱嚴君…玄孫惠隱。末孫大師也。
teacher.note: His own stele. Teacher = 惠隱 (Hyeeun). Roster CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 新羅惠隱弟子。（全唐文．拾遺．卷四十四．大唐新羅國故鳳巖山寺教謚智證大師寂照之塔碑銘）

dates.quote: 長慶甲辰歲。現于世。中和壬寅曆。歸于寂…歸全也五十九年。
dates.note: 824-882, age 59 — from the stele itself. Roster's 824/882 CONFIRMED exactly.

school.quote: 道信之旁出東漸于海…雙峯（子）法朗。孫信行。曾孫遵範。玄孫惠隱。末孫大師也。
school.note: The domestic Daoxin line — explains why he never went to Tang.

notes: Silla monk associated with the Huiyang-san school, one of the Nine Mountain Schools. Unlike most Nine Mountain founders, he did not travel to Tang China for transmission, making his lineage claim domestically attested only.

bio: Of Linzi, tonsured at the Hutong cloister in Caozhou. He met Nanquan Puyuan, awoke under him and inherited his dharma, then took full precepts at Songyue. Late in life he settled at the Guanyin cloister in Zhaozhou and taught there into extreme old age. His 'drink tea' and 'a dog has no Buddha-nature' exchanges made him the most quoted master in the koan literature. Died 897; posthumous title Zhenji.

steles.title: 趙州真際禪師行狀
steles.author: anonymous (transmitted with the 語錄)
steles.quote: 師即南泉門人也…鎮府有塔記云
steles.note: Cites a 塔記 at 鎮府; the stupa record itself is not separately preserved in the corpus.

teacher.kind: 行狀 (conduct-record, stele-class), prefixed to his own 趙州和尚語錄
teacher.quote: 趙州真際禪師行狀：師即南泉門人也。俗姓郝氏，本曹州郝鄉人也，諱從諗。鎮府有塔記云：「師得七百甲子歟！…」師初隨本師行腳到南泉。…南泉在方丈內臥次，見師來參…泉乃喚維那云：「此沙彌別處安排。」
teacher.note: The 行狀 opens by declaring him 南泉門人 outright, then narrates the first meeting with 南泉 at length. It also QUOTES a 塔記 standing at 鎮府 — i.e. the 行狀 itself is drawing on his physical stupa inscription. Note the 行狀 keeps the roles apart in the approved way: his 本師 (the master he was travelling with, and whose 護國院 he later revisits) is a DIFFERENT man from 南泉 — 本師 here is his tonsure/ordination master, not his dharma-father.

teacher.kind: independent quotation of the same 行狀
teacher.quote: 趙州真際禪師行狀曰：師即南泉門人也，諱從諗。
teacher.note: The 行狀 is quoted with the same opening clause in a second, unrelated work — the text is stable across witnesses, not a one-copy artefact.

teacher.quote: 南泉普願（748-835）禪師法嗣…參池陽南泉有悟
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A003889 普願, citing T51n2076_p0273b05. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0778 (依記錄推算); death +0897-12-03 唐乾寧四年仲冬二日，右脅而寂。壽一百二十
dates.note: Roster's 778/897 CONFIRMED. The traditional age of 120 is what the sources say; the birth year is back-computed.

bio.kind: authority record (citing 宋高僧傳 T50n2061_p0775c07)

notes: One of the most celebrated Chan masters, appearing in more koans than any other figure. Met Nanquan at age 18, studied under him over 20 years. At 80, settled at the dilapidated Guanyin Temple in Zhaozhou where he taught for 40 more years. Famous for 'No' (無), 'wash your bowl', 'the cypress tree in the garden', and 'have a cup of tea' (喫茶去). Lived to 120. His lineage died out by c. 1000 CE, but his recorded sayings (趙州錄) preserved his enormous influence.

bio: Of Huaining, Liu clan; a monk of Mount Touzi in Tongcheng, Shuzhou. He left home under Manchan of Baotang in Luoyang, first practised anapana meditation, then turned to the Huayan 'ocean of nature'. At Cuiwei's assembly he came to a clear understanding of the patriarchal intent and inherited Cuiwei Wuxue's dharma. He returned home, built a thatched hut on Mount Touzi and lived there for decades; Zhaozhou Congshen's visit to him is a well-known encounter. Died 914, aged 96, with 46 years of ordination.

teacher.quote: 翠微學（即翠微無學）法嗣…復負錫謁翠微山法會，同伏牛元通激發請益，大明祖意。
teacher.note: teacher 翠微無學 confirmed; 保唐滿 = his first出俗 master (tonsure), separate.

teacher.quote: 翠微學（即翠微無學）法嗣…復負錫謁翠微山法會，同伏牛元通激發請益，大明祖意
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A010616 無學. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0819; death +0914-05-08 梁乾化四年甲戌四月六日，加趺坐亡，春秋九十六，法臘四十六。（T50n2061_p0785b14）
dates.note: Roster's 819/914 CONFIRMED, from 宋高僧傳.

notes: Heir of Cuiwei Wuxue, from Shuzhou in Anhui. Settled on Mount Touzi and lived there as a hermit for over thirty years, drawing many students. Visited by Zhaozhou Congshen in a famous encounter. Appears in Blue Cliff Record cases 41, 79, 80, and 91.

bio: Of the Kim clan, his forebears from Gyerim; born at Sotae. At twelve he entered Gayagap-sa under the dharma master Deongnyang; took full precepts in 886 from the Vinaya master Dogyeon. In 896 he sailed to China with the envoy Choe Yehui, sought out Yunju Daoying and received his dharma — one of the 'four fearless great ones', Korean heirs of Yunju. He returned in 911 and founded the Sumi-san school, the last of the Nine Mountain Schools, at Gwangjo-sa in Haeju. Posthumously Jincheol Daesa; his stupa is the Bowol Seunggong.

steles.title: 有唐高麗國海州湏彌山廣照寺故教諡真澈大師寶月乘空之塔碑銘并序
steles.author: 崔彥撝 (Choe Eonwi)
steles.author_note: Goryeo court official, 檢校尚書左僕射兼御史大夫; the stele names 門人元輔 as the disciple who commissioned it
steles.quote: 大師法諱利嚴。俗姓金氏。其先鷄林人也…故大師生於蘇泰…年十二。往迦耶岬寺。投德良法師…中和六年。受具足戒於本寺道堅律師…乾寧三年。忽遇入浙使崔藝熙大夫…于時。企聞雲居道膺大師。
steles.note: His own stupa stele. Gives lay surname, birthplace, tonsure, ordination, the 896 crossing to China, and the teacher: Yunju Daoying.

teacher.quote: 乾寧三年…企聞雲居道膺大師。禪門之…
teacher.note: His own stele. Roster CONFIRMED (Yunju Daoying).

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A010588 道膺
慶猷逈㣲。麗嚴。利嚴。共海東謂之四無畏大士也。
teacher.note: A SECOND, independent stele (that of his dharma-brother Gyeongyu) names him among Yunju Daoying's four Korean heirs.

dates.note: Roster's death 936 CONFIRMED; roster's 'floruit 869' is really the birth year, 870.

dates.kind: 朝鮮佛教通史 chronicle entry
dates.quote: 辛未十五年後梁乾化元年高僧利嚴。自唐還。
dates.note: Returned from Tang in 911.

school.note: Sumi-san / Gwangjo-sa — the Sumi-san school.

notes: Late Silla / early Goryeo monk who studied under Yunju Daoying (Dongshan Liangjie lineage) in Tang China. Founded the Sumi-san school, the last of the Nine Mountain Schools. Attested primarily in Korean stele inscriptions.

bio: Of Yuhang, Liu clan. Tonsured by the Vinaya master Zhigong at Kaiyuan monastery, he first studied the Tiantai Lotus commentaries and its meditation system. He failed to connect with Jingqing Daofu, then went to Nanyuan Huiyong and stayed six years, inheriting his dharma. In 931 he entered the ruined Fengxue monastery in Ruzhou and stayed seven years; in 937 he opened Anle monastery at Jingshan. He is the man who carried the Linji line through the Five Dynasties. Died 973, aged 78.

teacher.kind: 佛祖正傳古今捷錄 biography
teacher.quote: 第八世風穴延沼禪師，餘杭劉氏子，一舉不第出家。初參鏡清，次謁南院。院問：南方一棒作麼生商量？師曰：作奇特商量…院拈拄杖曰：棒下無生忍，臨機不見師。師於言下大徹玄旨。
teacher.note: ⚠ TWO verbs again: 初參鏡清 (association, failed to hold) → 次謁南院 → 於言下大徹. The awakening is under 南院慧顒. 鏡清 is not the teacher.

teacher.quote: 南院慧顒禪師法嗣…參鏡清怤不合，謁南院顒，依止六年
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A004981 慧顒. Nanyuan's OWN record (A004981) independently says 法嗣有風穴延昭禪師 — attested from both ends. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0897 「唐乾寧三年十二月生」（佛祖歷代通載 18）; death +0973-09-19 「宋太祖開寶六年八月十五日跏趺而逝，壽七十八」（釋氏稽古略 3）
dates.note: Roster's 897/973 CONFIRMED.

notes: Preserved the Linji lineage during Five Dynasties persecutions.

bio: His father was prefect of Hengyang and died in office; escorting the coffin home, the young Huijue passed the old Yaoshan monastery in Lizhou, felt he had lived there before, and left home on the strength of it. He travelled, and got the dharma from Fenyang Shanzhao. In 1026 he took up residence on Mount Langye in Chuzhou and made the Linji style flourish there. He and Xuedou Chongxian, who was then teaching the Yunmen way, were called 'the two gates of sweet dew'. Six heirs, among them Haiyin Xin.

teacher.kind: 續傳燈錄, his own entry
teacher.quote: 滁州琅邪山慧覺廣照禪師，西洛人也。父為衡陽太守，因疾傾喪，師扶櫬歸洛，過澧陽藥山古剎，宛若夙居，緣此出家，遊方參問，得法汾陽，應緣滁水。與雪竇明覺同時唱道，四方皆謂二甘露門。
teacher.note: 得法汾陽 — the transmission verb, in his own lamp entry. The roster's edge is confirmed.

teacher.quote: 得法於汾陽善昭禪師，天聖四年（1026）住滁州瑯琊山，大振臨濟宗風
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A004984 善昭. Roster CONFIRMED.

school.quote: 同時，明州雪竇重顯禪師則唱雲門之法道，時人稱「二甘露門」

notes: Dharma brother of Shishuang Chuyuan.

bio: Of the Deng clan; he was thirty-five before he shaved his head and took precepts. He went to Chengdu and studied the Hundred Dharmas and Consciousness-Only, then turned to Chan: he saw Yuanzhao Zongben, then Fushan Fayuan, and finally Baiyun Shouduan, who sealed him. He taught at Mount Wuzu in Qizhou. His three great heirs — Yuanwu Keqin, Foyan Qingyuan and Taiping Huiqin — were called 'the three Buddhas under Fayan' and dominated the next generation. Died 1104, aged 87.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his first enthronement (初住四面山)
teacher.quote: 拈香云：此一瓣香。得來久矣。十有餘年海上雲遊。討一箇冤讐。未曾遭遇。一到龍舒。果遇其人。方契憤憤之心。今日對大眾雪屈。須至爇却。為我見住白雲端和尚。
teacher.note: First-person incense, unmistakable. 為…白雲端和尚 (Baiyun Shouduan). The '10-odd years hunting an enemy' is a stock Chan trope for the search for a true teacher; 果遇其人 = 'I met my man' at Longshu, where Baiyun then taught. NOTE this is not literally 用酬法乳 wording but it IS the dharma-incense: it is raised 為 his awakening-master, distinct from the祝聖 stick.

teacher.quote: 白雲端（1025-1072）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第十四世…後投白雲守端禪師，受印可
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A003723 守端. Roster CONFIRMED.

teacher.kind: flat 法嗣 index (續傳燈錄)
teacher.quote: 白雲端禪師法嗣一十二人：五祖法演禪師、雲蓋智本禪師、琅邪永起禪師…
teacher.note: Listed first among Baiyun Shouduan's twelve heirs.

dates.quote: birth +1018-01-26 ~ +1019-02-13 (鈴木省訓); death +1104-07-25 「崇寧三年六月二十五日」（續傳燈錄 20）「八十七歲」
dates.note: DISCREPANCY WITH ROSTER: roster gives floruit 1024. The scholarship (Suzuki Shokun) and the age-87-at-death arithmetic put his birth at 1018/1019. Death 1104 confirmed. I take 1018.

school.quote: 北宋臨濟宗楊岐派僧…大鑑下第十四世

notes: His three principal disciples became the most influential Chan teachers of the next generation.

bio: A man of Xiangyang; Chan master of Langye in Chuzhou. He was a dharma heir of Baiyun Shouduan and thus a dharma-brother of Wuzu Fayan, with whom he is listed in the same breath in the Xu chuandeng lu. The Xu chuandeng lu preserves a handful of his exchanges ('Why does the man inside the hut not see what is outside it?' — 'The east house lights a lamp, the west house sits in the dark'). Nothing else is known of his life.

teacher.kind: 續傳燈錄, 滁州琅邪永起禪師
teacher.quote: 滁州琅邪永起禪師襄陽人也。…乃曰。五更殘月落。天曉白雲飛。分明目前事。不是目前機。
teacher.note: Body of his lamp bio; he is listed in the 白雲端禪師法嗣一十二人 section: 「五祖法演禪師、雲蓋智本禪師、琅邪永起禪師…」 (T51n2077).

teacher.quote: 白雲端禪師法嗣。（T51n2077_p0597b26）
teacher.note: 白雲守端 confirmed.

teacher.kind: flat 法嗣 index (續傳燈錄)
teacher.quote: 白雲端禪師法嗣一十二人：五祖法演禪師、雲蓋智本禪師、琅邪永起禪師、保福殊禪師、崇勝琪禪師、提刑郭祥正居士…
teacher.note: DECISIVE. He is listed among Baiyun Shouduan's twelve heirs, alongside Wuzu Fayan.

teacher.quote: 琅邪永起禪師 滁州琅邪永起禪師襄陽人也。
teacher.note: His own entry sits under the Baiyun Shouduan heirs section; gives his native place.

teacher.quote: 白雲端禪師法嗣。（T51n2077_p0597b26）
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A003723 守端.

notes: Song dynasty Chan master at Langye Mountain. Teacher of Yu Daopo, his only dharma heir.
date_note: roster 1090-1150 is impossible: teacher 白雲守端 died 1072

bio: Of Fuzhou, Zheng clan; his mother is said to have dreamt of an old monk of Mount Lu entering the house before his birth. Broadly learned, a good writer and calligrapher, he travelled widely before meeting Ying'an Tanhua at Mingguo hermitage in Quzhou, who sealed him. He came out at Wuju hermitage and went on to head Jiangshan, Huazang, Jingshan, Lingyin and Tiantong. His heirs — Songyuan Chongyue, Po'an Zuxian and Caoyuan Daosheng — carry the dominant Linji line onward. Died 1186, aged 69.

steles.title: 密菴和尚語錄〈塔銘〉
steles.author_note: Author not named in the source available to me
steles.quote: 淳熙十三年六月十二日，年六十九
steles.note: ATTESTED BUT NOT LOCATED IN THE CORPUS: DILA cites his 塔銘 in 《密菴和尚語錄》卷1 for the death date, but the CBETA text of that 語錄 (T47n1999) does NOT carry the 塔銘 — I searched it and there are no hits for 咸傑 or the date. DILA must be quoting a different edition. Flagging rather than pretending.

teacher.quote: 師諱咸傑，嗣應菴，福州鄭氏子。母夢廬山僧入屋而生，下髮徧扣諸方。後見應菴…
teacher.note: Written by XISOU SHAOTAN — who is also in this batch. A near-contemporary Linji insider. Roster CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 諱咸傑，福州鄭氏子，嗣歸宗華祖法。
teacher.note: 華 = 曇華 = Ying'an Tanhua.

teacher.quote: 應菴曇華禪師（1103-1163）法嗣，大鑑下第十八世

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 塔銘
dates.quote: death +1186-07-07 「淳熙十三年六月十二日，年六十九」（《密菴和尚語錄》卷 1〈塔銘〉）; birth +1118
dates.note: Roster's 1118/1186 CONFIRMED.

bio.quote: 〔傳畧〕師諱咸傑，福州鄭氏子。母夢廬山老僧入室而生。自幼穎悟，及出家，不憚遊行。徧參知識，無所契。

notes: His most prominent heir Songyuan Chongyue continued the dominant Linji line through Po'an Zuxian and Yunan Puyan.

bio: Khitan statesman, eighth-generation descendant of the Liao prince Yelü Bei; chief advisor to Genghis and then Ogedei, and the architect of civil administration in Mongol north China — he reopened the examinations, fixed court ritual, and pressed for taxation over massacre. A lay dharma heir of Wansong Xingxiu, under the name Zhanran Jushi. His collected works are the Zhanran jushi wenji. Posthumous name Wenzheng.

teacher.kind: own signed preface to 從容庵錄 (dated 甲申中元日 = 1224, signed 漆水移剌楚才晉卿, written at Almaliq in Central Asia)
teacher.quote: 有萬松老人者，儒釋兼備，宗說精通，辯才無礙，君可見之。予既謁萬松，杜絕人迹，屏斥家務，雖祁寒大暑，無日不參，焚膏繼晷，廢寢忘餐者幾三年。誤被法恩，謬膺子印，以湛然居士從源目之。
teacher.note: 「誤被法恩，謬膺子印」 — 'undeservedly I received the dharma-grace; unworthily I bore THE SEAL OF A [DHARMA-]SON.' 子印 is transmission, in the first person, in a preface he signed with his own name and dated. He then adds that Wansong gave him his dharma-names: 湛然居士 從源. Three years of daily interviews through heat and cold, sleep and meals forgotten. This is as complete a first-person transmission statement as any monk in the batch produced.

teacher.kind: 萬松行秀's own reply letter — 〈評唱天童從容庵錄寄湛然居士書〉 — the teacher's side, addressed to him
teacher.quote: 萬松昔嘗評唱，兵革以來廢其祖…邇來退居燕京報恩，旋築蝸舍，榜曰從容庵…適值湛然居士勸請成之…壬午歲杪，湛然居士書至，堅要拈出，不免家醜外揚，累吾累汝也。癸未年上巳日，萬松野老因風附寄。
teacher.note: And the master writes BACK, by name, and signs it: 癸未 (1223), 萬松野老. 「累吾累汝也」 — 'this will burden me and burden you' — the exasperated intimacy of a teacher to a disciple who will not let a thing go. Both halves of the correspondence survive, in the same book, in the canon.

teacher.quote: 號湛然居士，萬松行秀（1166-1246）禪師法嗣
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A000408 行秀. Wansong's OWN record (A000408) independently says 法嗣有林泉從倫、耶律楚材 — attested from both ends. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +1189-08-10 「金世宗大定二十九年，己酉。六月二十日生」; death +1243-06-09 「蒙古乃馬真后稱制二年，癸卯。五月十四日薨」（陳垣〈耶律楚材之生卒年〉）
dates.note: DISCREPANCY WITH ROSTER: the roster says died 1244. Chen Yuan's study (which DILA follows) puts the death on 9 June 1243. DILA also records the competing statement from 《五燈全書》卷61: 「太宗十六年公卒，壽五十五」. I take 1243 (Chen Yuan) and record both.

notes: Khitan statesman, chief advisor to Genghis Khan and Ögedei Khan; architect of early Mongol civil administration in North China. Lay disciple of Wansong Xingxiu from 1215, dharma name Zhanran Jushi ('Layman Clear-and-Still'). Commissioned Wansong to reconstruct the Book of Serenity in 1224 — without him, Hongzhi Zhengjue's 100 verses would have been lost.

bio: Of Wujiang, Xu clan. He entered Miyin monastery at Jiaxing at fifteen, took full precepts at seventeen, studied Tiantai at eighteen, and at twenty went to Jingci and set himself a three-year death-limit to settle Chan. At twenty-two he took the 'where does life come from, where does death go' phrase from Duanqiao Miaolun; he then went to Xueyan Zuqin, who gave him the word 'wu' and hounded him with 'who drags this corpse here for you?'. He broke through at twenty-four before a portrait-verse of Wuzu Fayan. From 1266 he spent nine years in a hut at Longxu; in 1279 he climbed to West Peak on Mount Tianmu, walled himself into a cave he called the Death Barrier, pulled up the ladder, and did not leave it for fifteen years. Died 1295/96, aged 58. His three barriers and his teaching on the 'great doubt' shaped later huatou practice.

steles.title: 高峰原妙禪師語錄〈行狀〉 (the short one, No.1400-B)
steles.author: 祖雍
steles.author_note: his own dharma heir — 「孝小師嗣法比丘祖雍識」
steles.quote: 師姓徐，諱原妙，蘇之吳江人。受業秀之密印，雪巖欽禪師的嗣。生宋戊戌三月二十三日申時…元貞乙未臘月朔，焚香說偈告眾，坐亡。春秋五十八，臘四十三。
steles.note: Written by his heir at his death. States the transmission in four characters: 雪巖欽禪師的嗣.

steles.title: 高峰原妙禪師語錄〈行狀〉 (the long one, No.1400-C)
steles.author_note: Author not named in the text
steles.quote: 二十二，請益斷橋倫，令參生從何來，死從何去話…時雪巖欽寓北磵塔，欣然懷香往扣之…欽忽問：阿誰與你拖箇死屍來？
steles.note: The long 行狀 is explicit that Duanqiao Miaolun was his FIRST teacher and Xueyan Zuqin the man who transmitted — the association/transmission distinction, in the source itself.

teacher.quote: 受業秀之密印，雪巖欽禪師的嗣
teacher.note: His heir's 行狀. Roster CONFIRMED (Xueyan Zuqin). Note the trap: he studied first under Duanqiao Miaolun — an easy false teacher-edge, which the roster correctly avoided.

teacher.quote: 雪巖祖欽禪師法嗣…首謁斷橋妙倫，後參雪巖祖欽，得其心法

dates.quote: 生宋戊戌三月二十三日申時…元貞乙未臘月朔…春秋五十八，臘四十三
dates.note: Born 嘉熙戊戌 = 1238. Died on the 1st of the 12th month of 元貞元年 (乙未) — Chinese year 1295, but 13 Jan 1296 Gregorian. DILA gives +1296-01-13. Roster says 1295. BOTH ARE RIGHT, depending on calendar; I keep 1295 (the Chinese year) to match the roster and flag it.

school.quote: 法嗣有斷崖了義、中峰明本、布衲祖雍諸禪師

notes: Lived on Tianmu mountain in a hermitage. Writings on the huatou (critical phrase) method and 'great doubt' highly influential.

bio: Of Yueqing, Jin clan. He left home at thirteen under the lecture-master Sheng at Yanqing monastery, became a monk at sixteen and took full precepts at nineteen. He saw Zhiyan at Hupao, then practised alone on Mount Fojiada at Dapeng in Mingzhou, and finally got the seal from Qianyan Yuanchang. At the end of the Yuan he moved to Mount Dengwei near Suzhou and opened Sheng'en monastery, where he taught for some thirty years. Died 1381, aged 79. His heirs — Wunian Shengxue, Baozang Puchi, Haizhou Puci — carry the line into the Ming.

steles.title: 慈光寂炤圓明利濟萬峰大禪師塔銘
steles.author: 苕溪花城隱士海安同知沈貫撰文；太常寺卿程南雲篆書
steles.quote: 大明洪武十六年三月　日，弟子普壽、普福、善堅、普隱、西序、普持、普華、普榮、普慈等立石
steles.note: COMPLETE STELE, with author, calligrapher, date (1383), and the full list of disciples who set the stone. Independently corroborated in 正名錄 B24n0137 lb 0470b11 (「苕溪花城隱士海安同知沈貫撰萬峯塔銘」), where the Qing genealogist 智楷惟直 uses THIS STELE as the decisive document to settle the 海舟普慈 vs 海舟永慈 lineage fight — i.e. the tradition itself treats this stone as the court of last resort.

steles.title: 萬峯塔銘
steles.author: 沈貫 (海安同知, 苕溪花城隱士)
steles.quote: 苕溪花城隱士海安同知沈貫撰萬峯塔銘有曰．貫才輕德薄．不敢污禪師之德。自念為師嗣法弟子海舟和尚座下參學久矣
steles.note: quoted in full in 正名錄; the phrase 為師嗣法弟子海舟和尚 is the load-bearing one — Shen Guan calls Haizhou WANFENG'S dharma-heir

teacher.kind: Wuwen Mingcong's own 客牕夜話, quoted in 正名錄
teacher.quote: 自臨濟至高峯玅十有八傳．玅出中峯本．本出千巖長．長出萬峯蔚．蔚出海舟慈．慈出寶峯瑄．瑄出天奇瑞
teacher.note: his own descendant's recitation of the line: 千巖長 -> 萬峯蔚

teacher.quote: 至高峯妙禪師．中峯本禪師．千巖長禪師．萬峯蔚禪師．寶藏持禪師．東明旵禪師．海舟慈禪師．雲溪瑛禪師
teacher.note: the OTHER branch's own lineage chart gives the same 千巖->萬峯 step; both sides of the 17th-c. war agree here

teacher.kind: his own 塔銘 — 慈光寂炤圓明利濟萬峰大禪師塔銘, 沈貫撰, 程南雲篆書, 1383
teacher.quote: 後于壬辰三月二十四日，和尚令源藏主送法衣頂相來。岩云：「老僧袈裟一頂，送與嵩山蔚長老，畧表叢林之道，念非諸方兜法子者也。」呵呵！師得法之後…
teacher.note: 師得法之後 — 'AFTER the Master received the dharma.' Qianyan sent his DHARMA-ROBE and his PORTRAIT (法衣頂相) by the hand of 源藏主 in 壬辰 (1352), with a barbed note that Shiwei is not one of those who go around the monasteries begging for a dharma-heirship. On the stone, at the grave, by a named layman, two years after the death.

teacher.kind: same 塔銘, the lineage preamble
teacher.quote: 唯中峰本公深造閫奥，以得其訣…入室弟子以數十計，惟千岩長公得其法爾。岩得其傳，居義烏伏龍山…惟萬峰禪師一人最為上首。師諱時蔚，號萬峰，溫州樂清縣金氏子。
teacher.note: The stele lays the chain out: 中峰明本 → 千巖元長 → 萬峰時蔚, 'and of these Chan master Wanfeng alone was the foremost.' Birth 癸卯 (1303), Yueqing in Wenzhou, surname Jin — matches the roster.

teacher.kind: the 銘 (the verse cut on the stone itself)
teacher.quote: 千岩一隕　卓然萬峰
teacher.note: 'When Qianyan fell, Wanfeng stood alone.' The transmission is in the carved verse, not just the prose preface.

teacher.quote: 千巖長（1284-1357）法嗣…後見千嚴和尚，得印可
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A004551 元長. Qianyan Yuanchang's OWN record (A004551) independently says 法嗣有萬峰時蔚 — both ends. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +1303-10-18 癸卯…八月二十九日午時生 (《萬峰和尚語錄》卷1); death +1381-03-03 洪武辛酉十四年正月二十九日坐化，世壽七十九 (《補續高僧傳》卷15)
dates.note: Roster's 1303/1381 CONFIRMED. Birth is from his own 語錄.

notes: Late Yuan / early Ming Linji master. Key link between Yuan-era Chan and the Ming revival.

bio: Of Guangze, Xi clan. He was ordained at seventeen under Yin'an and took full precepts at twenty; he was strict in Vinaya, practised samatha-vipasyana and studied Consciousness-Only. He went to Tianqi Benrui and received transmission in 1506, then lived at Longquan monastery at Guanziling in Suizhou. Died 1543, aged 63. His heir Xiaoyan Debao (1512-1581) carried the Linji line on into the late Ming.

teacher.quote: 據傳中載。明聰生正德九年甲戌…曰．三十三參天奇．在嘉靖二十五年丙午。曰．服勤五載．始受付囑．在嘉靖三十年辛亥。按天奇傳略載．明弘治間示寂。霽崙全書．亦謂天奇示寂在弘治十一年戊午。夫弘治戊午至嘉靖辛亥．計五十四年。豈已死五十四年之天奇．尚乃付光澤無聞之法乎。且無論付法之年．即生正德甲戌去弘治戊午．亦相間十七載
teacher.note: THE 54 YEARS. Tianqi d.1498; Mingcong b.1514 (16 yrs later) and 'received the charge' 1551 (54 yrs later). A face-to-face transmission is impossible.

teacher.quote: 今霽崙明知天奇示寂在弘治戊午．焉有不知邵武無聞拈香遙嗣者乎。故於傳中削去降生．出家．秉具．參師．受囑之年甲
teacher.note: THE LANDING PLACE. 拈香遙嗣 — a remote heirship by raising incense. Zhikai asserts this is the true relation, and that the dates were deleted to conceal it. This is the attested replacement for the false 'direct' edge.

teacher.quote: 况此機緣法偈．原係延安無聞之事．刻在弘治元年戊申。至光澤無聞受囑之年．計六十四年遠矣。準正宗夢說二錄所紀．則光澤無聞．非天奇之嗣明矣
teacher.note: the encounter-dialogue and dharma-verse credited to him were actually YAN'AN Wuwen's, printed in Tianqi's record in 1488 — 64 years earlier. They were STOLEN and reassigned to him (0466a03: 「盜延安無聞機緣．為光澤無聞機緣」).

teacher.kind: 正名錄 — Zhikai's own unresolved doubt
teacher.quote: 寶華謂關嶺無聞．不但非天奇之嗣．亦非笑巖之師．不無其疑。今雲公又謂關嶺無聞乃係斷橋後裔．其疑愈甚。故述以請問海內高明…乞海內高明．細心參考．畢竟誰為天奇之嗣．笑巖之師
teacher.note: HONESTY CLAUSE. Zhikai does NOT close this. Rival readings on the table: (a) 遙嗣 of Tianqi [Zhikai]; (b) not Tianqi's heir at all [寶華通忍]; (c) a descendant of DUANQIAO, a different line entirely [雲公]. He ends by asking the question, not answering it.

teacher.kind: HIS OWN 語錄 — 〈客窗夜話〉, his first-person narration of his own lineage, quoted in 《正名錄》 under the heading 「臨濟第二十五世／天奇瑞禪師法嗣／無聞明聰禪師」
teacher.quote: 無聞明聰禪師，有客牕夜話一篇，敘從上源流曰：自臨濟至高峯玅十有八傳。玅出中峯本，本出千巖長，長出萬峯蔚，蔚出海舟慈，慈出寶峯瑄，瑄出天奇瑞。載原本語錄及五宗敕中。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. He wrote out his own descent and stopped at 天奇瑞 — 天奇本瑞, the generation immediately above himself. He is the last link he names because he is the next one. Quoted from 原本語錄 — the ORIGINAL printing (see the forgery note below, which is why 'original' matters here).

teacher.quote: 天奇本瑞禪師（？-1508）法嗣…往謁天奇禪師，正德元年（1506）得付法
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A000259 本瑞. Tianqi Benrui's OWN record (A000259) independently says 法嗣有無聞明聰、大休實等三十九位 — both ends. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: death +1543-02-14 ~ +1544-02-02 （明嘉靖）癸卯二十二年…示寂。世壽六十有三。一說正德壬申七月朔二日入寂。
dates.note: Death 1543 CONFIRMED (roster agrees). DILA records a COMPETING tradition (正德壬申 = 1512) and I record it too. If he died in 1543 aged 63, he was born c.1481 — the roster's 'floruit 1480' is roughly that, but no birth date is directly attested, so I leave birth null.

notes: Ming dynasty Linji master. Teacher of both Xiaoyan Debao and Yungu Fahui.

bio: Joseon Seon master, disciple of Buyong Yeonggwan (also called Eunam Yeonggwan, 1485-1571) — and therefore a dharma-brother of Hyujeong/Seosan. He founded the Buhyu branch, which with Hyujeong's line forms one of the two great streams of later Korean Seon. 1543-1615.

steles.title: 追加弘覺登階碑銘并序
steles.author: 白谷處能 (Baekgok Cheoneung)
steles.quote: 萬曆甲寅。師年七十二。自曹溪之松廣。之方丈。之七佛。擬啟手足。翌年秋七月。示微疾。召上足碧…
steles.note: Death 1615 (乙卯), aged 72 — matches the roster's 1543-1615. B31n0170's own editorial preface (lb 0278b15) states its method: 「虛休兩師以下…但取有碑狀者，入于編年之中」 — it admits only men who HAVE a stele or a 行狀. That is why the Korean masters in this corpus are so well attested: 朝鮮佛教通史 is, by design, a stele collection.

teacher.kind: his own 碑銘 — 「追加弘覺登階碑銘并序」, by 白谷處能 (白谷山人處能撰, 1617-1680), in 朝鮮佛教通史
teacher.quote: 臨濟後二十四世。有嫡孫曰浮休。浮休號也。法名善修。俗姓金氏。古帶方獒樹人也。…辭入頭流山〔智異山之一名〕，從信明長老髠剃。謁芙蓉大師，盡得笆籬邊物。…惟左手失適。得法之後，借盧相國守慎家藏書，七閱寒暑。
teacher.note: The stele separates the two men cleanly: 信明長老 TONSURED him (髠剃) — and is NOT the dharma-father. 芙蓉大師 is the one he 謁 and from whom he 「盡得笆籬邊物」 — got everything, right down to the junk along the fence-line — and the very next clause is 「得法之後」: AFTER HE OBTAINED THE DHARMA. 得法 is the transmission verb.

teacher.quote: 隱庵靈觀弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：23）
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A031593. IMPORTANT: A031593's own name-list is 은암영관 / 靈觀 / 隱庵靈觀 / 芙蓉靈觀 — Eunam and BUYONG YEONGGWAN are the SAME MAN (1485-1571). So the roster's teacher is CONFIRMED, despite DILA's preferred sobriquet differing.

dates.quote: birth +1543; death +1615
dates.note: Roster's 1543/1615 CONFIRMED.

notes: Dharma brother of Hyujeong/Seosan. Founded the Buhyu branch, one of two major streams of Korean Seon.

bio: Of Mudu, Zhong clan. He began as a Confucian and wrote essays attacking Buddhism, then reversed himself; in 1622 he was tonsured by Xueling, a disciple of Hanshan Deqing, and given the name Zhixu. He went to Jingshan to sit Chan, then spent his life on Tiantai doctrine, Consciousness-Only, and above all Vinaya reform, which he thought had collapsed. He ended at Lingfeng in Xiaofeng, devoted to Pure Land, and is counted the ninth patriarch of the Pure Land school and the last of the Ming 'four great monks'. Died 1655, aged 57.

steles.title: 八不道人傳
steles.author: 智旭 himself; continued by 成時 (續傳)
steles.quote: 依大師自撰八不道人傳，及成時續傳錄寫 (so B23n0130, 0425a18)
steles.note: Its status as an autograph autobiography is confirmed independently at B23n0130 (0425a18, 0430b18, 0430b24), which also records that Zhixu personally revised it (刪改自述八不道人傳), producing variant recensions.

teacher.kind: his own autobiography 八不道人傳 (自撰)
teacher.quote: 二十四歲，夢禮憨山大師，哭恨緣慳，相見太晚…一月中，三夢憨師，師往曹谿，不能遠從，乃從雪嶺師剃度，命名智旭。雪師，憨翁門人也。
teacher.note: ⚠ READ THE VERB — 剃度, tonsure. Zhixu says in his own hand that he WANTED 憨山德清, could not reach him (Hanshan was away at Caoxi), and so took TONSURE from 雪嶺, who was merely 憨山's disciple. He nowhere claims 嗣法 / 得法 / 印可 from 雪嶺. This is the single cleanest first-person source in the whole batch, and it does NOT say what the roster needs it to say.

teacher.quote: 竟往徑山坐禪。次年夏，逼拶功極，身心世界，忽皆消殞…是時，一切經論、一切公案無不現前，旋自覺悟解發，非為聖證，故絕不語一人。
teacher.note: His breakthrough came ALONE, sitting at 徑山 — 「旋自覺悟解發」, self-arisen — and he explicitly declined to treat it as certified attainment (非為聖證) and TOLD NO ONE (絕不語一人). There is no 印可 event anywhere in the life. The 八不道人 name itself (Ch.: 'neither Confucian nor Chan nor Vinaya nor Doctrinal') is his refusal to be filed in any house, Chan included.

teacher.quote: 天啟二年（1622），從憨山之徒雪嶺剃度，命名「智旭」
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A007925 雪嶺. Xueling's own record (A007925) says 憨山大師弟子…為藕益智旭之剃度師 — both ends. Roster CONFIRMED. NOTE the nature of the tie: Xueling was his TONSURE master, not a Chan dharma-transmission; DILA also records 傳燈 (Wuyi Chuandeng, Tiantai) as a teacher. Zhixu is only loosely a Chan figure.

dates.quote: birth +1599-06-24 「萬曆二十七年己亥五月三日亥時」（靈峰蕅益大師宗論 1）; death +1655-02-26 「順治十二年正月二十一日，年五十七」（九華山志 4）
dates.note: Roster's 1599/1655 CONFIRMED.

notes: Last of the 'four great monks'. Primarily Tiantai and Pure Land, fierce advocate of Vinaya reform.

bio: Of Wuhu in Jiangnan, Ding clan; father Yinghe, mother of the Chen clan. He could write verse at nine and made a name in the examination halls, but had no heart for it. He was tonsured at twenty-eight by Jianmen at Qingliang monastery in Jinling and took full precepts from Jianyue at Baohua. Travelling, he broke through on the Five Old Men peak of Mount Lu — 'shattering empty space into two halves'. He then went to Tianzhu Xingzhen, who was presiding at Yumen, and received his dharma. He became the thirteenth abbot of Li'an in Hangzhou, later abbot of Bailin in Beijing, where he died in 1708, aged 70. His stupa inscription was written by a Qing imperial prince.

steles.title: 夢菴格禪師塔銘 (recorded in 武林理安寺志)
steles.author: 和碩莊親王
steles.author_note: Prince Zhuang of the Qing imperial house
steles.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十三代．第十三次住持夢菴格禪師。和碩莊親王撰塔銘。夢菴禪師，名超格，號夢菴，世為江南蕪湖人，姓丁氏。父應鶴，母陳…至二十八歲始投金陵清涼寺劍門和尚落䰂，秉寶華山見月師具足戒…時天笠禪師主禹門，往參次…
steles.note: The Li'an temple gazetteer records his stupa inscription and names its author. It also names his teacher: Tianzhu Xingzhen.

teacher.quote: 時天笠禪師主禹門，往參次，便問：「破夏遠來，請師一接！」
teacher.note: DECISIVE. 天笠 = 天笠行珍 (DILA A004105, 1624-1694, heir of Ruo'an Tongwen), an earlier abbot of the same Li'an monastery.

teacher.quote: 寂後，門人夢菴格禪師撰行狀。
teacher.note: CLINCHING: Chaoge WROTE THE 行狀 FOR XINGZHEN at his death. A disciple writes his master's account of conduct.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A004105 行珍; and A004105's own record reads 「法嗣有夢菴格、樗關真、越鑑徹諸禪師」
teacher.note: Attested from both ends of the edge.

dates.kind: authority record quoting 武林理安寺志 卷5
dates.quote: birth +1639-06-07 「生崇德己卯五月七日。」; death +1708-08-06 「示寂康熙戊子六月二日，世壽七十。」
dates.note: Roster's 1639/1708 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十三代
school.note: Linji, 33rd generation.

notes: Linji heir of Maoxi Xingsen in the Yulin Tongxiu line. Taught at Li'an monastery in Hangzhou and later became abbot of Bailin monastery in Beijing. His student Jialing Xingyin became the Chan teacher of the Yongzheng Emperor.

bio: Joseon Seon master, 1738-1823. Dharma heir of Cheongbong Geoan, who was himself a disciple of Hoam Chejeong (1687-1748). His line runs on to Yongam Hyeeon and eventually to Gyeongheo Seongu (1849-1912), the reviver of modern Korean Seon — which is why the Yulbong branch matters out of all proportion to what is known about the man himself. The Yulbong school combined patriarchal Seon with Huayan study and flourished around Mount Geumgang.

steles.title: (untitled 行狀 embedded under the heading 栗峯禪師杖嚇羅漢)
steles.author: unnamed; carried in 李能和 朝鮮佛教通史
steles.quote: 大師諱青杲。字拈花。號栗峯。俗姓白氏。湖南順天人也…十九。乾隆二十一年投無垢大俊禪師得度。明年乞具於雲月淑敏大師。受禪於喚菴卓戒禪師。而遂請益於青峯巨岸大師…遂傳心印焉。
steles.note: The 行狀 KEEPS FOUR MEN APART, exactly as 東明慧旵's stele does: 無垢大俊 TONSURED him (得度) · 雲月淑敏 ORDAINED him (乞具) · 喚菴卓戒 gave him Zen instruction (受禪) · 青峯巨岸 gave him the MIND-SEAL (傳心印). Only the last is the dharma-father. Any of the other three would be an association-trap edge.

teacher.kind: 行狀 (explicitly labelled 行狀 at its close, lb 0781a15), in 朝鮮佛教通史
teacher.quote: 而遂請益於青峯巨岸大師。三藏奧義非不精通。惟雜華玄旨。最善游刃。不離言教。深悟別傳。岸老歎曰。余講死句。子投活句。可謂茜絳藍青者此也。遂傳心印焉。
teacher.note: 遂傳心印 — 巨岸 transmitted the mind-seal. First-hand 行狀, and it gives dates that match the roster exactly: born 乾隆三年戊午正月八日 (1738), died 道光三年癸未正月晦日 (1823), 世壽八十六, 法臘六十七.

teacher.kind: Bulgyo Sinmun article on 靑峰巨岸
teacher.quote: 청봉스님의 법맥은 율봉청고(栗峰靑杲, 1738~1823)를 거쳐 경허성우(鏡虛惺牛, 1849~1912)로 이어져
teacher.note: FETCHED AND CONFIRMED. Cheongbong Geoan's dharma lineage passes THROUGH Yulbong Cheonggo. Roster teacher CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 巨岸 / 青峰巨岸 — 虎巖體淨弟子。（禪典．禪宗法系譜：25）
teacher.note: The teacher exists in DILA and is himself an heir of Hoam Chejeong. Cheonggo himself is NOT in DILA under any spelling.

dates.quote: 율봉청고(栗峰靑杲, 1738~1823)
dates.note: The old roster had NO dates at all for him. Now: 1738-1823.

school.note: The Yulbong school is named for him. NOTE: I could not fetch the EncyKorea page (404 on the old Contents/Item URL form) — this entry is cited from search-result summary only, so I have NOT put it in links.

links.label: Bulgyo Sinmun: 靑峰巨岸 (names Yulbong Cheonggo as his heir, with dates)

notes: Transmission link in the Pyeonyang lineage. The 70th Korean patriarch. No independent biographical sources survive. Known from lineage charts where dharma was transmitted 'from Cheongbong and Geo-ae to Yulbong and Cheonggo.'

bio: Of Xinyu, Peng clan. At twenty-one he was tonsured and took precepts under Zu'an Ji at Guanghua monastery on Dongshan; he then went into Fujian and lived at Xichan in Fuzhou.
