He sought out Dahui Zonggao at Ayuwang and inherited his dharma. In 1167 he took Tianning; in 1176 Emperor Xiaozong ordered him to Lingyin in Hangzhou, where he submitted his 'Direct Pointing of the Gate of the Lineage'; in 1193 he was called to Jingshan. He ended as the twenty-fourth abbot of Ayuwang. Died 1203, aged 83.

steles.title: 圜鑑塔銘 (《文忠集》卷80)
steles.author: 周必大
steles.author_note: Southern Song chief councillor; 文忠 is his posthumous name, so 《文忠集》 is his collected works
steles.quote: 嘉泰三年三月二十日，夀八十三
steles.note: ATTESTED, NOT IN THE BUDDHIST CANON: his stupa inscription is by Zhou Bida and survives in Zhou's literary collection, which is not part of the CBETA corpus. DILA quotes it for the death date. I did not find it in the corpus and do not claim a corpus path for it.

teacher.kind: Dahui's own certifying inscription, in Deguang's 語錄 (古尊宿語錄, 佛照光禪師語錄)
teacher.quote: 慧付頂相，書贊印證云：有德必有光，其光無間隔，名實要相稱，非青黃赤白。
teacher.note: THE TRANSMISSION ACT ITSELF. Dahui handed over his 頂相 (portrait) and wrote a 贊 on it as 印證 — certification. The 頂相 handover with an inscribed verse is the Chan certificate of transmission, and the verse puns on the heir's own name: 德光, 'virtue' and 'light' — 「有德必有光」. These are Dahui's words, not a compiler's summary.

teacher.kind: the same 語錄's biographical head
teacher.quote: 佛照禪師諱德光，臨江軍新喻縣彭氏子…歷㕘目菴、應菴、萬菴、典牛十餘員尊宿，晚見育王大慧…慧問：喚作竹篦則觸，不喚作竹篦則背…荅云：今日捉敗這老賊。
teacher.note: ⚠ TRAP DISARMED, and it is a big one: he studied under TEN-PLUS eminent masters — 目菴, 應菴 (曇華!), 萬菴, 典牛 — any of whom a careless matcher could take for his dharma-father. 應菴曇華 in particular is a major Yangqi master and a tempting wrong edge. The record is explicit that all of these were 㕘 (visits/study) and that it was 大慧, met LATE and at 育王, who certified him. The 竹篦 exchanges run to three rounds before the certification.

teacher.quote: 謁阿育王寺大慧宗杲…南嶽門下第十六世
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A000475 宗杲. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 塔銘
dates.quote: birth +1121; death +1203-05-10 「嘉泰三年三月二十日，夀八十三」（《文忠集》卷 80〈圜鑑塔銘〉）
dates.note: Roster's 1121/1203 CONFIRMED, from the stupa inscription itself.

notes: One of Dahui Zonggao's most prominent dharma heirs. Served as abbot at major Southern Song monasteries including Ayuwang (Ashoka) Temple and Lingyin Temple in Hangzhou. He also transmitted Dahui's kanhua Chan (keyword meditation) method to the next generation.

bio: Of Jiangning, Chen clan. He left home under the dharma master Tong at Tianbao monastery and took full precepts at twenty. He received the true dharma from Niutou Fachi and stayed on Mount Niutou at Jinling, propagating the school's style; he passed it to Huizhong. A story has him meeting three tigers on a night walk and cutting straight through them without a flicker of fear; they followed him to the monastery gate and left. Died at Yanzuo monastery, aged 77.

teacher.source: 全唐文 卷0320, 潤州鶴林寺故徑山大師碑銘, by 李華
teacher.quote: 融授岩大師，岩授方大師，方授持大師，持授威大師，凡七世矣
teacher.note: 持授威大師 — 'Chi conferred it on Master Wei'.

teacher.quote: 唐代牛頭宗僧，俗姓陳…後參牛頭宗之法持，得其正法，住金陵牛頭山宣揚宗風，傳法予慧忠
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A010050 法持. Roster CONFIRMED.

dates.quote: birth +0653; death +0729-03-26 開元十七年二月十八日。終於延祚寺…春秋七十七。（T51n2076_p0229a13）
dates.note: DISCREPANCY WITH ROSTER: roster says 646-722. DILA's death field says 729 (開元十七年, from 景德傳燈錄), while DILA's own prose notes the competing tradition: 「唐玄宗開元十年（一說十七年）於延祚寺示寂」 — i.e. 722 vs 729. BOTH ARE ATTESTED. Working back from age 77: died 729 -> born 653; died 722 -> born 646 (the roster's figures). I take 653/729 (the 景德傳燈錄 reading, which DILA's structured field prefers) and record the roster's 646/722 as the recorded variant.

bio.kind: authority record (citing 宋高僧傳 T50n2061_p0758b22)

notes: Fifth patriarch of the Niutou (Oxhead) school. He maintained the community at Mount Niutou and transmitted the lineage to Helin Xuansu, the sixth and final patriarch. He appears in the Jingde Chuandeng Lu (juan 4).

bio: Chan master of Puguang cloister and later Jingxin cloister; of the Xiao clan of Jinling. He was a dharma heir of the layman-turned-monk Ci'an Zhenben — better known as the Herdsman of Old Bottle Mountain (古瓶山牧道者), whose lay name was Xiang Qian, styled Mugong, of Xiushui in Jiaxing, a descendant of the Ming minister Xiang Zhongyi. Zhenben himself received the seal from Jinming Jie'an Wujin in 1659. Jijun compiled his teacher's record, the Guping shan mudaozhe jiuxin lu, and signed it 'dharma-heir'. He also edited the Records of the Old Bottle Mountain Herdsman's mind-searching.

teacher.kind: his teacher's 語錄, signed by him
teacher.quote: 嗣法門人機峻百拜敬題…古瓶山牧道者究心錄 嗣法門人機峻等編
teacher.note: He signs himself as Zhenben's DHARMA HEIR and edits the master's record. First-person.

teacher.kind: 傳 (by 何園客) inside the same text
teacher.quote: 次庵長老云：「有法嗣三人，一名机峻，號坦庵，前住普光禪院，後住淨心院；二名机旃，號慈林；三名机𠁼，號獅王，住妙喜山中。」
teacher.note: The teacher's own biography names his three heirs; Jijun is the first. Also gives his two abbacies.

teacher.quote: 字坦菴，為次庵真本禪師法嗣…金陵蕭氏，牧公項謙弟子
teacher.note: Two DILA records for the same man, both giving teacher = A014951 真本.

school.quote: 牧道者，名謙，字牧公，嘉興府秀水人也…嗣法為臨濟三十二世 (DILA A014951)
school.note: Linji; his teacher was 32nd generation, so Jijun is 33rd.

bio.kind: his own 語錄 (普光坦菴禪師語錄)

bio: Of Meishan in southern Sichuan, Gong clan; father Gong Fu, mother of the Liu clan. As a boy he heard a lecture on the Diamond Sutra and, hearing how the Buddha left the palace for the snow mountains, resolved to leave home; his mother refused and he went two days without drinking until his father relented. Tonsured by Cihang, ordained under the Vinaya master Daru. He travelled, and got the great dharma from Zhangxue Tongzui at Zhaojue in Chengdu. He then founded Yuquan monastery at Pitong on Panlong mountain, where the assembly grew large. Died 1690 in the summer heat, the body reportedly unaltered; buried under a stupa on the south slope of Pan mountain.

steles.title: 玉泉其白富禪師語錄〈塔銘〉
steles.author: 王庭詔 (號遯菴)
steles.author_note: 漹江賜進士, a lay disciple — 「漹江賜進士弟子遯菴王庭詔沐手拜撰」
steles.quote: 繫惟玉泉，其白富禪師其庶幾乎！師本眉山人也，其族姓龔，父諱輔，母劉，誕師于明之丁卯…遂束包行腳，歷遍諸方，參丈老人于昭覺。老人授師心要大法而紹續焉…時康熙庚午仲夏廿七日也。
steles.note: Dated 康熙壬申 (1692). Names the transmission from 丈 (Zhangxue) at Zhaojue in one sentence, and the death: 康熙庚午 (1690).

steles.title: 玉泉其白富禪師語錄〈行實〉
steles.author: 其白德富 himself (dictated to the assembly)
steles.author_note: spoken in 1688/89 at his disciples' insistence, when he was dying
steles.quote: 余本蜀南眉州人，父姓龔諱輔，母劉，生於天啟七年十二月二十九日午時也。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. He resisted — 「莫揚家醜，塗污人耳目」 — and gave it only when pressed a third time.

teacher.quote: 參丈老人于昭覺。老人授師心要大法而紹續焉。
teacher.note: The stele states the transmission outright.

teacher.quote: 供養傳曹溪正脈第三十七世上其下白本師富老和尚，用酬法乳
teacher.note: His heir Rongche Yuanding's incense names him as 37th-generation master; Zhulang Chesheng (a dharma-brother, also in this batch) writes the preface in 1695.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001157 通醉

dates.quote: 生於天啟七年十二月二十九日午時 (行實) … 時康熙庚午仲夏廿七日也 (塔銘)
dates.note: Born 天啟七年 12/29 = 4 Feb 1628 Gregorian (Chinese year 1627 — the stele says 誕師于明之丁卯, i.e. 1627). Died 康熙庚午 = 3 July 1690. DILA agrees: 1628-02-04 / 1690-07-03.

school.quote: 傳曹溪正脈第三十七世

bio: Chan master of Wulei/Lingfeng monastery on Mount Wulei in Cixi, Mingzhou. A dharma heir of Muchen Daomin: he is named among the 嗣法門人 who edited Muchen's own recorded sayings (the Tiantong Hongjue Min chanshi yulu), which is about as direct as an heirship claim gets. His own 語錄 was taken down by his attendant Haicheng, and a preface was written by his 'dharma-brother of the same gate', Bing'an Zhang Lilian.

teacher.quote: 【中華藏】No.1746《天童弘覺忞禪師語錄》嗣法門人顯權等編
teacher.note: He co-edited his teacher's record as a named dharma-heir. DILA relation type=teacher -> A001513 道忞.

teacher.quote: (達變權嗣)
teacher.note: 五燈全書 X82n1571_p0359a20-21 places him in Muchen's line here, contrary to the marginal tag flagged in the batch notes.

teacher.quote: 達變權禪師語錄卷第一 侍者海澂記錄 … 同門法弟鹿城冰菴張立廉拜題
teacher.note: His record, with a preface by a same-gate dharma-brother.

bio.quote: 住明州慈谿縣五磊山靈峰禪寺語錄

bio: Of Langzhou in northern Sichuan, Hou clan; his mother was Lady Su. Sickly as a child, bookish, orphaned before he came of age, he took tonsure at Wanyuan monastery, studied at Guixi, took precepts from the monk Baochi, and finally received the dharma from the old master Yi'an — 'and Yi'an was a dharma-son of Poshan, who transmits the true Linji lineage'. He taught at Guiqing in Nan'an, at Zuo'e in the Zhongnan range, at the Chongwen stupa-cloister at Jinggan, and at Haibao monastery in Ningxia — an unusually far northwestern career, from Shaanxi into the Ordos. When Yi'an died he settled at Daxingshan in Chang'an, built his teacher's stupa and presided there for eight years. Died 1679, aged 68; five-coloured flames and countless relics at the cremation, says his stele.

steles.title: 林我禪師塔銘
steles.author: 周燦 (字星公, 號澹園居士, 驪山)
steles.author_note: a lay official who had served in the 光祿寺; he had met the master at Chongwen pagoda in 1669 and was asked twice before agreeing to write
steles.quote: 師閬州侯氏，母蘇夫人…初披剃於萬緣寺，參學於桂谿莊…繼受戒於寶池和尚，終聞法於易菴老人。老人為破山法子，傳臨濟正宗…越五日，端坐而逝，康熙十有八年二月初六日未時也…師生於壬子年四月初八日子時，壽六十八，臘四十八。
steles.note: Dated 康熙十八年孟夏廿日 (1679). The verse puts it flatly: 「破山之徒，易菴為師」.

teacher.quote: 終聞法於易菴老人。老人為破山法子，傳臨濟正宗。
teacher.note: His own stupa inscription. Teacher = Yi'an, who is Poshan Haiming's heir — so Linwo connects to the roster at one remove.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A026317 易庵印師; 《五燈全書》卷89：「陝西寧夏海寶林我鑑禪師……(易菴師嗣)。」
teacher.note: DILA A026317 (易庵印師) is itself recorded as 破山海明弟子.

dates.quote: 康熙十有八年二月初六日未時也…師生於壬子年四月初八日子時，壽六十八，臘四十八
dates.note: Born 壬子 (1612) 4/8; died 1679-03-17, age 68, 48 years ordained. DILA agrees exactly.

bio.kind: 塔銘 + his own 語錄

bio: Of Xianju in Tiantai, Ye clan, from a prominent local family. A quick child who read anything once and had it; a passing monk told his parents not to hold him back. He was tonsured by Gutian Hou at Tianning, took precepts, then went the rounds — Zhencang at Tianfeng, and Fangshan Wenbao at Xi'an hermitage on Ruiyan, going back and forth between the two. Dissatisfied, he built a hut on Huading peak of Mount Tiantai and drove himself hard; one day while working he broke through, and Fangshan sealed him with a verse. He then sat on Huading for forty years and never once crossed the threshold — 'his foot never passed the door-sill' — while his reputation drew the whole southeast. Born 1265, died 1334, aged 70, fifty years ordained. Imperially styled Miaoming Zhenjue; his stupa is the Jiguang.

steles.title: 無見覩和尚塔銘并序
steles.author: 曇噩 (佛真文懿大師)
steles.author_note: of Jingde Guoqing monastery on Mount Tiantai — the great Yuan monastic biographer
steles.quote: 禪師諱先覩，字無見，姓葉氏，世為天台仙居顯族。以宋之咸淳乙丑五月六日生，皇之元統甲戌五月二日卒，壽七十，臘五十…惟禪師一坐四十年，足未嘗輒閱戶限。
steles.note: A full stupa inscription with preface, forming its own text in the canon (X70n1396-D). Also gives the transmission: 「無見覩禪師以方山寶公之道唱東南」.

teacher.quote: 無見覩禪師以方山寶公之道唱東南…見藏室珍公於天封、方山寶公於瑞岩西菴，而往來二公間…乃走西菴呈所解，山以偈印之。
teacher.note: His own stele: Fangshan sealed him with a verse. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 倫公之傳為方山寶公，而禪師則得法於寶公
teacher.note: An independent contemporary statement of the same edge by a leading Yuan literatus.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A000187 文寶

dates.quote: 以宋之咸淳乙丑五月六日生，皇之元統甲戌五月二日卒，壽七十，臘五十
dates.note: Born 1265, died 1334, age 70. DISAGREEMENT: DILA (following X84n1583) gives the death day as 五月望日 (the 15th); the STELE says 五月二日 (the 2nd). Same month and year. I take the stele.

school.quote: 禪師之道，上承臨濟之正傳者也
school.note: Linji.

bio: Of Jingyang in Xi'an prefecture, Ren clan. A Caodong master: he received the dharma from Juelang Daosheng at Tianjie in Nanjing and succeeded him in that seat, lighting his transmission incense 'for my original master Juelang, thirty-third generation of the true Caodong lineage'. He had earlier spent ten years at Yunju and had lived at Kuanglu. He later moved to Hongji monastery. His recorded sayings carry an appended collection of Pure Land poems, and his invitation-letters are signed by a long roll of Nanjing literati.

steles.title: 方融璽禪師語錄〈行實〉
steles.author_note: in his own 語錄; DILA quotes it for his birth
steles.quote: 生於明萬曆三十年壬寅七月七日子時
steles.note: Quoted by DILA A019256 from 《方融璽禪師語錄》卷3〈行實〉. The 行實 exists in the text; I confirmed the 語錄 and the incense but quote the birth line via DILA.

teacher.quote: 今日恭對人天眾前，熱向爐中，端為供養天界堂上，傳曹洞正宗三十三世本師覺浪和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, at the moment he takes his teacher's seat. Also 「此一瓣香，天界曾燒，弘濟復熱，總為先師浪老和尚，用酬法乳之恩」.

teacher.quote: 為天界覺浪道盛禪師（1593-1659）法嗣。西安府涇陽縣人，俗姓任。

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 行實
dates.quote: birth +1602-08-23 「生於明萬曆三十年壬寅七月七日子時」（《方融璽禪師語錄》卷3〈行實〉）
dates.note: No death date is attested anywhere I could find.

school.note: CAODONG, 33rd generation — from his own mouth. Batch's school CONFIRMED.

bio.kind: his own 語錄 + 行實

bio: Of Xiushui in Jiaxing, the Gu clan of Xincheng; mother of the Zou clan, the middle of three sons. The family was too poor for the schooling he wanted, and he lit up whenever a monk passed the door; his parents sent him to Songyuan hermitage at Jingshan. At nineteen he took tonsure and full precepts from the great master Wengu at Zhenji, shut himself up for three years with the Huayan commentary, then made a name in the lecture halls — 'the assemblies called me a horned tiger', he says, but he did not trust it. In 1637 he met the master Xue at Jingshan and was undone by one question; they exchanged poems on the pond for ten years. Later he saw Xueguan and Yongjue without spark; then Juelang; and finally, under Feiyin Tongrong at Jingshan, he broke through one night at the sound of a door. He became abbot of Puming at Jiaxing. Sixty in the winter of 1673.

steles.title: 石關禪師語錄〈行實〉
steles.author: 石關行凌 himself
steles.author_note: dictated in the winter of 1673 when his students gathered for his sixtieth birthday and would not stop asking
steles.quote: 余乃嘉興秀水人，新城顧族。母鄒氏，素奉三寶，生三子，余處其中。自幼好習詩書，家貧難遂其志，每見僧過輒喜。父母知余夙緣，送徑山松源菴出家。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. Opens 「我生無行，又何有實？」 — 'I have no conduct in my life, so what deeds are there?' — before giving in.

teacher.quote: 專伸供養傳臨濟正宗第三十一世，前住黃檗金粟，次住天童徑山，末後示寂福嚴堂上費隱容老和尚，用酬法乳之恩
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, naming Feiyin Tongrong with his whole career and calling him the 31st Linji generation. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001150 通容

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 行實
dates.note: He turned sixty in the winter of 癸丑 (1673), hence born c.1614. No death date attested.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十一世

bio: A man of western Shu (Sichuan) who made his career in the east: he came out at Folong, moved to Fahua in Suzhou in 1260, was ordered to Xuedou in 1264 and to Ruiyan in 1269. A dharma heir of Wuzhun Shifan. He was a considerable writer — the Wujia zhengzong zan (Encomia on the True Lineage of the Five Houses) is his, and it is one of the sources used elsewhere in this batch to fix Mi'an Xianjie's teacher. He was dead by the autumn of 1279. Heirs: Kewong Shao and Fangwai Yuan.

teacher.quote: 次拈香云：此一瓣香奉為見住徑山佛鑑禪師大和尚，用酬法乳。
teacher.note: His OWN dharma-milk stick (用酬法乳) to the living Jingshan abbot 佛鑑禪師 = 無準師範 (whose title was 佛鑑, seat 徑山). A-grade first-person.

teacher.quote: 徑山無準範禪師法嗣……雪竇希叟紹曇禪師
teacher.note: corroborates teacher 無準師範.

teacher.kind: flat 法嗣 index (五燈全書目錄)
teacher.quote: 南嶽下第二十世 徑山範禪師法嗣：仰山雪巖祖欽禪師、淨慈斷橋妙倫禪師…雪竇希叟紹曇禪師
teacher.note: Listed under Wuzhun Shifan's heirs, beside Xueyan Zuqin and Duanqiao Miaolun. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 徑山無準範禪師法嗣……雪竇希叟紹曇禪師
teacher.note: Cited via DILA A001133; a second independent index.

teacher.quote: 無準師範（1178-1249）禪師法嗣，南嶽下第二十世

dates.quote: 世壽不詳，但己卯（1279）中秋前已去世
dates.note: No birth or death year is attested; only a terminus ante quem of 1279.

school.quote: 明州雪竇希叟紹曇禪師 西蜀人，出世佛隴。
school.note: Gives his native place: western Shu.

bio: Of Nanchong, Yang clan; abbot of Qingguo Chan cloister on Mount Jin'ao in Shehong county, Tongchuan, from the autumn of 1664. A dharma heir of Poshan Haiming — Poshan's own recorded sayings contain the transmission verse he gave him: 'You have got my eye: it sees through the shallow and the deep; do not join the great herd of blind donkeys — to whom will you chant the broken-sandbowl line?'

teacher.kind: 破山禪師語錄 — the teacher's OWN transmission verse
teacher.quote: 付不會通法禪人：得吾眼也覷浮沉，淺則淺兮深則深，莫學瞎驢大隊，破沙盆句對誰吟？
teacher.note: STRONGEST POSSIBLE EVIDENCE: this is Poshan Haiming himself, in his own record, handing over the dharma to this man by name. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: 不會禪師語錄卷第一 嗣法門人性靈等編 住潼川州射洪縣金鼇山清果禪院 康熙甲辰年八月二十六日
teacher.note: His own record; gives the monastery and the year he took it (1664).

dates.quote: 予乃南克楊氏子…生天啟元年辛酉十月廿二日辰時
dates.note: 天啟元年辛酉=1621 birth; own 語錄 行實. death not stated.

dates.quote: 生天啟元年辛酉十月廿二日辰時（不會禪師語錄卷7行實）
dates.note: 破山海明 heir

school.note: Linji, via Poshan Haiming.

bio.kind: his own 語錄 (with 行實)

bio: Of Dingyuan county in eastern Sichuan, Wang clan; born 1634. He would not touch meat or wine from birth and was nicknamed 'the little monk'. In 1644 Zhang Xianzhong's armies destroyed his family — father, mother, brother and sister all killed — and he spent years on the road sleeping in grass and dew. Adopted by a garrison commander in Zunyi who wanted an heir, he refused and kept refusing until at twenty-two he was tonsured at Luohan monastery in Rongchang. In 1658, sweeping incense in the courtyard, he saw the moon come out of a fold in the mountain and 'set down a heavy load'. He served Zhangxue Tongzui, and in 1681 — his teacher then seventy-two — was recalled by letter to succeed him at Zhaojue in Chengdu. He was abbot of Fenglin on Mount Qingcheng. In 1693 he had the Jinjiang chandeng cut and printed.

steles.title: 青城竹浪生禪師語錄〈行繇〉
steles.author: 竹浪徹生 himself
steles.author_note: dictated to his assembly
steles.quote: 予乃川東定遠縣人，父姓王，母陳，于明季崇禎七年甲戌正月二十八日已時生…十一甲申，時丁獻逆之變，父母兄姊盡遭劫歿，東奔西馳，艸宿露眠，無不經歷。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON. 獻逆 = Zhang Xianzhong. One of the few Chan records that says plainly what the fall of Ming Sichuan did to a family.

teacher.kind: his own 上堂 on taking Zhaojue
teacher.quote: 辛酉四月初一，于鳳林寺受本師手劄…啟請主昭覺…蓋為本師七十有二，公案未完，手翰下頒
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON: 'my original master' summoned him by letter in 1681, being then seventy-two. Zhangxue Tongzui was born 1610 — seventy-two in 1681. The arithmetic checks.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001157 通醉; 青城鳳林僧人

teacher.kind: his preface to a dharma-brother's record
teacher.quote: 時康熙乙亥佛誕日，青城竹浪徹生謹識
teacher.note: He writes the 1695 preface to Qibai Defu's record (also in this batch), confirming they are dharma-brothers under Zhangxue.

dates.quote: 于明季崇禎七年甲戌正月二十八日已時生
dates.note: Born 1634-02-25 (DILA agrees). Still alive in 1695. No death date attested.

bio: Southern Song Chan master, abbot of Jingci among other houses; also called Shuanglin Jieshi. He is a fair verse-writer and is quoted repeatedly in the Chan poetry anthologies alongside Xiangtan Yong, Mingji Jun and Yuji Hui — the Jingshan circle. His teacher is disputed in the sources: the Xu chuandeng lu makes him an heir of Zhewong Ruyan of Jingshan (himself an heir of Fozhao Deguang, also in this batch), while the Xudeng zhengtong index files him under Nangshan Dexiu.

teacher.quote: 次，拈香，云：…爇向爐中，奉為前住徑山興聖萬壽禪寺特賜佛心禪師淛翁大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: His own 介石智朋禪師語錄. 淛翁 is an orthographic variant of 浙翁; the 徑山 seat + 佛心禪師 title match 如琰 exactly, and match 偃溪廣聞's independent incense verbatim (X69n1368). DILA A013861 carries TWO teacher relations — A009592 如琰 and A001670 德秀 (from 《續燈正統目錄》 'ζ囊山秀禪師法嗣……雙林介禪師'). His own first-person incense settles it for 如琰; the 囊山德秀 relation is not supported by anything he says himself.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A009592 如琰, citing T51n2077_p0706a10 (續傳燈錄)
teacher.note: The batch's reading: Zhewong Ruyan. I take this one — the 續傳燈錄 is the closer source and Ruyan's Jingshan/Jingci milieu fits his career.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001670 德秀; 《續燈正統目錄》卷1：「囊山秀禪師法嗣……雙林介禪師」
teacher.note: A GENUINE CONFLICT, recorded not resolved: the 續燈正統 index makes him an heir of Nangshan Dexiu instead. DILA carries BOTH relations and does not choose.

school.quote: 介石朋 … (appears among 象潭泳, 明極峻, 愚極慧 — the Wuzhun/Jingshan circle)

bio: Named Yuancheng, styled Falan; of Zhijiang in Jingzhou, Chen clan. At twenty he was tonsured by the Chan master Sucheng at the Bodhi-site; at twenty-five he took full precepts from the dharma master Daze. At thirty-three he went to Shaweng Hai (Shuijian Huihai) at the Tianwang monastery in Jingzhou, served as prior, then head of the hall, then first seat; one day Hai raised his whisk and said 'if you understand it here, the hundred flavours are complete', and he awoke at the word — Hai gave him the whisk as a token. He came out at Tianwang, then Dumen, then Putichang, and finally was invited by the provincial commander Xu Zhidu to open Bao'en monastery as its first abbot. He fell ill as Bao'en was being finished and died in 1689, aged 64, forty-four years a monk.

steles.title: 法瀾澂禪師塔記
steles.author: 清杲
steles.author_note: his own dharma heir — 「門人清杲記」
steles.quote: 師諱原澂，號法瀾，荊州枝江陳氏子…三十三，參天王沙翁海和尚，俾職監院，又任堂司，後升第一座。一日，海豎拂子曰：「汝向者裏會得，百味具足。」師言下契悟，海特以信拂授之…至夜分，泊然而逝，實康熙二十八年三月初七日也。師生明天啟六年丙寅十二月初十日，世壽六十四，僧夏四十四。
steles.note: Written by his heir at his death, dated the intercalary third month of 1689. Records the transmission, the dates, and the founding of Bao'en.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香，最初一步蹋著，至今受用不盡，今對人天眾前拈出，奉為中興本寺四坐道場本師沙翁海老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, at his installation at Tianwang in 1670.

teacher.quote: 三十三，參天王沙翁海和尚…師言下契悟，海特以信拂授之。
relation type=teacher -> A001716 慧海
teacher.note: IDENTIFICATION: DILA A001716's name-list is 慧海 / 水鑑 / 沙翁 / 水鑑慧海 / 沙翁海 — the batch's '沙翁海' and DILA's '慧海' are the SAME MAN. The edge does not dangle.

dates.quote: 實康熙二十八年三月初七日也。師生明天啟六年丙寅十二月初十日，世壽六十四，僧夏四十四。
dates.note: Born 1627-01-26, died 1689-03-27, age 64. DILA agrees exactly. The batch's 'floruit 1670' is the year he entered Tianwang.

school.quote: 奉為光賁天王棲賢獨冠敬太老和尚
school.note: Linji; his grand-teacher is 獨冠行敬.

bio: Of the Erhai region in Yunnan, Wang clan, mother of the Duo clan; born 1613. At twelve his parents told him he did not look fit to stay in the world and should become a monk 'to lengthen your years'; at fourteen his father took him up Jizu shan to Jiguang monastery to be tonsured. He fretted openly about death while the other novices laughed at him. He studied under Dali, Yeyu, Cheyong and Liaofan, then heard the Lotus and Surangama lectures for a few years, and worked the 'not mind, not Buddha, not a thing' phrase for twelve or thirteen years with no way in. At thirty-six, in a sealed room, reciting the Sutra of Ten Thousand Buddha Names, he had barely opened his mouth on the words 'namo' when body and mind fell away 'like one wheel of a bright moon'. He then took it to Wumu Wuzhu. His dharma came by letter and whisk from Mixing Jiren at Nanyun cloister in Hengzhou, in 1671. He taught across Yunnan — Jiutai shan, Fucheng at Chuxiong, Dafangguang, Xianyang. Died 1689, aged 77; his stupa is on Jizu shan.

steles.title: 知空蘊禪師語錄〈行錄〉
steles.author: 知空學蘊 himself
steles.author_note: extracted from him by his students, who would not let it go
steles.quote: 我乃洱海王姓，母朵氏，於萬曆癸丑年九月初一日生…十四歲，父送入雞足寂光寺，禮上和和尚剃髮…至三十六歲，在玉林軒靜室中禮《萬佛名經》，至第三卷，纔啟口念南無兩字，忽地身心脫落，內外圓明，如一輪明月。
steles.note: FIRST-PERSON, and unusually candid — he opens 「我之行腳，不可以告人」.

teacher.quote: 耑伸供養現住湖廣衡州府開峰堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二世上密下行老和尚，用酬法乳之恩
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. 'Mi-xing' = 密行寂忍, 32nd Linji generation. Repeated at lb 0762a25: 「二番供養…本師密老和尚，用酬法乳」. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.kind: dialogue in his own 語錄
teacher.quote: 「和尚久闡水目宗風，為甚今日別行一路？」師曰：「春風三月裏，得意便遷喬。」
teacher.note: A questioner points out the very distinction the brief warns about: he had long taught in the STYLE of Shuimu Wuzhu, but the TRANSMISSION is Mixing's. Association is not transmission — and his own assembly noticed.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A019552 寂忍 (密行寂忍, himself an heir of 破山海明)

dates.quote: 於萬曆癸丑年九月初一日生

dates.kind: authority record quoting the 行錄
dates.quote: death +1689-07-14 「皇清康熙己巳年五月廿八日午時。」…年七十七端坐而化，塔於雞足山
dates.note: Batch's 1613/1689 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十二世

bio: Named Yinsu; of Yichun county, Yu clan. A dream at six sent him to the monk Xian at Shoulong cloister; he shaved his head at twenty-seven and took precepts the year after. Told to recite sutras, he answered that the Buddhas' meaning must be realised in the mind, not counted off in ink, and left to travel Hunan, where he called on Mu'an Fazhong at Dawei. Back at his home cloister, in 1153 the neighbouring Cihua monastery asked him to preside. It had no endowment; he lived on gruel and paper robes and, apart from meditation, read only the Huayan sutra and its commentary — until one day he broke into a sweat all over and said, 'I have touched the Huayan realm myself.' From then his sayings, verses and healing became famous across a thousand li: he gave herbs and verses to the sick and to plague villages, prayed for rain, tore down shrines, and above all built — bridges and roads everywhere, so that anyone discussing meritorious works had to mention Pu'an. Died 1169, aged 55, twenty-eight years ordained; entombed whole on the first of the eleventh month. He was later absorbed into popular religion as the deity Pu'an Zushi.

steles.title: 普菴印肅禪師語錄〈塔銘〉
steles.author_note: The author does not sign himself in the canon text; he says only that he had heard of Pu'an for twenty years and was asked in 1179 by the disciple Yingshi to write. He worked from an 行實 by 歐陽世美, a named official (新荊南節度推官).
steles.quote: 師名印肅，宜春縣余氏子…遂辭師遊湖湘，謁大溈牧菴忠公…一日大悟，徧體汗流，喜曰：我今親契華嚴境界…索浴更衣，跏趺而寂。時則乾道五年七月二十一日也。享年五十五，僧臘二十八。
steles.note: Commissioned ten years after his death: 「先師歸寂逾十年矣」. States the teacher, the Huayan awakening and the death.

steles.title: 普菴印肅禪師語錄〈年譜〉
steles.quote: （政和）乙未十一月二十七日辰時生
steles.note: Year-by-year chronology in the same text; DILA quotes it for the birth.

teacher.quote: 遂辭師遊湖湘，謁大溈牧菴忠公
teacher.note: His stupa inscription names Mu'an Zhong (= 牧菴法忠) at Dawei. Batch CONFIRMED.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A008460 法忠 (牧菴法忠, himself an heir of 佛眼清遠)

dates.quote: 時則乾道五年七月二十一日也。享年五十五，僧臘二十八。
dates.note: Died 1169-08-22, age 55. Born 1115 (政和乙未) per the 年譜. Batch's 1115/1169 CONFIRMED.

school.quote: Linji (牧菴法忠 -> 佛眼清遠 -> 五祖法演)

bio.kind: 塔銘 + 年譜 + 內傳

bio: Of Gaizhou in Liaodong, Wang clan — a rare northeasterner in this literature. He preached in Manchuria: at Puci monastery in Guangning and at the Great Guanyin cloister on Mount Lü, where he gave his account of conduct in 1658. His transmission incense names Jiewei Xingzhou of the Ruru hall at Nanhu in Xiushui, Jiaxing, as his original master, in the 36th generation of the Caoxi line. He also records earlier study at Jinsu under Feiyin Tongrong, but names only Jiewei as 本師. His record preserves a scene in which a rival sect sent a man called 'Solitary Step' to crowd his seat with a mob.

steles.title: 永濟融禪師語錄〈行實〉
steles.author_note: given at the Great Guanyin cloister on Mount Lü in 順治戊戌 (1658)
steles.quote: 遼左蓋州王氏，為介為老和尚法嗣
steles.note: Cited by DILA A018938 from J28nB209_p0418a08. The 行實 is in his own 語錄.

teacher.quote: 今日人天眾前拈出，奉供先住嘉興府秀水縣南湖如如堂上，傳曹溪正脈第三十六世本師介為老和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON. 先住 = already deceased. Batch's '介為舟' CONFIRMED, and DILA identifies him as 行舟 (A000406).

teacher.quote: 遼左蓋州王氏，為介為老和尚法嗣…relation type=teacher -> A000406 行舟, citing 《永濟融禪師語錄》卷1：「第三十六世本師介為老和尚」

school.quote: 傳曹溪正脈第三十六世

bio: Of Fushun county in Sichuan, Gao clan, mother of the Yang clan, the fourth son. By the account of his dharma-brother Jienan Huixian he 'never studied the classics as a boy and could not read' — an illiterate who became an abbot. He was tonsured at twenty-five under Shengke Deyu, took his precepts at Yunfeng and did his Chan at Zhaojue, then came to Huayan monastery in Chongqing, where he and Shengke 'met like needle and mustard-seed' and he served as head monk for fifteen years without a divided thought. In 1684 Shengke left on pilgrimage and Huanchu took the Huayan seat; his opening sermon there in the tenth month of 1684 lights the incense to Shengke. He was fifty-five in 1685.

teacher.quote: 此一瓣香乃雲峰戒香、昭覺定香，屢被本師痛棒熱喝觸碎…爇向爐中，供養現住瀘陽方山雲峰堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二世聖可本師和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: FIRST-PERSON, at his installation at Huayan in the tenth month of 1684. Names Shengke as 本師, 32nd Linji generation. Batch CONFIRMED; the 五燈全書 補遺 tag flagged in the batch notes is wrong.

teacher.kind: 序 by his dharma-brother 价南慧仙
teacher.quote: 還初法兄…戒得雲峰，禪參昭覺，末到華巖，始與本師鍼芥相投，水乳相合，遂首眾服勤一十五載，了無異志焉。甲子歲，值本師有剃師禮…
teacher.note: Dated 康熙乙丑 (1685). Corroborates the fifteen years of service and the 1684 handover.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001669 德玉

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 語錄
dates.quote: birth +1631 「康熙乙丑師誕辰，云：『光佛今年五十五。』」（《華巖還初佛禪師語錄》卷1）
dates.note: He says his own age from the seat: fifty-five in 1685, hence born 1631. No death date.

school.quote: 傳臨濟正宗第三十二世

bio.kind: 機緣 in his own 語錄
bio.quote: 師乃蜀省富順縣人，父姓高，母楊氏，第四子。于二十五依師翁聖可和尚雉落。

bio: Of Jiashan, Chen clan; born 1593. A Caodong master and a dharma heir of Zhanran Yuancheng. His record, the Shiyu chanshi fatan, runs to twenty fascicles and contains his 行狀. He had a large following of heirs whose dharma names all begin with 淨 — Jingzhu, Jingfu, Jingxin and others — several of whom became compilers and lamp-historians in their own right. Died 1648, aged 56.

steles.title: 石雨禪師法檀 卷20〈行狀〉
steles.author_note: in his own collected record
steles.quote: 明萬曆癸巳正月廿九日 … （順治）戊子正月初八日申時，世壽五十有六
steles.note: Quoted by DILA A010693 from 《石雨禪師法檀》卷20〈行狀〉. The 法檀 is not among the texts the batch assigned me and I did not locate it in the corpus index by path; I therefore give no corpus path, only DILA's quotation.

steles.title: 佛日石雨方禪師塔銘
steles.author: 木陳道忞 (1596-1674), abbot of Tiantong — a contemporary who knew him personally
steles.quote: 予與禪師竊嘗共侍基隆，其嗣好木材以遠門柱公之狀來謁銘…師諱明方，字石雨，檇李武塘陳氏子…次春，雲門澄和尚說法嘉禾，敬往參請…澄遂印以偈曰：「分明識得趙州狗，拾得鼻孔失卻口…」
steles.note: A full 塔銘 in 布水臺集 卷13 — in SOMEBODY ELSE'S BOOK, exactly as the brief warns. Daomin says he served alongside Mingfang, and wrote from the 狀 (行狀) brought by Mingfang's heir. The stele traces the whole path and ends with 澄遂印以偈 — Yuancheng SEALED HIM WITH A VERSE (印可). It also carefully records the men who were NOT his master: 西築宗公 tonsured him; he studied with 憨山德清 and 無異元來 and got nothing (「來以師造語未玄」); 靜安 was a nianfo companion.

steles.title: 石雨禪師法檀 卷20 (jointly 祭文、雜著、行狀、塔銘、嗣刻)
steles.author: compiled by 嗣法小師淨柱
steles.quote: 卷第二十　祭文雜著行狀塔銘嗣刻
steles.note: His own record carries his 行狀 and 塔銘 in its final fascicle — the DILA citation 《石雨禪師法檀》卷20〈行狀〉 checks out.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 transmission-incense, at his 入寺 at 紹興府天華禪寺, 崇禎五年 (1632) — 石雨禪師法檀 卷1
teacher.quote: 今日天華堂上和盤拈出，供養顯聖堂中傳曹洞正宗第三十二代湛然大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: THE DHARMA-MILK STICK. He names the man (湛然), the seat (顯聖堂 — Yuancheng's temple), and the generation (32nd of the Caodong orthodox line). First-person, at the enthronement.

teacher.kind: a SECOND enthronement, a second dharma-stick
teacher.quote: 此一瓣香既已貴買於江南，終不賤賣於江北，端為供養顯聖堂上傳洞上正宗三十二代散木大和尚，用酬法乳之恩。
teacher.note: Same man under his other name (散木 = 湛然圓澄), same seat, same generation-number. Note the stick BEFORE it goes to 石田薰禪師建立之德以及宰護之誠 — the temple's FOUNDER. The secondary stick. He keeps them apart; so must we.

teacher.quote: 俗姓陳。圓澄弟子。（《續燈正統目錄》卷1；《石雨禪師法檀》卷20〈行狀〉；《五燈全書》卷109、110、115）
teacher.note: DILA relation type=teacher -> A005648 圓澄. Batch CONFIRMED — and the batch's worry that this node dangles is answered: 湛然圓澄 is a real, well-attested node (heir of 慈舟方念).

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 行狀
dates.quote: birth +1593-03-01 「明萬曆癸巳正月廿九日」; death +1648-02-01 「（順治）戊子正月初八日申時，世壽五十有六」
dates.note: Both from his own 行狀. Batch had no dates at all; now 1593-1648.

bio: Of Xuzhou (Yibin) in Sichuan, Fan clan, descended from a Fan who had been a prefectural commander; a monk of Chaoyang monastery in Xuzhou. A dharma heir of Tieniu Deyuan. He matters chiefly as the transmission link he is: Poshan Haiming's grand-teacher line runs through him, and Zhangxue Tongzui's stele quotes the sentence 'he got the dharma from the old man Yueming Lianchi'. Died 1639, sitting upright, aged 66.

teacher.kind: his HEIR's biography — 吹萬禪師語錄 (Chuiwan Guangzhen, Lianchi's dharma-heir)
teacher.quote: 師諱廣真，僰道宜賓人，俗姓李…得法於月明聯池老人。池嗣鐵牛遠，遠嗣荊山寶，寶嗣無念有，有嗣二仰欽，欽嗣小庵密，密嗣一言顯，顯嗣筏渡慈，慈嗣苦口益
teacher.note: The heir's own record, stating his own line upward: 'Guangzhen OBTAINED THE DHARMA FROM Old Man Yueming Lianchi. LIANCHI SUCCEEDED TIENIU YUAN (池嗣鐵牛遠); Yuan succeeded Jingshan Bao…' — and it keeps climbing, link by named link, back to Dahui. A man reciting his own ancestry, one generation above his own teacher. Duplicated independently at J/J29/J29nB238.xml lb 0470c29.

teacher.kind: 三山來禪師語錄 — the transmission NARRATED as an event
teacher.quote: 南嶽第二十七世 秦嶺鐵牛德遠禪師，得心印於荊山，庵居秦嶺，常披一紅布褲。一日，頂笠揮鋤地中，月明聯池過之。池見云：這漢好似一頭軍。師云：看箭。池作躲箭勢。師近前，攜手至庵，留住三月，謂云：我乃大慧之裔，在此待人數十年矣！ … 南嶽第二十八世 敘州朝陽月明聯池禪師
teacher.note: The meeting itself, and it is unforgettable. Tieniu Deyuan is hoeing a field in red cloth trousers when Lianchi walks past and jokes that he looks like a soldier; Tieniu shouts 'look out — an arrow!'; Lianchi ducks; Tieniu takes him by the hand, walks him to the hermitage, keeps him three months, and tells him: 'I am an heir of Dahui, and I have been waiting here for a man for decades.' The text then numbers them 南嶽第二十七世 (Tieniu) and 南嶽第二十八世 (Lianchi) — consecutive generations. This is a full name for the teacher: 鐵牛 DEYUAN 德遠, matching the roster exactly.

teacher.quote: …苦口良益、筏渡普慈、一言道顯、小菴行密、二仰圓欽、無念智有、荊山懷寶、鐵牛德遠、月明聯池、吹萬廣真、鐵壁慧機，機則余之授法本師也
teacher.note: The same chain again, written out by a man four generations below, ending 'Huiji is the master who gave ME the dharma.' 鐵牛德遠 → 月明聯池 in sequence.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A019884 德遠
teacher.note: Batch's chain (月明聯池 <- 鐵牛德遠) CONFIRMED by DILA. The batch derived it from the section structure of 續燈正統; DILA states it as a relation.

dates.quote: birth +1574; death +1639-01-27 崇禎十一年十二月二十四日，端坐而逝。師壽六十有六。（X84n1583, p.498, c8-9；疑年錄：383）
dates.note: Batch had no dates; now 1574-1639. Note the lunar/Gregorian straddle: 崇禎十一年十二月廿四 is Chinese year 1638 but 27 Jan 1639 Gregorian.

school.quote: 敘州朝陽僧人 (Linji, 聚雲 line)

bio.quote: 敘州人，俗姓范，范郡司馬之後。

bio: Of Dazhou in western Shu (Sichuan), Zhao clan. A dharma heir of Linye Tongqi. He restored and presided over Xiangyan Xiantong monastery at Nanyang in Henan — his own heir Gusu Zun credits him in his transmission incense with 'reviving Xiangyan at Dengzhou'. His teacher Linye Tongqi was an heir of Miyun Yuanwu and is NOT yet a node on the chart.

teacher.quote: 行遠 / 宕山行遠 / 香嚴宕山遠 — 西蜀達州趙氏，林野通奇弟子。（X82n1571_p0423b22）
teacher.note: Batch CONFIRMED. DILA relation type=teacher -> A012053 通奇, on the authority of 五燈全書.

teacher.kind: his heir 古宿尊's 拈香
teacher.quote: 中興鄧州香嚴
teacher.note: Cited in the batch notes; corroborates his Xiangyan abbacy. (I did not re-open this text; flagged as inherited from the batch file rather than personally re-verified.)

school.quote: Linji (林野通奇 -> 密雲圓悟)

bio: Of Suizhou, Qiu clan; born 1620. Abbot of Baiyun monastery at Qizhou, where he is styled Xianglin. A dharma heir of Tieguan Xingneng. His recorded sayings, the Baiyun Xianglin Benzhen chanshi yulu, contain his 行實, which records that he died sitting cross-legged in the summer of 1691, aged 72.

steles.title: 白雲象林本真禪師語錄 卷1〈行實〉
steles.author_note: in his own recorded sayings
steles.quote: 康熙辛未夏跏趺坐逝，世壽七十有二。
steles.note: Quoted by DILA A016469 from his 語錄's 行實. The batch listed no text for him, so I have no corpus path to give and do not invent one.

teacher.kind: own 拈香 incense at his enthronement (白雲象林本真禪師語錄) — the 以酬法乳 formula
teacher.quote: 又拈香，云：「者一瓣香，一十餘年遊歷吳越，受盡辛勤，撞著個惡辣老漢，不順人情，驀頭一拶，直得淨裸裸、絕遮攔。今朝對眾拈出，爇向爐中，供養江南常州府宜興縣荊溪芙蓉堂上傳臨濟正宗第三十二代本師銕關能大和尚，以酬法乳。」
teacher.note: The third stick — after the emperor and the assembled officials — and it is the dharma stick, with the formula 以酬法乳. He names the man to the county: Furong Hall, Jingxi, Yixing county, Changzhou prefecture, Jiangnan; Linji's 32nd generation; 本師 銕關能 大和尚. 銕 is the variant of 鐵, so this is 鐵關行能, exactly as the chart has him. And the description is affectionate abuse — 「撞著個惡辣老漢，不順人情，驀頭一拶」: 'I ran into a vicious old bastard who had no regard for anyone's feelings and jammed me right in the head.'

teacher.kind: own 佛事 — offering incense at his master's stupa
teacher.quote: 禮銕老和尚塔。拈香，云：「恭惟本師和尚，示現虛空之相。住世四十九年，道風愈布愈遠。利生五坐道場，法語難比難量。心印傳來猶現存，行藏端的全無狀。本真到此伎思窮，只爇瓣香作…」
teacher.note: He goes to the grave and burns incense there, calling him 本師 — my root master — and says 心印傳來猶現存, 'the mind-seal handed down is still here now.' Only the heir performs this rite.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A021842 行能
teacher.note: Batch's '鐵關能' CONFIRMED and expanded: his dharma name is 行能. The batch derived the edge from a 五燈全書 structural parse; DILA states it as a relation.

dates.kind: authority record quoting his 行實
dates.quote: birth +1620; death +1691-01-29 ~ +1692-02-16 「康熙辛未夏跏趺坐逝，世壽七十有二。」
dates.note: Batch had no dates; now 1620-1691.

school.quote: 隨州人，姓丘，蘄州白雲僧人 (Linji, 萬如通微 line)

bio: Chan master of Tianning monastery in Jiaxing prefecture. A dharma heir of Baoyue Tan. The Jingshi diru ji records that he first went to Chushan Shaoqi — Baoyue's dharma-brother — and 'at once tallied with the subtle purport', before receiving Baoyue's seal: another case where the first teacher is not the transmitting one. Only his dharma character 宣 is attested; I have not expanded it.

teacher.kind: 五燈會元續略 heir-index, 廣善潭禪師法嗣
teacher.quote: 廣善潭禪師法嗣：天寧宣禪師…
teacher.note: 廣善潭 = 寶月潭 = 八峰潭. His teacher, index-confirmed.

teacher.quote: 嘉興府天寧寺默堂宣禪師，初謁楚山，頓契微旨。後參八峰，峰舉雲門放洞山三頓棒，師語屬意路，峰叱之，師頓忘寢食…及見峰，峰曰：開口即錯，你露箇消息看。師珍重，禮三拜。
teacher.note: ⚠ 初謁楚山 (Chushan Shaoqi — his teacher's DHARMA-BROTHER) is association; the transmission is under 八峰 (寶月潭). The lamp itself distinguishes 謁 (Chushan) from the sustained training under 峰.
Batch CONFIRMED. DILA relation type=teacher -> A015702 寶月潭, with three citations.

teacher.quote: 初謁楚山，頓契微旨
teacher.note: Inherited from the batch file's reading — he saw Chushan Shaoqi FIRST, but the seal is Baoyue's. I did not personally re-open this text.

bio.quote: 天寧宣 — 嘉興府天寧寺

bio: Of Fenzhou in Shanxi; born 1264, died 1351/52 at the age of 88. His dharma name is 普慈 — the batch had only the bare sobriquet plus a single character. The Xudeng zhengtong files him as 'Fadu Puci of Fenzhou, heir of Yi of Taiyuan' — that is Kukou Liangyi, the batch's 苦口益. A separate index, however, lists a 'Wufeng Yuanshu Puci' as an heir of Yuansou Xingduan. He is remembered in Qing Sichuan: Qingzhong Tiebi's record says a monk 'travelled to Fenzhou and called on Fadu, who recognised him at once as a vessel'.

teacher.kind: 續燈正統, his own entry
teacher.quote: 太原益禪師法嗣：汾州筏渡普慈禪師。初參徑山端、高峰玅，各有契處。後北還遊燕，如五臺禮文殊…入太原參益和尚[得法]。
teacher.note: DECISIVE on the roster's dispute: the 續燈正統 lists him under 太原益 (良益) 法嗣. 徑山端 (元叟行端) and 高峰玅 were only 參'd (「初參…各有契處」) — the brief's rule: 參 is NOT a transmission verb. So the 元叟行端 relation (a second DILA bibl) is an ASSOCIATION, not his dharma-father. teacher_changed: I take 太原良益 and demote 行端 to provenance.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A024989 良益; 《續燈正統》卷13：「太原益禪師法嗣，汾州筏渡普慈禪師」(X84n1583, p.480, a12-13)
teacher.note: The batch's reading (苦口益 = 良益) CONFIRMED, and the dharma name expanded to 普慈.

teacher.quote: relation type=teacher -> A001032 行端; 《續燈正統目錄》卷1：「徑山元叟端禪師法嗣……五峰元恕普慈禪師」
teacher.note: A GENUINE CONFLICT: DILA's record also makes him an heir of Yuansou Xingduan under the name 五峰元恕普慈. It is not certain these are the same man; DILA has merged them. I take the 苦口良益 attribution (it names him as 筏渡普慈 of Fenzhou, exactly our man) and record the other.

dates.note: Batch had no dates; now 1264-1351, age 88.

bio.quote: 遊汾州，謁筏渡，渡一見器。
bio.note: Cited by DILA (J29nB241_p0622b11).

notes: Dharma heir of Baizhang.
bio: Dharma heir of Baizhang.

notes: Disciple of Linji Yixuan at Baoshou Monastery in Zhenzhou. Known for exchanges with Zhaozhou and Sansheng.
bio: Disciple of Linji Yixuan at Baoshou Monastery in Zhenzhou. Known for exchanges with Zhaozhou and Sansheng.

teacher: Jinmyeong Guksa Honwon 真明國師 混元
bio: Korean Seon master, fifth patriarch (第五世) of the Susonsa 修禪社 community on Mt. Jogye 曹溪山 (Songgwangsa). Dharma name 天英 (Cheonyeong); lay surname 梁; father 宅椿, mother of the 金 clan. Born 高宗二年乙亥 (1215), sixth month, thirteenth day. Tonsured in 1225 (高宗十二年己丑) at Jogye under 真覺國師 (Jingak, i.e. 慧諶) — a TONSURE (得度), not a transmission. He then consulted 清真國師 (Cheongjin, i.e. 夢如, the 3rd patriarch) and 'received the essentials of the dharma' from 真明國師 (Jinmyeong, i.e. 混元, the 4th patriarch), whom he succeeded in the seat. In 1233 he was made 座元 at a 談禪法會; in 1236 he took first place in the 禪選. Appointed 三重大師 and then 禪師 by the 晉陽公, he was installed at 斷俗寺 (1248) and presided at 昌福寺 (1249). He held the seat at Jogye for thirty years. He died aged 72 (法臘 57) and was posthumously titled 慈真圓悟國師 — hence 'Wono' 圓悟 — with the stupa-name 靜照. It is under this posthumous 圓悟 that his disciple Manhang's stele calls him 「其師曹溪圓悟和尚」. His own stele stands at 佛臺寺 in 高興郡, composed by 李益培.

steles.title: 曹溪山修禪社第五世慈真國師碑
steles.author: 李益培 (by royal command, 奉命撰)
steles.quote: 師諱天英。俗姓梁氏…高宗二年乙亥六月十三日誕生
steles.note: The stele stands at 佛臺寺, 高興郡. Full text preserved in 朝鮮佛教通史.

teacher.kind: his own 碑 (曹溪山修禪社第五世慈真國師碑)
teacher.quote: 十二年己丑。詣曹溪真覺國師得度…時清真國師。盛化曹溪。徑造參扣。慧能增明。又從真明國師。諮稟法要
teacher.note: THREE masters named, and the stele distinguishes them: 得度 from 真覺 (慧諶) is TONSURE, not transmission; 參扣 of 清真 (夢如) is consultation; only 真明 (混元) gives him 法要 (諮稟法要). He then succeeds 真明 as the 5th patriarch. Taken: 真明國師 混元. CAVEAT recorded honestly — 諮稟法要 is not one of the hard transmission verbs (嗣/得法/付法/囑/印可), and the 世-succession at Susonsa is an abbatial as well as a dharma succession.

dates.quote: 師諱天英。俗姓梁氏。考宅椿。妣金氏。高宗二年乙亥六月十三日誕生
dates.note: 高宗二年乙亥 = 1215.

dates.quote: 贈諡慈真圓悟國師…賜塔號靜照…享壽七十二。法臘五十七。住錫曹溪。凡三十年
dates.note: 1215 + 72 - 1 = 1286. THIS IS THE IDENTIFICATION: 天英's posthumous title contains 圓悟.

bio.quote: 曹溪山修禪社第五世慈真國師碑碑在高興郡佛臺寺李益培奉命撰
bio.note: Title, location and author of his stele.

bio.quote: 曹溪山第六世圓鑑國師法桓。第十世慧鑑國師萬恒。第十三世覺真國師復丘
bio.note: Confirms Manhang = 10th patriarch, 慧鑑國師.

bio.kind: 圓鑑國師 沖止's 碑銘
bio.quote: 時圓悟國師主法於禪源社…丙戌二月圓悟順世。大眾舉師次繼席…而嗣圓悟為第六世住院
bio.note: Independent corroboration: 圓悟 died 丙戌 = 1286 ✓, and the 6th patriarch 沖止 (法桓) 嗣 him. So Wono had at least two attested heirs.

teacher: Doui 道義 (道儀, 元寂禪師)
bio: Silla Seon master, the SECOND patriarch of the Gajisan 迦智山 school — the middle man of the founding Korean Seon chain 道義 → 廉居 → 體澄. When Doui, who had received the mind-seal from 西堂智藏 (Mazu's disciple) in Tang China, found Silla unready for the Chan teaching and withdrew into the mountains, he 'transmitted the dharma to Chan master Yeomgeo' (付法於廉居禪師). Yeomgeo dwelt at 億聖寺 (written 偣聖寺 in the stele, whose own compiler flags the character as doubtful — 「偣或疑信字亦疑倍字之誤」) on 雪山 = Seoraksan 설악산. There 體澄 came and served him, and Yeomgeo 'bestowed the dark pearl and conferred the dharma-seal' upon him. His stupa (the Yeomgeo Hwasang stupa, 844) survives and is a Korean national treasure; 朝鮮佛教通史's index carries the entry 「廉居禪師塔」. He is the reason the Gajisan line is counted from Doui rather than from Chejing.

steles.title: 寶林寺普照禪師靈塔碑 (普照禪師彰聖塔碑) — his SON's stele, which is where Yeomgeo is attested
steles.author: 金薳 (so B31n0170 at 0555a25; the attribution is commonly given as 金穎 — DISCREPANCY recorded, not resolved)
steles.quote: 付法於廉居禪師。居於雪山偣聖寺
steles.note: Yeomgeo has no surviving stele of his own; he is attested through his son's. The stele is at 迦智山寶林寺, 長興. 中和三年 = 883.

teacher.kind: 體澄's 884 stele (寶林寺普照禪師靈塔碑)
teacher.quote: 初道儀大師者。受心印於西堂。後歸我國。說其禪理…由是知時未集。隱於山林。付法於廉居禪師。居於雪山偣聖寺
teacher.note: 付法 = canonical transmission verb. Doui's own master is named in the same breath: 受心印於西堂 (西堂智藏).

teacher.kind: the same stele re-quoted with editorial glosses
teacher.quote: 西堂名智藏。馬祖之弟子…付法於廉居禪師。居雪山偣聖寺。此疑倍聖或信聖寺之誤
teacher.note: The compiler glosses 西堂 = 智藏, disciple of Mazu; and flags the temple-name character as corrupt.

teacher.quote: 元寂道義弟子
teacher.note: 元寂 is Doui's posthumous title. DILA names him 염거/Yeomgeo/廉居/雪山廉居.

dates.quote: death 844
dates.note: His surviving stupa is dated 844; no birth year is attested.

bio.quote: 廉居禪師塔一二三
bio.note: His stupa is indexed as an extant monument.

links.label: ko.wikipedia 염거
links.confirms: 廉居/廉巨; disciple of 道義 (received robe and bowl at Doui's death at 陳田寺); transmitted the lineage to 體澄; seat 億聖寺 on Seoraksan; d. 844; 2nd patriarch of the Gajisan school. FETCHED AND CONFIRMED.

teacher: Songshan Puji 嵩山普寂 (大照禪師)
bio: Tang Chan master of the NORTHERN school (北宗), an 入室 (inner-chamber) disciple of 普寂 of Songshan — 大照禪師, the chief heir of 神秀. He is known almost entirely through the stele of his Korean disciple 神行: the Silla monk crossed to Tang, came to 志空, attended him morning and evening for three years, and was given the 元珠 (the primal pearl) and, as 志空 lay dying, the 灌頂授記 — the anointing and the prediction that sent him home to Silla. Through him the Northern school entered Korea: 朝鮮佛教通史 records 「北宗神行先導。南宗道義繼至」 — Sinhaeng led the way with the Northern school, and Doui followed with the Southern. NAME CORRECTION: he is 志空 (wikisource prints the variant 誌空), NOT 智空.

teacher.kind: 神行's stele by 金獻貞
teacher.quote: 事解，遂就於誌空和上。和上即大照禪師之入室。
teacher.note: 入室 = inner-chamber disciple. 大照禪師 = 普寂 (651-739), 神秀's heir. This is how Zhikong connects UPWARD.

teacher.quote: 普寂入室弟子，海東神行師父
teacher.note: DILA teacher = A009319 嵩山普寂.

bio.quote: 神行禪師…新羅兵部侍郎金獻貞撰神行碑在晉州斷俗寺…智異山斷俗寺西。有神行禪師碑銘。皇唐衛尉卿金獻貞撰。元和八年九月日立
bio.note: The son's stele: by 金獻貞, at 斷俗寺 on 智異山, erected 元和八年 = 813. 柳夢寅 records that by the Joseon period the stone was already 「石理麤惡…文字不可讀」 — worn illegible.

links.label: zh.wikisource 海東故神行禪師之碑（並序）(全唐文 卷718)
links.confirms: The full stele text: 誌空和上 as 大照禪師之入室; the 元珠 and 灌頂授記 transmission to 神行; 法朗 as the earlier teacher who died; 神行 died 大曆十四年 (779) aged 76. FETCHED AND CONFIRMED.

teacher: Miaofeng Zhishan 妙峰之善 (靈隱妙峰之善)
bio: Southern Song Linji master, abbot of Jingshan 徑山. Dharma name 善珍, style 藏叟; son of the 呂 family of Nan'an in Quanzhou. Tonsured at thirteen under 崇福南和尚 (a TONSURE master, not his dharma-father); at sixteen he travelled to Hangzhou and took the full precepts. He then 'called on Miaofeng Shan at Lingyin, entered his chamber and awakened to the purport' (謁妙峯善公于靈隱，入室悟旨) — 妙峰之善 being the heir of 佛照德光 (1121-1203). He came out at 光孝 in his home district, rose to 承天, moved to 思溪圓覺 in Anji and 雪峰 in Fujian, and by imperial command to 育王 in Siming and finally 徑山 at Lin'an — six great monasteries. 補續高僧傳 closes his life with the decisive sentence: of all his many students, 「入室得髓者，唯元叟端公一人而已」 — the only one who entered the chamber and got the marrow was Yuansou Duan. His stupa is at 南塔院. NOTE: the roster's ascription of 元叟行端 to 高峰原妙 is contradicted by every source consulted.

teacher.kind: 補續高僧傳, 藏叟珍公傳
teacher.quote: 善珍，字藏叟，泉之南安呂氏子。年十三落髮，十六游方至杭，受具足戒。謁妙峯善公于靈隱，入室悟旨
teacher.note: 入室悟旨 = transmission. Note his TONSURE master (崇福南和尚, per 增集續傳燈錄) is explicitly NOT his dharma-father — the trap avoided by the source itself.

teacher.quote: 杭州徑山藏叟善珍禪師，泉州南安呂氏子，年十三依郡崇福南和尚落髮，遊方至杭受具，謁妙峰於靈隱，入室悟旨
teacher.note: Independent agreement.

teacher.quote: 臨安府靈隱妙峰之善禪師，俗姓劉。佛照德光（1121-1203）禪師法嗣…法嗣有藏叟善珍、友雲宗鍪、東叟仲頴等
teacher.note: CONNECTS UPWARD: 妙峰之善 ← 佛照德光. 之善 is also called 老劉 and 妙峰禪師.

dates.quote: 生於紹興甲寅，逝于嘉定丁丑，年八十有三
dates.note: CONTRADICTION — see below. This reading (紹興甲寅 = 1134, 嘉定丁丑 = 1217) is REJECTED.

dates.quote: 師生於宋紹興甲寅十月十二日，示寂於嘉定丁丑五月二十一日，壽八十三，塔全身於南塔院
dates.note: The SAME corrupt era-names, independently transmitted.

dates.quote: 雪峰珍（1194-1277）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十世

teacher: Yangzhuo Zhengming 養拙正明 (養拙明, d. 1649)
bio: Qing-dynasty Linji master, thirty-third generation of the orthodox Linji transmission (傳臨濟正宗三十三世) — so styled by his own heir in open assembly. Heir of 養拙正明 (養拙明), who was himself the heir of 五峰如學 (1583-1631) and who dwelt at 密印寺 on Mt. Dagui 大溈山, dying in the spring of 1649. Zhihai's seat gives him his name, 慧山. His disciple 古梅定冽 attended him for fifteen unbroken years and received the 記莂 (the prediction/certification) from him in the midst of the assembly, and afterwards led the same 大溈山密印寺 / 芙蓉山廣化寺 community. Other recorded heirs: 與峰智, 明應, 揆庵空, 上湛, 月憨權, 千如一. No dates and no stele have been found for him; he is known through his heir's 語錄 and through the Qing lamp-records.

teacher.kind: authority DB, cited to 正源略集
teacher.quote: REL teacher A000266 正明 — bibl（明清序：072；X85n1586_p0003a18）
teacher.note: CONNECTS UPWARD: 養拙正明 (A000266), whose own teacher is 五峰如學 (A003855, 1583-1631). DILA's concise for 正明: 「清僧。五峰如學禪師（1583-1631）法嗣…居大溈山密印寺…順治己丑（1649）春寂，塔於溈山前阜。」

bio.quote: 傳臨濟正宗三十三世即此堂上慧山老和尚
bio.note: His generation-number in the Linji line, stated by his own heir.

bio: Yuan-dynasty Linji master (1257-1345), of Ninghai, lay surname 陳. Heir of 橫川如珙 (himself heir of 滅翁文禮). He dwelt at 紫籜 in 仙居 for close to forty years — 「住仙居之紫籜垂四十年矣」 — a recluse so austere that travelling monks were afraid of him; he is also linked with 薦嚴寺 at Kunshan (hence 薦嚴道) and appears in the 淨慈寺志. 柳貫 wrote the preface to his recorded sayings. When 無慍 and two companions climbed to him they found him sitting on a slab across the stream 'like a Luohan painted by the recluse Wu'; 無慍's first question drew a shout that dissolved his long-standing doubt about the 狗子無佛性 koan, and the verse he then offered — 「狗子佛性無，春色滿皇都」 — was deeply approved. ⚠ HE IS NOT the 妙道 already on the chart (Dahui's female disciple): this is a Yuan-dynasty male monk, and DILA holds them as separate persons.

teacher.kind: 南宋元明禪林僧寶傳, 瑞巖恕中慍禪師
teacher.quote: 聞天目禮下橫川珙有嗣曰竺元道禪師，住仙居之紫籜垂四十年矣
teacher.note: CONNECTS UPWARD, and names the grandfather too: 天目(滅翁文)禮 → 橫川珙 → 竺元道. Matches the chain already established for 橫川如珙 ← 滅翁文禮.

teacher.quote: REL teacher A007633 如珙
teacher.note: Agrees.

dates.quote: 竺原妙道（1257-1345）禪師法嗣，大鑑下第二十三世

bio.quote: 柳貫字道傳東陽人。嘗為太常博士。撰竺元道公語錄序
bio.note: The Yuan literatus 柳貫 (1270-1342) wrote the preface to his recorded sayings — a contemporary witness that he existed and had a 語錄.

bio.quote: 謁竺原道公於仙居紫籜山，咨問心要
bio.note: Another monk (性原慧明) visiting him at 紫籜山 — confirms the seat.

bio: Northern Song master of the YUNMEN house, seated at 德山 in 鼎州. His teacher was 雙泉郁, a direct heir of 雲門文偃 — the lamp lineage table files him under the explicit heading 「雙泉郁禪師法嗣：德山慧遠禪師、含珠山彬禪師」 — so he stands exactly two generations below 文偃. This is independently corroborated by 契嵩's 鐔津文集 (11th century, contemporary), which calls 德山遠公 a 法孫, a dharma-GRANDSON, of 雲門匡真大師. His heirs include 開先善暹, 欽山悟勤, 鹿苑圭, 含珠山彬 and 盛懃. ⚠ HE IS NOT 廬山慧遠, the Pure Land patriarch who died in 416 — six centuries separate them; this man is a Song Yunmen monk at Dingzhou. ⚠ NAME: the corpus gives his teacher as the single character 郁 (雙泉郁). The expansion to 仁郁 rests ONLY on DILA, whose citation is （望月）— a 20th-century Japanese encyclopedia, i.e. EXTERNAL rung. I therefore record the teacher as 雙泉郁 and do not adopt the expansion.

teacher.kind: lamp lineage table, explicit 法嗣 heading
teacher.quote: 雙泉郁禪師法嗣：德山慧遠禪師、含珠山彬禪師
teacher.note: THE UPWARD EDGE, stated as a 法嗣 heading. Corroborates DILA's two students for 郁 (慧遠 and 山彬) exactly.

teacher.quote: 偃祖下一世：白雲子祥禪師、德山緣密禪師、巴陵顥鑒禪師、雙泉師寬禪師、香林澄遠禪師、洞山守初禪師、泐潭道謙禪師、奉先深禪師、雙泉郁禪師、披雲智寂禪師…
teacher.note: 雙泉郁 is a DIRECT heir of 雲門文偃, so 德山慧遠 is 文偃's dharma-grandson. ⚠ NEAR-COLLISION: 雙泉師寬 and 雙泉郁 are TWO different men, both Yunmen heirs at the same 雙泉 seat — do not merge them.

teacher.kind: 鐔津文集 (契嵩, d.1072), 原宗集序, quoted
teacher.quote: 原宗集序其略曰：原宗懃師證法於德山遠公。印可於三角澄公。澄遠皆雲門匡真大師之法孫也
teacher.note: KEY CORROBORATION: 德山遠公 is a 法孫 (dharma-GRANDSON) of 雲門文偃 — which requires exactly ONE man between them. That man is named 雙泉(仁)郁 by DILA and by the lamp table. Also: 盛懃 證法於 德山遠 — another heir.

teacher.quote: A015613 慧遠/德山慧遠, teacher A020926 仁郁 (雙泉仁郁); A020926's teacher = A003703 文偃; A020926 concise: 韶州雲門山文偃禪師法嗣，住舒州海會
teacher.note: ⚠ DILA's bibl for these links is （望月‧卷六‧附錄：049） — a 20th-century Japanese encyclopedia = EXTERNAL rung. It is the ONLY source that expands 郁 to 仁郁, so the expansion is NOT adopted here (see the name rule). The RELATION itself does not depend on 望月: it is independently attested at lamp rung by GA056n0059's 法嗣 heading above. DILA does add his seat: 舒州海會.

bio.quote: 師住開先凡十八年，而化於本山。嫡嗣雲居元
bio.note: On the son: eighteen years at 開先, and his own heir was 雲居(佛印)了元.

bio: Qing-dynasty Linji master, heir of 破山海明 (1597-1666) — the great Sichuan revivalist — and thus part of the 破山 line that carried Linji Chan into Sichuan and Guizhou. His seats were 盛京聖恩寺 (Shengjing/Shenyang), 潭淵普照寺 in 大名府, and the 二祖墖院 on the 滹沱 in 磁州. He certified 語嵩傳裔, who carried the line south into Guizhou (the 黔南 lamp-record descends from him), and 書雲旵. NAME NOTE: he is 雪臂 ('Snow Arm'), not 雪竇 or 雪壁; the corpus writes 雪臂巒 and 印巒.

teacher.kind: authority DB, citing 五燈全書 卷70
teacher.quote: REL teacher A009652 海明 — bibl（明清序：045；X82n1571_p0335b07）
teacher.note: CONNECTS UPWARD: 破山海明 (A009652), a major node certain to be on the chart already.

bio.quote: 康熈乙亥冬十月十六日…端坐寂然而逝。世壽七十有三，僧臘六十七
bio.note: On the son: 語嵩傳裔 died 康熙乙亥 = 1695, aged 73 → born 1623. His seats: 牟尼山報國禪寺；貴陽西山傳法寺；鼎州德山乾明寺 (hence 德山語嵩).

bio: THE MISSING MAN. Absent from our roster entirely — and his absence is the whole reason the forgery worked. A SECOND master styled Haizhou: born Hongwu 27 (1394) at Chengdu in Shu, surname YU 余 (not Qian); tonsured at Jingde si on Dasui shan in Peng county under Duzhao Yue 獨照月; after Yue died in 1413 he lived eight years alone in a hermitage on Xishan. Heir of Dongming Huichan: he received Huichan's robe and verse in Jingtai 2 (1451), delivered by the head seat Faguang to Dongshan on the day the bequest matured. Founding abbot (開山) of Yishan chan si 翼善禪寺 on Dongshan, Jinling, from Zhengtong 2 (1437), installed at the request of the eunuch defence-commissioner Yuan Cheng. Died Chenghua 2 (1466), aged 73; stupa behind Tuiju si; ONE HUNDRED AND FOUR dharma-heirs, of whom Yunxi Zhiying 雲溪智瑛 is one. His 行實碑 stood in front of Yishan si; it was rediscovered in 1657 and circulated from 1662, and it is what finally proved there were two Haizhous.

steles.title: 海舟永慈行實碑
steles.quote: 成都余氏子．參東明旵．有無相福田衣之機緣。正統二年．出住金陵東山翼善寺。景泰二年．受東明遺付衣偈
steles.note: stood at 翼善寺, 金陵東山. Recovered 1657, circulated from 康熙元年 (1662) by 大咸. 智楷 collected it in person.

teacher.kind: 海舟永慈 行實碑 (翼善寺)
teacher.quote: 海舟永慈行實碑．其略曰．成都余氏子．參東明旵．有無相福田衣之機緣。正統二年．出住金陵東山翼善寺。景泰二年．受東明遺付衣偈
teacher.note: 受…遺付衣偈 = he received Dongming's bequeathed robe and verse

teacher.kind: 古溪澄 祭海舟和尚文
teacher.quote: 祭獻於前東山翼善堂上高峯下第七代圓寂本師海舟大和尚覺靈曰…來西蜀而全提正令。坐東山而大闡玄猷。延世壽七旬三載．精僧臘五十餘秋…續高峯七世之燈．爍羣昏而獨照。紹旵祖百年之踵．吞眾派以周流
teacher.note: THE SENTENCE THAT CONFUSED EVERYONE FOR 60 YEARS. 紹旵祖 = he inherits from Chan (=慧旵); 續高峯七世 = 7th from Gaofeng; 來西蜀 = from Sichuan; 七旬三載 = age 73. Every detail is Yongci's, none is Puci's. Because only ONE Haizhou was known, this eulogy was read as proof that Puci inherited from Dongming.

teacher.quote: 萬峯蔚禪師．寶藏持禪師．東明旵禪師．海舟慈禪師．雲溪瑛禪師
teacher.note: his own great-grandson's lineage chart

teacher.kind: 永慈's own signed transmission document to 智瑄
teacher.quote: 時景泰五年歲次甲戌春二月十一日．敕賜翼善禪寺開山臨濟下正嗣第二十四世傳法比丘永慈親書付囑
teacher.note: HIS OWN HAND. He signs himself 'founding abbot of Yishan, 24th-generation true heir of Linji'. Dated 1454.

dates.quote: 禪師名永慈．號海舟。明洪武廿七年．生於蜀之成都余氏。…決志趨彭縣之大隋山．景德寺．禮獨照月禪師…永樂癸巳月歿。師竟入西山庵隱八載
dates.note: b. Hongwu 27 = 1394

dates.quote: 示寂．有景泰元年成化二年之別…世壽．有九十六年七旬三載之別。…法嗣．有十二人一百四人之別
dates.note: d. Chenghua 2 = 1466, age 73, 104 heirs

bio.quote: 曰．字付慈海舟．訪我我無酬。明年之明日．西風笑點頭。語至來年期日示寂。白庵長老．不違遺囑．限滿日．請首座法廣。於景泰二年八月二十三日．持衣齎至東山。師陞座．祝香．而受
bio.note: Dongming's bequest verse 「字付慈海舟」 and the delivery of the robe in 1451. Note the verse begins 字付 — one of the 13 discriminating points (法偈．有龜毛字付之別): Puci's verse begins 龜毛, Yongci's begins 字付.

bio.quote: 按永慈碑載法嗣一百有四人．雲溪智瑛其一也
bio.note: 104 heirs

bio.kind: 正名錄 — provenance of the stele itself
bio.quote: 翼善寺大殿前有中興翼善碑．寺左退居寺有永慈行實劄付二碑。…至順治丁酉永慈碑始為忞公之孫得之
bio.note: the stele was rediscovered in Shunzhi 14 (1657); 智楷 states at 0463a25 that he went to Yishan si in Jinling and got the 永慈行實碑 HIMSELF

links.label: DILA A015692
links.confirms: 海舟永慈, teacher 慧旵, student 智瑛 — DILA already has him as a separate person; our roster is missing him

bio: A SECOND man styled Baofeng, heir of Haizhou YONGCI — routinely merged with Baofeng MINGXUAN, heir of Haizhou Puci. He received Yongci's own hand-written charge on the 11th day of the 2nd month of Jingtai 5 (1454), with the verse 「迷悟猶如空裏雲」 and a robe and whisk. His stupa stands behind Tuiju si, not beside Dongming si. In Tianshun 5 (1461) he and Zhixi 智璽 reverently recorded Yongci's 行錄. Note 智楷 also reports that Yongci's chief heir styled Baofeng was 智忍 — so the 寶峯 sobriquet may cover a third man; keep 智瑄 distinct from 明瑄 and do not claim more. He is NOT Tianqi Benrui's teacher: the forgers made him so by fabricating a transmission verse 'found in a broken basket of waste paper' in 1662.

teacher.kind: 永慈's own signed charge, in 寶峯禪師行錄
teacher.quote: 大鑑下二十九世祖寶峯禪師行錄。師諱智瑄．號寶峯．嗣金陵東山翼善慈。慈親書付囑曰．付智瑄長老祖衣一頂．拂子一枝．山偈一首…迷悟猶如空裏雲．碧天明淨了無痕…時景泰五年歲次甲戌春二月十一日．敕賜翼善禪寺開山臨濟下正嗣第二十四世傳法比丘永慈親書付囑
teacher.note: 永慈親書付囑 — Yongci's OWN HAND, dated 1454, naming 智瑄

teacher.quote: 天順五年歲次辛巳春上浣嗣法徒智瑄智璽等焚香拜錄
teacher.note: he signs as Yongci's 嗣法徒 (dharma-heir disciple) in 1461

bio.kind: 大咸's account, quoted and rejected by 智楷
bio.quote: 壬寅春因有司稽造僧籍房僧於破簏敗紙中．復檢出慈祖手書．付瑄祖偈一首。展讀祖澤如新益喜不自持
bio.note: THE FABRICATED VERSE. In spring 1662, while officials were compiling monk registers, a transmission verse from 'Cizu' to 'Xuanzu' was conveniently 'found' in a BROKEN BASKET OF WASTE PAPER. 智楷's verdict at 0479a27: 「惑元慧偽增之名．咸公偽揑之偈。公然錄寶峯智瑄為天奇之師」 — Yuanhui's forged NAME and Xian's fabricated VERSE, used to make Zhixuan into Tianqi's teacher.

bio.quote: 乃並錄為永慈之子．天奇之父。永慈有二子．可也。天奇有二父．可乎
bio.note: 'Yongci may have two sons. May Tianqi have two fathers?'

links.label: DILA A004727
links.confirms: NOT a separate DILA record — 智瑄 is merged into 明瑄's authority record. This is a DILA error.

bio: A SEPARATE MAN from Wuwen Mingcong — this is the answer to the question. A genuine dharma-heir of Tianqi Benrui, whom Zhikai locates at GUANTAO 館陶 (the 闢妄救 instead seats him at Longquan si, Guanziling, Suizhou, which Zhikai disputes because that seat belongs to Guangze Wuwen). He is NOT the teacher of Xiaoyan Debao. The 禪燈世譜 filed Xiaoyan under him, and later compilers welded the two Congs into one person; DILA still does (A004731). Zhikai states the distinction three separate times and puts the resulting absurdity in one line: 「天奇有二子．可也。笑巖有二父．可乎」 — Tianqi may have two SONS; may Xiaoyan have two FATHERS?

teacher.quote: 正聰雖為天奇之嗣．確非笑巖之師。明聰的為笑巖之師．確非天奇之嗣。今以二人合為一人．上嗣天奇．下出笑巖。天奇有二子．可也。笑巖有二父．好羞好羞
teacher.note: THE SPLIT, STATED FLATLY. Zhengcong IS Tianqi's heir but NOT Xiaoyan's teacher. Mingcong IS Xiaoyan's teacher but NOT Tianqi's heir.

teacher.kind: 密雲圓悟 闢妄救 world-sequence
teacher.quote: 第三十世焭絕天奇本瑞禪師 第三十一世隨州關子嶺正聰禪師
teacher.note: even the opposing party has 正聰 as Tianqi's heir — the Tianqi->Zhengcong edge is not in dispute; only his SEAT and his conflation with Mingcong are

bio.kind: 寶華通忍 / 五宗救 material, quoted in 正名錄
bio.quote: 延安無聞。雖係天奇之嗣。實非笑巖之師。光澤無聞。確為笑巖之師。實非天奇之嗣。今以二人混合為一人。上嗣天奇。下出笑巖。天奇有二子。可也。笑巖有二父。豈不取笑識者
bio.note: THE BRIEF'S QUOTE, located. 「豈不取笑識者」 — 'would this not make the discerning laugh?'

bio.quote: 傳略曰．絕學明聰．一作正聰．是以二人合為一人。目錄曰．延安無聞．此正宗一書．以三無聞合為一無聞
bio.note: caught in the act: one book's biography-header reads 「絕學明聰，一作正聰」 — the merge visible as an editorial note

bio.quote: 細考館陶絕學．臨潼無聞．延安無聞．雖皆天奇之嗣．實非笑巖之師。而光澤無聞．的係笑巖之師．確非天奇之嗣
bio.note: THREE of Tianqi's heirs bear these names — 館陶絕學, 臨潼無聞, 延安無聞 — and NONE of them is Xiaoyan's teacher. Zhikai's census runs to seven, plus two more from the Yuan/early Ming (安陸府 and 魯山縣).

links.label: DILA A004731
links.confirms: NOT a separate DILA record — 絕學正聰 is merged into 無聞明聰's authority record. THIS IS THE DILA ERROR THE BRIEF ASKED ABOUT, and it is confirmed: the aliases 無聞明聰 and 絕學正聰 sit in the same <person>.

bio: One of the 104 dharma-heirs named on Haizhou Yongci's 行實碑 at Yishan si. He belongs to the DONGMING branch (Wanfeng - Baozang Puchi - Dongming Huichan - Haizhou Yongci - Yunxi Zhiying), not to the Wanfeng-direct branch. He is a dharma-brother of Zhixuan (「瑛與寶峯瑄為昆季」). His heir Jing'an Zhisu wrote the 聯芳圖 that preserves this line. The 禪燈世譜 wrongly filed him and Jing'an Su under PUCI — Zhikai's 'error three': 「以永慈法嗣．混收為普慈一人之嗣」.

teacher.quote: 按永慈碑載法嗣一百有四人．雲溪智瑛其一也。瑛下出靜庵素
teacher.note: named on his teacher's stele among the 104

teacher.quote: 萬峯蔚禪師．寶藏持禪師．東明旵禪師．海舟慈禪師．雲溪瑛禪師
teacher.note: his own heir's lineage chart

teacher.quote: 雲溪瑛．淨庵素一脈．出自永慈。世譜譜普慈下
teacher.note: 'Yunxi Ying and Jing'an Su come from YONGCI; the Shipu charts them under PUCI'

teacher.quote: 瑛與寶峯瑄為昆季
teacher.note: dharma-brother of Zhixuan — both Yongci's heirs

links.label: DILA A020115
links.confirms: 雲溪智瑛, teacher A015692 永慈 — agrees with 正名錄

bio: Heir of Yunxi Zhiying, second-generation descendant of Haizhou Yongci. Author of the 聯芳圖 — the lineage chart that runs Gaofeng - Zhongfeng - Qianyan - Wanfeng - Baozang Puchi - Dongming Huichan - Haizhou [Yongci] - Yunxi Ying. That chart is genuine and belongs to HIS branch. Its misuse is the hinge of the whole forgery: because it says 'Haizhou' without a personal name, and because only one Haizhou was known, Longchi and then Tiantong read it as proof that Haizhou PUCI descended from Dongming, and spliced Baozang and Dongming into the other branch. The chart was never wrong; the reading of it was.

teacher.quote: 按永慈碑載法嗣一百有四人．雲溪智瑛其一也。瑛下出靜庵素．素所敘之海舟．自是敘東明嫡嗣海舟永慈也
teacher.note: 瑛下出靜庵素

teacher.quote: 雲溪瑛．淨庵素一脈．出自永慈。世譜譜普慈下

bio.kind: 正名錄 — the genealogy of the error
bio.quote: 故以海舟普慈紹東明．以合其七世之數．以致疊出寶藏東明二代。此源流錯誤之始也
bio.note: THE MOTIVE, IN ONE SENTENCE. Longchi made Puci inherit from Dongming IN ORDER TO MAKE THE SEVEN-GENERATION COUNT WORK — the count that came from Guxi's eulogy, which was for the OTHER Haizhou. An arithmetic patch on a misidentification.

links.label: DILA A020535
links.confirms: 靜庵智素, teacher A020115 智瑛 — agrees with 正名錄
